text:
Ek be-daleel riwayat aur wafaye-ahd ki takeed. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) se kaha! Aap mujhe khaas nasihat kijiye. Aap ne farmaya "Jab tu Quran mein lafz-e-aayat (Ya Ayyuhallazina Aamanu) sun le toh foran kaan laga kar dil se mutawajja ho ja, kyunke is ke baad kisi na kisi bhalai ka hukum hoga ya kisi na kisi burai se muman'at hogi." Hazrat Zuhri farmate hain "Jahan kahin Allah Ta'ala ne imaan walon ko koi hukum diya hai us hukum mein Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi shamil hain." Hazrat Faisama farmate hain ke Taurat mein bajaye (Ya Ayyuhallazina Aamanu) ke (Ya Ayyuhal-Masakin) hai. Ek riwayat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke naam se bayan ki jaati hai ke jahan kahin lafz-e-aayat (Ya Ayyuhallazina Aamanu) hai, un tamam mawaqe par un sab imaan walon ke sardar-o-shareef aur ameer Hazrat Ali (R.A) hain, Ashab-e-Rasool mein se har ek ko danta gaya hai bajuz Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib (R.A) ke ke unhein kisi amr mein nahin danta gaya, yaad rahe ke yeh asar bilkul be-daleel hai. Is ke alfaaz munkar hain aur is ki sanad bhi sahih nahin. Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) farmate hain is ka rawi Isa bin Rashid majhool hai, is ki riwayat munkar hai. Main kehta hoon isi tarah is ka dusra rawi Ali bin Bazima go siqah hai magar aala darja ka Shia hai. Phir bhala is ki aisi riwayat jo us ke apne khaas khayalat ki ta'eed mein ho, kaise qabool ki ja sake gi? Yaqeenan woh is mein na-qabil-e-qabool thehre ga, is riwayat mein yeh kaha gaya hai ke tamam Sahaba ko bajuz Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke danta gaya, is se murad un ki woh aayat hai jis mein Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sargoshi karne se pehle sadqa nikalne ka hukum diya tha, pas ek se zyada mufassireen ne kaha hai ke is par amal sirf Hazrat Ali (R.A) hi ne kiya aur phir yeh farman utra ke aayat (ءَاَشْفَقْتُمْ اَنْ تُقَدِّمُوْا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوٰىكُمْ صَدَقٰتٍ) (Surah Al-Mujadilah: 13) lekin yeh ghalat hai ke is aayat mein Sahaba ko danta gaya, balkeh dar-asal yeh hukum bator-e-wajib ke tha hi nahin, ikhtiyari amr tha. Phir is par amal hone se pehle hi Allah Ta'ala ne ise mansookh kar diya. Pas haqeeqatan kisi se is ke khilaf amal sarzad hi nahin hua. Phir yeh baat bhi ghalat hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko kisi baat mein danta nahin gaya. Surah Anfal ki aayat mulahiza ho jis mein un tamam Sahaba ko danta gaya hai jinhon ne Badri qaidiyon se fidiya le kar unhein chhor dene ka mashwara diya tha, dar-asal siwaye Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ke baqi tamam Sahaba ka mashwara yahi tha pas yeh daant bajuz Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke baqi sab ko hai, jin mein Hazrat Ali (R.A) bhi shamil hain, pas yeh tamam baatein is amr ki khuli daleel hain ke yeh asar bilkul za'eef aur bouda hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Ibn-e-Jarir mein Hazrat Muhammad bin Salma farmate hain jo kitab Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Amr bin Hazm ko likhwa kar di thi jabke unhein Najran bheja tha, is kitab ko main ne Abu Bakr bin Hazm ke paas dekha tha aur ise parha tha, is mein Allah aur Rasool ke bohat se ahkaam thay, is mein aayat (Yaa Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Awfoo Bil-Uqood) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 1) se aayat (Yas'aloonaka Maaza Uhilla Lahum, Qul Uhilla Lakumut-Tayyibaatu Wamaa Allamtum Min-al-Jawaarihi Mukallibeena Tu'allimoonahunna Mimmaa Allamakumullah, Fakuloo Mimmaa Amsakna Alaikum Wazkurusmallahi Alaih, Wattaqullah, Innallaha Saree-ul-Hisaab) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 4) tak bhi likha hua tha. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Amr bin Hazm ke pote Hazrat Abu Bakr bin Muhammad ne farmaya hamare paas Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki yeh kitab hai jise Aap (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Amr bin Hazm ko likh kar di thi jabke unhein Yaman walon ko deeni samajh aur hadees sikhane ke liye aur un se Zakat wasool karne ke liye Yaman bheja tha, us waqt yeh kitab likh kar di thi, is mein ahd-o-paiman aur hukm-o-ahkaam ka bayan yeh. Is mein aayat (Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim) ke baad likha hai yeh kitab hai Allah aur us ke Rasool ki taraf se, imaan walo wadon ko aur ahd-o-paiman ko pura karo, yeh ahd Muhammad Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki taraf se Amr bin Hazm ke liye hai jabke unhein Yaman bheja unhein apne tamam kamon mein Allah Ta'ala se darte rehne ka hukm hai yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala un ke sath hai jo us se darte rahein aur jo ehsan khuloos aur neki karein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) waghaira farmate hain "Uqood se murad ahd hain." Ibn-e-Jarir is par ijma batate hain. Khwah qasamia ahd-o-paiman ho ya aur wade hon, sab ko pura karna farz hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh bhi marwi hai ke "Ahd ko pura karne mein Allah ke halal ko halal janna, us ke haram ko haram janna, us ke faraiz ki pabandi karna, us ki had-bandi ki nigahdasht karna bhi hai, kisi baat ka khilaf na karo, had ko na toro, kisi haram kaam ko na karo, is par sakhti bohat hai. Parho aayat (Wallazeena Yanqudoona Ahdallahi Mim-ba'di Meesaqihi Wa Yaqta'oona Maa Amarallahu Bihi An Yoosala Wa Yufsidoona Fil-Ardi, Ulaa'ika Lahumul-La'natu Wa Lahum Soo-ud-Daar) (Surah Ar-Ra'd: 25).

Hazrat Zahhak farmate hain "Is se murad yeh ke Allah ke halal ko, us ke haram ko, us ke wadon ko, jo iman ke baad har momin ke zimme aa jate hain pura karna Allah ki taraf se farz hai, faraiz ki pabandi, halal haram ki aqidat mandi waghera waghera." Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain "Yeh chhay ahd hain, Allah ka ahd, aapas ki yaganat ka qasmiya ahd, shirkat ka ahd, tijarat ka ahd, nikah ka ahd aur qasmiya wada." Muhammad bin Ka'ab kehte hain "Paanch hain, jin mein jahiliyat ke zamana ki qasmein hain aur shirkat tijarat ke ahd-o-paiman hain, jo log kehte hain ke kharido farokht puri ho chukne ke baad go ab tak kharida aur bechne wale ek dusre se juda na hue hon taham wapas lautane ka ikhtiyar nahin woh apni daleel is ayat ko batlate hain." Imam Abu Hanifa aur Imam Malik ka yahi mazhab hai, lekin Imam Shafi aur Imam Ahmad is ke khilaf hain aur jumhur ulama-e-kiram bhi is ke mukhalif hain, aur daleel mein woh sahih hadith pesh karte hain jo Sahih Bukhari Muslim mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar se marwi hai ke Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya "Kharido farokht karne walon ko saude ke wapas lene dene ka ikhtiyar hai jab tak ke juda juda na ho jayen." Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki ek riwayat mein yun bhi hai ke "Jab woh shakhson ne kharido farokht karli to un mein se har ek ko dusre se alaihida hone tak ikhtiyar baqi hai." Yeh hadith saaf aur sarih hai ke yeh ikhtiyar kharido farokht pure ho chukne ke baad ka hai. Haan ise bai ke lazim ho jane ke khilaf na samjha jaye balkeh yeh shar'i taur par isi ka muqtazi hai, pas ise nibhana bhi isi ayat ke matehat zaroori hai. Phir farmata hai maweshi chaupaye tumhare liye halal kiye gaye hain yani unt, gaye, bakri. Abul Hasan, Qatada waghera ka yahi qaul hai. Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain "Arab mein un ke lughat ke mutabiq bhi yahi hai." Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas waghera bahut se buzurgon ne is ayat se istidlal kiya hai ke jis halal madda ko zibah kiya jaye aur us ke pet mein se bacha nikle go woh murda ho phir bhi halal hai. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke sahaba ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya ke untni, gaye, bakri zibah ki jati hai, un ke pet se bacha nikalta hai to hum use kha len ya phenk den. Aap ne farmaya "Agar chaho kha lo, is ka zabiha is ki maa ka zabiha hai." Imam Tirmidhi ise hasan kehte hain, Abu Dawood mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain "Pet ke andar wale bache ka zabiha is ki maa ka zabiha hai." Phir farmata hai magar woh jin ka bayan tumhare samne kiya jaye ga. Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain "Is se matlab murdar, khoon aur khinzeer ka gosht hai."

Hazrat Qatadah R.H farmate hain "murad is se az-khud mara hua janwar aur woh janwar hai jis ke zabiha par Allah ka naam na liya gaya ho". Poora ilm toh Allah Ta'ala ko hi hai lekin ba-zahir yeh maloom hota hai ke is se murad Allah ka farman aayat (Hurrimat 'alaikumul maitatu waddamu wa lahmul khinziri wa ma uhilla lighairillahi bihi wal-munkhaniqatu wal-mauquzatu wal-mutaraddiyatu wannatihatu wa ma akalas-sabu'u illa ma zakkaitum wa ma zubiha 'alan-nusubi wa an tastaqsimu bil-azlami zalikum fisqun, al-yauma ya'isallazina kafaru min dinikum fala takhshawhum wakhshawni, al-yauma akmaltu lakum dinakum wa atmamtu 'alaikum ni'mati wa raditu lakumul-islama dina, famanidturra fi makhmasatin ghaira mutajanifin li-ithmin fa-innallaha Ghafurur-Rahim) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 3) hai. Ya'ni tum par murdar aur khoon aur khinzir ka gosht aur har woh cheez jo Allah ke siwa dusre ke naam par mansoob-o-mashhoor ki jaye aur jo gala ghontne se mar jaye, kisi zarb se mar jaye, oonchi jagah se gir kar mar jaye aur kisi takkar lagne se mar jaye, jise darinda khane lage, pas yeh bhi go maweshiyon chaupayon mein se hain lekin in wujooh se woh haram ho jate hain, isi liye is ke baad farmaya lekin jis ko zibah kar daalo. Jo janwar parastish-gahon par zibah kiya jaye, woh bhi haram hai aur aisa haram ke is mein se koi cheez halal nahin, isi liye is se istidrak nahin kiya gaya aur halal ke sath is ka koi fard milaya nahin gaya, pas yahan yahi farmaya ja raha hai ke chaupaye maweshi tum par halal hain lekin woh jin ka zikr abhi aayega, ba'z ahwal mein haram hain. Is ke baad ka jumla haliyat ki bina par mansoob hai. Murad an'am se aam hai, ba'z toh woh jo insanon mein rehte palte hain, jaise oont, gaye, bakri aur ba'z woh jo jungli hain jaise hiran, neel-gaye aur jungli gadhe. Pas paaltu janwaron mein se toh un ko makhsoos kar liya jo bayan hue aur wahshi janwaron mein se ehram ki halat mein kisi ko bhi shikar karna mamnoo' qarar diya. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad yeh hai "hum ne tumhare liye chaupaye janwar har hal mein halal kiye hain pas tum ehram ki halat mein shikar khelne se ruk jao aur ise haram jano" kyunke Allah Ta'ala ka yahi hukm hai, jis tarah is ke tamam ahkam sarasar hikmat se pur hain, isi tarah is ki har muman'at mein bhi hikmat hai, Allah woh hukm farmata hai jo irada karta hai. Imandar! Rabb ki nishaniyon ki tauheen na karo, ya'ni manasik-e-Hajj, Safa, Marwah, qurbani ke janwar, oont aur Allah ki haram karda har cheez, hurmat wale mahinon samet kisi ki tauheen na karo, in ka adab karo, in ka lihaz rakho, in ki azmat ko mano aur in mein khusoosiyat ke sath Allah ki nafarmaniyon se bacho aur in mubarak aur mohtaram mahinon mein apne dushmanon se az-khud ladai na chhero.

Jaise irshad hai aayat (YAS-ALUNAKA 'ANISH-SHAHRIL-HARAMI QITALIN FIH. QUL QITALUN FIHI KABIR. WA SADDUN 'AN SABILILLAHI WA KUFRUM BIHI WAL-MASJIDIL-HARAMI WA IKHRAJU AHLIHI MINHU AKBARU 'INDALLAH. WAL-FITNATU AKBARU MINAL-QATL. WA LA YAZALUNA YUQATILUNAKUM HATTA YARUDDUKUM 'AN DINIKUM INISTATA'U. WA MAY-YARTADID MINKUM 'AN DINIHI FAYAMUT WA HUWA KAFIRUN FA-ULA-IKA HABITAT A'MALUHUM FID-DUNYA WAL-AKHIRAH. WA ULA-IKA ASHABUN-NAR. HUM FIHA KHALIDUN) (2. Al-Baqarah: 217). Ae Nabi log tum se hurmat wale mahinon mein jang karne ka hukum puchte hain tum un se kaho ke in mein ladai karna gunah hai aur aayat mein hai mahinon ki ginti Allah ke nazdeek barah hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A se marvi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hajjat-ul-Wida mein farmaya "Zamana ghoom gham kar theek isi tarz par aa gaya hai jis par woh us waqt tha, jis din Allah Ta'ala ne aasman aur zameen ko paida kiya tha. Saal barah maah ka hai, jin mein se chaar maah hurmat wale hain. Teen to yakke baad deegare Zul-Qa'dah, Zul-Hijjah aur Muharram aur chautha Rajab, jise qabila Mudar Rajab kehta hai jo Jamadi-ul-Akhir aur Sha'ban ke darmiyan hai." Is se yeh bhi maloom hua ke in mahinon ki hurmat ta-qayamat hai jaise ke salaf ki ek jama'at ka mazhab hai aayat ki tafsir mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A waghera se yeh marvi hai ke "in mahinon mein ladai karna halal na kar liya karo." Lekin jumhoor ka mazhab yeh hai ke yeh hukum mansookh hai aur hurmat wale mahinon mein bhi dushmanan-e-Islam se jihad ki ibtida karna bhi jaiz hai. Un ki daleel Allah Ta'ala ka yeh farman hai aayat (FA-IDHAN-SALAKHAL-ASH-HURUL-HURUMU FAQ-TULUL-MUSHRIKINA HAITHU WAJATTUMUHUM WA KHUZUHUM WA AHSURUHUM WAQ-'UDU LAHUM KULLA MARSAD. FA-IN TABU WA AQAMUS-SALATA WA ATUZ-ZAKATA FA-KHALLU SABILAHUM. INNALLAHA GAFURUR-RAHIM) (9. At-Tawbah: 5) yani jab hurmat wale mahine guzar jayen to mushrikeen ko qatl karo jahan pao aur murad yahan in chaar mahinon ka guzar jana hai, jab woh chaar mahine guzar chuke jo us waqt the, to ab un ke baad barabar jihad jaari hai aur Quran ne phir koi mahina khaas nahin kiya, balkay Imam Abu Ja'far R.H to is par ijma naqal karte hain ke "Allah Ta'ala ne mushrikeen se jihad karna, har waqt aur har mahine mein jaari hi rakha hai." Aap farmate hain ke is par bhi ijma hai ke "agar koi kafir haram ke tamam darakhton ki chhaal apne upar lapet le tab bhi us ke liye aman-o-aman na samjhi jayegi. Agar musalmanon ne az-khud us se pehle use aman na diya ho." Is masla ki poori behas yahan nahin ho sakti. Phir farmaya ke Hady aur Qalaid ki be-hurmati bhi mat karo.

Ya'ni Baitullah Sharif ki taraf qurbaniyan bhejna band na karo, kyunke is mein Allah ki nishaniyon ki ta'zeem hai aur qurbani ke liye jo oont Bait-ul-Haram ki taraf bhejo, un ke gale mein bator-e-nishan patta dalne se bhi na ruko. Taake is nishan se har koi pehchan le ke yeh janwar Allah ke liye, Allah ki rah ke liye waqf ho chuka hai, ab ise koi burai se hath na lagaye ga, balkay ise dekh kar dusron ko bhi shauq paida hoga ke hum bhi is tarah Allah ke naam janwar bhejein aur is surat mein tumhein is ki neki par bhi ajar mile ga, kyunke jo shakhs dusron ko hidayat ki taraf bulaye, use bhi woh ajar mile ga jo us ki baat maan kar us par amal karne walon ko milta hai. Yeh bhi khayal rahe Allah Ta'ala un ke ajar ko kam kar ke ise nahin de ga balkay ise apne paas se ata farmaye ga. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab Hajj ke liye nikle to aap ne wadi-e-Aqeeq ya'ni Zul-Hulaifa mein raat guzari, subah apni nau biwiyon ke paas gaye, phir ghusal kar ke khushbu mali aur do rakat namaz ada ki aur apni qurbani ke janwar ke kohan par nishan kiya aur gale mein patta dala aur Hajj aur Umre ka ehram bandha. Qurbani ke liye aap ne bahut khush-rang, mazboot aur naujawan oont saath se upar upar apne saath liye the, jaise ke Quran ka farman hai jo shakhs Allah ke ahkaam ki ta'zeem kare us ka dil taqwe wala hai. Ba'az salaf ka farman hai ke "Ta'zeem yeh bhi hai ke qurbani ke janwaron ko achi tarah rakha jaye aur unhein khoob khilaya jaye aur mazboot aur mota kiya jaye." Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib (R.A) farmate hain "Hamein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukum diya ke hum qurbani ke janwaron ki aankhein aur kaan dekh bhaal kar khareedein" (Rawah Ahl-us-Sunan). Muqatil bin Hayyan farmate hain "Jahiliyat ke zamane mein jab yeh log apne watan se nikalte the aur hurmat wale mahine nahin hote the to yeh apne upar baalon aur oon ko lapet lete the aur haram mein rehne wale mushrik log haram ke darakhton ki chhalein apne jism par bandh lete the, is se aam log unhein aman dete the aur un ko marte peette na the." Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se barwayat Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se marwi hai ke is surat ki do aayatein mansookh hain "Aayat-e-Qalaid aur yeh aayat (Fa-in ja'ooka fahkum bainahum au a'rid 'anhum, wa in tu'rid 'anhum falan yadurruka shai'an) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 42)" lekin Hazrat Hasan (R.H) se jab sawal hota hai ke "Kya is surat mein se koi aayat mansookh hui hai?" to aap farmate hain "Nahin." Hazrat Atta (R.H) farmate hain ke "Woh log haram ke darakhton ki chhalein latka liya karte the aur is se unhein aman milta tha, pas Allah Ta'ala ne haram ke darakhton ko katna mana farma diya." Phir farmata hai "Jo log Baitullah ke irade se nikle hon, un se ladai mat lado. Yahan jo aaye woh aman mein pahunch gaya, pas jo is ke qasd se chala hai us ki niyat Allah ke fazl ki talash aur us ki razamandi ki justuju hai to ab ise dar-khauf ke dabao mein na rakho, is ki izzat aur adab karo aur ise Baitullah se na roko."

Ba'az ka qaul hai ke "Allah ka fazl talash karne se murad tijarat hai." Jaise is aayat mein hai (Laisa 'alaikum junahun an tabtaghu fadlan mir-rabbikum) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 198) yani zamana-e-hajj mein tijarat karne mein tum par koi gunah nahin. Rizwan se murad hajj karne mein Allah ki marzi ko talash karna hai. Ibn-e-Jarir waghera farmate hain "Yeh aayat Khatim bin Hind, Bakri ke bare mein nazil hui hai, is shakhs ne Madina ki charagah par dhawa dala tha phir agle saal yeh umre ke irade se aa raha tha to ba'az sahaba ka irada hua ke ise raste mein rokein, is par yeh farman nazil hua." Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne is masle par ijma naqal kiya hai ke "Jo mushrik musalmanon ki aman liye hue na ho to chahe woh Baitullah Sharif ke irade se ja raha ho ya Bait-ul-Muqaddas ke irade se, use qatl karna jaiz hai yeh hukm unke haq mein mansookh hai wallahu a'alam wahan jo shakhs wahan ilhad phailane ke liye ja raha hai aur shirk-o-kufr ke irade ka qasd karta ho to use roka jayega." Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain pehle momin-o-mushrik sab hajj karte the aur Allah Ta'ala ki muman'at thi ke kisi momin kafir ko na roko lekin iske baad yeh aayat utri ke (Ya ayyuhallazina amanu innammal mushrikuna najasun fala yaqrabul masjidal harama ba'da 'amihim haza, wa in khiftum 'ailatan fasaufa yughnikumullahu min fadlihi in sha'a, innallaha 'alimun hakim) (Surah At-Tawbah: 28) yani mushrikeen sarasar najas hain aur woh is saal ke baad Masjid-e-Haram ke paas bhi na aayenge aur farman hai aayat (Innama ya'muru masajidallahi man amana billahi wal yaumil akhiri wa aqamas salata wa ataz zakata wa lam yakhsha illallaha fa'asa ula'ika ay-yakunu minal muhtadeen) (Surah At-Tawbah: 18) yani mushrikeen Allah ki masjid ko abad rakhne ke hargiz ahl nahin. Farman hai aayat (Innama ya'muru masajidallahi man amana billahi wal yaumil akhiri wa aqamas salata wa ataz zakata wa lam yakhsha illallaha fa'asa ula'ika ay-yakunu minal muhtadeen) (Surah At-Tawbah: 18) yani Allah ki masjid ko to sirf wohi abad rakh sakte hain jo Allah par aur Qayamat ke din par iman rakhte hon. Pas mushrikeen masjidon se rok diye gaye, Hazrat Qatadah R.H farmate hain mansookh hai, jahiliyat ke zamana mein jab koi shakhs apne ghar se hajj ke irade se nikalta to woh darakht ki chhaal waghera bandh leta to raste mein use koi na satata, phir laut-te waqt baalon ka haar daal leta aur mehfooz rehta us waqt tak mushrikeen Baitullah se roke na jaate the, ab musalmanon ko hukm diya gaya ke woh hurmat wale mahinon mein na ladein aur na Baitullah ke paas ladein, phir is hukm ko is aayat ne mansookh kardiya ke mushrikeen se lado jahan kahin unhein pao.

Ibn-e-Jarir ka qaul hai ke "Qala'id se murad yahi hai jo haar woh Haram se gale mein daal lete thay aur uski wajah se aman mein rehte thay, Arab mein iski ta'zeem barabar chali aa rahi thi aur jo iske khilaf karta tha usey bahut bura kaha jata tha aur shayar usko hajv karte thay." Phir farmata hai "Jab tum ehram khol daalo toh shikar kar sakte ho." Ehram mein shikar ki muman'at thi, ab ehram ke baad phir iski ibahat ho gayi. Jo hukm muman'at ke baad ho us hukm se wahi sabit hota hai jo muman'at se pehle asal mein tha. Ya'ni agar wujub-e-asli tha toh muman'at ke baad ka amr bhi wujub ke liye hoga. Aur isi tarah mustahab-o-mubah ke bare mein. Go baaz ne kaha hai ke aisa amr wujub ke liye hi hota hai aur baaz ne kaha hai, sirf mubah hone ke liye hi hota hai lekin dono jamaton ke khilaf Quran ki ayatein maujood hain. Pas sahih mazhab jis se tamam daleelein mil jayen wahi hai jo hum ne zikr kiya aur baaz ulama-e-usool ne bhi isey hi ikhtiyar kiya, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmata hai jis qaum ne tumhein Hudaibiya wale saal Masjid-e-Haram se roka tha toh tum un se dushmani baandh kar qisas par amada ho kar Allah ke hukm se aage badh kar zulm-o-ziyadati par na utar aana, balkeh tumhein kisi waqt bhi adl ko haath se na chhodna chahiye. Isi tarah ki woh ayat bhi hai jis mein farmaya hai "Tumhein kisi qisam ki adawat khilaf-e-adl karne par amada na kar de. Adl kiya karo, adl hi taqwe se zyada qareeb hai." Baaz salaf ka qaul hai ke "Go koi tujh se tere bare mein Allah ki nafarmani kare lekin tujhe chahiye ke tu us ke bare mein Allah ki farmanbardari hi kare. Adl hi ki wajah se aasman-o-zameen qaim hain." Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aur aap ke ashab ko jabkeh mushrikeen ne Baitullah ki ziyarat se roka aur Hudaibiya se aage badhne hi na diya, isi ranj-o-gham mein sahaba wapas aa rahe thay jo mushrik-e-Makkah jate hue unhein mile toh un ka irada hua ke jaise un ke garohon ne hamein roka hum bhi inhein un tak na jane dein. Is par yeh ayat utri. (Shanan) ke ma'ni bughz ke hain, baaz Arab isey shinan bhi kehte hain lekin kisi qari ki yeh qira'at marwi nahin, haan arabi sheron mein shantan bhi aaya hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne iman wale bandon ko neki ke kamon par ek dusre ki ta'eed karne ko farmata hai, "Bir" kehte hain nekiyan karne ko aur "Taqwa" kehte hain buraiyon ke chhodne ko aur unhein mana farmata hai gunahon aur haram kamon par kisi ki madad karne ko. Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain jis kaam ke karne ka Allah ka hukm ho aur insaan usey na kare, yeh "Ism" hai aur deen mein jo haddein Allah ne muqarrar kar di hain jo faraiz apni jaan ya dusron ke bare mein Janab-e-Bari ne muqarrar farmaye hain, un se aage nikal jana "Udwan" hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai "Apne bhai ki madad kar, khwah woh zalim ho khwah mazloom ho" toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke "Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mazloom hone ki surat mein madad karna theek hai lekin zalim hone ki surat mein kaise madad karein?"

Farmaya "Use zulm na karne do, zulm se rok lo, yahi us waqt ki uski madad hai" yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai "Jo musalman logon se mile jule aur deen ke hawaley se unki ezaon par sabr kare woh un musalmanon se bade ajar wala hai, jo na logon se mile jule, na unki ezaon par sabr kare" Musnad-e-Bazzar mein hai "Jo shakhs kisi bhali baat ki dusre ko hidayat kare woh us bhalai ke karne wale jaisa hi hai" Imam Abu Bakr Bazzar ise bayan farma kar farmate hain ke "Yeh hadith sirf isi ek sanad se marwi hai." Lekin main kehta hoon iski shahid yeh sahi hadith hai ke jo shakhs hidayat ki taraf logon ko bulaye, use un tamam ke barabar sawab milega jo Qayamat tak aayenge aur uski tabedari karenge. Lekin unke sawab mein se ghata kar nahin aur jo shakhs kisi ko burai ki taraf chalaye to Qayamat tak jitne log us burai ko karenge. Un sab ka jitna gunah hoga, woh sara us akele ko hoga. Lekin unke gunah ghata kar nahin. Tabrani mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain "Jo shakhs kisi zalim ke sath jaye taake uski iaanat-o-imdad kare aur woh janta ho ke yeh zalim hai woh yaqeenan deen-e-Islam se kharij ho jata hai."

Shikari kuttay aur shikar chunke is se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne nuqsan pohanchane wali khabeeth cheezon ki hurmat ka bayan farmaya khwah nuqsan jismani ho ya deeni ya dono, phir zaroorat ki halat ke ahkamat makhsoos karaye gaye jaise farman hai ayat (وَقَدْ فَصَّلَ لَكُمْ مَّا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ اِلَّا مَا اضْطُرِرْتُمْ اِلَيْهِ) (Surah Al-An'am: 119) yani tamam haram janwaron ka bayan tafseel se tumhare samne aa chuka hai yeh aur baat hai ke tum halat ki bina par bebas aur be-qarar ho jao. To is ke baad irshad ho raha hai ke halal cheezon ke daryaft karne walon se keh dijiye ke tamam pak cheezain tum par halal hain, Surah A'raf mein An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh sifat bayan farmayi gayi hai ke aap tayyab cheezon ko halal karte hain aur khabeeth cheezon ko haram karte hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke qabeela Tai ke do shakhson Hazrat Adi bin Hatim (R.A) aur Zaid bin Muhalhil (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke murda janwar to haram ho chuka ab halal kya hai? Is par yeh ayat utri. Hazrat Saeed (R.H) farmate hain yani zibah kiye hue janwar halal tayyab hain. Muqatil (R.H) farmate hain har halal rizq tayyibat mein dakhil hai. Imam Zuhri (R.H) se sawal kiya gaya ke dawa ke tor par peshab ka peena kaisa hai? Jawab diya ke woh tayyibat mein dakhil nahin. Imam Malik (R.H) se poocha gaya ke us mitti ka bechna kaisa hai jise log khate hain farmaya woh tayyibat mein dakhil nahin aur tumhare liye shikari janwaron ke zariye khela hua shikar bhi halal kiya jata hai maslan sudhaye hue kuttay aur shikray waghera ke zariye. Yehi mazhab hai jamhoor sahaba, tabieen, aimma waghera ka. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke shikari sudhaye hue kuttay, baaz, cheetay, shikray waghera har woh parinda jo shikar karne ki taleem diya ja sakta ho aur bhi bohat se buzurgon se yehi marwi hai ke phaadne wale janwaron aur aise hi parindon mein se jo bhi taleem hasil kar le, un ke zariye shikar khelna halal hai, lekin Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se marwi hai ke unhon ne tamam shikari parindon ka kiya hua shikar makrooh kaha hai aur daleel mein ayat (ۙوَمَا عَلَّمْتُمْ مِّنَ الْجَوَارِحِ مُكَلِّبِيْنَ تُعَلِّمُوْنَهُنَّ مِمَّا عَلَّمَكُمُ اللّٰهُ ۡ فَكُلُوْا مِمَّآ اَمْسَكْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْهِ ۠ وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 4) parha hai. Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) se bhi isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai. Zahhak aur Suddi (R.H) ka bhi yehi qaul Ibn-e-Jareer mein marwi hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) farmate hain baaz waghera parind jo shikar pakrein agar woh tumhein zinda mil jaye to tum zibah kar ke kha lo warna na khao, lekin jamhoor ulama-e-Islam ka fatwa yeh hai ke shikari parindon ke zariye jo shikar ho, us ka aur shikari kutton ke kiye hue shikar ka ek hi hukum hai, un mein tafreeq karne ki koi cheez baqi nahin rehti.

Charon imamon waghera ka mazhab bhi yahi hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko pasand karte hain aur is ki daleel mein is hadith ko late hain ke Hazrat Adi bin Hatim ne Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se baaz ke kiye hue shikar ka masla poocha to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya "Jis janwar ko woh tere liye rok rakhe to use kha le." Imam Ahmad ne siyah kutte ka kiya hua shikar bhi mustasna kar liya hai, is liye ke un ke nazdeek is ka qatl karna wajib hai aur palna haram hai, kyunke Sahih Muslim mein hadith hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain "Namaz ko teen cheezein tod deti hain, gadha, aurat aur siyah kutta." Is par Hazrat Abi ne sawal kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) siyah kutte ki khusoosiyat ki kya wajah hai? To Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya "Shaitan hai." Doosri hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kutton ke maar dalne ka hukum diya phir farmaya in kutton se kya wasta? In kutton mein se sakht siyah kutton ko maar dala karo. Shikari haiwanat ko jawarih is liye kaha gaya ke jarh kehte hain kasb aur kamai ko, jaise Arab kehte hain (Fulan jaraha ahlahu khairan) yani falan shakhs ne apni ahl ke liye bhalai hasil kar li aur Arab kehte hain (Fulan la jariha lahu) falan shakhs ka koi kamau nahin, Quran mein bhi lafz jarh kasb aur kamai aur hasil karne ke ma'ani mein aaya hai farman hai ayat (Wa ya'lamu ma jarahtum bin-nahar) (6. Al-An'am: 60) yani din ko jo bhalai burai tum hasil karte ho aur use bhi Allah janta hai. Is ayat-e-karima ke utarne ki wajah Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein yeh hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kutton ke qatl karne ka hukum diya aur woh qatl kiye jane lage to logon ne aakar Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jis ummat ke qatl ka hukum Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne diya un se hamare liye kya faida halal hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khamosh rahe is par yeh ayat utri. Pas Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jab koi shakhs apne kutte ko shikar ke peeche chhore aur Bismillah bhi kahe phir woh shikar pakad le aur rok rakhe to jab tak woh na khaye yeh kha le. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai "Jibraeel ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se andar aane ki ijazat chahi, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ijazat di lekin woh phir bhi andar na aaye to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ae qasid-e-Rabb hum to tumhein ijazat de chuke phir kyun nahin aate? Is par farishte ne kaha! Hum is ghar mein nahin jate, jis mein kutta ho, is par Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Rafe ko hukum diya ke Madine ke kul kutte maar dale jayen, Abu Rafe farmate hain, main gaya aur sab kutton ko qatl karne laga, ek burhiya ke paas kutta tha, jo us ke daman mein lipatne laga aur bator faryad us ke samne bhonkne laga, mujhe reham aa gaya aur main ne use chhor diya aur aakar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko khabar di Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukum diya ke use bhi baqi na chhoro, main phir wapas gaya aur use bhi qatl kar diya, ab logon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke jis ummat ke qatl ka Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukum diya hai, un se koi faida hamare liye halal bhi hai ya nahin? Is par ayat (Yas'alunaka) ilakh, nazil hui.

Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Madine ke kutton ko qatl kar ke phir Abu Rafi aas paas ki bastiyon mein pahunche aur masla daryaft karne walon ke naam bhi is mein hain yani Hazrat Asim bin Adi, Hazrat Saeed bin Khaithama, Hazrat Uwaimir bin Sa'idah. Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi farmate hain ke aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool kutton ka qatl hai. (Mukallibeen) ka lafz mumkin hai ke (Allamtum) ki zameer yani fa'il ka haal ho aur mumkin hai ke jawarih yani maqtool ka haal ho. Yani jin shikar hasil karne wale janwaron ko tum ne sudhaya ho aur halanke woh shikar ko apne panjon aur nakhunon se shikar karte hon, is se bhi yeh istidlal ho sakta hai ke shikari janwar jab shikar ko apne sadme se hi daboch kar maar dale to woh halal na hoga jaise ke Imam Shafi'i R.H ke dono qaulon mein se ek qaul hai aur ulama ki ek jama'at ka khayal hai. Isi liye farmaya "tum ne unhein is se kuch sikha diya ho jo Allah ne tumhein sikha rakha hai" yani jab tum chhoro, jaye, jab tum rok lo ruk jaye aur shikar pakar kar tumhare liye rok rakhe. Taake tum ja kar use le lo, us ne khud apne liye use shikar na kiya ho, is liye is ke baad hi farmaya ke jab shikari janwar sudhaya hua ho aur us ne apne chhorne wale ke liye shikar kiya ho aur us ne bhi us ke chhorne ke waqt Allah ka naam liya ho to woh shikar musalmanon ke liye halal hai go woh shikar mar bhi gaya ho, is par ijma hai. Is aayat ke masle ke mutabiq hi Bukhari o Muslim ki yeh hadith hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam R.A ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main Allah ka naam le kar apne sudhaye hue kutte ko shikar par chhorta hoon to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya jis janwar ko woh pakar rakhe to use kha le agarche kutte ne use maar bhi dala ho, haan yeh zaroor hai ke us ke sath shikar karne mein doosra kutta na mila ho is liye ke tu ne apne kutte ko Allah ka naam le kar chhora hai doosre ko Bismillah parh kar nahin chhora. Main ne kaha ke main nokdar lakri se shikar khelta hoon farmaya agar woh apni tezi ki taraf se zakhmi kare to kha le aur agar apni chorai ki taraf se laga ho to na kha kyunke woh lath mara hua hai. Doosri riwayat mein yeh lafz hain ke jab tu apne kutte ko chhore to Allah ka naam parh liya kar phir woh shikar ko tere liye pakar rakhe aur tere pahunch jaane par shikar zinda mil jaye to tu use zibah kar daal aur agar kutte ne hi use maar dala ho aur us mein se khaya na ho to tu use bhi kha sakta hai is liye ke kutte ka use shikar kar lena hi us ka zabiha hai aur riwayat mein yeh alfaaz bhi hain ke "agar us ne kha liya ho to phir use na kha, mujhe to dar hai ke kahin us ne apne khane ke liye shikar na pakra ho?" Yehi daleel jamhoor ki hai aur haqiqatan Imam Shafi'i R.H ka sahih mazhab bhi yehi hai ke jab kutta shikar ko kha le to woh mutlaqan haram ho jata hai is mein koi gunjaish nahin jaisa ke hadith mein hai. Haan salaf ki ek jama'at ka yeh qaul bhi hai ke mutlaqan halal hai. Un ke dalail yeh hain.

Salman Farsi R.A farmate hain tu kha sakta hai agarche kutte ne tihai hissa kha liya ho, Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas R.A farmate hain ke go ek tukda hi baqi reh gaya ho phir bhi kha sakte hain. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas R.A farmate hain go do tihaiyan kutta kha gaya ho phir bhi tu kha sakta hai, Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A ka bhi yahi farman hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A farmate hain jab Bismillah keh kar tu ne apne sudhaye hue kutte ko shikar par choda ho to jis janwar ko us ne tere liye pakad rakha hai to use kha le, kutte ne us mein se khaya ho ya na khaya ho, yahi marwi hai Hazrat Ali R.A aur Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se. Hazrat Ata R.H aur Hazrat Hasan Basri R.H se is mein mukhtalif aqwal marwi hain, Zuhri, Rabia aur Malik R.H se bhi yahi riwayat ki gayi hai, isi ki taraf Imam Shafi R.H apne pehle qaul mein gaye hain aur naye qaul mein isi ki taraf ishara kiya hai. Hazrat Salman Farsi R.A se Ibn Jarir R.H ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya jab koi shakhs apne kutte ko shikar par chode phir shikar ko is halat mein paye ke kutte ne use kha liya ho to jo baqi ho use woh kha sakta hai. Is hadith ki sanad mein baqol Ibn Jarir R.H nazar hai aur Saeed rawi ka Hazrat Salman R.A se sunna maloom nahin hua aur dusre siqa rawi ise marfoo nahin karte balkeh Hazrat Salman R.A ka qaul naqal karte hain, yeh qaul hai to sahi lekin isi ma'ani ki aur marfoo hadithein bhi marwi hain, Abu Dawood mein hai Hazrat Amr bin Shuaib R.H apne baap se woh apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke ek a'arabi Abu Thalaba R.A ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se kaha ke Huzoor ﷺ mere paas shikari kutte sudhaye hue hain un ke shikar ki nisbat kya fatwa hai? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya jo janwar woh tere liye pakdein woh tujh par halal hai, us ne kaha zibah kar sakun jab bhi aur zibah na kar sakun to bhi? Aur agarche kutte ne kha liya ho to bhi? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya haan go kha bhi liya ho, unhon ne dusra sawal kiya ke main apne teer kaman se jo shikar karun us ka kya fatwa hai? Farmaya use bhi tu kha sakta hai, pucha agar woh zinda mile aur main use zibah kar sakun to bhi aur teer lagte hi mar jaye to bhi? Farmaya balkeh go woh tujhe nazar na pade aur dhundne se mil jaye to bhi. Basharte ke us mein kisi dusre shakhs ke teer ka nishan na ho, unhon ne teesra sawal kiya ke ba-waqt-e-zaroorat majusiyon ke bartanon ka istemal karna hamare liye kaisa hai? Farmaya tum unhein dho daalo phir un mein kha pee sakte ho. Yeh hadith Nasai mein bhi hai, Abu Dawood ki dusri hadith mein hai jab tu ne apne kutte ko Allah ka naam le kar choda ho to tu us ke shikar ko kha sakta hai go us ne us mein se kha bhi liya ho aur tera hath jis shikar ko tere liye laya ho use bhi tu kha sakta hai.

In dono ahadees ki sanadein bahut hi aala aur umdah hain aur hadees mein hai ke tera sudhaya hua kutta jo shikar tere liye khele toh usey kha le, Hazrat Adi R.A ne poocha agarche usne is mein se kha liya ho farmaya haan phir bhi, in aasar aur ahadees se sabit hota hai ke shikari kutte ne shikar ko go kha liya ho taham baqiya shikar shikari kha sakta hai. Kutte waghera ke khaye hue shikar ko haram na kehne walon ke yeh dalail hain. Ek aur jamaat in dono jamaaton ke darmiyan hai woh kehti hai ke agar shikar pakarte hi khane baith gaya toh baqiya haram aur agar shikar pakar kar apne malik ka intezar kiya aur bawajood khasi der guzar jane ke apne malik ko na paya aur bhook ki wajah se usey kha liya toh baqiya halal. Pehli baat par mehmool hai Hazrat Adi R.A wali hadees aur dusri par mehmool hai Abu Thalaba R.A wali hadees mein. Yeh farq bhi bahut achha hai aur is se do sahi hadeesein bhi jama ho jati hain. Ustad Abu Al-Ma'ali Juwaini R.H ne apni kitab Nihaya mein yeh tamanna zahir ki thi ke kaash koi is bare mein yeh wazahat kare toh Alhamdulillah yeh wazahat logon ne kar li. Is masle mein ek chautha qaul bhi hai woh yeh ke kutte ka khaya hua shikar toh haram hai jaisa ke Hazrat Adi R.A ki hadees mein hai, aur shikre waghera ka khaya hua shikar haram nahin is liye ke woh toh khane se hi taleem qabool karta hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke agar parind apne malik ke paas laut aaya aur maar se nahin phir woh par noche aur gosht khaye toh kha le. Ibrahim Nakh'i R.H, Sha'bi R.H, Hammad bin Suleman R.H yahi kehte hain unki daleel Ibn Abi Hatim R.H ki yeh riwayat hai ke Hazrat Adi R.A ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke hum log kutton aur baaz se shikar khela karte hain toh hamare liye kya halal hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shikari janwar ya shikar hasil karne wale khud shikar karne wale aur sudhaye hue tumhare liye shikar rok rakhein aur tum ne un par Allah ka naam le liya ho usey tum kha lo. Phir farmaya jise kutte ko tu ne Allah ka naam le kar chhora ho woh jis janwar ko rok rakhe toh usey kha le maine kaha go usey maar dala ho farmaya go maar dala ho lekin yeh shart hai ke khaya na ho maine kaha agar is kutte ke sath dusre kutte bhi mil gaye hon? Toh? Farmaya phir na kha jab tak ke tujhe is baat ka poora itminan na ho ke tere hi kutte ne shikar kiya hai. Maine kaha hum log teer se bhi shikar kiya karte hain is mein se kaunsa halal hai? Farmaya jo teer zakhmi kare aur tu ne Allah ka naam le kar chhora ho usey kha le, wajah dalalat yeh hai ke kutte mein na khane ki shart Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne batayi aur baaz mein nahin batayi, pas in dono mein farq sabit ho gaya Wallahu A'lam. Allah Rabbul Izzat farmata hai ke tum kha lo jin halal janwaron ko tumhare yeh shikari janwar pakar lein aur tum ne un ke chhorne ke waqt Allah ka naam le liya ho.

Jaise ke Hazrat Adi aur Hazrat Abu Thalaba ki hadith mein hai isi liye Hazrat Imam Ahmad waghera imamon ne yeh shart zaroori batlai hai ke shikar ke liye janwar ko chhodte waqt aur teer chalate waqt Bismillah parhna shart hai. Jamhoor ka mashhoor mazhab bhi yahi hai ke is ayat aur is hadith se murad janwar ke chhodne ka waqt hai, Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke apne shikari janwar ko bhejte waqt Bismillah keh le haan agar bhool jaye to koi harj nahin. Baaz log kehte hain ke murad khane ke waqt Bismillah parhna hai. Jaise ke Bukhari o Muslim mein Umar bin Abu Salama ki rabiba ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farmana marwi hai ke Allah ka naam le aur apne dahine hath se apne samne se kha. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Aisha se marwi hai ke logon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha log hamare paas jo gosht late hain woh nau-muslim hain hamein is ka ilm nahin hota ke unhon ne Allah ka naam liya bhi hai ya nahin? To kya hum ise kha lein? Aap ne farmaya tum khud Allah ka naam le lo aur kha lo. Musnad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) chhe sahaba ke sath khana tanawul farma rahe the ke ek a'arabi ne aa kar do luqme is mein se uthaye, Aap ne farmaya agar yeh Bismillah keh leta to yeh khana tum sab ko kafi ho jata, tum mein se jab koi khane baithe to Bismillah parh liya kare agar awwal mein bhool gaya to jab yaad aa jaye keh de dua (Bismillah-e-awwalahu wa akhirahu). Yahi hadith munqata sanad ke sath Ibn Majah mein bhi hai. Doosri sanad se yeh hadith Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasai aur Musnad Ahmad mein hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih batate hain. Jabir bin Sabih farmate hain, Hazrat Muthanna bin Abdur Rahman Khuzai ke sath main ne Wasit ka safar kiya un ki aadat yeh thi ke khana shuru karte waqt Bismillah keh lete aur aakhri luqme ke waqt dua (Bismillah-e-awwalahu wa akhirahu) keh liya karte aur mujh se unhon ne farmaya ke Khalid bin Umayyah bin Makhshi sahabi ka farman hai ke Shaitan us shakhs ke sath khana khata rehta hai jis ne Allah ka naam na liya ho, jab khane wala Allah ka naam yaad karta hai to use qai ho jati hai aur jitna us ne khaya hai sab nikal jata hai (Musnad Ahmad waghera). Is ke rawi ko Ibn Moin aur Nasai to siqa kehte hain lekin Abu al-Fath Azdi farmate hain yeh daleel lene ke qabil rawi nahin.

Hazrat Huzaifa R.A farmate hain hum Nabi ﷺ ke sath khana kha rahe the ke ek ladki girti padti aayi, jaise koi use dhakke de raha ho aur aate hi usne luqma uthana chaha, Huzoor ﷺ ne uska hath tham liya aur ek a'arabi bhi isi tarah aaya aur pyale mein hath dala, Aap ﷺ ne uska hath bhi apne hath mein pakad liya aur farmaya jab kisi khane par Bismillah na kahi jaye to Shaitan use apne liye halal kar leta hai. Woh pehle to us ladki ke sath aaya taake hamara khana khaye to main ne uska hath tham liya, phir woh a'arabi ke sath, main ne uska bhi hath tham liya. Uss ki qasam jiske qabze mein meri jaan hai ke Shaitan ka hath un dono ke hath ke sath mere hath mein hai. (Musnad, Muslim, Abu Dawood, Nasai).

Muslim, Abu Dawood, Nasai aur Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke jab insaan apne ghar mein jate hue aur khana khate hue Allah ka naam yaad kar liya karta hai to Shaitan kehta hai ke ae shaitano! Na to tumhare liye raat guzarne ki jagah hai na iska khana, aur jab woh ghar mein jate hue, khate hue Allah ka naam nahin leta to woh pukar deta hai ke tum ne shab-bashi ki aur khana khane ki jagah pa li.

Musnad, Abu Dawood aur Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein shikayat ki ke hum khate hain aur hamara pet nahin bharta, to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya shayad tum alag alag khate hoge, khana sab mil kar khao aur Bismillah keh liya karo, is mein Allah ki taraf se barkat di jayegi.

Zabiha kis naam aur kin hathon ka halal hai? Halal-o-haram ke bayan ke baad bator khulasa farmaya ke kul suthri cheezein halal hain, phir Yahood-o-Nasara ke zibah kiye hue janwaron ki hillat bayan farmayi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Abu Umamah (R.A), Mujahid (R.H), Saeed bin Jubair (R.H), Ikrimah (R.H), Atta (R.H), Hasan (R.H), Makhool (R.H), Ibrahim (R.H), Nakh'i (R.H), Suddi (R.H), Muqatil bin Hayyan (R.H) yeh sab yahi kehte hain ke ta'am se murad unka apne hath se zibah kiya hua janwar hai, jis ka khana musalmanon ko halal hai, ulama-e-Islam ka is par mukammal ittefaq hai ke unka zabiha hamare liye halal hai, kyunke woh bhi ghair-Allah ke liye zibah karna najayaz jante hain aur zibah karte waqt Allah ke siwa dusre ka naam nahin lete go unke aqide zaat-e-Bari ki nisbat yaksar aur sarasar batil hain, jin se Allah Ta'ala buland-o-bala aur pak-o-munazzah hai. Sahih hadith mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Mughaffal (R.A) ka bayan hai ke jang-e-Khaibar mein mujhe charbi ki bhari hui ek mashk mil gayi, main ne use qabze mein kiya aur kaha is mein se toh aaj main kisi ko bhi hissa na dunga, ab jo idhar udhar nigah phirayi toh dekhta hoon ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas hi khade hue tabassum farma rahe hain. Is hadith se yeh bhi istidlal kiya gaya hai ke maal-e-ghanimat mein se khane peene ki zaroori cheezein taqseem se pehle bhi le leni jayaz hain aur yeh istidlal is hadith se saaf zahir hai, teenon mazhab ke fuqaha ne Malikiyon par apni sanad pesh ki hai aur kaha hai ke tum jo kehte ho ke Ahl-e-Kitab ka wahi khana hum par halal hai jo khud unke haan bhi halal ho yeh ghalat hai kyunke charbi ko Yahoodi haram jante hain lekin musalman ke liye halal hai lekin yeh ek shakhs ka infiradi waqia hai. Albatta yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh woh charbi ho jise khud Yahoodi bhi halal jante the yani pusht ki charbi, antriyon se lagi hui charbi aur haddi se mili hui charbi, is se bhi zyada dalalat wali toh woh riwayat hai jis mein hai ke Khaibar walon ne salim bhuni hui ek bakri Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tohfe mein di jis ke shane ke gosht ko unhon ne zehar-alood kar rakha tha kyunke unhein maloom tha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko shane ka gosht pasand hai, chunancha aap ne is ka yahi gosht le kar munh mein rakh kar danton se toda toh farman-e-Bari se is shane ne kaha, mujh mein zehar mila hua hai, aap ne usi waqt use thook diya aur is ka asar aap ke samne ke danton waghera mein reh gaya, aap ke sath Hazrat Bishr bin Bara bin Ma'roor (R.A) bhi the, jo isi ke asar se rahi-e-baqa hue, jin ke qisas mein zehar milane wali aurat ko bhi qatl kiya gaya, jis ka naam Zainab tha, wajah-e-dalalat yeh hai ke khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ma' apne sathiyon ke is gosht ke khane ka pukhta irada kar liya aur yeh na pucha ke is ki jis charbi ko tum halal jante ho use nikal bhi dala hai ya nahin?

Aur hadith mein hai ke ek Yahudi ne Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dawat mein jau ki roti aur purani sookhi charbi pesh ki thi, Hazrat Makhool (R.H) farmate hain jis cheez par naam-e-Rabb na liya jaye us ka khana haram karne ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne musalmanon par raham farma kar mansookh kar ke Ahl-e-Kitab ke zibah kiye janwar halal kar diye. Yeh yaad rahe ke Ahl-e-Kitab ka zabiha halal hone se yeh sabit nahin hota ke jis janwar par bhi naam-e-Ilahi na liya jaye woh halal ho? Is liye ke woh apne zibihon par Allah ka naam lete the, balkeh jis gosht ko khate the use zabiha par mauqoof na rakhte the balkeh murda janwar bhi kha lete the. Lekin Samira aur Saiba aur Ibrahim aur Shees waghera paighambaron ke deen ke mudda'i is se mustasna the, jaise ke ulama ke do aqwal mein se ek qaul hai aur Arab ke Nasrani jaise Banu Taghlib, Tanookh, Bahra, Juzam, Lahm, Aamila ke aise aur bhi hain ke jamhoor ke nazdeek un ke hath ka kiya hua zabiha nahin khaya jayega. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain qabila Banu Taghlib ke hath ka zibah kiya hua janwar na khao, is liye ke unhon ne to Nasraniyat se siwaye sharab noshi ke aur koi cheez nahin li. Haan, Saeed bin Musayyab aur Hasan (R.H) Banu Taghlib ke Nasara ke hathon zibah kiye hue janwar ke kha lene mein koi haraj nahin jante the. Baqi rahe Majoosi, un se go jizya liya gaya hai kyunke unhein is masle mein Yahood-o-Nasara mein mila diya gaya hai aur un ka hi tabe kar diya gaya hai, lekin un ki aurton se nikah karna aur un ke zibah kiye hue janwar ka khana mamnoo hai. Haan, Abu Thaur Ibrahim bin Khalid Kalbi jo Shafi'i aur Ahmad (R.H) ke sathiyon mein se the, is ke khilaf hain, jab unhon ne ise jaiz kaha aur logon mein is ki shohrat hui to fuqaha ne is qaul ki zabardast tardeed ki hai. Yahan tak ke Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) ne to farmaya ke Abu Thaur is masle mein apne naam ki tarah hi hai yani bail ka baap. Mumkin hai Abu Thaur ne ek hadith ke umoom ko samne rakh kar yeh fatwa diya ho jis mein hukm hai ke Majoosion ke sath Ahl-e-Kitab ka sa tariqa barto, lekin awwalan to yeh riwayat in alfaaz se sabit hi nahin, dusre yeh riwayat mursal hai. Haan, albatta Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein sirf itna to hai ke Hajar ke Majoosion se Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jizya liya. Alawa in sab ke hum kehte hain ke Abu Thaur ki pesh karda hadith ko agar hum sahih maan lein, to bhi hum keh sakte hain ke is ke umoom se bhi is ayat mein hukm-e-imtina'i ko daleel bana kar Ahl-e-Kitab ke siwa aur deen walon ka zabiha bhi hamare liye haram sabit hota hai, phir farmata hai ke tumhara zabiha un ke liye halal hai yani tum unhein apna zabiha khila sakte ho.

Yeh is amr ki khabar nahin ke un ke deen mein un ke liye tumhara zabiha halal hai, han zyada se zyada itna kaha ja sakta hai ke yeh is baat ki khabar ho ke unhein bhi un ki kitab mein yeh hukum diya gaya hai ke jis janwar ka zabiha Allah ke naam par hua ho use woh kha sakta hai, bilhaz is se ke zibah karne wala unhein mein se ho ya un ke siwa koi aur ho, lekin zyada bawazan baat pehli hi hai. Yani yeh ke tumhein ijazat hai ke unhein apna zabiha khilao jaise ke un ke zibah kiye hue janwar tum kha lete ho. Yeh goya awaz-e-badal ke taur par hai, jis tarah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salool munafiq ko apne khas kurte mein kafan diya jis ki wajah se baaz hazrat ne yeh bayan kiya hai ke us ne aap ke chacha Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ko apna kurta diya tha jab woh Madine mein aaye the to aap ne us ka badla chuka diya. Han ek hadith mein hai ke momin ke siwa kisi aur ki ham-nashini na kar aur apna khana bajuz parhezgaron ke aur kisi ko na khila, ise is badle ke khilaf na samajhna chahiye, ho sakta hai ke hadith ka yeh hukum bator-e-pasandidgi aur afzaliyat ke ho, Wallahu A'lam. Phir irshad hota hai ke pak daman momin aurton se nikah karna tumhare liye halal kar diya gaya hai, yeh bator-e-tamheed ke hai isi liye is ke baad hi farmaya ke tum se pehle jinhein kitab di gayi hai un ki afifa aurton se bhi nikah tumhein halal hai. Yeh qaul bhi hai ke murad muhsanat se azad aurtein hain yani londiyan na hon. Yeh qaul Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ki taraf mansoob hai aur Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ke alfaz yeh hain ke muhsanat se azad murad hain aur jab yeh hai to jahan is qaul ka woh matlab liya ja sakta hai ke londiyan is se kharij hain wahan yeh mani bhi liye ja sakte hain ke pak daman, iffat-e-sha'ar, jaise ke inhi se dusri riwayat in hi lafzon mein maujood hai, jamhoor bhi kehte hain aur yeh zyada theek bhi hai. Taake zimmiya hone ke sath hi ghair-afifa hona shamil ho kar bilkul hi ba'is-e-fasad na ban jaye aur us ka khawand sirf fazool bharti ke taur par buri raye par na chal pade, pas bazahir yahi theek maloom hota hai ke muhsanat se murad iffat-ma'ab aur badkari se bachao waliyan hi li jayen, jaise dusri ayat mein muhsanat ke sath hi ayat (Ghaira musafihina wa la muttakhizi akhdan) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 5) aaya hai. Ulama aur mufassireen ka is mein bhi ikhtilaf hai ke kya ayat har kitabiya afifa aurat par mushtamil hai? Khwah woh azad ho khwah londiyan ho?

Ibn-e-Jarir mein salaf ki ek jamaat se isay naqal kiya hai jo kehte hain ke muhsanat se murad paak daman hai, ek qaul yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yahan murad Ahl-e-Kitab se Israeli auratein hain, Imam Shafi'i ka yahi mazhab hai aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad zimmiya auratein hain siwaye azad auraton ke aur daleel yeh aayat hai (QATILUL-LADHINA LA YU'MINUNA BILLAHI WALA BIL-YAWMIL-AKHIRI WALA YUHARRIMUNA MA HARRAMALLAHU WA RASULUHU WALA YADINUNA DINAL-HAQQI MINAL-LADHINA UTUL-KITABA HATTA YU'TUL-JIZYATA 'AN YADIW-WA HUM SAGHIRUN) (Surah At-Tawbah: 29) yani un se lado jo Allah par aur Qayamat ke din par iman nahin late, chunancha Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) nasraniya auraton se nikah karna jaiz nahin jante thay aur farmate thay is se bada shirk kya hoga? Ke woh kehti ho ke is ka Rabb Isa (A.S) hai aur jab yeh mushrik thehrein to nass-e-qurani majood hai ke aayat (WALA TANKIHUL-MUSHRIKATI HATTA YU'MINNA WALA AMATUM-MU'MINATUN KHAIRUM-MIM-MUSHRIKATIW-WALAW A'JABATKUM WALA TUNKIHUL-MUSHRIKINA HATTA YU'MINU) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 221) yani mushrika auraton se nikah na karo jab tak ke woh iman na layein, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab mushrika auraton se nikah na karne ka hukm nazil hua to Sahaba (R.A) un se ruk gaye yahan tak ke is ke baad ki aayat Ahl-e-Kitab ki paak daman auraton se nikah karne ki rukhsat nazil hui to Sahaba (R.A) ne Ahl-e-Kitab auraton se nikah kiye aur Sahaba (R.A) ki ek jamaat se aise nikah isi aayat ko daleel bana kar karne sabit hain to goya pehle Surah Baqarah ki aayat ki mumanat mein yeh dakhil thin lekin dusri aayat ne unhein makhsoos kar diya. Yeh us waqt jab yeh maan liya jaye ke mumanat wali aayat ke hukm mein yeh bhi dakhil thin warna in dono aayaton mein koi mu'ariz nahin, is liye ke aur bhi bohat si aayaton mein aam mushrikeen se unhein alag bayan kiya gaya hai jaise aayat Lam Yakunil-Ladhina Kafaru. (WA QUL-LILLADHINA UTUL-KITABA WAL-UMMIYYINA A-ASLAMTUM FA-IN ASLAMU FAQADIHTADAW WA-IN TAWALLAW FA-INNAMA 'ALAIKAL-BALAGH WALLAHU BASIRUM-BIL-'IBAD) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 20). Phir farmata hai jab tum unhein un ke muqarrara mehar de do woh apne nafs ko bachane waliyan hon aur tum un ke mehar ada karne wale ho, Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A), Aamir Sha'bi, Ibrahim Nakh'i, Hasan Basri (R.H) ka fatwa hai ke jab kisi shakhs ne kisi aurat se nikah kiya aur dukhool se pehle us ne badkari ki to miyan biwi mein tafreeq kara di jaye gi aur jo mehar khawand ne aurat ko diya hai usay wapas dilwaya jaye ga (Ibn-e-Jarir). Phir farmata hai tum bhi paak daman iffat-ma'ab ho aur alaniya ya posheeda badkar na ho'o.

Pas auraton mein jis tarah pak daman aur afifa hone ki shart lagayi thi mardon mein bhi yahi shart lagayi aur sath hi farmaya ke woh khule badkar na hon ke idhar udhar munh marte phirte hon aur na aise hon ke khas talluq se haram kari karte hon. Surah Nisa mein bhi isi ke tamathul hukm guzar chuka hai. Hazrat Imam Ahmad (R.H) isi taraf gaye hain ke zaniya auraton se tauba se pehle hargiz kisi bhale aadmi ko nikah karna jaiz nahin, aur yahi hukm unke nazdeek mardon ka bhi hai ke badkar mardon ka nikah nek kar iffat shiar auraton se bhi najaiz hai jab tak woh sachi tauba na karein aur is razeel fel se baz na aa jayein. Unki daleel ek hadith bhi hai jis mein hai kore lagaya hua zani apne jaisi se hi nikah kar sakta hai. Khalifatul Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne ek martaba farmaya ke main irada kar raha hoon ke jo musalman koi badkari kare main use hargiz kisi musalman pak daman aurat se nikah na karne doon. Is par Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) ne arz ki ke ae Ameer-ul-Momineen shirk is se bahut bada hai iske bawajood bhi uski tauba qabool hai. Is masle ko hum ayat (Al-Zani la yankihu illa zaniyatan au mushrikatan, wazzaniyatu la yankihuha illa zanin au mushrikun, wa hurrima dhalika alal-muminin) (24. An-Nur: 3) ki tafsir mein poori tarah bayan karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Ayat ke khatma par irshad hota hai ke kuffar ke aamal akarat hain aur woh akhirat mein nuqsan yafta hain.

Wuzu aur ghusl ke ahkamat aksar mufassireen ne kaha hai ke hukm-e-wuzu us waqt hai jab ke aadmi be-wuzu ho. Ek jamaat kehti hai jab tum khade ho yani neend se jaago, yeh dono qaul taqreeban ek hi matlab ke hain aur hazraat farmate hain aayat toh aam hai aur apne umoom par hi rahegi lekin jo be-wuzu ho us par wuzu karne ka hukm wujooban hai aur jo ba-wuzu ho us par istihbaaban. Ek jamaat ka khayal hai ke ibtida-e-Islam mein har salat ke waqt wuzu karne ka hukm tha phir mansookh ho gaya. Musnad-e-Ahmad waghera mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) har namaz ke liye taza wuzu kiya karte the, Fatah-e-Makkah wale din aap ne wuzu kiya aur jurabon par masah kiya aur isi ek wuzu se kayi namazein ada keen, yeh dekh kar Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaj aap ne woh kaam kiya jo aaj se pehle nahin karte the. Aap ne farmaya haan main ne bhool kar aisa nahin kiya balkay jaan boojh kar qasdan yeh kiya hai, Ibn-e-Majah waghera mein hai ke Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) ek wuzu se kayi namazein padha karte the haan peshab karein ya wuzu toot jaye toh naya wuzu kar liya karte aur wuzu hi ke bache hue pani se jurabon par masah kar liya karte. Yeh dekh kar Hazrat Fazl bin Mubashir ne sawal kiya ke kya aap ise apni raye se karte hain? Farmaya nahin balkay main ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aisa karte dekha, Musnad-e-Ahmad waghera mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ko har namaz ke liye taza wuzu karte dekh kar khwah wuzu toota ho ya na toota ho un ke sahibzade Ubaidullah se sawal hota hai ke is ki kya sanad hai? Farmaya is se Hazrat Asma bint Zaid bin Khattab (R.A) ne kaha hai ke un se Hazrat Abdullah bin Hanzala (R.A) ne jo farishton ke ghusl diye hue ke sahibzade the bayan kiya hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko har namaz ke liye taza wuzu karne ka hukm diya gaya tha is halat mein wuzu baqi ho toh bhi aur na ho toh bhi, lekin is mein qadre mushaqqat maloom hui toh wuzu ke hukm ke badle miswak ka hukm rakha gaya haan jab wuzu toote toh namaz ke liye naya wuzu zaroori hai ise samne rakh kar Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ka khayal hai ke chunke unhein quwwat hai is liye woh har namaz ke waqt wuzu karte hain. Aakhri dam tak aap ka yahi haal raha, (R.A) wa an walidihi. Is ke ek rawi Hazrat Muhammad bin Ishaq hain lekin chunke unhon ne sarahat ke sath haddasana kaha hai is liye tadlees ka khauf bhi jata raha. Haan Ibn-e-Asakir ki riwayat mein yeh lafz nahin Allah A'alam. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ke is fe'l aur is par hameshangi se yeh sabit hota hai ke yeh mustahab zaroor hai aur yahi mazhab-e-jumhoor ka hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke khulafa har namaz ke waqt wuzu kar liya karte the, Hazrat Ali (Karam Allahu Wajhahu) yaum-ul-qiyamah har namaz ke liye wuzu karte aur daleel mein yeh aayat tilawat farma dete ek martaba aap ne Zohar ki namaz ada ki phir logon ke majmay mein tashreef farma the phir pani laya gaya aur aap ne munh dhoya hath dhoye phir sar ka masah kiya aur phir pair ka. Aur farmaya yeh wuzu hai us ka jo be-wuzu na hua ho, ek martaba aap ne khafeef wuzu kar ke bhi yahi farmaya tha. Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) se bhi isi tarah marwi hai.

Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab R.H ka qaul hai ke wuzu toote baghair wuzu karna ziyadti hai. Awalan toh yeh fe'l sanadan bahut ghareeb hai, doosra yeh ke murad is se woh shakhs hai jo ise wajib janta ho aur sirf mustahab samajh kar jo aisa kare woh toh aamil bil-hadith hai, Bukhari, Sunan waghaira mein marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ har namaz ke liye naya wuzu karte thay, ek Ansari ne Hazrat Anas R.A se yeh sun kar kaha aur aap log kya karte thay? Farmaya ek wuzu se kayi namazein parhte thay jab tak wuzu toote nahin, Ibn-e-Jareer mein Huzoor ﷺ ka farman marwi hai ke jo shakhs wuzu par wuzu kare us ke liye das nekiyan likhi jati hain, Tirmidhi waghaira mein bhi yeh riwayat hai aur Imam Tirmidhi R.H ne ise za'eef kaha hai. Ek jamaat kehti hai ke aayat se sirf itna hi maqsood hai ke kisi aur kaam ke waqt wuzu karna wajib nahin sirf namaz ke liye hi is ka wujoob hai. Yeh farman is liye hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ki sunnat yeh thi ke wuzu tootne par koi kaam na karte thay jab tak phir wuzu na kar lein, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghaira ki ek za'eef ghareeb riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ jab peshab ka irada karte hum aap se bolte lekin aap jawab na dete hum salam-e-alaik karte phir bhi jawab na dete yahan tak ke yeh aayat-e-rukhsat ki utri. Abu Dawood mein hai ke ek martaba Huzoor ﷺ pakhane se nikle aur khana aap ke samne laya gaya toh hum ne kaha agar farmayein toh wuzu ka pani hazir karein, farmaya wuzu ka hukm toh mujhe sirf namaz ke liye khara hone ke waqt hi kiya gaya hai. Imam Tirmidhi R.H ise Hasan batate hain. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke aap ne farmaya mujhe kuch namaz thora hi parhni hai jo main wuzu karoon. Aayat ke in alfaaz se ke jab tum namaz ke liye khare ho toh wuzu kar liya karo, ulama-e-kiram ki ek jamaat ne istidlal kiya hai ke wuzu mein niyat wajib hai, matlab Kalam-e-Allah Sharif ka yeh hai ke namaz ke liye wuzu kar liya karo. Jaise Arab mein kaha jata hai, jab tu ameer ko dekhe toh khara ho ja toh matlab yeh hota hai ke ameer ke liye khara ho ja. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai a'maal ka daromadar niyat par hai aur har shakhs ke liye sirf wohi hai jo woh niyat kare aur munh ke dhone se pehle wuzu mein Bismillah kehna mustahab hai. Kyunke ek pukhta aur bilkul sahi hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya us shakhs ka wuzu nahin jo apne wuzu mein Bismillah na kahe (hadith ke zahiri alfaaz toh niyat ki tarah Bismillah kehne par bhi wujoob ki dalalat karte hain wallahu a'lam. Mutarjim). Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke wuzu ke pani ke bartan mein hath dalne se pehle kano ka dho lena mustahab hai aur jab neend se utha ho tab toh sakht takeed aati hai, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Rasool Allah ﷺ ka farman marwi hai ke tum mein se koi neend se jaag kar bartan mein hath na dale jab tak ke teen martaba dho na le, ise nahin maloom ke us ke hath raat ke waqt kahan rahe hon? Munh ki had fuqaha ke nazdeek lambai mein sar ke balon ki ugne ki jo jagah umooman hai wahan se darhi ki haddi aur thori tak hai aur chorai mein ek kaan se doosre kaan tak.

Is mein ikhtilaf hai ke dono janib ki peshani ke ure hue baalon ki jagah sar ke hukm mein hai ya munh ke? Aur darhi ke latakte hue baalon ka dhona munh ke dhone ki farziyat mein dakhil hai ya nahin? Is mein do qaul hain, ek toh yeh ke un par pani ka bahana wajib hai is liye ke munh samne karne ke waqt is ka bhi samna hota hai. Ek hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne ek shakhs ko darhi dhanpe hue dekh kar farmaya ise khol de yeh bhi munh mein dakhil hai, Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain Arab ka muhawara bhi yahi hai ke jab bache ke darhi nikalti hai toh woh kehte hain tala'a wajhuhu pas maloom hota hai ke kalam-e-Arab mein darhi munh ke hukm mein hai aur lafz-e-wajh mein dakhil hai. Darhi ghani aur bhari hui ho toh is ka khilal karna bhi mustahab hai. Hazrat Usman (R.A) ke wuzu ka zikr karte hue rawi kehta hai ke aap ne munh dhote waqt teen dafa darhi ka khilal kiya. Phir farmaya jis tarah tum ne mujhe karte dekha isi tarah main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko karte dekha hai (Tirmidhi waghera). Is riwayat ko Imam Bukhari aur Imam Tirmidhi hasan batate hain. Abu Dawood mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) wuzu karte waqt ek chullu pani le kar apni thori tale daal kar apni darhi mubarak ka khilal karte the aur farmate the ke mujhe mere Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal ne isi tarah hukm farmaya hai. Hazrat Imam Baihaqi farmate hain darhi ka khilal karna Hazrat Ammar, Hazrat Aisha, Hazrat Umme Salma, Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai, aur is ke tark ki rukhsat Ibn-e-Umar, Hasan bin Ali aur tabieen ki ek jamaat se marwi hai. Sahah waghera mein marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) jab wuzu karte baithte kulli karte aur naak mein pani dete. Aimma ka is mein ikhtilaf hai ke yeh dono wuzu aur ghusl mein wajib hain ya mustahab? Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal ka mazhab toh wujoob ka hai aur Imam Shafi aur Imam Malik mustahab kehte hain. Un ki daleel sunan ki woh sahih hadith hai jis mein jaldi jaldi namaz parhne wale se Huzoor (ﷺ) ka yeh farmana marwi hai ke wuzu kar jis tarah Allah ne tujhe hukm diya hai. Imam Hanifa ka maslak yeh hai ke ghusl mein wajib aur wuzu mein nahin, ek riwayat Imam Ahmad se marwi hai ke naak mein pani dena toh wajib aur kulli karna mustahab, kyunke Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Huzoor (ﷺ) ka farman hai jo wuzu kare woh naak mein pani dale aur riwayat mein hai tum mein se jo wuzu kare woh apne dono nathnon mein pani dale aur achi tarah wuzu kare. Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Bukhari mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) wuzu karne baithe toh munh dhoya ek chullu pani ka le kar kulli ki aur naak ko saaf kiya phir ek chullu le kar dahina hath dhoya phir ek chullu le kar isi se bayan hath dhoya. Phir apne sar ka masah kiya. Phir pani ka ek chullu le kar apne dahine paon par daal kar use dhoya phir ek chullu se bayan paon dhoya. Phir farmaya main ne Allah ke paighambar (ﷺ) ko isi tarah wuzu karte dekha hai. (Ila-al-marafiq) se murad (Ma'al-marafiq) hai, jaise farman hai aayat (Wala ta'kulu amwalahum ila amwalikum innahu kana huban kabira) 4.

An-Nisa: 2) Ya'ni yateemon ke maalon ko apne maalon samet na kha jaya karo yeh bada hi gunah hai. Isi tarah yahan bhi hai ke hathon ko kohniyon tak nahin, balkay kohniyon samet dhona chahiye. Dar-e-Qutni waghera mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wuzu karte hue apni kohniyon par pani bahate thay, lekin is ke do rawiyon mein kalam hai. Wallahu A'lam. Wuzu karne wale ke liye mustahab hai ke kohniyon se aagay apne shanay ko bhi wuzu mein dhoye kyunke Bukhari Muslim mein hadith hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain meri ummat wuzu ke nishanon ki wajah se Qayamat ke din chamakte hue a'zaon se aayegi, pas tum mein se jis se woh ho sakay woh apni chamak ko door tak le jaye. Sahih Muslim mein hai momin ko wahan tak zevar pehnaye jayenge jahan tak us ke wuzu ka pani pahunchta tha. (Bi-ru'oosikum) mein jawab hai is ka ilhaq ya'ni mila dene ke liye hona to zyada ghalib hai aur tab'eez ya'ni kuch hissay ke liye hona ta'ammul talab hai. Ba'az usooli hazrat farmate hain chunke aayat mein ijmali hai is liye sunnat ne jo is ki tafseel ki hai wahi mo'tabar hai aur isi ki taraf lautna padega. Hazrat Abdullah bin Zaid bin Aasim (R.A) sahabi se ek shakhs ne kaha "Aap wuzu kar ke hamain batlayiye." Aap ne pani mangwaya aur apne dono hath do-do dafa dhoye, phir teen baar kulli ki aur naak mein pani diya, teen hi dafa apna munh dhoya, phir kohniyon samet apne dono hath do martaba dhoye, phir dono hath se sar ka masah kiya, sar ke ibtidai hissay se gaddi tak le gaye, phir wahan se yahin tak wapas laye, phir apne dono pair dhoye (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Hazrat Ali (R.A) se bhi Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke wuzu ka tariqa isi tarah manqool hai. Abu Dawood mein Hazrat Mu'awiyah (R.A) aur Hazrat Miqdad (R.A) se bhi isi tarah marwi hai, yeh hadithain daleel hain is par ke pooray sar ka masah farz hai. Yehi mazhab Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) aur Hazrat Imam Ahmad (R.H) ka hai aur yehi mazhab un tamam hazrat ka hai jo aayat ko mujmal maante hain aur hadith ko is ki wazahat jaante hain. Hanifiyon ka khayal hai ke chauthai sar ka masah farz hai jo sar ka ibtidai hissa hai aur hamaray sathi kehte hain ke farz sirf itna hai jitne par masah ka itlaq ho jaye, is ki koi had nahin. Sar ke chand baalon par bhi masah ho gaya to farziyat poori ho gayi, in dono jamaton ki daleel Hazrat Mughira bin Shu'bah (R.A) wali hadith hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) peechay reh gaye aur main bhi aap ke sath peechay reh gaya jab aap qaza-e-hajat kar chukay to mujh se pani talab kiya main lota le aaya aap ne apne dono pahunchay dhoye phir munh dhoya phir kalaiyon par se kapda hataya aur peshani se milay hue baalon aur pagdi par masah kar ke baqi pagdi par poora kar liya aur is ki bohat si misalain ahadith mein hain. Aap safay par aur jurabon par barabar masah kiya karte thay, pas yehi aula hai aur is mein hargiz is baat par koi dalalat nahin ke sar ke ba'az hissay par ya sirf peshani ke baalon par hi masah kar le aur is ki takmeel pagdi par na ho. Wallahu A'lam. Phir is mein bhi ikhtilaf hai ke sar ka masah bhi teen baar ho ya ek hi baar?

Imam Shafi'i R.H ka mashhoor mazhab awwal hai aur Imam Ahmad R.H aur unke muttabi'een ka dom. Dalail yeh hain: Hazrat Usman bin Affan R.A wuzu karne baithte hain apne dono hathon par teen baar pani dalte hain, unhein dho kar phir kulli karte hain aur naak mein pani dete hain, phir teen martaba munh dhote hain, phir teen teen baar dono hath kohniyon samet dhote hain, pehle dayaan phir baayaan. Phir apne sar ka masah karte hain phir dono pair teen teen baar dhote hain pehle daahna phir baayaan. Phir aap ne farmaya main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ ko isi tarah wuzu karte dekha aur wuzu ke baad aap ne farmaya jo shakhs mere is wuzu jaisa wuzu kare phir do rakat namaz ada kare jis mein dil se baatein na kare to uske tamam sabqa gunah maaf ho jate hain (Bukhari o Muslim). Sunan Abi Dawood mein isi riwayat mein sar ke masah karne ke sath hi yeh lafz bhi hain ke sar ka masah ek martaba kiya, Hazrat Ali R.A se bhi isi tarah marwi hai aur jin logon ne sar ke masah ko bhi teen baar kaha hai unhon ne hadith se daleel li hai. Jis mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne teen teen baar aaza-e-wuzu ko dhoya. Hazrat Usman R.A se marwi hai ke aap ne wuzu kiya phir isi tarah riwayat hai aur us mein kulli karni aur naak mein pani dene ka zikr nahin aur us mein hai ke phir aap ne teen martaba sar ka masah kiya aur teen martaba apne dono pair dhoye. Phir farmaya main ne Huzoor ﷺ ko isi tarah karte dekha aur aap ne farmaya jo aisa wuzu kare use kafi hai. Lekin Hazrat Usman R.A se jo hadeesein Sahah mein marwi hain un se to sar ka masah ek baar hi sabit hota hai. (Arjulakum) laam ki zabar se atf hai jo (Yaa ayyuhallazeena aamanoo iza qumtum ilas-salaati faghsiloo wujoohakum wa aydiyakum ilal-maraafiqi wamsahoo bi-ru'oosikum wa arjulakum ilal-ka'bayn. Wa in kuntum junuban fattahharoo) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 6) par matahat hai dhone ke hukum ke. Ibn Abbas R.A yunhi padhte the aur yahi farmate the, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood R.A, Hazrat Urwah R.H, Hazrat Atta R.H, Hazrat Ikrimah R.H, Hazrat Hasan R.H, Hazrat Mujahid R.H, Hazrat Ibrahim R.H, Hazrat Zahhak R.H, Hazrat Suddi R.H, Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayyan R.H, Hazrat Zuhri R.H, Hazrat Ibrahim Taimi R.H waghera ka yahi qaul aur yahi qira'at hai, aur yeh bilkul zahir hai ke paon dhone chahiyein, yahi salaf ka farman hai aur yahin se jamhoor ne wuzu ki tarteeb ke wujoob par istidlal kiya hai, sirf Abu Hanifa R.H is ke khilaf hain, woh wuzu mein tarteeb ko shart nahin jante. Un ke nazdeek agar koi shakhs pehle pairon ko dhoye phir sar ka masah kare phir hath dhoye phir munh dhoye jab bhi jaiz hai is liye ke aayat ne in aaza ke dhone ka hukum diya hai. Wao ki dalalat tarteeb par nahin hoti, is ke jawab jamhoor ne kayi ek diye hain, ek to yeh ke "Wao" tarteeb par dalalat karti hai, aayat ke alfaaz mein namaz padhne wale ko munh dhone ka hukum lafz (Faghsiloo) se hota hai.

Toh kam az kam munh ka awwal awwal dhona toh lafzon se sabit hogaya ab is ke baad ke aaza mein tarteeb ijma se sabit hai jis mein ikhtilaf nazar nahin aata. Phir jabke "wao" jo ta'qeeb ke liye hai aur jo tarteeb ki muqtazi hai ek par dakhil ho chuki toh is ek ki tarteeb maante hue dusri ki tarteeb ka inkar koi nahin karta balkeh toh sab ki tarteeb ke qail hain ya kisi ek ki bhi tarteeb ke qail nahin. Pas yeh aayat un par yaqeenan hujjat hai jo sire se tarteeb ke munkir hain, dusra jawab yeh hai ke wao tarteeb par dalalat nahin karta ise bhi hum tasleem nahin karte balkeh woh tarteeb par dalalat karta hai jaise ke nahwiyon ki ek jamaat ka aur baaz fuqaha ka mazhab hai phir yeh cheez bhi qabil-e-ghaur hai ke bilfarz lughatan is ki dalalat tarteeb par na bhi hoti hum shar'an toh jin cheezon mein tarteeb ho sakti hai un mein is ki dalalat tarteeb par hoti hai, chunancha Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hadith hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) jab Baitullah Shareef ka tawaf kar ke bab-e-Safa se nikle toh aap aayat (Innas-Safa wal-Marwata min sha'a'irillah, faman hajjal-baita awi'tamara fala junaha alaihi ay-yattawwafa bihima, wa man tatawwa'a khairan fa'innallaha Shakirun 'Aleem) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 158) ki tilawat kar rahe the aur farmaya main isi se shuru karunga jise Allah ne pehle bayan farmaya, chunancha Safa se sa'i shuru ki, Nasai mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ka yeh hukm dena bhi marwi hai ke us se shuru karo jis se Allah Ta'ala ne shuru kiya. Is ki asnad bhi sahih hai aur is mein amr hai pas maloom hua ke jis ka zikr pehle ho use pehle karna aur is ke baad use jis ka zikr baad mein ho karna wajib hai. Pas saaf sabit hogaya ke aise mawaqe par shar'an tarteeb murad hoti hai. Wallahu A'lam, teesri jamaat jawaban kehti hai hathon ko kohniyon samet dhone ke hukm aur pairon ko dhone ke hukm ke darmiyan sar ke masah ke hukm ko bayan karna is amr ki saaf daleel hai ke murad tarteeb ko baqi rakhna hai, warna nazm-e-kalam ko yun ulat pulat na kiya jata. Ek jawab is ka yeh bhi hai ke Abu Dawood waghera mein sahih sanad se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne aaza-e-wazu ko ek ek baar dho kar wazu kiya phir farmaya yeh wazu hai ke jis ke baghair Allah Ta'ala namaz ko qabool nahin karta. Ab do suratein hain ya toh is wazu mein tarteeb thi ya na thi?

Agar kaha jaye ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh wuzu murattab tha yani baqaida ek ke peeche ek uzw dhoya tha toh maloom hua ke jis wuzu mein taqdeem-o-takheer ho aur sahih taur par tarteeb na ho woh namaz namaqbool, lehaza tarteeb wajib-o-farz aur agar yeh maan liya jaye ke is wuzu mein tarteeb na thi balkay be-tarteeb tha, pair dho liye phir kulli karli phir masah karliya phir munh dho liya waghera toh adam-e-tarteeb wajib ho jayegi halankeh is ka qail ummat mein se ek bhi nahin, pas sabit ho gaya ke wuzu mein tarteeb farz hai. Aayat ke is jumlay ki ek qirat aur bhi hai yani (Wa arjulakum) laam ke zer se aur isi se Shia ne apne is qaul ki daleel li hai ke pairon par masah karna wajib hai kyunke un ke nazdeek is ka atf sar ke masah karne par hai. Baaz salaf se bhi kuch aise aqwal marwi hain jin se masah ke qaul ka wahm padta hai, chunancha Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Musa bin Anas ne Hazrat Anas (R.A) se logon ki maujoodgi mein kaha ke Hajjaj ne Ahwaz mein khutba dete hue taharat aur wuzu ke ahkaam mein kaha ke munh hath dho'o aur sar ka masah karo aur pairon ko dhoya karo, umooman pairon par hi gandagi lagti hai. Pas talwon ko aur pairon ki pusht ko aur edi ko khoob achi tarah dhoya karo. Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne jawaban kaha ke Allah sacha hai aur Hajjaj jhoota hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai aayat (Wamsahu bi ru'usikum wa arjulakum ilal ka'bain) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 6) aur Hazrat Anas (R.A) ki aadat thi ke pairon ka jab masah karte unhein bilkul bhigo liya karte, aap hi se marwi hai ke Quran-e-Kareem mein pairon par masah karne ka hukm hai, haan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sunnat pairon ka dhona hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke wuzu mein do cheezon ka dhona hai aur do par masah karna. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) se marwi hai ke aayat mein pairon par masah karne ka bayan hai. Ibn-e-Umar (R.A), Alqama (R.H), Abu Jafar (R.H), Muhammad bin Ali (R.H) aur ek riwayat mein Hazrat Hasan (R.H) aur Jabir bin Zaid (R.H) aur ek riwayat mein Mujahid (R.H) se bhi isi tarah marwi hai. Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) apne pairon par masah kar liya karte the. Sha'bi (R.H) farmate hain ke Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ki ma'rifat masah ka hukm nazil hua hai, aap se yeh bhi marwi hai ke kya tum dekhte nahin ho ke jin cheezon ke dhone ka hukm tha un par toh tayammum ke waqt masah ka hukm raha aur jin cheezon par masah ka hukm tha tayammum ke waqt unhein chhod diya gaya. Aamir (R.H) se kisi ne kaha ke log kehte hain Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) pairon ke dhone ka hukm laye hain, aap ne farmaya Jibraeel (A.S) masah ke hukm ke sath nazil hue the.

Pas yeh sab aasar bilkul ghareeb hain aur mahmool hain is amr par ke murad masah se in buzurgon ki halka dhona hai, kyunke sunnat se saaf sabit hai ke pairon ka dhona wajib hai, yaad rahe ke zer ki qira'at ya toh mujawarat aur tanasub-e-kalam ki wajah se hai jaise Arab ka kalam hajar-e-zab-e-kharib mein aur Allah ke kalam aayat (عٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُـنْدُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَّاِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۡ وَّحُلُّوْٓا اَسَاوِرَ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ ۚ وَسَقٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُوْرًا) (Surah Ad-Dahr: 21) mein lughat mein Arab mein paas hone ki wajah se dono lafzon ko ek hi a'raab de dena yeh aksar paya gaya hai. Hazrat Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ne is ki ek taujeeh yeh bhi bayan ki hai ke yeh hukm us waqt hai jab pairon par jurabein hon, ba'az kehte hain murad masah se halka dho lena hai jaise ke ba'az riwayaton mein sunnat se sabit hai. Al-gharaz pairon ka dhona farz hai jis ke baghair wuzu na hoga. Aayat bhi yahi hai aur ahadees mein bhi yahi hai jaise ke ab hum unhein waarid karenge, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Baihaqi mein hai Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib (R.A) zohar ki namaz ke baad baithak mein baithe rahe phir paani mangwaya aur ek chullu se munh ka, dono hathon, sar ka aur dono pairon ka masah kiya aur khade ho kar bacha hua paani pee liya phir farmane lage ke log khade khade paani peene ko makrooh kehte hain aur main ne jo kiya yahi karte hue Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko dekha hai aur farmaya yeh wuzu hai us ka jo be-wuzu na hua ho (Bukhari). Shi'on mein se jin logon ne pairon ko masah isi tarah qarar diya jis tarah jurabon par masah karte hain un logon ne yaqeenan ghalti ki aur logon ko gumrahi mein dala. Isi tarah woh log bhi khata-kar hain jo masah aur dhona dono ko jaiz qarar dete hain aur jin logon ne Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) ki nisbat yeh khayal kiya hai ke unhon ne ahadees ki bina par pairon ke dhone ko aur aayat-e-qurani ki bina par pairon ke masah ko farz qarar diya hai.

Un ki tahqeeq bhi sahih nahin, Tafsir-e-Ibn-e-Jarir hamare hathon mein majood hai un ke kalam ka khulasa yeh hai ke pairon ko ragadna wajib hai aur aaza mein yeh wajib nahin kyunke pair zameen ki mitti waghera se ragadte rehte hain toh un ko dhona zaroori hai taake jo kuch laga ho hat jaye lekin is ragadne ke liye masah ka lafz laye hain aur isi se baaz logon ko shuba ho gaya hai aur woh yeh samajh baithe hain ke masah aur ghusl jama kar diya hai halankeh darasal is ke kuch ma'ani hi nahin hote masah toh ghusl mein dakhil hai chahe muqaddam ho chahe mu'akhkhar ho pas haqiqatan Imam sahib ka irada yahi hai jo main ne zikr kiya aur is ko na samajh kar aksar fuqaha ne ise mushkil jaan liya, main ne mukarrar ghaur-o-fikr kiya toh mujh par saaf taur se yeh baat wazeh ho gayi hai ke Imam sahib dono qiraton ko jama karna chahte hain pas zer ki qirat yani masah ko toh woh mahmool karte hain dalk par yani achi tarah mal ragad kar saaf karne par aur zabar ki qirat ko ghusl par yani dhone par daleel hai hi pas woh dhone aur malne dono ko wajib kehte hain taake zer aur zabar ki dono qiraton par ek sath ho jaye "Ab in ahadees ko suniye jin mein pairon ke dhone ka aur pairon ke dhone ke zaroori hone ka zikr hai" Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A), Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib (R.A), Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Muawiyah (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Zaid (R.A), Asim (R.A), Hazrat Miqdad bin Ma'di Karb (R.A) ki riwayat pehle bayan ho chuki hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne wuzu karte hue apne pairon ko dhoya, ek baar ya do baar ya teen baar, Amr bin Shuaib ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne wuzu kiya aur apne dono pair dhoye phir farmaya yeh wuzu hai jis ke baghair Allah Ta'ala namaz qabool nahin farmata. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke ek martaba ek safar mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum se peeche reh gaye the jab aap aaye toh hum jaldi jaldi wuzu kar rahe the kyunke Asr ki namaz ka waqt kaafi der se ho chuka tha hum ne jaldi jaldi apne pairon par chhua-chhui shuru kar di toh aap ne bahut buland aawaz se farmaya wuzu ko kamil aur poora karo ediyon ko kharabi se aag ke lagne se, ek aur hadith mein hai wail hai ediyon ke liye aur talon ke liye aag se (Baihaqi-o-Hakim) aur riwayat mein hai takhnon ko wail hai aag se (Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad) ek shakhs ke pair mein ek dirham ke barabar jagah be-dhuli dekh kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kharabi hai ediyon ke liye aag se (Musnad) Ibn-e-Majah waghera mein hai ke kuch logon ko wuzu karte hue dekh kar jin ki ediyon par achi tarah pani nahin pahuncha tha Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya in ediyon ko aag se kharabi hogi, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke yeh alfaaz warid hain.

Ibn-e-Jarir mein do martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka in alfaaz ko kehna warid hai. Rawi Hazrat Abu Umamah (R.A) farmate hain phir toh masjid mein ek bhi shareef-o-wazi aisa na raha jo apni eriyon ko baar baar dho kar na dekhta ho. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek shakhs ko namaz parhte hue dekha jis ki eri ya takhne mein ba-qadr-e-neem dirham ke chamri khushk reh gayi thi toh yahi farmaya. Phir toh yeh halat thi ke agar zara si jagah pair ki kisi khushk reh jaati toh woh poora wuzu phir se karta. Pas in ahadees se khullam khulla zahir hai ke pairon ka dhona farz hai, agar un ka masah farz hota toh zara si jagah ke khushk reh jaane par Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) waeed se aur woh bhi jahannam ki aag ki waeed se na darate, is liye ke masah mein zara zara si jagah par haath ka pahunchana dakhil hi nahin. Balkeh phir toh pair ke masah ki wahi surat hoti hai jo pair ke oopar juraab hone ki surat mein masah ki surat hai. Yahi cheez Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne shiyon ke muqable mein pesh ki hai. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dekha ke ek shakhs ne wuzu kiya aur us ka pair kisi jagah se nakhun ke barabar dhula nahin khushk reh gaya toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya laut jao aur achi tarah wuzu karo. Baihaqi waghera mein bhi yeh hadees hai, Musnad mein hai ke ek namazi ko Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne namaz mein dekha ke us ke pair mein ba-qadr-e-dirham ke jagah khushk reh gayi hai toh use wuzu lautane ka hukum kiya. Hazrat Usman (R.A) se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke wuzu ka tariqa jo marwi hai us mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ungliyon ke darmiyan khilal bhi kiya. Sunan mein hai Hazrat Sabrah (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se wuzu ki nisbat daryaft kiya toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya wuzu kaamil aur acha karo, ungliyon ke darmiyan khilal karo aur naak mein paani achi tarah dalo, haan rozay ki halat mein ho toh aur baat hai.
