Musnad-o-Muslim waghera mein hai Hazrat Amr bin Anbasah (R.A) kehte hain ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe wuzu ki babat khabar dijiye, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs wuzu ka paani le kar kulli karta hai aur naak mein paani deta hai us ke munh se, nathnon se paani ke saath hi khatayen jhar jaati hain jabke woh naak jhaarta hai, phir jab woh munh dhota hai jaisa ke Allah ka hukum hai toh us ke munh ki khatayen darhi aur darhi ke baalon se paani ke girne ke saath hi jhar jaati hain, phir woh apne dono haath dhota hai takhnon samet toh us ke hathon ke gunah us ki puriyon ki tarah jhar jaate hain, phir woh masah karta hai toh us ke sar ki khatayen us ke baalon ke kinaron se paani ke saath hi jhar jaati hain, phir jab woh apne paon takhnon samet hukum-e-Ilahi ke mutabiq dhota hai toh ungliyon se paani tapakne ke saath hi us ke pairon ke gunah bhi door ho jaate hain, phir woh khara ho kar Allah Ta'ala ke laiq jo hamd-o-sana hai use bayan kar ke do rakat namaz jab ada karta hai toh woh apne gunahon se aisa paak saaf ho jaata hai jaise woh tawalud hua ho. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Abu Umamah (R.A) ne Hazrat Amr bin Anbasah (R.A) se kaha khoob gaur kijiye ke Aap kya farma rahe hain? Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Aap ne isi tarah suna hai?

Kya yeh sab kuch ek hi maqam mein insaan hasil kar leta hai? Hazrat Amr ne jawab diya ke Abu Umamah main boodha ho gaya hoon, meri haddiyan zaeef ho chuki hain, meri maut qareeb aa pahunchi hai, mujhe kya faida jo main Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jhoot boloon, ek dafa nahin, do dafa nahin, teen dafa nahin, main ne toh ise Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani saat baar balkay is se bhi zyada suna hai, is hadith ki sanad bilkul sahih hai. Sahih Muslim ki dusri sanad wali hadith mein hai phir woh apne dono paon ko dhota hai jaisa ke Allah ne use hukum diya hai. Pas saaf sabit hua ke Quran-e-Hakeem ka hukum pairon ke dhone ka hai. Abu Ishaq Sabee'i ne Hazrat Ali Karam Allahu Wajhahu fil Jannah se bawasta Hazrat Haris riwayat mein Hazrat Ali se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne dono qadam jooti mein hi bhigo liye is se murad jootiyon mein hi halka dhona hai aur chappal jooti pair mein hote hue pair dhul sakta hai garz yeh hadith bhi dhone ki daleel hai albatta is se un waswasi aur wahmi logon ki tardeed hai jo had se guzar jate hain, isi tarah woh dusri hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek qoum ke kooda dalne ki jagah par peshab kiya phir pani mangwa kar wuzu kiya aur apne na'lain par masah kar liya, lekin yahi hadith dusri sanadon se marwi hai aur un mein se ke Aap ne apni jurabon par masah kiya aur in mein mutabiqat ki surat yeh bhi ho sakti hai ke jurabein pairon mein thin aur un par na'lain thay aur un dono par Aap ne masah kar liya. Yahi matlab is hadith ka bhi hai, Musnad-e-Ahmed mein Aus Abu Aus se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mere dekhte hue wuzu kiya aur apne na'lain par masah kiya aur namaz ke liye kharay ho gaye, yahi riwayat dusri sanad se marwi hai is mein Aap ka kooday par peshab karna phir wuzu karna aur is mein na'lain aur dono qadmon par masah karna mazkoor hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ise bayan karte hain, phir farmaya hai ke yeh mahmool is par hai ke us waqt Aap ka pehla wuzu tha (ya yeh mahmool hai is par ke na'lain jurabon ke oopar thay. Mutarjim) bhala koi musalman yeh kaise qabool kar sakta hai ke Allah ke fareezay mein aur Paighambar ki sunnat mein ta'aruz ho Allah kuch farmaye aur Paighambar kuch aur hi karein? Pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hamesha ke fe'l se wuzu mein pairon ke dhone ki farziyat sabit hai aur aayat ka sahih matlab bhi yeh hai jis ke kanon tak yeh daleelein pahunch jayen us par Allah ki hujjat poori ho gayi. Chunke zer ki qira'at se pairon ka dhona aur zer ki qira'at ka bhi isi par mahmool hona farziyat ka qat'i suboot hai is se ba'az salaf toh yeh bhi keh gaye hain ke is aayat se jurabon ka masah hi mansookh hai, go ek riwayat Hazrat Ali se bhi aisi marwi hai lekin is ki asnaad sahih nahin balkay khud Aap se sehat ke sath is ke khilaf sabit hai aur jin ka bhi yeh qaul hai un ka yeh khayal sahih nahin balkay Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad bhi jurabon par masah karna sabit hai.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Jareer bin Abdullah Bajli R.A ka qaul hai ke Surah Ma'idah ke nazil hone ke baad hi mein Musalman hua aur apne Islam ke baad mein ne Rasool Allah ﷺ ko jurabon par masah karte dekha. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Jareer R.A ne peshab kiya phir wuzu karte hue apni jurabon par masah kiya, un se poocha gaya ke aap aisa karte hain? To farmaya yahi karte hue mein ne Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ko dekha hai. Rawi-e-Hadith Hazrat Ibrahim R.H farmate hain logon ko yeh hadith bahut achi lagti thi is liye ke Hazrat Jareer R.A ka Islam lana Surah Ma'idah ke nazil ho chukne ke baad ka tha. Ahkaam ki badi badi kitabon mein tawatur ke sath Huzoor ﷺ ke qaul-o-fe'l se jurabon par masah karna sabit hai. Ab masah ki muddat hai ya nahin? Is ke zikr ki yeh jagah nahin, ahkaam ki kitabon mein is ki tafseel maujood hai, Rafziyon ne is mein bhi gumrahi ikhtiyar ki hai. Khud Hazrat Ali R.A ki riwayat se Sahih Muslim mein yeh sabit hai, lekin Rawafiz ise nahin maante, jaise ke Hazrat Ali R.A ki hi riwayat se Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Nikah-e-Mut'ah ki muman'at sabit hai lekin taham Shia ise mubah qarar dete hain. Theek isi tarah yeh Aayah-e-Kareema dono pairon ke dhone par saaf dalalat karti hai aur yahi amr Huzoor ﷺ ka mutawatir ahadees se sabit hai lekin Shia jamaat is ki bhi mukhalif hai. Fi-waq'a in masail mein un ke haath daleel se bilkul khali hain. Wallahul Hamd. Isi tarah un logon ne aayat ka aur Salaf-e-Saliheen ka masah ke bare mein bhi ulat mafhoom liya hai, woh kehte hain ke qadam ki pusht ubhaar Ka'bain hai, pas un ke nazdeek har qadam mein ek hi Ka'b yani takhna hai aur Jamhoor ke nazdeek takhne ki woh haddiyan jo pindli aur qadam ke darmiyan ubhri hui hain aur woh Ka'bain hain. Imam Shafi'i R.H ka farman hai ke jin Ka'bain ka yahan zikr hai yeh takhne ki do haddiyan hain jo idhar udhar qadray zahir dono taraf hain, ek hi qadam mein Ka'bain hain, logon ke arz mein bhi yahi hai aur hadith ki dalalat bhi isi par hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Usman R.A ne wuzu karte hue apne dahne paon ko Ka'bain samet dhoya phir baen ko bhi isi tarah. Bukhari mein ta'leeqan baseegha-e-jazm aur Sahih Ibn Khuzaima mein aur Sunan Abi Dawood mein hai ke hamari taraf mutawajjeh ho kar Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya "Apni saffein theek theek durust kar lo" teen baar yeh farma kar farmaya qasam Allah ki ya to tum apni saffon ko poori tarah durust karoge ya Allah tumhare dilon mein mukhalifat daal dega. Hazrat Nu'man bin Basheer R.A rawi-e-hadith farmate hain phir to yeh ho gaya ke har shakhs apne sathi ke takhne se takhna aur ghutne se ghutna aur kandhe se kandha mila liya karta tha. Is riwayat se saaf maloom ho gaya ke Ka'bain us haddi ka naam nahin jo qadam ki pusht ki taraf hai kyunke us ka milana do paas paas ke shakhson mein mumkin nahin balkay wahi do ubhri hui haddiyan hain jo pindli ke khatmay par hain aur yahi mazhab Ahl-e-Sunnat ka hai.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Yahya bin Haris Taimi se manqool hai ke Zaid ke jo saathi shia qatl kiye gaye thay unhein main ne dekha toh un ka takhna qadam ki pusht par paya. Unhein qudrati saza thi jo un ki maut ke baad zahir ki gayi aur mukhalifat-e-haq aur kitman-e-haq ka badla diya gaya. Is ke baad tayammum ki suratein aur tayammum ka tariqa bayan hua hai, is ki poori tafsir Surah Nisa mein guzar chuki hai lehaza yahan bayan nahin ki jati. Ayat-e-tayammum ka shaan-e-nuzool bhi wahin bayan kar diya gaya hai. Lekin Ameer-ul-Momineen fil Hadith Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) ne is ayat ke mutaliq khastan ek hadith warid ki hai use sun lijiye. Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) Umm-ul-Momineen ka bayan hai ke mere gale ka haar Baida mein gir gaya, hum Madina mein dakhil hone wale thay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne sawari roki aur meri god mein sar rakh kar so gaye. Itne mein mere walid Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) mere paas tashreef laye aur mujh par bigadne lage ke tu ne haar kho kar logon ko rok diya aur mujhe kachoke maarne lage. Jis se mujhe takleef hui lekin Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki neend mein khalal-andazi na ho, is khayal se main hili juli nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab jaage aur subh ki namaz ka waqt ho gaya aur pani ki talash ki gayi toh pani na mila, is par yeh poori ayat nazil hui. Hazrat Usaid bin Hufeir kehne lage, "Ae Aal-e-Abu Bakr! Allah Ta'ala ne logon ke liye tumhein babarkat bana diya hai, tum in ke liye sartapa barkat ho." Phir Allah Ta'ala farmata hai main tum par haraj dalna nahin chahta isi liye apne deen ko sahal, aasaan aur halka kar diya hai. Bojhal, sakht aur mushkil nahin. Hukm toh is ka yeh tha ke pani se wuzu karo lekin jab mayassar na ho ya bimari ho toh tumhein tayammum karne ki rukhsat ata farmata hai, baqi ahkaam ahkaam ki kitabon mein mulahiza hon. Balkeh Allah ki chahat yeh hai ke tumhein paak saaf kar de aur tumhein poori poori ne'matein ata farmaye taake tum us ki rehmaton par us ki shukr-guzari karo, us ki tawsee-e-ahkaam aur ra'fat-o-rehmat, aasani aur rukhsat par us ka ehsan mano. Wuzu ke baad Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek dua taleem farmayi hai jo goya is ayat ke mat-hat hai. Musnad, Sunan aur Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Uqba bin Aamir (R.A) se riwayat hai ke hum bari bari oonton ko charaya karte thay. Main apni bari wali raat Isha ke waqt chala toh dekha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khade hue logon se kuch farma rahe hain. Main bhi pahunch gaya, us waqt main ne aap se yeh suna ke jo musalman achi tarah wuzu kar ke dili tawajo ke sath do rakat namaz ada kare us ke liye jannat wajib hai. Main ne kaha wah wah yeh bohat hi achi baat hai. Meri yeh baat sun kar ek sahib ne jo mere aage hi baithe thay farmaya, "Is se pehle jo baat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmayi hai woh is se bhi zyada behtar hai." Main ne jo gaur se dekha toh woh Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) thay. Aap mujh se farmane lage tum abhi aaye ho, tumhare aane se pehle Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai ke jo shakhs umdagi aur achai se wuzu kare phir kahe dua (Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluhu).

Is ke liye Jannat ke aathon darwaze khul jate hain jis mein se chahe dakhil ho. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke jab imaan-o-Islam wala wuzu karne baithta hai us ke munh dhote hue us ki aankhon ki tamam khatayen paani ke sath ya paani ke aakhri qatre ke sath jhad jati hain, isi tarah hathon ke dhone ke waqt hathon ki tamam khatayen aur isi tarah pairon ke dhone ke waqt pairon ki tamam khatayen dhul jati hain woh gunahon se bilkul paak saaf ho jata hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai jo shakhs wuzu karte hue jab apne hath ya bazuyon ko dhota hai to un se un ke gunah door ho jate hain, munh ko dhote waqt munh ke gunah alag ho jate hain, sar ka masah sar ke gunah jhaad deta hai pair ka dhona un ke gunah dho deta hai. Dusri sanad mein sar ke masah ka zikr nahin. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai jo shakhs achi tarah wuzu kar ke namaz ke liye khada hota hai us ke kanon se, aankhon se, hathon se, paon se sab gunah alag ho jate hain. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai wuzu aadha imaan hai, Alhamdulillah kehne se neki ka palra bhar jata hai. Quran ya to teri muwafiqat mein daleel hai ya tere khilaf daleel hai, har shakhs subh hi subh apne nafs ki farokht karta hai pas ya to apne tayin azaad kara leta hai ya halak kar leta hai aur hadith mein hai "Maal-e-haram ka sadqa Allah qabool nahin farmata aur be-wuzu ki namaz bhi ghair maqbool hai" (Sahih Muslim). Yeh riwayat Abu Dawood, Tayalisi, Musnad-e-Ahmad, Abu Dawood, Nasai aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi hai.

"Islam" zaban se ahd aur "Iman" amal se ita'at. Is ahd ka izhar is Deen-e-Azeem aur is Rasool-e-Kareem ko bhej kar jo ehsan Allah Ta'ala ne is ummat par kiya hai, use yaad dila raha hai aur is ahd par mazboot rehne ki hidayat kar raha hai jo musalmanon ne Allah ke Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari aur imdad karne, deen par qaim rehne, ise qabool kar lene, ise dusron tak pahunchane ke liye kiya hai. Islam late waqt inhi cheezon ka har momin apni bai'at mein iqrar karta tha, chunancha Sahaba (R.A) ke alfaaz hain ke hum ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se bai'at ki ke "Hum sunte rahenge aur mante chale jayenge, khwah jee chahe khwah na chahe, khwah dusron ko hum par tarjeeh di jaye aur kisi laiq shakhs se hum kisi kaam ko nahin chheenen ge." Bari Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal ka irshad hai ke tum kyun iman nahin late? Halan-ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhein Rabb par iman lane ki dawat de rahe hain, agar tumhein yaqeen ho aur us ne tum se ahd bhi le liya hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is aayat mein Yahudiyon ko yaad dilaya ja raha hai ke tum se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari ke qaul-o-qarar ho chuke hain, phir tumhari nafarmani ke kya ma'ani? Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke "Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki peeth se nikal kar jo ahd Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat ne Bani Adam se liya tha, use yaad dilaya ja raha hai jis mein farmaya tha ke kya main tumhara Rabb nahin hoon? Sab ne iqrar kiya ke haan hum is par gawah hain, lekin pehla qaul zyada zahir hai, Suddi aur Ibn Abbas (R.A) se wahi marwi hai aur Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne bhi isi ko mukhtar bataya hai. Har haal mein insan ko Allah ka khauf rakhna chahiye. Dilon aur seenon ke bhed se woh waqif hai. Iman walo logon ko dikhane ko nahin balkeh Allah ki wajah se haq par qaim ho jao aur adl ke sath sahih gawah ban jao. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Nu'man bin Bashir (R.A) se riwayat hai ke mere baap ne mujhe ek atiya de rakha tha, meri maa Umrah bint-e-Rawahah ne kaha ke main to is waqt tak mutma'in nahin hone lagi jab tak ke tum is par Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko gawah na bana lo, mere baap Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hue waqia bayan kiya to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya kya apni dusri aulad ko bhi aisa hi atiya diya hai? Jawab diya ke nahin to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah se daro, apni aulad mein adl kiya karo, jao main kisi zulm par gawah nahin banta. Chunancha mere baap ne woh sadqa lauta liya, phir farmaya dekho kisi ki adawat aur zid mein aa kar adl se na hat jana. Dost ho ya dushman ho, tumhein adl-o-insaf ka sath dena chahiye, taqwe se zyada qareeb yahi hai, 'hu' ki zameer ke marja par dalalat fe'l ne kar di hai jaise ke is ki naziren Quran mein aur bhi hain aur kalam-e-Arab mein bhi, jaise aur jagah hai. Aayat (Wa in qeela lakumurji'oo farji'oo huwa azka lakum, wallahu bima ta'maluna 'aleem) (Surah An-Nur: 28) yani agar tum kisi makan mein jane ki ijazat mango aur na mile balkeh kaha jaye ke wapas jao to tum wapas chale jao yahi tumhare liye zyada pakeezgi ka ba'is hai.

Pas yahan 'hu' ki zameer ka marja' mazkoor nahin, lekin fe'l ki dalalat majood hai yani laut jana isi tarah mandraja ayat mein yani adl karna. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke yahan par 'aqrab' af'al-ut-tafzeel ka seegha aise mauqa par hai ke dusri janib aur koi cheez nahin, jaise is ayat mein hai. (Ashabul jannati yauma'izin khairum mustaqarran wa ahsanu maqila) (25. Al-Furqan: 24) aur jaise ke kisi Sahabiya ka Hazrat Umar (R.A) se kehna ke: 'Anta wa aghlazu min Rasulillah (ﷺ)'. Allah se daro! Woh tumhare amalon se bakhabar hai, har khair-o-shar ka pura pura badla dega. Woh iman walon, nek karon se unke gunahon ki bakhshish ka aur unhein ajr-e-azeem yani jannat dene ka wada kar chuka hai. Go darasal woh is rahmat ko sirf fe'l-e-Ilahi se hasil karenge lekin rahmat ki tawajo ka sabab unke nek a'maal bane. Pas haqeeqatan har tarah qabil-e-tareef-o-sataish Allah hi hai aur yeh sab kuch uska fazl-o-rahm hai. Hikmat-o-adl ka taqaza yahi tha ke imandaron aur nek karon ko jannat di jaye aur kafiron aur jhutlane walon ko jahannam wasil kiya jaye chunancha yunhi hoga. Phir apni ek aur ne'mat yaad dilata hai, jis ki tafseel yeh hai, Hazrat Jabir (R.A) farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ek manzil mein utre, log idhar udhar saya-dar darakhton ki talash mein lag gaye aap ne hathiyar utar kar ek darakht par latka diye. Ek a'rabi ne aakar aap ki talwar apne hath mein le li aur use khench kar An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ke paas khada ho gaya aur kehne laga ab bata ke mujh se tujhe kaun bacha sakta hai? Aap ne foran baad jawab diya ke Allah Azzawajal, us ne phir yahi sawal kiya aur aap ne phir yahi jawab diya, teesri martaba ke jawab ke sath hi uske hath se talwar gir padi, ab aap ne Sahaba ko awaz di aur jab woh aa gaye to un se sara waqia keh diya, a'rabi us waqt bhi majood tha, lekin aap ne us se koi badla na liya. Qatada (R.H) farmate hain ke kuch logon ne dhoke se Huzoor (ﷺ) ko qatl karna chaha tha aur unhon ne is a'rabi ko aap ki ghaat mein bheja tha lekin Allah ne use nakam aur namurad rakha falhamdulillah. Is a'rabi ka naam sahih ahadees mein Ghauth bin Haris aaya hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Yahudiyon ne aap ko aur aap ke Sahaba ko qatl karne ke irada se zehar mila kar khana paka kar dawat kardi, lekin Allah ne aap ko aagah kar diya aur aap bach rahe, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Ka'b bin Ashraf aur uske Yahudi sathiyon ne apne ghar mein bula kar aap ko sadma pahunchana chaha tha.

Ibn-e-Ishaq waghera kehte hain ke is se murad Bani Nazeer ke woh log hain jinhon ne chakki ka paat qila ke oopar se Aap (ﷺ) ke sar par girana chaha tha jabke Aap (ﷺ) Aamiri logon ki diyat ke lene ke liye un ke paas gaye the to un shareeron ne Amr bin Hajjash bin Ka'ab ko is baat par aamada kiya tha ke hum Huzoor (ﷺ) ko neeche khada kar ke baaton mein mashghool kar lenge to oopar se yeh phenk kar Aap ka kaam tamam kar dena lekin raaste mein hi Allah Ta'ala ne apne Paighambar (ﷺ) ko un ki shararat-o-khabasat se aagah kar diya, Aap (ﷺ) ma'a apne Sahaba (R.A) ke wahin se palat gaye, isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai, mominon ko Allah Ta'ala hi par bharosa karna chahiye jo kifayat karne wala, hifazat karne wala hai. Is ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ) Allah ke hukum se Bani Nazeer ki taraf ma'a lashkar gaye, muhasara kiya, woh haare aur unhein jala-watan kar diya.

"Islam" zaban se ahd aur "Iman" amal se ita'at. Is ahd ka izhar is Deen-e-Azeem aur is Rasool-e-Kareem ko bhej kar jo ehsan Allah Ta'ala ne is ummat par kiya hai, use yaad dila raha hai aur is ahd par mazboot rehne ki hidayat kar raha hai jo musalmanon ne Allah ke Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari aur imdad karne, deen par qaim rehne, ise qabool kar lene, ise dusron tak pahunchane ke liye kiya hai. Islam late waqt inhi cheezon ka har momin apni bai'at mein iqrar karta tha, chunancha Sahaba (R.A) ke alfaaz hain ke hum ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se bai'at ki ke "Hum sunte rahenge aur mante chale jayenge, khwah jee chahe khwah na chahe, khwah dusron ko hum par tarjeeh di jaye aur kisi laiq shakhs se hum kisi kaam ko nahin chheenen ge." Bari Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal ka irshad hai ke tum kyun iman nahin late? Halan-ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhein Rabb par iman lane ki dawat de rahe hain, agar tumhein yaqeen ho aur us ne tum se ahd bhi le liya hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is aayat mein Yahudiyon ko yaad dilaya ja raha hai ke tum se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari ke qaul-o-qarar ho chuke hain, phir tumhari nafarmani ke kya ma'ani? Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke "Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki peeth se nikal kar jo ahd Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat ne Bani Adam se liya tha, use yaad dilaya ja raha hai jis mein farmaya tha ke kya main tumhara Rabb nahin hoon? Sab ne iqrar kiya ke haan hum is par gawah hain, lekin pehla qaul zyada zahir hai, Suddi aur Ibn Abbas (R.A) se wahi marwi hai aur Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne bhi isi ko mukhtar bataya hai. Dost ho ya dushman ho, tumhein adl-o-insaf ka sath dena chahiye, taqwe se zyada qareeb yahi hai, 'hu' ki zameer ke marja par dalalat fe'l ne kar di hai jaise ke is ki naziren Quran mein aur bhi hain aur kalam-e-Arab mein bhi, jaise aur jagah hai. Aayat (Wa in qeela lakumurji'oo farji'oo huwa azka lakum, wallahu bima ta'maluna 'aleem) (Surah An-Nur: 28) yani agar tum kisi makan mein jane ki ijazat mango aur na mile balkeh kaha jaye ke wapas jao to tum wapas chale jao yahi tumhare liye zyada pakeezgi ka ba'is hai.

Pas yahan 'hu' ki zameer ka marja' mazkoor nahin, lekin fe'l ki dalalat majood hai yani laut jana isi tarah mandraja ayat mein yani adl karna. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke yahan par 'aqrab' af'al-ut-tafzeel ka seegha aise mauqa par hai ke dusri janib aur koi cheez nahin, jaise is ayat mein hai. (Ashabul jannati yauma'izin khairum mustaqarran wa ahsanu maqila) (25. Al-Furqan: 24) aur jaise ke kisi Sahabiya ka Hazrat Umar (R.A) se kehna ke: 'Anta wa aghlazu min Rasulillah (ﷺ)'. Allah se daro! Woh tumhare amalon se bakhabar hai, har khair-o-shar ka pura pura badla dega. Woh iman walon, nek karon se unke gunahon ki bakhshish ka aur unhein ajr-e-azeem yani jannat dene ka wada kar chuka hai. Go darasal woh is rahmat ko sirf fe'l-e-Ilahi se hasil karenge lekin rahmat ki tawajo ka sabab unke nek a'maal bane. Pas haqeeqatan har tarah qabil-e-tareef-o-sataish Allah hi hai aur yeh sab kuch uska fazl-o-rahm hai. Hikmat-o-adl ka taqaza yahi tha ke imandaron aur nek karon ko jannat di jaye aur kafiron aur jhutlane walon ko jahannam wasil kiya jaye chunancha yunhi hoga. Phir apni ek aur ne'mat yaad dilata hai, jis ki tafseel yeh hai, Hazrat Jabir (R.A) farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ek manzil mein utre, log idhar udhar saya-dar darakhton ki talash mein lag gaye aap ne hathiyar utar kar ek darakht par latka diye. Ek a'rabi ne aakar aap ki talwar apne hath mein le li aur use khench kar An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ke paas khada ho gaya aur kehne laga ab bata ke mujh se tujhe kaun bacha sakta hai? Aap ne foran baad jawab diya ke Allah Azzawajal, us ne phir yahi sawal kiya aur aap ne phir yahi jawab diya, teesri martaba ke jawab ke sath hi uske hath se talwar gir padi, ab aap ne Sahaba ko awaz di aur jab woh aa gaye to un se sara waqia keh diya, a'rabi us waqt bhi majood tha, lekin aap ne us se koi badla na liya. Qatada (R.H) farmate hain ke kuch logon ne dhoke se Huzoor (ﷺ) ko qatl karna chaha tha aur unhon ne is a'rabi ko aap ki ghaat mein bheja tha lekin Allah ne use nakam aur namurad rakha falhamdulillah. Is a'rabi ka naam sahih ahadees mein Ghauth bin Haris aaya hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Yahudiyon ne aap ko aur aap ke Sahaba ko qatl karne ke irada se zehar mila kar khana paka kar dawat kardi, lekin Allah ne aap ko aagah kar diya aur aap bach rahe, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Ka'b bin Ashraf aur uske Yahudi sathiyon ne apne ghar mein bula kar aap ko sadma pahunchana chaha tha.

Ibn-e-Ishaq waghera kehte hain ke is se murad Bani Nazeer ke woh log hain jinhon ne chakki ka paat qila ke oopar se Aap (ﷺ) ke sar par girana chaha tha jabke Aap (ﷺ) Aamiri logon ki diyat ke lene ke liye un ke paas gaye the to un shareeron ne Amr bin Hajjash bin Ka'ab ko is baat par aamada kiya tha ke hum Huzoor (ﷺ) ko neeche khada kar ke baaton mein mashghool kar lenge to oopar se yeh phenk kar Aap ka kaam tamam kar dena lekin raaste mein hi Allah Ta'ala ne apne Paighambar (ﷺ) ko un ki shararat-o-khabasat se aagah kar diya, Aap (ﷺ) ma'a apne Sahaba (R.A) ke wahin se palat gaye, isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai, mominon ko Allah Ta'ala hi par bharosa karna chahiye jo kifayat karne wala, hifazat karne wala hai. Is ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ) Allah ke hukum se Bani Nazeer ki taraf ma'a lashkar gaye, muhasara kiya, woh haare aur unhein jala-watan kar diya.

"Islam" zaban se ahd aur "Iman" amal se ita'at. Is ahd ka izhar is Deen-e-Azeem aur is Rasool-e-Kareem ko bhej kar jo ehsan Allah Ta'ala ne is ummat par kiya hai, use yaad dila raha hai aur is ahd par mazboot rehne ki hidayat kar raha hai jo musalmanon ne Allah ke Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari aur imdad karne, deen par qaim rehne, ise qabool kar lene, ise dusron tak pahunchane ke liye kiya hai. Islam late waqt inhi cheezon ka har momin apni bai'at mein iqrar karta tha, chunancha Sahaba (R.A) ke alfaaz hain ke hum ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se bai'at ki ke "Hum sunte rahenge aur mante chale jayenge, khwah jee chahe khwah na chahe, khwah dusron ko hum par tarjeeh di jaye aur kisi laiq shakhs se hum kisi kaam ko nahin chheenen ge." Bari Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal ka irshad hai ke tum kyun iman nahin late? Halan-ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhein Rabb par iman lane ki dawat de rahe hain, agar tumhein yaqeen ho aur us ne tum se ahd bhi le liya hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is aayat mein Yahudiyon ko yaad dilaya ja raha hai ke tum se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari ke qaul-o-qarar ho chuke hain, phir tumhari nafarmani ke kya ma'ani? Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke "Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki peeth se nikal kar jo ahd Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat ne Bani Adam se liya tha, use yaad dilaya ja raha hai jis mein farmaya tha ke kya main tumhara Rabb nahin hoon? Sab ne iqrar kiya ke haan hum is par gawah hain, lekin pehla qaul zyada zahir hai, Suddi aur Ibn Abbas (R.A) se wahi marwi hai aur Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne bhi isi ko mukhtar bataya hai. Har haal mein insan ko Allah ka khauf rakhna chahiye. Dilon aur seenon ke bhed se woh waqif hai. Iman walo logon ko dikhane ko nahin balkeh Allah ki wajah se haq par qaim ho jao aur adl ke sath sahih gawah ban jao. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Nu'man bin Bashir (R.A) se riwayat hai ke mere baap ne mujhe ek atiya de rakha tha, meri maa Umrah bint-e-Rawahah ne kaha ke main to is waqt tak mutma'in nahin hone lagi jab tak ke tum is par Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko gawah na bana lo, mere baap Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hue waqia bayan kiya to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya kya apni dusri aulad ko bhi aisa hi atiya diya hai? Ahd-shikan log? Aur Imam Mahdi kaun? Upar ki aayaton mein Allah Ta'ala ne apne momin bandon ko ahd-o-paimaan ki wafadari, haq par mustaqeem rehne aur adl ki shahadat dene ka hukum diya tha. Saath hi apni zahiri-o-batini na'amaton ko yaad dilaya tha. Toh ab in aayaton mein un se pehle ke Ahl-e-Kitab se jo ahd-o-misaq liya tha, us ki haqeeqat-o-kaifiyat ko bayan farma raha hai, phir jabke unhon ne Allah se kiye hue ahd-o-paimaan tod daale toh un ka kya hashr hua, ise bayan farma kar goya musalmanon ko ahd-shikani se rokta hai. Un ke barah sardar thay. Ya'ni barah qabeelon ke barah chaudhry thay jo un se un ki bai'at ko pura karate thay ke yeh Allah aur Rasool ke tabe-e-farman rahein aur Kitabullah ki itteba karte rahein. Hazrat Musa (A.S) jab sarkashon se ladne ke liye gaye tab har qabeela mein se ek-ek sardar muntakhab kar gaye thay. Obeel qabeele ka sardar Shamoon bin Akoon tha, Shamooniyon ka chaudhry Shafat bin Jadi, Yahooda ka Kalab bin Yuhanna, Fikhail ka Ibn-e-Yusuf aur Afraim ka Yusha bin Noon aur Bani-Yameen ke qabeele ka chaudhry Qantami bin Wafoon, Zabuloon ka Jadi bin Shoori, Mansha ka Jadi bin Sosi, Daan Hamlasal ka Ibn-e-Hamal, Ashar ka Sator, Taftay ka Bahr aur Ya-Sakhar Kalabal. Taurat ke chauthe juz mein Bani-Israel ke qabeelon ke sardaron ke naam mazkoor hain. Jo in naamon se qadre mukhtalif hain. Wallahu A'lam. Maujooda Taurat ke naam yeh hain. Banu Adeel par Soni bin Sadoon, Bani Shamoon par Shamwal bin Soor, Banu Yahood par Hashoon bin Amyaazab, Banu Yasaakhar par Shaal bin Sa'oon, Banu Zabuloon par Aliyaab bin Haloob, Banu Afraim par Mansha bin Anhoor, Banu Mansha par Hamayil, Banu Biba mein par Abidan, Banu Daan par Ja'eez, Banu Ashaad Nahayil. Banu Kaan par Saif bin Da'wabeel, Banu Naf'ali par Ajza'. Yaad rahe ke Lailat-ul-Aqaba mein jab Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ansar se bai'at li us waqt un ke sardar bhi barah hi thay. Teen qabeela Aus ke. Hazrat Usaid bin Huzair, Hazrat Sa'ad bin Khaishama aur Hazrat Rifa'a bin Abdul Munzir aur nau sardar qabeela Khazraj thay. Abu Umama, As'ad bin Zurara, Sa'ad bin Rabi, Abdullah bin Rawaha, Rafi bin Maalik bin Ajlaan, Bara bin Ma'roor, Ubada bin Samit, Sa'ad bin Ubada, Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram, Munzir bin Amr bin Hunaish Ajma'een. Inhi sardaron ne apni apni qoum ki taraf se Paighambar-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farameen sunne aur manne ki bai'at ki, Hazrat Masrooq farmate hain hum log Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ke paas baithe thay, aap hamein us waqt Quran padha rahe thay toh ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke aap logon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh bhi pucha hai ke is ummat ke kitne khalifa honge? Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne farmaya main jab se Iraq aaya hoon, is sawal ko bajuz tere kisi ne nahin pucha, hum ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is baare mein daryaft kiya tha toh aap ne farmaya, barah honge, jitni ginti Bani-Israel ke naqeebon ki thi.

Yeh riwayat sanadan ghareeb hai, lekin mazmoon hadith Bukhari aur Muslim ki riwayat se bhi sabit hai, Jabir bin Samurah R.A farmate hain "Main ne Nabi ﷺ se suna hai, logon ka kaam chalta rahega, jab tak un ke wali barah shakhs na ho lein, phir ek lafz Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya lekin main na sun saka to main ne dusron se pucha ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ab kaunsa lafz farmaya, unhon ne jawab diya yeh farmaya ke yeh sab Quraish honge." Sahih Muslim mein yahi lafz hain. Is hadith ka matlab yeh hai ke barah khalifa saleh naik bakht honge. Jo haq ko qaim karenge aur logon mein adl karenge. Is se yeh sabit nahin hota ke yeh sab pay dar pay yakay baad deegaray hi hon. Pas chaar khulafa to pay dar pay Hazrat Abu Bakr, Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Usman, Hazrat Ali R.A jin ki khilafat batareeq-e-nubuwwat rahi. Inhi barah mein se paanchwein Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz R.H hain. Banu Abbas mein se bhi ba'az isi tarah ke khalifa huye hain aur Qayamat se pehle pehle in barah ki tadaad puri honi zaroori hai aur inhi mein se Hazrat Imam Mahdi hain, jin ki basharat ahadith mein aa chuki hai un ka naam Huzoor ﷺ ke naam par hoga aur un ke walid ka naam Huzoor ﷺ ke walid ka hoga, zameen ko adl-o-insaf se bhar denge halankeh is se pehle woh zulm-o-jabr se pur hogi lekin is se Shiaon ka Imam-e-Muntazar murad nahin, is ki to darasal koi haqeeqat hi nahin, na saray se is ka koi wajood hai, balkeh yeh to sirf Shia ki waham parasti aur un ka takhayyul hai, na is hadith se Shiaon ke firqay Ithna Ashariya ke aimma murad hain. Is hadith ko un aimma par mahmool karna bhi Shiaon ke is firqa ki banawat hai jo un ki kam-aqli aur jahalat ka karishma hai. Taurat mein Hazrat Ismail A.S ki basharat ke sath hi marqoom hai ke un ki nasl mein se barah baray shakhs honge, is se murad bhi yahi Musalmanon ke barah Quraishi badshah hain lekin jo Yahudi Musalman huye thay, woh apne Islam mein kachay aur jahil bhi thay, unhon ne Shiaon ke kaan mein kahin yeh soor phoonk diya aur woh samajh bethay ke is se murad un ke barah Imam hain, warna hadithein is ke wazeh khilaf majood hain. Ab is ahd-o-paiman ka zikr ho raha hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne Yahudiyon se liya tha ke woh namazein parhte rahein, zakat dete rahein, Allah ke Rasoolon ki tasdeeq karein, un ki nusrat-o-iaanat karein aur Allah ki marzi ke kaamon mein apna maal kharch karein. Jab woh aisa karenge to Allah ki madad-o-nusrat un ke sath rahegi, un ke gunah maaf honge aur yeh jannaton mein dakhil kiye jayenge, maqsood hasil hoga aur khauf zail hoga, lekin agar woh is ahd-o-paiman ke baad phir gaye aur isay ghair maroof kar diya to yaqeenan woh haq se door ho jayenge, bhatak aur behak jayenge.

Chunancha yahi hua ke unhon ne misaq tod diya, wada khilafi ki toh un par Allah ki la'nat nazil hui, hidayat se door ho gaye, un ke dil sakht ho gaye aur wa'z-o-pand se mustafid na ho sake, samajh bigad gayi, Allah ki baton mein her-pher karne lage, batil ta'weelein ghadne lage, jo murad-e-haqiqi thi, us se Kalam-e-Allah ko pher kar aur hi matlab samajhne samjhane lage, Allah ka naam le kar woh masail bayan karne lage, jo murad-e-haqiqi thi, us se Kalam-e-Allah ko pher kar aur hi matlab samajhne samjhane lage, Allah ka naam le kar woh masail bayan karne lage jo Allah ke bataye hue na thay, yahan tak ke Allah ki kitab un ke hathon se chhoot gayi, woh us se be-amal chhoot jaane ki tawajjo se na toh dil theek rahe, na fitrat achi rahi, na khuloos-o-ikhlas raha, ghaddari aur makkari ko apna shiwa bana liya. Nit naye jaal Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur as-hab-e-Nabi ke khilaf bunte rahe. Phir Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukm hota hai ke aap un se chashm-poshi kijiye, yahi mamla un ke sath acha hai, jaise Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) se marwi hai ke jo tujh se Allah ke farman ke khilaf sulook kare toh us se hukm-e-Ilahi ki baja-awari ke matahat sulook kar. Is mein ek badi maslahat yeh bhi hai ke mumkin hai un ke dil khinch aayen, hidayat naseeb ho jaye aur haq ki taraf aa jayen. Allah Ta'ala ehsan karne walon ko dost rakhta hai. Ya'ni dusron ki bad-sulooki se chashm-poshi kar ke khud naya sulook karne wale Allah ke mehboob hain. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain "Darguzar karne ka hukm jihad ki ayat se mansookh hai." Phir irshad hota hai ke "In nasraniyon se bhi hum ne wada liya tha ke jo Rasool aayega, yeh us par iman layenge, us ki madad karenge aur us ki baatein manenge." Lekin unhon ne bhi yahudiyon ki tarah bad-ahdi ki, jis ki saza mein hum ne un mein aapas mein adawat daal di jo Qayamat tak jaari rahegi. Un mein firqe firqe ban gaye jo ek dusre ko kafir-o-mal'oon kehte hain aur apne ibadat khanon mein bhi nahin aane dete. Malkiya firqa Ya'qubiya firqe ko, Ya'qubiya Malkiya ko khule bandon kafir kehte hain, isi tarah dusre tamam firqe bhi, unhein un ke a'maal ki poori tanbeeh anqareeb hogi. Unhon ne bhi Allah ki nasihaton ko bhula diya hai aur Allah par tohmaten lagayi hain, us par biwi aur aulad wala hone ka bohtan bandha hai, yeh Qayamat ke din buri tarah pakde jayenge. Allah Ta'ala Wahid, Ahad, Fard-o-Samad, Lam yalid wa lam yulad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad hai.

Taurat ke chauthe juz mein Bani-Israel ke qabeelon ke sardaron ke naam mazkoor hain. Jo in naamon se qadre mukhtalif hain. Wallahu A'lam. Maujooda Taurat ke naam yeh hain. Banu Adeel par Soni bin Sadoon, Bani Shamoon par Shamwal bin Soor, Banu Yahood par Hashoon bin Amyaazab, Banu Yasaakhar par Shaal bin Sa'oon, Banu Zabuloon par Aliyaab bin Haloob, Banu Afraim par Mansha bin Anhoor, Banu Mansha par Hamayil, Banu Biba mein par Abidan, Banu Daan par Ja'eez, Banu Ashaad Nahayil. Banu Kaan par Saif bin Da'wabeel, Banu Naf'ali par Ajza'. Yaad rahe ke Lailat-ul-Aqaba mein jab Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ansar se bai'at li us waqt un ke sardar bhi barah hi thay. Teen qabeela Aus ke. Hazrat Usaid bin Huzair, Hazrat Sa'ad bin Khaishama aur Hazrat Rifa'a bin Abdul Munzir aur nau sardar qabeela Khazraj thay. Abu Umama, As'ad bin Zurara, Sa'ad bin Rabi, Abdullah bin Rawaha, Rafi bin Maalik bin Ajlaan, Bara bin Ma'roor, Ubada bin Samit, Sa'ad bin Ubada, Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram, Munzir bin Amr bin Hunaish Ajma'een. Inhi sardaron ne apni apni qoum ki taraf se Paighambar-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farameen sunne aur manne ki bai'at ki, Hazrat Masrooq farmate hain hum log Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ke paas baithe thay, aap hamein us waqt Quran padha rahe thay toh ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke aap logon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh bhi pucha hai ke is ummat ke kitne khalifa honge? Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne farmaya main jab se Iraq aaya hoon, is sawal ko bajuz tere kisi ne nahin pucha, hum ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is baare mein daryaft kiya tha toh aap ne farmaya, barah honge, jitni ginti Bani-Israel ke naqeebon ki thi.

Yeh riwayat sanadan ghareeb hai, lekin mazmoon hadith Bukhari aur Muslim ki riwayat se bhi sabit hai, Jabir bin Samurah R.A farmate hain "Main ne Nabi ﷺ se suna hai, logon ka kaam chalta rahega, jab tak un ke wali barah shakhs na ho lein, phir ek lafz Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya lekin main na sun saka to main ne dusron se pucha ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ab kaunsa lafz farmaya, unhon ne jawab diya yeh farmaya ke yeh sab Quraish honge." Sahih Muslim mein yahi lafz hain. Is hadith ka matlab yeh hai ke barah khalifa saleh naik bakht honge. Jo haq ko qaim karenge aur logon mein adl karenge. Is se yeh sabit nahin hota ke yeh sab pay dar pay yakay baad deegaray hi hon. Pas chaar khulafa to pay dar pay Hazrat Abu Bakr, Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Usman, Hazrat Ali R.A jin ki khilafat batareeq-e-nubuwwat rahi. Inhi barah mein se paanchwein Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz R.H hain. Banu Abbas mein se bhi ba'az isi tarah ke khalifa huye hain aur Qayamat se pehle pehle in barah ki tadaad puri honi zaroori hai aur inhi mein se Hazrat Imam Mahdi hain, jin ki basharat ahadith mein aa chuki hai un ka naam Huzoor ﷺ ke naam par hoga aur un ke walid ka naam Huzoor ﷺ ke walid ka hoga, zameen ko adl-o-insaf se bhar denge halankeh is se pehle woh zulm-o-jabr se pur hogi lekin is se Shiaon ka Imam-e-Muntazar murad nahin, is ki to darasal koi haqeeqat hi nahin, na saray se is ka koi wajood hai, balkeh yeh to sirf Shia ki waham parasti aur un ka takhayyul hai, na is hadith se Shiaon ke firqay Ithna Ashariya ke aimma murad hain. Is hadith ko un aimma par mahmool karna bhi Shiaon ke is firqa ki banawat hai jo un ki kam-aqli aur jahalat ka karishma hai. Taurat mein Hazrat Ismail A.S ki basharat ke sath hi marqoom hai ke un ki nasl mein se barah baray shakhs honge, is se murad bhi yahi Musalmanon ke barah Quraishi badshah hain lekin jo Yahudi Musalman huye thay, woh apne Islam mein kachay aur jahil bhi thay, unhon ne Shiaon ke kaan mein kahin yeh soor phoonk diya aur woh samajh bethay ke is se murad un ke barah Imam hain, warna hadithein is ke wazeh khilaf majood hain. Ab is ahd-o-paiman ka zikr ho raha hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne Yahudiyon se liya tha ke woh namazein parhte rahein, zakat dete rahein, Allah ke Rasoolon ki tasdeeq karein, un ki nusrat-o-iaanat karein aur Allah ki marzi ke kaamon mein apna maal kharch karein. Jab woh aisa karenge to Allah ki madad-o-nusrat un ke sath rahegi, un ke gunah maaf honge aur yeh jannaton mein dakhil kiye jayenge, maqsood hasil hoga aur khauf zail hoga, lekin agar woh is ahd-o-paiman ke baad phir gaye aur isay ghair maroof kar diya to yaqeenan woh haq se door ho jayenge, bhatak aur behak jayenge.

Chunancha yahi hua ke unhon ne misaq tod diya, wada khilafi ki toh un par Allah ki la'nat nazil hui, hidayat se door ho gaye, un ke dil sakht ho gaye aur wa'z-o-pand se mustafid na ho sake, samajh bigad gayi, Allah ki baton mein her-pher karne lage, batil ta'weelein ghadne lage, jo murad-e-haqiqi thi, us se Kalam-e-Allah ko pher kar aur hi matlab samajhne samjhane lage, Allah ka naam le kar woh masail bayan karne lage, jo murad-e-haqiqi thi, us se Kalam-e-Allah ko pher kar aur hi matlab samajhne samjhane lage, Allah ka naam le kar woh masail bayan karne lage jo Allah ke bataye hue na thay, yahan tak ke Allah ki kitab un ke hathon se chhoot gayi, woh us se be-amal chhoot jaane ki tawajjo se na toh dil theek rahe, na fitrat achi rahi, na khuloos-o-ikhlas raha, ghaddari aur makkari ko apna shiwa bana liya. Nit naye jaal Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur as-hab-e-Nabi ke khilaf bunte rahe. Phir Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukm hota hai ke aap un se chashm-poshi kijiye, yahi mamla un ke sath acha hai, jaise Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) se marwi hai ke jo tujh se Allah ke farman ke khilaf sulook kare toh us se hukm-e-Ilahi ki baja-awari ke matahat sulook kar. Is mein ek badi maslahat yeh bhi hai ke mumkin hai un ke dil khinch aayen, hidayat naseeb ho jaye aur haq ki taraf aa jayen. Allah Ta'ala ehsan karne walon ko dost rakhta hai. Ya'ni dusron ki bad-sulooki se chashm-poshi kar ke khud naya sulook karne wale Allah ke mehboob hain. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain "Darguzar karne ka hukm jihad ki ayat se mansookh hai." Phir irshad hota hai ke "In nasraniyon se bhi hum ne wada liya tha ke jo Rasool aayega, yeh us par iman layenge, us ki madad karenge aur us ki baatein manenge." Lekin unhon ne bhi yahudiyon ki tarah bad-ahdi ki, jis ki saza mein hum ne un mein aapas mein adawat daal di jo Qayamat tak jaari rahegi. Un mein firqe firqe ban gaye jo ek dusre ko kafir-o-mal'oon kehte hain aur apne ibadat khanon mein bhi nahin aane dete. Allah Ta'ala Wahid, Ahad, Fard-o-Samad, Lam yalid wa lam yulad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad hai.

Allah wahdahu shareek hai. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala Isaiyon ke kufr ko bayan farmata hai ke unhon ne Allah ki makhlooq ko uluhiyat ka darja de rakha hai. Allah Ta'ala shirk se pak hai, tamam cheezein uski mahkoom aur maqdoor hain, har cheez par uski hukoomat aur malkiyat hai. Koi nahin jo use kisi iraday se baaz rakh sakay, koi nahin jo uski marzi ke khilaf lab-kushai ki jurrat kar sakay. Woh agar Maseeh ko, unki walida ko aur roo-e-zameen ki tamam makhlooq ka maujid-o-khaliq wahi hai. Sab ka malik aur sab ka hukmran wahi hai. Jo chahay kar guzray koi cheez uske ikhtiyar se bahar nahin, us se koi baaz-purs nahin kar sakta, uski saltanat-o-mamlikat bahut wasee hai, uski azmat, izzat bahut buland hai, woh aadil-o-ghalib hai. Jisay jis tarah chahta hai banata bigarta hai, uski qudraton ki koi intiha nahin. Nasraniyon ki tardeed ke baad ab Yahudiyon aur Nasraniyon dono ki tardeed ho rahi hai ke unhon ne Allah par ek jhoot yeh bandha ke hum Allah ke betay aur uske mehboob hain, hum ambiya ki aulad hain aur woh Allah ke ladlay farzand hain, apni kitab se naqal karte thay ke Allah Ta'ala ne Israel ko kaha hai (Anta ibni bakri) phir taweelein kar ke matlab ulat-palat kar ke kehte ke jab woh Allah ke betay huay to hum bhi Allah ke betay aur azeez huay halankeh khud un hi mein se jo aqalmand aur sahib-e-deen thay woh unhein samjhatay thay ke in lafzon se sirf buzurgi sabit hoti hai, qarabat-dari nahin. Isi ma'ani ki aayat Nasrani apni kitab se naqal karte thay ke Hazrat Isa A.S ne farmaya (Inni zahibun ila abi wa abikum) is se murad bhi sagga baap na tha balkeh unke apne muhawaray mein Allah ke liye yeh lafz bhi aata tha pas matlab iska yeh hai ke main apne aur tumhare Rabb ki taraf ja raha hoon aur ibadat ka mafhoom wazeh bata raha hai ke yahan is aayat mein jo nisbat Hazrat Isa A.S ki taraf se, wahi nisbat unki tamam ummat ki taraf hai lekin woh log apne batil aqeeday mein Hazrat Isa A.S ko Allah se jo nisbat dete hain, us nisbat ka apne apne oopar itlaq nahin maantay. Pas yeh lafz sirf izzat-o-waqat ke liye tha na ke kuch aur. Allah Ta'ala unhein jawab deta hai ke agar yeh sahih hai to phir tumhare kufr-o-kazb, bohtan-o-iftira par Allah tumhein saza kyun karta hai? Kisi soofi ne kisi faqeeh se daryaft farmaya ke kya Quran mein yeh bhi kahin hai ke habeeb apne habeeb ko azab nahin karta? Is se koi jawab ban na para to soofi ne yahi aayat tilawat farma di, yeh qaul nihayat umdah hai aur isi ki daleel Musnad-e-Ahmed ki yeh hadees hai ke ek martaba Rasool Allah ﷺ apne as-haab ki ek jamaat ke sath raah se guzar rahe thay.

Ek chhota sa bacha rasta mein khel raha tha, uski maa ne jab dekha ke isi jamaat ki jamaat isi raah aa rahi hai toh use dar laga ke bacha ronda na jaye, mera bacha mera bacha kehti hui daudi hui aayi aur jhat se bache ko god mein utha liya. Is par Sahaba (R.A) ne kaha "Huzoor (ﷺ) yeh aurat toh apne pyare bache ko kabhi bhi aag mein nahin daal sakti." Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Theek hai, Allah Ta'ala bhi apne pyare bandon ko hargiz jahannam mein nahin le jayega." Yahudiyon ke jawab mein farmata hai ke tum bhi munjamla aur makhlooq ke ek insaan ho, tumhein dusron par koi fauqiyat-o-fazeelat nahin, Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala apne bandon par haakim hai aur wahi un mein sache faisle karne wala hai, woh jise chahe bakhshe jise chahe pakde, woh jo chahe kar guzarta hai, uska koi haakim nahin, use koi rad nahin kar sakta, "Woh bahut jald bandon se hisab lene wala hai. Zameen-o-Aasman aur unke darmiyan ki makhlooq sab uski malkiyat hai" uske zer-e-asar hai, uski badshahat tale hai, sab ka lautna uski taraf hai, wahi bandon ke faisle karega, woh zalim nahin aadil hai, nekon ko neki aur badon ko badi dega. Nu'man bin Aasa, Bahr bin Amr, Shas bin Adi jo Yahudiyon ke bade bhari ulama the, Huzoor (ﷺ) ke paas aaye, Aap (ﷺ) ne unhein samjhaya bujhaya, aakhirat ke azaab se daraya toh kehne lage suniye, Hazrat aap hamein dara rahe hain, hum toh Allah ke bache aur uske pyare hain, yahi Nasrani bhi kehte the, pas yeh aayat utri. In logon ne ek baat yeh bhi ghad kar mashhoor kar di thi ke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Israel (A.S) ki taraf wahi nazil farmayi ke tera pehlauta beta meri aulad mein se hai. Uski aulad chalis din tak jahannam mein rahegi, is muddat mein aag unhein paak kar degi aur unki khataon ko kha jayegi, phir ek farishta munadi karega ke Israel (A.S) ki aulad mein se jo bhi khatna shuda hon, woh nikal aayen, yahi ma'ani hain unke is qaul ke jo Quran mein marwi hai woh kehte hain hamein ginti ke chand hi din jahannam mein rehna padega.

Allah wahdahu shareek hai. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala Isaiyon ke kufr ko bayan farmata hai ke unhon ne Allah ki makhlooq ko uluhiyat ka darja de rakha hai. Allah Ta'ala shirk se pak hai, tamam cheezein uski mahkoom aur maqdoor hain, har cheez par uski hukoomat aur malkiyat hai. Koi nahin jo use kisi iraday se baaz rakh sakay, koi nahin jo uski marzi ke khilaf lab-kushai ki jurrat kar sakay. Woh agar Maseeh ko, unki walida ko aur roo-e-zameen ki tamam makhlooq ka maujid-o-khaliq wahi hai. Sab ka malik aur sab ka hukmran wahi hai. Jo chahay kar guzray koi cheez uske ikhtiyar se bahar nahin, us se koi baaz-purs nahin kar sakta, uski saltanat-o-mamlikat bahut wasee hai, uski azmat, izzat bahut buland hai, woh aadil-o-ghalib hai. Jisay jis tarah chahta hai banata bigarta hai, uski qudraton ki koi intiha nahin. Nasraniyon ki tardeed ke baad ab Yahudiyon aur Nasraniyon dono ki tardeed ho rahi hai ke unhon ne Allah par ek jhoot yeh bandha ke hum Allah ke betay aur uske mehboob hain, hum ambiya ki aulad hain aur woh Allah ke ladlay farzand hain, apni kitab se naqal karte thay ke Allah Ta'ala ne Israel ko kaha hai (Anta ibni bakri) phir taweelein kar ke matlab ulat-palat kar ke kehte ke jab woh Allah ke betay huay to hum bhi Allah ke betay aur azeez huay halankeh khud un hi mein se jo aqalmand aur sahib-e-deen thay woh unhein samjhatay thay ke in lafzon se sirf buzurgi sabit hoti hai, qarabat-dari nahin. Isi ma'ani ki aayat Nasrani apni kitab se naqal karte thay ke Hazrat Isa A.S ne farmaya (Inni zahibun ila abi wa abikum) is se murad bhi sagga baap na tha balkeh unke apne muhawaray mein Allah ke liye yeh lafz bhi aata tha pas matlab iska yeh hai ke main apne aur tumhare Rabb ki taraf ja raha hoon aur ibadat ka mafhoom wazeh bata raha hai ke yahan is aayat mein jo nisbat Hazrat Isa A.S ki taraf se, wahi nisbat unki tamam ummat ki taraf hai lekin woh log apne batil aqeeday mein Hazrat Isa A.S ko Allah se jo nisbat dete hain, us nisbat ka apne apne oopar itlaq nahin maantay. Pas yeh lafz sirf izzat-o-waqat ke liye tha na ke kuch aur. Allah Ta'ala unhein jawab deta hai ke agar yeh sahih hai to phir tumhare kufr-o-kazb, bohtan-o-iftira par Allah tumhein saza kyun karta hai? Muhammad ﷺ mutlaqan Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain! Is ayat mein Allah Ta'ala Yahood-o-Nasara ko khitab kar ke farmata hai ke main ne tum sab ki taraf apna Rasool bhej diya hai jo Khatam-ul-Anbiya hai, jis ke baad koi Nabi Rasool aane wala nahin, yeh sab ke baad hain, dekh lo Hazrat Isa A.S ke baad se le kar ab tak koi Rasool nahin aaya, (Fatrat) ki is lambi muddat ke baad yeh Rasool aaye, ba'az kehte hain yeh muddat chhe sau saal ki thi, ba'az kehte hain saarhe paanch sau baras ki, ba'az kehte hain paanch sau chalis baras ki, koi kehta hai chaar sau kuch oopar tees baras ki. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Hazrat Isa A.S ke aasman ki taraf uthaye jaane aur hamare Nabi ﷺ ke hijrat karne ke darmiyan nau sau taintis saal ka fasla tha. Lekin mashhoor qaul pehla hi hai yani chhe sau saal ka, ba'az kehte hain chhe sau bees saal ka fasla tha. In dono qaulon mein is tarah tatbiq bhi ho sakti hai ke pehla qaul shamsi hisab se ho aur doosra qamari hisab se ho aur is ginti mein har teen sau saal mein taqreeban aath ka farq par jata hai. Isi liye Ahl-e-Kahf ke qisse mein hai: "Wa labithu fi kahfihim thalatha mi'atin sinina wazdadu tis'a." Woh log apne ghaar mein teen sau saal tak rahe aur nau baras aur zyada kiye. Pas shamsi hisab se Ahl-e-Kitab ko jo muddat un ki ghaar ki maloom thi, woh teen sau saal ki thi, nau barha kar qamari hisab poora ho gaya, ayat se maloom hua ke Hazrat Isa A.S se le kar jo Bani Israel ke aakhri Nabi the, Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ tak jo 'ala al-itlaq Khatam-ul-Anbiya the, Fatrat ka zamana tha yani darmiyan mein koi Nabi nahin hua. Chunancha Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai "Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain Hazrat Isa A.S se ba-nisbat aur logon ke main zyada aula hoon, is liye ke mere aur un ke darmiyan koi Nabi nahin." Is mein un logon ki bhi tardeed hai jo khayal karte hain ke in dono jaleel-ul-qadr paighambaron ke darmiyan bhi ek Nabi guzre hain, jin ka naam Khalid bin Sinan tha. Jaise ke Quda'i waghera ne hikayat ki hai. Maqsood yeh hai ke Khatam-ul-Anbiya Habibullah ﷺ duniya mein us waqt tashreef laate hain jabke rasoolon ki taleem mit chuki hai, un ki raahein be-nishan ho chuki hain, duniya tauheed ko bhula chuki hai, duniya tauheed ko bhula chuki hai, jagah jagah makhlooq parasti ho rahi hai, sooraj chand but aag ki pooja ki ja rahi hai, Allah ka deen badal chuka hai, kufr ki tareeki noor-e-deen par chha chuki hai, duniya ka chappa chappa sarkashi aur tughyani se bhar gaya hai, adl-o-insaf balkeh insaniyat bhi fana ho chuki hai, jahalat-o-qasawat ka daur daura hai, bajuz chand nufoos ke Allah ka naam lewa zameen par nahin raha, pas maloom hua ke Aap ki jalalat-o-izzat Allah ke paas bahut bari thi aur Aap ne jo risalat ki zimmedari ada ki, woh koi mamooli na thi, ﷺ.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne ek khutba mein farmaya "Mujhe mere Rab ka hukum hai ke main tumhein woh baatein sikhaoon, jin se tum nawaqif ho aur Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe aaj bhi batayi hain, farmaya hai main ne apne bandon ko jo kuch inayat farmaya hai woh un ke liye halal hai, main ne apne sab bandon ko muwahid paida kiya hai, lekin phir Shaitan un ke paas aata hai aur unhein behkata hai aur meri halal karda cheezein un par haram karta hai aur unhein kehta hai ke woh mere sath bawajood daleel na hone ke shirk karein. Suno Allah Ta'ala ne zameen walon ko dekha aur tamam Arab-o-Ajam ko napasand farmaya bajuz un chand baqaya Bani Israel ke (jo tauheed par qaim hain) phir (mujh se) farmaya, main ne tujhe isi liye apna Nabi bana kar bheja hai ke teri aazmaish karoon aur teri wajah se auron ki bhi aazmaish kar loon. Main ne tujh par woh Kitab nazil farmayi hai, jise pani dho nahin sakta jise tu sote jaagte padhta hai, phir mujhe mere Rab ne hukum diya ke Quraishiyon mein paigham-e-Ilahi pahunchaoon main ne kaha Ya Rab yeh to mera sar kuchal kar roti jaisa bana denge, Parwardigar ne farmaya tu unhein nikal, jaise unhon ne tujhe nikala tu un se jihad kar, teri imdad ki jayegi. Tu un par kharch kar, tujh par kharch kiya jayega, tu un ke muqable par lashkar bhej, hum us se paanch guna lashkar aur bhi bhejenge apne farmanbardaron ko le kar apne nafarmaron se jang kar, Jannati log teen qisam ke hain, badshah-e-adil, taufeeq-e-khair wala, sadqa khairat karne wala aur bawajood muflis hone ke haram se bachne wala, halankeh ahl-o-ayal bhi hai, aur Jahannami log paanch qisam ke hain woh suflay log jo bedeen, khushamad khore aur matahat hain, jin ki aal-aulad dhan daulat hai aur woh hain log jin ke daant choti se choti cheez par bhi hote hain aur haqeer cheezon mein bhi khayanat se nahin chookte aur woh log jo subh-o-sham logon ko un ke ahl-o-maal mein dhoka dete phirte hain aur bakheel hain farmaya kazzab aur shanteer yani badgo." Yeh hadith Muslim aur Nasai mein hai. Maqsood yeh hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ba'asat ke waqt saccha deen duniya mein na tha, Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki wajah se logon ko andheron se aur gumrahiyon se nikal kar ujale mein aur rah-e-rast par la khada kiya aur unhein roshan-o-zahir shariat ata farmayi. Is liye ke logon ka uzr na rahe, unhein yeh kehne ki gunjaish na rahe ke hamare paas koi Nabi nahin aaya, hamein na to kisi ne koi khushkhabri sunayi na dhamkaya daraya. Pas kamil qudraton wale Allah ne apne barguzida paighambaron ko sari duniya ki hidayat ke liye bhej diya, woh apne farmanbardaron ko sawab dene par aur nafarmaron ko azab karne par qadir hai.

Tasalsul-e-Anbiya, nasl-e-insani par Allah ki rahmat. Hazrat Musa A.S ne apni qoum ko Allah ki jo ne'matein yaad dila kar us ki ita'at ki taraf mail kiya tha, us ka bayan ho raha hai ke farmaya "Logon! Allah ki us ne'mat ko yaad karo ke us ne ek ke baad ek nabi tum mein, tumhin mein se bheja." Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah A.S ke baad se unhi ki nasl mein nabuwat rahi. Yeh sab anbiya tumhein dawat-e-tauheed-o-ittiba dete rahe. Yeh silsila Hazrat Isa Ruhullah A.S par khatam hua, phir Khatam-ul-Anbiya-wal-Mursaleen Hazrat Muhammad bin Abdullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko nabuwat-e-kamilah ata hui, aap Ismail A.S ke wasta se Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki aulad mein se the, jo apne se pehle ke tamam rasoolon aur nabiyon se afzal the. Allah aap par durood-o-salam nazil farmaye aur tumhein us ne badshah bana diya yani khadim diye, biwiyan dein, ghar baar diya aur us waqt jitne log the, un sab se zyada ne'matein tumhein ata farmayin. Yeh log itna paane ke baad badshah kehlaane lagte hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Aas R.A se ek shakhs ne poocha ke kya main fuqra-e-muhajireen mein se nahin hoon? Aap ne farmaya teri biwi hai? Us ne kaha haan, ghar bhi hai? Kaha haan, kaha phir to tu ghani hai, us ne kaha yun to mera khadim bhi hai, aap ne farmaya phir to tu badshahon mein se hai. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain "Sawari aur khadim mulk hai". Bani Israel aise logon ko mulook kaha karte the. Baqol Qatada R.H khadimon ka awwal riwaj in Bani Israelion ne hi diya hai. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke un logon mein jis ke paas khadim, sawari aur biwi ho woh badshah kaha jata tha. Ek aur marfoo hadith mein hai "Jis ka ghar ho aur khadim ho woh badshah hai". Yeh hadith mursal aur ghareeb hai. Ek hadith mein aaya hai "Jo shakhs is halat mein subh kare ke us ka jism sahih salim ho, us ka nafs aman-o-aman mein ho, din bhar kifayat kare, us ke liye itna maal bhi ho to us ke liye goya kul duniya simat kar aa gayi". Us waqt jo Yunani, Qibti waghera the un se yeh ashraf-o-afzal maane gaye the aur ayat mein hai hum ne Bani Israel ko kitab, hukm, nabuwat, pakeeza roziyan aur sab par fazeelat di thi. Hazrat Musa A.S se jab unhon ne mushrikon ki dekha dekhi Allah banane ko kaha us ke jawab mein Hazrat Musa A.S ne Allah ke fazl bayan karte hue yahi farmaya tha ke us ne tumhein tamam jahan par fazeelat de rakhi hai. Matlab sab jagah yahi hai ke us waqt ke tamam logon par kyunke yeh sabit shuda amr hai ke yeh ummat un se afzal hai, kya shar'i haisiyat se, kya ahkami haisiyat se, kya nabuwat ki haisiyat se, kya badshahat, izzat, mamlikat, daulat, hashmat, maal, aulad waghera ki haisiyat se, khud Quran farmata hai ayat (Kuntum khaira ummatin ukhrijat lin-nasi ta'muruna bil-ma'rufi wa tanhawna 'anil-munkari wa tu'minuna billah) (Surah Al-Imran: 110) aur farmaya ayat (Wa kazalika ja'alnakum ummatan wasatal-litakunu shuhada'a 'alan-nasi wa yakunar-rasulu 'alaikum shahida) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 143).

(Al-Baqarah: 143) Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke "Bani Israel ke sath is fazeelat mein Ummat-e-Muhammadi (ﷺ) ko bhi shamil kar ke khitab kiya gaya hai" aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke "ba'az umoor mein unhein filwaq'e ala-al-itlaq fazeelat di gayi thi jaise Mann-o-Salwa ka utarna, badalon se saya muhayya karna waghera jo khilaf-e-adat cheezein thin". Yeh qaul aksar mufassireen ka hai jaisa pehle bayan ho chuka hai ke murad is se un ke apne zamane walon par unhein fazeelat diya jana hai, Wallahu A'lam. Phir bayan hota hai ke "Bait-ul-Muqaddas darasal un ke dada Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ke zamana mein unhi ke qabze mein tha aur jab woh ma'a apne ahl-o-ayal ke Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke paas Misr chale gaye to yahan Amalqa qaum is par qabza jama baithi, woh bade mazboot hath pairon ki thi. Ab Hazrat Musa (A.S) apni qaum se farmate hain ke tum un se jihad karo Allah tumhein un par ghalib karega aur yahan ka qabza phir tumhein mil jayega lekin yeh namardi dikhate hain aur buzdili se munh pher lete hain. Un ki saza mein unhein chalees saal tak wadi-e-Teeh mein hairan-o-sargardan khana-badoshi mein rehna padta hai, Muqaddasa se murad pak hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh wadi-e-Toor aur us ke paas ki zameen ka zikr hai, ek riwayat mein Ariha ka zikr hai lekin yeh theek nahin, is liye ke na to Ariha ka fath karna maqsood tha, na woh un ke raste mein tha, kyunke woh Firaun ki halakat ke baad Misr ke shehron se aa rahe the aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas ja rahe the, yeh ho sakta hai ke woh mashhoor shehar jo Toor ki taraf Bait-ul-Muqaddas ke mashriqi rukh par tha". "Allah ne ise tumhare liye likh diya hai" matlab yeh hai ke tumhare baap Israel (A.S) se Allah ne wada kiya hai ke woh teri aulad ke ba-iman logon ke wirse mein aayega, tum apni peethon par murtad na ho jao. Yani jihad se munh pher kar thak kar na baith jao, warna zabardast nuqsan mein pad jaoge. Jis ke jawab mein woh kehte hain ke jis shehar mein jaane aur jin shehrion se jihad karne ke liye aap farma rahe hain, hamein maloom hai ke woh bade qawi taqatwar aur jangju hain, hum un se muqabla nahin kar sakte, jab tak woh wahan majood hain, hum us shehar mein nahin ja sakte, han agar woh log wahan se nikal jayen to hum chale jayenge, warna aap ke hukm ki tameel hamari taqat se bahar hai, Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke "Hazrat Musa (A.S) jab Ariha ke qareeb pahunch gaye to aap ne barah jasoos muqarrar kiye, Bani Israel ke har qabeelay mein se ek jasoos liya aur unhein Ariha mein bhej kar sahih khabrein le aayen. Yeh log jab gaye to un ki jasamat aur quwwat se khauf-zada ho gaye".

Ek bagh mein yeh sab ke sab thay, ittefaqan bagh wala phal todne ke liye aa gaya, woh phal todta hua unke qadmon ke nishan dhoondta hua unke paas pahunch gaya aur unhein bhi phalon ke sath hi sath apni gathri mein bandh liya aur jakar badshah ke samne bagh ke phal ki gathri khol kar daal di, jis mein yeh sab ke sab thay, badshah ne unhein kaha ab toh tumhein hamari quwwat ka andaza ho gaya hai, tumhein qatl nahin karta jao wapas jao aur apne logon se hamari quwwat bayan kardo. Chunancha unhon ne jakar sab haal bayan kiya jis se Bani Israel ra'ab mein aa gaye". Lekin iski asnad theek nahin. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke in barah logon ko ek shakhs ne pakad liya aur apni chadar mein gathri bandh kar nehar mein le gaya aur logon ke samne unhein daal diya, unhon ne poocha tum kaun log ho? Jawab diya ke hum Musa ki qaum ke log hain, hum tumhari khabrein lene ke liye bheje gaye thay. Unhon ne ek angoor unko diya jo ek shakhs ko kafi tha aur kaha jao inse keh do ke yeh hamare meway hain. Unhon ne wapas ja kar qaum se sab haal keh diya, ab Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne unhein jihad ka aur us shehar mein jaane ka hukum diya toh unhon ne saaf keh diya ke aap aur aap ka Allah jayen aur ladein hum toh yahan se hilne ke bhi nahin. Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne ek baans le kar napa jo pachaas ya pachpan haath ka tha, phir use gaad kar farmaya "In Amaliq ke qad is qadar lambay thay". Mufassireen ne yahan par Israeli riwayatein bahut si bayan ki hain ke yeh log is qadar qawi thay, itne motay aur itne lambay qad thay, inhi mein Auj bin Unuq bin Hazrat Adam (A.S) tha, jiska qad lambai mein (3333) teen hazar teen sau teetis gaz ka tha, aur chaudai uske jism ki teen gaz ki thi lekin yeh sab baatein wahi hain, inke toh zikr se bhi haya mani hai, phir yeh sahih hadith ke khilaf bhi hain, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Adam (A.S) ko saath haath paida kiya tha, phir se aaj tak makhlooq ke qad ghat-te hi rahe, in Israeli riwayaton mein yeh bhi hai ke Auj bin Unuq kafir tha aur walad-uz-zina tha yeh toofan-e-Nuh mein thay aur Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ke sath unki kashti mein na baitha tha, taham pani uske ghutnon tak bhi na pahuncha tha. Yeh mehez laghw aur bilkul jhoot hai balkay Quran ke khilaf hai, Quran-e-Kareem mein Nuh (A.S) ki dua yeh mazkoor hai ke zameen par ek kafir bhi na bachna chahiye, yeh dua qabool hui aur yahi hua bhi, Quran farmata hai "Hum ne Nuh ko aur unki kashti walon ko nijat di, phir baqi ke sab kafiron ko gharq kardiya". Khud Quran mein hai ke "Aaj ke din bajuz un logon ke jin par Rahmat-e-Haq hai, koi bhi bachne ka nahin". Ta'ajjub sa ta'ajjub hai ke Nuh (A.S) ka ladka bhi jo imandar na tha bach na sake lekin Auj bin Unuq kafir walad-uz-zina bach rahe. Yeh bilkul aql-o-naql ke khilaf hai balkay hum toh siray se iske bhi qail nahin ke Auj bin Unuq nami koi shakhs tha Wallahu A'alam.

Bani Israel jab apne Nabi (A.S) ko nahin maante balkeh un ke samne sakht-kalami aur be-adabi karte to woh shakhs jin par Allah ka in'am-o-ikram tha, woh unhein samjhate hain. Un ke dilon mein Allah ka khauf tha, woh darte the, keh Bani Israel ki is sarkashi se kahin azab-e-Ilahi na aa jaye, ek qira'at mein (yakhaufuna) ke badle (yahabuna) hai, is se murad yeh hai keh "un dono buzurgon ki qoum mein izzat-o-azmat thi". Ek ka naam Hazrat Yusha bin Noon (A.S) tha dusre ka naam Kalib bin Yufa tha". Unhon ne kaha keh agar tum Allah par bharosa rakhoge, us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at karoge to Allah Ta'ala tumhein un dushmanon par ghalib kar de ga aur woh tumhari madad ko ta'eed kare ga aur tum us shehar mein ghalbe ke sath pahunch jaoge, tum darwaze tak to chale chalo, yaqeen mano keh ghalba tumhara hi hai. Lekin un namuradon ne apna pehla jawab aur mazboot kar diya aur kaha keh is jabbar qoum ki maujoodgi mein hamara ek qadam barhana bhi namumkin hai. Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur Hazrat Haroon (A.S) ne dekh kar bahut samjhaya yahan tak keh un ke samne bari aajizi ki lekin woh na mane. Yeh haal dekh kar Hazrat Yusha (A.S) aur Hazrat Kalib (A.S) ne apne kapre phaar dale aur unhein bahut kuch malamat ki. Lekin yeh badnaseeb aur akar gaye, balkeh yeh bhi kaha gaya hai keh un dono buzurgon ko unhon ne pathron se shaheed kar diya, ek toofan-e-badtameezi shuru ho gaya aur betarah mukhalifat-e-Rasool par tul gaye. Un ke is haal ko samne rakh kar phir Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Sahaba (R.A) ke haal ko dekhiye keh jab nau sau ya ek hazar kafir apne qafle ko bachane ke liye chale, qafila to dusre raste se nikal gaya lekin unhon ne apni taqat-o-quwwat ke ghamand par Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko nuqsan pahunchaye baghair wapas jana apni ummidon par pani pherna, samajh kar Islam aur Musalmanon ko kuchal dalne ke irade se Madina ka rukh kiya, udhar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jab yeh halat maloom hue to aap ne apne Sahaba (R.A) se kaha keh batao ab kya karna chahiye? Allah un sab se khush rahe, unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke muqable mein apne maal apni jaanein aur apne ahl-o-ayal sab ko hech samjha na kuffar ke ghalbe ko dekha, na asbab par nazar dali balkeh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke farman pe qurban hain. Sab se pehle Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne is qisam ki guftagu ki, phir Muhajireen Sahaba (R.A) mein se kai ek ne isi qisam ki taqreer ki. Lekin phir bhi aap ne farmaya? Aur bhi koi shakhs apna irada zahir karna chahe to kare, aap ka maqsad is se yeh tha keh Ansar ka dili irada maloom karein, is liye keh yeh jagah unhi ki thi aur tadaad mein bhi yeh Muhajireen se zyada the. Is par Hazrat Sa'ad bin Mu'az Ansari (R.A) wa Ansar khare ho gaye aur farmane lage shayad aap ka irada hamari mansha maloom karne ka hai "Suniye Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Qasam hai us Allah ki jis ne aap ko haq ke sath sacha Nabi bana kar bheja hai keh agar aap hamein samundar ke kinare khara kar ke farmayein keh is mein kood jao to baghair kisi pesh-o-pesh ke is mein kood jayenge".

Aap dekh lenge ke hum mein se ek bhi na hoga jo kinare par khada reh jaye, Huzoor ﷺ aap apne dushmanon ke muqable mein hamein shauq se le chaliye. Aap dekh lenge ke hum ladai mein sabr aur sabit qadmi dikhane wale log hain, aap jaan lenge ke hum Allah ki mulaqat ko sach janne wale log hain, aap Allah ka naam lijiye, khade ho jaiye hamein dekh kar hamari bahaduri aur istiqal ko dekh kar Insha'Allah aap ki aankhein thandi hongi. Yeh sun kar Allah ke Rasool ﷺ khush ho gaye aur aap ko Ansar ki yeh baatein bahut hi bhali maloom huin (R.A). Ek riwayat mein hai ke Badr ki ladai ke mauqe par aap ne musalmanon se mashwara liya, Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne kuch kaha phir Ansariyon ne kaha ke agar aap hamari sunna chahte hain, to suniye hum Bani Israel ki tarah nahin, jo keh dein ke aap aur aap ka Allah ja kar ladein, hum yahan baithe hain, balkeh hamara jawab yeh hai ke aap Allah ki madad le kar jihad ke liye chaliye, hum jaan-o-maal se aap ke sath hain. Hazrat Miqdad Ansari (R.A) ne bhi khade ho kar yahi farmaya tha. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmaya karte the ke Hazrat Miqdad (R.A) ke is qaul se Allah ke Rasool ﷺ khush ho gaye, unhon ne kaha tha ke Huzoor ﷺ ladai ke waqt dekh lenge ke aap ke aage peeche dayein bayein hum hi hum honge. Kash ke koi aisa mauqa mujhe mayassar aata ke main Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ko is qadar khush kar sakta. Ek riwayat mein Hazrat Miqdad (R.A) ka yeh qaul Hudaibiya ke din marwi hai jabke mushrikeen ne aap ko Umrah ke liye Baitullah Sharif jate hue raste mein roka aur qurbani ke janwar bhi zibah ki jagah na pahunch sake to aap ne farmaya main to apni qurbani ke janwar ko le kar Baitullah pahunch kar qurban karna chahta hoon to Hazrat Miqdad bin Aswad (R.A) ne farmaya hum Ashab-e-Musa (A.S) ki tarah nahin ke unhon ne apne Nabi ﷺ se keh diya ke aap aur aap ka Allah ja kar lad lo hum to yahan baithe hain. Hum kehte hain Huzoor ﷺ aap chaliye Allah ki madad aap ke sath ho aur hum sab ke sab aap ke sathi hain, yeh sun kar Ashab ne bhi isi tarah jaan nisaron ke wade karne shuru kar diye. Pas agar is riwayat mein Hudaibiya ka zikr mehfooz ho to ho sakta hai ke Badr wale din bhi aap ne yeh farmaya ho aur Hudaibiya wale din bhi yahi farmaya ho wallahu a'lam. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko apni ummat ka yeh jawab sun kar un par bahut gussa aaya aur Allah ke samne un se apni bezari ka izhar kiya ke "Rabbul Aalameen mujhe to apni jaan par aur apne bhai par ikhtiyar hai, to mere aur meri qaum ke in fasiqon ke darmiyan faisla farma". Janab-e-Bari ne yeh dua qabool farmayi aur farmaya ke ab chalees saal tak yahan se ja nahin sakte. Wadi-e-Teeh mein hairan-o-sargardan ghoomte phirte rahenge, kisi tarah is ki hudood se bahar nahin ja sakte the. Yahan unhon ne ajeeb-o-ghareeb khilaf-e-adat umoor dekhe maslan abr ka saya un par hona, Mann-o-Salwa ka utarna.

Ek thos patthar se, jo un ke saath tha, paani ka nikalna, Hazrat Musa A.S ne us patthar par ek lakri maari toh foran hi us se barah chashme paani ke jaari ho gaye aur har qabeelay ki taraf ek chashma beh nikla, is ke siwa aur bhi bohat se mojzay Bani Israel ne wahan par dekhay, yahin Taurat utri, yahin Ahkam-e-Ilahi nazil huay waghera waghera, isi maidan mein chalees saal tak yeh ghoomtay phirtay rahay lekin koi raah wahan se guzar jaanay ki unhein na mili. Haan abr ka saya un par kar diya gaya aur Mann-o-Salwa utaar diya gaya. Futoon ki mutawwal hadith mein Ibn Abbas R.A se yeh sab marwi hai. Phir Hazrat Haroon A.S ki wafat ho gayi aur us ke teen saal baad Kaleemullah Hazrat Musa A.S bhi inteqal farma gaye, phir aap ke khalifa Hazrat Yusha bin Noon A.S nabi banaye gaye. Isi asna mein bohat se Bani Israel mar mara chukay thay, balkay yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke sirf Hazrat Yusha aur Kalab hi baqi rahay thay. Baaz mufassireen 'sannatan' par waqf-e-taam kartay hain aur 'arba'een sannatan' ko nasb ki halat mein mantay hain aur is ka aamil (yatayahoona fil-ard) ko batlatay hain. Is se bhi baqi Bani Israel un ke saath ho liye aur aap ne Bait-ul-Muqaddas ka mohasra kar liya. Jumma ke din asr ke baad jab ke fath ka waqt aapohncha dushmanon ke qadam ukhad gaye, itnay mein sooraj doobnay laga aur sooraj doobnay ke baad haftay ki ta'zeem ki wajah se ladai ho nahin sakti thi is liye Allah ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya "Ae sooraj! Tu bhi Allah ka ghulam hai aur main bhi Allah ka mehkoom hoon, ae Allah! Isay zara si der rok de." Chunancha Allah ke hukum se sooraj ruk gaya aur aap ne diljami ke saath Bait-ul-Muqaddas ko fath kar liya. Allah Ta'ala ka hukum hua ke Bani Israel ko keh do is shehar ke darwazay mein sajday kartay huay jayen aur 'Hittatun' kahein yani ya Allah hamari gunah maaf farma. Lekin unhon ne Allah ke hukum ko badal diya. Ranon par ghasat-tay huay aur zaban se 'habbatun fi sha'ratin' kehtay huay shehar mein gaye, mazeed tafseel Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafseer mein guzar chuki hai, doosri riwayat mein itni ziyadati bhi hai ke is qadar maal-e-ghaneemat unhein hasil hua ke itna maal kabhi unhon ne nahin dekha tha. Farman-e-Rabb ke mutabiq isay aag mein jalanay ke liye aag ke paas le gaye lekin aag ne isay jalaya nahin, is par un ke Nabi Hazrat Yusha A.S ne farmaya "Tum mein se kisi ne is mein se kuch chura liya hai, pas mere paas har qabeelay ka sardar aaye aur mere haath par bai'at karay." Chunancha yunhi kiya gaya, ek qabeelay ke sardar ka haath Allah ke Nabi ﷺ ke haath se chipak gaya, aap ne farmaya "Tere paas jo bhi khayanat ki cheez hai, isay le aa." Us ne ek gaaye ka sar sonay ka bana hua pesh kiya, jis ki aankhein yaqoot ki theen aur daant moti ke thay, jab woh bhi doosray maal ke saath daal diya gaya, ab aag ne is sab maal ko jala diya.

Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne bhi isi qaul ko pasand kiya hai (Arba'een Sanah) mein (Fa-innaha Muharramatun) aamil hai, aur Bani Israel ki yeh jamaat chalees baras tak isi Maidan-e-Teeh mein sargardan rahi phir Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke sath yeh log nikle aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas ko fatah kiya. Is ki daleel agle ulama-e-Yahood ka ijma hai ke 'Uj bin Unq ko Hazrat Kaleemullah (A.S) ne hi qatl kiya hai. Agar is ka qatl Amaliq ki is jang se pehle ka hota toh koi wajah na thi ke Bani Israel jang-e-Amaliq ka inkar kar baithte? Toh maloom hua ke yeh waqia Teeh se chhootne ke baad ka hai, ulama-e-Yahood ka is par bhi ijma hai ke Bal'am bin Ba'oora ne qaum-e-Amaliq ke jabbaron ki iaanat ki aur us ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) par bad-dua ki. Yeh waqia bhi is maidan ki qaid se chhootne ke baad ka hai. Is liye ke is se pehle toh jabbaron ko Musa (A.S) aur un ki qaum se koi dar na tha. Ibn-e-Jarir ki yahi daleel hai woh yeh bhi kehte hain ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ka asa das hath ka tha aur aap ka qad bhi das hath ka tha aur das hath zameen se uchhal kar aap ne 'Uj bin Unq ko woh asa mara tha jo us ke takhne par laga aur woh mar gaya, us ke jussay se Neel ka pul banaya gaya tha, jis par se saal bhar tak ahl-e-Neel aate jaate rahe. Nauf Bakali kehte hain ke us ka takht teen gaz ka tha. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tasalli dete hue farmata hai ke tu apni qaum Bani Israel par gham-o-ranj na kar, woh isi jail khane ke mustahiq hain, is waqia mein darhaqiqat Yahoodiyon ko daant-dapat ka zikr hai aur un ki mukhalifaton ka aur buraiyon ka bayan hai. Yeh dushmanan-e-Rabb sakhti ke waqt Allah ke deen par qaim nahin rehte the, Rasoolon ki pairwi se inkar kar jaate the, jihad se jee churate the, Allah ke is Kaleem-o-buzurg Rasool (A.S) ki maujoodgi ka, un ke wade ka, un ke hukm ka koi paas unhon ne nahin kiya, din raat mojze dekhte the, Firaun ki barbadi apni aankhon dekh li thi aur use kuch zamana bhi na guzra tha, Allah ke buzurg Kaleem paighambar sath hain, woh nusrat-o-fatah ke wade kar rahe hain, magar yeh hain ke apni buzdili mein mare ja rahe hain aur na sirf inkar balkeh haulanaki ke sath inkar karte hain, Nabi-e-Allah ki be-adabi karte hain aur saaf jawab dete hain. Apni aankhon dekh chuke hain ke Firaun jaise ba-samaan badshah ko us ke saaz-o-samaan aur lashkar-o-ra'iyat samet us Rabb ne dubo diya. Lekin phir bhi isi basti walon ki taraf Allah ke bharose par us ke hukm ki mat-huti mein nahin barhte halankeh yeh Firaun ke daswein hissa mein bhi na the. Pas Allah ka ghazab un par nazil hota hai, un ki buzdili duniya par zahir ho jaati hai aur aaye din un ki ruswai aur zillat barhti jaati hai. Goya yeh log apne tain Allah ke mehboob jaante the lekin haqeeqat is ke bilkul bar-aks thi. Rabb ki nazron se yeh gir gaye the, duniya mein un par tarah tarah ke azab aaye, suar bandar bhi banaye gaye, la'nat-e-abadi mein yahan giraftar ho kar azab-e-ukhrawi ke daimi shikar banaye gaye. Pas tamam tareef us Allah ke liye hai, jis ki farmanbardari tamam bhalaiyon ki kunji hai.

Tasalsul-e-Anbiya, nasl-e-insani par Allah ki rahmat. Hazrat Musa A.S ne apni qoum ko Allah ki jo ne'matein yaad dila kar us ki ita'at ki taraf mail kiya tha, us ka bayan ho raha hai ke farmaya "Logon! Allah ki us ne'mat ko yaad karo ke us ne ek ke baad ek nabi tum mein, tumhin mein se bheja." Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah A.S ke baad se unhi ki nasl mein nabuwat rahi. Yeh sab anbiya tumhein dawat-e-tauheed-o-ittiba dete rahe. Yeh silsila Hazrat Isa Ruhullah A.S par khatam hua, phir Khatam-ul-Anbiya-wal-Mursaleen Hazrat Muhammad bin Abdullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko nabuwat-e-kamilah ata hui, aap Ismail A.S ke wasta se Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki aulad mein se the, jo apne se pehle ke tamam rasoolon aur nabiyon se afzal the. Allah aap par durood-o-salam nazil farmaye aur tumhein us ne badshah bana diya yani khadim diye, biwiyan dein, ghar baar diya aur us waqt jitne log the, un sab se zyada ne'matein tumhein ata farmayin. Yeh log itna paane ke baad badshah kehlaane lagte hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Aas R.A se ek shakhs ne poocha ke kya main fuqra-e-muhajireen mein se nahin hoon? Aap ne farmaya teri biwi hai? Us ne kaha haan, ghar bhi hai? Kaha haan, kaha phir to tu ghani hai, us ne kaha yun to mera khadim bhi hai, aap ne farmaya phir to tu badshahon mein se hai. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain "Sawari aur khadim mulk hai". Bani Israel aise logon ko mulook kaha karte the. Baqol Qatada R.H khadimon ka awwal riwaj in Bani Israelion ne hi diya hai. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke un logon mein jis ke paas khadim, sawari aur biwi ho woh badshah kaha jata tha. Ek aur marfoo hadith mein hai "Jis ka ghar ho aur khadim ho woh badshah hai". Yeh hadith mursal aur ghareeb hai. Ek hadith mein aaya hai "Jo shakhs is halat mein subh kare ke us ka jism sahih salim ho, us ka nafs aman-o-aman mein ho, din bhar kifayat kare, us ke liye itna maal bhi ho to us ke liye goya kul duniya simat kar aa gayi". Us waqt jo Yunani, Qibti waghera the un se yeh ashraf-o-afzal maane gaye the aur ayat mein hai hum ne Bani Israel ko kitab, hukm, nabuwat, pakeeza roziyan aur sab par fazeelat di thi. Hazrat Musa A.S se jab unhon ne mushrikon ki dekha dekhi Allah banane ko kaha us ke jawab mein Hazrat Musa A.S ne Allah ke fazl bayan karte hue yahi farmaya tha ke us ne tumhein tamam jahan par fazeelat de rakhi hai. Matlab sab jagah yahi hai ke us waqt ke tamam logon par kyunke yeh sabit shuda amr hai ke yeh ummat un se afzal hai, kya shar'i haisiyat se, kya ahkami haisiyat se, kya nabuwat ki haisiyat se, kya badshahat, izzat, mamlikat, daulat, hashmat, maal, aulad waghera ki haisiyat se, khud Quran farmata hai ayat (Kuntum khaira ummatin ukhrijat lin-nasi ta'muruna bil-ma'rufi wa tanhawna 'anil-munkari wa tu'minuna billah) (Surah Al-Imran: 110) aur farmaya ayat (Wa kazalika ja'alnakum ummatan wasatal-litakunu shuhada'a 'alan-nasi wa yakunar-rasulu 'alaikum shahida) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 143).

(Al-Baqarah: 143) Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke "Bani Israel ke sath is fazeelat mein Ummat-e-Muhammadi (ﷺ) ko bhi shamil kar ke khitab kiya gaya hai" aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke "ba'az umoor mein unhein filwaq'e ala-al-itlaq fazeelat di gayi thi jaise Mann-o-Salwa ka utarna, badalon se saya muhayya karna waghera jo khilaf-e-adat cheezein thin". Yeh qaul aksar mufassireen ka hai jaisa pehle bayan ho chuka hai ke murad is se un ke apne zamane walon par unhein fazeelat diya jana hai, Wallahu A'lam. Phir bayan hota hai ke "Bait-ul-Muqaddas darasal un ke dada Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ke zamana mein unhi ke qabze mein tha aur jab woh ma'a apne ahl-o-ayal ke Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke paas Misr chale gaye to yahan Amalqa qaum is par qabza jama baithi, woh bade mazboot hath pairon ki thi. Ab Hazrat Musa (A.S) apni qaum se farmate hain ke tum un se jihad karo Allah tumhein un par ghalib karega aur yahan ka qabza phir tumhein mil jayega lekin yeh namardi dikhate hain aur buzdili se munh pher lete hain. Un ki saza mein unhein chalees saal tak wadi-e-Teeh mein hairan-o-sargardan khana-badoshi mein rehna padta hai, Muqaddasa se murad pak hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh wadi-e-Toor aur us ke paas ki zameen ka zikr hai, ek riwayat mein Ariha ka zikr hai lekin yeh theek nahin, is liye ke na to Ariha ka fath karna maqsood tha, na woh un ke raste mein tha, kyunke woh Firaun ki halakat ke baad Misr ke shehron se aa rahe the aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas ja rahe the, yeh ho sakta hai ke woh mashhoor shehar jo Toor ki taraf Bait-ul-Muqaddas ke mashriqi rukh par tha". "Allah ne ise tumhare liye likh diya hai" matlab yeh hai ke tumhare baap Israel (A.S) se Allah ne wada kiya hai ke woh teri aulad ke ba-iman logon ke wirse mein aayega, tum apni peethon par murtad na ho jao. Yani jihad se munh pher kar thak kar na baith jao, warna zabardast nuqsan mein pad jaoge. Jis ke jawab mein woh kehte hain ke jis shehar mein jaane aur jin shehrion se jihad karne ke liye aap farma rahe hain, hamein maloom hai ke woh bade qawi taqatwar aur jangju hain, hum un se muqabla nahin kar sakte, jab tak woh wahan majood hain, hum us shehar mein nahin ja sakte, han agar woh log wahan se nikal jayen to hum chale jayenge, warna aap ke hukm ki tameel hamari taqat se bahar hai, Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke "Hazrat Musa (A.S) jab Ariha ke qareeb pahunch gaye to aap ne barah jasoos muqarrar kiye, Bani Israel ke har qabeelay mein se ek jasoos liya aur unhein Ariha mein bhej kar sahih khabrein le aayen. Yeh log jab gaye to un ki jasamat aur quwwat se khauf-zada ho gaye".

Ek bagh mein yeh sab ke sab thay, ittefaqan bagh wala phal todne ke liye aa gaya, woh phal todta hua unke qadmon ke nishan dhoondta hua unke paas pahunch gaya aur unhein bhi phalon ke sath hi sath apni gathri mein bandh liya aur jakar badshah ke samne bagh ke phal ki gathri khol kar daal di, jis mein yeh sab ke sab thay, badshah ne unhein kaha ab toh tumhein hamari quwwat ka andaza ho gaya hai, tumhein qatl nahin karta jao wapas jao aur apne logon se hamari quwwat bayan kardo. Chunancha unhon ne jakar sab haal bayan kiya jis se Bani Israel ra'ab mein aa gaye". Lekin iski asnad theek nahin. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke in barah logon ko ek shakhs ne pakad liya aur apni chadar mein gathri bandh kar nehar mein le gaya aur logon ke samne unhein daal diya, unhon ne poocha tum kaun log ho? Jawab diya ke hum Musa ki qaum ke log hain, hum tumhari khabrein lene ke liye bheje gaye thay. Unhon ne ek angoor unko diya jo ek shakhs ko kafi tha aur kaha jao inse keh do ke yeh hamare meway hain. Unhon ne wapas ja kar qaum se sab haal keh diya, ab Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne unhein jihad ka aur us shehar mein jaane ka hukum diya toh unhon ne saaf keh diya ke aap aur aap ka Allah jayen aur ladein hum toh yahan se hilne ke bhi nahin. Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne ek baans le kar napa jo pachaas ya pachpan haath ka tha, phir use gaad kar farmaya "In Amaliq ke qad is qadar lambay thay".
