Pas parwardigar se darne wale khade ho jayenge aur Allah ke bazu ke neeche ja thahrenge, Allah Ta'ala na unse rukh poshi karega na parda. Rawi-e-hadith Abu Afif se daryaft kiya gaya ke muttaqi kaun hain?

Farmaya woh jo shirk aur but-parasti se bache aur khalis Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat kare phir yeh sab log jannat mein jayenge. Jis nek-bakht ki qurbani qabool ki gayi thi, woh apne bhai ke is irada ko sun kar us se kehta hai ke tu jo chahe kar, main toh teri tarah nahin karunga balkay main sabr-o-zabt karunga, thay toh zor-o-taqat mein yeh us se zyada magar apni bhalai, nek-bakhti aur tawazo-o-furotni aur parhezgari ki wajah se yeh farmaya ke tu gunah par amada ho jaye lekin mujh se is jurm ka irtikab nahin ho sakta, main toh Allah Ta'ala se darta hoon woh tamam jahan ka Rabb hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke "Jab do musalman talwarein le kar bhar gaye toh qatil maqtool dono jahannami hain." Sahaba ne poocha qatil toh khair lekin maqtool kyun hua? Aap ne farmaya is liye ke woh bhi apne sathi ke qatl par harees tha. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Waqqas (R.A) ne us waqt jabke baghiyon ne Hazrat Usman Zun-Noorain (R.A) ko gher rakha tha kaha ke main gawahi deta hoon ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai "Anqareeb fitna barpa hoga. Baitha rehne wala us waqt kharay rehne wale se achha hoga aur kharay rehne wala chalne wale se behtar hoga aur chalne wala daurne wale se behtar hoga". Kisi ne poocha "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar koi mere ghar mein bhi ghus aaye aur mujhe qatl karna chahe". Aap ne farmaya phir bhi tu Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke bete ki tarah ho ja. Ek riwayat mein aap ka is ke baad is ayat ki tilawat karna bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Ayyub Sakhtiyani (R.H) farmate hain "Is ummat mein sab se pehle jis ne is ayat par amal kiya woh Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) hain". Ek martaba ek janwar par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sawar thay aur aap ke sath hi aap ke peeche Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) thay, aap ne farmaya Abu Zar batao toh jab logon par aise faaqay aayenge ke ghar se masjid tak na ja sakenge toh tu kya karega? Main ne kaha jo hukm-e-Rabb aur Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ho farmaya sabr karo. Phir farmaya jabke aapas mein khoon-rezi hogi yahan tak ke rait ke thar bhi khoon mein doob jayenge toh tu kya karega? Main ne wahi jawab diya toh farmaya ke apne ghar mein baith ja aur darwaze band kar le kaha phir agarche main na maidan mein utroon? Farmaya toh un mein chala ja, jin ka tu hai aur wahin reh. Arz kiya ke phir main apne hathiyar hi kyun na le loon? Farmaya phir toh tu bhi un ke sath hi shamil ho jayega balkay agar tujhe kisi ki talwar ki shua'ein pareshan karti nazar aayen toh bhi apne munh par kapra daal le taake tere aur khud apne gunahon ko wahi le jaye. Hazrat Rab'i (R.H) farmate hain hum Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ke janaze mein thay, ek sahib ne kaha main ne marhoom se suna hai aap Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki suni hui hadeesain bayan farmate hue kehte thay ke agar tum aapas mein laro ge toh main apne sab se door daraz ghar mein chala jaunga aur use band kar ke baith jaunga, agar wahan bhi koi ghus aaye ga toh main keh doonga ke le apna aur mera gunah apne sar par rakh le, pas main Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke un do beton mein se jo behtar tha, us ki tarah ho jaunga.

Main toh chahta hoon ke tu mera aur apna gunah apne sar rakh le jaye. Yani tere woh gunah jo is se pehle ke hain aur mere qatl ka gunah bhi. Yeh matlab bhi Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se marvi hai ke meri khatayen bhi mujh par aapadein aur mere qatl ka gunah bhi. Lekin inhi se ek qaul pehle jaisa bhi marvi hai, mumkin hai yeh dusra sabit na ho. Isi bina par baaz log kehte hain ke qatil maqtool ke sab gunah apne upar baar kar leta hai aur is ma'ani ki ek hadith bhi bayan ki jati hai lekin is ki koi asal nahin. Bazzar mein ek hadith hai ke "Besabab ka qatl tamam gunahon ko mita deta hai". Goya yeh hadith upar wale ma'ani mein nahin, taham yeh bhi sahi nahin aur is riwayat ka matlab yeh bhi hai ke qatl ki eeza ke ba'is Allah Ta'ala maqtool ke sab gunah maaf kar deta hai. Ab woh qatil par aa jate hain. Yeh baat sabit nahin, mumkin hai baaz qatil waise bhi hon, qatil ko maidan-e-Qayamat mein maqtool dhoondta phire ga aur is ke zulm ke mutabiq is ki nekiyan le jaye ga. Aur sab nekiyan le lene ke baad bhi is zulm ki talafi na hui toh maqtool ke gunah qatil par rakh diye jayenge, yahan tak ke badla ho jaye toh mumkin hai ke saare hi gunah baaz qatilon ke sar pad jayen kyunke zulm ke is tarah ke badle liye jane ahadith se sabit hain aur yeh zahir hai ke qatl sab se badh kar zulm hai aur sab se badtar. Wallahu A'lam. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain matlab is jumle ka sahih-tar yahi hai ke main chahta hoon ke tu apne gunah aur mere qatl ke gunah sab hi apne upar le jaye, tere aur gunahon ke sath ek gunah yeh bhi badh jaye. Is ka yeh matlab hargiz nahin ke mere gunah bhi tujh par aa jayen, is liye ke Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke har aamil ko is ke amal ki jaza milti hai, phir yeh kaise ho sakta hai ke maqtool ke umr bhar ke gunah qatil par daal diye jayen, aur is ke gunahon par is ki pakad ho? Baqi rahi yeh baat ke phir Habil (A.S) ne yeh baat apne bhai se kyun kahi? Is ka jawab yeh hai ke us ne aakhri martaba nasihat ki aur daraya aur khauf-zada kiya ke is kaam se baaz aa ja, warna gunahgar ho kar jahannam wasil ho jaye ga kyunke main toh tera muqabla karne hi ka nahin, sara bojh tujh hi par hoga aur tu hi zalim thehre ga aur zalimon ka thikana dozakh hai. Is nasihat ke bawajood is ke nafs ne ise dhoka diya aur gusse aur hasad aur takabbur mein aa kar apne bhai ko qatl kar diya, ise Shaitan ne qatl par ubhaar diya aur us ne apne nafs-e-ammara ki pairwi kar li hai aur lohay se ise maar dala. Ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh apne janwaron ko le kar pahadiyon par chale gaye the, yeh dhoondta hua wahan pahuncha aur ek bhari patthar utha kar un ke sar par de mara, yeh us waqt soye hue the. Baaz kehte hain misl darinday ke kaat kaat kar, gala daba daba kar un ki jaan li.

Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Shaitan ne jab dekha ke ise qatl karne ka dhang nahin aata, yeh is ki gardan marod raha hai toh is la'een ne ek janwar pakra aur is ka sar ek patthar par rakh kar ise dusra patthar zor se de mara, jis se woh janwar usi waqt mar gaya, yeh dekh is ne bhi apne bhai ke sath yahi kiya. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke chunke ab tak zameen par koi qatl nahin hua tha, is liye Qabeel apne bhai ko gira kar kabhi is ki aankhein band karta, kabhi ise thappar aur ghunse marta. Yeh dekh kar Iblees la'een is ke paas aaya aur ise bataya ke patthar le kar is ka sar kuchal daal, jab is ne kuchal dala toh la'een daurta hua Hazrat Hawa ke paas aaya aur kaha Qabeel ne Habeel ko qatl kar diya, unhon ne pucha qatl kaisa hota hai? Kaha ab na woh khata peeta hai na bolta chalta hai, na hilta julta hai. Kaha shayad maut aa gayi, us ne kaha haan wahi maut. Ab toh mai sahiba cheekhne chillane lagin, itne mein Hazrat Adam A.S aaye pucha kya baat hai? Lekin yeh jawab na de sakin, Aap ne dobara daryaft farmaya lekin fart-e-gham-o-ranj ki wajah se un ki zaban na chali toh kaha achha toh aur teri betiyan haye-waye mein hi rahengi aur main aur mere bete is se bari hain. Qabeel khasare tute aur nuqsan wala ho gaya, duniya aur aakhirat dono hi bigar gayin. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain "Jo insaan zulm se qatl kiya jata hai, is ke khoon ka bojh Adam ke is larke par bhi parta hai, is liye ke isi ne sab se pehle zameen par khoon-e-nahaq giraya hai". Mujahid ka qaul hai ke "Qatil ke ek pair ki pindli ko raan se us din se latka diya gaya aur is ka munh suraj ki taraf kar diya gaya, is ke ghoomne ke sath ghoomta rehta hai, jaron aur garmiyon mein aag aur barf ke garhay mein woh mu'azzab hai". Hazrat Abdullah se marwi hai ke "Jahannam ka aadhon aadh azab sirf is ek ko ho raha hai, sab se bara mu'azzab yahi hai zameen ke har qatl ke gunah ka hissa is ke zimme hai". Ibrahim Nakh'i farmate hain "Is par aur Shaitan par har khoon-e-nahaq ka bojh parta hai". Jab maar dala toh ab yeh maloom na tha ke kya kare, kis tarah ise chupaye? Toh Allah ne do kaway bheje, woh dono bhi aapas mein bhai bhai thay, yeh is ke samne larne lage, yahan tak ke ek ne dusre ko maar dala, phir ek garha khod kar is mein is ki laash ko rakh kar upar se mitti daal di, yeh dekh kar Qabeel ki samajh mein bhi yeh tarkeeb aa gayi aur is ne bhi aisa hi kiya. Hazrat Ali R.A se marwi hai ke az-khud mare hue ek kawway ko dusre kawway ne is tarah garha khod kar dafan kiya tha. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke saal bhar tak Qabeel apne bhai ki laash apne kandhe par lade lade phirta raha, phir kawway ko dekh kar apne nafs par malamat karne laga ke main itna bhi na kar saka, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai maar daal kar phir pachhtaya aur laash ko god mein rakh kar baith gaya aur is liye bhi ke sab se pehli mayyat aur sab se pehla qatl roo-e-zameen par yahi tha.

Ahl-e-Taurat kehte hain ke jab Qabeel ne apne bhai Habeel ko qatl kiya toh Allah ne us se poocha ke tere bhai Habeel ko kya hua? Us ne kaha mujhe kya khabar? Main us ka nigahban toh tha hi nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya sun tere bhai ka khoon zameen mein se mujhe pukar raha hai, tujh par meri laanat hai, is zameen mein jis ka munh khol kar tu ne use apne beganah bhai ka khoon pilaya hai, ab tu zameen mein jo kuch kaam karega woh apni kheti mein se tujhe kuch nahin degi, yahan tak tum zameen par umr bhar bechain bhatakte rahoge phir toh Qabeel bada hi nadim hua. Nuqsan ke sath hi pachtawa goya azaab par azaab tha. Is qissa mein mufassireen ke aqwal is baat par toh muttafiq hain ke yeh toh dono Hazrat Adam A.S ke sulbi bete thay aur yahi Quran ke alfaaz se bazahir maloom hota hai aur yahi hadith mein bhi hai ke roo-e-zameen par jo qatl-e-na-haq hota hai us ka ek hissa bojh aur gunah ka Hazrat Adam A.S ke is pehle ladke par hota hai, is liye ke isi ne sab se pehle qatl ka tareeqa ijaad kiya hai, lekin Hasan Basri R.H ka qaul hai ke "Yeh dono Bani Israel mein thay, qurbani sab se pehle inhi mein aayi aur zameen par sab se pehle Hazrat Adam A.S ka inteqal hua hai" lekin yeh qaul ghaur talab hai aur is ki asnaad bhi theek nahin. Ek marfoo hadith mein yeh waqea bator ek misaal ke hai "Tum is mein se achhai le lo aur bure ko chhod do". Yeh hadith mursal hai kehte hain ke is sadme se Hazrat Adam A.S bahut ghamgeen hue aur saal bhar tak unhein hansi na aayi, aakhir farishton ne un ke gham ke door hone aur unhein hansi aane ki dua ki. Hazrat Adam A.S ne us waqt apne ranj-o-gham mein yeh bhi kaha tha ke shehar aur shehar ki sab cheezein mutaghayyar ho gayin. Zameen ka rang badal gaya aur woh nihayat badsurat ho gayi, har har cheez ka rang-o-maza jata raha aur kashish wale chehron ki malahat bhi salb ho gayi. Is par unhein jawab diya gaya ke is murde ke sath is zinde ne bhi goya apne tayein halak kar diya aur jo burai qatil ne ki thi, us ka bojh us par aa gaya, bazahir maloom hota hai ke Qabeel ko usi waqt saza di gayi chunancha warid hua hai ke us ki pindli us ki raan se latka di gayi aur us ka munh suraj ki taraf kar diya gaya aur us ke sath hi sath ghoomta rehta tha yani jidhar suraj hota udhar hi us ka munh utha rehta. Hadith-e-Shareef mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jitne gunah is laiq hain ke bahut jald un ki saza duniya mein bhi di jaye aur phir aakhirat ke zabardast azaab baqi rahein un mein sab se badh kar gunah sarkashi aur qat-e-rehmi hai. Toh Qabeel mein yeh dono baatein jama ho gayin (Fa Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilaihi Raji'oon). (Yeh yaad rahe ke is qissa ki tafseelat jis qadar bayan hui hain, un mein se aksar-o-beshtar hissa Ahl-e-Kitab se akhaz kiya hua hai. Wallahu A'lam. Mutarjim)

Hasad-o-bughz se muman'at is qissay mein hasad-o-bughz, sarkashi aur takabbur ka bad-anjam bayan ho raha hai ke kis tarah Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ke do salbi beton mein kashmakash ho gayi aur ek Allah ka ho kar mazloom bana aur maar dala gaya aur apna thikana jannat mein bana liya aur dusre ne usay zulm-o-ziyadati ke sath be-wajah qatl kiya aur dono jahan mein barbad hua. Farmata hai "Ae Nabi (ﷺ) inhein Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ke dono beton ka sahih sahih be-kam-o-kast qissa suna do." In dono ka naam Habil-o-Qabil tha. Marwi hai ke chunke us waqt duniya ki ibtidai halat thi, is liye yun hota tha ke Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ke yahan ek hamal se ladki ladka do hotay thay, phir dusre hamal mein bhi isi tarah to us hamal ka ladka aur dusre hamal ki ladki in dono ka nikah kara diya jata tha, Habil ki behan to khubsurat na thi aur Qabil ki behan khubsurat thi to Qabil ne chaha ke apni hi behan se apna nikah kar le, Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ne us se mana kiya aakhir yeh faisla hua ke tum dono Allah ke naam par kuch nikalo, jis ki khairat qabool ho jaye us ka nikah us ke sath kar diya jaye ga. Habil ki khairat qabool ho gayi phir woh hua jis ka bayan Quran ki in aayat mein hua: "Mufassireen ke aqwal suniye Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ki salbi aulad ke nikah ka qaida jo oopar mazkoor hua bayan farmanay ke baad marwi hai ke bada bhai Qabil kheti karta tha aur Habil janwaron wala tha, Qabil ki behan ba-nisbat Habil ki behan ke khub-roo thi. Jab Habil ka paigham us se hua to Qabil ne inkar kar diya aur apna nikah us se karna chaha, Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ne us se roka. Ab in dono ne khairat nikali ke jis ki qabool ho jaye woh nikah ka zyada haqdar hai. Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) us waqt Makkah chalay gaye ke dekhein kya hota hai? Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) se farmaya zameen par jo mera ghar hai usay jantay ho? Aap ne kaha nahin, hukm hua Makkah mein hai tum wahin jao, Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ne aasman se kaha ke mere bachon ki tu hifazat kare ga? Us ne inkar kiya, zameen se kaha us ne bhi inkar kar diya, paharon se kaha unhon ne bhi inkar kar diya, Qabil se kaha, us ne kaha han main muhafiz hoon, aap jayiye aa kar mulahiza farma len ge aur khush hon ge. Ab Habil ne ek khubsurat mota taza mendha Allah ke naam par zibah kiya aur baday bhai ne apni kheti ka hissa Allah ke liye nikala. Aag aayi aur Habil ki nazr to jala gayi, jo us zamana mein qabooliyat ki alamat thi aur Qabil ki nazr qabool na hui, us ki kheti yunhi reh gayi, us ne rah-e-Allah karne ke baad us mein se achi achi baalein tor kar kha li thin. Chunke Qabil ab mayoos ho chuka tha ke us ke nikah mein us ki behan nahin aa sakti, is liye apne bhai ko qatl ki dhamki di thi us ne kaha ke "Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke Allah Ta'ala taqwa walon ki qurbani qabool farmaya karta hai. Is mein mera kya qusoor?" Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh mendha jannat mein palta raha aur yahi woh mendha hai jisay Hazrat-e-Ibrahim (A.S) ne apne bachay ke badlay zibah kiya.

Ek riwayat mein hai ke Habil ne apne janwaron mein se behtareen aur marghoob-o-mehboob janwar Allah ke naam aur khushi ke sath qurban kiya, barkhilaf iske Qabil ne apni kheti mein se nihayat raddi aur wahi cheez aur woh bedili se Allah ke naam nikali. Habil tan-o-mandi aur taqatwari mein bhi Qabil se zyada tha taham Allah ke khauf ki wajah se usne apne bhai ka zulm-o-ziyadati seh li aur hath na uthaya. Bade bhai ki qurbani jab qabool na hui aur Hazrat Adam (A.S) ne usse kaha toh usne kaha ke chunke aap Habil ko chahte hain aur aapne uske liye dua ki toh uski qurbani qabool ho gayi. Ab usne thaan li ke main is kante hi ko ukhaad daloon. Mauqe ka muntazir tha, ek roz ittefaqan Hazrat Habil ke aane mein der lag gayi toh unhein bulane ke liye Hazrat Adam (A.S) ne Qabil ko bheja. Yeh ek chhuri apne sath lekar chala, raste mein hi dono bhaiyon ki mulaqat ho gayi, usne kaha main tujhe maar daloon ga kyunke teri qurbani qabool hui aur meri na hui. Is par Habil ne kaha main ne behtareen, umda, mehboob aur marghoob cheez Allah ke naam nikali aur tu ne bekar be-jaan cheez nikali, Allah Ta'ala apne muttaqiyon hi ki neki qabool karta hai. Is par woh aur bigda aur chhuri ghonp di, Habil kehte reh gaye ke Allah ko kya jawab dega? Allah ke yahan is zulm ka badla tujhse buri tarah liya jayega. Allah ka khauf kar mujhe qatl na kar, lekin is be-rahm ne apne bhai ko maar hi dala. Qabil ne apni tawam behen se apna hi nikah karne ki ek wajah yeh bhi bayan ki thi ke hum dono jannat mein paida hue hain aur yeh dono zameen mein paida hue hain, isi liye main iska haqdar hoon. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Qabil ne gehoon nikale the aur Habil ne gaye qurban ki thi. Chunke us waqt koi maskeen toh tha hi nahin jise sadqa diya jaye, is liye yahi dastoor tha ke sadqa nikal dete, aag aasman se aati aur use jala jati, yeh qabooliyat ka nishan tha. Is bartari se jo chhote bhai ko hasil hui, bada bhai hasad ki aag mein bhadka aur uske qatl ke darpe ho gaya, yunhi baithe baithe dono bhaiyon ne qurbani ki thi. Nikah ke ikhtilaf ko mitane ki wajah na thi, Quran ke zahiri alfaaz ka iqtiza bhi yahi hai ke narazgi ka baais adam-e-qabooliyat-e-qurbani thi na kuch aur. Ek riwayat mandarija riwayaton ke khilaf yeh bhi hai ke Qabil ne kheti Allah ke naam nazr di thi jo qabool hui lekin maloom hota hai ke is mein rawi ka hafiza theek nahin aur yeh mashhoor amr ke bhi khilaf hai, Wallahu A'alam. Allah Ta'ala uska amal qabool karta hai jo apne fe'l mein usse darta rahe. Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) farmate hain log maidan-e-qayamat mein honge toh ek munadi nida karega ke parhezgar kahan hain? Pas parwardigar se darne wale khade ho jayenge aur Allah ke bazu ke neeche ja thahrenge, Allah Ta'ala na unse rukh poshi karega na parda. Rawi-e-hadith Abu Afif se daryaft kiya gaya ke muttaqi kaun hain?

Arz kiya ke phir main apne hathiyar hi kyun na le loon? Farmaya phir toh tu bhi un ke sath hi shamil ho jayega balkay agar tujhe kisi ki talwar ki shua'ein pareshan karti nazar aayen toh bhi apne munh par kapra daal le taake tere aur khud apne gunahon ko wahi le jaye. Hazrat Rab'i (R.H) farmate hain hum Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ke janaze mein thay, ek sahib ne kaha main ne marhoom se suna hai aap Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki suni hui hadeesain bayan farmate hue kehte thay ke agar tum aapas mein laro ge toh main apne sab se door daraz ghar mein chala jaunga aur use band kar ke baith jaunga, agar wahan bhi koi ghus aaye ga toh main keh doonga ke le apna aur mera gunah apne sar par rakh le, pas main Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke un do beton mein se jo behtar tha, us ki tarah ho jaunga.

Main toh chahta hoon ke tu mera aur apna gunah apne sar rakh le jaye. Yani tere woh gunah jo is se pehle ke hain aur mere qatl ka gunah bhi. Yeh matlab bhi Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se marvi hai ke meri khatayen bhi mujh par aapadein aur mere qatl ka gunah bhi. Lekin inhi se ek qaul pehle jaisa bhi marvi hai, mumkin hai yeh dusra sabit na ho. Isi bina par baaz log kehte hain ke qatil maqtool ke sab gunah apne upar baar kar leta hai aur is ma'ani ki ek hadith bhi bayan ki jati hai lekin is ki koi asal nahin. Bazzar mein ek hadith hai ke "Besabab ka qatl tamam gunahon ko mita deta hai". Goya yeh hadith upar wale ma'ani mein nahin, taham yeh bhi sahi nahin aur is riwayat ka matlab yeh bhi hai ke qatl ki eeza ke ba'is Allah Ta'ala maqtool ke sab gunah maaf kar deta hai. Ab woh qatil par aa jate hain. Yeh baat sabit nahin, mumkin hai baaz qatil waise bhi hon, qatil ko maidan-e-Qayamat mein maqtool dhoondta phire ga aur is ke zulm ke mutabiq is ki nekiyan le jaye ga. Aur sab nekiyan le lene ke baad bhi is zulm ki talafi na hui toh maqtool ke gunah qatil par rakh diye jayenge, yahan tak ke badla ho jaye toh mumkin hai ke saare hi gunah baaz qatilon ke sar pad jayen kyunke zulm ke is tarah ke badle liye jane ahadith se sabit hain aur yeh zahir hai ke qatl sab se badh kar zulm hai aur sab se badtar. Wallahu A'lam. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain matlab is jumle ka sahih-tar yahi hai ke main chahta hoon ke tu apne gunah aur mere qatl ke gunah sab hi apne upar le jaye, tere aur gunahon ke sath ek gunah yeh bhi badh jaye. Is ka yeh matlab hargiz nahin ke mere gunah bhi tujh par aa jayen, is liye ke Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke har aamil ko is ke amal ki jaza milti hai, phir yeh kaise ho sakta hai ke maqtool ke umr bhar ke gunah qatil par daal diye jayen, aur is ke gunahon par is ki pakad ho? Baqi rahi yeh baat ke phir Habil (A.S) ne yeh baat apne bhai se kyun kahi? Is ka jawab yeh hai ke us ne aakhri martaba nasihat ki aur daraya aur khauf-zada kiya ke is kaam se baaz aa ja, warna gunahgar ho kar jahannam wasil ho jaye ga kyunke main toh tera muqabla karne hi ka nahin, sara bojh tujh hi par hoga aur tu hi zalim thehre ga aur zalimon ka thikana dozakh hai. Is nasihat ke bawajood is ke nafs ne ise dhoka diya aur gusse aur hasad aur takabbur mein aa kar apne bhai ko qatl kar diya, ise Shaitan ne qatl par ubhaar diya aur us ne apne nafs-e-ammara ki pairwi kar li hai aur lohay se ise maar dala. Ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh apne janwaron ko le kar pahadiyon par chale gaye the, yeh dhoondta hua wahan pahuncha aur ek bhari patthar utha kar un ke sar par de mara, yeh us waqt soye hue the. Baaz kehte hain misl darinday ke kaat kaat kar, gala daba daba kar un ki jaan li.

Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Shaitan ne jab dekha ke ise qatl karne ka dhang nahin aata, yeh is ki gardan marod raha hai toh is la'een ne ek janwar pakra aur is ka sar ek patthar par rakh kar ise dusra patthar zor se de mara, jis se woh janwar usi waqt mar gaya, yeh dekh is ne bhi apne bhai ke sath yahi kiya. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke chunke ab tak zameen par koi qatl nahin hua tha, is liye Qabeel apne bhai ko gira kar kabhi is ki aankhein band karta, kabhi ise thappar aur ghunse marta. Yeh dekh kar Iblees la'een is ke paas aaya aur ise bataya ke patthar le kar is ka sar kuchal daal, jab is ne kuchal dala toh la'een daurta hua Hazrat Hawa ke paas aaya aur kaha Qabeel ne Habeel ko qatl kar diya, unhon ne pucha qatl kaisa hota hai? Kaha ab na woh khata peeta hai na bolta chalta hai, na hilta julta hai. Kaha shayad maut aa gayi, us ne kaha haan wahi maut. Ab toh mai sahiba cheekhne chillane lagin, itne mein Hazrat Adam A.S aaye pucha kya baat hai? Lekin yeh jawab na de sakin, Aap ne dobara daryaft farmaya lekin fart-e-gham-o-ranj ki wajah se un ki zaban na chali toh kaha achha toh aur teri betiyan haye-waye mein hi rahengi aur main aur mere bete is se bari hain. Qabeel khasare tute aur nuqsan wala ho gaya, duniya aur aakhirat dono hi bigar gayin. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain "Jo insaan zulm se qatl kiya jata hai, is ke khoon ka bojh Adam ke is larke par bhi parta hai, is liye ke isi ne sab se pehle zameen par khoon-e-nahaq giraya hai". Mujahid ka qaul hai ke "Qatil ke ek pair ki pindli ko raan se us din se latka diya gaya aur is ka munh suraj ki taraf kar diya gaya, is ke ghoomne ke sath ghoomta rehta hai, jaron aur garmiyon mein aag aur barf ke garhay mein woh mu'azzab hai". Hazrat Abdullah se marwi hai ke "Jahannam ka aadhon aadh azab sirf is ek ko ho raha hai, sab se bara mu'azzab yahi hai zameen ke har qatl ke gunah ka hissa is ke zimme hai". Ibrahim Nakh'i farmate hain "Is par aur Shaitan par har khoon-e-nahaq ka bojh parta hai". Jab maar dala toh ab yeh maloom na tha ke kya kare, kis tarah ise chupaye? Toh Allah ne do kaway bheje, woh dono bhi aapas mein bhai bhai thay, yeh is ke samne larne lage, yahan tak ke ek ne dusre ko maar dala, phir ek garha khod kar is mein is ki laash ko rakh kar upar se mitti daal di, yeh dekh kar Qabeel ki samajh mein bhi yeh tarkeeb aa gayi aur is ne bhi aisa hi kiya. Hazrat Ali R.A se marwi hai ke az-khud mare hue ek kawway ko dusre kawway ne is tarah garha khod kar dafan kiya tha. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke saal bhar tak Qabeel apne bhai ki laash apne kandhe par lade lade phirta raha, phir kawway ko dekh kar apne nafs par malamat karne laga ke main itna bhi na kar saka, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai maar daal kar phir pachhtaya aur laash ko god mein rakh kar baith gaya aur is liye bhi ke sab se pehli mayyat aur sab se pehla qatl roo-e-zameen par yahi tha.

Ahl-e-Taurat kehte hain ke jab Qabeel ne apne bhai Habeel ko qatl kiya toh Allah ne us se poocha ke tere bhai Habeel ko kya hua? Us ne kaha mujhe kya khabar? Main us ka nigahban toh tha hi nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya sun tere bhai ka khoon zameen mein se mujhe pukar raha hai, tujh par meri laanat hai, is zameen mein jis ka munh khol kar tu ne use apne beganah bhai ka khoon pilaya hai, ab tu zameen mein jo kuch kaam karega woh apni kheti mein se tujhe kuch nahin degi, yahan tak tum zameen par umr bhar bechain bhatakte rahoge phir toh Qabeel bada hi nadim hua. Nuqsan ke sath hi pachtawa goya azaab par azaab tha. Is qissa mein mufassireen ke aqwal is baat par toh muttafiq hain ke yeh toh dono Hazrat Adam A.S ke sulbi bete thay aur yahi Quran ke alfaaz se bazahir maloom hota hai aur yahi hadith mein bhi hai ke roo-e-zameen par jo qatl-e-na-haq hota hai us ka ek hissa bojh aur gunah ka Hazrat Adam A.S ke is pehle ladke par hota hai, is liye ke isi ne sab se pehle qatl ka tareeqa ijaad kiya hai, lekin Hasan Basri R.H ka qaul hai ke "Yeh dono Bani Israel mein thay, qurbani sab se pehle inhi mein aayi aur zameen par sab se pehle Hazrat Adam A.S ka inteqal hua hai" lekin yeh qaul ghaur talab hai aur is ki asnaad bhi theek nahin. Ek marfoo hadith mein yeh waqea bator ek misaal ke hai "Tum is mein se achhai le lo aur bure ko chhod do". Yeh hadith mursal hai kehte hain ke is sadme se Hazrat Adam A.S bahut ghamgeen hue aur saal bhar tak unhein hansi na aayi, aakhir farishton ne un ke gham ke door hone aur unhein hansi aane ki dua ki. Hazrat Adam A.S ne us waqt apne ranj-o-gham mein yeh bhi kaha tha ke shehar aur shehar ki sab cheezein mutaghayyar ho gayin. Zameen ka rang badal gaya aur woh nihayat badsurat ho gayi, har har cheez ka rang-o-maza jata raha aur kashish wale chehron ki malahat bhi salb ho gayi. Is par unhein jawab diya gaya ke is murde ke sath is zinde ne bhi goya apne tayein halak kar diya aur jo burai qatil ne ki thi, us ka bojh us par aa gaya, bazahir maloom hota hai ke Qabeel ko usi waqt saza di gayi chunancha warid hua hai ke us ki pindli us ki raan se latka di gayi aur us ka munh suraj ki taraf kar diya gaya aur us ke sath hi sath ghoomta rehta tha yani jidhar suraj hota udhar hi us ka munh utha rehta. Hadith-e-Shareef mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jitne gunah is laiq hain ke bahut jald un ki saza duniya mein bhi di jaye aur phir aakhirat ke zabardast azaab baqi rahein un mein sab se badh kar gunah sarkashi aur qat-e-rehmi hai. Toh Qabeel mein yeh dono baatein jama ho gayin (Fa Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilaihi Raji'oon). (Yeh yaad rahe ke is qissa ki tafseelat jis qadar bayan hui hain, un mein se aksar-o-beshtar hissa Ahl-e-Kitab se akhaz kiya hua hai. Wallahu A'lam. Mutarjim)

Hasad-o-bughz se muman'at is qissay mein hasad-o-bughz, sarkashi aur takabbur ka bad-anjam bayan ho raha hai ke kis tarah Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ke do salbi beton mein kashmakash ho gayi aur ek Allah ka ho kar mazloom bana aur maar dala gaya aur apna thikana jannat mein bana liya aur dusre ne usay zulm-o-ziyadati ke sath be-wajah qatl kiya aur dono jahan mein barbad hua. Farmata hai "Ae Nabi (ﷺ) inhein Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ke dono beton ka sahih sahih be-kam-o-kast qissa suna do." In dono ka naam Habil-o-Qabil tha. Marwi hai ke chunke us waqt duniya ki ibtidai halat thi, is liye yun hota tha ke Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ke yahan ek hamal se ladki ladka do hotay thay, phir dusre hamal mein bhi isi tarah to us hamal ka ladka aur dusre hamal ki ladki in dono ka nikah kara diya jata tha, Habil ki behan to khubsurat na thi aur Qabil ki behan khubsurat thi to Qabil ne chaha ke apni hi behan se apna nikah kar le, Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ne us se mana kiya aakhir yeh faisla hua ke tum dono Allah ke naam par kuch nikalo, jis ki khairat qabool ho jaye us ka nikah us ke sath kar diya jaye ga. Habil ki khairat qabool ho gayi phir woh hua jis ka bayan Quran ki in aayat mein hua: "Mufassireen ke aqwal suniye Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ki salbi aulad ke nikah ka qaida jo oopar mazkoor hua bayan farmanay ke baad marwi hai ke bada bhai Qabil kheti karta tha aur Habil janwaron wala tha, Qabil ki behan ba-nisbat Habil ki behan ke khub-roo thi. Jab Habil ka paigham us se hua to Qabil ne inkar kar diya aur apna nikah us se karna chaha, Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ne us se roka. Ab in dono ne khairat nikali ke jis ki qabool ho jaye woh nikah ka zyada haqdar hai. Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) us waqt Makkah chalay gaye ke dekhein kya hota hai? Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) se farmaya zameen par jo mera ghar hai usay jantay ho? Aap ne kaha nahin, hukm hua Makkah mein hai tum wahin jao, Hazrat-e-Adam (A.S) ne aasman se kaha ke mere bachon ki tu hifazat kare ga? Us ne inkar kiya, zameen se kaha us ne bhi inkar kar diya, paharon se kaha unhon ne bhi inkar kar diya, Qabil se kaha, us ne kaha han main muhafiz hoon, aap jayiye aa kar mulahiza farma len ge aur khush hon ge. Ab Habil ne ek khubsurat mota taza mendha Allah ke naam par zibah kiya aur baday bhai ne apni kheti ka hissa Allah ke liye nikala. Aag aayi aur Habil ki nazr to jala gayi, jo us zamana mein qabooliyat ki alamat thi aur Qabil ki nazr qabool na hui, us ki kheti yunhi reh gayi, us ne rah-e-Allah karne ke baad us mein se achi achi baalein tor kar kha li thin. Chunke Qabil ab mayoos ho chuka tha ke us ke nikah mein us ki behan nahin aa sakti, is liye apne bhai ko qatl ki dhamki di thi us ne kaha ke "Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke Allah Ta'ala taqwa walon ki qurbani qabool farmaya karta hai. Is mein mera kya qusoor?" Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh mendha jannat mein palta raha aur yahi woh mendha hai jisay Hazrat-e-Ibrahim (A.S) ne apne bachay ke badlay zibah kiya.

Ek riwayat mein hai ke Habil ne apne janwaron mein se behtareen aur marghoob-o-mehboob janwar Allah ke naam aur khushi ke sath qurban kiya, barkhilaf iske Qabil ne apni kheti mein se nihayat raddi aur wahi cheez aur woh bedili se Allah ke naam nikali. Habil tan-o-mandi aur taqatwari mein bhi Qabil se zyada tha taham Allah ke khauf ki wajah se usne apne bhai ka zulm-o-ziyadati seh li aur hath na uthaya. Bade bhai ki qurbani jab qabool na hui aur Hazrat Adam (A.S) ne usse kaha toh usne kaha ke chunke aap Habil ko chahte hain aur aapne uske liye dua ki toh uski qurbani qabool ho gayi. Ab usne thaan li ke main is kante hi ko ukhaad daloon. Mauqe ka muntazir tha, ek roz ittefaqan Hazrat Habil ke aane mein der lag gayi toh unhein bulane ke liye Hazrat Adam (A.S) ne Qabil ko bheja. Yeh ek chhuri apne sath lekar chala, raste mein hi dono bhaiyon ki mulaqat ho gayi, usne kaha main tujhe maar daloon ga kyunke teri qurbani qabool hui aur meri na hui. Is par Habil ne kaha main ne behtareen, umda, mehboob aur marghoob cheez Allah ke naam nikali aur tu ne bekar be-jaan cheez nikali, Allah Ta'ala apne muttaqiyon hi ki neki qabool karta hai. Is par woh aur bigda aur chhuri ghonp di, Habil kehte reh gaye ke Allah ko kya jawab dega? Allah ke yahan is zulm ka badla tujhse buri tarah liya jayega. Allah ka khauf kar mujhe qatl na kar, lekin is be-rahm ne apne bhai ko maar hi dala. Qabil ne apni tawam behen se apna hi nikah karne ki ek wajah yeh bhi bayan ki thi ke hum dono jannat mein paida hue hain aur yeh dono zameen mein paida hue hain, isi liye main iska haqdar hoon. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Qabil ne gehoon nikale the aur Habil ne gaye qurban ki thi. Chunke us waqt koi maskeen toh tha hi nahin jise sadqa diya jaye, is liye yahi dastoor tha ke sadqa nikal dete, aag aasman se aati aur use jala jati, yeh qabooliyat ka nishan tha. Is bartari se jo chhote bhai ko hasil hui, bada bhai hasad ki aag mein bhadka aur uske qatl ke darpe ho gaya, yunhi baithe baithe dono bhaiyon ne qurbani ki thi. Nikah ke ikhtilaf ko mitane ki wajah na thi, Quran ke zahiri alfaaz ka iqtiza bhi yahi hai ke narazgi ka baais adam-e-qabooliyat-e-qurbani thi na kuch aur. Ek riwayat mandarija riwayaton ke khilaf yeh bhi hai ke Qabil ne kheti Allah ke naam nazr di thi jo qabool hui lekin maloom hota hai ke is mein rawi ka hafiza theek nahin aur yeh mashhoor amr ke bhi khilaf hai, Wallahu A'alam. Allah Ta'ala uska amal qabool karta hai jo apne fe'l mein usse darta rahe. Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) farmate hain log maidan-e-qayamat mein honge toh ek munadi nida karega ke parhezgar kahan hain? Pas parwardigar se darne wale khade ho jayenge aur Allah ke bazu ke neeche ja thahrenge, Allah Ta'ala na unse rukh poshi karega na parda. Rawi-e-hadith Abu Afif se daryaft kiya gaya ke muttaqi kaun hain?

Farmaya woh jo shirk aur but-parasti se bache aur khalis Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat kare phir yeh sab log jannat mein jayenge. Jis nek-bakht ki qurbani qabool ki gayi thi, woh apne bhai ke is irada ko sun kar us se kehta hai ke tu jo chahe kar, main toh teri tarah nahin karunga balkay main sabr-o-zabt karunga, thay toh zor-o-taqat mein yeh us se zyada magar apni bhalai, nek-bakhti aur tawazo-o-furotni aur parhezgari ki wajah se yeh farmaya ke tu gunah par amada ho jaye lekin mujh se is jurm ka irtikab nahin ho sakta, main toh Allah Ta'ala se darta hoon woh tamam jahan ka Rabb hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke "Jab do musalman talwarein le kar bhar gaye toh qatil maqtool dono jahannami hain." Sahaba ne poocha qatil toh khair lekin maqtool kyun hua? Aap ne farmaya is liye ke woh bhi apne sathi ke qatl par harees tha. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Waqqas (R.A) ne us waqt jabke baghiyon ne Hazrat Usman Zun-Noorain (R.A) ko gher rakha tha kaha ke main gawahi deta hoon ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai "Anqareeb fitna barpa hoga. Baitha rehne wala us waqt kharay rehne wale se achha hoga aur kharay rehne wala chalne wale se behtar hoga aur chalne wala daurne wale se behtar hoga". Kisi ne poocha "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar koi mere ghar mein bhi ghus aaye aur mujhe qatl karna chahe". Aap ne farmaya phir bhi tu Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke bete ki tarah ho ja. Ek riwayat mein aap ka is ke baad is ayat ki tilawat karna bhi marwi hai. Hazrat Ayyub Sakhtiyani (R.H) farmate hain "Is ummat mein sab se pehle jis ne is ayat par amal kiya woh Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) hain". Ek martaba ek janwar par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sawar thay aur aap ke sath hi aap ke peeche Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) thay, aap ne farmaya Abu Zar batao toh jab logon par aise faaqay aayenge ke ghar se masjid tak na ja sakenge toh tu kya karega? Main ne kaha jo hukm-e-Rabb aur Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ho farmaya sabr karo. Phir farmaya jabke aapas mein khoon-rezi hogi yahan tak ke rait ke thar bhi khoon mein doob jayenge toh tu kya karega? Main ne wahi jawab diya toh farmaya ke apne ghar mein baith ja aur darwaze band kar le kaha phir agarche main na maidan mein utroon? Farmaya toh un mein chala ja, jin ka tu hai aur wahin reh. Arz kiya ke phir main apne hathiyar hi kyun na le loon? Farmaya phir toh tu bhi un ke sath hi shamil ho jayega balkay agar tujhe kisi ki talwar ki shua'ein pareshan karti nazar aayen toh bhi apne munh par kapra daal le taake tere aur khud apne gunahon ko wahi le jaye.
