Baqi rahi yeh baat ke phir Habil (A.S) ne yeh baat apne bhai se kyun kahi? Is ka jawab yeh hai ke us ne aakhri martaba nasihat ki aur daraya aur khauf-zada kiya ke is kaam se baaz aa ja, warna gunahgar ho kar jahannam wasil ho jaye ga kyunke main toh tera muqabla karne hi ka nahin, sara bojh tujh hi par hoga aur tu hi zalim thehre ga aur zalimon ka thikana dozakh hai. Is nasihat ke bawajood is ke nafs ne ise dhoka diya aur gusse aur hasad aur takabbur mein aa kar apne bhai ko qatl kar diya, ise Shaitan ne qatl par ubhaar diya aur us ne apne nafs-e-ammara ki pairwi kar li hai aur lohay se ise maar dala. Ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh apne janwaron ko le kar pahadiyon par chale gaye the, yeh dhoondta hua wahan pahuncha aur ek bhari patthar utha kar un ke sar par de mara, yeh us waqt soye hue the. Baaz kehte hain misl darinday ke kaat kaat kar, gala daba daba kar un ki jaan li.

Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Shaitan ne jab dekha ke ise qatl karne ka dhang nahin aata, yeh is ki gardan marod raha hai toh is la'een ne ek janwar pakra aur is ka sar ek patthar par rakh kar ise dusra patthar zor se de mara, jis se woh janwar usi waqt mar gaya, yeh dekh is ne bhi apne bhai ke sath yahi kiya. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke chunke ab tak zameen par koi qatl nahin hua tha, is liye Qabeel apne bhai ko gira kar kabhi is ki aankhein band karta, kabhi ise thappar aur ghunse marta. Yeh dekh kar Iblees la'een is ke paas aaya aur ise bataya ke patthar le kar is ka sar kuchal daal, jab is ne kuchal dala toh la'een daurta hua Hazrat Hawa ke paas aaya aur kaha Qabeel ne Habeel ko qatl kar diya, unhon ne pucha qatl kaisa hota hai? Kaha ab na woh khata peeta hai na bolta chalta hai, na hilta julta hai. Kaha shayad maut aa gayi, us ne kaha haan wahi maut. Ab toh mai sahiba cheekhne chillane lagin, itne mein Hazrat Adam A.S aaye pucha kya baat hai? Lekin yeh jawab na de sakin, Aap ne dobara daryaft farmaya lekin fart-e-gham-o-ranj ki wajah se un ki zaban na chali toh kaha achha toh aur teri betiyan haye-waye mein hi rahengi aur main aur mere bete is se bari hain. Qabeel khasare tute aur nuqsan wala ho gaya, duniya aur aakhirat dono hi bigar gayin. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain "Jo insaan zulm se qatl kiya jata hai, is ke khoon ka bojh Adam ke is larke par bhi parta hai, is liye ke isi ne sab se pehle zameen par khoon-e-nahaq giraya hai". Mujahid ka qaul hai ke "Qatil ke ek pair ki pindli ko raan se us din se latka diya gaya aur is ka munh suraj ki taraf kar diya gaya, is ke ghoomne ke sath ghoomta rehta hai, jaron aur garmiyon mein aag aur barf ke garhay mein woh mu'azzab hai". Hazrat Abdullah se marwi hai ke "Jahannam ka aadhon aadh azab sirf is ek ko ho raha hai, sab se bara mu'azzab yahi hai zameen ke har qatl ke gunah ka hissa is ke zimme hai". Ibrahim Nakh'i farmate hain "Is par aur Shaitan par har khoon-e-nahaq ka bojh parta hai". Jab maar dala toh ab yeh maloom na tha ke kya kare, kis tarah ise chupaye? Toh Allah ne do kaway bheje, woh dono bhi aapas mein bhai bhai thay, yeh is ke samne larne lage, yahan tak ke ek ne dusre ko maar dala, phir ek garha khod kar is mein is ki laash ko rakh kar upar se mitti daal di, yeh dekh kar Qabeel ki samajh mein bhi yeh tarkeeb aa gayi aur is ne bhi aisa hi kiya. Hazrat Ali R.A se marwi hai ke az-khud mare hue ek kawway ko dusre kawway ne is tarah garha khod kar dafan kiya tha. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke saal bhar tak Qabeel apne bhai ki laash apne kandhe par lade lade phirta raha, phir kawway ko dekh kar apne nafs par malamat karne laga ke main itna bhi na kar saka, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai maar daal kar phir pachhtaya aur laash ko god mein rakh kar baith gaya aur is liye bhi ke sab se pehli mayyat aur sab se pehla qatl roo-e-zameen par yahi tha.

Ahl-e-Taurat kehte hain ke jab Qabeel ne apne bhai Habeel ko qatl kiya toh Allah ne us se poocha ke tere bhai Habeel ko kya hua? Us ne kaha mujhe kya khabar? Main us ka nigahban toh tha hi nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya sun tere bhai ka khoon zameen mein se mujhe pukar raha hai, tujh par meri laanat hai, is zameen mein jis ka munh khol kar tu ne use apne beganah bhai ka khoon pilaya hai, ab tu zameen mein jo kuch kaam karega woh apni kheti mein se tujhe kuch nahin degi, yahan tak tum zameen par umr bhar bechain bhatakte rahoge phir toh Qabeel bada hi nadim hua. Nuqsan ke sath hi pachtawa goya azaab par azaab tha. Is qissa mein mufassireen ke aqwal is baat par toh muttafiq hain ke yeh toh dono Hazrat Adam A.S ke sulbi bete thay aur yahi Quran ke alfaaz se bazahir maloom hota hai aur yahi hadith mein bhi hai ke roo-e-zameen par jo qatl-e-na-haq hota hai us ka ek hissa bojh aur gunah ka Hazrat Adam A.S ke is pehle ladke par hota hai, is liye ke isi ne sab se pehle qatl ka tareeqa ijaad kiya hai, lekin Hasan Basri R.H ka qaul hai ke "Yeh dono Bani Israel mein thay, qurbani sab se pehle inhi mein aayi aur zameen par sab se pehle Hazrat Adam A.S ka inteqal hua hai" lekin yeh qaul ghaur talab hai aur is ki asnaad bhi theek nahin. Ek marfoo hadith mein yeh waqea bator ek misaal ke hai "Tum is mein se achhai le lo aur bure ko chhod do". Yeh hadith mursal hai kehte hain ke is sadme se Hazrat Adam A.S bahut ghamgeen hue aur saal bhar tak unhein hansi na aayi, aakhir farishton ne un ke gham ke door hone aur unhein hansi aane ki dua ki. Hazrat Adam A.S ne us waqt apne ranj-o-gham mein yeh bhi kaha tha ke shehar aur shehar ki sab cheezein mutaghayyar ho gayin. Zameen ka rang badal gaya aur woh nihayat badsurat ho gayi, har har cheez ka rang-o-maza jata raha aur kashish wale chehron ki malahat bhi salb ho gayi. Is par unhein jawab diya gaya ke is murde ke sath is zinde ne bhi goya apne tayein halak kar diya aur jo burai qatil ne ki thi, us ka bojh us par aa gaya, bazahir maloom hota hai ke Qabeel ko usi waqt saza di gayi chunancha warid hua hai ke us ki pindli us ki raan se latka di gayi aur us ka munh suraj ki taraf kar diya gaya aur us ke sath hi sath ghoomta rehta tha yani jidhar suraj hota udhar hi us ka munh utha rehta. Hadith-e-Shareef mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jitne gunah is laiq hain ke bahut jald un ki saza duniya mein bhi di jaye aur phir aakhirat ke zabardast azaab baqi rahein un mein sab se badh kar gunah sarkashi aur qat-e-rehmi hai. Toh Qabeel mein yeh dono baatein jama ho gayin (Fa Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilaihi Raji'oon). (Yeh yaad rahe ke is qissa ki tafseelat jis qadar bayan hui hain, un mein se aksar-o-beshtar hissa Ahl-e-Kitab se akhaz kiya hua hai. Wallahu A'lam. Mutarjim)

Ek beganah shakhs ka qatl tamam insanon ka qatl. Farman hai ke Hazrat Adam A.S ke us ladke ke qatl-e-beja ki wajah se hum ne Bani Israel se saaf farma diya, un ki kitab mein likh diya aur un ke liye is hukm ko hukm-e-shar'i kar diya ke "Jo shakhs kisi ek ko bila wajah maar dale, na us ne kisi ko qatl kiya tha na us ne zameen mein fasad phailaya tha, toh goya us ne tamam logon ko qatl kiya, is liye ke Allah ke nazdeek sari makhlooq yaksan hai aur jo kisi be-qasoor shakhs ke qatl se baaz rahe, use haram jaane, toh goya us ne tamam logon ko zindagi di, is liye ke yeh sab log is tarah salamti ke sath rahenge".

Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman R.A ko jab baghi gher lete hain, toh Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A un ke paas jaate hain aur kehte hain main aap ki taraf-dari mein aap ke mukhalifeen se ladne ke liye aaya hoon, aap mulahiza farmayiye ke ab pani sar se uncha ho gaya hai. Yeh sun kar masoom khalifa ne farmaya, kya tum is baat par amada ho ke sab logon ko qatl kar do, jin mein ek main bhi hoon. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne farmaya nahin nahin, farmaya suno ek ko qatl karna aisa bura hai jaise sab ko qatl karna. Jao wapas laut jao, meri yahi khwahish hai Allah tumhein ajar de aur gunah na de, yeh sun kar aap wapas chale gaye aur na lade. Matlab yeh hai ke qatl ka ajar duniya ki barbadi ka ba'is hai aur is ki rok logon ki zindagi ka sabab hai.

Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain "Ek musalman ka khoon halal karne wala tamam logon ka qatil hai aur ek muslim ke khoon ko bachane wala tamam logon ke khoon ko goya bacha raha hai". Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke "Nabi ﷺ ko aur aadil muslim badshah ko qatl karne wale par sari duniya ke insanon ke qatl ka gunah hai aur Nabi aur Imam-e-Aadil ke bazu ko mazboot karna duniya ko zindagi dene ke mutaradif hai" (Ibn Jarir). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke "Ek ko be-wajah maar dalte hi jahannami ho jata hai goya sab ko maar dala".

Mujahid R.H farmate hain "Momin ko be-wajah shar'i maar dalne wala jahannami, dushman-e-Rabb, mal'oon aur mustahiq-e-saza ho jata hai, phir agar woh sab logon ko bhi maar dalta toh is se zyada azab use aur kya hota? Jo qatl se ruk jaye goya ke us ki taraf se sab ki zindagi mehfooz hai". Abdur Rahman R.H farmate hain "Ek qatl ke badle hi us ka khoon halal ho gaya, yeh nahin ke kayi ek ko qatl kare, jab hi woh qisas ke qabil ho, aur jo use zindagi de yani qatil ke wali se dargarzar kare aur us ne goya logon ko zindagi di".

Aur yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke jis ne insaan ki jaan bacha li maslan doobte ko nikal liya, jalte ko bacha liya, kisi ko halakat se hata liya. Maqsad logon ko khoon-e-nahaq se rokna aur logon ki khair-khwahi aur aman-o-aman par amada karna hai. Hazrat Hasan R.H se poocha gaya ke "Kya Bani Israel jis tarah is hukm ke mukallaf the, hum bhi hain, farmaya haan yaqeenan Allah ki qasam!"

Bani Israel ke khoon Allah ke nazdeek hamare khoon se zyada ba-waqat na thay, pas ek shakhs ka be-sabab qatl sab ke qatl ka bojh hai aur ek ki jaan ke bachao ka sawab sab ko bacha lene ke barabar hai". Ek martaba Hazrat Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib R.A ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se darkhwast ki ke Huzoor ﷺ mujhe koi aisi baat batayen ke meri zindagi ba-aaram guzre. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya kya kisi ko maar dalna tumhein pasand hai ya kisi ko bacha lena tumhein mehboob hai? Jawab diya bacha lena, farmaya "bas ab apni islah mein lage raho". Phir farmata hai un ke paas hamare Rasool wazeh daleelein aur roshan ahkaam aur khule mojizaat le kar aaye lekin us ke baad bhi aksar log apni sarkashi aur daraz dasti se baaz na rahe. Bani Qainuqa ke Yahood-o-Bani Quraiza aur Bani Nazeer waghera ko dekh lijiye ke Aus aur Khazraj ke sath mil kar aapas mein ek dusre se ladte thay aur ladai ke baad phir qaidiyon ke fidiye de kar chhudate thay aur maqtool ki diyat ada karte thay. Jis par unhein Quran mein samjhaya gaya ke tum se ahd yeh liya gaya tha ke na to apne walon ke khoon bahao, na unhein des se nikalo lekin tum ne bawajood pukhta iqrar aur mazboot ahd-o-paiman ke us ke khilaf go fidiye ada kiye lekin nikalna bhi to haram tha, us ke kya ma'ani ke kisi hukum ko mano aur kisi se inkar karo, aise logon ko saza yahi hai ke duniya mein ruswa aur zaleel hon aur aakhirat mein sakht-tar azabon ka shikar hon, Allah tumhare aamal se ghafil nahin. (Muharaba) ke ma'ani hukum ke khilaf karna, bar-aks karna, mukhalifat par tal jana hain. Murad us se kufr, daka zani, zameen mein shorish-o-fasad aur tarah tarah ki bad-amni paida karna hai, yahan tak ke salaf ne yeh bhi farmaya hai ke sikke ko tod dena bhi zameen mein fasad machana hai. Quran ki ek aur aayat mein hai jab woh kisi iqtidar ke malik ho jate hain to fasad phaila dete hain aur khet aur nasl ko halak karne lagte hain Allah Ta'ala fasad ko pasand nahin farmata. Yeh aayat mushrikeen ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Is liye ke us mein yeh bhi hai ke jab aisa shakhs un kamon ke baad musalmanon ke hathon mein giraftar hone se pehle hi tauba kar le to phir us par koi muakhaza nahin, bar-khilaf us ke agar musalman un kamon ko kare aur bhag kar kuffar mein ja mile to had-e-shar'i se azaad nahin hota. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain "Yeh aayat mushrikon ke bare mein utri hai, phir un mein se jo koi musalman ke hath aa jane se pehle tauba kar le to jo hukum us par us ke fe'l ke ba'is sabit ho chuka hai woh tal nahin sakta". Fasad aur qatl-o-gharat Hazrat Ubay R.A se marwi hai ke Ahl-e-Kitab ke ek giroh se Rasool Allah ﷺ ka mu'ahida ho gaya tha lekin unhon ne use tod diya aur fasad macha diya. Us par Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ ko ikhtiyar diya ke agar aap chahein to unhein qatl kar dein, chahein to ulte seedhe hath paon katwa dein. Hazrat Sa'ad R.A farmate hain "Yeh Haruriya Khawarij ke bare mein nazil hui hai". Sahih yeh hai ke jo bhi is fe'l ka murtakib ho us ke liye yeh hukum hai.

Chunancha Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke "Qabila-e-Ukl ke aath aadmi Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas aaye, Aap (ﷺ) ne un se farmaya agar tum chaho to hamare charwahon ke sath chale jao, oonton ka doodh aur peshab tumhein milega. Chunancha yeh gaye aur jab un ki bimari jati rahi to unhon ne un charwahon ko maar dala aur oont le kar chalte bane. Huzoor (ﷺ) ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi to Aap (ﷺ) ne Sahaba ko un ke peeche doraya ke unhein pakar layein, chunancha yeh giraftar kiye gaye aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ke samne pesh kiye gaye. Phir un ke hath paon kaat diye gaye aur aankhon mein garam silaiyan pheri gayin aur dhoop mein pare hue tarap tarap kar mar gaye". Muslim mein hai ya to yeh log Ukl ke thay ya Uraina ke. Yeh pani mangte thay magar unhein pani na diya gaya na un ke zakhm dhoye gaye. Unhon ne chori bhi ki thi, qatl bhi kiya tha, iman ke baad kufr bhi kiya tha aur Allah Rasool se larte bhi thay. Unhon ne charwahon ki aankhon mein garam silaiyan bhi pheri thin, Madine ki aab-o-hawa us waqt durust na thi, sarsam ki bimari thi, Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un ke peeche bees Ansari ghursawar bheje thay aur ek khoji tha, jo nishan-e-qadam dekh kar rehbari karta jata tha. Maut ke waqt un ki pyas ke mare yeh halat thi ke zameen chaat rahe thay, inhi ke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai. Ek martaba Hajjaj ne Hazrat Anas (R.A) se sawal kiya ke sab se bari aur sab se sakht saza jo Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne kisi ko di ho, tum bayan karo to Aap (R.A) ne yeh waqia bayan farmaya. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh log Bahrain se aaye thay, bimari ki wajah se un ke rang zard par gaye thay aur pait barh gaye thay to Aap (ﷺ) ne unhein farmaya ke jao oonton mein raho aur un ka doodh aur peshab piyo. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain phir main ne dekha ke Hajjaj ne to is riwayat ko apne mazalim ki daleel bana li tab to mujhe sakht nadamat hui ke main ne is se yeh hadith kyun bayan ki? Aur riwayat mein hai ke un mein se char shakhs to Uraina qabile ke thay aur teen Ukl ke thay, yeh sab tandurust ho gaye to yeh murtad ban gaye. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke raste bhi unhon ne band kar diye thay aur zina kar bhi thay, jab yeh aaye to ab sab ke paas ba-wajah-e-faqeeri pehanne ke kapre tak na thay, yeh qatl-o-gharat kar ke bhag kar apne shehar ko ja rahe thay. Hazrat Jareer (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh apni qoum ke paas pahunchne wale thay jo hum ne unhein ja liya. Woh pani mangte thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate thay, ab to pani ke badle Jahannam ki aag milegi. Is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke aankhon mein silaiyan pherna Allah ko na-pasand aaya, yeh hadith zaeef aur ghareeb hai lekin is se yeh maloom hua ke jo lashkar un murtadon ke giraftar karne ke liye bheja gaya tha, un ke sardar Hazrat Jareer (R.A) thay. Haan is riwayat mein yeh fiqra bilkul munkar hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne un ki aankhon mein silaiyan pherna makrooh rakha.

Is liye ke Sahih Muslim mein yeh majood hai ke unhon ne charwahon ke sath bhi yahi kiya tha, pas yeh us ka badla aur un ka qisas tha jo unhon ne un ke sath kiya tha wahi un ke sath kiya gaya wallahu a'lam. Aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh log Banu Fazarah ke thay, is waqiye ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh saza kisi ko nahin di. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ek ghulam tha, jis ka naam Yasar tha chunke yeh bade achay namazi thay, is liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein azaad kar diya tha aur apne oonton mein unhein bhej diya tha ke yeh un ki nigrani rakhein, inhi ko in murtadon ne qatl kiya aur un ki aankhon mein kaantay gaar kar oont le kar bhaag gaye, jo lashkar unhein giraftar kar ke laya tha, un mein ek shah-zor Hazrat Kurz bin Jabir Fehri thay. Hafiz Abu Bakr bin Marduyah ne is riwayat ke tamam tareeqon ko jama kar diya Allah unhein jazaye khair de. Abu Hamza Abdul Kareem se oonton ke peshab ke bare mein sawal hota hai to aap in muharibeen ka qissa bayan farmatay hain is mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh log munafiqana taur par imaan laye thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Madine ki aab-o-hawa ki namuwafiqat ki shikayat ki thi, jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un ki dagha bazi aur qatl-o-gharat aur irtidad ka ilm hua, to aap ne munadi karayi ke Allah ke lashkariyo uth kharay ho, yeh aawaz suntay hi mujahideen kharay ho gaye, baghair is ke ke koi kisi ka intezar kare in murtad daakuon aur baghiyon ke peechay dauray, khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi un ko rawana kar ke un ke peechay chalay, woh log apni jaye aman mein pohanchne hi ko thay ke sahaba ne unhein gher liya aur un mein se jitne giraftar ho gaye, unhein le kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne pesh kar diya aur yeh aayat utri, un ki jalawatni yahi thi ke unhein hukumat-e-Islam ki hudood se kharij kar diya gaya. Phir un ko ibratnak sazayein di gayin, is ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi ke bhi aaza-e-badan se juda nahin karaye balkay aap ne is se mana farmaya hai, janwaron ko bhi is tarah karna mana hai. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke qatl ke baad unhein jala diya gaya, baaz kehte hain yeh Banu Saleem ke log thay. Baaz buzurgon ka qaul hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo saza unhein di woh Allah ko pasand na aayi aur is aayat se usay mansookh kar diya. Un ke nazdeek goya is aayat mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is saza se roka gaya hai. Jaise aayat (Afa Allahu Anka) mein aur baaz kehte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne musla karne se yani haath paon kaan naak kaatne se jo muman'at farmayi hai, is hadees se yeh saza mansookh ho gayi lekin yeh zara ghaur talab hai phir yeh bhi sawal talab amr hai ke nasikh ki takheer ki daleel kya hai? Baaz kehte hain hudood-e-Islam muqarrar hon is se pehle ka yeh waqiya hai lekin yeh bhi kuch theek nahin maloom hota, balkay hudood ke taqarrur ke baad ka waqiya maloom hota hai is liye ke is hadees ke ek rawi Hazrat Jareer bin Abdullah hain aur un ka Islam Surah Maidah ke nazil ho chukne ke baad ka hai.

Baaz kehte hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ki aankhon mein garam salaiyan pherni chahi thin lekin yeh aayat utri aur aap apne irade se baaz rahe, lekin yeh bhi durust nahin. Is liye ke Bukhari-o-Muslim mein yeh lafz hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ki aankhon mein salaiyan pherwayin. Muhammad bin Ajlan farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo sakht saza unhein di, us ke inkar mein yeh aayatein utri hain aur un mein sahih saza bayan ki gayi hai jo qatl karne aur haath paon ulti taraf se kaatne aur watan se nikal dene ke hukm par shamil hai chunancha dekh lijiye ke us ke baad phir kisi ki aankhon mein salaiyan pherni sabit nahin, lekin Auza'i kehte hain ke yeh theek nahin ke is aayat mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is fe'l par aap ko danta gaya ho, baat yeh hai ke unhon ne jo kiya tha us ka wahi badla mil gaya, ab aayat nazil hui jis ne ek khaas hukm aise logon ka bayan farmaya aur us mein aankhon mein garam salaiyan pherne ka hukm nahin diya. Is aayat se jamhoor ulama ne daleel pakdi hai ke raston ki bandish kar ke ladna aur shehron mein ladna dono barabar hain kyunke lafz (wa yas'awna fil-ardi fasada) ke hain. Malik, Auza'i, Laith, Shafi'i, Ahmad (Rahimahumullah Ajma'in) ka yahi mazhab hai ke baghi log khwah shehar mein aisa fitna machayen ya beroon-e-shehar, un ki saza yahi hai, balkeh Imam Malik to yahan tak farmate hain ke agar koi shakhs dusre ko us ke ghar mein is tarah dhoka dahi se maar dale to use pakad liya jaye aur use qatl kar diya jaye aur khud Imam-e-Waqt in kamon ko az-khud kare ga, na ke maqtool ke awliya ke haath mein yeh kaam hon balkeh agar woh darguzar karna chahein to bhi un ke ikhtiyar mein nahin balkeh yeh jurm, be-wasta hukumat-e-Islamia ka hai. Imam Abu Hanifa ka mazhab yeh nahin, woh kehte hain ke "Muharaba usi waqt mana jaye ga jabke shehar ke bahar aise fasad koi kare, kyunke shehar mein to imdad ka pahunchna mumkin hai, raston mein yeh baat namumkin si hai". Jo saza in muharibeen ki bayan hui hai us ke bare mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain "Jo shakhs musalmanon par talwar uthaye, raston ko pur-khatar bana de, Imam-ul-Muslimeen ko in teenon sazaon mein se jo saza dena chahe us ka ikhtiyar hai". Yahi qaul aur bhi bahut son ka hai aur is tarah ka ikhtiyar aisi hi aur aayaton ke ahkaam mein bhi maujood hai jaise mohrim agar shikar khele to us ka badla shikar ke barabar ki qurbani ya masakeen ka khana hai ya us ke barabar rozay rakhna hai, bimari ya sar ki takleef ki wajah se halat-e-ehram mein sar mundwane aur khilaf-e-ehram kaam karne wale ke fidiye mein bhi rozay ya sadqa ya qurbani ka hukm hai. Qasam ke kaffaray mein darmiyani darja ka khana dein maskeenon ka ya un ka kapda ya ek ghulam ko azaad karna hai. To jis tarah yahan in suraton mein se kisi ek ke pasand kar lene ka ikhtiyar hai, isi tarah aise muharib, murtad logon ki saza bhi ya to qatl hai ya haath paon ulti tarah se kaatna hai ya jala-watan karna.

Aur jamhoor ka qaul hai ke yeh aayat kayi ahwaal mein hai, jab daaku qatl-o-gharat dono ke murtakib hote hon toh qabil-e-daar aur gardan-e-zadani hain aur jab sirf qatl sarzad hua ho toh qatl ka badla sirf qatl hai aur agar faqat maal liya ho toh haath paon ultay seedhay kaat diye jayenge aur agar raastay pur-khatar kardiye hon, logon ko khauf-zada kardiya ho aur kisi gunah ke murtakib na huye hon aur giraftar kar liye jayen toh sirf jala-watni hai. Aksar salaf aur aimma ka yahi mazhab hai phir buzurgon ne is mein bhi ikhtilaf kiya hai ke aaya sooli par latka kar yunhi chhor diya jaye ke bhooka pyasa mar jaye? Ya neze waghera se qatl kardiya jaye? Ya pehle qatl kardiya jaye phir sooli par latkaya jaye taake aur logon ko ibrat hasil ho? Aur kya teen din tak sooli par rehne de kar phir utaar liya jaye? Ya yunhi chhor diya jaye lekin tafsir ka yeh mauzoo nahin ke hum aise juzwi ikhtilafat mein padein aur har ek ki daleelein waghera waarid karein. Haan ek hadith mein kuch tafseel-e-saza hai, agar is ki sanad sahih ho toh woh yeh ke huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jab in muharibeen ke baare mein Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se daryaft kiya toh aap ne farmaya "jinhon ne maal churaya aur raaston ko khatarnak banadiya un ke haath toh chori ke badle kaat dijiye aur jis ne qatl aur dehshat-gardi phailayi aur badkari ka irtikab kiya hai, use sooli charha do. Farman hai ke zameen se alag kardiye jayen yani unhein talash kar ke un par had qaim ki jaye ya woh Dar-ul-Islam se bhaag kar kahin chale jayen ya yeh ke ek shehar se dusre shehar aur dusre se teesre shehar unhein bhej diya jata rahe ya yeh ke Islami saltanat se bilkul hi kharij kardiya jaye". Sha'bi toh nikal hi dete the aur Atta Khurasani kehte hain "ek lashkar mein se dusre lashkar mein pahuncha diya jaye yunhi kayi saal tak maara maara phiraya jaye lekin Dar-ul-Islam se bahar na kiya jaye". Abu Hanifa (R.H) aur un ke as-haab kehte hain "use jail khane mein daal diya jaye". Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ka mukhtar qaul yeh hai ke "use us ke shehar se nikal kar kisi dusre shehar ke jail khane mein daal diya jaye". "Aise log duniya mein zaleel-o-razeel aur aakhirat mein bade bhaari azabon mein giraftar honge". Aayat ka yeh tukda toh un logon ki ta'eed karta hai jo kehte hain ke yeh aayat mushrikon ke baare mein utri hai aur musalmanon ke baare woh sahih hadith hai jis mein hai ke huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hum se waise hi ahd liye jaise aurton se liye the ke "hum Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na karein, chori na karein, zina na karein, apni auladon ko qatl na karein, ek dusre ki nafarmani na karein jo is waade ko nibhaye, us ka ajar Allah ke zimme hai aur jo in mein se kisi gunah ke saath aalooda hojaye phir agar use saza hogayi toh woh saza kaffara ban jayegi aur agar Allah Ta'ala ne parda-poshi karli toh is amr ka Allah hi mukhtar hai agar chahe azab kare, agar chahe chhor de".

Aur hadith mein hai "Jis kisi ne koi gunah kiya phir Allah Ta'ala ne usey dhanp liya aur us se chashm-poshi karli toh Allah ki zaat aur uska rahm-o-karam us se bahut buland-o-bala hai, maaf kiye hue jaraim ko dobara karne pe usey dunyawi saza milegi, agar be-tauba mar gaye toh aakhirat ki woh sazayein baqi hain jin ka us waqt sahi tasawwur bhi muhal hai haan tauba naseeb ho jaye toh aur baat hai". Phir tauba karne walon ki nisbat jo farmaya hai "Is ka izhar is surat mein toh saaf hai ke is aayat ko mushrikon ke bare mein nazil shuda mana jaye. Lekin jo musalman maghroor hon aur woh qabze mein aane se pehle tauba kar lein toh un se qatl aur suli aur paon kaatna toh hat jata hai lekin haath ka katna bhi hat jata hai ya nahin, is mein ulama ke do qaul hain, aayat ke zahiri alfaaz se toh yahi maloom hota hai ke sab kuch hat jaye, Sahaba ka amal bhi isi par hai. Chunancha Jariya bin Badr Taimi Basri ne zameen mein fasad kiya, musalmanon se lara, is bare mein chand Quraishiyon ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se sifarish ki, jin mein Hazrat Hasan bin Ali (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Jafar (R.A) bhi thay lekin aap ne usey aman dene se inkar kar diya. Woh Saeed bin Qais Hamdani ke paas aaya, aap ne apne ghar mein usey thahraya aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke paas aaye aur kaha batayiye toh jo Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) se larey aur zameen mein fasad ki sa'i kare phir in aayaton ki (Qabla an taqdiru alaihim) tak tilawat ki toh aap ne farmaya main toh aise shakhs ko aman likh doon ga, Hazrat Saeed ne farmaya yeh Jariya bin Badr hai, chunancha Jariya ne is ke baad un ki madh mein ashaar bhi kahe hain. Qabila Murad ka ek shakhs Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) ke paas Kufa ki masjid mein jahan ke yeh governor thay, ek farz namaz ke baad aaya aur kehne laga ae Ameer-e-Kufa falan bin falan Muradi qabile ka hoon, main ne Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) se larai lari, zameen mein fasad ki koshish ki lekin aap log mujh par qudrat payein, is se pehle main taib ho gaya ab main aap se panah hasil karne wale ki jagah par khara hoon. Is par Hazrat Abu Musa (R.A) kharay ho gaye aur farmaya ae logo! Tum mein se koi ab is tauba ke baad is se kisi tarah ki larai na kare, agar yeh sacha hai toh Alhamdulillah aur yeh jhoota hai toh is ke gunah hi isey halak kar denge. Yeh shakhs ek muddat tak toh theek theek raha lekin phir baghawat kar gaya, Allah ne bhi is ke gunahon ke badle isey gharat kar diya aur yeh maar dala gaya. Ali nami ek Asadi shakhs ne bhi guzar-gahon mein dehshat phaila di, logon ko qatl kiya, maal loota, badshah lashkar aur ri'aya ne harchand isey giraftar karna chaha, lekin yeh haath na laga.

Ek martaba yeh jungle mein tha, ek shakhs ko Quran padhte suna aur woh us waqt yeh aayat tilawat kar raha tha (Qul ya ibadiyallazina asrafu) al-kh, yeh ise sun kar ruk gaya aur us se kaha ae Allah ke bande yeh aayat mujhe dobara suna, us ne phir padhi Allah ki is aawaz ko sun kar woh farmata hai ae mere gunahgar bando tum meri rahmat se na-umeed na ho jao, main sab gunahon ko bakhshne par qadir hoon main Ghafoor-o-Rahim hoon. Is shakhs ne jhat se apni talwar miyan mein kar li, isi waqt sache dil se tauba ki aur subah ki namaz se pehle Madine pahunch gaya, ghusal kiya aur Masjid-e-Nabvi mein namaz-e-subah jamaat ke sath ada ki aur Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ke paas jo log baithe the, un hi mein ek taraf yeh bhi baith gaya. Jab din ka ujala hua to logon ne ise dekh kar pehchan liya ke yeh to saltanat ka baghi, bahut bada mujrim aur mafroor shakhs Ali Asadi hai, sab ne chaha ke ise giraftar kar lein. Us ne kaha suno bhaiyo! Tum mujhe giraftar nahin kar sakte, is liye ke mujh par tumhare qabu paane se pehle hi main to tauba kar chuka hoon balkeh tauba ke baad khud tumhare paas aa gaya hoon, Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne farmaya! Yeh sach kehta hai aur is ka hath pakad kar Marwan bin Hakam ke paas le chale, yeh us waqt Hazrat Muawiya (R.A) ki taraf se Madine ke governor the, wahan pahunch kar farmaya ke yeh Ali Asadi hain, yeh tauba kar chuke hain, is liye ab tum inhe kuch nahin keh sakte. Chunancha kisi ne is ke sath kuch na kiya, jab mujahideen ki ek jamaat Roomiyon se ladne ke liye chali to un mujahidon ke sath yeh bhi ho liye, samundar mein in ki kashti ja rahi thi ke samne se chand kashtiyan Roomiyon ki aa gayin, yeh apni kashti mein se Roomiyon ki gardanein maarne ke liye un ki kashti mein kood gaye, in ki aabdar khara-shigaf talwar ki chamak ki taab Roomi na la sake aur namardi se ek taraf ko bhage, yeh bhi un ke peeche isi taraf chale chunke sara bojh ek taraf ho gaya, is liye kashti ulat gayi jis se woh saare Roomi kuffar halak ho gaye aur Hazrat Ali Asadi bhi doob kar shaheed ho gaye (Allah un par apni rahmaten nazil farmaye).

Ek beganah shakhs ka qatl tamam insanon ka qatl. Farman hai ke Hazrat Adam A.S ke us ladke ke qatl-e-beja ki wajah se hum ne Bani Israel se saaf farma diya, un ki kitab mein likh diya aur un ke liye is hukm ko hukm-e-shar'i kar diya ke "Jo shakhs kisi ek ko bila wajah maar dale, na us ne kisi ko qatl kiya tha na us ne zameen mein fasad phailaya tha, toh goya us ne tamam logon ko qatl kiya, is liye ke Allah ke nazdeek sari makhlooq yaksan hai aur jo kisi be-qasoor shakhs ke qatl se baaz rahe, use haram jaane, toh goya us ne tamam logon ko zindagi di, is liye ke yeh sab log is tarah salamti ke sath rahenge".

Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman R.A ko jab baghi gher lete hain, toh Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A un ke paas jaate hain aur kehte hain main aap ki taraf-dari mein aap ke mukhalifeen se ladne ke liye aaya hoon, aap mulahiza farmayiye ke ab pani sar se uncha ho gaya hai. Yeh sun kar masoom khalifa ne farmaya, kya tum is baat par amada ho ke sab logon ko qatl kar do, jin mein ek main bhi hoon. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne farmaya nahin nahin, farmaya suno ek ko qatl karna aisa bura hai jaise sab ko qatl karna. Jao wapas laut jao, meri yahi khwahish hai Allah tumhein ajar de aur gunah na de, yeh sun kar aap wapas chale gaye aur na lade. Matlab yeh hai ke qatl ka ajar duniya ki barbadi ka ba'is hai aur is ki rok logon ki zindagi ka sabab hai.

Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain "Ek musalman ka khoon halal karne wala tamam logon ka qatil hai aur ek muslim ke khoon ko bachane wala tamam logon ke khoon ko goya bacha raha hai". Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke "Nabi ﷺ ko aur aadil muslim badshah ko qatl karne wale par sari duniya ke insanon ke qatl ka gunah hai aur Nabi aur Imam-e-Aadil ke bazu ko mazboot karna duniya ko zindagi dene ke mutaradif hai" (Ibn Jarir). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke "Ek ko be-wajah maar dalte hi jahannami ho jata hai goya sab ko maar dala".

Mujahid R.H farmate hain "Momin ko be-wajah shar'i maar dalne wala jahannami, dushman-e-Rabb, mal'oon aur mustahiq-e-saza ho jata hai, phir agar woh sab logon ko bhi maar dalta toh is se zyada azab use aur kya hota? Jo qatl se ruk jaye goya ke us ki taraf se sab ki zindagi mehfooz hai". Abdur Rahman R.H farmate hain "Ek qatl ke badle hi us ka khoon halal ho gaya, yeh nahin ke kayi ek ko qatl kare, jab hi woh qisas ke qabil ho, aur jo use zindagi de yani qatil ke wali se dargarzar kare aur us ne goya logon ko zindagi di".

Aur yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke jis ne insaan ki jaan bacha li maslan doobte ko nikal liya, jalte ko bacha liya, kisi ko halakat se hata liya. Maqsad logon ko khoon-e-nahaq se rokna aur logon ki khair-khwahi aur aman-o-aman par amada karna hai. Hazrat Hasan R.H se poocha gaya ke "Kya Bani Israel jis tarah is hukm ke mukallaf the, hum bhi hain, farmaya haan yaqeenan Allah ki qasam!"

Bani Israel ke khoon Allah ke nazdeek hamare khoon se zyada ba-waqat na thay, pas ek shakhs ka be-sabab qatl sab ke qatl ka bojh hai aur ek ki jaan ke bachao ka sawab sab ko bacha lene ke barabar hai". Ek martaba Hazrat Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib R.A ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se darkhwast ki ke Huzoor ﷺ mujhe koi aisi baat batayen ke meri zindagi ba-aaram guzre. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya kya kisi ko maar dalna tumhein pasand hai ya kisi ko bacha lena tumhein mehboob hai? Jawab diya bacha lena, farmaya "bas ab apni islah mein lage raho". Phir farmata hai un ke paas hamare Rasool wazeh daleelein aur roshan ahkaam aur khule mojizaat le kar aaye lekin us ke baad bhi aksar log apni sarkashi aur daraz dasti se baaz na rahe. Bani Qainuqa ke Yahood-o-Bani Quraiza aur Bani Nazeer waghera ko dekh lijiye ke Aus aur Khazraj ke sath mil kar aapas mein ek dusre se ladte thay aur ladai ke baad phir qaidiyon ke fidiye de kar chhudate thay aur maqtool ki diyat ada karte thay. Jis par unhein Quran mein samjhaya gaya ke tum se ahd yeh liya gaya tha ke na to apne walon ke khoon bahao, na unhein des se nikalo lekin tum ne bawajood pukhta iqrar aur mazboot ahd-o-paiman ke us ke khilaf go fidiye ada kiye lekin nikalna bhi to haram tha, us ke kya ma'ani ke kisi hukum ko mano aur kisi se inkar karo, aise logon ko saza yahi hai ke duniya mein ruswa aur zaleel hon aur aakhirat mein sakht-tar azabon ka shikar hon, Allah tumhare aamal se ghafil nahin. (Muharaba) ke ma'ani hukum ke khilaf karna, bar-aks karna, mukhalifat par tal jana hain. Murad us se kufr, daka zani, zameen mein shorish-o-fasad aur tarah tarah ki bad-amni paida karna hai, yahan tak ke salaf ne yeh bhi farmaya hai ke sikke ko tod dena bhi zameen mein fasad machana hai. Quran ki ek aur aayat mein hai jab woh kisi iqtidar ke malik ho jate hain to fasad phaila dete hain aur khet aur nasl ko halak karne lagte hain Allah Ta'ala fasad ko pasand nahin farmata. Yeh aayat mushrikeen ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Is liye ke us mein yeh bhi hai ke jab aisa shakhs un kamon ke baad musalmanon ke hathon mein giraftar hone se pehle hi tauba kar le to phir us par koi muakhaza nahin, bar-khilaf us ke agar musalman un kamon ko kare aur bhag kar kuffar mein ja mile to had-e-shar'i se azaad nahin hota. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain "Yeh aayat mushrikon ke bare mein utri hai, phir un mein se jo koi musalman ke hath aa jane se pehle tauba kar le to jo hukum us par us ke fe'l ke ba'is sabit ho chuka hai woh tal nahin sakta". Fasad aur qatl-o-gharat Hazrat Ubay R.A se marwi hai ke Ahl-e-Kitab ke ek giroh se Rasool Allah ﷺ ka mu'ahida ho gaya tha lekin unhon ne use tod diya aur fasad macha diya. Us par Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ ko ikhtiyar diya ke agar aap chahein to unhein qatl kar dein, chahein to ulte seedhe hath paon katwa dein. Hazrat Sa'ad R.A farmate hain "Yeh Haruriya Khawarij ke bare mein nazil hui hai". Sahih yeh hai ke jo bhi is fe'l ka murtakib ho us ke liye yeh hukum hai.

Chunancha Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke "Qabila-e-Ukl ke aath aadmi Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas aaye, Aap (ﷺ) ne un se farmaya agar tum chaho to hamare charwahon ke sath chale jao, oonton ka doodh aur peshab tumhein milega. Chunancha yeh gaye aur jab un ki bimari jati rahi to unhon ne un charwahon ko maar dala aur oont le kar chalte bane. Huzoor (ﷺ) ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi to Aap (ﷺ) ne Sahaba ko un ke peeche doraya ke unhein pakar layein, chunancha yeh giraftar kiye gaye aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ke samne pesh kiye gaye. Phir un ke hath paon kaat diye gaye aur aankhon mein garam silaiyan pheri gayin aur dhoop mein pare hue tarap tarap kar mar gaye". Muslim mein hai ya to yeh log Ukl ke thay ya Uraina ke. Yeh pani mangte thay magar unhein pani na diya gaya na un ke zakhm dhoye gaye. Unhon ne chori bhi ki thi, qatl bhi kiya tha, iman ke baad kufr bhi kiya tha aur Allah Rasool se larte bhi thay. Unhon ne charwahon ki aankhon mein garam silaiyan bhi pheri thin, Madine ki aab-o-hawa us waqt durust na thi, sarsam ki bimari thi, Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un ke peeche bees Ansari ghursawar bheje thay aur ek khoji tha, jo nishan-e-qadam dekh kar rehbari karta jata tha. Maut ke waqt un ki pyas ke mare yeh halat thi ke zameen chaat rahe thay, inhi ke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai. Ek martaba Hajjaj ne Hazrat Anas (R.A) se sawal kiya ke sab se bari aur sab se sakht saza jo Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne kisi ko di ho, tum bayan karo to Aap (R.A) ne yeh waqia bayan farmaya. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh log Bahrain se aaye thay, bimari ki wajah se un ke rang zard par gaye thay aur pait barh gaye thay to Aap (ﷺ) ne unhein farmaya ke jao oonton mein raho aur un ka doodh aur peshab piyo. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain phir main ne dekha ke Hajjaj ne to is riwayat ko apne mazalim ki daleel bana li tab to mujhe sakht nadamat hui ke main ne is se yeh hadith kyun bayan ki? Aur riwayat mein hai ke un mein se char shakhs to Uraina qabile ke thay aur teen Ukl ke thay, yeh sab tandurust ho gaye to yeh murtad ban gaye. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke raste bhi unhon ne band kar diye thay aur zina kar bhi thay, jab yeh aaye to ab sab ke paas ba-wajah-e-faqeeri pehanne ke kapre tak na thay, yeh qatl-o-gharat kar ke bhag kar apne shehar ko ja rahe thay. Hazrat Jareer (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh apni qoum ke paas pahunchne wale thay jo hum ne unhein ja liya. Woh pani mangte thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate thay, ab to pani ke badle Jahannam ki aag milegi. Is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke aankhon mein silaiyan pherna Allah ko na-pasand aaya, yeh hadith zaeef aur ghareeb hai lekin is se yeh maloom hua ke jo lashkar un murtadon ke giraftar karne ke liye bheja gaya tha, un ke sardar Hazrat Jareer (R.A) thay. Haan is riwayat mein yeh fiqra bilkul munkar hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne un ki aankhon mein silaiyan pherna makrooh rakha.

Is liye ke Sahih Muslim mein yeh majood hai ke unhon ne charwahon ke sath bhi yahi kiya tha, pas yeh us ka badla aur un ka qisas tha jo unhon ne un ke sath kiya tha wahi un ke sath kiya gaya wallahu a'lam. Aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh log Banu Fazarah ke thay, is waqiye ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh saza kisi ko nahin di. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ek ghulam tha, jis ka naam Yasar tha chunke yeh bade achay namazi thay, is liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein azaad kar diya tha aur apne oonton mein unhein bhej diya tha ke yeh un ki nigrani rakhein, inhi ko in murtadon ne qatl kiya aur un ki aankhon mein kaantay gaar kar oont le kar bhaag gaye, jo lashkar unhein giraftar kar ke laya tha, un mein ek shah-zor Hazrat Kurz bin Jabir Fehri thay. Hafiz Abu Bakr bin Marduyah ne is riwayat ke tamam tareeqon ko jama kar diya Allah unhein jazaye khair de. Abu Hamza Abdul Kareem se oonton ke peshab ke bare mein sawal hota hai to aap in muharibeen ka qissa bayan farmatay hain is mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh log munafiqana taur par imaan laye thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Madine ki aab-o-hawa ki namuwafiqat ki shikayat ki thi, jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un ki dagha bazi aur qatl-o-gharat aur irtidad ka ilm hua, to aap ne munadi karayi ke Allah ke lashkariyo uth kharay ho, yeh aawaz suntay hi mujahideen kharay ho gaye, baghair is ke ke koi kisi ka intezar kare in murtad daakuon aur baghiyon ke peechay dauray, khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi un ko rawana kar ke un ke peechay chalay, woh log apni jaye aman mein pohanchne hi ko thay ke sahaba ne unhein gher liya aur un mein se jitne giraftar ho gaye, unhein le kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne pesh kar diya aur yeh aayat utri, un ki jalawatni yahi thi ke unhein hukumat-e-Islam ki hudood se kharij kar diya gaya. Phir un ko ibratnak sazayein di gayin, is ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi ke bhi aaza-e-badan se juda nahin karaye balkay aap ne is se mana farmaya hai, janwaron ko bhi is tarah karna mana hai. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke qatl ke baad unhein jala diya gaya, baaz kehte hain yeh Banu Saleem ke log thay. Baaz buzurgon ka qaul hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo saza unhein di woh Allah ko pasand na aayi aur is aayat se usay mansookh kar diya. Un ke nazdeek goya is aayat mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is saza se roka gaya hai. Jaise aayat (Afa Allahu Anka) mein aur baaz kehte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne musla karne se yani haath paon kaan naak kaatne se jo muman'at farmayi hai, is hadees se yeh saza mansookh ho gayi lekin yeh zara ghaur talab hai phir yeh bhi sawal talab amr hai ke nasikh ki takheer ki daleel kya hai? Baaz kehte hain hudood-e-Islam muqarrar hon is se pehle ka yeh waqiya hai lekin yeh bhi kuch theek nahin maloom hota, balkay hudood ke taqarrur ke baad ka waqiya maloom hota hai is liye ke is hadees ke ek rawi Hazrat Jareer bin Abdullah hain aur un ka Islam Surah Maidah ke nazil ho chukne ke baad ka hai.

Baaz kehte hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ki aankhon mein garam salaiyan pherni chahi thin lekin yeh aayat utri aur aap apne irade se baaz rahe, lekin yeh bhi durust nahin. Is liye ke Bukhari-o-Muslim mein yeh lafz hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ki aankhon mein salaiyan pherwayin. Muhammad bin Ajlan farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo sakht saza unhein di, us ke inkar mein yeh aayatein utri hain aur un mein sahih saza bayan ki gayi hai jo qatl karne aur haath paon ulti taraf se kaatne aur watan se nikal dene ke hukm par shamil hai chunancha dekh lijiye ke us ke baad phir kisi ki aankhon mein salaiyan pherni sabit nahin, lekin Auza'i kehte hain ke yeh theek nahin ke is aayat mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is fe'l par aap ko danta gaya ho, baat yeh hai ke unhon ne jo kiya tha us ka wahi badla mil gaya, ab aayat nazil hui jis ne ek khaas hukm aise logon ka bayan farmaya aur us mein aankhon mein garam salaiyan pherne ka hukm nahin diya. Is aayat se jamhoor ulama ne daleel pakdi hai ke raston ki bandish kar ke ladna aur shehron mein ladna dono barabar hain kyunke lafz (wa yas'awna fil-ardi fasada) ke hain. Malik, Auza'i, Laith, Shafi'i, Ahmad (Rahimahumullah Ajma'in) ka yahi mazhab hai ke baghi log khwah shehar mein aisa fitna machayen ya beroon-e-shehar, un ki saza yahi hai, balkeh Imam Malik to yahan tak farmate hain ke agar koi shakhs dusre ko us ke ghar mein is tarah dhoka dahi se maar dale to use pakad liya jaye aur use qatl kar diya jaye aur khud Imam-e-Waqt in kamon ko az-khud kare ga, na ke maqtool ke awliya ke haath mein yeh kaam hon balkeh agar woh darguzar karna chahein to bhi un ke ikhtiyar mein nahin balkeh yeh jurm, be-wasta hukumat-e-Islamia ka hai. Imam Abu Hanifa ka mazhab yeh nahin, woh kehte hain ke "Muharaba usi waqt mana jaye ga jabke shehar ke bahar aise fasad koi kare, kyunke shehar mein to imdad ka pahunchna mumkin hai, raston mein yeh baat namumkin si hai". Jo saza in muharibeen ki bayan hui hai us ke bare mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain "Jo shakhs musalmanon par talwar uthaye, raston ko pur-khatar bana de, Imam-ul-Muslimeen ko in teenon sazaon mein se jo saza dena chahe us ka ikhtiyar hai". Yahi qaul aur bhi bahut son ka hai aur is tarah ka ikhtiyar aisi hi aur aayaton ke ahkaam mein bhi maujood hai jaise mohrim agar shikar khele to us ka badla shikar ke barabar ki qurbani ya masakeen ka khana hai ya us ke barabar rozay rakhna hai, bimari ya sar ki takleef ki wajah se halat-e-ehram mein sar mundwane aur khilaf-e-ehram kaam karne wale ke fidiye mein bhi rozay ya sadqa ya qurbani ka hukm hai. Qasam ke kaffaray mein darmiyani darja ka khana dein maskeenon ka ya un ka kapda ya ek ghulam ko azaad karna hai. To jis tarah yahan in suraton mein se kisi ek ke pasand kar lene ka ikhtiyar hai, isi tarah aise muharib, murtad logon ki saza bhi ya to qatl hai ya haath paon ulti tarah se kaatna hai ya jala-watan karna.

Aur jamhoor ka qaul hai ke yeh aayat kayi ahwaal mein hai, jab daaku qatl-o-gharat dono ke murtakib hote hon toh qabil-e-daar aur gardan-e-zadani hain aur jab sirf qatl sarzad hua ho toh qatl ka badla sirf qatl hai aur agar faqat maal liya ho toh haath paon ultay seedhay kaat diye jayenge aur agar raastay pur-khatar kardiye hon, logon ko khauf-zada kardiya ho aur kisi gunah ke murtakib na huye hon aur giraftar kar liye jayen toh sirf jala-watni hai. Aksar salaf aur aimma ka yahi mazhab hai phir buzurgon ne is mein bhi ikhtilaf kiya hai ke aaya sooli par latka kar yunhi chhor diya jaye ke bhooka pyasa mar jaye? Ya neze waghera se qatl kardiya jaye? Ya pehle qatl kardiya jaye phir sooli par latkaya jaye taake aur logon ko ibrat hasil ho? Aur kya teen din tak sooli par rehne de kar phir utaar liya jaye? Ya yunhi chhor diya jaye lekin tafsir ka yeh mauzoo nahin ke hum aise juzwi ikhtilafat mein padein aur har ek ki daleelein waghera waarid karein. Haan ek hadith mein kuch tafseel-e-saza hai, agar is ki sanad sahih ho toh woh yeh ke huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jab in muharibeen ke baare mein Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se daryaft kiya toh aap ne farmaya "jinhon ne maal churaya aur raaston ko khatarnak banadiya un ke haath toh chori ke badle kaat dijiye aur jis ne qatl aur dehshat-gardi phailayi aur badkari ka irtikab kiya hai, use sooli charha do. Farman hai ke zameen se alag kardiye jayen yani unhein talash kar ke un par had qaim ki jaye ya woh Dar-ul-Islam se bhaag kar kahin chale jayen ya yeh ke ek shehar se dusre shehar aur dusre se teesre shehar unhein bhej diya jata rahe ya yeh ke Islami saltanat se bilkul hi kharij kardiya jaye". Sha'bi toh nikal hi dete the aur Atta Khurasani kehte hain "ek lashkar mein se dusre lashkar mein pahuncha diya jaye yunhi kayi saal tak maara maara phiraya jaye lekin Dar-ul-Islam se bahar na kiya jaye". Abu Hanifa (R.H) aur un ke as-haab kehte hain "use jail khane mein daal diya jaye". Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ka mukhtar qaul yeh hai ke "use us ke shehar se nikal kar kisi dusre shehar ke jail khane mein daal diya jaye". "Aise log duniya mein zaleel-o-razeel aur aakhirat mein bade bhaari azabon mein giraftar honge". Aayat ka yeh tukda toh un logon ki ta'eed karta hai jo kehte hain ke yeh aayat mushrikon ke baare mein utri hai aur musalmanon ke baare woh sahih hadith hai jis mein hai ke huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hum se waise hi ahd liye jaise aurton se liye the ke "hum Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na karein, chori na karein, zina na karein, apni auladon ko qatl na karein, ek dusre ki nafarmani na karein jo is waade ko nibhaye, us ka ajar Allah ke zimme hai aur jo in mein se kisi gunah ke saath aalooda hojaye phir agar use saza hogayi toh woh saza kaffara ban jayegi aur agar Allah Ta'ala ne parda-poshi karli toh is amr ka Allah hi mukhtar hai agar chahe azab kare, agar chahe chhor de".

Aur hadith mein hai "Jis kisi ne koi gunah kiya phir Allah Ta'ala ne usey dhanp liya aur us se chashm-poshi karli toh Allah ki zaat aur uska rahm-o-karam us se bahut buland-o-bala hai, maaf kiye hue jaraim ko dobara karne pe usey dunyawi saza milegi, agar be-tauba mar gaye toh aakhirat ki woh sazayein baqi hain jin ka us waqt sahi tasawwur bhi muhal hai haan tauba naseeb ho jaye toh aur baat hai". Phir tauba karne walon ki nisbat jo farmaya hai "Is ka izhar is surat mein toh saaf hai ke is aayat ko mushrikon ke bare mein nazil shuda mana jaye. Lekin jo musalman maghroor hon aur woh qabze mein aane se pehle tauba kar lein toh un se qatl aur suli aur paon kaatna toh hat jata hai lekin haath ka katna bhi hat jata hai ya nahin, is mein ulama ke do qaul hain, aayat ke zahiri alfaaz se toh yahi maloom hota hai ke sab kuch hat jaye, Sahaba ka amal bhi isi par hai. Chunancha Jariya bin Badr Taimi Basri ne zameen mein fasad kiya, musalmanon se lara, is bare mein chand Quraishiyon ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se sifarish ki, jin mein Hazrat Hasan bin Ali (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Jafar (R.A) bhi thay lekin aap ne usey aman dene se inkar kar diya. Woh Saeed bin Qais Hamdani ke paas aaya, aap ne apne ghar mein usey thahraya aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke paas aaye aur kaha batayiye toh jo Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) se larey aur zameen mein fasad ki sa'i kare phir in aayaton ki (Qabla an taqdiru alaihim) tak tilawat ki toh aap ne farmaya main toh aise shakhs ko aman likh doon ga, Hazrat Saeed ne farmaya yeh Jariya bin Badr hai, chunancha Jariya ne is ke baad un ki madh mein ashaar bhi kahe hain. Qabila Murad ka ek shakhs Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) ke paas Kufa ki masjid mein jahan ke yeh governor thay, ek farz namaz ke baad aaya aur kehne laga ae Ameer-e-Kufa falan bin falan Muradi qabile ka hoon, main ne Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) se larai lari, zameen mein fasad ki koshish ki lekin aap log mujh par qudrat payein, is se pehle main taib ho gaya ab main aap se panah hasil karne wale ki jagah par khara hoon. Is par Hazrat Abu Musa (R.A) kharay ho gaye aur farmaya ae logo! Tum mein se koi ab is tauba ke baad is se kisi tarah ki larai na kare, agar yeh sacha hai toh Alhamdulillah aur yeh jhoota hai toh is ke gunah hi isey halak kar denge. Yeh shakhs ek muddat tak toh theek theek raha lekin phir baghawat kar gaya, Allah ne bhi is ke gunahon ke badle isey gharat kar diya aur yeh maar dala gaya. Ali nami ek Asadi shakhs ne bhi guzar-gahon mein dehshat phaila di, logon ko qatl kiya, maal loota, badshah lashkar aur ri'aya ne harchand isey giraftar karna chaha, lekin yeh haath na laga.

Ek martaba yeh jungle mein tha, ek shakhs ko Quran padhte suna aur woh us waqt yeh aayat tilawat kar raha tha (Qul ya ibadiyallazina asrafu) al-kh, yeh ise sun kar ruk gaya aur us se kaha ae Allah ke bande yeh aayat mujhe dobara suna, us ne phir padhi Allah ki is aawaz ko sun kar woh farmata hai ae mere gunahgar bando tum meri rahmat se na-umeed na ho jao, main sab gunahon ko bakhshne par qadir hoon main Ghafoor-o-Rahim hoon. Is shakhs ne jhat se apni talwar miyan mein kar li, isi waqt sache dil se tauba ki aur subah ki namaz se pehle Madine pahunch gaya, ghusal kiya aur Masjid-e-Nabvi mein namaz-e-subah jamaat ke sath ada ki aur Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ke paas jo log baithe the, un hi mein ek taraf yeh bhi baith gaya. Jab din ka ujala hua to logon ne ise dekh kar pehchan liya ke yeh to saltanat ka baghi, bahut bada mujrim aur mafroor shakhs Ali Asadi hai, sab ne chaha ke ise giraftar kar lein. Us ne kaha suno bhaiyo! Tum mujhe giraftar nahin kar sakte, is liye ke mujh par tumhare qabu paane se pehle hi main to tauba kar chuka hoon balkeh tauba ke baad khud tumhare paas aa gaya hoon, Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne farmaya! Yeh sach kehta hai aur is ka hath pakad kar Marwan bin Hakam ke paas le chale, yeh us waqt Hazrat Muawiya (R.A) ki taraf se Madine ke governor the, wahan pahunch kar farmaya ke yeh Ali Asadi hain, yeh tauba kar chuke hain, is liye ab tum inhe kuch nahin keh sakte. Chunancha kisi ne is ke sath kuch na kiya, jab mujahideen ki ek jamaat Roomiyon se ladne ke liye chali to un mujahidon ke sath yeh bhi ho liye, samundar mein in ki kashti ja rahi thi ke samne se chand kashtiyan Roomiyon ki aa gayin, yeh apni kashti mein se Roomiyon ki gardanein maarne ke liye un ki kashti mein kood gaye, in ki aabdar khara-shigaf talwar ki chamak ki taab Roomi na la sake aur namardi se ek taraf ko bhage, yeh bhi un ke peeche isi taraf chale chunke sara bojh ek taraf ho gaya, is liye kashti ulat gayi jis se woh saare Roomi kuffar halak ho gaye aur Hazrat Ali Asadi bhi doob kar shaheed ho gaye (Allah un par apni rahmaten nazil farmaye).

Ek beganah shakhs ka qatl tamam insanon ka qatl. Farman hai ke Hazrat Adam A.S ke us ladke ke qatl-e-beja ki wajah se hum ne Bani Israel se saaf farma diya, un ki kitab mein likh diya aur un ke liye is hukm ko hukm-e-shar'i kar diya ke "Jo shakhs kisi ek ko bila wajah maar dale, na us ne kisi ko qatl kiya tha na us ne zameen mein fasad phailaya tha, toh goya us ne tamam logon ko qatl kiya, is liye ke Allah ke nazdeek sari makhlooq yaksan hai aur jo kisi be-qasoor shakhs ke qatl se baaz rahe, use haram jaane, toh goya us ne tamam logon ko zindagi di, is liye ke yeh sab log is tarah salamti ke sath rahenge".

Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman R.A ko jab baghi gher lete hain, toh Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A un ke paas jaate hain aur kehte hain main aap ki taraf-dari mein aap ke mukhalifeen se ladne ke liye aaya hoon, aap mulahiza farmayiye ke ab pani sar se uncha ho gaya hai. Yeh sun kar masoom khalifa ne farmaya, kya tum is baat par amada ho ke sab logon ko qatl kar do, jin mein ek main bhi hoon. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne farmaya nahin nahin, farmaya suno ek ko qatl karna aisa bura hai jaise sab ko qatl karna. Jao wapas laut jao, meri yahi khwahish hai Allah tumhein ajar de aur gunah na de, yeh sun kar aap wapas chale gaye aur na lade. Matlab yeh hai ke qatl ka ajar duniya ki barbadi ka ba'is hai aur is ki rok logon ki zindagi ka sabab hai.

Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain "Ek musalman ka khoon halal karne wala tamam logon ka qatil hai aur ek muslim ke khoon ko bachane wala tamam logon ke khoon ko goya bacha raha hai". Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke "Nabi ﷺ ko aur aadil muslim badshah ko qatl karne wale par sari duniya ke insanon ke qatl ka gunah hai aur Nabi aur Imam-e-Aadil ke bazu ko mazboot karna duniya ko zindagi dene ke mutaradif hai" (Ibn Jarir). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke "Ek ko be-wajah maar dalte hi jahannami ho jata hai goya sab ko maar dala".

Mujahid R.H farmate hain "Momin ko be-wajah shar'i maar dalne wala jahannami, dushman-e-Rabb, mal'oon aur mustahiq-e-saza ho jata hai, phir agar woh sab logon ko bhi maar dalta toh is se zyada azab use aur kya hota? Jo qatl se ruk jaye goya ke us ki taraf se sab ki zindagi mehfooz hai". Abdur Rahman R.H farmate hain "Ek qatl ke badle hi us ka khoon halal ho gaya, yeh nahin ke kayi ek ko qatl kare, jab hi woh qisas ke qabil ho, aur jo use zindagi de yani qatil ke wali se dargarzar kare aur us ne goya logon ko zindagi di".

Aur yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke jis ne insaan ki jaan bacha li maslan doobte ko nikal liya, jalte ko bacha liya, kisi ko halakat se hata liya. Maqsad logon ko khoon-e-nahaq se rokna aur logon ki khair-khwahi aur aman-o-aman par amada karna hai. Hazrat Hasan R.H se poocha gaya ke "Kya Bani Israel jis tarah is hukm ke mukallaf the, hum bhi hain, farmaya haan yaqeenan Allah ki qasam!"

Bani Israel ke khoon Allah ke nazdeek hamare khoon se zyada ba-waqat na thay, pas ek shakhs ka be-sabab qatl sab ke qatl ka bojh hai aur ek ki jaan ke bachao ka sawab sab ko bacha lene ke barabar hai". Ek martaba Hazrat Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib R.A ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se darkhwast ki ke Huzoor ﷺ mujhe koi aisi baat batayen ke meri zindagi ba-aaram guzre. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya kya kisi ko maar dalna tumhein pasand hai ya kisi ko bacha lena tumhein mehboob hai? Jawab diya bacha lena, farmaya "bas ab apni islah mein lage raho". Phir farmata hai un ke paas hamare Rasool wazeh daleelein aur roshan ahkaam aur khule mojizaat le kar aaye lekin us ke baad bhi aksar log apni sarkashi aur daraz dasti se baaz na rahe. Bani Qainuqa ke Yahood-o-Bani Quraiza aur Bani Nazeer waghera ko dekh lijiye ke Aus aur Khazraj ke sath mil kar aapas mein ek dusre se ladte thay aur ladai ke baad phir qaidiyon ke fidiye de kar chhudate thay aur maqtool ki diyat ada karte thay. Jis par unhein Quran mein samjhaya gaya ke tum se ahd yeh liya gaya tha ke na to apne walon ke khoon bahao, na unhein des se nikalo lekin tum ne bawajood pukhta iqrar aur mazboot ahd-o-paiman ke us ke khilaf go fidiye ada kiye lekin nikalna bhi to haram tha, us ke kya ma'ani ke kisi hukum ko mano aur kisi se inkar karo, aise logon ko saza yahi hai ke duniya mein ruswa aur zaleel hon aur aakhirat mein sakht-tar azabon ka shikar hon, Allah tumhare aamal se ghafil nahin. (Muharaba) ke ma'ani hukum ke khilaf karna, bar-aks karna, mukhalifat par tal jana hain. Murad us se kufr, daka zani, zameen mein shorish-o-fasad aur tarah tarah ki bad-amni paida karna hai, yahan tak ke salaf ne yeh bhi farmaya hai ke sikke ko tod dena bhi zameen mein fasad machana hai. Quran ki ek aur aayat mein hai jab woh kisi iqtidar ke malik ho jate hain to fasad phaila dete hain aur khet aur nasl ko halak karne lagte hain Allah Ta'ala fasad ko pasand nahin farmata. Yeh aayat mushrikeen ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Is liye ke us mein yeh bhi hai ke jab aisa shakhs un kamon ke baad musalmanon ke hathon mein giraftar hone se pehle hi tauba kar le to phir us par koi muakhaza nahin, bar-khilaf us ke agar musalman un kamon ko kare aur bhag kar kuffar mein ja mile to had-e-shar'i se azaad nahin hota. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain "Yeh aayat mushrikon ke bare mein utri hai, phir un mein se jo koi musalman ke hath aa jane se pehle tauba kar le to jo hukum us par us ke fe'l ke ba'is sabit ho chuka hai woh tal nahin sakta". Fasad aur qatl-o-gharat Hazrat Ubay R.A se marwi hai ke Ahl-e-Kitab ke ek giroh se Rasool Allah ﷺ ka mu'ahida ho gaya tha lekin unhon ne use tod diya aur fasad macha diya. Us par Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ ko ikhtiyar diya ke agar aap chahein to unhein qatl kar dein, chahein to ulte seedhe hath paon katwa dein. Hazrat Sa'ad R.A farmate hain "Yeh Haruriya Khawarij ke bare mein nazil hui hai". Sahih yeh hai ke jo bhi is fe'l ka murtakib ho us ke liye yeh hukum hai.

Chunancha Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke "Qabila-e-Ukl ke aath aadmi Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas aaye, Aap (ﷺ) ne un se farmaya agar tum chaho to hamare charwahon ke sath chale jao, oonton ka doodh aur peshab tumhein milega. Chunancha yeh gaye aur jab un ki bimari jati rahi to unhon ne un charwahon ko maar dala aur oont le kar chalte bane. Huzoor (ﷺ) ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi to Aap (ﷺ) ne Sahaba ko un ke peeche doraya ke unhein pakar layein, chunancha yeh giraftar kiye gaye aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ke samne pesh kiye gaye. Phir un ke hath paon kaat diye gaye aur aankhon mein garam silaiyan pheri gayin aur dhoop mein pare hue tarap tarap kar mar gaye". Muslim mein hai ya to yeh log Ukl ke thay ya Uraina ke. Yeh pani mangte thay magar unhein pani na diya gaya na un ke zakhm dhoye gaye. Unhon ne chori bhi ki thi, qatl bhi kiya tha, iman ke baad kufr bhi kiya tha aur Allah Rasool se larte bhi thay. Unhon ne charwahon ki aankhon mein garam silaiyan bhi pheri thin, Madine ki aab-o-hawa us waqt durust na thi, sarsam ki bimari thi, Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un ke peeche bees Ansari ghursawar bheje thay aur ek khoji tha, jo nishan-e-qadam dekh kar rehbari karta jata tha. Maut ke waqt un ki pyas ke mare yeh halat thi ke zameen chaat rahe thay, inhi ke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai. Ek martaba Hajjaj ne Hazrat Anas (R.A) se sawal kiya ke sab se bari aur sab se sakht saza jo Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne kisi ko di ho, tum bayan karo to Aap (R.A) ne yeh waqia bayan farmaya. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh log Bahrain se aaye thay, bimari ki wajah se un ke rang zard par gaye thay aur pait barh gaye thay to Aap (ﷺ) ne unhein farmaya ke jao oonton mein raho aur un ka doodh aur peshab piyo. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain phir main ne dekha ke Hajjaj ne to is riwayat ko apne mazalim ki daleel bana li tab to mujhe sakht nadamat hui ke main ne is se yeh hadith kyun bayan ki? Aur riwayat mein hai ke un mein se char shakhs to Uraina qabile ke thay aur teen Ukl ke thay, yeh sab tandurust ho gaye to yeh murtad ban gaye. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke raste bhi unhon ne band kar diye thay aur zina kar bhi thay, jab yeh aaye to ab sab ke paas ba-wajah-e-faqeeri pehanne ke kapre tak na thay, yeh qatl-o-gharat kar ke bhag kar apne shehar ko ja rahe thay. Hazrat Jareer (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh apni qoum ke paas pahunchne wale thay jo hum ne unhein ja liya. Woh pani mangte thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate thay, ab to pani ke badle Jahannam ki aag milegi. Is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke aankhon mein silaiyan pherna Allah ko na-pasand aaya, yeh hadith zaeef aur ghareeb hai lekin is se yeh maloom hua ke jo lashkar un murtadon ke giraftar karne ke liye bheja gaya tha, un ke sardar Hazrat Jareer (R.A) thay. Haan is riwayat mein yeh fiqra bilkul munkar hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne un ki aankhon mein silaiyan pherna makrooh rakha.

Is liye ke Sahih Muslim mein yeh majood hai ke unhon ne charwahon ke sath bhi yahi kiya tha, pas yeh us ka badla aur un ka qisas tha jo unhon ne un ke sath kiya tha wahi un ke sath kiya gaya wallahu a'lam. Aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh log Banu Fazarah ke thay, is waqiye ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh saza kisi ko nahin di. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ek ghulam tha, jis ka naam Yasar tha chunke yeh bade achay namazi thay, is liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein azaad kar diya tha aur apne oonton mein unhein bhej diya tha ke yeh un ki nigrani rakhein, inhi ko in murtadon ne qatl kiya aur un ki aankhon mein kaantay gaar kar oont le kar bhaag gaye, jo lashkar unhein giraftar kar ke laya tha, un mein ek shah-zor Hazrat Kurz bin Jabir Fehri thay. Hafiz Abu Bakr bin Marduyah ne is riwayat ke tamam tareeqon ko jama kar diya Allah unhein jazaye khair de. Abu Hamza Abdul Kareem se oonton ke peshab ke bare mein sawal hota hai to aap in muharibeen ka qissa bayan farmatay hain is mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh log munafiqana taur par imaan laye thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Madine ki aab-o-hawa ki namuwafiqat ki shikayat ki thi, jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un ki dagha bazi aur qatl-o-gharat aur irtidad ka ilm hua, to aap ne munadi karayi ke Allah ke lashkariyo uth kharay ho, yeh aawaz suntay hi mujahideen kharay ho gaye, baghair is ke ke koi kisi ka intezar kare in murtad daakuon aur baghiyon ke peechay dauray, khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi un ko rawana kar ke un ke peechay chalay, woh log apni jaye aman mein pohanchne hi ko thay ke sahaba ne unhein gher liya aur un mein se jitne giraftar ho gaye, unhein le kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne pesh kar diya aur yeh aayat utri, un ki jalawatni yahi thi ke unhein hukumat-e-Islam ki hudood se kharij kar diya gaya. Phir un ko ibratnak sazayein di gayin, is ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi ke bhi aaza-e-badan se juda nahin karaye balkay aap ne is se mana farmaya hai, janwaron ko bhi is tarah karna mana hai. Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke qatl ke baad unhein jala diya gaya, baaz kehte hain yeh Banu Saleem ke log thay. Baaz buzurgon ka qaul hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo saza unhein di woh Allah ko pasand na aayi aur is aayat se usay mansookh kar diya. Un ke nazdeek goya is aayat mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is saza se roka gaya hai. Jaise aayat (Afa Allahu Anka) mein aur baaz kehte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne musla karne se yani haath paon kaan naak kaatne se jo muman'at farmayi hai, is hadees se yeh saza mansookh ho gayi lekin yeh zara ghaur talab hai phir yeh bhi sawal talab amr hai ke nasikh ki takheer ki daleel kya hai? Baaz kehte hain hudood-e-Islam muqarrar hon is se pehle ka yeh waqiya hai lekin yeh bhi kuch theek nahin maloom hota, balkay hudood ke taqarrur ke baad ka waqiya maloom hota hai is liye ke is hadees ke ek rawi Hazrat Jareer bin Abdullah hain aur un ka Islam Surah Maidah ke nazil ho chukne ke baad ka hai.

Baaz kehte hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ki aankhon mein garam salaiyan pherni chahi thin lekin yeh aayat utri aur aap apne irade se baaz rahe, lekin yeh bhi durust nahin. Is liye ke Bukhari-o-Muslim mein yeh lafz hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ki aankhon mein salaiyan pherwayin. Muhammad bin Ajlan farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo sakht saza unhein di, us ke inkar mein yeh aayatein utri hain aur un mein sahih saza bayan ki gayi hai jo qatl karne aur haath paon ulti taraf se kaatne aur watan se nikal dene ke hukm par shamil hai chunancha dekh lijiye ke us ke baad phir kisi ki aankhon mein salaiyan pherni sabit nahin, lekin Auza'i kehte hain ke yeh theek nahin ke is aayat mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is fe'l par aap ko danta gaya ho, baat yeh hai ke unhon ne jo kiya tha us ka wahi badla mil gaya, ab aayat nazil hui jis ne ek khaas hukm aise logon ka bayan farmaya aur us mein aankhon mein garam salaiyan pherne ka hukm nahin diya. Is aayat se jamhoor ulama ne daleel pakdi hai ke raston ki bandish kar ke ladna aur shehron mein ladna dono barabar hain kyunke lafz (wa yas'awna fil-ardi fasada) ke hain. Malik, Auza'i, Laith, Shafi'i, Ahmad (Rahimahumullah Ajma'in) ka yahi mazhab hai ke baghi log khwah shehar mein aisa fitna machayen ya beroon-e-shehar, un ki saza yahi hai, balkeh Imam Malik to yahan tak farmate hain ke agar koi shakhs dusre ko us ke ghar mein is tarah dhoka dahi se maar dale to use pakad liya jaye aur use qatl kar diya jaye aur khud Imam-e-Waqt in kamon ko az-khud kare ga, na ke maqtool ke awliya ke haath mein yeh kaam hon balkeh agar woh darguzar karna chahein to bhi un ke ikhtiyar mein nahin balkeh yeh jurm, be-wasta hukumat-e-Islamia ka hai. Imam Abu Hanifa ka mazhab yeh nahin, woh kehte hain ke "Muharaba usi waqt mana jaye ga jabke shehar ke bahar aise fasad koi kare, kyunke shehar mein to imdad ka pahunchna mumkin hai, raston mein yeh baat namumkin si hai". Jo saza in muharibeen ki bayan hui hai us ke bare mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain "Jo shakhs musalmanon par talwar uthaye, raston ko pur-khatar bana de, Imam-ul-Muslimeen ko in teenon sazaon mein se jo saza dena chahe us ka ikhtiyar hai". Yahi qaul aur bhi bahut son ka hai aur is tarah ka ikhtiyar aisi hi aur aayaton ke ahkaam mein bhi maujood hai jaise mohrim agar shikar khele to us ka badla shikar ke barabar ki qurbani ya masakeen ka khana hai ya us ke barabar rozay rakhna hai, bimari ya sar ki takleef ki wajah se halat-e-ehram mein sar mundwane aur khilaf-e-ehram kaam karne wale ke fidiye mein bhi rozay ya sadqa ya qurbani ka hukm hai. Qasam ke kaffaray mein darmiyani darja ka khana dein maskeenon ka ya un ka kapda ya ek ghulam ko azaad karna hai. To jis tarah yahan in suraton mein se kisi ek ke pasand kar lene ka ikhtiyar hai, isi tarah aise muharib, murtad logon ki saza bhi ya to qatl hai ya haath paon ulti tarah se kaatna hai ya jala-watan karna.

Aur jamhoor ka qaul hai ke yeh aayat kayi ahwaal mein hai, jab daaku qatl-o-gharat dono ke murtakib hote hon toh qabil-e-daar aur gardan-e-zadani hain aur jab sirf qatl sarzad hua ho toh qatl ka badla sirf qatl hai aur agar faqat maal liya ho toh haath paon ultay seedhay kaat diye jayenge aur agar raastay pur-khatar kardiye hon, logon ko khauf-zada kardiya ho aur kisi gunah ke murtakib na huye hon aur giraftar kar liye jayen toh sirf jala-watni hai. Aksar salaf aur aimma ka yahi mazhab hai phir buzurgon ne is mein bhi ikhtilaf kiya hai ke aaya sooli par latka kar yunhi chhor diya jaye ke bhooka pyasa mar jaye? Ya neze waghera se qatl kardiya jaye? Ya pehle qatl kardiya jaye phir sooli par latkaya jaye taake aur logon ko ibrat hasil ho? Aur kya teen din tak sooli par rehne de kar phir utaar liya jaye? Ya yunhi chhor diya jaye lekin tafsir ka yeh mauzoo nahin ke hum aise juzwi ikhtilafat mein padein aur har ek ki daleelein waghera waarid karein. Haan ek hadith mein kuch tafseel-e-saza hai, agar is ki sanad sahih ho toh woh yeh ke huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jab in muharibeen ke baare mein Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se daryaft kiya toh aap ne farmaya "jinhon ne maal churaya aur raaston ko khatarnak banadiya un ke haath toh chori ke badle kaat dijiye aur jis ne qatl aur dehshat-gardi phailayi aur badkari ka irtikab kiya hai, use sooli charha do. Farman hai ke zameen se alag kardiye jayen yani unhein talash kar ke un par had qaim ki jaye ya woh Dar-ul-Islam se bhaag kar kahin chale jayen ya yeh ke ek shehar se dusre shehar aur dusre se teesre shehar unhein bhej diya jata rahe ya yeh ke Islami saltanat se bilkul hi kharij kardiya jaye". Sha'bi toh nikal hi dete the aur Atta Khurasani kehte hain "ek lashkar mein se dusre lashkar mein pahuncha diya jaye yunhi kayi saal tak maara maara phiraya jaye lekin Dar-ul-Islam se bahar na kiya jaye". Abu Hanifa (R.H) aur un ke as-haab kehte hain "use jail khane mein daal diya jaye". Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ka mukhtar qaul yeh hai ke "use us ke shehar se nikal kar kisi dusre shehar ke jail khane mein daal diya jaye". "Aise log duniya mein zaleel-o-razeel aur aakhirat mein bade bhaari azabon mein giraftar honge". Aayat ka yeh tukda toh un logon ki ta'eed karta hai jo kehte hain ke yeh aayat mushrikon ke baare mein utri hai aur musalmanon ke baare woh sahih hadith hai jis mein hai ke huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hum se waise hi ahd liye jaise aurton se liye the ke "hum Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na karein, chori na karein, zina na karein, apni auladon ko qatl na karein, ek dusre ki nafarmani na karein jo is waade ko nibhaye, us ka ajar Allah ke zimme hai aur jo in mein se kisi gunah ke saath aalooda hojaye phir agar use saza hogayi toh woh saza kaffara ban jayegi aur agar Allah Ta'ala ne parda-poshi karli toh is amr ka Allah hi mukhtar hai agar chahe azab kare, agar chahe chhor de".

Aur hadith mein hai "Jis kisi ne koi gunah kiya phir Allah Ta'ala ne usey dhanp liya aur us se chashm-poshi karli toh Allah ki zaat aur uska rahm-o-karam us se bahut buland-o-bala hai, maaf kiye hue jaraim ko dobara karne pe usey dunyawi saza milegi, agar be-tauba mar gaye toh aakhirat ki woh sazayein baqi hain jin ka us waqt sahi tasawwur bhi muhal hai haan tauba naseeb ho jaye toh aur baat hai". Phir tauba karne walon ki nisbat jo farmaya hai "Is ka izhar is surat mein toh saaf hai ke is aayat ko mushrikon ke bare mein nazil shuda mana jaye. Lekin jo musalman maghroor hon aur woh qabze mein aane se pehle tauba kar lein toh un se qatl aur suli aur paon kaatna toh hat jata hai lekin haath ka katna bhi hat jata hai ya nahin, is mein ulama ke do qaul hain, aayat ke zahiri alfaaz se toh yahi maloom hota hai ke sab kuch hat jaye, Sahaba ka amal bhi isi par hai. Chunancha Jariya bin Badr Taimi Basri ne zameen mein fasad kiya, musalmanon se lara, is bare mein chand Quraishiyon ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se sifarish ki, jin mein Hazrat Hasan bin Ali (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Jafar (R.A) bhi thay lekin aap ne usey aman dene se inkar kar diya. Woh Saeed bin Qais Hamdani ke paas aaya, aap ne apne ghar mein usey thahraya aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke paas aaye aur kaha batayiye toh jo Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) se larey aur zameen mein fasad ki sa'i kare phir in aayaton ki (Qabla an taqdiru alaihim) tak tilawat ki toh aap ne farmaya main toh aise shakhs ko aman likh doon ga, Hazrat Saeed ne farmaya yeh Jariya bin Badr hai, chunancha Jariya ne is ke baad un ki madh mein ashaar bhi kahe hain. Qabila Murad ka ek shakhs Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) ke paas Kufa ki masjid mein jahan ke yeh governor thay, ek farz namaz ke baad aaya aur kehne laga ae Ameer-e-Kufa falan bin falan Muradi qabile ka hoon, main ne Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) se larai lari, zameen mein fasad ki koshish ki lekin aap log mujh par qudrat payein, is se pehle main taib ho gaya ab main aap se panah hasil karne wale ki jagah par khara hoon. Is par Hazrat Abu Musa (R.A) kharay ho gaye aur farmaya ae logo! Tum mein se koi ab is tauba ke baad is se kisi tarah ki larai na kare, agar yeh sacha hai toh Alhamdulillah aur yeh jhoota hai toh is ke gunah hi isey halak kar denge. Yeh shakhs ek muddat tak toh theek theek raha lekin phir baghawat kar gaya, Allah ne bhi is ke gunahon ke badle isey gharat kar diya aur yeh maar dala gaya. Ali nami ek Asadi shakhs ne bhi guzar-gahon mein dehshat phaila di, logon ko qatl kiya, maal loota, badshah lashkar aur ri'aya ne harchand isey giraftar karna chaha, lekin yeh haath na laga.

Ek martaba yeh jungle mein tha, ek shakhs ko Quran padhte suna aur woh us waqt yeh aayat tilawat kar raha tha (Qul ya ibadiyallazina asrafu) al-kh, yeh ise sun kar ruk gaya aur us se kaha ae Allah ke bande yeh aayat mujhe dobara suna, us ne phir padhi Allah ki is aawaz ko sun kar woh farmata hai ae mere gunahgar bando tum meri rahmat se na-umeed na ho jao, main sab gunahon ko bakhshne par qadir hoon main Ghafoor-o-Rahim hoon. Is shakhs ne jhat se apni talwar miyan mein kar li, isi waqt sache dil se tauba ki aur subah ki namaz se pehle Madine pahunch gaya, ghusal kiya aur Masjid-e-Nabvi mein namaz-e-subah jamaat ke sath ada ki aur Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ke paas jo log baithe the, un hi mein ek taraf yeh bhi baith gaya. Jab din ka ujala hua to logon ne ise dekh kar pehchan liya ke yeh to saltanat ka baghi, bahut bada mujrim aur mafroor shakhs Ali Asadi hai, sab ne chaha ke ise giraftar kar lein. Us ne kaha suno bhaiyo! Tum mujhe giraftar nahin kar sakte, is liye ke mujh par tumhare qabu paane se pehle hi main to tauba kar chuka hoon balkeh tauba ke baad khud tumhare paas aa gaya hoon, Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne farmaya! Yeh sach kehta hai aur is ka hath pakad kar Marwan bin Hakam ke paas le chale, yeh us waqt Hazrat Muawiya (R.A) ki taraf se Madine ke governor the, wahan pahunch kar farmaya ke yeh Ali Asadi hain, yeh tauba kar chuke hain, is liye ab tum inhe kuch nahin keh sakte. Chunancha kisi ne is ke sath kuch na kiya, jab mujahideen ki ek jamaat Roomiyon se ladne ke liye chali to un mujahidon ke sath yeh bhi ho liye, samundar mein in ki kashti ja rahi thi ke samne se chand kashtiyan Roomiyon ki aa gayin, yeh apni kashti mein se Roomiyon ki gardanein maarne ke liye un ki kashti mein kood gaye, in ki aabdar khara-shigaf talwar ki chamak ki taab Roomi na la sake aur namardi se ek taraf ko bhage, yeh bhi un ke peeche isi taraf chale chunke sara bojh ek taraf ho gaya, is liye kashti ulat gayi jis se woh saare Roomi kuffar halak ho gaye aur Hazrat Ali Asadi bhi doob kar shaheed ho gaye (Allah un par apni rahmaten nazil farmaye).

Taqwa qurbat-e-Ilahi ki bunyad hai. Taqway ka hukum ho raha hai aur woh bhi ita'at se mila hua. Matlab yeh hai ke Allah ke mana karda kamon se jo shakhs ruka rahe, us ki taraf qurbat yani nazdiki talash kare. Waseele ke yahi ma'ani Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se manqool hain. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Hazrat Wa'il (R.H), Hazrat Hasan (R.H), Hazrat Ibn-e-Zaid (R.H) aur bahut se mufassireen se bhi marwi hai. Qatada (R.H) farmate hain Allah ki ita'at aur us ki marzi ke a'maal karne se us se qareeb hote jao. Ibn-e-Zaid (R.H) ne yeh aayat bhi parhi (Ula'ika-lladhina yad'una yabtaghuna ila rabbihimu-l-wasilata ayyuhum aqrabu wa yarjuna rahmatahu wa yakhafuna 'adhabahu inna 'adhab-e-rabbika kana mahdhura) (Surah Al-Isra: 57). Jinhein yeh pukarte hain woh toh khud hi apne Rab ki nazdiki ki justuju mein lage hue hain. In a'imma ne waseele ke jo ma'ani is aayat mein kiye hain us par sab mufassireen ka ijma hai, is mein kisi ek ko bhi ikhtilaf nahin. Imam Jarir (R.H) ne is par ek Arabi sher bhi warid kiya hai, jis mein waseela ma'ani qurbat aur nazdeek ke musta'mal hua hai. Waseele ke ma'ani us cheez ke hain jis se maqsood ke hasil karne ki taraf pahuncha jaye aur waseela Jannat ki us a'la aur behtareen manzil ka naam hai jo Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki jagah hai. Arsh se bahut zyada qareeb yahi darja hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai "Jo shakhs azan sun kar dua (Allahumma rabba hadhihi-d-da'wati-t-tammati) ilakh, parhe us ke liye meri shafa'at halal ho jati hai". Muslim ki hadith mein hai "Jab tum azan suno toh jo mu'azzin keh raha ho, wahi tum bhi kaho, phir mujh par durood bhejo, ek durood ke badle tum par Allah Ta'ala das rahmaten nazil farmaye ga. Phir mere liye Allah Ta'ala se waseela talab karo, woh Jannat ka ek darja hai, jise sirf ek hi banda paye ga, mujhe umeed hai ke woh banda main hi hoon. Pas jis ne mere liye waseela talab kiya, us ke liye meri shafa'at wajib ho gayi". Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai "Jab tum mujh par durood parho toh mere liye waseela mango, poocha gaya ke waseela kya hai? Farmaya Jannat ka sab se buland darja jise sirf ek shakhs hi paye ga aur mujhe umeed hai ke woh shakhs main hoon". Tabrani mein hai "Tum Allah se dua karo ke Allah mujhe waseela ata farmaye, jo shakhs duniya mein mere liye yeh dua kare ga, main us par gawah ya us ka sifarishi Qayamat ke din ban jaunga". Aur hadith mein hai "Waseele se bada darja Jannat mein koi nahin. Lehaza tum Allah Ta'ala se mere liye waseele ke milne ki dua karo". Ek ghareeb aur munkar hadith mein itni zyadati bhi hai ke logon ne aap (ﷺ) se poocha ke waseele mein aap ke sath aur kaun honge? Toh aap (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Fatima (R.A) aur Hasan (R.A), Hussain (R.A) ka naam liya. Ek aur bahut ghareeb riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne Kufa ke mimbar par farmaya ke Jannat mein do moti hain, ek safed ek zard, zard toh Arsh tale hai aur Maqam-e-Mahmood safed moti ka hai, jis mein sattar hazar bala khane hain, jin mein se har har ghar teen meel ka hai. Us ke dariche darwaza takht waghera sab ke sab goya ek hi jad se hain.

Isi ka naam waseela hai, yeh Muhammad (ﷺ) aur aap ki Ahl-e-Bait ke liye hai. Taqwa ka yani mamnoo'aat se rukne ka aur hukm-e-ahkaam ke baja lane ka hukm de kar phir farmaya ke " Is ki raah mein jihad karo, mushrikeen-o-kuffar ko jo is ke dushman hain is ke deen se alag hain, is ki seedhi raah se bhatak gaye hain, unhein qatl karo. Aise mujahideen ba-muraad hain, falah-o-salah sa'adat-o-sharafat inhi ke liye hain, jannat ke buland bala khane aur Allah ki beshumar ne'matein inhi ke liye hain, yeh is jannat mein pahunchaye jayenge, jahan maut-o-faut nahin, jahan kami aur nuqsan nahin, jahan hameshangi ki jawani aur abadi sehat aur dawami aish-o-ishrat hai ". Apne doston ka nek anjam bayan farma kar ab apne dushmanon ka bura natija zahir farmata hai ke " Aise sakht aur bade azab unhein ho rahe honge ke agar us waqt roo-e-zameen ke maalik hon balkay utna hi aur bhi ho to un azabon se bachne ke liye bator badle ke sab de dalein lekin agar aisa ho bhi jaye to bhi un se ab fidiya qabool nahin balkay jo azab un par hain, woh daimi aur abadi aur dawami hain ". Jaise aur jagah hai ke " Jahannami jab jahannam mein se nikalna chahenge to phir dobara isi mein lauta diye jayenge. Bhadakti hui aag ke sholon ke sath upar aa jayenge ke daroghe unhein lohay ke hathore maar maar kar phir qa'r-e-jahannam mein gira denge. Garz un daimi azabon se chhutkara muhaal hai ". Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain " Ek jahannami ko laya jayega phir us se poocha jayega ke ae Ibn-e-Adam kaho tumhari jagah kaisi hai ? Woh kahega badtareen aur sakht tareen. (Al-Ma'idah: 37) Ya'ni woh Jahannam se azad hona chahenge lekin woh azad hone wale nahin. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Yazid ka khayal yahi tha ke Jahannam mein se koi bhi na niklega is liye yeh sun kar unhon ne Hazrat Jabir R.A se kaha ke mujhe aur logon par toh afsos nahin, haan aap sahabiyon par afsos hai ke aap bhi Quran ke ulat kehte hain. Us waqt mujhe bhi gussa aa gaya tha, is par un ke sathiyon ne mujhe danta lekin Hazrat Jabir R.A bahut hi haleem-ut-tab'a the, unhon ne sab ko rok diya aur samjhe samjhaya ke Quran mein jin ka Jahannam se na nikalne ka zikr hai woh kuffar hain.
