Allah Ta'ala ba'az logon ko Jahannam mein un ki khataon ki wajah se dalega aur jab tak chahe unhein Jahannam mein hi rakhe ga, phir jab chahe ga unhein is se azad kar de ga. Hazrat Yazid farmate hain ke is ke baad se mera khayal theek ho gaya. Hazrat Talq bin Habib R.H kehte hain main bhi munkir-e-shafa'at tha yahan tak ke Hazrat Jabir R.A se mila aur apne da'we ke suboot mein jin jin ayaton mein Jahannam ke hamesha rehne walon ka zikr hai sab parh dalin, toh aap ne sun kar farmaya! Ae Talq! Kya tum apne tain Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ilm mein mujh se afzal jante ho? Suno jitni ayatein tum ne parhi hain woh sab ahl-e-Jahannam ke bare mein hain ya'ni mushrikon ke liye. Lekin woh log niklenge, yeh woh log hain jo mushrik na the lekin gunahgar the, gunahon ke badle saza bhugat li phir Jahannam se nikal diye gaye. Hazrat Jabir R.A ne yeh sab farma kar apne dono hathon se apne dono kanon ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya yeh dono behre ho jayen agar main ne Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh na suna ho ke Jahannam mein dakhil hone ke baad bhi log is mein se nikale jayenge aur woh Jahannam se azad kar diye jayenge, Quran ki yeh ayatein jis tarah tum parhte ho hum bhi parhte hi hain.

Taqwa qurbat-e-Ilahi ki bunyad hai. Taqway ka hukum ho raha hai aur woh bhi ita'at se mila hua. Matlab yeh hai ke Allah ke mana karda kamon se jo shakhs ruka rahe, us ki taraf qurbat yani nazdiki talash kare. Waseele ke yahi ma'ani Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se manqool hain. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Hazrat Wa'il (R.H), Hazrat Hasan (R.H), Hazrat Ibn-e-Zaid (R.H) aur bahut se mufassireen se bhi marwi hai. Qatada (R.H) farmate hain Allah ki ita'at aur us ki marzi ke a'maal karne se us se qareeb hote jao. Ibn-e-Zaid (R.H) ne yeh aayat bhi parhi (Ula'ika-lladhina yad'una yabtaghuna ila rabbihimu-l-wasilata ayyuhum aqrabu wa yarjuna rahmatahu wa yakhafuna 'adhabahu inna 'adhab-e-rabbika kana mahdhura) (Surah Al-Isra: 57). Jinhein yeh pukarte hain woh toh khud hi apne Rab ki nazdiki ki justuju mein lage hue hain. In a'imma ne waseele ke jo ma'ani is aayat mein kiye hain us par sab mufassireen ka ijma hai, is mein kisi ek ko bhi ikhtilaf nahin. Imam Jarir (R.H) ne is par ek Arabi sher bhi warid kiya hai, jis mein waseela ma'ani qurbat aur nazdeek ke musta'mal hua hai. Waseele ke ma'ani us cheez ke hain jis se maqsood ke hasil karne ki taraf pahuncha jaye aur waseela Jannat ki us a'la aur behtareen manzil ka naam hai jo Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki jagah hai. Arsh se bahut zyada qareeb yahi darja hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai "Jo shakhs azan sun kar dua (Allahumma rabba hadhihi-d-da'wati-t-tammati) ilakh, parhe us ke liye meri shafa'at halal ho jati hai". Muslim ki hadith mein hai "Jab tum azan suno toh jo mu'azzin keh raha ho, wahi tum bhi kaho, phir mujh par durood bhejo, ek durood ke badle tum par Allah Ta'ala das rahmaten nazil farmaye ga. Phir mere liye Allah Ta'ala se waseela talab karo, woh Jannat ka ek darja hai, jise sirf ek hi banda paye ga, mujhe umeed hai ke woh banda main hi hoon. Pas jis ne mere liye waseela talab kiya, us ke liye meri shafa'at wajib ho gayi". Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai "Jab tum mujh par durood parho toh mere liye waseela mango, poocha gaya ke waseela kya hai? Farmaya Jannat ka sab se buland darja jise sirf ek shakhs hi paye ga aur mujhe umeed hai ke woh shakhs main hoon". Tabrani mein hai "Tum Allah se dua karo ke Allah mujhe waseela ata farmaye, jo shakhs duniya mein mere liye yeh dua kare ga, main us par gawah ya us ka sifarishi Qayamat ke din ban jaunga". Aur hadith mein hai "Waseele se bada darja Jannat mein koi nahin. Lehaza tum Allah Ta'ala se mere liye waseele ke milne ki dua karo". Ek aur bahut ghareeb riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne Kufa ke mimbar par farmaya ke Jannat mein do moti hain, ek safed ek zard, zard toh Arsh tale hai aur Maqam-e-Mahmood safed moti ka hai, jis mein sattar hazar bala khane hain, jin mein se har har ghar teen meel ka hai. Us ke dariche darwaza takht waghera sab ke sab goya ek hi jad se hain.

Isi ka naam waseela hai, yeh Muhammad (ﷺ) aur aap ki Ahl-e-Bait ke liye hai. Taqwa ka yani mamnoo'aat se rukne ka aur hukm-e-ahkaam ke baja lane ka hukm de kar phir farmaya ke " Is ki raah mein jihad karo, mushrikeen-o-kuffar ko jo is ke dushman hain is ke deen se alag hain, is ki seedhi raah se bhatak gaye hain, unhein qatl karo. Jaise aur jagah hai ke " Jahannami jab jahannam mein se nikalna chahenge to phir dobara isi mein lauta diye jayenge. Islam ne unhein theek-thaak kardiya. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke sab se pehle Duwaik nami ek Khuza'i shakhs ke haath chori ke ilzam mein Quraish ne kaatay thay, us ne Ka'bay ka ghulam churaya tha aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke choron ne us ke paas rakh diya tha. Ba'az fuqaha ka khayal hai ke chori ki cheez ki koi had nahin, thodi ho ya bahut, mehfooz jagah se li ho ya ghair-mehfooz jagah se, bahar-surat haath kaata jayega. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke yeh aayat aam hai to mumkin hai is qaul ka yahi matlab ho aur dusray matalab bhi mumkin hain. Ek daleel un hazrat ki yeh hadith bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala chor par la'nat kare ke anda churata hai aur haath katwata hai, rassi churayi hai aur haath kaata jata hai. Jamhoor ulama ka mazhab yeh hai ke chori ke maal ki had muqarrar hai, go is ke taqarrur mein ikhtilaf hai. Imam Malik (R.H) kehte hain teen dirham sikkay walay khalis ya un ki qeemat ya zyada ki koi cheez, chunancha Sahih Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ek dhaal ki chori par haath kaatna marwi hai aur us ki qeemat itni hi thi. Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne utranj ke chor ke haath kaatay thay jabke woh teen dirham ki qeemat ka tha. Hazrat Usman (R.A) ka fe'l goya Sahaba (R.A) ka ijma-e-sakooti hai aur is se yeh bhi sabit hota hai ke phal ke chor ke haath bhi kaatay jayenge. Hanafia isay nahin maante aur un ke nazdeek chori ke maal ka das dirham ki qeemat ka hona zaroori hai. Is mein Shafia ka ikhtilaf hai pao ya dinar ke taqarrur mein. Imam Shafi (R.H) ka farman hai ke pao dinar ki qeemat ki cheez ho ya us se zyada. Un ki daleel Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Chor ka haath pao dinar mein, phir jo us se oopar ho us mein kaatna chahiye. Muslim ki ek hadith mein hai: Chor ka haath na kaata jaye magar pao dinar phir us se oopar mein. Pas yeh hadith is maslay ka saaf faisla kardeti hai aur jis hadith mein teen dirham mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se haath kaatne ko farmana marwi hai woh is ke khilaf nahin is liye ke us waqt dinar barah dirham ka tha. Pas asal chauthai dinar hai na ke teen dirham. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A), Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A), Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (R.A) bhi yahi farmate hain. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H), Lais bin Sa'ad (R.H), Auza'i (R.H), Shafi (R.H), Ishaq bin Rahwiya (R.H), Abu Saur (R.H), Dawood bin Ali Zahiri (R.H) ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Ek riwayat mein Imam Ishaq bin Rahwiya (R.H) aur Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) se marwi hai ke khwah rub'a dinar ho khwah teen dirham, dono hi haath kaatne ka nisab hai. Musnad Ahmad ki ek hadith mein hai: Chauthai dinar ki chori par haath kaat do, us se kam mein nahin. Us waqt dinar barah dirham ka tha to chauthai dinar teen dirham ka hua.

Nasa'i mein hai chor ka haath dhaal ki qeemat se kam mein na kaata jaye. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se poocha gaya dhaal ki qeemat kya hai? Farmaya pao dinar. Pas in tamam ahadees se saaf saaf saabit ho raha hai ke das dirham shart lagani khuli ghalti hai wallahu a'lam. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) aur un ke sathiyon ne kaha hai ke jis dhaal ke baare mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein chor ka haath kaata gaya us ki qeemat nau dirham thi chunancha Abu Bakr bin Shaiba mein yeh majood hai aur Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se. Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) aur Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) mukhalifat karte rahe hain aur hudood ke baare mein ikhtiyar par amal karna chahiye aur ehtiyat ziyadati mein hai is liye das dirham nisaab hum ne muqarrar kiya hai. Ba'az salaf kehte hain ke das dirham ya ek dinar had hai. Ali ibn Mas'ud (R.A), Ibrahim Nakh'i (R.H), Abu Ja'far Baqir (R.H) se yahi marwi hai. Sa'eed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain paanchon na kaati jayen magar paanch dinar pachaas dirham ki qeemat ke barabar ke maal ki chori mein. Zahiriya ka mazhab hai ke har thodi bahut cheez ki chori par haath katega unhein jamhoor ne yeh jawab diya hai ke awwalan to yeh itlaq mansookh hai lekin yeh jawab theek nahin is liye tareekh-e-naskh ka koi yaqeeni amal nahin. Doosra jawab yeh hai ke ande se murad lohay ka anda hai aur rassi se murad kashtiyon ke qeemti rassay hain. Teesra jawab yeh hai ke yeh farman ba'etibar-e-natijay ke hai yani in choti choti mamooli si cheezon se chori shuru karta hai aakhir qeemti cheezein churane lagta hai aur haath kaata jata hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bator-e-afsos ke upar chor ko nadim karne ke farma rahe hain ke kaisa razeel aur be-khauf insaan hai ke mamooli cheez ke liye haath jaisi ne'amat se mehroom ho jata hai. Mazkoor hai ke Abu Al-Ala Ma'arri jab Baghdad mein aaya to us ne is baare mein bade aitraz shuru kiye aur us ke jee mein yeh khayal baith gaya ke mere is aitraz ka jawab kisi se nahin ho sakta to us ne ek sher kaha ke agar haath kaat dala jaye to diyat mein paanch sau dilwayen aur phir isi haath ko pao dinar ki chori par katwa dein yeh aisa tanaquz hai ke hamari samajh mein to aata hi nahin khamosh hain aur kehte hain ke hamara Maula hamein jahannam se bachaye. Lekin jab us ki yeh bakwas mashhoor hui to ulama-e-kiram ne use jawab dena chaha to yeh bhaag gaya phir jawab bhi mashhoor kar diye gaye. Qazi Abdul Wahab (R.H) ne jawab diya tha ke jab tak haath ameen tha tab tak sameen yani qeemti tha aur jab yeh khayin ho gaya is ne chori kar li to us ki qeemat ghat gayi. Ba'az buzurgon ne ise qadray tafseel se jawab diya tha ke is se shariyat ki kamil hikmat zahir hoti hai aur duniya ka aman-o-aman qaim hota hai, jo kisi ka haath be-wajah kaat dene ka hukum diya taake chori ka darwaza is khauf se band ho jaye. Pas yeh to ain hikmat hai agar chori mein bhi itni raqam ki qaid lagayi jati to choriyon ka insidad na hota. Yeh badla hai un ke kartoot ka. Munasib maqam yahi hai ke jis uzw se us ne doosre ko nuqsan pahunchaya hai, usi uzw par saza ho.

Taake unhein kaafi ibrat haasil ho aur dusron ko bhi tanbeeh ho jaye. Allah apne inteqam mein Ghalib hai aur apne ahkaam mein Hakeem hai. Jo shakhs apne gunah ke baad tauba karle aur Allah ki taraf jhuk jaye, Allah usey apna gunah maaf farma diya karta hai. Haan jo maal chori mein kisi ka le liya hai chunke woh us shakhs ka haq hai, lehaza sirf tauba karne se woh maaf nahin hota ta-waqtike woh maal jis ka hai usey na pahunchaye ya us ke badle poori poori qeemat ada kare. Jamhoor-e-Aimma ka yahi qaul hai, sirf Imam Abu Hanifa kehte hain ke "Jab chori par haath kat gaya aur maal talaf ho chuka hai toh us ka badla dena us par zaroori nahin". Dar-e-Qutni waghera ki ek mursal hadith mein hai ke "Ek chor Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne laya gaya, jis ne chadar churayi thi, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us se farmaya, mera khayal hai ke tum ne chori nahin ki hogi, unhon ne kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne chori ki hai toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya isey le jao aur is ka haath kaat do, jab haath kat chuka aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tauba karo, unhon ne tauba ki, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah ne tumhari tauba qabool farma li" (R.A). Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke "Hazrat Umar bin Samurah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aakar kehte hain ke mujh se chori ho gayi hai toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe paak kijiye, falan qabeele walon ka oont main ne chura liya hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us qabeele walon ke paas aadmi bhej kar daryaft farmaya toh unhon ne kaha ke hamara oont toh zaroor gum ho gaya hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukm diya aur un ka haath kaat dala gaya, woh haath katne par kehne lage, Allah ka shukr hai jis ne tujhe mere jism se alag kar diya, tu ne mere saare jism ko jahannam mein le jana chaha tha" (R.A). Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke "Ek aurat ne kuch zevar chura liye, un logon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas usey pesh kiya, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us ka dahina haath kaatne ka hukm diya, jab kat chuka toh us aurat ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya meri tauba bhi hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum toh aisi paak saaf ho gayin ke goya aaj hi paida huin". Is par aayat (Faman taaba) nazil hui. Musnad mein itna aur bhi hai ke us waqt us aurat walon ne kaha hum is ka fidiya dene ko tayyar hain lekin Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isey qabool na farmaya aur haath kaatne ka hukm de diya. Yeh aurat Makhzoom qabeele ki thi aur is ka yeh waqia Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi maujood hai ke chunke yeh bade gharane ki aurat thi, logon mein badi tashweesh phaili aur irada kiya ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is ke bare mein kuch kahein sunein, yeh waqia Ghazwa-e-Fatah mein hua tha, bil-akhir yeh tay hua ke Hazrat Usama bin Zaid jo Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke bahut pyare hain, woh un ke bare mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sifarish karein, Hazrat Usama ne jab is ki sifarish ki toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sakht nagawar guzra aur gusse se farmaya! Usama tu Allah ki hudood mein se ek had ke bare mein sifarish kar raha hai? Ab toh Hazrat Usama bahut ghabraye aur kehne lage mujh se badi khata hui, mere liye Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) istighfar kijiye.

Shaam ke waqt Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek khutba sunaya jis mein Allah Ta'ala ki poori hamd-o-sana ke baad farmaya ke tum se pehle ke log isi khaslat par tabah-o-barbad ho gaye ke un mein se jab koi shareef shakhs bada aadmi chori karta tha toh use chhod dete the aur jab koi mamooli aadmi hota toh us par had jaari karte. Us Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai agar Fatima bint-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi chori karein toh main un ke bhi haath kaat doon. Phir hukum diya aur us aurat ka haath kaat diya gaya. Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain phir us biwi sahiba ne tauba ki aur poori aur pukhta tauba ki aur nikah kar liya, phir woh mere paas apne kisi kaam kaaj ke liye aati thin aur main us ki haajat Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se bayan kar diya karti thi (R.A). Muslim mein hai ek aurat logon se asbaab udhaar leti thi, phir inkaar kar jaya karti thi, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us ke haath kaatne ka hukum diya. Aur riwayat mein hai yeh zevar udhaar leti thi aur us ka haath kaatne ka hukum Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ko hua tha. Kitab-ul-Ahkaam mein aisi bahut si hadeesein waarid hain jo chori se talluq rakhti hain. Falhamdulillah. Jamee-e-mamlook ka maalik saari kainat ka haqeeqi baadshah, saccha haakim, Allah hi hai. Jis ke kisi hukum ko koi rok nahin sakta. Jis ke kisi irade ko koi badal nahin sakta, jise chahe bakhshe jise chahe azaab kare. Har har cheez par woh qadir hai us ki qudrat-e-kaamil aur us ka qabza saccha hai.

Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum toh aisi paak saaf ho gayin ke goya aaj hi paida huin". Is par aayat (Faman taaba) nazil hui. Musnad mein itna aur bhi hai ke us waqt us aurat walon ne kaha hum is ka fidiya dene ko tayyar hain lekin Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isey qabool na farmaya aur haath kaatne ka hukm de diya. Yeh aurat Makhzoom qabeele ki thi aur is ka yeh waqia Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi maujood hai ke chunke yeh bade gharane ki aurat thi, logon mein badi tashweesh phaili aur irada kiya ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is ke bare mein kuch kahein sunein, yeh waqia Ghazwa-e-Fatah mein hua tha, bil-akhir yeh tay hua ke Hazrat Usama bin Zaid jo Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke bahut pyare hain, woh un ke bare mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sifarish karein, Hazrat Usama ne jab is ki sifarish ki toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sakht nagawar guzra aur gusse se farmaya! Usama tu Allah ki hudood mein se ek had ke bare mein sifarish kar raha hai? Ab toh Hazrat Usama bahut ghabraye aur kehne lage mujh se badi khata hui, mere liye Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) istighfar kijiye.

Shaam ke waqt Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek khutba sunaya jis mein Allah Ta'ala ki poori hamd-o-sana ke baad farmaya ke tum se pehle ke log isi khaslat par tabah-o-barbad ho gaye ke un mein se jab koi shareef shakhs bada aadmi chori karta tha toh use chhod dete the aur jab koi mamooli aadmi hota toh us par had jaari karte. Us Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai agar Fatima bint-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi chori karein toh main un ke bhi haath kaat doon. Phir hukum diya aur us aurat ka haath kaat diya gaya. Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain phir us biwi sahiba ne tauba ki aur poori aur pukhta tauba ki aur nikah kar liya, phir woh mere paas apne kisi kaam kaaj ke liye aati thin aur main us ki haajat Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se bayan kar diya karti thi (R.A). Muslim mein hai ek aurat logon se asbaab udhaar leti thi, phir inkaar kar jaya karti thi, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us ke haath kaatne ka hukum diya. Aur riwayat mein hai yeh zevar udhaar leti thi aur us ka haath kaatne ka hukum Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ko hua tha. Kitab-ul-Ahkaam mein aisi bahut si hadeesein waarid hain jo chori se talluq rakhti hain. Falhamdulillah. Jamee-e-mamlook ka maalik saari kainat ka haqeeqi baadshah, saccha haakim, Allah hi hai. Jis ke kisi hukum ko koi rok nahin sakta. Jis ke kisi irade ko koi badal nahin sakta, jise chahe bakhshe jise chahe azaab kare. Har har cheez par woh qadir hai us ki qudrat-e-kaamil aur us ka qabza saccha hai.

Ahkam-e-Jurm-o-Saza Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ki qira'at mein (faqta'u aimanahuma) hai lekin yeh qira'at shaz hai, go amal isi par hai lekin woh amal us qira'at ki wajah se nahin balkay dusray dalail ki bina par hai. Chor ke haath kaatne ka tareeqa Islam se pehle bhi tha, Islam ne isay tafseel-war aur munazzam kardiya, isi tarah qasamat, diyat, faraiz ke masail bhi pehle thay lekin ghair-munazzam aur adhooray. Islam ne unhein theek-thaak kardiya. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke sab se pehle Duwaik nami ek Khuza'i shakhs ke haath chori ke ilzam mein Quraish ne kaatay thay, us ne Ka'bay ka ghulam churaya tha aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke choron ne us ke paas rakh diya tha. Ba'az fuqaha ka khayal hai ke chori ki cheez ki koi had nahin, thodi ho ya bahut, mehfooz jagah se li ho ya ghair-mehfooz jagah se, bahar-surat haath kaata jayega. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke yeh aayat aam hai to mumkin hai is qaul ka yahi matlab ho aur dusray matalab bhi mumkin hain. Ek daleel un hazrat ki yeh hadith bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala chor par la'nat kare ke anda churata hai aur haath katwata hai, rassi churayi hai aur haath kaata jata hai. Jamhoor ulama ka mazhab yeh hai ke chori ke maal ki had muqarrar hai, go is ke taqarrur mein ikhtilaf hai. Imam Malik (R.H) kehte hain teen dirham sikkay walay khalis ya un ki qeemat ya zyada ki koi cheez, chunancha Sahih Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ek dhaal ki chori par haath kaatna marwi hai aur us ki qeemat itni hi thi. Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne utranj ke chor ke haath kaatay thay jabke woh teen dirham ki qeemat ka tha. Hazrat Usman (R.A) ka fe'l goya Sahaba (R.A) ka ijma-e-sakooti hai aur is se yeh bhi sabit hota hai ke phal ke chor ke haath bhi kaatay jayenge. Hanafia isay nahin maante aur un ke nazdeek chori ke maal ka das dirham ki qeemat ka hona zaroori hai. Is mein Shafia ka ikhtilaf hai pao ya dinar ke taqarrur mein. Imam Shafi (R.H) ka farman hai ke pao dinar ki qeemat ki cheez ho ya us se zyada. Un ki daleel Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Chor ka haath pao dinar mein, phir jo us se oopar ho us mein kaatna chahiye. Muslim ki ek hadith mein hai: Chor ka haath na kaata jaye magar pao dinar phir us se oopar mein. Pas yeh hadith is maslay ka saaf faisla kardeti hai aur jis hadith mein teen dirham mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se haath kaatne ko farmana marwi hai woh is ke khilaf nahin is liye ke us waqt dinar barah dirham ka tha. Pas asal chauthai dinar hai na ke teen dirham. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A), Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A), Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (R.A) bhi yahi farmate hain. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H), Lais bin Sa'ad (R.H), Auza'i (R.H), Shafi (R.H), Ishaq bin Rahwiya (R.H), Abu Saur (R.H), Dawood bin Ali Zahiri (R.H) ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Ek riwayat mein Imam Ishaq bin Rahwiya (R.H) aur Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) se marwi hai ke khwah rub'a dinar ho khwah teen dirham, dono hi haath kaatne ka nisab hai. Musnad Ahmad ki ek hadith mein hai: Chauthai dinar ki chori par haath kaat do, us se kam mein nahin. Us waqt dinar barah dirham ka tha to chauthai dinar teen dirham ka hua.

Nasa'i mein hai chor ka haath dhaal ki qeemat se kam mein na kaata jaye. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se poocha gaya dhaal ki qeemat kya hai? Farmaya pao dinar. Pas in tamam ahadees se saaf saaf saabit ho raha hai ke das dirham shart lagani khuli ghalti hai wallahu a'lam. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) aur un ke sathiyon ne kaha hai ke jis dhaal ke baare mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein chor ka haath kaata gaya us ki qeemat nau dirham thi chunancha Abu Bakr bin Shaiba mein yeh majood hai aur Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se. Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) aur Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) mukhalifat karte rahe hain aur hudood ke baare mein ikhtiyar par amal karna chahiye aur ehtiyat ziyadati mein hai is liye das dirham nisaab hum ne muqarrar kiya hai. Ba'az salaf kehte hain ke das dirham ya ek dinar had hai. Ali ibn Mas'ud (R.A), Ibrahim Nakh'i (R.H), Abu Ja'far Baqir (R.H) se yahi marwi hai. Sa'eed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain paanchon na kaati jayen magar paanch dinar pachaas dirham ki qeemat ke barabar ke maal ki chori mein. Zahiriya ka mazhab hai ke har thodi bahut cheez ki chori par haath katega unhein jamhoor ne yeh jawab diya hai ke awwalan to yeh itlaq mansookh hai lekin yeh jawab theek nahin is liye tareekh-e-naskh ka koi yaqeeni amal nahin. Doosra jawab yeh hai ke ande se murad lohay ka anda hai aur rassi se murad kashtiyon ke qeemti rassay hain. Teesra jawab yeh hai ke yeh farman ba'etibar-e-natijay ke hai yani in choti choti mamooli si cheezon se chori shuru karta hai aakhir qeemti cheezein churane lagta hai aur haath kaata jata hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bator-e-afsos ke upar chor ko nadim karne ke farma rahe hain ke kaisa razeel aur be-khauf insaan hai ke mamooli cheez ke liye haath jaisi ne'amat se mehroom ho jata hai. Mazkoor hai ke Abu Al-Ala Ma'arri jab Baghdad mein aaya to us ne is baare mein bade aitraz shuru kiye aur us ke jee mein yeh khayal baith gaya ke mere is aitraz ka jawab kisi se nahin ho sakta to us ne ek sher kaha ke agar haath kaat dala jaye to diyat mein paanch sau dilwayen aur phir isi haath ko pao dinar ki chori par katwa dein yeh aisa tanaquz hai ke hamari samajh mein to aata hi nahin khamosh hain aur kehte hain ke hamara Maula hamein jahannam se bachaye. Lekin jab us ki yeh bakwas mashhoor hui to ulama-e-kiram ne use jawab dena chaha to yeh bhaag gaya phir jawab bhi mashhoor kar diye gaye. Qazi Abdul Wahab (R.H) ne jawab diya tha ke jab tak haath ameen tha tab tak sameen yani qeemti tha aur jab yeh khayin ho gaya is ne chori kar li to us ki qeemat ghat gayi. Ba'az buzurgon ne ise qadray tafseel se jawab diya tha ke is se shariyat ki kamil hikmat zahir hoti hai aur duniya ka aman-o-aman qaim hota hai, jo kisi ka haath be-wajah kaat dene ka hukum diya taake chori ka darwaza is khauf se band ho jaye. Pas yeh to ain hikmat hai agar chori mein bhi itni raqam ki qaid lagayi jati to choriyon ka insidad na hota. Yeh badla hai un ke kartoot ka. Munasib maqam yahi hai ke jis uzw se us ne doosre ko nuqsan pahunchaya hai, usi uzw par saza ho.

Taake unhein kaafi ibrat haasil ho aur dusron ko bhi tanbeeh ho jaye. Allah apne inteqam mein Ghalib hai aur apne ahkaam mein Hakeem hai. Jo shakhs apne gunah ke baad tauba karle aur Allah ki taraf jhuk jaye, Allah usey apna gunah maaf farma diya karta hai. Haan jo maal chori mein kisi ka le liya hai chunke woh us shakhs ka haq hai, lehaza sirf tauba karne se woh maaf nahin hota ta-waqtike woh maal jis ka hai usey na pahunchaye ya us ke badle poori poori qeemat ada kare. Jamhoor-e-Aimma ka yahi qaul hai, sirf Imam Abu Hanifa kehte hain ke "Jab chori par haath kat gaya aur maal talaf ho chuka hai toh us ka badla dena us par zaroori nahin". Dar-e-Qutni waghera ki ek mursal hadith mein hai ke "Ek chor Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne laya gaya, jis ne chadar churayi thi, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us se farmaya, mera khayal hai ke tum ne chori nahin ki hogi, unhon ne kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne chori ki hai toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya isey le jao aur is ka haath kaat do, jab haath kat chuka aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tauba karo, unhon ne tauba ki, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah ne tumhari tauba qabool farma li" (R.A). Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke "Hazrat Umar bin Samurah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aakar kehte hain ke mujh se chori ho gayi hai toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe paak kijiye, falan qabeele walon ka oont main ne chura liya hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us qabeele walon ke paas aadmi bhej kar daryaft farmaya toh unhon ne kaha ke hamara oont toh zaroor gum ho gaya hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukm diya aur un ka haath kaat dala gaya, woh haath katne par kehne lage, Allah ka shukr hai jis ne tujhe mere jism se alag kar diya, tu ne mere saare jism ko jahannam mein le jana chaha tha" (R.A). Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke "Ek aurat ne kuch zevar chura liye, un logon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas usey pesh kiya, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us ka dahina haath kaatne ka hukm diya, jab kat chuka toh us aurat ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya meri tauba bhi hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum toh aisi paak saaf ho gayin ke goya aaj hi paida huin". Is par aayat (Faman taaba) nazil hui. Usama tu Allah ki hudood mein se ek had ke bare mein sifarish kar raha hai? Ab toh Hazrat Usama bahut ghabraye aur kehne lage mujh se badi khata hui, mere liye Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) istighfar kijiye.

Us Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai agar Fatima bint-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi chori karein toh main un ke bhi haath kaat doon. Aur riwayat mein hai yeh zevar udhaar leti thi aur us ka haath kaatne ka hukum Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ko hua tha. Kitab-ul-Ahkaam mein aisi bahut si hadeesein waarid hain jo chori se talluq rakhti hain. Falhamdulillah. Jamee-e-mamlook ka maalik saari kainat ka haqeeqi baadshah, saccha haakim, Allah hi hai. Jis ke kisi hukum ko koi rok nahin sakta. Jis ke kisi irade ko koi badal nahin sakta, jise chahe bakhshe jise chahe azaab kare. Har har cheez par woh qadir hai us ki qudrat-e-kaamil aur us ka qabza saccha hai.

Jhoot sunne aur kehne ke aadi log: In aayaton mein un logon ki muzammat bayan ho rahi hai, jo raye, qiyas aur khwahish-e-nafsani ko Allah ki shariat par muqaddam rakhte hain. Allah-o-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki itaat se nikal kar kufr ki taraf daudte bhagte rehte hain. Goya yeh log zabani imaan ke dawe karein lekin unka dil imaan se khali hai. Munafiqon ki yahi halat hai ke zaban ke khare, dil ke khote aur yahi khaslat Yahudiyon ki hai jo Islam aur Ahl-e-Islam ke dushman hain. Yeh jhoot ko maze maze se sunte hain aur dil khol kar qabool karte hain. Lekin sach se bhagte hain, balkay nafrat karte hain aur jo log aap ki majlis mein nahin aate yeh yahan ki wahan pahunchate hain. Unki taraf se jasusi karne ko aate hain. Phir nalaiqi yeh karte hain ke yeh baat ko badal dala karte hain, matlab kuch ho, le kar kuch udte hain, irade yahi hain ke agar tumhari khwahish ke mutabiq kahe to maan lo, tabiyat ke khilaf ho to door raho. Kaha kya gaya hai ke yeh aayat un Yahudiyon ke bare mein utri thi jin mein ek ko dusre ne qatl kar diya tha, ab kehne lage chalo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas chalein agar aap diyat jurmane ka hukum dein to manzoor kar lenge aur agar qisas badle ko farmayein to nahin manenge. Lekin zyada sahih baat yeh hai ke woh ek zina-kar ko le kar aaye the. Unki kitab Taurat mein darasal hukum to yeh tha ke shadi shuda zani ko sangsar kiya jaye. Lekin unhon ne ise badal dala tha aur sau kode maar kar, munh kala kar ke, ulta gadha sawar kar ke ruswai kar ke chhod dete the. Jab hijrat ke baad un mein se koi zina-kari ke jurm mein pakda gaya to yeh kehne lage aao Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas chalein aur aap se uske bare mein sawal karein, agar aap bhi wahi farmayein jo hum karte hain to ise qabool karenge aur Allah ke haan bhi yeh hamari sanad ho jayegi aur agar rajam ko farmayein ge to nahin manenge. Chunancha yeh aaye aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya ke hamare ek mard aurat ne badkari ki hai, unke bare mein aap kya irshad farmate hain? Aap ne farmaya tumhare haan Taurat mein kya hukum hai? Unhon ne kaha hum to ise ruswa karte hain aur kode maar kar chhod dete hain. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (R.A) ne farmaya, jhoot kehte hain, Taurat mein sangsar ka hukum hai. Lao Taurat pesh karo, unhon ne Taurat kholi lekin aayat-e-rajam par haath rakh kar aage peeche ki sab ibarat padh sunayi. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) samajh gaye aur aap ne farmaya apne haath ko to hata, haath hataya to sangsar karne ki aayat maujood thi, ab to unhein bhi iqrar karna pada. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hukum se zaniyon ko sangsar kar diya gaya, Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain "Main ne dekha ke woh zani us aurat ko pattharon se bachane ke liye uske aade aa jata tha" (Bukhari, Muslim) aur sanad se marwi hai ke Yahudiyon ne kaha "Hum to ise kala munh kar ke kuch maar peet kar chhod dete hain".

Aur aayat ke zahir hone ke baad unhon ne kaha, hai toh yahi hukm lekin hum ne toh ise chupaya tha, jo parh raha tha usi ne rajam ki aayat par apna haath rakh diya tha, jab uska haath uthwaya toh aayat par uchat-ti hui nazar parh gayi. In dono ke rajam karne walon mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) bhi maujood thay, ek aur riwayat mein hai ke un logon ne apne aadmi bhej kar aap ko bulwaya tha, apne madrasay mein gaddi par aap ko bithaya tha aur jo ab Taurat aap ke samne parh raha tha, woh un ka bahut bara aalim tha. Ek riwayat mein hai ke aap ne un se qasam de kar poocha tha ke tum Taurat mein shadi shuda zani ki kya saza paate ho? Toh unhon ne yahi jawab diya tha lekin ek naujawan kuch na bola, khamosh hi khara raha, aap ne us ki taraf dekh kar khaas use dobara qasam di aur jawab manga, us ne kaha jab aap aisi qasmein de rahe hain toh main jhoot na bolunga, waqai Taurat mein in logon ki saza sangsari hai. Aap ne farmaya achha phir yeh bhi sach sach batao ke pehle pehal is rajam ko tum ne kyun aur kis par se uraya? Us ne kaha Hazrat hamare kisi badshah ke rishtedar, bare aadmi ne zina kari ki. Us ki azmat aur badshah ki haibat ke maaray use rajam karo warna ise bhi chhoro. Aakhir hum ne mil mila kar yeh tay kiya ke bajaye rajam ke is qisam ki koi saza muqarrar kar di jaye. Chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Taurat ke hukm ko jaari kiya aur isi bare mein aayat (Inna Anzalna) ilakh, utri. Pas Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi in ahkaam ke jaari karne walon mein se hain (Ahmad, Abu Dawood). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek shakhs ko Yahudi kala munh kiye le ja rahe thay aur use koray bhi maar rakhe thay, toh aap ne bula kar un se majra poocha unhon ne kaha ke is ne zina kiya hai. Aap ne farmaya ke kya zani ki yahi saza tumhare haan hai? Kaha haan. Aap ne un ke ek aalim ko bula kar use sakht qasam de kar poocha toh us ne kaha ke agar aap aisi qasam na dete toh main hargiz na batata, baat yeh hai ke hamare haan darasal zina kari ki saza sangsari hai lekin chunke ameer-umara aur shurafa logon mein yeh badkari barh gayi thi aur unhein is qisam ki saza deni hum ne munasib na jaani, is liye unhein toh chor dete thay aur Allah ka hukm mara na jaye is liye ghareeb ghurba, kam haisiyat logon ko rajam kara dete thay phir hum ne raye zani ki ke aao koi aisi saza tajweez karo ke shareef-o-ghair shareef, ameer-ghareeb par sab par yaksan jaari ho sakay chunancha hamara sab ka is baat par ittefaq hua ke munh kaalay kar dein aur koray lagayein. Yeh sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukm diya ke in dono ko sangsar karo chunancha unhein rajam kar diya gaya aur aap ne farmaya ae Allah main pehla woh shakhs hoon jis ne tere ek murda hukm ko zinda kiya. Is par aayat (Yaa Ayyuhar-Rasulu La Yahzun-kalladhina Yusari'una Fil-Kufri Minalladhina Qalu Aamanna Bi-Afwahihim Wa Lam Tu'min Qulubuhum) (5:41) utri.

(Al-Ma'idah: 41) se (Wa man lam yahkum bima anzalallahu fa-ula'ika humul-kafirun) (Al-Ma'idah: 44) tak nazil hui. Inhi Yahudiyon ke bare mein. Aur ayat mein hai ke Allah ke nazil karda hukm ke mutabiq faisla na karne wale zalim hain aur ayat mein hai (fasiq hain) (Muslim wagaira aur riwayat mein hai "waqia-e-zina Fadak mein hua tha aur wahan ke Yahudiyon ne Madine Sharif ke Yahudiyon ko likh kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se puchwaya tha jo aalim unka aaya uska naam Ibn-e-Suriya tha, yeh aankh ka bhenga tha, aur uske sath dusra aalim bhi tha. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jab unhein qasam di to dono ne qaul diya tha, Aap ne unhein kaha tha, tumhein us Allah ki qasam jis ne Bani Israel ke liye pani mein raah kar di thi aur abr ka saya un par kiya tha aur Firauniyon se bacha liya tha aur Mann-o-Salwa utara tha. Is qasam se woh chaunk gaye aur aapas mein kehne lage badi zabardast qasam hai, is mauqe par jhoot bolna theek nahin to kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Taurat mein yeh hai ke buri nazar se dekhna bhi misl-e-zina ke hai aur gale lagana bhi aur bosa lena bhi, phir agar char gawah is baat ke hon ke unhon ne dukhool-o-khurooj dekha hai jaisa ke silai surma-dani mein jati aati hai to rajam wajib ho jata hai. Aap ne farmaya yahi masla hai phir hukm diya aur unhein rajam kara diya gaya". Is par ayat (Fa-in ja'uka fahkum bainahum au a'rid 'anhum, wa in tu'rid 'anhum falan yadurruka shai'an, wa in hakamta fahkum bainahum bil-qist, innallaha yuhibbul-muqsitina) (Al-Ma'idah: 42), utri (Abu Dawood wagaira). Ek riwayat mein jo do aalim samne laye gaye the, yeh dono Suriya ke ladke the. Tark-e-hadd ka sabab is riwayat mein Yahudiyon ki taraf se yeh bayan hua hai ke jab hum mein saltanat na rahi to hum ne apne admiyon ki jaan leni munasib na samjhi phir Aap ne gawahon ko bulwa kar gawahi li jinhon ne bayan diya ke hum ne apni aankhon se unhein is burai mein dekha hai, jis tarah surma-dani mein silai hoti hai.

Darasal Taurat waghera ka mangwana un ke aalimon ko bulwana, yeh sab unhein ilzam dene ke liye na tha, na is liye tha ke woh isi ke manne ke mukallaf hain, nahin balkay khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman wajib-ul-amal hai, is se maqsad ek toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sachai ka izhar tha ke Allah ki wahi se aap ne yeh maloom kar liya ke un ki Taurat mein bhi hukm-e-rajm majood hai aur yahi nikla, dusre un ki ruswai ke unhein pehle ke inkar ke baad iqrar karna pada aur duniya par zahir ho gaya ke yeh log farman-e-Ilahi ko chupa lene wale aur apni raye qiyas par amal karne wale hain aur is liye bhi ke yeh log sache dil se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas is liye nahin aaye thay ke aap ki farman-bardari karein balkay mehez is liye aaye thay ke agar aap ko bhi apne ijma ke muwafiq payenge toh ittehad kar lenge warna hargiz qabool na karenge, isi liye farman hai ke "Jinhein Allah gumrah kar de toh un ko kisi qisam se rah-e-rast aane ka ikhtiyar nahin hai un ke gande dilon ko pak karne ka Allah ka irada nahin, yeh duniya mein zaleel-o-khwar honge aur aakhirat mein dakhil-e-nar honge. Yeh batil ko kaan laga kar maze le kar sunne wale hain aur rishwat jaisi haram cheez ko din dahade khane wale hain, bhala un ke najis dil kaise pak honge? Aur un ki duayein Allah kaise sunega? Agar yeh tere paas aayein toh tujhe ikhtiyar hai ke un ke faisle kar ya na kar agar tu un se munh pher le jab bhi yeh tera kuch nahin bigad sakte kyunke un ka qasd itteba-e-haq nahin balkay apni khwahishon ki pairwi hai". Baaz buzurg kehte hain yeh aayat mansookh hai is aayat se (Wa anihkum bainahum bima anzalallahu wala tattabi' ahwa'ahum wahzarhum an yaftinuka 'an ba'di ma anzalallahu ilaika) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 49). Phir farmaya "Agar tu un mein faisle kare toh adl-o-insaf ke sath kar, goya khud zalim hain aur adl se hate hue hain aur maan lo ke Allah Ta'ala adil logon se mohabbat rakhta hai". Phir in ki khabasat, bad-batini aur sarkashi bayan ho rahi hai ke "Ek taraf toh is Kitabullah ko chhod rakha hai, jis ki tabedari aur haqaniyat ke khud qail hain, dusri taraf is janib jhuk rahe hain, jise nahin mante aur jise jhoot mashhoor kar rakha hai, phir is mein bhi niyat bad hai ke agar wahan se hamari khwahish ke mutabiq hukm milega toh le lenge, warna chhod chhad denge". Yeh farmaya ke yeh kaise teri farman-bardari karenge? Unhon ne toh Taurat ko bhi chhod rakha hai, jis mein Allah ke ahkamat hone ka iqrar nahin bhi hai lekin phir bhi beimani kar ke is se phir jate hain. Phir is Taurat ki midhat-o-tareef bayan farmayi jo us ne apne barguzida Rasool Hazrat Musa bin Imran (A.S / Alaihis Salam) par nazil farmayi thi ke is mein hidayat-o-nooraniyat thi. Anbiya (A.S / Alaihimas Salam) jo Allah ke zer-e-farman thay, isi par faisle karte rahe, Yahudiyon mein isi ke ahkam jari karte rahe, tabdeeli aur tehreef se bache rahe, Rabbani yani aabid, ulama aur ahbar yani zi-ilm log bhi isi raush par rahe.

Kyunke unhein yeh Pak Kitab sonpi gayi thi aur is ke izhar ka aur is par amal karne ka unhein hukum diya gaya tha aur woh is par gawah-o-shahid thay. Ab tumhein chahiye ke bajuz Allah ke kisi aur se na daro. Haan qadam qadam aur lamha lamha par khauf rakho aur meri aayaton ko thore thore mol farokht na kiya karo. Jaan lo ke Allah ki wahi ka hukum jo na maane woh kafir hai. Is mein do qaul hain jo abhi bayan honge Insha'Allah. In aayaton ka ek shaan-e-nuzool bhi sun lijiye. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke aise logon ko is aayat mein to kafir kaha, dusri mein zalim, teesri mein fasiq. Baat yeh hai ke Yahudiyon ke do giroh thay, ek ghalib tha, dusra maghloob. Un ki aapas mein is baat par sulah hui thi ke ghalib, zi-izzat firqe ka koi shakhs agar maghloob zaleel firqe ke kisi shakhs ko qatl kar dale to pachaas wasq diyat de aur zaleel logon mein se koi aziz ko qatl kar de to ek sau wasq diyat de. Yehi riwaj un mein chala aa raha tha. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine mein aaye, is ke baad ek waqiya aisa hua ke in neeche wale Yahudiyon mein se kisi ne kisi oonche Yahudi ko maar dala. Yahan se aadmi gaya ke lao sau wasq dilwao, wahan se jawab mila ke yeh sareeh na-insafi hai ke hum dono ek hi qabile ke, ek hi deen ke, ek hi nasab ke, ek hi shehar ke phir hamari diyat kam aur tumhari zyada? Hum chunke ab tak tumhare dabe hue thay, is na-insafi ko badil-e-nakhwasta bardasht karte rahe lekin ab jab ke Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jaise aadil badshah yahan aa gaye hain hum tumhein utni hi diyat denge jitni tum hamein do. Is baat par idhar udhar se aastein charh gayin, phir aapas mein yeh baat tay hui ke achha is jhagde ka faisla Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) karenge. Lekin oonchi qoum ke logon ne aapas mein jab mashwara kiya to un ke samajhdaron ne kaha dekho is se hath dho rakho ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) koi na-insafi pe mabni hukum karein. Yeh to sareeh zyadti hai ke hum aadhi dein aur poori lein aur filwaqia un logon ne dab kar ise manzoor kiya tha jo tum ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum aur salis muqarrar kiya hai to yaqeenan tumhara yeh haq mara jayega. Kisi ne raye di ke achha yun karo, kisi ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas chupke se bhej do, woh maloom kar aaye ke aap faisla kya karenge? Agar hamari himayat mein hua tab to bahut achha chalo aur un se haq hasil kar aao aur agar khilaf hua to phir alag thalag hi achhe hain. Chunancha Madina ke chand munafiqon ko unhon ne jasoos bana kar Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas bheja. Is se pehle ke woh yahan pahunchein Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein utaar kar apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko in dono firqon ke bad iradon se mutla'a farma diya (Abu Dawood). Ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh dono qabile Banu Nazeer aur Banu Quraiza thay. Banu Nazeer ki poori diyat thi aur Banu Quraiza ki aadhi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dono ki diyat yaksan dene ka faisla sadir farmaya. Ek riwayat hai ke Qurzi agar kisi Nazri ko qatl kar dale to us se qisas lete thay lekin is ke khilaf mein qisas tha hi nahin sau wasq diyat thi.

Yeh bahut mumkin hai ke idhar yeh waqia hua, idhar zina ka qissa waqia hua, jis ka tafseeli bayan guzar chuka hai un dono par yeh aayatein nazil huin, Wallahu A'lam. Haan ek baat aur hai jis se is dusri shaan-e-nuzool ki taqwiyat hoti hai woh yeh ke is ke baad hi farmaya hai aayat (Wa katabna alaihim fiha annannafsa binnafsi wal-aina bil-aini wal-anfa bil-anfi wal-uzuna bil-uzuni was-sinna bissinni wal-jurooha qisasun faman tasaddaqa bihi fahuwa kaffaratullahu waman lam yahkum bima anzalallahu fa-ulaika humuz-zalimun) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 45) yani hum ne Yahudiyon par Taurat mein yeh hukm farz kar diya tha ke jaan ke ewaz jaan, aankh ke ewaz aankh. Wallahu A'lam. Phir unhein kaafir kaha gaya jo Allah ki shariat aur us ki utari hui wahi ke mutabiq faisle aur hukm na karein, go yeh aayat shaan-e-nuzool ke aitbar se baqol mufassireen Ahl-e-Kitab ke bare mein hai lekin hukm ke aitbar se har shakhs ko shamil hai. Bani Israel ke bare mein utri aur is ummat ka bhi yahi hukm hai. Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke rishwat haram hai aur rishwat-sitani ke baad kisi shar'i masle ke khilaf fatwa dena kufr hai. Suddi farmate hain jis ne wahi-e-Ilahi ke khilaf amdan fatwa diya, janne ke bawajood us ke khilaf kiya woh kafir hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jis ne Allah ke farman se inkar kiya, us ka yeh hukm hai aur jis ne inkar to na kiya lekin us ke mutabiq na kaha woh zalim aur fasiq hai, khwah Ahl-e-Kitab ho khwah koi aur. Sha'bi farmate hain "Musalmanon mein jis ne Kitab ke khilaf fatwa diya woh kafir hai aur Yahudiyon mein diya ho to zalim hai aur Nasraniyon mein diya ho to fasiq hai". Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain "Is ka kufr is aayat ke sath hai". Ta'oos farmate hain "Is ka kufr us ke kufr jaisa nahin jo sire se Allah ke Rasool, Quran aur farishton ka munkir ho". Ata farmate hain "Kufr (chupana) kufr se kam hai isi tarah zulm-o-fisq ke bhi adna-o-a'la darje hain. Is kufr se woh millat-e-Islam se phir jane wala nahin ho jata". Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain "Is se murad woh kufr nahin jis ki taraf tum ja rahe ho".

Jhoot sunne aur kehne ke aadi log: In aayaton mein un logon ki muzammat bayan ho rahi hai, jo raye, qiyas aur khwahish-e-nafsani ko Allah ki shariat par muqaddam rakhte hain. Allah-o-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki itaat se nikal kar kufr ki taraf daudte bhagte rehte hain. Goya yeh log zabani imaan ke dawe karein lekin unka dil imaan se khali hai. Munafiqon ki yahi halat hai ke zaban ke khare, dil ke khote aur yahi khaslat Yahudiyon ki hai jo Islam aur Ahl-e-Islam ke dushman hain. Yeh jhoot ko maze maze se sunte hain aur dil khol kar qabool karte hain. Lekin sach se bhagte hain, balkay nafrat karte hain aur jo log aap ki majlis mein nahin aate yeh yahan ki wahan pahunchate hain. Unki taraf se jasusi karne ko aate hain. Phir nalaiqi yeh karte hain ke yeh baat ko badal dala karte hain, matlab kuch ho, le kar kuch udte hain, irade yahi hain ke agar tumhari khwahish ke mutabiq kahe to maan lo, tabiyat ke khilaf ho to door raho. Kaha kya gaya hai ke yeh aayat un Yahudiyon ke bare mein utri thi jin mein ek ko dusre ne qatl kar diya tha, ab kehne lage chalo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas chalein agar aap diyat jurmane ka hukum dein to manzoor kar lenge aur agar qisas badle ko farmayein to nahin manenge. Lekin zyada sahih baat yeh hai ke woh ek zina-kar ko le kar aaye the. Unki kitab Taurat mein darasal hukum to yeh tha ke shadi shuda zani ko sangsar kiya jaye. Lekin unhon ne ise badal dala tha aur sau kode maar kar, munh kala kar ke, ulta gadha sawar kar ke ruswai kar ke chhod dete the. Jab hijrat ke baad un mein se koi zina-kari ke jurm mein pakda gaya to yeh kehne lage aao Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas chalein aur aap se uske bare mein sawal karein, agar aap bhi wahi farmayein jo hum karte hain to ise qabool karenge aur Allah ke haan bhi yeh hamari sanad ho jayegi aur agar rajam ko farmayein ge to nahin manenge. Chunancha yeh aaye aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya ke hamare ek mard aurat ne badkari ki hai, unke bare mein aap kya irshad farmate hain? Aap ne farmaya tumhare haan Taurat mein kya hukum hai? Unhon ne kaha hum to ise ruswa karte hain aur kode maar kar chhod dete hain. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (R.A) ne farmaya, jhoot kehte hain, Taurat mein sangsar ka hukum hai. Lao Taurat pesh karo, unhon ne Taurat kholi lekin aayat-e-rajam par haath rakh kar aage peeche ki sab ibarat padh sunayi. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) samajh gaye aur aap ne farmaya apne haath ko to hata, haath hataya to sangsar karne ki aayat maujood thi, ab to unhein bhi iqrar karna pada. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hukum se zaniyon ko sangsar kar diya gaya, Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain "Main ne dekha ke woh zani us aurat ko pattharon se bachane ke liye uske aade aa jata tha" (Bukhari, Muslim) aur sanad se marwi hai ke Yahudiyon ne kaha "Hum to ise kala munh kar ke kuch maar peet kar chhod dete hain".

Aur aayat ke zahir hone ke baad unhon ne kaha, hai toh yahi hukm lekin hum ne toh ise chupaya tha, jo parh raha tha usi ne rajam ki aayat par apna haath rakh diya tha, jab uska haath uthwaya toh aayat par uchat-ti hui nazar parh gayi. In dono ke rajam karne walon mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) bhi maujood thay, ek aur riwayat mein hai ke un logon ne apne aadmi bhej kar aap ko bulwaya tha, apne madrasay mein gaddi par aap ko bithaya tha aur jo ab Taurat aap ke samne parh raha tha, woh un ka bahut bara aalim tha. Ek riwayat mein hai ke aap ne un se qasam de kar poocha tha ke tum Taurat mein shadi shuda zani ki kya saza paate ho? Toh unhon ne yahi jawab diya tha lekin ek naujawan kuch na bola, khamosh hi khara raha, aap ne us ki taraf dekh kar khaas use dobara qasam di aur jawab manga, us ne kaha jab aap aisi qasmein de rahe hain toh main jhoot na bolunga, waqai Taurat mein in logon ki saza sangsari hai. Aap ne farmaya achha phir yeh bhi sach sach batao ke pehle pehal is rajam ko tum ne kyun aur kis par se uraya? Us ne kaha Hazrat hamare kisi badshah ke rishtedar, bare aadmi ne zina kari ki. Us ki azmat aur badshah ki haibat ke maaray use rajam karo warna ise bhi chhoro. Aakhir hum ne mil mila kar yeh tay kiya ke bajaye rajam ke is qisam ki koi saza muqarrar kar di jaye. Chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Taurat ke hukm ko jaari kiya aur isi bare mein aayat (Inna Anzalna) ilakh, utri. Pas Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi in ahkaam ke jaari karne walon mein se hain (Ahmad, Abu Dawood). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek shakhs ko Yahudi kala munh kiye le ja rahe thay aur use koray bhi maar rakhe thay, toh aap ne bula kar un se majra poocha unhon ne kaha ke is ne zina kiya hai. Darasal Taurat waghera ka mangwana un ke aalimon ko bulwana, yeh sab unhein ilzam dene ke liye na tha, na is liye tha ke woh isi ke manne ke mukallaf hain, nahin balkay khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman wajib-ul-amal hai, is se maqsad ek toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sachai ka izhar tha ke Allah ki wahi se aap ne yeh maloom kar liya ke un ki Taurat mein bhi hukm-e-rajm majood hai aur yahi nikla, dusre un ki ruswai ke unhein pehle ke inkar ke baad iqrar karna pada aur duniya par zahir ho gaya ke yeh log farman-e-Ilahi ko chupa lene wale aur apni raye qiyas par amal karne wale hain aur is liye bhi ke yeh log sache dil se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas is liye nahin aaye thay ke aap ki farman-bardari karein balkay mehez is liye aaye thay ke agar aap ko bhi apne ijma ke muwafiq payenge toh ittehad kar lenge warna hargiz qabool na karenge, isi liye farman hai ke "Jinhein Allah gumrah kar de toh un ko kisi qisam se rah-e-rast aane ka ikhtiyar nahin hai un ke gande dilon ko pak karne ka Allah ka irada nahin, yeh duniya mein zaleel-o-khwar honge aur aakhirat mein dakhil-e-nar honge. Yeh batil ko kaan laga kar maze le kar sunne wale hain aur rishwat jaisi haram cheez ko din dahade khane wale hain, bhala un ke najis dil kaise pak honge? Aur un ki duayein Allah kaise sunega? Agar yeh tere paas aayein toh tujhe ikhtiyar hai ke un ke faisle kar ya na kar agar tu un se munh pher le jab bhi yeh tera kuch nahin bigad sakte kyunke un ka qasd itteba-e-haq nahin balkay apni khwahishon ki pairwi hai". Baaz buzurg kehte hain yeh aayat mansookh hai is aayat se (Wa anihkum bainahum bima anzalallahu wala tattabi' ahwa'ahum wahzarhum an yaftinuka 'an ba'di ma anzalallahu ilaika) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 49). Phir farmaya "Agar tu un mein faisle kare toh adl-o-insaf ke sath kar, goya khud zalim hain aur adl se hate hue hain aur maan lo ke Allah Ta'ala adil logon se mohabbat rakhta hai". Phir in ki khabasat, bad-batini aur sarkashi bayan ho rahi hai ke "Ek taraf toh is Kitabullah ko chhod rakha hai, jis ki tabedari aur haqaniyat ke khud qail hain, dusri taraf is janib jhuk rahe hain, jise nahin mante aur jise jhoot mashhoor kar rakha hai, phir is mein bhi niyat bad hai ke agar wahan se hamari khwahish ke mutabiq hukm milega toh le lenge, warna chhod chhad denge". Yeh farmaya ke yeh kaise teri farman-bardari karenge? Unhon ne toh Taurat ko bhi chhod rakha hai, jis mein Allah ke ahkamat hone ka iqrar nahin bhi hai lekin phir bhi beimani kar ke is se phir jate hain. Phir is Taurat ki midhat-o-tareef bayan farmayi jo us ne apne barguzida Rasool Hazrat Musa bin Imran (A.S / Alaihis Salam) par nazil farmayi thi ke is mein hidayat-o-nooraniyat thi. Anbiya (A.S / Alaihimas Salam) jo Allah ke zer-e-farman thay, isi par faisle karte rahe, Yahudiyon mein isi ke ahkam jari karte rahe, tabdeeli aur tehreef se bache rahe, Rabbani yani aabid, ulama aur ahbar yani zi-ilm log bhi isi raush par rahe.

Kyunke unhein yeh Pak Kitab sonpi gayi thi aur is ke izhar ka aur is par amal karne ka unhein hukum diya gaya tha aur woh is par gawah-o-shahid thay. Ab tumhein chahiye ke bajuz Allah ke kisi aur se na daro. Haan qadam qadam aur lamha lamha par khauf rakho aur meri aayaton ko thore thore mol farokht na kiya karo. Jaan lo ke Allah ki wahi ka hukum jo na maane woh kafir hai. Is mein do qaul hain jo abhi bayan honge Insha'Allah. In aayaton ka ek shaan-e-nuzool bhi sun lijiye. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke aise logon ko is aayat mein to kafir kaha, dusri mein zalim, teesri mein fasiq. Baat yeh hai ke Yahudiyon ke do giroh thay, ek ghalib tha, dusra maghloob. Un ki aapas mein is baat par sulah hui thi ke ghalib, zi-izzat firqe ka koi shakhs agar maghloob zaleel firqe ke kisi shakhs ko qatl kar dale to pachaas wasq diyat de aur zaleel logon mein se koi aziz ko qatl kar de to ek sau wasq diyat de. Yehi riwaj un mein chala aa raha tha. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine mein aaye, is ke baad ek waqiya aisa hua ke in neeche wale Yahudiyon mein se kisi ne kisi oonche Yahudi ko maar dala. Yahan se aadmi gaya ke lao sau wasq dilwao, wahan se jawab mila ke yeh sareeh na-insafi hai ke hum dono ek hi qabile ke, ek hi deen ke, ek hi nasab ke, ek hi shehar ke phir hamari diyat kam aur tumhari zyada? Hum chunke ab tak tumhare dabe hue thay, is na-insafi ko badil-e-nakhwasta bardasht karte rahe lekin ab jab ke Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jaise aadil badshah yahan aa gaye hain hum tumhein utni hi diyat denge jitni tum hamein do. Is baat par idhar udhar se aastein charh gayin, phir aapas mein yeh baat tay hui ke achha is jhagde ka faisla Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) karenge. Lekin oonchi qoum ke logon ne aapas mein jab mashwara kiya to un ke samajhdaron ne kaha dekho is se hath dho rakho ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) koi na-insafi pe mabni hukum karein. Yeh to sareeh zyadti hai ke hum aadhi dein aur poori lein aur filwaqia un logon ne dab kar ise manzoor kiya tha jo tum ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum aur salis muqarrar kiya hai to yaqeenan tumhara yeh haq mara jayega. Kisi ne raye di ke achha yun karo, kisi ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas chupke se bhej do, woh maloom kar aaye ke aap faisla kya karenge? Agar hamari himayat mein hua tab to bahut achha chalo aur un se haq hasil kar aao aur agar khilaf hua to phir alag thalag hi achhe hain. Chunancha Madina ke chand munafiqon ko unhon ne jasoos bana kar Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas bheja. Is se pehle ke woh yahan pahunchein Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein utaar kar apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko in dono firqon ke bad iradon se mutla'a farma diya (Abu Dawood). Ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh dono qabile Banu Nazeer aur Banu Quraiza thay. Banu Nazeer ki poori diyat thi aur Banu Quraiza ki aadhi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dono ki diyat yaksan dene ka faisla sadir farmaya. Ek riwayat hai ke Qurzi agar kisi Nazri ko qatl kar dale to us se qisas lete thay lekin is ke khilaf mein qisas tha hi nahin sau wasq diyat thi.

Yeh bahut mumkin hai ke idhar yeh waqia hua, idhar zina ka qissa waqia hua, jis ka tafseeli bayan guzar chuka hai un dono par yeh aayatein nazil huin, Wallahu A'lam. Haan ek baat aur hai jis se is dusri shaan-e-nuzool ki taqwiyat hoti hai woh yeh ke is ke baad hi farmaya hai aayat (Wa katabna alaihim fiha annannafsa binnafsi wal-aina bil-aini wal-anfa bil-anfi wal-uzuna bil-uzuni was-sinna bissinni wal-jurooha qisasun faman tasaddaqa bihi fahuwa kaffaratullahu waman lam yahkum bima anzalallahu fa-ulaika humuz-zalimun) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 45) yani hum ne Yahudiyon par Taurat mein yeh hukm farz kar diya tha ke jaan ke ewaz jaan, aankh ke ewaz aankh. Wallahu A'lam. Phir unhein kaafir kaha gaya jo Allah ki shariat aur us ki utari hui wahi ke mutabiq faisle aur hukm na karein, go yeh aayat shaan-e-nuzool ke aitbar se baqol mufassireen Ahl-e-Kitab ke bare mein hai lekin hukm ke aitbar se har shakhs ko shamil hai. Bani Israel ke bare mein utri aur is ummat ka bhi yahi hukm hai. Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke rishwat haram hai aur rishwat-sitani ke baad kisi shar'i masle ke khilaf fatwa dena kufr hai. Suddi farmate hain jis ne wahi-e-Ilahi ke khilaf amdan fatwa diya, janne ke bawajood us ke khilaf kiya woh kafir hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jis ne Allah ke farman se inkar kiya, us ka yeh hukm hai aur jis ne inkar to na kiya lekin us ke mutabiq na kaha woh zalim aur fasiq hai, khwah Ahl-e-Kitab ho khwah koi aur. Sha'bi farmate hain "Musalmanon mein jis ne Kitab ke khilaf fatwa diya woh kafir hai aur Yahudiyon mein diya ho to zalim hai aur Nasraniyon mein diya ho to fasiq hai". Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain "Is ka kufr is aayat ke sath hai". Ta'oos farmate hain "Is ka kufr us ke kufr jaisa nahin jo sire se Allah ke Rasool, Quran aur farishton ka munkir ho". Ata farmate hain "Kufr (chupana) kufr se kam hai isi tarah zulm-o-fisq ke bhi adna-o-a'la darje hain. Is kufr se woh millat-e-Islam se phir jane wala nahin ho jata". Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain "Is se murad woh kufr nahin jis ki taraf tum ja rahe ho".

Jhoot sunne aur kehne ke aadi log: In aayaton mein un logon ki muzammat bayan ho rahi hai, jo raye, qiyas aur khwahish-e-nafsani ko Allah ki shariat par muqaddam rakhte hain. Allah-o-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki itaat se nikal kar kufr ki taraf daudte bhagte rehte hain. Goya yeh log zabani imaan ke dawe karein lekin unka dil imaan se khali hai. Munafiqon ki yahi halat hai ke zaban ke khare, dil ke khote aur yahi khaslat Yahudiyon ki hai jo Islam aur Ahl-e-Islam ke dushman hain. Yeh jhoot ko maze maze se sunte hain aur dil khol kar qabool karte hain. Lekin sach se bhagte hain, balkay nafrat karte hain aur jo log aap ki majlis mein nahin aate yeh yahan ki wahan pahunchate hain. Unki taraf se jasusi karne ko aate hain. Phir nalaiqi yeh karte hain ke yeh baat ko badal dala karte hain, matlab kuch ho, le kar kuch udte hain, irade yahi hain ke agar tumhari khwahish ke mutabiq kahe to maan lo, tabiyat ke khilaf ho to door raho. Kaha kya gaya hai ke yeh aayat un Yahudiyon ke bare mein utri thi jin mein ek ko dusre ne qatl kar diya tha, ab kehne lage chalo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas chalein agar aap diyat jurmane ka hukum dein to manzoor kar lenge aur agar qisas badle ko farmayein to nahin manenge. Lekin zyada sahih baat yeh hai ke woh ek zina-kar ko le kar aaye the. Unki kitab Taurat mein darasal hukum to yeh tha ke shadi shuda zani ko sangsar kiya jaye. Lekin unhon ne ise badal dala tha aur sau kode maar kar, munh kala kar ke, ulta gadha sawar kar ke ruswai kar ke chhod dete the. Jab hijrat ke baad un mein se koi zina-kari ke jurm mein pakda gaya to yeh kehne lage aao Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas chalein aur aap se uske bare mein sawal karein, agar aap bhi wahi farmayein jo hum karte hain to ise qabool karenge aur Allah ke haan bhi yeh hamari sanad ho jayegi aur agar rajam ko farmayein ge to nahin manenge. Chunancha yeh aaye aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya ke hamare ek mard aurat ne badkari ki hai, unke bare mein aap kya irshad farmate hain? Aap ne farmaya tumhare haan Taurat mein kya hukum hai? Unhon ne kaha hum to ise ruswa karte hain aur kode maar kar chhod dete hain. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (R.A) ne farmaya, jhoot kehte hain, Taurat mein sangsar ka hukum hai. Lao Taurat pesh karo, unhon ne Taurat kholi lekin aayat-e-rajam par haath rakh kar aage peeche ki sab ibarat padh sunayi. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) samajh gaye aur aap ne farmaya apne haath ko to hata, haath hataya to sangsar karne ki aayat maujood thi, ab to unhein bhi iqrar karna pada. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hukum se zaniyon ko sangsar kar diya gaya, Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain "Main ne dekha ke woh zani us aurat ko pattharon se bachane ke liye uske aade aa jata tha" (Bukhari, Muslim) aur sanad se marwi hai ke Yahudiyon ne kaha "Hum to ise kala munh kar ke kuch maar peet kar chhod dete hain".

Aur aayat ke zahir hone ke baad unhon ne kaha, hai toh yahi hukm lekin hum ne toh ise chupaya tha, jo parh raha tha usi ne rajam ki aayat par apna haath rakh diya tha, jab uska haath uthwaya toh aayat par uchat-ti hui nazar parh gayi. In dono ke rajam karne walon mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) bhi maujood thay, ek aur riwayat mein hai ke un logon ne apne aadmi bhej kar aap ko bulwaya tha, apne madrasay mein gaddi par aap ko bithaya tha aur jo ab Taurat aap ke samne parh raha tha, woh un ka bahut bara aalim tha. Ek riwayat mein hai ke aap ne un se qasam de kar poocha tha ke tum Taurat mein shadi shuda zani ki kya saza paate ho? Toh unhon ne yahi jawab diya tha lekin ek naujawan kuch na bola, khamosh hi khara raha, aap ne us ki taraf dekh kar khaas use dobara qasam di aur jawab manga, us ne kaha jab aap aisi qasmein de rahe hain toh main jhoot na bolunga, waqai Taurat mein in logon ki saza sangsari hai. Aap ne farmaya achha phir yeh bhi sach sach batao ke pehle pehal is rajam ko tum ne kyun aur kis par se uraya? Us ne kaha Hazrat hamare kisi badshah ke rishtedar, bare aadmi ne zina kari ki. Us ki azmat aur badshah ki haibat ke maaray use rajam karo warna ise bhi chhoro. Aakhir hum ne mil mila kar yeh tay kiya ke bajaye rajam ke is qisam ki koi saza muqarrar kar di jaye. Chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Taurat ke hukm ko jaari kiya aur isi bare mein aayat (Inna Anzalna) ilakh, utri. Pas Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi in ahkaam ke jaari karne walon mein se hain (Ahmad, Abu Dawood). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek shakhs ko Yahudi kala munh kiye le ja rahe thay aur use koray bhi maar rakhe thay, toh aap ne bula kar un se majra poocha unhon ne kaha ke is ne zina kiya hai. Aap ne farmaya ke kya zani ki yahi saza tumhare haan hai? Kaha haan. Aap ne un ke ek aalim ko bula kar use sakht qasam de kar poocha toh us ne kaha ke agar aap aisi qasam na dete toh main hargiz na batata, baat yeh hai ke hamare haan darasal zina kari ki saza sangsari hai lekin chunke ameer-umara aur shurafa logon mein yeh badkari barh gayi thi aur unhein is qisam ki saza deni hum ne munasib na jaani, is liye unhein toh chor dete thay aur Allah ka hukm mara na jaye is liye ghareeb ghurba, kam haisiyat logon ko rajam kara dete thay phir hum ne raye zani ki ke aao koi aisi saza tajweez karo ke shareef-o-ghair shareef, ameer-ghareeb par sab par yaksan jaari ho sakay chunancha hamara sab ka is baat par ittefaq hua ke munh kaalay kar dein aur koray lagayein. Yeh sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukm diya ke in dono ko sangsar karo chunancha unhein rajam kar diya gaya aur aap ne farmaya ae Allah main pehla woh shakhs hoon jis ne tere ek murda hukm ko zinda kiya. Is par aayat (Yaa Ayyuhar-Rasulu La Yahzun-kalladhina Yusari'una Fil-Kufri Minalladhina Qalu Aamanna Bi-Afwahihim Wa Lam Tu'min Qulubuhum) (5:41) utri.

(Al-Ma'idah: 41) se (Wa man lam yahkum bima anzalallahu fa-ula'ika humul-kafirun) (Al-Ma'idah: 44) tak nazil hui. Inhi Yahudiyon ke bare mein. Aur ayat mein hai ke Allah ke nazil karda hukm ke mutabiq faisla na karne wale zalim hain aur ayat mein hai (fasiq hain) (Muslim wagaira aur riwayat mein hai "waqia-e-zina Fadak mein hua tha aur wahan ke Yahudiyon ne Madine Sharif ke Yahudiyon ko likh kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se puchwaya tha jo aalim unka aaya uska naam Ibn-e-Suriya tha, yeh aankh ka bhenga tha, aur uske sath dusra aalim bhi tha. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jab unhein qasam di to dono ne qaul diya tha, Aap ne unhein kaha tha, tumhein us Allah ki qasam jis ne Bani Israel ke liye pani mein raah kar di thi aur abr ka saya un par kiya tha aur Firauniyon se bacha liya tha aur Mann-o-Salwa utara tha. Is qasam se woh chaunk gaye aur aapas mein kehne lage badi zabardast qasam hai, is mauqe par jhoot bolna theek nahin to kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Taurat mein yeh hai ke buri nazar se dekhna bhi misl-e-zina ke hai aur gale lagana bhi aur bosa lena bhi, phir agar char gawah is baat ke hon ke unhon ne dukhool-o-khurooj dekha hai jaisa ke silai surma-dani mein jati aati hai to rajam wajib ho jata hai. Aap ne farmaya yahi masla hai phir hukm diya aur unhein rajam kara diya gaya". Is par ayat (Fa-in ja'uka fahkum bainahum au a'rid 'anhum, wa in tu'rid 'anhum falan yadurruka shai'an, wa in hakamta fahkum bainahum bil-qist, innallaha yuhibbul-muqsitina) (Al-Ma'idah: 42), utri (Abu Dawood wagaira). Jaan lo ke Allah ki wahi ka hukum jo na maane woh kafir hai. Is mein do qaul hain jo abhi bayan honge Insha'Allah. In aayaton ka ek shaan-e-nuzool bhi sun lijiye. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke aise logon ko is aayat mein to kafir kaha, dusri mein zalim, teesri mein fasiq. Baat yeh hai ke Yahudiyon ke do giroh thay, ek ghalib tha, dusra maghloob. Un ki aapas mein is baat par sulah hui thi ke ghalib, zi-izzat firqe ka koi shakhs agar maghloob zaleel firqe ke kisi shakhs ko qatl kar dale to pachaas wasq diyat de aur zaleel logon mein se koi aziz ko qatl kar de to ek sau wasq diyat de. Yehi riwaj un mein chala aa raha tha. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine mein aaye, is ke baad ek waqiya aisa hua ke in neeche wale Yahudiyon mein se kisi ne kisi oonche Yahudi ko maar dala. Yahan se aadmi gaya ke lao sau wasq dilwao, wahan se jawab mila ke yeh sareeh na-insafi hai ke hum dono ek hi qabile ke, ek hi deen ke, ek hi nasab ke, ek hi shehar ke phir hamari diyat kam aur tumhari zyada? Hum chunke ab tak tumhare dabe hue thay, is na-insafi ko badil-e-nakhwasta bardasht karte rahe lekin ab jab ke Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jaise aadil badshah yahan aa gaye hain hum tumhein utni hi diyat denge jitni tum hamein do. Is baat par idhar udhar se aastein charh gayin, phir aapas mein yeh baat tay hui ke achha is jhagde ka faisla Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) karenge. Lekin oonchi qoum ke logon ne aapas mein jab mashwara kiya to un ke samajhdaron ne kaha dekho is se hath dho rakho ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) koi na-insafi pe mabni hukum karein. Yeh to sareeh zyadti hai ke hum aadhi dein aur poori lein aur filwaqia un logon ne dab kar ise manzoor kiya tha jo tum ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum aur salis muqarrar kiya hai to yaqeenan tumhara yeh haq mara jayega. Kisi ne raye di ke achha yun karo, kisi ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas chupke se bhej do, woh maloom kar aaye ke aap faisla kya karenge? Agar hamari himayat mein hua tab to bahut achha chalo aur un se haq hasil kar aao aur agar khilaf hua to phir alag thalag hi achhe hain. Chunancha Madina ke chand munafiqon ko unhon ne jasoos bana kar Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas bheja. Is se pehle ke woh yahan pahunchein Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein utaar kar apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko in dono firqon ke bad iradon se mutla'a farma diya (Abu Dawood). Ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh dono qabile Banu Nazeer aur Banu Quraiza thay. Banu Nazeer ki poori diyat thi aur Banu Quraiza ki aadhi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dono ki diyat yaksan dene ka faisla sadir farmaya. Ek riwayat hai ke Qurzi agar kisi Nazri ko qatl kar dale to us se qisas lete thay lekin is ke khilaf mein qisas tha hi nahin sau wasq diyat thi.

Yeh bahut mumkin hai ke idhar yeh waqia hua, idhar zina ka qissa waqia hua, jis ka tafseeli bayan guzar chuka hai un dono par yeh aayatein nazil huin, Wallahu A'lam. Haan ek baat aur hai jis se is dusri shaan-e-nuzool ki taqwiyat hoti hai woh yeh ke is ke baad hi farmaya hai aayat (Wa katabna alaihim fiha annannafsa binnafsi wal-aina bil-aini wal-anfa bil-anfi wal-uzuna bil-uzuni was-sinna bissinni wal-jurooha qisasun faman tasaddaqa bihi fahuwa kaffaratullahu waman lam yahkum bima anzalallahu fa-ulaika humuz-zalimun) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 45) yani hum ne Yahudiyon par Taurat mein yeh hukm farz kar diya tha ke jaan ke ewaz jaan, aankh ke ewaz aankh. Wallahu A'lam. Phir unhein kaafir kaha gaya jo Allah ki shariat aur us ki utari hui wahi ke mutabiq faisle aur hukm na karein, go yeh aayat shaan-e-nuzool ke aitbar se baqol mufassireen Ahl-e-Kitab ke bare mein hai lekin hukm ke aitbar se har shakhs ko shamil hai. Bani Israel ke bare mein utri aur is ummat ka bhi yahi hukm hai. Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke rishwat haram hai aur rishwat-sitani ke baad kisi shar'i masle ke khilaf fatwa dena kufr hai. Suddi farmate hain jis ne wahi-e-Ilahi ke khilaf amdan fatwa diya, janne ke bawajood us ke khilaf kiya woh kafir hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jis ne Allah ke farman se inkar kiya, us ka yeh hukm hai aur jis ne inkar to na kiya lekin us ke mutabiq na kaha woh zalim aur fasiq hai, khwah Ahl-e-Kitab ho khwah koi aur. Sha'bi farmate hain "Musalmanon mein jis ne Kitab ke khilaf fatwa diya woh kafir hai aur Yahudiyon mein diya ho to zalim hai aur Nasraniyon mein diya ho to fasiq hai". Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain "Is ka kufr is aayat ke sath hai". Ta'oos farmate hain "Is ka kufr us ke kufr jaisa nahin jo sire se Allah ke Rasool, Quran aur farishton ka munkir ho". Ata farmate hain "Kufr (chupana) kufr se kam hai isi tarah zulm-o-fisq ke bhi adna-o-a'la darje hain. Is kufr se woh millat-e-Islam se phir jane wala nahin ho jata". Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain "Is se murad woh kufr nahin jis ki taraf tum ja rahe ho".

Jhoot sunne aur kehne ke aadi log: In aayaton mein un logon ki muzammat bayan ho rahi hai, jo raye, qiyas aur khwahish-e-nafsani ko Allah ki shariat par muqaddam rakhte hain. Allah-o-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki itaat se nikal kar kufr ki taraf daudte bhagte rehte hain. Goya yeh log zabani imaan ke dawe karein lekin unka dil imaan se khali hai. Munafiqon ki yahi halat hai ke zaban ke khare, dil ke khote aur yahi khaslat Yahudiyon ki hai jo Islam aur Ahl-e-Islam ke dushman hain. Yeh jhoot ko maze maze se sunte hain aur dil khol kar qabool karte hain. Lekin sach se bhagte hain, balkay nafrat karte hain aur jo log aap ki majlis mein nahin aate yeh yahan ki wahan pahunchate hain. Unki taraf se jasusi karne ko aate hain. Phir nalaiqi yeh karte hain ke yeh baat ko badal dala karte hain, matlab kuch ho, le kar kuch udte hain, irade yahi hain ke agar tumhari khwahish ke mutabiq kahe to maan lo, tabiyat ke khilaf ho to door raho. Kaha kya gaya hai ke yeh aayat un Yahudiyon ke bare mein utri thi jin mein ek ko dusre ne qatl kar diya tha, ab kehne lage chalo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas chalein agar aap diyat jurmane ka hukum dein to manzoor kar lenge aur agar qisas badle ko farmayein to nahin manenge. Lekin zyada sahih baat yeh hai ke woh ek zina-kar ko le kar aaye the. Unki kitab Taurat mein darasal hukum to yeh tha ke shadi shuda zani ko sangsar kiya jaye. Lekin unhon ne ise badal dala tha aur sau kode maar kar, munh kala kar ke, ulta gadha sawar kar ke ruswai kar ke chhod dete the. Jab hijrat ke baad un mein se koi zina-kari ke jurm mein pakda gaya to yeh kehne lage aao Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas chalein aur aap se uske bare mein sawal karein, agar aap bhi wahi farmayein jo hum karte hain to ise qabool karenge aur Allah ke haan bhi yeh hamari sanad ho jayegi aur agar rajam ko farmayein ge to nahin manenge. Chunancha yeh aaye aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya ke hamare ek mard aurat ne badkari ki hai, unke bare mein aap kya irshad farmate hain? Aap ne farmaya tumhare haan Taurat mein kya hukum hai? Unhon ne kaha hum to ise ruswa karte hain aur kode maar kar chhod dete hain. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (R.A) ne farmaya, jhoot kehte hain, Taurat mein sangsar ka hukum hai. Lao Taurat pesh karo, unhon ne Taurat kholi lekin aayat-e-rajam par haath rakh kar aage peeche ki sab ibarat padh sunayi. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) samajh gaye aur aap ne farmaya apne haath ko to hata, haath hataya to sangsar karne ki aayat maujood thi, ab to unhein bhi iqrar karna pada. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hukum se zaniyon ko sangsar kar diya gaya, Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain "Main ne dekha ke woh zani us aurat ko pattharon se bachane ke liye uske aade aa jata tha" (Bukhari, Muslim) aur sanad se marwi hai ke Yahudiyon ne kaha "Hum to ise kala munh kar ke kuch maar peet kar chhod dete hain".

Aur aayat ke zahir hone ke baad unhon ne kaha, hai toh yahi hukm lekin hum ne toh ise chupaya tha, jo parh raha tha usi ne rajam ki aayat par apna haath rakh diya tha, jab uska haath uthwaya toh aayat par uchat-ti hui nazar parh gayi. In dono ke rajam karne walon mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) bhi maujood thay, ek aur riwayat mein hai ke un logon ne apne aadmi bhej kar aap ko bulwaya tha, apne madrasay mein gaddi par aap ko bithaya tha aur jo ab Taurat aap ke samne parh raha tha, woh un ka bahut bara aalim tha. Ek riwayat mein hai ke aap ne un se qasam de kar poocha tha ke tum Taurat mein shadi shuda zani ki kya saza paate ho? Toh unhon ne yahi jawab diya tha lekin ek naujawan kuch na bola, khamosh hi khara raha, aap ne us ki taraf dekh kar khaas use dobara qasam di aur jawab manga, us ne kaha jab aap aisi qasmein de rahe hain toh main jhoot na bolunga, waqai Taurat mein in logon ki saza sangsari hai. Aap ne farmaya achha phir yeh bhi sach sach batao ke pehle pehal is rajam ko tum ne kyun aur kis par se uraya? Us ne kaha Hazrat hamare kisi badshah ke rishtedar, bare aadmi ne zina kari ki. Us ki azmat aur badshah ki haibat ke maaray use rajam karo warna ise bhi chhoro. Aakhir hum ne mil mila kar yeh tay kiya ke bajaye rajam ke is qisam ki koi saza muqarrar kar di jaye. Chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Taurat ke hukm ko jaari kiya aur isi bare mein aayat (Inna Anzalna) ilakh, utri. Pas Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi in ahkaam ke jaari karne walon mein se hain (Ahmad, Abu Dawood). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek shakhs ko Yahudi kala munh kiye le ja rahe thay aur use koray bhi maar rakhe thay, toh aap ne bula kar un se majra poocha unhon ne kaha ke is ne zina kiya hai. Aap ne farmaya ke kya zani ki yahi saza tumhare haan hai? Kaha haan. Aap ne un ke ek aalim ko bula kar use sakht qasam de kar poocha toh us ne kaha ke agar aap aisi qasam na dete toh main hargiz na batata, baat yeh hai ke hamare haan darasal zina kari ki saza sangsari hai lekin chunke ameer-umara aur shurafa logon mein yeh badkari barh gayi thi aur unhein is qisam ki saza deni hum ne munasib na jaani, is liye unhein toh chor dete thay aur Allah ka hukm mara na jaye is liye ghareeb ghurba, kam haisiyat logon ko rajam kara dete thay phir hum ne raye zani ki ke aao koi aisi saza tajweez karo ke shareef-o-ghair shareef, ameer-ghareeb par sab par yaksan jaari ho sakay chunancha hamara sab ka is baat par ittefaq hua ke munh kaalay kar dein aur koray lagayein. Yeh sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukm diya ke in dono ko sangsar karo chunancha unhein rajam kar diya gaya aur aap ne farmaya ae Allah main pehla woh shakhs hoon jis ne tere ek murda hukm ko zinda kiya. Is par aayat (Yaa Ayyuhar-Rasulu La Yahzun-kalladhina Yusari'una Fil-Kufri Minalladhina Qalu Aamanna Bi-Afwahihim Wa Lam Tu'min Qulubuhum) (5:41) utri.

(Al-Ma'idah: 41) se (Wa man lam yahkum bima anzalallahu fa-ula'ika humul-kafirun) (Al-Ma'idah: 44) tak nazil hui. Inhi Yahudiyon ke bare mein. Aur ayat mein hai ke Allah ke nazil karda hukm ke mutabiq faisla na karne wale zalim hain aur ayat mein hai (fasiq hain) (Muslim wagaira aur riwayat mein hai "waqia-e-zina Fadak mein hua tha aur wahan ke Yahudiyon ne Madine Sharif ke Yahudiyon ko likh kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se puchwaya tha jo aalim unka aaya uska naam Ibn-e-Suriya tha, yeh aankh ka bhenga tha, aur uske sath dusra aalim bhi tha. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jab unhein qasam di to dono ne qaul diya tha, Aap ne unhein kaha tha, tumhein us Allah ki qasam jis ne Bani Israel ke liye pani mein raah kar di thi aur abr ka saya un par kiya tha aur Firauniyon se bacha liya tha aur Mann-o-Salwa utara tha. Is qasam se woh chaunk gaye aur aapas mein kehne lage badi zabardast qasam hai, is mauqe par jhoot bolna theek nahin to kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Taurat mein yeh hai ke buri nazar se dekhna bhi misl-e-zina ke hai aur gale lagana bhi aur bosa lena bhi, phir agar char gawah is baat ke hon ke unhon ne dukhool-o-khurooj dekha hai jaisa ke silai surma-dani mein jati aati hai to rajam wajib ho jata hai. Aap ne farmaya yahi masla hai phir hukm diya aur unhein rajam kara diya gaya". Is par ayat (Fa-in ja'uka fahkum bainahum au a'rid 'anhum, wa in tu'rid 'anhum falan yadurruka shai'an, wa in hakamta fahkum bainahum bil-qist, innallaha yuhibbul-muqsitina) (Al-Ma'idah: 42), utri (Abu Dawood wagaira). Ek riwayat mein jo do aalim samne laye gaye the, yeh dono Suriya ke ladke the. Tark-e-hadd ka sabab is riwayat mein Yahudiyon ki taraf se yeh bayan hua hai ke jab hum mein saltanat na rahi to hum ne apne admiyon ki jaan leni munasib na samjhi phir Aap ne gawahon ko bulwa kar gawahi li jinhon ne bayan diya ke hum ne apni aankhon se unhein is burai mein dekha hai, jis tarah surma-dani mein silai hoti hai.

Darasal Taurat waghera ka mangwana un ke aalimon ko bulwana, yeh sab unhein ilzam dene ke liye na tha, na is liye tha ke woh isi ke manne ke mukallaf hain, nahin balkay khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman wajib-ul-amal hai, is se maqsad ek toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sachai ka izhar tha ke Allah ki wahi se aap ne yeh maloom kar liya ke un ki Taurat mein bhi hukm-e-rajm majood hai aur yahi nikla, dusre un ki ruswai ke unhein pehle ke inkar ke baad iqrar karna pada aur duniya par zahir ho gaya ke yeh log farman-e-Ilahi ko chupa lene wale aur apni raye qiyas par amal karne wale hain aur is liye bhi ke yeh log sache dil se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas is liye nahin aaye thay ke aap ki farman-bardari karein balkay mehez is liye aaye thay ke agar aap ko bhi apne ijma ke muwafiq payenge toh ittehad kar lenge warna hargiz qabool na karenge, isi liye farman hai ke "Jinhein Allah gumrah kar de toh un ko kisi qisam se rah-e-rast aane ka ikhtiyar nahin hai un ke gande dilon ko pak karne ka Allah ka irada nahin, yeh duniya mein zaleel-o-khwar honge aur aakhirat mein dakhil-e-nar honge. Yeh batil ko kaan laga kar maze le kar sunne wale hain aur rishwat jaisi haram cheez ko din dahade khane wale hain, bhala un ke najis dil kaise pak honge? Aur un ki duayein Allah kaise sunega? Agar yeh tere paas aayein toh tujhe ikhtiyar hai ke un ke faisle kar ya na kar agar tu un se munh pher le jab bhi yeh tera kuch nahin bigad sakte kyunke un ka qasd itteba-e-haq nahin balkay apni khwahishon ki pairwi hai". Baaz buzurg kehte hain yeh aayat mansookh hai is aayat se (Wa anihkum bainahum bima anzalallahu wala tattabi' ahwa'ahum wahzarhum an yaftinuka 'an ba'di ma anzalallahu ilaika) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 49). Phir farmaya "Agar tu un mein faisle kare toh adl-o-insaf ke sath kar, goya khud zalim hain aur adl se hate hue hain aur maan lo ke Allah Ta'ala adil logon se mohabbat rakhta hai". Phir in ki khabasat, bad-batini aur sarkashi bayan ho rahi hai ke "Ek taraf toh is Kitabullah ko chhod rakha hai, jis ki tabedari aur haqaniyat ke khud qail hain, dusri taraf is janib jhuk rahe hain, jise nahin mante aur jise jhoot mashhoor kar rakha hai, phir is mein bhi niyat bad hai ke agar wahan se hamari khwahish ke mutabiq hukm milega toh le lenge, warna chhod chhad denge". Yeh farmaya ke yeh kaise teri farman-bardari karenge? Unhon ne toh Taurat ko bhi chhod rakha hai, jis mein Allah ke ahkamat hone ka iqrar nahin bhi hai lekin phir bhi beimani kar ke is se phir jate hain. Phir is Taurat ki midhat-o-tareef bayan farmayi jo us ne apne barguzida Rasool Hazrat Musa bin Imran (A.S / Alaihis Salam) par nazil farmayi thi ke is mein hidayat-o-nooraniyat thi. Anbiya (A.S / Alaihimas Salam) jo Allah ke zer-e-farman thay, isi par faisle karte rahe, Yahudiyon mein isi ke ahkam jari karte rahe, tabdeeli aur tehreef se bache rahe, Rabbani yani aabid, ulama aur ahbar yani zi-ilm log bhi isi raush par rahe.
