Ek riwayat hai ke Qurzi agar kisi Nazri ko qatl kar dale to us se qisas lete thay lekin is ke khilaf mein qisas tha hi nahin sau wasq diyat thi.

Yeh bahut mumkin hai ke idhar yeh waqia hua, idhar zina ka qissa waqia hua, jis ka tafseeli bayan guzar chuka hai un dono par yeh aayatein nazil huin, Wallahu A'lam. Haan ek baat aur hai jis se is dusri shaan-e-nuzool ki taqwiyat hoti hai woh yeh ke is ke baad hi farmaya hai aayat (Wa katabna alaihim fiha annannafsa binnafsi wal-aina bil-aini wal-anfa bil-anfi wal-uzuna bil-uzuni was-sinna bissinni wal-jurooha qisasun faman tasaddaqa bihi fahuwa kaffaratullahu waman lam yahkum bima anzalallahu fa-ulaika humuz-zalimun) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 45) yani hum ne Yahudiyon par Taurat mein yeh hukm farz kar diya tha ke jaan ke ewaz jaan, aankh ke ewaz aankh. Wallahu A'lam. Phir unhein kaafir kaha gaya jo Allah ki shariat aur us ki utari hui wahi ke mutabiq faisle aur hukm na karein, go yeh aayat shaan-e-nuzool ke aitbar se baqol mufassireen Ahl-e-Kitab ke bare mein hai lekin hukm ke aitbar se har shakhs ko shamil hai. Bani Israel ke bare mein utri aur is ummat ka bhi yahi hukm hai. Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain ke rishwat haram hai aur rishwat-sitani ke baad kisi shar'i masle ke khilaf fatwa dena kufr hai. Suddi farmate hain jis ne wahi-e-Ilahi ke khilaf amdan fatwa diya, janne ke bawajood us ke khilaf kiya woh kafir hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jis ne Allah ke farman se inkar kiya, us ka yeh hukm hai aur jis ne inkar to na kiya lekin us ke mutabiq na kaha woh zalim aur fasiq hai, khwah Ahl-e-Kitab ho khwah koi aur. Sha'bi farmate hain "Musalmanon mein jis ne Kitab ke khilaf fatwa diya woh kafir hai aur Yahudiyon mein diya ho to zalim hai aur Nasraniyon mein diya ho to fasiq hai". Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain "Is ka kufr is aayat ke sath hai". Ta'oos farmate hain "Is ka kufr us ke kufr jaisa nahin jo sire se Allah ke Rasool, Quran aur farishton ka munkir ho". Ata farmate hain "Kufr (chupana) kufr se kam hai isi tarah zulm-o-fisq ke bhi adna-o-a'la darje hain. Is kufr se woh millat-e-Islam se phir jane wala nahin ho jata". Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain "Is se murad woh kufr nahin jis ki taraf tum ja rahe ho".

Qatl ke badle taqaza-e-adl hai. Yahudiyon ko aur sarzanish ki ja rahi hai ke un ki kitab mein saaf lafzon mein jo hukm tha yeh khullam khulla us ka bhi khilaf kar rahe hain aur sarkashi aur be-parwahi se use bhi chhod rahe hain. Nazri Yahudiyon ko to Qurzi Yahudiyon ke badle qatl karte hain lekin Quraiza ke Yahud ko Banu Nazir ke Yahud ke ewaz qatl nahin karte balkeh diyat le kar chhod dete hain. Isi tarah unhon ne shadi shuda zani ki sangsari ke hukm ko badal diya hai aur sirf kala munh kar ke ruswa kar ke maar peet kar chhod dete hain. Isi liye wahan to unhein kafir kaha yahan insaf na karne ki wajah se unhein zalim kaha. Ek hadith mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka (Wal-Ainu) padhna bhi marwi hai (Abu Dawood waghera). Ulama-e-Kiram ka qaul hai ke agli shariat chahe hamare samne bator-e-taqarrur bayan ki jaye aur mansookh na ho to woh hamare liye bhi shariat hai. Jaise yeh ahkam sab ke sab hamari shariat mein bhi isi tarah hain. Imam Nawawi farmate hain is masle mein teen maslak hain, ek to wahi jo bayan hua, ek is ke bilkul bar-aks, ek yeh ke sirf Ibrahimi shariat jari aur baqi hai aur koi nahin. Is ayat ke umoom se yeh bhi istidlal kiya gaya hai ke mard aurat ke badle bhi qatl kiya jayega kyunke yahan lafz nafs hai jo mard aurat donon ko shamil hai. Chunancha hadith-e-sharif mein bhi hai ke mard aurat ke khoon ke badle qatl kiya jayega aur hadith mein hai ke musalmanon ke khoon aapas mein masawi hain. Baaz buzurgon se marwi hai ke "mard jab kisi aurat ko qatl kar de to use us ke badle qatl na kiya jayega balkeh sirf diyat li jayegi" lekin yeh qaul jamhoor ke khilaf hai. Imam Abu Hanifa to farmate hain ke "zimmi kafir ke qatl ke badle bhi musalman qatl kar diya jayega aur ghulam ke qatl ke badle azad bhi qatl kar diya jayega." Lekin yeh mazhab jamhoor ke khilaf hai. Bukhari Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain "Musalman kafir ke badle qatl kiya na kiya jayega" aur salaf ke bahut se asar is bare mein maujood hain ke woh ghulam ka qisas azad se nahin lete the aur azad ghulam ke badle qatl na kiya jayega. Hadithein bhi is bare mein marwi hain lekin sehat ko nahin pahunchin. Imam Shafi'i to farmate hain is masle mein Imam Abu Hanifa ke khilaf ijma hai lekin in baton se is qaul ka butlan lazim nahin aata ta-waqteke ayat ke umoom ko khas karne wali koi zabardast saaf sabit daleel na ho. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke "Hazrat Anas bin Nazr ki phuphi Rubai ne ek laundi ke daant tod diye, ab logon ne us se muafi chahi lekin woh na mani. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas mamla aaya aap ne badla lene ka hukm de diya, is par Hazrat Anas bin Nazr ne farmaya kya is aurat ke samne ke daant tod diye jayenge? Aap ne farmaya haan ae Anas Allah ki kitab mein qisas ka hukm maujood hai."

Yeh sun kar farmaya nahin nahin ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) qasam hai us Allah ki jis ne aap ko haq ke sath bheja hai, is ke daant hargiz na torey jayenge, chunancha hua bhi yahi ke log raazi razamand ho gaye aur qisas chhor diya balkay maaf kardiya. Is waqt aap ne farmaya baaz bandagan-e-Rabb aisay bhi hain ke agar woh Allah par koi qasam kha lein to Allah Ta'ala usay poori hi kar de". Doosri riwayat mein hai ke "pehle unhon ne na to maafi di na diyat leni manzoor ki." Nasai waghera mein hai, ek ghareeb jamaat ke ghulam ne kisi maal-daar jamaat ke ghulam ke kaan kaat diye, un logon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se aakar arz kiya ke hum log faqeer maskeen hain, maal hamaray paas nahin to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un par koi jurmana na rakha. Ho sakta hai ke yeh ghulam baaligh na ho aur ho sakta hai ke aap ne diyat apnay paas se de di ho aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke un se sifarish kar ke maaf kara liya ho. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain ke jaan jaan ke badlay maari jayegi, aankh phor denay walay ki aankh phor di jayegi, naak kaatnay walay ka naak kaat diya jayega, daant tor denay walay ka daant tor diya jayega aur zakhm ka bhi badla liya jayega. Is mein azaad musalman sab ke sab barabar hain. Mard aurat ek hi hukum mein. Jabke yeh kaam qasdan kiye gaye hon. Is mein ghulam bhi aapas mein barabar hain, un ke mard bhi aur auratein bhi. Qaida aaza ka katna to jor se hota hai is mein to qisas wajib hai. Jaise haath, pair, qadam, hatheli waghera. Lekin jo zakhm jor par na hon balkay haddi par aaye hon, un ki babat Hazrat Imam Malik (R.H) farmatay hain ke "un mein bhi qisas hai magar raan mein aur is jaisay aaza mein is liye ke woh khauf-o-khatar ki jagah hai". Un ke bar-khilaf Abu Hanifa (R.H) aur un ke dono sathiyon ka mazhab hai ke kisi haddi mein qisas nahin, bajuz daant ke aur Imam Shafi (R.H) ke nazdeek mutlaq kisi haddi ka qisas nahin. Yahi marwi hai Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) aur Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se bhi aur yahi kehtay hain Atta, Shabi, Hasan Basri, Zahri, Ibrahim, Nakhai aur Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) bhi aur isi ki taraf gaye hain Sufyan Thauri aur Laith bin Saad (R.H) bhi. Imam Ahmad (R.H) se bhi yahi qaul zyada mashhoor hai. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) ki daleel wahi Hazrat Anas (R.A) wali riwayat hai jis mein Rabia se daant ka qisas dilwanay ka hukum Huzoor (ﷺ) ka farmuda hai. Lekin darasal is riwayat se yeh mazhab sabit nahin hota. Kyunke is mein yeh lafz hain ke us ke samnay ke daant us ne tor diye thay aur ho sakta hai ke baghair tootnay ke jhar gaye hon. Is halat mein qisas ijma se wajib hai. Un ki daleel ka poora hissa woh hai jo Ibn Majah mein hai ke "ek shakhs ne doosray ke baazu ko kehni se neechay neechay ek talwar maar di, jis se us ki kalai kat gayi, Hazrat (ﷺ) ke paas muqadma aaya, aap ne hukum diya ke diyat ada karo us ne kaha mein qisas chahta hoon, aap ne farmaya isi ko le le Allah tujhay isi mein barkat de ga aur aap ne qisas ko nahin farmaya".

Lekin yeh hadith bilkul za'eef aur giri hui hai, is ke ek raawi Hashim bin Akli A'rabi za'eef hain, un ki hadith se hujjat nahin pakdi jaati, dusre raawi Gharran bin Jariya A'rabi bhi za'eef hain. Phir woh kehte hain ke zakhmon ka qisas un ke durust ho jaane aur bhar jaane se pehle lena jaaiz nahin aur agar pehle le liya gaya phir zakhm badh gaya to koi badla dilwaya na jaaye ga. Is ki daleel Musnad-e-Ahmad ki yeh hadith hai ke ek shakhs ne dusre ke ghutne mein chot maar di, woh Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaya aur kaha mujhe badla dilwaiye, Aap (ﷺ) ne dilwa diya, is ke baad woh phir aaya aur kehne laga Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Main to langda ho gaya, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya main ne tujhe mana kiya tha lekin tu na maana, ab tere is langde-pan ka badla kuch nahin. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ) ne zakhmon ke bhar jaane se pehle badla lene ko mana farma diya. Mas'ala: Agar kisi ne dusre ko zakhmi kiya aur badla us se le liya gaya, is mein yeh mar gaya to is par kuch nahin. Malik, Shafi'i, Ahmad aur jamhoori sahaba-o-taba'een ka yahi qaul hai. Abu Hanifa ka qaul hai ke is par diyat wajib hai, isi ke maal mein se. Ba'az aur buzurg farmate hain "Us ke maa baap ki taraf ke rishtedaron ke maal par woh diyat wajib hai". Ba'az aur hazraat kehte hain "baqadr us ke badle ke to saaqit hai baqi isi ke maal mein se wajib hai". Phir farmata hai "Jo shakhs qisas se darguzar kare aur bator-e-sadqe ke apne badle ko maaf kar de to zakhmi karne wale ka kaffara ho gaya aur jo zakhmi hua hai, use sawab hoga jo Allah Ta'ala ke zimme hai". Ba'az ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke "Woh zakhmi ke liye kaffara hai yani us ke gunah isi zakhm ki miqdaar se Allah Ta'ala bakhsh deta hai". Ek marfoo hadith mein yeh aaya hai ke "Agar chauthai diyat ke barabar ki cheez hai aur us ne darguzar kar liya to us ke chauthai gunah maaf ho jaate hain. Suls hai to tihai gunah, aadhi hai to aadhe gunah aur poori hai to poore gunah". Ek Quraishi ne ek Ansari ko zor se dhakka de diya jis se us ke aage ke daant toot gaye. Hazrat Mu'awiya (R.A) ke paas muqadma gaya aur jab woh bahut sar ho gaya to Aap (R.A) ne farmaya, achha ja tujhe ikhtiyar hai. Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) wahin the farmane lage main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se suna hai ke "Jis musalman ke jism mein koi eeza pahunchai jaaye aur woh sabr kar le, badla na le to Allah us ke darje badhata hai aur us ki khatayen maaf farmata hai", is Ansari ne yeh sun kar kaha, kya sach-much aap ne khud hi ise Huzoor (ﷺ) ki zabaani suna hai? Aap (R.A) ne farmaya haan mere in kaanon ne suna hai aur mere dil ne yaad kiya hai, us ne kaha phir gawah raho ke main ne apne mujrim ko maaf kar diya. Hazrat Mu'awiya (R.A) yeh sun kar bahut khush hue aur use inaam diya" (Ibn-e-Jareer). Tirmizi mein bhi yeh riwayat hai lekin Imam Tirmizi (R.H) kehte hain yeh hadith ghareeb hai.

Abu Safar rawi ka Abu Darda (R.A) se sunna sabit nahin aur riwayat mein hai ke teen guni diyat woh dena chahta tha lekin yeh raazi nahin hua tha, is hadith ke alfaaz yeh hain ke "Jo shakhs khoon ya us se kam ko maaf kar de, woh us ki paidaish se le kar maut tak ka kaffara hai". Musnad mein hai ke "Jis ke jism mein koi zakhm lage aur woh maaf kar de to Allah Ta'ala us ke utne hi gunah maaf farma deta hai". Musnad mein yeh bhi hadith hai "Allah ke hukm ke mutabiq hukm na karne wale zaalim hain". Pehle guzar chuka hai ke kufr kufr se kam hai, zulm mein bhi tafawat hai aur fisq bhi darje hain.

Batil ke ghulam log ambiya-e-Bani Israel ke peeche hum Isa Nabi ko laye jo Taurat par iman rakhte the, us ke ahkam ke mutabiq logon mein faisle karte the, hum ne unhein bhi apni kitab Injeel di, jis mein haq ki hidayat thi aur shubhat aur mushkilat ki tauzeeh thi aur pehli ilhami kitabon ki tasdeeq thi, han chand masail jin mein Yahudi ikhtilaf karte the, un ke saaf faisle us mein majood the. Jaise Quran mein aur jagah hai ke "Hazrat Isa ne farmaya, main tumhare liye ba'az woh cheezein halal karoon ga jo tum par haram kar di gayi hain". Isi liye ulama ka mashhoor maqoola hai ke Injeel ne Taurat ke ba'az ahkam mansookh kar diye hain. Injeel se parsa logon ki rehnumai aur wa'az-o-pand hoti thi ke woh neki ki taraf raghbat karein aur burai se bachein. Ahl-ul-Injeel bhi parha gaya hai is surat mein (Walyahkum) mein laam ke ma'ani mein hoga. Matlab yeh hoga ke hum ne Hazrat Isa ko Injeel is liye di thi ke woh apne zamane ke apne manne walon ko isi ke mutabiq chalayein aur is laam ko amr ka laam samjha jaye aur mashhoor qirat (Walyahkum) parhi jaye to ma'ani yeh honge ke unhein chahiye ke Injeel ke kul ahkam par iman layein aur isi ke mutabiq faisla karein. Jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (Qul ya ahlal-kitabi lastum 'ala shai'in hatta tuqimut-taurata wal-injila wa ma unzila ilaikum mir-rabbikum) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 68) yani ae Ahl-e-Kitab jab tak tum Taurat-o-Injeel par aur jo kuch Allah ki taraf se utra hai, agar us par qaim ho to tum kisi cheez par nahin ho. Aur ayat mein hai ayat (Allazina yattabi'unar-rasulan-nabiyyal-ummiyyallazi yajidunahu maktuban 'indahum fit-taurati wal-injil) (Surah Al-A'raf: 157) jo log is Rasool Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari karte hain, jis ki sifat apne han Taurat mein likhi hui pate hain woh log jo Kitabullah aur apne Nabi ke farman ke mutabiq hukm na karein woh Allah ki ita'at se kharij, haq ke tarik aur batil ke aamil hain, yeh ayat nasraniyon ke haq mein hai. Rawish-e-ayat se bhi yeh zahir hai aur pehle bayan bhi guzar chuka hai.

Quran ek mustaqil shariat hai. Taurat-o-Injeel ki sana-o-sifat aur tareef-o-madhat ke baad ab Quran-e-Azeem ki buzurgi bayan ho rahi hai ke "Hum ne ise haq-o-sadaqat ke sath nazil farmaya hai, yeh bil-yaqeen Allah Wahid ki taraf se hai aur Us ka kalam hai. Yeh tamam pehli Ilahi kitabon ko sacha manta hai aur un kitabon mein bhi is ki sifat-o-sana majood hai aur yeh bhi bayan un mein hai ke yeh pak aur aakhri kitab aakhri aur afzal Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utregi, pas har dana shakhs is par yaqeen rakhta hai aur ise manta hai." Jaise farman hai ayat: (Innal-lazina utul-ilma min qablihi iza yutla alaihim yakhirruna lil-azqani sujjada) (Surah Al-Isra: 107). Jinhein is se pehle ilm diya gaya tha, jab un ke samne is ki tilawat ki jati hai to woh thodiyon ke bal sajde mein gir padte hain aur zabani iqrar karte hain ke hamare Rab ka wada sacha hai aur woh sacha sabit ho chuka, us ne agle Rasoolon ki zabani jo khabar di thi woh puri hui aur aakhri Rasool, Rasoolon ke sartaj, Rasool aa hi gaye aur yeh kitab un pehli kitabon ki muhaimin (amin) hai. Yani is mein jo kuch hai, wahi pehli kitabon mein bhi tha, ab is ke khilaf koi kahe ke falan pehli kitab mein yun hai to yeh ghalat hai. Yeh un ki sachi gawah aur unhein gher lene wali aur samet lene wali hai. Jo jo achhaiyan pehle ki tamam kitabon mein jama thin, woh sab is aakhri kitab mein yakja majood hain, isi liye yeh sab par hakim aur sab par muqaddam hai aur is ki hifazat ka kafeel khud Allah Ta'ala hai. Jaise farmaya: (Inna nahnu nazzalnaz-zikra wa inna lahu lahafizun) (Surah Al-Hijr: 9). Baaz ne kaha hai ke murad is se yeh hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is kitab par amin hain. Waqia mein to yeh qaul bahut sahih hai lekin is ayat ki tafsir yeh karni theek nahin balkay Arabi zaban ke aitbar se bhi yeh ghaur talab amr hai. Sahih tafsir pehli hi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) ne bhi Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se is qaul ko naqal kar ke farmaya hai "Yeh bahut door ki baat hai balkay theek nahin hai is liye Muhaimin ka atf Musaddiq par hai, pas yeh bhi usi cheez ki sifat hai jis ki sifat Musaddiq ka lafz tha". Agar Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ke ma'ani sahih maan liye jayen to ibarat baghair atf ke honi chahiye thi khwah Arab hon, khwah Ajam hon, khwah likhay padhay hon, khwah an-padh hon. Allah ki taraf se nazil karda se murad Wahi-e-Ilahi hai khwah woh is kitab ki surat mein ho, khwah jo pehle ahkam Allah ne muqarrar kar rakhe hon. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is ayat se pehle to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko azadi di gayi thi, agar chahein un mein faislay karein chahein na karein, lekin is ayat ne hukm diya ke Wahi-e-Ilahi ke sath un mein faislay karne zaroori hain, un bad-naseeb jahilon ne apni taraf se jo ahkam ghad liye hain aur un ki wajah se Kitabullah ko pas-e-pusht daal diya hai, khabardar ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tu un ki chahaton ke peeche lag kar haq ko na chhod baithna. Un mein se har ek ke liye hum ne rasta aur tariqa bana diya hai.

Kisi cheez ki taraf ibtida karne ko shir'ah kehte hain, minhaj lughat mein kehte hain wazeh aur aasaan raaste ko. Pas in dono lafzon ki yahi tafseer zyada munasib hai. Pehli tamam shari'atein jo Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se thin, woh sab tauheed par muttafiq thin, albatta chote mote ahkaam mein qadre her-pher tha. Jaise hadith-e-sharif mein hai "Hum sab ambiya allati bhai hain, hum sab ka deen ek hi hai, har nabi tauheed ke sath bheja jata raha aur har aasmani kitab mein tauheed ka bayan uska suboot aur usi ki taraf dawat di jati rahi". Jaise Quran farmata hai ke "Tujh se pehle jitne bhi rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum ne bheje, un sab ki taraf yahi wahi ki ke mere siwa koi mabood-e-haqiqi nahin, tum sab sirf meri hi ibadat karte raho". Aur aayat mein (Walaqad ba'athna fi kulli ummatir rasoolan ani'budullaha wajtanibut taghut) (16. An-Nahl: 36) hum ne har ummat ko bazaban-e-rasool kehla diya ke Allah ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa dusron ki ibadat se bacho. Ahkaam ka ikhtilaf zaroor, koi cheez kisi zamane mein haram thi phir halal ho gayi ya us ke bar-aks. Ya kisi hukm mein takhfeef thi ab takeed ho gayi ya us ke khilaf aur yeh bhi hikmat aur maslahat aur hujjat-e-rabbani ke sath maslan Taurat ek shari'at hai, Injeel ek shari'at hai, Quran ek mustaqil shari'at hai taake har zamane ke farmanbardaron aur nafarmanon ka imtehan ho jaya kare. Albatta tauheed sab zamonon mein yaksan rahi aur ma'ani is jumla ke yeh hain ke ae ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Tum mein se har shakhs ke liye hum ne apni is kitab Quran-e-Kareem ko shari'at aur tariqa banaya hai, tum sab ko is ki iqtida aur tabedari karni chahiye. Is surat mein ja'alna ke baad zameer 'ha' ki mehzoof manni paregi. Pas behtareen maqasid hasil karne ka zariya aur tariqa sirf Quran-e-Kareem hi hai lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai aur is ki ek daleel yeh bhi hai ke is ke baad hi farman hua hai ke agar Allah chahta to sab ko ek hi ummat kar deta. Pas maloom hua ke agla khitab sirf is ummat se hi nahin balki sab ummaton se hai aur is mein Allah Ta'ala ki bahut badi aur kamil qudrat ka bayan hai ke agar woh chahta to sab logon ko ek hi shari'at aur deen par kar deta koi tabdeeli kisi waqt na hoti. Lekin Rabb ki hikmat-e-kamilah ka taqaza yeh hua ke alaihda alaihda shari'atein muqarrar kare, ek ke baad dusra nabi bheje aur ba'az ahkaam agle nabi ke pichle nabi se badalwa de, yahan tak ke agle deen Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat se mansookh ho gaye aur Aap tamam roo-e-zameen ki taraf bheje gaye aur Khatam-ul-Anbiya bana kar bheje gaye. Yeh mukhtalif shari'atein sirf tumhari aazmaish ke liye huin taake tabedaron ko jaza aur nafarmanon ko saza mile. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke woh tumhein aazmaye, us cheez mein jo tumhein us ne di hai yani kitab. Pas tumhein khairat aur nekiyon ki taraf sabqat aur daud karni chahiye.

Allah ki ita'at, us ki shari'at ki farmanbardari ki taraf aage barhna chahiye aur is aakhri shari'at, aakhri kitab aur aakhri paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ba-dil-o-jaan farmanbardari karni chahiye. Logo! Tum sab ka marja-o-mawa aur lautna phirna Allah hi ki taraf hai, wahan woh tumhein tumhare ikhtilaf ki asliyat bata de ga. Sachon ko un ki sachai ka achha phal de ga aur buron ko un ki kaj-bahsi, sarkashi aur khwahish-e-nafs ki pairwi ki saza de ga. Jo haq ko manna to ek taraf balkeh haq se chirte hain aur muqabla karte hain. Zahhak kehte hain murad ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai, magar awwal hi awla hai. Phir pehli baat ki aur takeed ho rahi hai aur us ke khilaf se roka jata hai aur farmaya jata hai ke "Dekho kahin is khain, makkar, kazzab, kuffar-e-yahood ki baton mein aa kar Allah ke kisi hukm se idhar udhar na ho jana. Agar woh tere ahkam se ro-gardani karein aur shari'at ke khilaf karein to tu samajh le ke un ki siyah-kariyon ki wajah se Allah ka koi azab un par aane wala hai. Isi liye taufiq-e-khair un se chheen li gayi hai. Aksar log fasiq hain yani ita'at-e-haq se kharij. Allah ke deen ke mukhalif, hidayat se door hain." Jaise farmaya aayat (Wama aksarun-nasi walaw harasta bimu'mineen) (12. Yusuf: 103) yani go tu hirs kar ke chahe lekin aksar log momin nahin hain. Yahudiyon ke chand bare bare ra'ison aur aalimon ne aapas mein ek meeting kar ke huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar arz kiya ke aap jante hain agar hum aap ko maan lein to tamam yahood aap ki nabuwwat ka iqrar kar lein ge aur hum aap ko manne ke liye tayyar hain, aap sirf itna kijiye ke hum mein aur hamari qoum mein ek jhagda hai, us ka faisla hamare mutabiq kar dijiye, aap ne inkar kar diya aur isi par yeh aayatein utrein. Is ke baad janab-e-Bari Ta'ala un logon ka zikr kar raha hai jo Allah ke hukm se hat jayen, jis mein tamam bhulaiyan majood aur tamam buraiyan door hain. Aise pak hukm se hat kar raye-o-qiyas ki taraf, khwahish-e-nafsani ki taraf aur un ahkam ki taraf jhuke jo logon ne az-khud apni taraf se baghair daleel-e-shar'i ke ghar liye hain jaise ke ahl-e-jahiliyat apni jahalat-o-zalalat aur apni raye aur apni marzi ke mutabiq hukm-e-ahkam jari kar liya karte the aur jaise ke tatari mulki mamlat mein Changez Khan ke ahkam ki pairwi karte the jo Ilyasaq ne ghar diye the. Woh bahut se ahkam ke majmo'e aur dafatir the jo mukhtalif shari'aton aur mazhabon se chhante gaye the. Yahudiyat, Nasraniyat, Islamiyat waghera sab ke ahkam ka woh majmo'a tha aur phir us mein bahut se ahkam woh bhi the, jo sirf apni aqli aur maslahat-e-waqt ke pesh-e-nazar ijad kiye gaye the, jin mein apni khwahish ki milawat bhi thi.

Pas wahi majmoo'ay un ki aulad mein qabil-e-amal thehar gaye aur isi ko Kitab-o-Sunnat par fauqiyat aur taqdeem de li. Darhaqiqat aisa karne wale kafir hain aur un se jihad wajib hai yahan tak ke woh laut kar Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hukm ki taraf aajayein aur kisi chote ya bade, ahem ya ghair-ahem mamle mein siwaye Kitab-o-Sunnat ke koi hukm kisi ka na lein. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke yeh jahiliyat ke ahkaam ka irada karte hain aur hukm-e-Rabb se sark rahe hain? Yaqeen walon ke liye Allah se behtar hukmran aur kar-farma kaun hoga? Allah se zyada adl-o-insaf wale ahkaam kis ke honge? Imaan-dar aur yaqeen-e-kamil wale bakhoobi jaante aur maante hain ke is Ahkam-ul-Hakimeen aur Arham-ur-Rahimeen se zyada achhe, saaf, sahal aur umda ahkaam-o-qawaid, masail-o-zawabit kisi ke bhi nahin ho sakte. Woh apni makhlooq par us se bhi zyada meharban hai jitni maa apni aulad par hoti hai, woh poore aur pukhta ilm wala, kamil aur azeem-ush-shan qudrat wala aur adl-o-insaf wala hai. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain "Allah ke faisle ke baghair jo fatwa de us ka fatwa jahiliyat ka hukm hai". Yeh hadith Bukhari mein bhi qadray alfaaz ki ziyadti ke sath hai.

Yeh tamam pehli Ilahi kitabon ko sacha manta hai aur un kitabon mein bhi is ki sifat-o-sana majood hai aur yeh bhi bayan un mein hai ke yeh pak aur aakhri kitab aakhri aur afzal Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utregi, pas har dana shakhs is par yaqeen rakhta hai aur ise manta hai." Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is ayat se pehle to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko azadi di gayi thi, agar chahein un mein faislay karein chahein na karein, lekin is ayat ne hukm diya ke Wahi-e-Ilahi ke sath un mein faislay karne zaroori hain, un bad-naseeb jahilon ne apni taraf se jo ahkam ghad liye hain aur un ki wajah se Kitabullah ko pas-e-pusht daal diya hai, khabardar ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tu un ki chahaton ke peeche lag kar haq ko na chhod baithna. Un mein se har ek ke liye hum ne rasta aur tariqa bana diya hai.

Kisi cheez ki taraf ibtida karne ko shir'ah kehte hain, minhaj lughat mein kehte hain wazeh aur aasaan raaste ko. Pas in dono lafzon ki yahi tafseer zyada munasib hai. Pehli tamam shari'atein jo Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se thin, woh sab tauheed par muttafiq thin, albatta chote mote ahkaam mein qadre her-pher tha. Jaise hadith-e-sharif mein hai "Hum sab ambiya allati bhai hain, hum sab ka deen ek hi hai, har nabi tauheed ke sath bheja jata raha aur har aasmani kitab mein tauheed ka bayan uska suboot aur usi ki taraf dawat di jati rahi". Jaise Quran farmata hai ke "Tujh se pehle jitne bhi rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum ne bheje, un sab ki taraf yahi wahi ki ke mere siwa koi mabood-e-haqiqi nahin, tum sab sirf meri hi ibadat karte raho". Aur aayat mein (Walaqad ba'athna fi kulli ummatir rasoolan ani'budullaha wajtanibut taghut) (16. An-Nahl: 36) hum ne har ummat ko bazaban-e-rasool kehla diya ke Allah ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa dusron ki ibadat se bacho. Ahkaam ka ikhtilaf zaroor, koi cheez kisi zamane mein haram thi phir halal ho gayi ya us ke bar-aks. Ya kisi hukm mein takhfeef thi ab takeed ho gayi ya us ke khilaf aur yeh bhi hikmat aur maslahat aur hujjat-e-rabbani ke sath maslan Taurat ek shari'at hai, Injeel ek shari'at hai, Quran ek mustaqil shari'at hai taake har zamane ke farmanbardaron aur nafarmanon ka imtehan ho jaya kare. Albatta tauheed sab zamonon mein yaksan rahi aur ma'ani is jumla ke yeh hain ke ae ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Tum mein se har shakhs ke liye hum ne apni is kitab Quran-e-Kareem ko shari'at aur tariqa banaya hai, tum sab ko is ki iqtida aur tabedari karni chahiye. Is surat mein ja'alna ke baad zameer 'ha' ki mehzoof manni paregi. Pas behtareen maqasid hasil karne ka zariya aur tariqa sirf Quran-e-Kareem hi hai lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai aur is ki ek daleel yeh bhi hai ke is ke baad hi farman hua hai ke agar Allah chahta to sab ko ek hi ummat kar deta. Pas maloom hua ke agla khitab sirf is ummat se hi nahin balki sab ummaton se hai aur is mein Allah Ta'ala ki bahut badi aur kamil qudrat ka bayan hai ke agar woh chahta to sab logon ko ek hi shari'at aur deen par kar deta koi tabdeeli kisi waqt na hoti. Lekin Rabb ki hikmat-e-kamilah ka taqaza yeh hua ke alaihda alaihda shari'atein muqarrar kare, ek ke baad dusra nabi bheje aur ba'az ahkaam agle nabi ke pichle nabi se badalwa de, yahan tak ke agle deen Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat se mansookh ho gaye aur Aap tamam roo-e-zameen ki taraf bheje gaye aur Khatam-ul-Anbiya bana kar bheje gaye. Yeh mukhtalif shari'atein sirf tumhari aazmaish ke liye huin taake tabedaron ko jaza aur nafarmanon ko saza mile. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke woh tumhein aazmaye, us cheez mein jo tumhein us ne di hai yani kitab. Pas tumhein khairat aur nekiyon ki taraf sabqat aur daud karni chahiye.

Allah ki ita'at, us ki shari'at ki farmanbardari ki taraf aage barhna chahiye aur is aakhri shari'at, aakhri kitab aur aakhri paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ba-dil-o-jaan farmanbardari karni chahiye. Logo! Tum sab ka marja-o-mawa aur lautna phirna Allah hi ki taraf hai, wahan woh tumhein tumhare ikhtilaf ki asliyat bata de ga. Sachon ko un ki sachai ka achha phal de ga aur buron ko un ki kaj-bahsi, sarkashi aur khwahish-e-nafs ki pairwi ki saza de ga. Jo haq ko manna to ek taraf balkeh haq se chirte hain aur muqabla karte hain. Zahhak kehte hain murad ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai, magar awwal hi awla hai. Phir pehli baat ki aur takeed ho rahi hai aur us ke khilaf se roka jata hai aur farmaya jata hai ke "Dekho kahin is khain, makkar, kazzab, kuffar-e-yahood ki baton mein aa kar Allah ke kisi hukm se idhar udhar na ho jana. Agar woh tere ahkam se ro-gardani karein aur shari'at ke khilaf karein to tu samajh le ke un ki siyah-kariyon ki wajah se Allah ka koi azab un par aane wala hai. Isi liye taufiq-e-khair un se chheen li gayi hai. Aksar log fasiq hain yani ita'at-e-haq se kharij. Allah ke deen ke mukhalif, hidayat se door hain." Jaise farmaya aayat (Wama aksarun-nasi walaw harasta bimu'mineen) (12. Yusuf: 103) yani go tu hirs kar ke chahe lekin aksar log momin nahin hain. Aur farmaya aayat (Wa-in tuti' aksara man fil-ardi yudilluka 'an sabeelillah) (6. Al-An'am: 116) agar tu zameen walon ki aksariyat ki mane ga to woh tujhe bhi rah-e-haq se behka dein ge. Yahudiyon ke chand bare bare ra'ison aur aalimon ne aapas mein ek meeting kar ke huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar arz kiya ke aap jante hain agar hum aap ko maan lein to tamam yahood aap ki nabuwwat ka iqrar kar lein ge aur hum aap ko manne ke liye tayyar hain, aap sirf itna kijiye ke hum mein aur hamari qoum mein ek jhagda hai, us ka faisla hamare mutabiq kar dijiye, aap ne inkar kar diya aur isi par yeh aayatein utrein. Is ke baad janab-e-Bari Ta'ala un logon ka zikr kar raha hai jo Allah ke hukm se hat jayen, jis mein tamam bhulaiyan majood aur tamam buraiyan door hain. Aise pak hukm se hat kar raye-o-qiyas ki taraf, khwahish-e-nafsani ki taraf aur un ahkam ki taraf jhuke jo logon ne az-khud apni taraf se baghair daleel-e-shar'i ke ghar liye hain jaise ke ahl-e-jahiliyat apni jahalat-o-zalalat aur apni raye aur apni marzi ke mutabiq hukm-e-ahkam jari kar liya karte the aur jaise ke tatari mulki mamlat mein Changez Khan ke ahkam ki pairwi karte the jo Ilyasaq ne ghar diye the. Woh bahut se ahkam ke majmo'e aur dafatir the jo mukhtalif shari'aton aur mazhabon se chhante gaye the. Yahudiyat, Nasraniyat, Islamiyat waghera sab ke ahkam ka woh majmo'a tha aur phir us mein bahut se ahkam woh bhi the, jo sirf apni aqli aur maslahat-e-waqt ke pesh-e-nazar ijad kiye gaye the, jin mein apni khwahish ki milawat bhi thi.

Pas wahi majmoo'ay un ki aulad mein qabil-e-amal thehar gaye aur isi ko Kitab-o-Sunnat par fauqiyat aur taqdeem de li. Darhaqiqat aisa karne wale kafir hain aur un se jihad wajib hai yahan tak ke woh laut kar Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hukm ki taraf aajayein aur kisi chote ya bade, ahem ya ghair-ahem mamle mein siwaye Kitab-o-Sunnat ke koi hukm kisi ka na lein. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke yeh jahiliyat ke ahkaam ka irada karte hain aur hukm-e-Rabb se sark rahe hain? Yaqeen walon ke liye Allah se behtar hukmran aur kar-farma kaun hoga? Allah se zyada adl-o-insaf wale ahkaam kis ke honge? Imaan-dar aur yaqeen-e-kamil wale bakhoobi jaante aur maante hain ke is Ahkam-ul-Hakimeen aur Arham-ur-Rahimeen se zyada achhe, saaf, sahal aur umda ahkaam-o-qawaid, masail-o-zawabit kisi ke bhi nahin ho sakte. Woh apni makhlooq par us se bhi zyada meharban hai jitni maa apni aulad par hoti hai, woh poore aur pukhta ilm wala, kamil aur azeem-ush-shan qudrat wala aur adl-o-insaf wala hai. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain "Allah ke faisle ke baghair jo fatwa de us ka fatwa jahiliyat ka hukm hai". Ek shakhs ne Hazrat Ta'oos (R.H) se poocha kya main apni aulad mein se ek ko zyada aur ek ko kam de sakta hoon? To aap ne yahi aayat padhi. Tabrani mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sab se bada Allah ka dushman woh hai jo Islam mein jahiliyat ka tareeqa aur heela talash kare aur be-wajah kisi ki gardan maarne ke darpay ho jaye. Yeh hadith Bukhari mein bhi qadray alfaaz ki ziyadti ke sath hai.

Dushman-e-Islam se dosti mana hai. Dushmanan-e-Islam Yahood-o-Nasara se dostiyan karne ki Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala muman'at farma raha hai aur farmata hai ke "Woh tumhare dost hargiz nahin ho sakte kyunke tumhare deen se unhein bughz-o-adawat hai. Haan apne walon se un ki dostiyan aur mohabbatain hain. Mere nazdeek toh jo bhi un se dili mohabbat rakhe woh un hi mein se hai". Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne Hazrat Abu Musa (R.A) ko is baat par poori tanbeeh ki aur yeh aayat parh sunayi. Hazrat Abdullah bin Utbah (R.H) ne farmaya logo! Tumhein is se bachna chahiye ke tumhein khud toh maloom na ho aur tum Allah ke nazdeek Yahood-o-Nasrani ban jao, hum samajh gaye ke aap ki murad isi aayat ke mazmoon se hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se Arab Nasraniyon ke zabiha ka masla poocha gaya toh aap ne yahi aayat tilawat ki. Jis ke dil mein khot hai woh toh lapak lapak kar posheeda taur par un se saaz-baaz aur mohabbat-o-mawaddat karte hain aur bahana yeh banate hain ke hamein khatra hai agar Musalmanon par yeh log ghalib aa gaye toh phir hamari tabahi kar denge, is liye hum un se bhi mel-milaap rakhte hain, hum kyun kisi se bigadein? Allah Ta'ala farmata hai mumkin hai Allah Musalmanon ko saaf taur par ghalib kar de, Makkah bhi un ke hathon fatah ho jaye, faisle aur hukm un hi ke chalne lagein, hukumat un ke qadmon mein sar daal de. Ya Allah Ta'ala aur koi cheez apne paas se laye yani Yahood-o-Nasara ko maghloob kar ke unhein zaleel kar ke un se jizya lene ka hukm Musalmanon ko de de phir toh yeh munafiqeen jo aaj lapak lapak kar un se gehri dosti karte phirte hain, bade bhunane lagenge aur apni is chalaki par khoon ke aansoo bahane lagenge. Un ke parde khul jayenge aur yeh jaise andar thay waise hi bahar se nazar aayenge. Us waqt Musalman un ki makkariyon par ta'ajjub karenge aur kahenge ae lo yahi woh log hain, jo badi badi qasmein kha kha kar hamein yaqeen dilate thay ke yeh hamare saathi hain. Unhon ne jo paya tha woh kho diya tha aur barbad ho gaye. (Wa yaqool) toh jamhoor ki qira'at hai. Ek qira'at baghair wao ke bhi hai, ahl-e-Madina ki yahi qira'at hai. Yaqool toh mubtada aur dusri qira'at is ki (yaqool) hai toh yeh (fa'asa) par atf hoga goya (wa in yaqool) hai. In aayaton ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke jang-e-Uhud ke baad ek shakhs ne kaha ke main is Yahoodi se dosti karta hoon taake mauqe par mujhe nafa pahunche, dusre ne kaha, main falan Nasrani ke paas jata hoon, us se dosti kar ke us ki madad karunga. Is par yeh aayatein utrein. Ikrimah (R.H) farmate hain "Lubaba bin Abdul Munzir ke bare mein yeh aayatein utrein jabke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein Banu Quraiza ki taraf bheja toh unhon ne aap se poocha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamare saath kya sulook karenge? Toh aap ne apne gale ki taraf ishara kiya yani tum sab ko qatl kara denge". Ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh aayatein Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salool ke bare mein utri hain. Hazrat Ubada bin Samit (R.A) ne Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke bahut se Yahoodiyon se meri dosti hai magar main un sab ki dostiyan todta hoon, mujhe Allah Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dosti kaafi hai.

Is par us munafiq ne kaha main door-andeshi hoon, door ki sochne ka aadi hoon, mujh se yeh na ho sake ga, na jaane kis waqt kya mauqa par jaye? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ae Abdullah tu Ubada ke muqable mein bahut hi ghate mein raha, is par yeh ayatein utrin. Ek riwayat mein hai ke "Jab Badr mein mushrikeen ko shikast hui to baaz musalmanon ne apne milne wale yahudiyon se kaha ke yahi tumhari halat ho, is se pehle hi tum is deen-e-barhaq ko qabool kar lo unhon ne jawab diya ke chand Quraishiyon par jo ladai ke funoon se be-bahra hain, fath-mandi hasil kar ke kahin tum maghroor na ho jana, hum se agar pala pada to hum to tumhein bata denge ke ladai ise kehte hain. Is par Hazrat Ubada aur Abdullah bin Ubay ka woh mukalma hua jo oopar bayan ho chuka hai. Jab yahudiyon ke is qabeela se musalmanon ki jang hui aur ba-fazl-e-Rabb yeh ghalib aa gaye to ab Abdullah bin Ubay aap se kehne laga, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere doston ke mamle mein mujh par ehsan kijiye, yeh log Khazraj ke sathi thay, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ise koi jawab na diya, us ne phir kaha, aap ne munh mod liya, yeh aap ke daman se chipak gaya, aap ne gussa se farmaya ke chhod de, us ne kaha nahin ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main na chhodunga, yahan tak ke aap un ke bare mein ehsan karein, un ki badi poori jamaat hai aur aaj tak yeh log mere tarafdar rahe aur ek hi din mein yeh sab fana ke ghat utar jayenge. Mujhe to aane wali musibaton ka khatka hai. Aakhir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, ja woh sab tere liye hain". Ek riwayat mein hai ke "Jab Banu Qainuqa ke yahudiyon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se jang ki aur Allah ne unhein neecha dikhaya to Abdullah bin Ubay un ki himayat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne karne laga aur Hazrat Ubada bin Samit ne bawajood-e-ke yeh bhi un ke haleef thay lekin unhon ne un se saaf bara'at zahir ki". Is par yeh ayatein (Hum-ul-Ghaliboon) tak utrin. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke "Is munafiq Abdullah bin Ubay ki ayadat ke liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef le gaye to aap ne farmaya, main ne to tujhe bar-ha in yahudiyon ki mohabbat se roka to us ne kaha Saad bin Zurara to un se dushmani rakhta tha woh bhi mar gaya".

Ibn Abbas (R.A) se Arab Nasraniyon ke zabiha ka masla poocha gaya toh aap ne yahi aayat tilawat ki. Jis ke dil mein khot hai woh toh lapak lapak kar posheeda taur par un se saaz-baaz aur mohabbat-o-mawaddat karte hain aur bahana yeh banate hain ke hamein khatra hai agar Musalmanon par yeh log ghalib aa gaye toh phir hamari tabahi kar denge, is liye hum un se bhi mel-milaap rakhte hain, hum kyun kisi se bigadein? Allah Ta'ala farmata hai mumkin hai Allah Musalmanon ko saaf taur par ghalib kar de, Makkah bhi un ke hathon fatah ho jaye, faisle aur hukm un hi ke chalne lagein, hukumat un ke qadmon mein sar daal de. Ya Allah Ta'ala aur koi cheez apne paas se laye yani Yahood-o-Nasara ko maghloob kar ke unhein zaleel kar ke un se jizya lene ka hukm Musalmanon ko de de phir toh yeh munafiqeen jo aaj lapak lapak kar un se gehri dosti karte phirte hain, bade bhunane lagenge aur apni is chalaki par khoon ke aansoo bahane lagenge. Un ke parde khul jayenge aur yeh jaise andar thay waise hi bahar se nazar aayenge. Us waqt Musalman un ki makkariyon par ta'ajjub karenge aur kahenge ae lo yahi woh log hain, jo badi badi qasmein kha kha kar hamein yaqeen dilate thay ke yeh hamare saathi hain. Unhon ne jo paya tha woh kho diya tha aur barbad ho gaye. (Wa yaqool) toh jamhoor ki qira'at hai. Ek qira'at baghair wao ke bhi hai, ahl-e-Madina ki yahi qira'at hai. Yaqool toh mubtada aur dusri qira'at is ki (yaqool) hai toh yeh (fa'asa) par atf hoga goya (wa in yaqool) hai. In aayaton ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke jang-e-Uhud ke baad ek shakhs ne kaha ke main is Yahoodi se dosti karta hoon taake mauqe par mujhe nafa pahunche, dusre ne kaha, main falan Nasrani ke paas jata hoon, us se dosti kar ke us ki madad karunga. Is par yeh aayatein utrein. Ikrimah (R.H) farmate hain "Lubaba bin Abdul Munzir ke bare mein yeh aayatein utrein jabke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein Banu Quraiza ki taraf bheja toh unhon ne aap se poocha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamare saath kya sulook karenge? Toh aap ne apne gale ki taraf ishara kiya yani tum sab ko qatl kara denge". Ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh aayatein Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salool ke bare mein utri hain. Hazrat Ubada bin Samit (R.A) ne Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke bahut se Yahoodiyon se meri dosti hai magar main un sab ki dostiyan todta hoon, mujhe Allah Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dosti kaafi hai.

Is par us munafiq ne kaha main door-andeshi hoon, door ki sochne ka aadi hoon, mujh se yeh na ho sake ga, na jaane kis waqt kya mauqa par jaye? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ae Abdullah tu Ubada ke muqable mein bahut hi ghate mein raha, is par yeh ayatein utrin. Ek riwayat mein hai ke "Jab Badr mein mushrikeen ko shikast hui to baaz musalmanon ne apne milne wale yahudiyon se kaha ke yahi tumhari halat ho, is se pehle hi tum is deen-e-barhaq ko qabool kar lo unhon ne jawab diya ke chand Quraishiyon par jo ladai ke funoon se be-bahra hain, fath-mandi hasil kar ke kahin tum maghroor na ho jana, hum se agar pala pada to hum to tumhein bata denge ke ladai ise kehte hain. Is par Hazrat Ubada aur Abdullah bin Ubay ka woh mukalma hua jo oopar bayan ho chuka hai. Jab yahudiyon ke is qabeela se musalmanon ki jang hui aur ba-fazl-e-Rabb yeh ghalib aa gaye to ab Abdullah bin Ubay aap se kehne laga, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere doston ke mamle mein mujh par ehsan kijiye, yeh log Khazraj ke sathi thay, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ise koi jawab na diya, us ne phir kaha, aap ne munh mod liya, yeh aap ke daman se chipak gaya, aap ne gussa se farmaya ke chhod de, us ne kaha nahin ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main na chhodunga, yahan tak ke aap un ke bare mein ehsan karein, un ki badi poori jamaat hai aur aaj tak yeh log mere tarafdar rahe aur ek hi din mein yeh sab fana ke ghat utar jayenge. Mujhe to aane wali musibaton ka khatka hai. Aakhir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, ja woh sab tere liye hain". Ek riwayat mein hai ke "Jab Banu Qainuqa ke yahudiyon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se jang ki aur Allah ne unhein neecha dikhaya to Abdullah bin Ubay un ki himayat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne karne laga aur Hazrat Ubada bin Samit ne bawajood-e-ke yeh bhi un ke haleef thay lekin unhon ne un se saaf bara'at zahir ki". Is par yeh ayatein (Hum-ul-Ghaliboon) tak utrin. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke "Is munafiq Abdullah bin Ubay ki ayadat ke liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef le gaye to aap ne farmaya, main ne to tujhe bar-ha in yahudiyon ki mohabbat se roka to us ne kaha Saad bin Zurara to un se dushmani rakhta tha woh bhi mar gaya".

Quwwat-e-Islam aur Murtadeen: Allah Rabbul Izzat jo Qadir-o-Ghalib hai khabar deta hai ke agar koi is pak deen se murtad hojaye toh woh Islam ki quwwat ghata nahin dega, Allah Ta'ala aise logon ke badle un logon ko is sachay deen ki khidmat par mamoor karega, jo un se har haisiyat mein achay honge. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa in tatallau) aur aayat mein hai (In yasha' yudhhibkum ayyuhan-nasu wa ya'ti bi-akharin) (Surah An-Nisa: 133) aur jagah farmaya (In yasha' yudhhibkum wa ya'ti bi-khalqin jadid) (Surah Fatir: 16), matlab in sab aayaton ka wahi hai jo bayan hua. Irtidad kehte hain, haq ko chhod kar batil ki taraf phir jaane ko. Muhammad bin Ka'ab R.H farmate hain yeh aayat sardaran-e-Quraish ke bare mein utri hai. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain "Khilafat-e-Siddiq R.A mein jo log Islam se phir gaye thay, un ka hukum is aayat mein hai. Jis qoum ko un ke badle lane ka wada de raha hai woh Ahl-e-Qadisiya hain ya qoum-e-Saba hai. Ya Ahl-e-Yaman hain jo Kinda aur Sakoon-e-Bila ke hain". Ek bahut hi ghareeb marfoo hadith mein bhi yeh pichli baat bayan hui hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari R.A ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya woh is ki qoum hai. Ab in kamil iman walon ki sifat bayan ho rahi hai ke "Yeh apne doston yani musalmanon ke samne toh bichh jaane wale, jhuk jaane wale hote hain aur kuffar ke muqable mein tan jaane wale, un par bhari padne wale aur un par tez hone wale hote hain". Jaise farmaya aayat (Ashidda'u 'alal-kuffari ruhama'u bainahum) (Surah Al-Fath: 29). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifaton mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khanda mizaj bhi thay aur qattal bhi yani doston ke samne hans mukh khanda-roo aur dushmanan-e-deen ke muqable mein sakht aur jangju, sachay musalman rah-e-haq ke jihad se na munh modte hain, na peeth dikhate hain, na thakte hain, na buzdili aur aaram talbi karte hain, na kisi ki murawwat mein aate hain, na kisi ki malamat ka khauf karte hain, woh barabar ita'at-e-Ilahi mein us ke dushmanon se jang karne mein bhala'i ka hukum karne mein aur buraiyon se rokne mein mashghool rehte hain. Hazrat Abu Zar R.A farmate hain "Mujhe mere Khaleel (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne saat baton ka hukum diya hai. Maskeenon se mohabbat rakhne, un ke sath baithne uthne aur dunyawi umoor mein apne se kam darje ke logon ko dekhne aur apne se badhe huon ko na dekhne, sila-rehmi karte rehne, go dusre na karte hon aur kisi se kuch bhi na mangne, haq baat bayan karne ka go woh sab ko kadwi lage aur deen ke mamlat mein kisi malamat karne wale ki malamat se na darne ka aur ba-kasrat La-haula wala quwwata illa billah padhne ka, kyunke yeh kalma Arsh ke niche ka khazana hai". (Musnad-e-Ahmad) Ek riwayat mein hai "Main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se paanch martaba bai'at ki hai aur saat baton ki Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe yaad-dihani ki hai aur saat martaba apne upar Allah ko gawah karta hoon ke main Allah ke deen ke bare mein kisi badgo ki badgoi ki mutlaq parwah nahin karta".

Mujhe bula kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya mujh se Jannat ke badle mein bai'at karega? Main ne manzoor kar ke haath barhaya toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne shart ki ke kisi se kuch bhi na maangna. Main ne kaha bahut achha, farmaya agarche koda bhi ho. Ya'ni agar woh gir pade toh khud sawari se utar kar le lena (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain "Logon ki haibat mein aa kar haq-goi se na rukna, yaad rakho na toh koi maut ko qareeb kar sakta hai, na rizq ko door kar sakta hai". Mulahiza ho Imam Ahmad ki Musnad. "Farmate hain khilaf-e-shar'a amr dekh kar, sun kar apne tayin kamzor jaan kar, khamosh na ho jana. Warna Allah ke haan is ki baaz-purs hogi, us waqt insaan jawab de ga ke main logon ke darr se chupka ho gaya toh Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala farmaye ga, main is ka zyada haqdar tha ke tu mujh se darta". (Musnad-e-Ahmad) Farmate hain Allah Ta'ala apne bande se Qayamat ke din ek sawal yeh bhi kare ga ke tu ne logon ko khilaf-e-shar'a kaam karte dekh kar us se roka kyun nahin? Phir Allah Ta'ala khud hi use jawab samjhaye ga aur yeh kahe ga Parwardigar main ne tujh par bharosa kiya aur logon se dara (Ibn-e-Majah). Ek aur sahih hadith mein hai "Momin ko na chahiye ke apne tayin zillat mein daale, Sahaba ne poocha, yeh kis tarah? Farmaya un balaon ko apne oopar le le, jin ki bardasht ki taqat na ho. Phir farmaya Allah ka fazl hai jise chahe de. Ya'ni kamal-e-iman ki yeh sifatein khaas Allah ka atiya hain, usi ki taraf se in ki taufeeq hoti hai, us ka fazl bahut hi wasee hai aur woh kamil ilm wala hai, khoob jaanta hai ke is bahut badi ne'amat ka mustahiq kaun hai? Phir irshad hota hai ke tumhare dost kuffar nahin balkay haqeeqatan tumhein Allah se, us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur mominon se dostiyan rakhni chahiyen. Momin bhi woh jin mein yeh sifatein hon ke woh namaz ke pooray paband hon, jo Islam ka a'ala aur behtareen rukn hai aur sirf Allah ka haq hai aur Zakat ada karte hain jo Allah ke za'eef maskeen bandon ka haq hai". Aur aakhri jumla jo hai us ki nisbat ba'az logon ko wahm sa ho gaya hai ke yeh (Yutoona-z-Zakat) se haal waqay ya'ni ruku ki halat mein Zakat ada karte hain. Yeh bilkul ghalat hai. Agar ise maan liya jaye toh yeh toh numaya taur par sabit ho jaye ga ke ruku ki halat mein Zakat dena afzal hai halankeh koi aalim is ka qail hi nahin, in wahmiyon ne yahan ek waqia bayan kiya hai ke Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib namaz ke ruku mein thay jo ek saail aa gaya toh Aap (R.A) ne apni angoothi utaar kar use de di, (Wallazeena Aamano) se murad baqol Utba jumla musalman aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) hain. Is par yeh aayat utri hai. Ek marfoo hadith mein bhi angoothi ka qissa hai aur ba'az deegar mufassireen ne bhi yeh tafseer ki hai lekin sanad ek ki bhi sahih nahin, rijal ek ke bhi siqa aur sabit nahin, pas yeh waqia bilkul ghair sabit shuda hai aur sahih nahin.

Theek rahi hai jo hum pehle bayan kar chuke hain ke yeh sab aayatein Hazrat Ubada bin Samit (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hui hain jabke unhon ne khule lafzon mein Yahood ki dosti todi aur Allah aur uske Rasool (ﷺ) aur ba-imaan logon ki dosti rakhe woh Allah ke lashkar mein dakhil hai aur yahi Allah ka lashkar ghalib hai. Jaise farman-e-Bari Ta'ala hai aayat (كَتَبَ اللّٰهُ لَاَغْلِبَنَّ اَنَا وَرُسُلِيْ) (Surah Al-Mujadila: 21), yani Allah Ta'ala yeh dekh chuka hai ke main aur mere Rasool (ﷺ) hi ghalib rahenge. Allah par aur aakhirat par imaan rakhne walon ko toh Allah aur Rasool (ﷺ) ke dushmanon se dosti rakhne wala kabhi pasand na aayega chahe woh baap, bete, bhai aur kunbe qabile ke logon mein se hi kyun na ho, yahi hain jin ke dilon mein Allah ne imaan likh diya hai aur apni rooh se un ki ta'eed ki hai, unhein Allah Ta'ala un jannaton mein le jayega, jin ke neeche nehrein beh rahi hain, jahan woh hamesha rahenge, Rabb un se raazi hai, yeh Allah se khush hain, yahi Allah ke lashkar hain aur Allah hi ka lashkar falah paane wala hai. Pas jo Allah aur uske Rasool (ﷺ) aur mominon ki dosti par raazi aur razamand ho jaye, woh duniya mein faateh hai aur aakhirat mein falah paane wala hai. Isi liye is aayat ko bhi is jumle par khatam kiya.

Quwwat-e-Islam aur Murtadeen: Allah Rabbul Izzat jo Qadir-o-Ghalib hai khabar deta hai ke agar koi is pak deen se murtad hojaye toh woh Islam ki quwwat ghata nahin dega, Allah Ta'ala aise logon ke badle un logon ko is sachay deen ki khidmat par mamoor karega, jo un se har haisiyat mein achay honge. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa in tatallau) aur aayat mein hai (In yasha' yudhhibkum ayyuhan-nasu wa ya'ti bi-akharin) (Surah An-Nisa: 133) aur jagah farmaya (In yasha' yudhhibkum wa ya'ti bi-khalqin jadid) (Surah Fatir: 16), matlab in sab aayaton ka wahi hai jo bayan hua. Irtidad kehte hain, haq ko chhod kar batil ki taraf phir jaane ko. Muhammad bin Ka'ab R.H farmate hain yeh aayat sardaran-e-Quraish ke bare mein utri hai. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain "Khilafat-e-Siddiq R.A mein jo log Islam se phir gaye thay, un ka hukum is aayat mein hai. Jis qoum ko un ke badle lane ka wada de raha hai woh Ahl-e-Qadisiya hain ya qoum-e-Saba hai. Ya Ahl-e-Yaman hain jo Kinda aur Sakoon-e-Bila ke hain". Ek bahut hi ghareeb marfoo hadith mein bhi yeh pichli baat bayan hui hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari R.A ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya woh is ki qoum hai. Ab in kamil iman walon ki sifat bayan ho rahi hai ke "Yeh apne doston yani musalmanon ke samne toh bichh jaane wale, jhuk jaane wale hote hain aur kuffar ke muqable mein tan jaane wale, un par bhari padne wale aur un par tez hone wale hote hain". Jaise farmaya aayat (Ashidda'u 'alal-kuffari ruhama'u bainahum) (Surah Al-Fath: 29). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifaton mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khanda mizaj bhi thay aur qattal bhi yani doston ke samne hans mukh khanda-roo aur dushmanan-e-deen ke muqable mein sakht aur jangju, sachay musalman rah-e-haq ke jihad se na munh modte hain, na peeth dikhate hain, na thakte hain, na buzdili aur aaram talbi karte hain, na kisi ki murawwat mein aate hain, na kisi ki malamat ka khauf karte hain, woh barabar ita'at-e-Ilahi mein us ke dushmanon se jang karne mein bhala'i ka hukum karne mein aur buraiyon se rokne mein mashghool rehte hain. Hazrat Abu Zar R.A farmate hain "Mujhe mere Khaleel (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne saat baton ka hukum diya hai. Maskeenon se mohabbat rakhne, un ke sath baithne uthne aur dunyawi umoor mein apne se kam darje ke logon ko dekhne aur apne se badhe huon ko na dekhne, sila-rehmi karte rehne, go dusre na karte hon aur kisi se kuch bhi na mangne, haq baat bayan karne ka go woh sab ko kadwi lage aur deen ke mamlat mein kisi malamat karne wale ki malamat se na darne ka aur ba-kasrat La-haula wala quwwata illa billah padhne ka, kyunke yeh kalma Arsh ke niche ka khazana hai". (Musnad-e-Ahmad) Ek riwayat mein hai "Main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se paanch martaba bai'at ki hai aur saat baton ki Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe yaad-dihani ki hai aur saat martaba apne upar Allah ko gawah karta hoon ke main Allah ke deen ke bare mein kisi badgo ki badgoi ki mutlaq parwah nahin karta".

Mujhe bula kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya mujh se Jannat ke badle mein bai'at karega? Main ne manzoor kar ke haath barhaya toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne shart ki ke kisi se kuch bhi na maangna. Main ne kaha bahut achha, farmaya agarche koda bhi ho. Ya'ni agar woh gir pade toh khud sawari se utar kar le lena (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain "Logon ki haibat mein aa kar haq-goi se na rukna, yaad rakho na toh koi maut ko qareeb kar sakta hai, na rizq ko door kar sakta hai". Mulahiza ho Imam Ahmad ki Musnad. "Farmate hain khilaf-e-shar'a amr dekh kar, sun kar apne tayin kamzor jaan kar, khamosh na ho jana. Warna Allah ke haan is ki baaz-purs hogi, us waqt insaan jawab de ga ke main logon ke darr se chupka ho gaya toh Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala farmaye ga, main is ka zyada haqdar tha ke tu mujh se darta". (Musnad-e-Ahmad) Farmate hain Allah Ta'ala apne bande se Qayamat ke din ek sawal yeh bhi kare ga ke tu ne logon ko khilaf-e-shar'a kaam karte dekh kar us se roka kyun nahin? Phir Allah Ta'ala khud hi use jawab samjhaye ga aur yeh kahe ga Parwardigar main ne tujh par bharosa kiya aur logon se dara (Ibn-e-Majah). Ek aur sahih hadith mein hai "Momin ko na chahiye ke apne tayin zillat mein daale, Sahaba ne poocha, yeh kis tarah? Farmaya un balaon ko apne oopar le le, jin ki bardasht ki taqat na ho. Phir farmaya Allah ka fazl hai jise chahe de. Ya'ni kamal-e-iman ki yeh sifatein khaas Allah ka atiya hain, usi ki taraf se in ki taufeeq hoti hai, us ka fazl bahut hi wasee hai aur woh kamil ilm wala hai, khoob jaanta hai ke is bahut badi ne'amat ka mustahiq kaun hai? Phir irshad hota hai ke tumhare dost kuffar nahin balkay haqeeqatan tumhein Allah se, us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur mominon se dostiyan rakhni chahiyen. Momin bhi woh jin mein yeh sifatein hon ke woh namaz ke pooray paband hon, jo Islam ka a'ala aur behtareen rukn hai aur sirf Allah ka haq hai aur Zakat ada karte hain jo Allah ke za'eef maskeen bandon ka haq hai". Aur aakhri jumla jo hai us ki nisbat ba'az logon ko wahm sa ho gaya hai ke yeh (Yutoona-z-Zakat) se haal waqay ya'ni ruku ki halat mein Zakat ada karte hain. Yeh bilkul ghalat hai. Agar ise maan liya jaye toh yeh toh numaya taur par sabit ho jaye ga ke ruku ki halat mein Zakat dena afzal hai halankeh koi aalim is ka qail hi nahin, in wahmiyon ne yahan ek waqia bayan kiya hai ke Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib namaz ke ruku mein thay jo ek saail aa gaya toh Aap (R.A) ne apni angoothi utaar kar use de di, (Wallazeena Aamano) se murad baqol Utba jumla musalman aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) hain. Is par yeh aayat utri hai. Ek marfoo hadith mein bhi angoothi ka qissa hai aur ba'az deegar mufassireen ne bhi yeh tafseer ki hai lekin sanad ek ki bhi sahih nahin, rijal ek ke bhi siqa aur sabit nahin, pas yeh waqia bilkul ghair sabit shuda hai aur sahih nahin.

Theek rahi hai jo hum pehle bayan kar chuke hain ke yeh sab aayatein Hazrat Ubada bin Samit (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hui hain jabke unhon ne khule lafzon mein Yahood ki dosti todi aur Allah aur uske Rasool (ﷺ) aur ba-imaan logon ki dosti rakhe woh Allah ke lashkar mein dakhil hai aur yahi Allah ka lashkar ghalib hai. Jaise farman-e-Bari Ta'ala hai aayat (كَتَبَ اللّٰهُ لَاَغْلِبَنَّ اَنَا وَرُسُلِيْ) (Surah Al-Mujadila: 21), yani Allah Ta'ala yeh dekh chuka hai ke main aur mere Rasool (ﷺ) hi ghalib rahenge. Allah par aur aakhirat par imaan rakhne walon ko toh Allah aur Rasool (ﷺ) ke dushmanon se dosti rakhne wala kabhi pasand na aayega chahe woh baap, bete, bhai aur kunbe qabile ke logon mein se hi kyun na ho, yahi hain jin ke dilon mein Allah ne imaan likh diya hai aur apni rooh se un ki ta'eed ki hai, unhein Allah Ta'ala un jannaton mein le jayega, jin ke neeche nehrein beh rahi hain, jahan woh hamesha rahenge, Rabb un se raazi hai, yeh Allah se khush hain, yahi Allah ke lashkar hain aur Allah hi ka lashkar falah paane wala hai. Pas jo Allah aur uske Rasool (ﷺ) aur mominon ki dosti par raazi aur razamand ho jaye, woh duniya mein faateh hai aur aakhirat mein falah paane wala hai. Isi liye is aayat ko bhi is jumle par khatam kiya.

Azan aur Dushmanan-e-Deen Allah Ta'ala Musalmanon ko ghair muslimon ki mohabbat se nafrat dilata hai aur farmata hai ke "Kya tum un se dostiyan karoge jo tumhare tahir-o-mutahhar deen ki hansi udate hain aur ise ek bazicha-e-atfal banaye hue hain". Min bayan-e-jins ke liye hai jaise (min-al-ausan) mein. Baaz ne (wal-kuffar) parha hai aur atf dala hai aur baaz ne (wal-kuffar) parha hai aur (la-tattakhizu) ka naya mamool banaya hai to taqdeer-e-ibarat (wa-lal-kuffari auliya) hogi, kuffar se murad mushrikeen hain, Ibn-e-Masood R.A ki qirat mein (wa-min-allazina ashraku) hai. Allah se daro aur un se dostiyan na karo agar tum sache momin ho. Yeh to tumhare deen ke, Allah ki shariat ke dushman hain. Jaise farmaya ayat (La yattakhizil-mu'minunal-kafirina auliya'a min dunil-mu'minin) (Surah Al-Imran: 28) Momin mominon ko chhor kar kuffar se dostiyan na karen aur jo aisa kare woh Allah ke han kisi bhalai mein nahin, han un se bachao maqsood ho to aur baat hai, Allah Ta'ala tumhein apni zaat se dara raha hai aur Allah hi ki taraf lautna hai. Isi tarah yeh kuffar Ahl-e-Kitab aur mushrik us waqt bhi mazaq udate hain jab tum namazon ke liye logon ko pukarte ho halanke woh Allah Ta'ala ki sab se pyari ibadat hai, lekin yeh bewaqoof itna bhi nahin jante, is liye ke yeh muttabi-e-shaitan hain, us ki yeh halat hai ke azan sunte hi badbu chhor kar dum dabaye bhagta hai aur wahan ja kar thaharta hai, jahan azan ki awaz na sun paye. Is ke baad aa jata hai phir takbeer sun kar bhag khara hota hai aur us ke khatam hote hi aa kar apne behkawe mein lag jata hai, insan ko idhar udhar ki bhuli bisri baatein yaad dilata hai yahan tak ke use yeh bhi khabar nahin rahti ke namaz ki kitni rakat parhin? Jab aisa ho to woh sajda-e-sahw kar le. (Muttafaqun Alaih) Imam Zuhri R.H farmate hain "Azan ka zikr Quran-e-Kareem mein bhi hai phir yahi ayat tilawat ki". Ek nasrani Madine mein tha, azan mein jab Ash-hadu anna Muhammadar-Rasulullah sunta to kehta kazzab jal jaye. Ek martaba raat ko us ki khadima ghar mein aag layi, koi patanga ura jis se ghar mein aag lag gayi, woh shakhs us ka ghar bar sab jal kar khatam ho gaya. Fatah-e-Makkah wale saal Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Bilal R.A ko Kabe mein azan kehne ka hukum diya, qareeb hi Abu Sufyan bin Harb, Attab bin Asid, Haris bin Hisham baithe hue the, Attab ne to azan sun kar kaha mere baap par to Allah ka fazl hua ke woh is gussa dilane wali awaz ke sunne se pehle hi duniya se chal basa. Haris kehne laga agar main ise sacha janta to maan hi na leta.

Abu Sufyan ne kaha bhai main toh kuch bhi zaban se nahin nikalta, dar hai ke kahin yeh kankariyan use khabar na kardein. Unhon ne baatein khatam ki hi thin ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aa gaye aur farmane lage is waqt tum ne yeh yeh baatein ki hain, yeh sunte hi Attab aur Haris toh bol pade ke hamari gawahi hai ke aap Allah ke sachay Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain, yahan toh koi chautha tha hi nahin, warna guman kar sakte thay ke us ne ja kar aap se keh diya hoga (Seerat-e-Muhammad bin Ishaq). Hazrat Abdullah bin Jubair jab Sham ke safar ko jaane lage toh Hazrat Mahzoorah se jin ki god mein unhon ne ayyam-e-yateemi basar kiye thay, kaha aap ki azan ke bare mein mujh se wahan ke log zaroor sawal karenge toh aap apne waqiat toh mujhe bata dijiye. Farmaya haan suno jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hunain se wapas aa rahe thay, raaste mein hum log ek jagah rukay, toh namaz ke waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke muazzin ne azan kahi, hum ne us ka mazaq urana shuru kiya, kahin aap ke kaan mein bhi awazein par gayin. Sipahi aaya aur hamein aap ke paas le gaya. Aap ne daryaft farmaya ke tum sab mein zyada unchi awaz kis ki thi? Sab ne meri taraf ishara kiya toh aap ne aur sab ko chhor diya aur mujhe rok liya aur farmaya "Utho azan kaho". Wallah us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaat se aur aap ki farmanbardari se zyada buri cheez mere nazdeek koi na thi lekin bebas tha, khara ho gaya, ab khud aap ne mujhe azan sikhayi aur jo sikhate rahe, main kehta raha, phir azan poori bayan ki, jab main azan se farigh hua toh aap ne mujhe ek thaili di, jis mein chandi thi, phir apna dast-e-mubarak mere sar par rakha aur peeth tak laye, phir farmaya Allah tujh mein aur tujh par apni barkat nazil kare. Ab toh Allah ki qasam mere dil se Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki adawat bilkul jati rahi, aisi mohabbat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dil mein paida ho gayi, main ne aarzoo ki ke Makkah ka muazzin Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujh ko bana dein. Aap ne meri yeh darkhwast manzoor farma li aur main Makkah mein chala gaya aur wahan ke governor Hazrat Attab bin Usaid se mil kar azan par mamoor ho gaya. Hazrat Abu Mahzoorah ka naam Samurah bin Mughirah bin Lozan tha, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chaar muazzinon mein se ek aap thay aur lambi muddat tak aap Ahl-e-Makkah ke muazzin rahe. (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) wa arzah.

Badtareen giroh aur us ka anjam hukm hota hai ke jo Ahl-e-Kitab tumhare deen par mazaq urate hain, un se kaho ke tum ne jo dushmani hum se kar rakhi hai, us ki koi wajah is ke siwa nahin ke hum Allah par aur us ki tamam kitabon par iman rakhte hain. Pas darasal na to yeh koi wajah-e-bughz hai, na sabab-e-mazammat ba-istisna-e-munqata hai. Aur ayat mein hai (Wama naqamu minhum illa ay-yu'minu billahil-azizil-hamid) (Surah Al-Buruj: 8) yani faqat is wajah se unhon ne un se dushmani ki thi ke woh Allah Aziz-o-Hamid ko mante thay. Aur jaise aur ayat mein Wama naqamu illa an aghnahumullahu wa rasuluhu min fadlihi. Yani unhon ne sirf is ka inteqam liya hai ke unhein Allah ne apne fazl se aur Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne maal de kar ghani kar diya hai. Bukhari Muslim ki hadith mein hai "Ibn-e-Jameel isi ka badla leta hai ke woh faqeer tha to Allah ne use ghani kar diya aur yeh ke tum mein se aksar sirat-e-mustaqeem se alag aur kharij ho chuke hain. Tum jo hamari nisbat guman rakhte ho aao main tumhein bataun ke Allah ke yahan se badla paane mein kaun badtar hai? Aur woh tum ho ke kyunke yeh khaslatein tum mein hi payi jati hain. Yani jise Allah ne la'nat ki ho, apni rahmat se door phenk diya ho, us par ghasabnak hua ho, aisa jis ke baad razamand nahin hoga aur jin mein se ba'az ki suratein bigar di hon, bandar aur suar bana diye hon". Is ka poora bayan Surah Baqarah mein guzar chuka hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke yeh bandar-o-suar wahi hain? To aap ne farmaya, jis qaum par Allah ka aisa azab nazil hota hai, un ki nasl hi nahin hoti, un se pehle bhi suar aur bandar thay. Riwayat mukhtalif alfaz mein Sahih Muslim aur Nasai mein bhi hai. Musnad mein hai ke "Jinnon ki ek qaum saanp bana di gayi thi. Jaise ke bandar aur suar bana diye gaye thay". Yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai. Inhi mein se ba'az ko ghair-ullah ke parastar bana diye. Ek qira'at mein izafat ke sath Taghoot ki zer se bhi hai. Yani unhein buton ka ghulam bana diya. Hazrat Bureeda Aslami ise (Abid-ut-Taghoot) parhte thay. Hazrat Abu Ja'far Qari se (Wa 'abad-ut-Taghoot) bhi manqool hai jo ba'eed az ma'ni ho jata hai lekin fil-waq'a aisa nahin hota matlab yeh hai ke tum hi woh ho, jinhon ne Taghoot ki ibadat ki. Phir munafiqon ki ek aur bad-khaslat bayan ki ja rahi hai ke "Zahir mein to woh mominon ke samne iman ka izhar karte hain aur un ke batin kufr se bhare pare hain".

Yeh tere kufr ki halat mein paas aate hain aur isi halat mein tere paas se jaate hain toh teri baatein, teri naseehatein un par kuch asar nahin kartin. Bhala yeh parda-dari unhein kya kaam aayegi, jis se un ka mamla hai, woh toh Aalim-ul-Ghaib hai, dilon ke bhed us par roshan hain. Wahan ja kar poora poora badla bhugatna padega. Tu dekh raha hai ke yeh log gunahon par, haram par aur batil ke sath logon ke maal par kis tarah chadh daudte hain? Un ke aamal nihayat hi kharab ho chuke hain. Un ke Auliya-e-Allah yani aabid-o-aalim aur un ke ulama unhein in baaton se kyun nahin rokte? Dar-asal un ke ulama aur peeron ke aamal badtareen ho gaye hain". Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke "Ulama aur fuqara ki daant ke liye is se zyada sakht aayat koi nahin". Hazrat Zahhak R.H se bhi isi tarah manqool hai. Hazrat Ali R.A ne ek khutbe mein Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana ke baad farmaya "Logon tum se agle log isi bina par halak kar diye gaye ke woh buraiyan karte the toh un ke aalim aur Allah wale khamosh rehte the, jab yeh aadat un mein pukhta ho gayi toh Allah ne unhein qisam qisam ki sazayein dein. Pas tumhein chahiye ke bhalai ka hukum karo, burai se roko, is se pehle ke tum par bhi wahi azab aa jayein jo tum se pehle walon par aaye, yaqeen rakho ke achai ka hukum aur burai se mumanat na toh tumhare rozi ghatayega, na tumhare maut qareeb kar dega". Rasool Allah ﷺ ka farman hai ke "Jis qoum mein koi Allah ki nafarmani kare aur woh log bawajood rokne ki qudrat aur ghalbe ke use na mitayein toh Allah Ta'ala sab par apna azab nazil farmayega" (Musnad Ahmad). Abu Dawood mein hai ke "Yeh azab un ki maut se pehle hi aayega". Ibn Majah mein bhi yeh riwayat hai.

Bukhl se bacho aur fazool kharchi se haath roko. Allah Ta'ala mal'oon Yahudiyon ka ek khabeeth qaul bayan farma raha hai ke yeh Allah ko bakheel kehte thay, yahi log Allah ko faqeer bhi kehte hain. Allah ki zaat unke is naapak maqoolay se bahut buland-o-bala hai. Pas Allah ke haath bandhay hue hain, matlab unka yeh na tha ke haath jakar diye gaye hain balkay muraad is se bukhl tha. Yahi muhawara Quran mein aur jagah bhi hai, farmata hai aayat (Wala taj'al yadaka maghloolatan ila unuqika wala tabsut-ha kullal basti fataq'uda maloomam mahsoora) (17. Al-Isra: 29) yani apne haath apni gardan se baandh bhi na le aur na had se zyada phaila de ke phir thakaan aur nadamat ke saath baithay rehna paray, pas bukhl se aur israaf se Allah ne is aayat mein roka. Pas mal'oon Yahudiyon ki bhi haath bandha hua honay se yahi muraad thi. Fahaas naami Yahudi ne yeh kaha tha aur usi mal'oon ka woh doosra qaul bhi tha ke Allah faqeer hai aur hum ghani hain. Jis par Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ne usay peeta tha. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Shammaas bin Qais ne yahi kaha tha jis par yeh aayat utri. Aur irshad hua ke bakheel aur kanjoos, zaleel aur buzdil yeh log khud hain. Chunancha aur aayat mein hai ke agar yeh baadshah ban jayen to kisi ko kuch bhi na dein. Balkay yeh to auron ki ne'matein dekh kar jaltay hain. Yeh zaleel-tar log hain. Balkay Allah ke haath khulay hain woh sab kuch kharch karta rehta hai, uska fazl wasee hai, uski bakhshish aam hai, har cheez ke khazanay uske haathon mein hain. Har ne'mat uski taraf se hai. Saari makhlooq din raat har waqt har jagah usi ki mohtaaj hai. Farmata hai aayat (Wa-aataakum min kulli ma sa'altumoohu wa-in ta'uddoo ni'matallahi la tuhsooha innal insana lazaloomun kaffar) (14. Ibrahim: 34). "Tum ne jo maanga, Allah ne diya, agar tum Allah ki ne'maton ka shumaar karna chaho to shumaar bhi nahin kar sakte, yaqeenan insaan bara hi zaalim behad nashukra hai". Musnad mein hadees hai ke "Allah Ta'ala ka daahina haath oopar hai, din raat ka kharch uske khazanay ko ghatata nahin, shuru se le kar aaj tak jo kuch bhi usne apni makhlooq ko ata farmaya, usne uske khazanay mein koi kami nahin ki. Uska Arsh pehle paani par tha, usi ke haath mein faiz hi faiz hai, wahi buland aur past karta hai. Uska farmaan hai ke logo tum meri raah mein kharch karoge tum to diye jaoge". Bukhari Muslim mein bhi yeh hadees hai. Phir farmaya "Ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Jis qadar Allah ki ne'matein tum par zyada hongi, utna hi in shayateen ka kufr, hasad aur jalapa barhay ga. Theek isi tarah jis tarah mominon ka imaan aur unki tasleem-o-ita'at barhti hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai: (Qul huwa lillazeena aamanoo hudan washifa'un) (41. Fussilat: 44). Imaan walon ke liye to yeh hidayat-o-shifa hai aur be-imaan is se andhay behray hotay hain. Yahi hain jo darwazay se pukaray jatay hain.

Aur aayat mein hai (Wa nunazzilu minal Qur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatul lil-mu'mineen, wa la yazeeduz-zalimeena illa khasara) (Surah Al-Isra: 82) hum ne woh Qur'an utara hai jo mominon ke liye shifa aur rahmat hai aur zalimon ka toh nuqsan hi barhta rehta hai. Phir irshad hua ke un ke dilon mein se khud aapas ka bughz-o-bair bhi Qayamat tak nahin mite ga, ek dusre ka aapas mein hi khoon peene wale log hain. Namumkin hai ke yeh haq par jam jayen, yeh apne hi deen mein firqa firqa ho rahe hain, un ke jhagray aur adawatein aapas mein jaari hain aur jaari rahengi. Yeh log basa auqat larai ke saman karte hain, tere khilaf charon taraf ek aag bharkana chahte hain lekin har martaba munh ki khatay hain, un ka makr unhi par laut jata hai, yeh mufsid log hain aur Allah ke dushman hain, kisi mufsid ko Allah apna dost nahin banata. Agar yeh ba-iman aur parhezgar ban jayen toh hum un se tamam dar door kar dein aur asal maqsad-e-hayat se unhein mila dein. Agar yeh Taurat-o-Injeel aur is Qur'an ko maan lein kyunke Taurat-o-Injeel ka manna, Qur'an ke manne ko lazim kar de ga, in kitabon ki sahih taleem yahi hai ke yeh Qur'an saccha hai is ki aur Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq pehle ki kitabon mein majood hai toh agar yeh apni in kitabon ko baghair tahrif-o-tabdeel aur ta'weel-o-tafseer ke manein toh woh unhein isi Islam ki hidayat dengi, jo Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) batatay hain. Is surat mein Allah unhein duniya ke kayi faiday de ga, aasman se pani barsaye ga, zameen se paidawar ugaye ga, neeche oopar ki yani zameen-o-aasman ki barkatein unhein mil jayengi. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa lau anna ahlal qura amanu wattaqau la-fatahna alaihim barakatin minas-sama'i wal-ard, wa lakin kazzabu fa-akhaznahum bima kanu yaksiboon) (Surah Al-A'raf: 96) yani agar bastiyon wale iman latay hain aur parhezgari karte toh hum un par aasman-o-zameen se barkatein nazil farmatay. Aur aayat mein (Zaharal fasadu fil barri wal bahri bima kasabat aydin-nasi liyuzeeqahum ba'dal-lazi amilu la'allahum yarji'oon) (Surah Ar-Rum: 41). Logon ki buraiyon ki wajah se khushki aur tari mein fasad zahir ho gaya hai, aur yeh bhi ma'ni ho sakte hain ke baghair mushaqqat-o-mushkil ke hum unhein bakasrat babarakat roziyan detay hain, ba'z ne is jumla ka matlab yeh bhi bayan kiya hai ke yeh log aisa karte toh bhalaiyon se mustafid ho jatay. Lekin yeh qaul aqwal-e-salaf ke khilaf hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne is jagah ek asar warid kiya hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya qareeb hai ke ilm utha liya jaye. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Ziyad bin Labeed (R.A) ne arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh kaise ho sakta hai ke ilm uth jaye, hum ne Qur'an seekha, apni auladon ko sikhaya.

Aap ne farmaya afsos main toh tamam Madine walon se zyada tum ko samajhdar janta tha lekin kya tu nahin dekhta ke Yahood-o-Nasara ke hathon mein bhi Taurat-o-Injeel hai. Lekin kis kaam ki? Jabke unhon ne Allah ke ahkaam chhod diye phir aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Yeh hadith Musnad mein bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi cheez ka bayan farmaya ke yeh baat ilm ke jaate rehne ke waqt hogi, is par Hazrat Ibn-e-Labeed ne kaha ilm kaise jaata rahega? Hum Quran padhe hue hain apne bachon ko padha rahe hain, woh apni auladon ko padhayenge, yahi silsila Qayamat tak jaari rahega, is par aap ne yeh farmaya jo oopar bayan hua. Phir farmaya in mein ek jamaat miyana-ro bhi hai magar aksar bada'amal hai. Jaise farman-e-aayat (Wa min qawmi Musa ummatun yahdoona bil-haqqi wa bihi ya'diloon) (7. Al-A'raf: 159) Musa ki qoum mein se ek giroh haq ki hidayat karne wala aur isi ke sath adl-o-insaf karne wala bhi tha. Aur qoum-e-Isa ke bare mein farman hai. Aayat (Fa-aataynal-ladheena aamanoo minhum ajrahum) (57. Al-Hadid: 27) In mein se ba-imaan logon ko hum ne un ke sawab inayat farmaye, yeh nukta khayal mein rahe ke un ka behtareen darja beech ka darja bayan farmaya aur is ummat ka yeh darja doosra darja hai, jis par ek teesra ooncha darja bhi hai. Jaise farmaya. Aayat (Thumma awrathnal-kitabal-ladheena istafayna min ibadina, faminhum zalimul-linafsihi, wa minhum muqtasidun, wa minhum sabiqum-bil-khayrati bi-idhnillahi, dhalika huwal-fadlul-kabeer) (35. Fatir: 32). Ya'ni phir hum ne kitab ka waris apne chida bandon ko banaya, in mein se ba'az toh apne nafson par zulm karne wale hain, ba'az miyana-ro hain aur ba'az Allah ke hukum se nekiyon mein aage badhne wale hain, yahi bahut bada fazl hai. Teeno qismein is ummat ki dakhil-e-jannat hone wali hain. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke Sahaba ke samne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya "Musa ki ummat ke ikhattar giroh ho gaye, jin mein se ek toh jannati hai, baqi sattar dozakhi. Meri yeh ummat dono se badh jayegi. Un ka bhi ek giroh toh jannat mein jayega, baqi bahattar giroh jahannam mein jayenge, logon ne poocha, woh kaun hain? Farmaya jamaatein jamaatein". Yaqoob bin Yazeed kehte hain jab Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib (R.A) yeh hadith bayan karte toh Quran ki aayat (Wa law anna ahlal-kitabi aamanoo wattaqaw la-kaffarna anhum sayyi-atihim wa la-adkhalnahum jannatin-na'eem) (5.
