Allah ki zaat unke is naapak maqoolay se bahut buland-o-bala hai. Pas Allah ke haath bandhay hue hain, matlab unka yeh na tha ke haath jakar diye gaye hain balkay muraad is se bukhl tha. Yahi muhawara Quran mein aur jagah bhi hai, farmata hai aayat (Wala taj'al yadaka maghloolatan ila unuqika wala tabsut-ha kullal basti fataq'uda maloomam mahsoora) (17. Al-Isra: 29) yani apne haath apni gardan se baandh bhi na le aur na had se zyada phaila de ke phir thakaan aur nadamat ke saath baithay rehna paray, pas bukhl se aur israaf se Allah ne is aayat mein roka. Pas mal'oon Yahudiyon ki bhi haath bandha hua honay se yahi muraad thi. Fahaas naami Yahudi ne yeh kaha tha aur usi mal'oon ka woh doosra qaul bhi tha ke Allah faqeer hai aur hum ghani hain. Jis par Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ne usay peeta tha. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Shammaas bin Qais ne yahi kaha tha jis par yeh aayat utri. Aur irshad hua ke bakheel aur kanjoos, zaleel aur buzdil yeh log khud hain. Chunancha aur aayat mein hai ke agar yeh baadshah ban jayen to kisi ko kuch bhi na dein. Balkay yeh to auron ki ne'matein dekh kar jaltay hain. Yeh zaleel-tar log hain. Balkay Allah ke haath khulay hain woh sab kuch kharch karta rehta hai, uska fazl wasee hai, uski bakhshish aam hai, har cheez ke khazanay uske haathon mein hain. Har ne'mat uski taraf se hai. Saari makhlooq din raat har waqt har jagah usi ki mohtaaj hai. Farmata hai aayat (Wa-aataakum min kulli ma sa'altumoohu wa-in ta'uddoo ni'matallahi la tuhsooha innal insana lazaloomun kaffar) (14. Ibrahim: 34). "Tum ne jo maanga, Allah ne diya, agar tum Allah ki ne'maton ka shumaar karna chaho to shumaar bhi nahin kar sakte, yaqeenan insaan bara hi zaalim behad nashukra hai". Musnad mein hadees hai ke "Allah Ta'ala ka daahina haath oopar hai, din raat ka kharch uske khazanay ko ghatata nahin, shuru se le kar aaj tak jo kuch bhi usne apni makhlooq ko ata farmaya, usne uske khazanay mein koi kami nahin ki. Uska Arsh pehle paani par tha, usi ke haath mein faiz hi faiz hai, wahi buland aur past karta hai. Uska farmaan hai ke logo tum meri raah mein kharch karoge tum to diye jaoge". Bukhari Muslim mein bhi yeh hadees hai. Phir farmaya "Ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Jis qadar Allah ki ne'matein tum par zyada hongi, utna hi in shayateen ka kufr, hasad aur jalapa barhay ga. Theek isi tarah jis tarah mominon ka imaan aur unki tasleem-o-ita'at barhti hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai: (Qul huwa lillazeena aamanoo hudan washifa'un) (41. Fussilat: 44). Imaan walon ke liye to yeh hidayat-o-shifa hai aur be-imaan is se andhay behray hotay hain. Yahi hain jo darwazay se pukaray jatay hain.

Aur aayat mein hai (Wa nunazzilu minal Qur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatul lil-mu'mineen, wa la yazeeduz-zalimeena illa khasara) (Surah Al-Isra: 82) hum ne woh Qur'an utara hai jo mominon ke liye shifa aur rahmat hai aur zalimon ka toh nuqsan hi barhta rehta hai. Phir irshad hua ke un ke dilon mein se khud aapas ka bughz-o-bair bhi Qayamat tak nahin mite ga, ek dusre ka aapas mein hi khoon peene wale log hain. Namumkin hai ke yeh haq par jam jayen, yeh apne hi deen mein firqa firqa ho rahe hain, un ke jhagray aur adawatein aapas mein jaari hain aur jaari rahengi. Yeh log basa auqat larai ke saman karte hain, tere khilaf charon taraf ek aag bharkana chahte hain lekin har martaba munh ki khatay hain, un ka makr unhi par laut jata hai, yeh mufsid log hain aur Allah ke dushman hain, kisi mufsid ko Allah apna dost nahin banata. Agar yeh ba-iman aur parhezgar ban jayen toh hum un se tamam dar door kar dein aur asal maqsad-e-hayat se unhein mila dein. Agar yeh Taurat-o-Injeel aur is Qur'an ko maan lein kyunke Taurat-o-Injeel ka manna, Qur'an ke manne ko lazim kar de ga, in kitabon ki sahih taleem yahi hai ke yeh Qur'an saccha hai is ki aur Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq pehle ki kitabon mein majood hai toh agar yeh apni in kitabon ko baghair tahrif-o-tabdeel aur ta'weel-o-tafseer ke manein toh woh unhein isi Islam ki hidayat dengi, jo Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) batatay hain. Is surat mein Allah unhein duniya ke kayi faiday de ga, aasman se pani barsaye ga, zameen se paidawar ugaye ga, neeche oopar ki yani zameen-o-aasman ki barkatein unhein mil jayengi. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa lau anna ahlal qura amanu wattaqau la-fatahna alaihim barakatin minas-sama'i wal-ard, wa lakin kazzabu fa-akhaznahum bima kanu yaksiboon) (Surah Al-A'raf: 96) yani agar bastiyon wale iman latay hain aur parhezgari karte toh hum un par aasman-o-zameen se barkatein nazil farmatay. Aur aayat mein (Zaharal fasadu fil barri wal bahri bima kasabat aydin-nasi liyuzeeqahum ba'dal-lazi amilu la'allahum yarji'oon) (Surah Ar-Rum: 41). Logon ki buraiyon ki wajah se khushki aur tari mein fasad zahir ho gaya hai, aur yeh bhi ma'ni ho sakte hain ke baghair mushaqqat-o-mushkil ke hum unhein bakasrat babarakat roziyan detay hain, ba'z ne is jumla ka matlab yeh bhi bayan kiya hai ke yeh log aisa karte toh bhalaiyon se mustafid ho jatay. Lekin yeh qaul aqwal-e-salaf ke khilaf hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne is jagah ek asar warid kiya hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya qareeb hai ke ilm utha liya jaye. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Ziyad bin Labeed (R.A) ne arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh kaise ho sakta hai ke ilm uth jaye, hum ne Qur'an seekha, apni auladon ko sikhaya.

Aap ne farmaya afsos main toh tamam Madine walon se zyada tum ko samajhdar janta tha lekin kya tu nahin dekhta ke Yahood-o-Nasara ke hathon mein bhi Taurat-o-Injeel hai. Lekin kis kaam ki? Jabke unhon ne Allah ke ahkaam chhod diye phir aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Yeh hadith Musnad mein bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi cheez ka bayan farmaya ke yeh baat ilm ke jaate rehne ke waqt hogi, is par Hazrat Ibn-e-Labeed ne kaha ilm kaise jaata rahega? Hum Quran padhe hue hain apne bachon ko padha rahe hain, woh apni auladon ko padhayenge, yahi silsila Qayamat tak jaari rahega, is par aap ne yeh farmaya jo oopar bayan hua. Phir farmaya in mein ek jamaat miyana-ro bhi hai magar aksar bada'amal hai. Jaise farman-e-aayat (Wa min qawmi Musa ummatun yahdoona bil-haqqi wa bihi ya'diloon) (7. Al-A'raf: 159) Musa ki qoum mein se ek giroh haq ki hidayat karne wala aur isi ke sath adl-o-insaf karne wala bhi tha. Aur qoum-e-Isa ke bare mein farman hai. Aayat (Fa-aataynal-ladheena aamanoo minhum ajrahum) (57. Al-Hadid: 27) In mein se ba-imaan logon ko hum ne un ke sawab inayat farmaye, yeh nukta khayal mein rahe ke un ka behtareen darja beech ka darja bayan farmaya aur is ummat ka yeh darja doosra darja hai, jis par ek teesra ooncha darja bhi hai. Jaise farmaya. Aayat (Thumma awrathnal-kitabal-ladheena istafayna min ibadina, faminhum zalimul-linafsihi, wa minhum muqtasidun, wa minhum sabiqum-bil-khayrati bi-idhnillahi, dhalika huwal-fadlul-kabeer) (35. Fatir: 32). Ya'ni phir hum ne kitab ka waris apne chida bandon ko banaya, in mein se ba'az toh apne nafson par zulm karne wale hain, ba'az miyana-ro hain aur ba'az Allah ke hukum se nekiyon mein aage badhne wale hain, yahi bahut bada fazl hai. Teeno qismein is ummat ki dakhil-e-jannat hone wali hain. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke Sahaba ke samne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya "Musa ki ummat ke ikhattar giroh ho gaye, jin mein se ek toh jannati hai, baqi sattar dozakhi. Meri yeh ummat dono se badh jayegi. Un ka bhi ek giroh toh jannat mein jayega, baqi bahattar giroh jahannam mein jayenge, logon ne poocha, woh kaun hain? Farmaya jamaatein jamaatein". Yaqoob bin Yazeed kehte hain jab Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib (R.A) yeh hadith bayan karte toh Quran ki aayat (Wa law anna ahlal-kitabi aamanoo wattaqaw la-kaffarna anhum sayyi-atihim wa la-adkhalnahum jannatin-na'eem) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 65) aur (Wa mimman khalaqna ummatun yahdoona bil-haqqi wa bihi ya'diloon) (7. Al-A'raf: 181) bhi padhte aur farmate hain is se murad ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai. Lekin yeh hadith in lafzon aur is sanad se behad ghareeb hai aur sattar se oopar oopar firqon ki hadith bahut si sanadon se marwi hai, jise hum ne aur jagah bayan kar diya hai falhamdulillah.

Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Allah Ta'ala ke kisi hukm ko chupaya nahin. Apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Rasool ke pyare khitab se aawaz de kar Allah Ta'ala ne hukm diya hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke kul ahkaam logon ko pahuncha do. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bhi aisa hi kiya. Sahih Bukhari mein hai "Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain jo tujh se kahe ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Allah Ta'ala ke nazil karda kisi hukm ko chupa liya to jaan lo ke woh jhoota hai, Allah ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh hukm diya hai phir is aayat ki tilawat aap ne ki". Yeh hadith yahan mukhtasar hai aur jagah par mutawwal bhi hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai "Agar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah ke kisi farman ko chupane wale hote to is aayat ko chupa lete. Aayat (Wa tukhfi fi nafsika mallahu mubdihi wa takhshan-nasa wallahu ahaqqu an takhshahu) (33. Al-Ahzab: 37). Ya'ni tu apne dil mein woh chupata tha jise Allah zahir karne wala tha aur logon se jhenp raha tha halankeh Allah zyada haqdar hai ke tu us se dare". Ibn Abbas (R.A) se kisi ne kaha ke logon mein yeh charcha ho raha hai ke tumhein kuch baatein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aisi batayi hain jo aur logon se chupayi jaati thin to aap ne yahi aayat padhi aur farmaya qasam Allah ki hamein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi aisi makhsoos cheez ka waris nahin banaya (Ibn Abi Hatim). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke "Hazrat Ali (R.A) se ek shakhs ne poocha kya tumhare paas Quran ke ilawa kuch aur wahi bhi hai? Aap ne farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne dane ko ugaya hai aur janwaron ko paida kiya hai ke kuch nahin bajuz is fahm-o-riwayat ke jo Allah kisi shakhs ko de aur jo kuch is sahifay mein hai, us ne poocha sahifay mein kya hai? Farmaya diyat ke masail hain, qaidiyon ko chhod dene ke ahkaam hain aur yeh hai ke musalman kafir ke badle qasasan qatl na kiya jaye". Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Zohri (R.H) ka farman hai ke Allah ki taraf se risalat hai aur paighambar ke zimme tabligh hai aur hamare zimme qabool karna aur tabe-e-farman hona hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Allah ki sab baatein pahuncha dein, is ki gawah aap ki tamam ummat hai ke filwaqay aap ne amanat ki poori adaigi ki aur sab se badi majlis jo thi, us mein sab ne is ka iqrar kiya ya'ni Hajjat-ul-Wida khutbay mein, jis waqt aap ke samne chalis hazar sahaba ka giroh-e-azeem tha". Sahih Muslim mein hai ke "Aap ne is khutbay mein logon se farmaya tum mere bare mein Allah ke haan pooche jaoge to batao kya jawab doge? Sab ne kaha hamari gawahi hai ke aap ne tabligh kar di aur haq-e-risalat ada kar diya aur hamari poori khair khwahi ki, aap ne sar aasman ki taraf utha kar farmaya ae Allah! Kya main ne tere tamam ahkamat ko pahuncha diya, ae Allah! Kya main ne pahuncha diya?". Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh bhi hai ke aap ne is khutbay mein poocha ke logo yeh kaunsa din hai? Sab ne kaha hurmat wala, poocha yeh kaunsa shahar hai, jawab diya, hurmat wala. Farmaya yeh kaunsa mahina hai?

Jawab mila, hurmat wala, farmaya pas tumhare maal aur khoon-o-aabroo aapas mein ek dusre par aisi hi hurmat wale hain jaise is din ki is shehar mein aur is mahine mein hurmat hai. Phir baar baar isi ko dohraaya. Phir apni ungli aasman ki taraf utha kar farmaya, "Aye Allah! Kya main ne pahuncha diya?" Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Allah ki qasam yeh aap ke Rabb ki taraf aap ki wasiyat thi. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya dekho har hazir shakhs ghair-hazir ko yeh baat pahuncha de. Dekho mere farmaan mere bandon tak na pahunchaye to tu ne haq-e-risalat ada nahin kiya, phir is ki jo saza hai woh zahir hai, agar ek aayat bhi chhupa li to haq-e-risalat ada na hua. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain jab yeh hukm nazil hua ke jo kuch utra hai sab pahuncha do to Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah main akela hoon aur yeh sab mil kar mujh par chadh daurte hain, main kis tarah karoon?" To dusra jumla utra ke agar tu ne na kiya to tu ne risalat ka haq ada nahin kiya. Phir farmaya tujhe logon se bacha lena mere zimme hai. Tera hafiz-o-nasir main hoon, be-khatar rahiye woh koi tera kuch nahin bigad sakte. Is aayat se pehle Huzoor ﷺ chaukne rehte the, log nigahbani par muqarrar rehte the. Chunancha Hazrat Ayesha R.A farmati hain ke ek raat ko Huzoor ﷺ bedaar the unhein neend nahin aa rahi thi, main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Aaj kya baat hai? Farmaya, "Kaash ke mera koi nek-bakht sahabi aaj pehra deta." Yeh baat ho hi rahi thi ke mere kaanon mein hathiyar ki aawaz aayi, aap ne farmaya kaun hai? Jawab mila ke main Sa'ad bin Malik hoon. Farmaya kaise aaye? Jawab diya is liye ke raat bhar Huzoor ﷺ ki chaukidari karoon. Is ke baad Huzoor ﷺ ba-aaram so gaye, yahan tak ke kharaton ki aawaz aane lagi (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh waqiya san 2 Hijri ka hai. Is aayat ke nazil hote hi aap ne khaime se sar nikal kar chaukidaron se farmaya, "Jao ab main Allah ki panah mein aa gaya, tumhari chaukidari ki zaroorat nahin rahi." Ek riwayat mein hai ke Abu Talib aap ke sath sath kisi na kisi aadmi ko rakhte, jab yeh aayat utri to aap ne farmaya, "Bas chacha! Ab mere sath kisi ke bhejne ki zaroorat nahin, main Allah ke bachao mein aa gaya hoon." Lekin yeh riwayat ghareeb aur munkar hai, yeh waqiya ho to Makkah ka ho aur yeh aayat to Madani hai, Madina ki bhi aakhri muddat ki aayat hai. Is mein shak nahin ke Makkah mein bhi Allah ki hifazat apne Rasool ﷺ ke sath rahi, bawajood dushman-e-jaan hone ke aur har har asbaab aur saman se lais hone ke sardaran-e-Makkah aur Ahl-e-Makkah aap ka baal tak bika na kar sake. Ibtida-e-risalat ke zamane mein apne chacha Abu Talib ki wajah se jo ke Quraishiyon ke sardar aur ba-rusookh shakhs the, aap ki hifazat hoti rahi, un ke dil mein Allah ne aap ki mohabbat aur izzat daal di, yeh mohabbat tab'i thi shar'i na thi. Agar shar'i hoti to Quraish Huzoor ﷺ ke sath hi un ki bhi jaan ke khwahan ho jaate. Un ke inteqal ke baad Allah Ta'ala ne Ansar ke dilon mein Huzoor ﷺ ki shar'i mohabbat paida kar di aur aap unhi ke haan chale gaye.

Ab toh mushrikeen bhi aur Yahood bhi mil mila kar nikal kharay huay, baray baray saaz-o-samaan lashkar le kar charh doray, lekin baar baar ki nakamiyon ne un ki umeedon par pani pher diya. Isi tarah khufiya sazishein bhi jitni keen, qudrat ne woh bhi unhi par ulat dein. Idhar woh jadoo karte hain, idhar Surah Mu'awwazatain nazil hoti hai aur un ka jadoo utar jata hai. Idhar hazaron jatan kar ke bakri ke shaanay mein zehar mila kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dawat kar ke aap ke samnay rakhte hain, idhar Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un ki dhoka dahi se aagah farma deta hai aur yeh haath kaatay reh jatay hain aur bhi aisay waqiyat aap ki zindagi mein bohat saray nazar aatay hain. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke "Ek safar mein aap ek darakht talay, jo Sahaba (R.A) apni aadat ke mutabiq har manzil mein talash kar ke aap ke liye chor detay thay, dopahar ke waqt qailula kar rahay thay toh ek a'arabi achanak aa nikla, aap ki talwar jo usi darakht mein latak rahi thi, utaar li aur miyaan se bahar nikal li aur daant kar aap se kehne laga, ab bata kaun hai jo tujhay bacha le? Aap ne farmaya Allah mujhay bachaye ga, isi waqt us a'arabi ka haath kaanpne lagta hai aur talwar us ke haath se gir jati hai aur woh darakht se takrata hai, jis se us ka dimagh paash paash ho jata hai aur Allah Ta'ala yeh aayat utarta hai". Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Banu Najjar se ghazwa kiya "Zaat-ur-Riqa khajoor ke baagh mein aap ek kunway mein pair latkaye baithay thay, jo Banu Najjar ke ek shakhs Waris naami ne kaha dekho main Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko qatl karta hoon. Logon ne kaha kaisay? Kaha main kisi heelay se aap ki talwar le loon ga aur phir ek hi waar kar ke paar kar doon ga. Yeh aap ke paas aaya aur idhar udhar ki baatein bana kar aap se talwar dekhne ko mangi, aap ne usay de di lekin talwar ke haath mein aatay hi us par is bala ka larza charha ke aakhir talwar sambhal na saki aur haath se gir pari toh aap ne farmaya teray aur teray bad iraday ke darmiyan Allah hail ho gaya aur yeh aayat utri. Huwairis bin Haris ka bhi aisa qissa mashhoor hai. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke "Sahaba (R.A) ki aadat thi ke safar mein jis jagah thehartay, An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke liye ghana saya-daar bara darakht chor detay ke aap usi ke talay aaram farmayain, ek din aap isi tarah aisay darakht talay so gaye aur aap ki talwar us darakht mein latak rahi thi, ek shakhs aa gaya aur talwar haath mein le kar kehne laga, ab bata ke meray haath se tujhay kaun bachaye ga? Aap ne farmaya Allah bachaye ga, talwar rakh de aur woh is qadar haibat mein aa gaya ke tameel-e-hukm karna hi pari aur talwar aap ke samnay daal di." Aur Allah ne yeh aayat utari ke (وَاللّٰهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ النَّاسِ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 67). Musnad mein hai ke "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek motay aadmi ke pait ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya agar yeh is ke siwa mein hota toh teray liye behtar tha."

Ek shakhs ko Sahaba pakar kar Aap (ﷺ) ke paas laye aur kaha yeh Aap ke qatl ka irada kar raha tha, woh kanpne laga, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ghabra nahin chahe to irada kare lekin Allah use pura nahin hone dega". Phir farmata hai tere zimma sirf tabligh hai, hidayat Allah ke haath hai, woh kafiron ko hidayat nahin dega. Tu pahuncha de, hisab ka lene wala Allah Ta'ala hi hai.

Aakhri Rasool par imaan awwalin shart hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke Yahood-o-Nasara kisi deen par nahin, jab tak ke apni kitabon par aur Allah ki is kitab par imaan na layein, lekin unki halat toh yeh hai ke jaise jaise Quran utarta hai yeh log sarkashi aur kufr mein barhte jate hain. Pas ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tu un kafiron ke liye hasrat-o-afsos kar ke kyun apni jaan ko rog lagata hai. Sabi, Nasraniyon aur Majusiyon ki bedeen jamaat ko kehte hain aur sirf Majusiyon ko bhi. Alawa azeen ek aur giroh tha, Yahood aur Nasara dono misl Majusiyon ke thay. Qatada (R.H) kehte hain yeh Zaboor parhte thay, ghair qibla ki taraf namazein parhte thay aur farishton ko poojte thay. Wahab (R.H) farmate hain Allah ko pehchante thay, apni shariat ke hamil thay, un mein kufr ki ijaad nahin hui thi, yeh Iraq ke mutasil abad thay, Yalutha kahe jate thay, nabiyon ko mante thay, har saal mein tees rozay rakhte thay aur Yaman ki taraf munh kar ke din bhar mein paanch namazein bhi parhte thay, is ke siwa aur qaul bhi hain. Chunke pehle do jumlon ke baad unka zikr aaya tha, is liye rafa ke sath atf dala. In tamam logon se Janab-e-Bari farmata hai ke "Aman-o-aman wale bedar aur be-khauf woh hain jo Allah par aur Qayamat par sacha imaan rakhein aur nek aamal karein aur yeh namumkin hai, jab tak is aakhri Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par imaan na ho jo ke tamam jinn-o-ins ki taraf Allah ke Rasool bana kar bheje gaye hain. Pas aap par imaan lane wale aane wali zindagi ke khatrat se be-khauf hain aur yahan chhor kar jane wali cheezon ki unhein koi tamanna aur hasrat nahin". Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir mein is jumle ke mufassal ma'ani bayan kar diye gaye hain.

Aakhri Rasool par imaan awwalin shart hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke Yahood-o-Nasara kisi deen par nahin, jab tak ke apni kitabon par aur Allah ki is kitab par imaan na layein, lekin unki halat toh yeh hai ke jaise jaise Quran utarta hai yeh log sarkashi aur kufr mein barhte jate hain. Pas ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tu un kafiron ke liye hasrat-o-afsos kar ke kyun apni jaan ko rog lagata hai. Sabi, Nasraniyon aur Majusiyon ki bedeen jamaat ko kehte hain aur sirf Majusiyon ko bhi. Alawa azeen ek aur giroh tha, Yahood aur Nasara dono misl Majusiyon ke thay. Qatada (R.H) kehte hain yeh Zaboor parhte thay, ghair qibla ki taraf namazein parhte thay aur farishton ko poojte thay. Wahab (R.H) farmate hain Allah ko pehchante thay, apni shariat ke hamil thay, un mein kufr ki ijaad nahin hui thi, yeh Iraq ke mutasil abad thay, Yalutha kahe jate thay, nabiyon ko mante thay, har saal mein tees rozay rakhte thay aur Yaman ki taraf munh kar ke din bhar mein paanch namazein bhi parhte thay, is ke siwa aur qaul bhi hain. Chunke pehle do jumlon ke baad unka zikr aaya tha, is liye rafa ke sath atf dala. In tamam logon se Janab-e-Bari farmata hai ke "Aman-o-aman wale bedar aur be-khauf woh hain jo Allah par aur Qayamat par sacha imaan rakhein aur nek aamal karein aur yeh namumkin hai, jab tak is aakhri Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par imaan na ho jo ke tamam jinn-o-ins ki taraf Allah ke Rasool bana kar bheje gaye hain. Pas aap par imaan lane wale aane wali zindagi ke khatrat se be-khauf hain aur yahan chhor kar jane wali cheezon ki unhein koi tamanna aur hasrat nahin". Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir mein is jumle ke mufassal ma'ani bayan kar diye gaye hain.

Siyah amal Yahood aur Nasara: Allah Ta'ala ne Yahood-o-Nasara se wade liye thay ke woh Allah ke ahkaam ke aamil aur wahi ke paband rahenge. Lekin unhon ne woh misaq tod diya. Apni raye aur khwahish ke peeche lag gaye, Kitabullah ki jo baat un ki mansha aur raye ke mutabiq thi maan li, jis mein ikhtilaf nazar aaya tark kar di. Na sirf itna hi kiya balkay Rasoolon ke mukhalif ho kar bohat se Rasoolon ko jhoota bataya aur bahuteron ko qatl bhi kar diya kyunke un ke laye hue ahkaam un ki raye aur qiyas ke khilaf thay. Itne bade gunah ke baad bhi be-fikr ho kar baithe rahe aur samajh liya ke hamein koi saza na hogi, lekin unhein zabardast roohani saza di gayi, yani woh haq se door phenk diye gaye aur is se andhay aur behray bana diye gaye, na haq ko sunen aur na hidayat ko dekh saken. Lekin phir bhi Allah ne un par meherbani ki, afsos is ke baad bhi un mein se aksar haq se nabina aur haq ke sunne se mehroom hi ho gaye. Allah un ke aamaal se ba-khabar hai, woh jaanta hai ke kaun kis cheez ka mustahiq hai.

Khud-sakhta mabood banana na-qabil-e-muafi jurm hai. Nasraniyon ke firqon ki yani Malkiya, Yaqubiya, Nasturiya ki kufr ki halat bayan ki ja rahi hai ke yeh Maseeh hi ko Allah kehte hain aur maante hain. Allah un ke qaul se pak, munazza aur mubarra hai. Maseeh to Allah ke ghulam thay. Sab se pehla kalma un ka duniya mein qadam rakhte hi gahware mein hi yeh tha ke (Inni Abdullah) main Allah ka ghulam hoon. Unhon ne yeh nahin kaha tha ke main Allah hoon ya Allah ka beta hoon balkay apni ghulami ka iqrar kiya tha aur sath hi farmaya tha ke mera aur tum sab ka Rabb Allah hi hai, isi ki ibadat karte raho, seedhi aur sahih rah yahi hai aur yahi baat apni jawani ke baad ki umar mein bhi kahi ke Allah hi ki ibadat karo. Us ke sath dusre ki ibadat karne wale par yeh jannat haram hai aur us ke liye jahannam wajib hai. Jaise Quran ki aur aayat mein hai Allah Ta'ala shirk ko maaf nahin farmata. Jahannami jab jannatiyon se khana pani mangenge to ahl-e-jannat ka yahi jawab hoga ke yeh dono cheezein kuffar par haram hain. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bazariya-e-munadi ke musalmanon mein aawaz lagwayi thi ke jannat mein faqat iman-o-islam wale hi jayenge. Surah Nisa ki aayat (Innal-laha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi wa yaghfiru ma duna zalika liman yashau, wa man yushrik billahi faqadiftara isman azima) (4. An-Nisa: 48) ki tafsir mein woh hadith bhi bayan kar di gayi hai jis mein hai ke gunah ke teen diwan hain jis mein se ek woh hai jise Allah ne kabhi nahin bakhsha aur woh Allah ke sath shirk ka hai. Hazrat Maseeh ne bhi apni qaum mein yahi wa'z bayan kiya aur farma diya ke aise na-insaf mushrikeen ka koi madadgar bhi khara na hoga. Ab un ka kufr bayan ho raha hai ke jo Allah ko teen mein se ek maante thay, Yahudi Hazrat Uzair ko aur Nasrani Hazrat Isa ko Allah ka beta kehte thay aur Allah ko teen mein ka ek maante thay, phir un teenon ke muqarrar karne mein bhi bohat bara ikhtilaf tha aur har firqa dusre ko kafir kehta tha aur haq to yeh hai ke sabhi sab kafir thay. Hazrat Isa se farmaye ga kya tum ne logon se kaha tha ke mujhe aur meri walida ko bhi Allah maano, woh us se saaf inkar karenge aur apni la-ilmi aur be-gunahi zahir karenge. Zyada zahir qaul bhi yahi hai, wallahu a'lam. Dar-asal laiq-e-ibadat siwaye us zaat-e-wahid ke aur koi nahin, tamam kainat aur kul maujudat ka mabood-e-barhaq wahi hai. Agar yeh apne is kafirana nazariye se baaz na aaye to yaqeenan yeh alamnak azabon ka shikar honge. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne karam-o-jud ko, bakhshish-o-inaam aur lutf-o-rahmat ko bayan farma raha hai aur bawajood un ke is qadar sakht jurm, itni ashad be-hayai aur kazb-o-iftira ke unhein apni rahmat ki dawat deta hai aur farmata hai ke ab bhi meri taraf jhuk jao, abhi sab maaf farma doonga aur daman-e-rahmat talay le loonga. Hazrat Maseeh Allah ke banday aur Rasool hi thay.

In jaise Rasool un se pehle bhi hue hain jaise farmaya (In huwa illa 'abdun) al-kh, woh hamare ek ghulam hi thay, haan hum ne un par Rahmat nazil farmayi thi aur Bani Israel ke liye Qudrat ki ek nishani banayi. Walida-e-Isa (A.S) momina aur sach kehne wali thin, is liye maloom hua ke nabiya na thin kyunke yeh maqam-e-wasf hai, toh behtareen wasf jo aap ka tha woh bayan kar diya, agar nabuwwat wali hotin toh is mauqa par is ka bayan nihayat zaroori tha. Ibn-e-Hazm waghera ka khayal hai ke Umm-e-Ishaq aur Umm-e-Musa aur Umm-e-Isa (A.S) nabiya thin aur daleel yeh dete hain ke farishton ne Hazrat Sarah aur Hazrat Maryam (A.S) se khitab aur kalam kiya aur walida-e-Musa (A.S) ki nisbat farman hai aayat (Wa awhayna ila ummi Musa an ardi'ihi fa-idha khifti 'alaihi fa-alqiqi fil-yammi wa la takhafi wa la tahzani inna radduhu ilaiki wa ja'iluhu minal-mursalin) (28. Al-Qasas: 7) hum ne Musa (A.S) ki walida ki taraf wahi ki ke tu inhe doodh pila. Lekin jamhoor ka mazhab is ke khilaf hai, woh kehte hain ke nabuwwat mardon mein hi rahi. Jaise Quran ka farman hai aayat (Wa ma arsalna qablaka illa rijalan noohi ilayhim fas'alu ahlaz-zikri in kuntum la ta'lamun) (21. Al-Anbiya: 7) tujh se pehle hum ne basti walon mein se mardon hi ki taraf risalat in'am farmayi hai. Sheikh Abul Hasan Ash'ari ne toh is par ijma naqal kiya hai. Phir farmata hai ke maa beta toh dono khane peene ke mohtaj thay aur zahir hai ke jo andar jayega woh bahar bhi aayega, pas sabit hua ke woh bhi misl auron ke bande hi thay, Allah ki sifaat un mein na thin. Dekh toh hum kis tarah khol khol kar un ke samne apni hujatein pesh kar rahe hain? Phir yeh bhi dekh ke bawajood is ke yeh kis tarah idhar udhar bhatakte aur bhagte phirte hain? Kaise gumrah mazhab qabool kar rahe hain? Aur kaise raddi aur be-daleel aqwal ko girah mein bandhe hue hain?

Hazrat Isa se farmaye ga kya tum ne logon se kaha tha ke mujhe aur meri walida ko bhi Allah maano, woh us se saaf inkar karenge aur apni la-ilmi aur be-gunahi zahir karenge. Zyada zahir qaul bhi yahi hai, wallahu a'lam. Dar-asal laiq-e-ibadat siwaye us zaat-e-wahid ke aur koi nahin, tamam kainat aur kul maujudat ka mabood-e-barhaq wahi hai. Agar yeh apne is kafirana nazariye se baaz na aaye to yaqeenan yeh alamnak azabon ka shikar honge. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne karam-o-jud ko, bakhshish-o-inaam aur lutf-o-rahmat ko bayan farma raha hai aur bawajood un ke is qadar sakht jurm, itni ashad be-hayai aur kazb-o-iftira ke unhein apni rahmat ki dawat deta hai aur farmata hai ke ab bhi meri taraf jhuk jao, abhi sab maaf farma doonga aur daman-e-rahmat talay le loonga. Hazrat Maseeh Allah ke banday aur Rasool hi thay.

In jaise Rasool un se pehle bhi hue hain jaise farmaya (In huwa illa 'abdun) al-kh, woh hamare ek ghulam hi thay, haan hum ne un par Rahmat nazil farmayi thi aur Bani Israel ke liye Qudrat ki ek nishani banayi. Walida-e-Isa (A.S) momina aur sach kehne wali thin, is liye maloom hua ke nabiya na thin kyunke yeh maqam-e-wasf hai, toh behtareen wasf jo aap ka tha woh bayan kar diya, agar nabuwwat wali hotin toh is mauqa par is ka bayan nihayat zaroori tha. Ibn-e-Hazm waghera ka khayal hai ke Umm-e-Ishaq aur Umm-e-Musa aur Umm-e-Isa (A.S) nabiya thin aur daleel yeh dete hain ke farishton ne Hazrat Sarah aur Hazrat Maryam (A.S) se khitab aur kalam kiya aur walida-e-Musa (A.S) ki nisbat farman hai aayat (Wa awhayna ila ummi Musa an ardi'ihi fa-idha khifti 'alaihi fa-alqiqi fil-yammi wa la takhafi wa la tahzani inna radduhu ilaiki wa ja'iluhu minal-mursalin) (28. Al-Qasas: 7) hum ne Musa (A.S) ki walida ki taraf wahi ki ke tu inhe doodh pila. Lekin jamhoor ka mazhab is ke khilaf hai, woh kehte hain ke nabuwwat mardon mein hi rahi. Jaise Quran ka farman hai aayat (Wa ma arsalna qablaka illa rijalan noohi ilayhim fas'alu ahlaz-zikri in kuntum la ta'lamun) (21. Al-Anbiya: 7) tujh se pehle hum ne basti walon mein se mardon hi ki taraf risalat in'am farmayi hai. Sheikh Abul Hasan Ash'ari ne toh is par ijma naqal kiya hai. Phir farmata hai ke maa beta toh dono khane peene ke mohtaj thay aur zahir hai ke jo andar jayega woh bahar bhi aayega, pas sabit hua ke woh bhi misl auron ke bande hi thay, Allah ki sifaat un mein na thin. Dekh toh hum kis tarah khol khol kar un ke samne apni hujatein pesh kar rahe hain? Phir yeh bhi dekh ke bawajood is ke yeh kis tarah idhar udhar bhatakte aur bhagte phirte hain? Kaise gumrah mazhab qabool kar rahe hain? Aur kaise raddi aur be-daleel aqwal ko girah mein bandhe hue hain?

Ma'budan-e-batil ki jo Allah ke siwa hain ibadat karne se muman'at ki jati hai ke un tamam logon se keh toh do ke jo tum se zarar ko dafa karne ki aur nafa ke pahunchane ki kuch bhi taqat nahin rakhte, aakhir tum kyun unhein puje chale ja rahe ho? Tamam baton ke sunne wale tamam cheezon se bakhabar Allah se hat kar be-sam' o basar, be-zarar o be-nafa o be-qadr aur be-qudrat cheezon ke peeche pad jana yeh kaun si aqalmandi hai? Ae Ahl-e-Kitab itteba-e-haq ki hudood se aage na badho, jis ki tauqeer karne ka jitna hukum ho utni hi us ki tauqeer karo. Insaanon ko jinhein Allah ne nabuwwat di hai nabuwwat ke darje se ma'bud tak na pahunchao. Jaise ke tum janab-e-Masih ke bare mein ghalti kar rahe ho aur us ki aur koi wajah nahin bajuz is ke ke tum apne peeron, murshidon, ustadon aur imamon ke peeche lag gaye ho woh toh khud hi gumrah hain balkeh gumrah-kun hain. Istiqamat aur adl ke raste ko chhore hue unhein zamana guzar gaya. Zalalat aur bid'aton mein mubtala hue arsa ho gaya. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek shakhs un mein bada paband-e-deen-e-haq tha, ek zamane ke baad shaitan ne use behka diya ke jo agle kar gaye wohi tum bhi kar rahe ho is mein kya rakha hai? Is ki wajah se na toh logon mein tumhari qadr hogi na shohrat, tumhein chahiye ke koi nayi baat ijad karo use logon mein phailao phir dekho ke kaisi shohrat hoti hai? Aur kis tarah jagah ba-jagah tumhara zikr hone lagta hai, chunancha us ne aisa hi kiya us ki bid'atein logon mein phail gayin aur zamana us ki taqleed karne laga. Ab toh use badi nadamat hui, saltanat o mulk chhor diya aur tanhai mein Allah ki ibadaton mein mashghool ho gaya lekin Allah ki taraf se use jawab mila ke meri khata hi sirf ki hoti toh main maaf kar deta lekin tu ne aam logon ko bigad diya aur unhein gumrah kar ke ghalat rah par laga diya. Jis rah par chalte chalte woh mar gaye un ka bojh tujh par se kaise tale ga? Main toh teri tauba qabool nahin farmaunga, pas aison hi ke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai.

Amr-e-Ma'roof se gurez ka anjam irshad hai ke Bani Israel ke kafir purane mal'oon hain, Hazrat Dawood A.S aur Hazrat Isa A.S ki zabani inhi ke zamana mein mal'oon qarar pa chuke hain. Kyunke woh Allah ke nafarman thay aur makhlooq par zalim thay, Taurat, Injeel, Zaboor aur Quran sab kitabein un par la'nat barsati aayin. Yeh apne zamana mein bhi ek dusre ko bure kamon mein dekhte thay lekin chup chap baithe rehte thay, haram kariyan aur gunah khule aam hote thay aur koi kisi ko rokta na tha. Yeh tha un ka badtareen fe'l. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein farman-e-Rasool ﷺ hai ke "Bani Israel mein pehle pehal jab gunahon ka silsila chala to un ke ulama ne unhein roka. Lekin jab dekha ke baz nahin aate to unhon ne unhein alag nahin kiya balkeh inhi ke sath uthte baithte khate peete rahe, jis ki wajah se dono girohon ke dilon mein aapas mein takra diya Allah Ta'ala ne ek dusre ke dil bhira diye aur Hazrat Dawood A.S aur Hazrat Isa A.S ki zabani un par apni la'nat nazil farmayi. Kyunke woh nafarman aur zalim thay. Is ke bayan ke waqt Huzoor ﷺ tek lagaye hue thay lekin ab theek ho kar baith gaye aur farmaya nahin nahin Allah ki qasam tum par zaroori hai ke logon ko khilaf-e-shar'a baton se roko aur unhein shariat ki pabandi par lao." Abu Dawood ki hadith mein hai ke "Sab se pehle burai Bani Israel mein dakhil hui thi ke ek shakhs dusre ko khilaf-e-shar'a koi kaam karte dekhta to use rokta, use kehta ke Allah se dar aur is bure kaam ko chhor de yeh haram hai. Lekin dusre roz jab woh na chhorta to yeh us se kinara kashi na karta balkeh us ka ham-niwala ham-pyala rehta aur mel jol baqi rakhta, is wajah se sab mein hi sangdili aa gayi. Phir Aap ﷺ ne is poori ayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya Wallah tum par farz hai ke bhali baton ka har ek ko hukum karo, buraiyon se roko, zalim ko us ke zulm se baz rakho aur use tang karo ke haq par aa jaye." Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh hadith majood hai. Abu Dawood waghera mein isi hadith ke aakhir mein yeh bhi hai ke agar tum aisa na karoge to Allah tumhare dilon ko bhi aapas mein ek dusre ke sath takra dega aur tum par apni phitkar nazil farmaye ga jaisi un par nazil farmayi. Is bare mein aur bohat si hadeesein hain kuch sun bhi lijiye Hazrat Jabir R.A wali hadith to ayat (Lau la yan ha humur rabbaniyoona wal ahbaru an qawlihimul isma wa aklihimus suht, labi'sa ma kanu yasna'oon) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 63) ki tafseer mein guzar chuki aur ya ayat (Ya ayyuhallazina amanu alaikum anfusakum, la yadurrukum man dalla izah-tadaitum, ilallahi marji'ukum jamee'an fayunabbi'ukum bima kuntum ta'maloon) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 105) ki tafseer mein Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A aur Hazrat Abu Sa'laba R.A ki hadeesein aayengi, Insha'Allah Ta'ala.

Musnad aur Tirmidhi mein hai ke "Ya toh tum bhalai ka hukm aur burai se mana karte rahoge ya Allah tum par apni taraf se koi azab bhej dega phir tum us se duayein bhi karoge lekin woh qabool nahin farmayega." Ibn-e-Majah mein hai "Achai ka hukm aur burai se mumanat karo is se pehle ke tumhari duayein qabool hone se rok di jayen." Sahih hadith mein hai "Tum mein se jo shakhs khilaf-e-shara kaam dekhe, us par farz hai ke use apne haath se mitaye agar us ki taqat na ho toh zaban se, agar us ki bhi taqat na rakhta ho toh dil se aur yeh bahut hi za'eef iman wala hai" (Muslim). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai "Allah Ta'ala khaas logon ke gunahon ki wajah se aam logon ko azab nahin karta lekin us waqt ke buraiyan un mein phail jayen aur woh bawajood qudrat ke inkar na karein, us waqt aam khaas sab ko Allah Ta'ala azab mein gher leta hai." Abu Dawood mein hai ke jis jagah Allah ki nafarmani honi shuru ho wahan jo bhi ho, un khilaf-e-shara umoor se naraz ho (ek aur riwayat mein hai un ka inkar karta ho) woh misl us ke hai jo wahan hazir hi na ho aur jo un khataon se razi ho go wahan majood na ho woh aisa hai goya un mein hazir hai. Abu Dawood mein hai logon ke uzr jab tak khatam na ho jayen woh halak na honge. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne apne khutbe mein farmaya khabardar kisi shakhs ko logon ki haibat haq baat kehne se rok na de. Is hadith ko bayan farma kar Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ro pade aur farmane lage afsos hum ne aise mauqon par logon ki haibat maan li. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah mein hai afzal jihad kalma-e-haq zalim badshah ke samne keh dena hai. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke Jamra-e-Ula ke paas Huzoor ﷺ ke samne ek shakhs aaya aur aap se sawal kiya ke sab se afzal jihad kaun sa hai? Aap khamosh rahe. Phir aap Jamra-e-Saniya par aaye toh us ne phir wahi sawal kiya magar aap khamosh rahe. Jab Jamra-e-Aqaba par kankar maar chuke aur sawari par sawar hone ke irade se rikab mein paon rakhe toh daryaft farmaya ke woh puchne wala kahan hai? Us ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ main hazir hoon farmaya haq baat zalim badshah ke samne keh dena. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke tum mein se kisi shakhs ko apni be-izzati na karni chahiye logon ne pucha? Huzoor ﷺ yeh kaise? Farmaya khilaf-e-shara koi amr dekhe aur kuch na kahe qayamat ke din us se baz-purs hogi ke falan mauqe par tu kyun khamosh raha? Yeh jawab dega ke logon ke dar ki wajah se toh Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga main sab se zyada haqdar tha ke tu mujh se khauf khaye. Ek riwayat mein hai ke jab use Allah talqeen-e-hujjat kare ga toh yeh kahe ga ke tujh se toh main ne umeed rakhi aur logon se khauf kha gaya. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke musalmanon ko apne tayin zaleel na karna chahiye. Logon ne pucha kaise? Farmaya un balaon ko sar par lena jin ki bardasht ki taqat na ho. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ se sawal kiya gaya ke Amr-bil-Ma'roof aur Nahi-anil-Munkar kab chhori jaye?

Farmaya us waqt jab tum mein bhi wohi kharabi hojaye jo tum se aglon mein zahir hui thi hum ne poocha woh kya cheez hai? Farmaya kameenay aadmiyon mein saltanat ka chala jana. Baray aadmiyon mein badkari ka aajana. Razeelon mein ilm ka aajana. Hazrat Zaid kehte hain razeelon mein ilm aajane se murad fasiqon mein ilm ka aajana hai. Is hadith ki shahid hadeesein Abu Thalaba ki riwayat se aayat (La yadurrukum) ki tafsir mein aayengi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Phir farmata hai ke aksar munafiqon ko tu dekhega ke woh kafiron se dostiyan ganthte hain un ke is fe'l ki wajah se yani musalmanon se dostiyan chhor kar kafiron se dostiyan karne ki wajah se unhon ne apne liye bura zakheera jama kar rakha hai. Is ki padash mein un ke dilon mein nifaq paida hogaya hai. Aur isi bina par Allah ka ghazab un par nazil hua hai aur Qayamat ke din ke liye daimi azab bhi un ke liye aagay aa rahe hain. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai aye musalmano, zina kari se bacho, is se chhay buraiyan aati hain, teen duniya mein aur teen aakhirat mein. Is se izzat-o-waqar, ronaq-o-tazgi jaati rehti hai. Is se faqr-o-faqa aajata hai. Is se umr ghatti hai aur Qayamat ke din teen buraiyan yeh hain Allah ka ghazab, hisab ki sakhti aur burai, aur Jahannam ka khulood. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aakhri jumlay ki tilawat farmayi. Yeh hadith za'eef hai wallahu a'lam. Phir farmata hai agar yeh log Allah par us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par aur Quran par poora imaan rakhte to hargiz kafiron se dostiyan na karte aur chup chupa kar un se mel milap jaari na rakhte. Na sachay musalmanon se dushmaniyan rakhte. Darasal baat yeh hai ke un mein se aksar log fasiq hain yani Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at se kharij ho chuke hain us ki wahi aur us ke pak kalam ki aayaton ke mukhalif ban baithe hain.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke musalmanon ko apne tayin zaleel na karna chahiye. Logon ne pucha kaise? Farmaya un balaon ko sar par lena jin ki bardasht ki taqat na ho. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ se sawal kiya gaya ke Amr-bil-Ma'roof aur Nahi-anil-Munkar kab chhori jaye?

Farmaya us waqt jab tum mein bhi wohi kharabi hojaye jo tum se aglon mein zahir hui thi hum ne poocha woh kya cheez hai? Farmaya kameenay aadmiyon mein saltanat ka chala jana. Baray aadmiyon mein badkari ka aajana. Razeelon mein ilm ka aajana. Hazrat Zaid kehte hain razeelon mein ilm aajane se murad fasiqon mein ilm ka aajana hai. Is hadith ki shahid hadeesein Abu Thalaba ki riwayat se aayat (La yadurrukum) ki tafsir mein aayengi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Phir farmata hai ke aksar munafiqon ko tu dekhega ke woh kafiron se dostiyan ganthte hain un ke is fe'l ki wajah se yani musalmanon se dostiyan chhor kar kafiron se dostiyan karne ki wajah se unhon ne apne liye bura zakheera jama kar rakha hai. Is ki padash mein un ke dilon mein nifaq paida hogaya hai. Aur isi bina par Allah ka ghazab un par nazil hua hai aur Qayamat ke din ke liye daimi azab bhi un ke liye aagay aa rahe hain. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai aye musalmano, zina kari se bacho, is se chhay buraiyan aati hain, teen duniya mein aur teen aakhirat mein. Is se izzat-o-waqar, ronaq-o-tazgi jaati rehti hai. Is se faqr-o-faqa aajata hai. Is se umr ghatti hai aur Qayamat ke din teen buraiyan yeh hain Allah ka ghazab, hisab ki sakhti aur burai, aur Jahannam ka khulood. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aakhri jumlay ki tilawat farmayi. Yeh hadith za'eef hai wallahu a'lam. Phir farmata hai agar yeh log Allah par us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par aur Quran par poora imaan rakhte to hargiz kafiron se dostiyan na karte aur chup chupa kar un se mel milap jaari na rakhte. Na sachay musalmanon se dushmaniyan rakhte. Darasal baat yeh hai ke un mein se aksar log fasiq hain yani Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at se kharij ho chuke hain us ki wahi aur us ke pak kalam ki aayaton ke mukhalif ban baithe hain.

Amr-e-Ma'roof se gurez ka anjam irshad hai ke Bani Israel ke kafir purane mal'oon hain, Hazrat Dawood A.S aur Hazrat Isa A.S ki zabani inhi ke zamana mein mal'oon qarar pa chuke hain. Kyunke woh Allah ke nafarman thay aur makhlooq par zalim thay, Taurat, Injeel, Zaboor aur Quran sab kitabein un par la'nat barsati aayin. Yeh apne zamana mein bhi ek dusre ko bure kamon mein dekhte thay lekin chup chap baithe rehte thay, haram kariyan aur gunah khule aam hote thay aur koi kisi ko rokta na tha. Yeh tha un ka badtareen fe'l. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein farman-e-Rasool ﷺ hai ke "Bani Israel mein pehle pehal jab gunahon ka silsila chala to un ke ulama ne unhein roka. Lekin jab dekha ke baz nahin aate to unhon ne unhein alag nahin kiya balkeh inhi ke sath uthte baithte khate peete rahe, jis ki wajah se dono girohon ke dilon mein aapas mein takra diya Allah Ta'ala ne ek dusre ke dil bhira diye aur Hazrat Dawood A.S aur Hazrat Isa A.S ki zabani un par apni la'nat nazil farmayi. Kyunke woh nafarman aur zalim thay. Is ke bayan ke waqt Huzoor ﷺ tek lagaye hue thay lekin ab theek ho kar baith gaye aur farmaya nahin nahin Allah ki qasam tum par zaroori hai ke logon ko khilaf-e-shar'a baton se roko aur unhein shariat ki pabandi par lao." Abu Dawood ki hadith mein hai ke "Sab se pehle burai Bani Israel mein dakhil hui thi ke ek shakhs dusre ko khilaf-e-shar'a koi kaam karte dekhta to use rokta, use kehta ke Allah se dar aur is bure kaam ko chhor de yeh haram hai. Lekin dusre roz jab woh na chhorta to yeh us se kinara kashi na karta balkeh us ka ham-niwala ham-pyala rehta aur mel jol baqi rakhta, is wajah se sab mein hi sangdili aa gayi. Phir Aap ﷺ ne is poori ayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya Wallah tum par farz hai ke bhali baton ka har ek ko hukum karo, buraiyon se roko, zalim ko us ke zulm se baz rakho aur use tang karo ke haq par aa jaye." Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh hadith majood hai. Abu Dawood waghera mein isi hadith ke aakhir mein yeh bhi hai ke agar tum aisa na karoge to Allah tumhare dilon ko bhi aapas mein ek dusre ke sath takra dega aur tum par apni phitkar nazil farmaye ga jaisi un par nazil farmayi. Is bare mein aur bohat si hadeesein hain kuch sun bhi lijiye Hazrat Jabir R.A wali hadith to ayat (Lau la yan ha humur rabbaniyoona wal ahbaru an qawlihimul isma wa aklihimus suht, labi'sa ma kanu yasna'oon) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 63) ki tafseer mein guzar chuki aur ya ayat (Ya ayyuhallazina amanu alaikum anfusakum, la yadurrukum man dalla izah-tadaitum, ilallahi marji'ukum jamee'an fayunabbi'ukum bima kuntum ta'maloon) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 105) ki tafseer mein Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A aur Hazrat Abu Sa'laba R.A ki hadeesein aayengi, Insha'Allah Ta'ala.

Musnad aur Tirmidhi mein hai ke "Ya toh tum bhalai ka hukm aur burai se mana karte rahoge ya Allah tum par apni taraf se koi azab bhej dega phir tum us se duayein bhi karoge lekin woh qabool nahin farmayega." Ibn-e-Majah mein hai "Achai ka hukm aur burai se mumanat karo is se pehle ke tumhari duayein qabool hone se rok di jayen." Sahih hadith mein hai "Tum mein se jo shakhs khilaf-e-shara kaam dekhe, us par farz hai ke use apne haath se mitaye agar us ki taqat na ho toh zaban se, agar us ki bhi taqat na rakhta ho toh dil se aur yeh bahut hi za'eef iman wala hai" (Muslim). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai "Allah Ta'ala khaas logon ke gunahon ki wajah se aam logon ko azab nahin karta lekin us waqt ke buraiyan un mein phail jayen aur woh bawajood qudrat ke inkar na karein, us waqt aam khaas sab ko Allah Ta'ala azab mein gher leta hai." Abu Dawood mein hai ke jis jagah Allah ki nafarmani honi shuru ho wahan jo bhi ho, un khilaf-e-shara umoor se naraz ho (ek aur riwayat mein hai un ka inkar karta ho) woh misl us ke hai jo wahan hazir hi na ho aur jo un khataon se razi ho go wahan majood na ho woh aisa hai goya un mein hazir hai. Abu Dawood mein hai logon ke uzr jab tak khatam na ho jayen woh halak na honge. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne apne khutbe mein farmaya khabardar kisi shakhs ko logon ki haibat haq baat kehne se rok na de. Is hadith ko bayan farma kar Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ro pade aur farmane lage afsos hum ne aise mauqon par logon ki haibat maan li. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah mein hai afzal jihad kalma-e-haq zalim badshah ke samne keh dena hai. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke Jamra-e-Ula ke paas Huzoor ﷺ ke samne ek shakhs aaya aur aap se sawal kiya ke sab se afzal jihad kaun sa hai? Aap khamosh rahe. Phir aap Jamra-e-Saniya par aaye toh us ne phir wahi sawal kiya magar aap khamosh rahe. Jab Jamra-e-Aqaba par kankar maar chuke aur sawari par sawar hone ke irade se rikab mein paon rakhe toh daryaft farmaya ke woh puchne wala kahan hai? Us ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ main hazir hoon farmaya haq baat zalim badshah ke samne keh dena. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke tum mein se kisi shakhs ko apni be-izzati na karni chahiye logon ne pucha? Huzoor ﷺ yeh kaise? Farmaya khilaf-e-shara koi amr dekhe aur kuch na kahe qayamat ke din us se baz-purs hogi ke falan mauqe par tu kyun khamosh raha? Ek riwayat mein hai ke jab use Allah talqeen-e-hujjat kare ga toh yeh kahe ga ke tujh se toh main ne umeed rakhi aur logon se khauf kha gaya. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke musalmanon ko apne tayin zaleel na karna chahiye. Logon ne pucha kaise? Farmaya un balaon ko sar par lena jin ki bardasht ki taqat na ho. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ se sawal kiya gaya ke Amr-bil-Ma'roof aur Nahi-anil-Munkar kab chhori jaye?

Yahudiyon ka tarikhi kirdar yeh aayat aur us ke baad ki chaar aayatein Najashi aur un ke sathiyon ke bare mein utri hain. Jab un ke samne Habsha ke mulk mein Hazrat Jafar bin Abu Talib ne Quran-e-Kareem parha toh un ki aankhon se aansu jaari ho gaye aur un ki darhiyan tar ho gayin. Yeh khayal rahe ke yeh aayatein Madine mein utri hain aur Hazrat Jafar ka yeh waqia hijrat se pehle ka hai. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh aayatein us wafd ke bare mein nazil hui hain jise Najashi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein bheja tha ke woh aap se milein, hazir-e-khidmat ho kar aap ke halaat-o-sifaat dekhein aur aap ka kalam sunein. Jab yeh aaye aap se mile aur aap ki zaban-e-mubarak se Quran-e-Kareem suna toh un ke dil narm ho gaye, bahut roye dhoye aur Islam qabool kiya aur wapas ja kar Najashi se sab haal kaha. Najashi apni saltanat chhor kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf hijrat kar ke aane lage lekin raste mein hi inteqal ho gaya. Yahan bhi yeh khayal rahe ke yeh bayan sirf Suddi ka hai aur sahih riwayaat se yeh sabit hai ke woh Habsha mein hi saltanat karte hue faut hue. Un ke inteqal wale din hi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne sahaba ko un ke inteqal ki khabar di aur un ki namaz-e-janaza ghaibana ada ki. Baaz toh kehte hain is wafd mein saat toh ulama thay aur paanch zahid thay ya paanch ulama aur saat zahid thay. Baaz kehte hain yeh kul pachaas aadmi thay aur kaha gaya hai ke saath se kuch oopar thay, ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke yeh sattar thay. Fallahu A'lam. Hazrat Atta farmate hain jin ke ausaf aayat mein bayan kiye gaye hain yeh Ahl-e-Habsha hain. Musalman muhajireen-e-Habsha jab un ke paas pohanche toh yeh sab musalman ho gaye thay. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain pehle yeh deen-e-Isawi par qaim thay lekin jab unhon ne musalmanon ko dekha aur Quran-e-Kareem ko suna toh foran sab musalman ho gaye. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ka faisla in sab aqwal ko theek kar deta hai aur farmate hain ke yeh aayatein un logon ke bare mein hain jin mein yeh ausaf hon khwah woh Habsha ke hon ya kahin ke. Yahudiyon ko musalmanon se jo sakht dushmani hai us ki wajah yeh hai ke un mein sarkashi aur inkar ka madda zyada hai aur jaan boojh kar kufr karte hain aur zid se nahaq par arte hain, haq ke muqable mein bigar baithte hain, haq walon par haqarat ki nazrein dalte hain, un se bughz-o-bair rakhte hain. Ilm se kore hain, ulama ki tadaad un mein bahut hi kam hai aur ilm aur zi-ilm logon ki koi waqat un ke dil mein nahin. Yehi thay jinhon ne bahut se ambiya ko qatl kiya, khud Paighambar-uz-Zaman Ahmad-e-Mujtaba Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke qatl ka irada bhi kiya aur ek dafa nahin balkeh baar baar. Aap ko zehar diya, aap par jadu kiya aur apne jaise bad-batin logon ko apne sath mila kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par hamle kiye lekin Allah ne har martaba unhein namurad aur nakam kiya.

Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab kabhi koi Yahudi kisi Musalman ko tanhai mein pata hai uske dil mein uske qatl ka qasd paida hota hai. Ek dusri sanad se bhi yeh hadith marwi hai lekin hai bahut hi ghareeb. Haan Musalmanon se dosti mein zyada qareeb woh log hain jo apne tayin Nasara kehte hain, Hazrat Masih (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke tabe-dar hain, Injeel ke asli aur sahi tareeqe par qaim hain. In mein ek had tak fil-jumla Musalmanon aur Islam ki mohabbat hai. Yeh is liye ke in mein narm dili hai, jaise irshad-e-Bari Ayat (Waja'alna fi qulubillazina-ttaba'uhu ra'fatan wa rahmah) (57. Al-Hadid: 27) yani Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke tabe-daron ke dilon mein hum ne narmi aur raham daal diya hai. Un ki kitab mein hukm hai ke jo tere dahine galle par thappar mare to uske samne bayan galla bhi pesh kar de. Un ki shariat mein ladai hai hi nahin. Yahan un ki is dosti ki wajah yeh bayan farmayi ke in mein khateeb aur waiz hain Qisseen, aur Qiss ki jama Qisseen hai, Qussoos bhi is ki jama aati hai. Ruhban jama hai Rahib ki, Rahib kehte hain aabid ko. Yeh lafz mushtaq hai rahab se aur rahabat ke ma'ani hain khauf aur darr ke. Jaise Rakib ki jama Rukban hai aur Fursan hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer farmate hain kabhi Ruhban wahid ke liye bhi aata hai aur is ki jama Rahabeen aati hai, jaise Qurban aur Qurabeen aur Jawazan aur Jawazeen aur kabhi is ki jama Rahabnah bhi aati hai. Arab ke ashaar mein bhi lafz Ruhban wahid ke liye aaya. Hazrat Salman (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) se ek shakhs (Qisseen-o-Ruhbana) parh kar uske ma'ani daryaft karta hai to aap farmate hain Qisseen ko khanqahon aur ghair-abad jaghon mein chhor, mujhe to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Siddiqeen-o-Ruhbana parhaya (Bazzar aur Ibn-e-Marduyah). Al-gharaz un ke teen ausaf yahan bayan hue hain: In mein aalimon ka hona, in mein aabidon ka hona, in mein tawazo, farotani aur aajizi ka hona.

Iman walon ki pehchan oopar bayan guzar chuka hai ke Isaiyon mein se jo nek dil log is pak mazhab-e-Islam ko qabool kiye hue hain un mein jo achhe ausaf hain maslan ibadat, ilm, tawazo, inkisari waghera, sath hi un mein rehamdili waghera bhi hai haq ki qabooliyat bhi hai Allah ke ahkamat ki itaat bhi hai adab aur lihaz se Kalam-e-Allah sunte hain, is se asar lete hain aur narm dili se ro dete hain kyunke woh haq ke janne wale hain, An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwat ki basharat se pehle hi aagah ho chuke hain. Is liye Quran sunte hi dil mom ho jate hain. Ek taraf aankhein aansu bahane lagti hain dusri janib zaban se haq ko tasleem karte hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) farmate hain yeh ayatein Hazrat Najashi aur un ke sathiyon ke bare mein nazil hui hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke kuch log Hazrat Jafar bin Abi Talib (R.A) ke sath Habsha se aaye the, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaban-e-mubarak se Quran-e-Kareem sun kar iman laye aur betahasha rone lage. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un se daryaft farmaya ke kahin apne watan pahunch kar is se phir to nahin jaoge? Unhon ne kaha namumkin hai, isi ka bayan in ayaton mein hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain shahidon se murad An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur deegar Anbiya-e-Kiram (Alaihimas Salam) ki tabligh ki shahadat hai. Phir is qisam ke Nasraniyon ka ek aur wasf bayan ho raha hai, un hi ka dusra wasf is ayat mein hai ayat (Wa in min ahlil kitabi illa layu'minanna bihi qabla mautihi, wa yaumal qiyamati yakunu alaihim shahida) (Surah An-Nisa: 159) yani Ahl-e-Kitab mein aise log bhi hain jo Allah par aur is Quran par aur jo un par nazil kiya gaya hai sab par iman rakhte hain aur phir Allah se darne wale bhi hain. Un hi ke bare mein farman-e-Rabbani ayat (Alladhina atainahumul kitaba min qablihi hum bihi yu'minun. Wa idha yutla alaihim qalu amanna bihi innahul haqqu mir-rabbina inna kunna min qablihi muslimin. Ulaika yu'tauna ajrahum marrataini bima sabaru wa yadra'una bil-hasanatis sayyi'ata wa mimma razaqnahum yunfiqun. Wa idha sami'ul laghwa a'radu anhu wa qalu lana a'maluna wa lakum a'malukum salamun alaikum la nabtaghil jahilin) (Surah Al-Qasas: 52 ta 55). Ke yeh log is kitab ko aur us kitab ko sach jante hain aur donon par iman rakhte hain. Pas yahan bhi farmaya ke woh kehte hain ke jab hamein saliheen mein milna hai to Allah par aur us ki is aakhri kitab par hum iman kyun na layein? Un ke is iman-o-tasdeeq aur qabooliyat-e-haq ka badla Allah ne unhein yeh diya ke woh hamesha rehne wale taro-taza baghat-o-chashmon wali jannaton mein jayenge. Mohsin, nekokar, muti-e-haq, tabe-e-farman-e-Ilahi logon ki jaza yahi hai, woh kahin ke bhi hon koi bhi hon.

Jo un ke khilaf hain anjam ke lihaz se bhi un ke bar-aks hain, kufr-o-takzeeb aur mukhalifat yahan un ka shewa hai aur wahan Jahannam un ka thikana hai.

Rahbaniyat (khanqah-nashini) Islam mein mamnoo hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke chand sahaba ne aapas mein kaha ke hum khasi ho jayen, dunyawi lazzaton ko tark kar dein, basti chhor kar jangalon mein ja kar tarik-e-dunya logon ki tarah zindagi yaad-e-Ilahi mein basar karein. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un ki yeh baatein maloom ho gayin, aap ne unhein yaad farmaya aur un se poocha, unhon ne iqrar kiya, is par aap ne farmaya tum dekh nahin rahe? Ke main nafli rozay rakhta hoon aur nahin bhi rakhta. Raat ko nafli namaz parhta bhi hoon aur sota bhi hoon. Main ne nikah bhi kar rakhe hain. Suno jo mere tariqe par ho woh to mera hai aur jo meri sunnaton ko na le woh mera nahin. Sahih Bukhari aur Sahih Muslim mein hai ke "Logon ne Ummahat-ul-Momineen se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aamal ki nisbat sawal kiya phir baaz ne kaha ke hum gosht nahin khayenge, baaz ne kaha hum nikah nahin karenge, baaz ne kaha hum bistar par soyenge hi nahin, jab yeh waqea Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke gosh-guzar hua to aap ne farmaya in logon ko kya ho gaya hai ke in mein se baaz yun kehte hain halankeh main roza rakhta hoon aur nahin bhi rakhta, sota bhi hoon aur tahajjud bhi parhta hoon, gosht bhi khata hoon aur nikah bhi kiye hue hoon, jo meri sunnat se munh more woh mera nahin." Tirmidhi waghera mein hai ke kisi shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar kaha ke gosht khane se meri quwwat-e-bah barh jati hai is liye main ne apne oopar gosht ko haram kar liya hai is par yeh aayat utri. Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Gharib batate hain aur sanad se bhi yeh riwayat mursalan marwi hai aur mauqoofan bhi, Wallahu A'lam. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain hum An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki matahuti mein jihad karte thay aur hamare sath hamari biwiyan nahin hoti thin to hum ne kaha achha hoga agar hum khasi ho jayen lekin Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hamein is se roka aur muddat-e-muayyana tak ke liye kapre ke badle par nikah karne ki rukhsat hamein ata farmayi phir Hazrat Abdullah ne yahi aayat parhi. Yeh yaad rahe ke yeh nikah ka waqea mut'ah ki hurmat se pehle ka hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ma'qal bin Muqarrin ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood ko kaha ke main ne to apna bistar apne oopar haram kar liya hai to aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood ke samne khana laya jata hai to ek shakhs is majmay se alag ho jata hai, aap use bulate hain ke aao hamare sath kha lo, woh kehta hai main ne to is cheez ka khana apne oopar haram kar rakha hai. Aap farmate hain aao kha lo apni qasam ka kaffara de dena, phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi (Mustadrak Hakim). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha (R.A) ke ghar koi mehman aaye, aap Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas se raat ko jab wapas ghar pohanche to maloom hua ke ghar walon ne aap ke intezar mein ab tak mehman ko bhi khana nahin khilaya. Aap ko bohat gussa aaya aur farmaya tum ne meri wajah se mehman ko bhooka rakha, yeh khana mujh par haram hai.

Biwi sahiba bhi naraz ho kar yahi keh baithin, mehman ne dekh kar apne upar bhi haram kar liya. Ab toh Hazrat Abdullah bahut ghabraye, khane ki taraf hath barhaya aur sab se kaha chalo Bismillah karo, kha pi liya. Phir jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir huye, sara waqea keh sunaya, pas yeh ayat utri, lekin asar munqata hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is jaisa ek qissa Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ka apne mehmanon ke sath ka hai. Is se Imam Shafi (R.H) waghera ulama ka woh qaul sabit hota hai ke jo shakhs alawa aurton ke kisi aur khane peene ki cheez ko apne upar haram kar le toh woh us par haram nahin ho jati aur na us par is mein koi kaffara hai. Daleel yeh ayat aur dusri woh hadith hai jo upar guzar chuki ke jis shakhs ne apne upar gosht haram kar liya tha, use Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi kaffare ka hukum nahin farmaya. Lekin Imam Ahmad (R.H) aur un ke hum-khayal jamaat-e-ulama ka khayal hai ke jo shakhs khane pehne waghera ki kisi cheez ko apne upar haram kar le toh us par qasam ka kaffara hai. Jaise us shakhs par jo kisi cheez ke tark par qasam kha le. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka fatwa yahi hai aur is ki daleel yeh ayat (يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ اَحَلَّ اللّٰهُ لَكَ ۚ تَبْتَغِيْ مَرْضَاتَ اَزْوَاجِكَ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ) (66. At-Tahrim: 1) bhi hai aur is ayat ke baad hi kaffara-e-qasam ka zikr bhi isi amr ka muqtazi hai ke yeh hurmat qaim maqam-e-qasam ke hai, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain, baaz hazrat ne tark-e-duniya ka, khasi ho jane ka aur taat pehanne ka azm-e-musammam kar liya, is par yeh ayatein utrin. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon (R.A), Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A), Hazrat Miqdad bin Aswad (R.A), Hazrat Salim Maula (R.A), Hazrat Abi Huzaifa (R.A) waghera tark-e-duniya ka irada kar ke gharon mein baith rahe, bahar aana jana tark kar diya, aurton se alaidgi ikhtiyar kar li, taat pehanne lage, achha khana aur achha pehanna haram kar liya aur Bani Israel ke abidon ki waza kar li, balkay irada kar liya ke khasi ho jayen taake yeh taqat hi salb ho jaye aur yeh bhi niyat kar li ke tamam ratain ibadat mein aur tamam din rozon mein guzarenge, is par yeh ayat utri yani yeh khilaf-e-sunnat hai. Pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein bula kar farmaya ke tumhari janon ka tum par haq hai, tumhari aankhon ka bhi tum par haq hai. Nafl rozay rakho aur kabhi kabhi chhor bhi do. Nafl namaz raat ko parho aur kuch der so bhi jao, jo hamari sunnat ko chhor de woh hum mein se nahin. Is par un buzurgon ne farmaya ya Allah hum ne suna aur jo farman hua us par hamari gardanein kham hain. Yeh waqea bahut se tabieen se mursal sanadon se marwi hai. Is ki shahid woh marfoo hadith bhi hai jo upar bayan ho chuki. Falhamdulillah.

Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek din Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Sahaba ke samne wa'z kiya aur us mein khauf aur dar ka hi bayan tha. Use sun kar das Sahabiyon ne jin mein Hazrat Ali (R.A), Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon (R.A) waghera thay, aapas mein kaha ke hamein toh koi bade bade tareeqe ibadat ke ikhtiyar karna chahiyein. Nasraniyon ko dekho ke unhon ne apne nafs par bahut si cheezein haram kar rakhi hain. Is par kisi ne gosht aur charbi waghera khana apne upar haram kiya, kisi ne din ko khana bhi haram kar liya, kisi ne raat ki neend apne upar haram kar li, kisi ne aurton se mubashirat haram kar li. Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon (R.A) ne apni biwi se mel-jol isi bina par tark kar diya. Miyan biwi apne sahih talluqat se alag rehne lage. Ek din yeh biwi sahiba Hazrat Khola (R.A), Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ke paas aayin, wahan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki azwaj-e-mutahharat bhi thin. Unhein paraganda halat mein dekh kar sab ne poocha ke tum ne apna yeh huliya kya bana rakha hai? Na kanghi na choti ki khabar hai, na libas theek-thaak hai, na safai aur khubsurti ka khayal hai? Kya baat hai? Hazrat Khola (R.A) ne farmaya mujhe ab is banao-singaar ki zaroorat hi kya rahi? Itni muddat hui jo mere miyan mujh se mile hi nahin, na kabhi unhon ne mera kapda hataya. Yeh sun kar aur biwiyan hansne lagin. Itne mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye aur daryaft farmaya ke yeh hansi kaisi hai? Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne sara waqia bayan farmaya. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne usi waqt aadmi bhej kar Hazrat Usman (R.A) ko bulwaya aur farmaya yeh kya qissa hai? Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne kul waqia bayan kar ke kaha ke main ne ise is liye chhod rakha hai ke Allah ki ibadat dilchaspi aur farigh-ul-bali se kar sakoon, balkeh mera irada hai ke main khasi ho jaoon taake aurton ke qabil hi na rahoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main tujhe qasam deta hoon ja apni biwi se mel kar le aur us se baat-cheet kar. Jawab diya ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is waqt toh main rozay se hoon. Farmaya jao roza tod daalo. Chunancha unhon ne hukm-bardari ki, roza tod diya aur biwi se bhi mile. Ab phir jo Hazrat Khola (R.A) aayin toh woh achi haiyat mein thin. Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ne hans kar poocha kaho ab kya haal hai? Jawab diya ke ab Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne apna ahd tod diya hai aur kal woh mujh se mile bhi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon mein farmaya logo yeh tumhara kya haal hai ke koi biwiyan haram kar raha hai, koi khana, koi sona. Tum nahin dekhte ke main sota bhi hoon aur qayam bhi karta hoon, iftar bhi karta hoon aur rozay se bhi rehta hoon. Aurton se milta bhi hoon, nikah bhi kar rakhe hain. Suno jo mujh se be-raghbati kare woh mujh se nahin hai. Is par yeh aayat utri. Had se na guzro se matlab yeh hai ke Usman (R.A) ko khasi nahin hona chahiye. Yeh had se guzar jana hai aur un buzurgon ko apni qasmon ka kaffara ada karne ka hukm hua aur farmaya aayat (لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللّٰهُ باللَّغْوِ فِيْٓ اَيْمَانِكُمْ وَلٰكِنْ يُّؤَاخِذُكُمْ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ قُلُوْبُكُمْ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ غَفُوْرٌ حَلِيْمٌ) 2.

Al-Baqarah: 225) Pas 'la ta'tadu' se murad ya toh yeh hai ke Allah ne jin cheezon ko tumhare liye mubah kiya hai tum unhein apne upar haram kar ke tangi na karo aur yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai ke halal ba-qadr-e-kifayat le lo aur is had se aage na nikal jao. Jaise farmaya khao piyo lekin had se na barho. Ek aur ayat mein hai imandaron ka ek wasf yeh bhi hai ke woh kharch karne mein israf aur bakhili ke darmiyan darmiyan rehte hain. Pas ifrat-o-tafrit Allah ke nazdeek buri baat hai aur darmiyani raush rab ko pasand hai. Isi liye yahan bhi farmaya had se guzar jane walon ko Allah napasand farmata hai. Phir farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne jo halal-o-tayyab cheezein tumhein de rakhi hain unhein khao piyo aur apne tamam umoor mein Allah se darte raho uski ita'at aur talab-e-raza-mandi mein raha karo. Uski nafarmani aur uski haram karda cheezon se alag raho. Isi Allah par tum yaqeen rakhte ho, isi par tumhara iman hai pas har amr mein uska lihaz rakho.

Rahbaniyat (khanqah-nashini) Islam mein mamnoo hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke chand sahaba ne aapas mein kaha ke hum khasi ho jayen, dunyawi lazzaton ko tark kar dein, basti chhor kar jangalon mein ja kar tarik-e-dunya logon ki tarah zindagi yaad-e-Ilahi mein basar karein. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un ki yeh baatein maloom ho gayin, aap ne unhein yaad farmaya aur un se poocha, unhon ne iqrar kiya, is par aap ne farmaya tum dekh nahin rahe? Ke main nafli rozay rakhta hoon aur nahin bhi rakhta. Raat ko nafli namaz parhta bhi hoon aur sota bhi hoon. Main ne nikah bhi kar rakhe hain. Suno jo mere tariqe par ho woh to mera hai aur jo meri sunnaton ko na le woh mera nahin. Sahih Bukhari aur Sahih Muslim mein hai ke "Logon ne Ummahat-ul-Momineen se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aamal ki nisbat sawal kiya phir baaz ne kaha ke hum gosht nahin khayenge, baaz ne kaha hum nikah nahin karenge, baaz ne kaha hum bistar par soyenge hi nahin, jab yeh waqea Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke gosh-guzar hua to aap ne farmaya in logon ko kya ho gaya hai ke in mein se baaz yun kehte hain halankeh main roza rakhta hoon aur nahin bhi rakhta, sota bhi hoon aur tahajjud bhi parhta hoon, gosht bhi khata hoon aur nikah bhi kiye hue hoon, jo meri sunnat se munh more woh mera nahin." Tirmidhi waghera mein hai ke kisi shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar kaha ke gosht khane se meri quwwat-e-bah barh jati hai is liye main ne apne oopar gosht ko haram kar liya hai is par yeh aayat utri. Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Gharib batate hain aur sanad se bhi yeh riwayat mursalan marwi hai aur mauqoofan bhi, Wallahu A'lam. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain hum An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki matahuti mein jihad karte thay aur hamare sath hamari biwiyan nahin hoti thin to hum ne kaha achha hoga agar hum khasi ho jayen lekin Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hamein is se roka aur muddat-e-muayyana tak ke liye kapre ke badle par nikah karne ki rukhsat hamein ata farmayi phir Hazrat Abdullah ne yahi aayat parhi. Yeh yaad rahe ke yeh nikah ka waqea mut'ah ki hurmat se pehle ka hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ma'qal bin Muqarrin ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood ko kaha ke main ne to apna bistar apne oopar haram kar liya hai to aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood ke samne khana laya jata hai to ek shakhs is majmay se alag ho jata hai, aap use bulate hain ke aao hamare sath kha lo, woh kehta hai main ne to is cheez ka khana apne oopar haram kar rakha hai. Aap farmate hain aao kha lo apni qasam ka kaffara de dena, phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi (Mustadrak Hakim). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawaha (R.A) ke ghar koi mehman aaye, aap Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas se raat ko jab wapas ghar pohanche to maloom hua ke ghar walon ne aap ke intezar mein ab tak mehman ko bhi khana nahin khilaya. Aap ko bohat gussa aaya aur farmaya tum ne meri wajah se mehman ko bhooka rakha, yeh khana mujh par haram hai.

Biwi sahiba bhi naraz ho kar yahi keh baithin, mehman ne dekh kar apne upar bhi haram kar liya. Ab toh Hazrat Abdullah bahut ghabraye, khane ki taraf hath barhaya aur sab se kaha chalo Bismillah karo, kha pi liya. Phir jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir huye, sara waqea keh sunaya, pas yeh ayat utri, lekin asar munqata hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is jaisa ek qissa Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ka apne mehmanon ke sath ka hai. Is se Imam Shafi (R.H) waghera ulama ka woh qaul sabit hota hai ke jo shakhs alawa aurton ke kisi aur khane peene ki cheez ko apne upar haram kar le toh woh us par haram nahin ho jati aur na us par is mein koi kaffara hai. Daleel yeh ayat aur dusri woh hadith hai jo upar guzar chuki ke jis shakhs ne apne upar gosht haram kar liya tha, use Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi kaffare ka hukum nahin farmaya. Lekin Imam Ahmad (R.H) aur un ke hum-khayal jamaat-e-ulama ka khayal hai ke jo shakhs khane pehne waghera ki kisi cheez ko apne upar haram kar le toh us par qasam ka kaffara hai. Jaise us shakhs par jo kisi cheez ke tark par qasam kha le. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka fatwa yahi hai aur is ki daleel yeh ayat (يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ اَحَلَّ اللّٰهُ لَكَ ۚ تَبْتَغِيْ مَرْضَاتَ اَزْوَاجِكَ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ) (66. Ghair iradi qasmein aur kaffara. Laghw qasmein kya hoti hain? In ke kya ahkaam hain? Yeh sab Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir mein bil-tafseel bayan kar chuke hain is liye yahan in ke dohrane ki zaroorat nahin, falhamdulillah. Maqsad yeh hai ke rawani-e-kalam mein insaan ke munh se baghair qasd ke jo qasmein aadatan nikal jayen woh laghw qasmein hain. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka yahi mazhab hai, mazaq mein qasam kha baithna, Allah ki nafarmani ke karne par qasam kha baithna, ziyadati gumaan ki bina par qasam kha baithna bhi is ki tafsir mein kaha gaya hai. Gusse aur ghazab mein, nisyaan aur bhool chook se khane peene pehanne odhne ki cheezon mein qasam kha baithna murad hai, is qaul ki daleel mein aayat (Yaa ayyuhallazina aamanu la tuharrimu tayyibati ma ahallallahu lakum wa la ta'tadu innallaha la yuhibbul mu'tadeen) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 87) ko pesh kiya jata hai. Bilkul sahih baat yeh hai ke laghw qasmon se murad baghair qasd ki qasmein hain aur is ki daleel (wa lakin yu'akhizukum bima 'aqadtumul ayman) hai, yani jo qasmein bil-qasd aur bil-azm hon un par girift hai aur un par kaffara hai. Kaffara das maskeenon ka khana jo mohtaj faqeer hon jin ke paas ba-qadr-e-kifayat ke na ho, ausat darjay ka khana jo umooman ghar mein khaya jata ho wahi unhein khila dena. Maslan doodh roti, ghee roti, zaitoon ka tel roti, yeh bhi matlab bayan kiya gaya hai ke ba'az logon ki khorak bahut aala hoti hai ba'az log bahut hi halki ghiza khate hain to na woh ho na yeh ho, takalluf bhi na ho aur bukhl bhi na ho, sakhti aur farakhi ke darmiyan ho, maslan gosht roti hai, sirka aur roti hai, roti aur khajoorein hain. Jaisi jis ki darmiyani haisiyat, isi tarah qillat aur kasrat ke darmiyan ho. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se manqool hai ke subh shaam ka khana, Hasan aur Muhammad bin Hanafiyya (R.H) ka qaul hai ke das maskeenon ko ek saath bitha kar roti gosht khila dena kaafi hai ya apni haisiyat ke mutabiq roti kisi aur cheez se khila dena, ba'az ne kaha hai har maskeen ko aadha saa' gehoon, khajoorein waghera de dena, Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) ka qaul hai ke gehoon to aadha saa' kaafi hai aur is ke ilawa har cheez ka poora saa' de de. Ibn Marduyah ki riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek saa' khajooron ka kaffaray mein ek ek shakhs ko diya hai aur logon ko bhi yahi hukm farmaya hai lekin jis ki itni haisiyat na ho woh aadha saa' gehoon ka de de, yeh hadith Ibn Majah mein bhi hai lekin is ka ek raawi bilkul za'eef hai jis ke za'f par muhaddiseen ka ittefaq hai. Darqutni ne isay matrook kaha hai is ka naam Umar bin Abdullah hai, Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke har maskeen ko ek mudd gehoon ma' saalan ke de de, Imam Shafi'i (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain lekin saalan ka zikr nahin hai aur daleel un ki woh hadith hai jis mein hai ke Ramzan shareef ke din mein apni biwi se jima' karne wale ko ek kumtal (khas paimana) mein se saath maskeenon ko khilane ka hukm Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne diya tha is mein pandrah saa' aate hain to har maskeen ke liye ek mudd hua.

Ibn-e-Marduyah ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke Rasool-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qasam ke kaffaray mein gehun ka ek mudd muqarrar kiya hai lekin is ki asnaad bhi za'eef hain kyunke Nazeer bin Zurarah Kufi ke baray mein Imam Abu Hatim Razi ka qaul hai ke woh majhool hai go is se bohat se logon ne riwayat ki hai aur Imam Ibn-e-Hibban ne usay siqah kaha hai wallahu a'lam, phir un ke ustaad Umari bhi za'eef hain, Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) ka farman hai ke gehun ka ek mudd aur baqi anaaj ke do mudd de. Wallahu a'lam (yeh yaad rahay ke sa'a angrezi assi rupay bhar ke seer ke hisab se taqreeban paunay teen seer ka hota hai aur ek sa'a ke chaar mudd hotay hain wallahu a'lam, mutarjim) ya un das ko kapra pehnana, Imam Shafi'i ka qaul hai ke har ek ko khwah kuch hi kapra de de jis par kapray ka itlaq hota ho kafi hai, maslan kurta hai, pajama hai, tehband hai, pagri hai ya sar par lapetnay ka roomal hai. Phir Imam sahab ke shagirdon mein se ba'az to kehtay hain topi bhi kafi hai. Ba'az kehtay hain yeh na-kafi hai, kafi kehnay walay yeh daleel detay hain ke Hazrat Imran bin Haseen (R.A) se jab is ke baray mein sawal hota hai to aap farmatay hain agar koi wafd kisi ameer ke paas aaye aur woh unhein topiyan de to Arab to yahi kahen ge ke qad kaswa unhein kapray pehnaye gaye. Lekin is ki asnaad bhi za'eef hain kyunke Muhammad bin Zubair za'eef hain wallahu a'lam. Mozay pehnanay ke baray mein bhi ikhtilaf hai. Sahih yeh hai ke jaiz nahin. Imam Malik aur Imam Ahmad farmatay hain ke kam se kam utna aur aisa kapra ho ke us mein namaz jaiz ho jaye mard ko diya hai to us ki aur aurat ko diya hai to us ki. Wallahu a'lam. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain abah ho ya shamla ho. Mujahid farmatay hain, adna darja yeh hai ke ek kapra ho aur us se zyada jo ho. Gharz kaffara-e-qasam mein har cheez siwaye janghay ke jaiz hai. Bohat se mufassireen farmatay hain ek ek kapra ek ek miskeen ko de de. Ibrahim Nakh'i ka qaul hai aisa kapra jo poora kar-e-aamad ho maslan lihaf chadar waghera na ke kurta dupatta waghera. Ibn-e-Seereen aur Hasan (R.H) do do kapray kehtay hain, Sa'eed bin Musayyib (R.H) kehtay hain imama jisay sar par bandhay aur aba jisay badan par pehnay. Hazrat Abu Musa (R.A) qasam khatay hain phir usay tortay hain to do kapray Bahrain ke de detay hain. Ibn-e-Marduyah ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke har miskeen ke liye ek aba, yeh hadith ghareeb hai, ya ek ghulam ka azad karna, Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) to farmatay hain ke yeh mutlaq hai kafir ho ya musalman, Imam Shafi'i aur dusray buzrugan-e-deen farmatay hain is ka momin hona zaroori hai kyunke qatl ke kaffaray mein ghulam ki azadi ka hukm hai aur woh muqayyad hai ke woh musalman hona chahye, dono kaffaron ka sabab chahay juda gana hai lekin wajah ek hi hai aur is ki daleel woh hadith bhi hai jo Muslim waghera mein hai ke Hazrat Mu'awiyah bin Hakam Sulami (R.A) ke zimmay ek gardan azad karna thi woh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir huay aur apnay sath ek londi liye huay aaye. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us siyah-faam londi se daryaft farmaya ke Allah kahan hai?

Us ne kaha aasman mein, poocha hum kaun hain? Jawab diya ke aap Rasool (ﷺ) hain. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ise azaad karo yeh imandar aurat hai. Pas in teenon kaamon mein se jo bhi karle woh qasam ka kaffara ho jayega aur kaafi hoga, is par sab ka ijma hai. Quran-e-Kareem ne in cheezon ka bayan sab se zyada aasaan cheez se shuru kiya hai aur batadreej oopar ko pahunchaya hai. Pas sab se sahal khana khilana hai. Phir is se qadre bhaari kapda pehnana hai aur is se bhi zyada bhaari ghulam ko azaad karna hai. Pas is mein adna se aala behtar hai. Ab agar kisi shakhs ko in teenon mein se ek ki bhi qudrat na ho to woh teen din ke rozay rakh le. Saeed bin Jubair aur Hasan Basri (R.H) se marwi hai ke jis ke paas teen dirham hon woh to khana khila de warna rozay rakh le aur baaz mutakhireen se manqool hai ke yeh us ke liye hai jis ke paas zarooriyaat se faazil cheez na ho, ma'ash waghera poonji ke baad jo faaltu ho us se kaffara ada kare. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer farmate hain jis ke paas us din ke apne aur apne baal bachon ke khane se kuch bache us mein se kaffara ada kare. Qasam ke todne ke kaffaray ke rozay pay dar pay rakhne wajib hain ya mustahab hain is mein do qaul hain. Ek yeh ke wajib nahin, Imam Shafi (R.H) ne Baab-ul-Iman mein ise saaf lafzon mein kaha hai, Imam Malik (R.H) ka qaul bhi yahi hai kyunke Quran-e-Kareem mein rozon ka hukm mutlaq hai to khwah pay dar pay hon khwah alag alag hon to sab par yeh sadiq aata hai, jaise ke Ramzan ke rozon ki qaza ke baare mein aayat (Fa 'iddatum min ayyamin ukhar) farmaya gaya hai, wahan bhi pay dar pay ki ya alaihda alaihda ki qaid nahin. Aur Hazrat Imam Shafi (R.H) ne Kitab-ul-Umm mein ek jagah sarahat se kaha hai ke qasam ke kaffaray ke rozay pay dar pay rakhne chahiye, yahi qaul Hanafia aur Hanabila ka hai. Is liye ke Hazrat Ubay bin Ka'ab (R.A) waghera se marwi hai ke un ki qira'at aayat (Fasiyamu thalathati ayyamin mutatabi'at) hai, Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) se bhi yahi qira'at marwi hai. Is surat mein agarcheh is ka mutawatir qira'at hona sabit na ho, taham khabar-e-wahid ya tafseer-e-sahaba se kam darjay ki to yeh qira'at nahin, pas hukman yeh bhi marfoo hai. Ibn-e-Marduyah ki ek bahut hi ghareeb hadees mein hai ke Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ne poocha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) humein ikhtiyar hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan, to ikhtiyar par hai khwah gardan azaad kar, khwah kapda pehna de, khwah khana khila de aur jo na paye woh pay dar pay teen rozay rakh le. Phir farmata hai ke tum jab qasam kha kar tod do to yeh kaffara hai lekin tumhein apni qasmon ki hifazat karni chahiye, unhein baghair kaffaray ke na chhodna chahiye. Isi tarah Allah Ta'ala tumhare samne apni aayatein wazeh taur par bayan farma raha hai taake tum shukarguzari karo.

Pansa bazi, jua aur sharab. In ayaton mein Allah Ta'ala baaz cheezon se rokta hai. Sharab ki muman'at farmayi, phir jue ki rok ki. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib R.A se marvi hai ke shatranj bhi jue mein dakhil hai (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Ata, Mujahid aur Taoos se ya in mein se do se marvi hai ke jue ki har cheez maisir mein dakhil hai go bachon ke khel ke tor par ho. Jahiliyat ke zamane mein jue ka bhi aam riwaj tha jise Islam ne gharat kiya. Un ka ek jua yeh bhi tha ke gosht ko bakri ke badle bechte the, panse phenk kar maal ya phal lena bhi jua hai. Hazrat Qasim bin Muhammad farmate hain ke jo cheez zikr-e-Allah aur namaz se ghafil kar de woh jua hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek marfoo ghareeb hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya in panson se bacho jin se log khela karte the, yeh bhi jua hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai panson se khelne wala goya apne hathon ko suar ke khoon aur gosht mein aalooda karne wala hai. Sunan mein hai ke woh Allah aur Rasool ka nafarman hai. Hazrat Abu Musa R.A ka qaul bhi isi tarah marvi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Musnad mein hai panson se khel kar namaz parhne wale ki misal aisi hai jaise koi shakhs qai aur gandagi se aur suar ke khoon se wuzu kar ke namaz ada kare. Hazrat Abdullah R.A farmate hain mere nazdeek shatranj is se bhi buri hai. Hazrat Ali R.A se shatranj ka jue mein se hona pehle bayan ho chuka hai. Imam Malik, Imam Abu Hanifa, Imam Ahmad to khulm khulla ise haram batate hain aur Imam Shafi'i bhi ise makrooh batate hain. Ansaab un pathron ko kehte hain jin par mushrikeen apne janwar charhaya karte the aur unhein wahin zibah karte the. Azlaam un teeron ko kehte hain jin mein woh faal liya karte the. In sab cheezon ki nisbat farmaya ke yeh Allah ki narazgi ke aur shaitani kaam hain. Yeh gunah ke aur burai ke kaam hain tum in shaitani kamon se bacho inhein chor do taake tum nijat pao. Is fiqre mein musalmanon ko in kamon se rokne ki targheeb hai. Phir raghbat aamez dhamki ke sath musalmanon ko in cheezon se roka gaya hai. Hurmat-e-Sharab ki mazeed wazahat: Ab hum yahan par hurmat-e-sharab ki mazeed ahadees warid karte hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmate hain sharab teen martaba haram hui. An-Hazrat ﷺ jab Madine Sharif mein aaye to log juari sharabi the. Huzoor ﷺ se is bare mein sawal hua aur ayat (YAS-ALUNAKA ANIL-KHAMRI WAL-MAISIRI QUL FEEHIMA ISMUN KABEERUN WA MANAFI'U LIN-NASI WA ISMUHUMA AKBARU MIN NAF'IHIMA) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 219) nazil hui. Is par logon ne kaha yeh dono cheezein hum par haram nahin ki gayin balke yeh farmaya gaya hai ke in mein bohat bara gunah hai aur logon ke liye kuch fawaid bhi hain. Chunancha sharab peete rahe.
