Ek din ek Sahabi apne sathiyon ko Maghrib ki namaz parhane ke liye kharay huay toh qirat mein ghalti ho gayi, is par ayat (Yaa-Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Laa Taqrabus-Salaata Wa Antum Sukaaraa Hattaa Ta'lamoo Maa Taqooloona Wa Laa Junuban Illaa Aabiree Sabeelin Hattaa Taghtasiloo) (Surah An-Nisa: 43) nazil hui. Yeh ba-nisbat pehli ayat ke zyada sakht thi, ab logon ne namazon ke waqt sharab chhor di lekin aadat barabar jaari rahi, is par is se bhi zyada sakht aur sareeh ayat (Yaa-Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Innamaal Khamru Wal-Maisiru Wal-Ansaabu Wal-Azlaamu Rijsun Min 'Amalish-Shaitaani Fajtaniboohu La'allakum Tuflihoon) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 90) nazil hui. Isay sun kar saaray Sahaba bol uthay, "Antahaina Rabbana", aye Allah hum ab baaz rahay, hum ruk gaye. Phir logon ne un logon ke baray mein daryaft farmaya jo sharab aur juay ki hurmat ke nazil honay se peshtar Allah ki raah mein shaheed kiye gaye thay, is ke jawab mein is ke baad ki ayat (Laisa 'Alallazeena) al-kh, nazil hui aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar un ki zindagi mein yeh hukm utra hota toh woh bhi tumhari tarah isay maan letay. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne tahreem-e-sharab ke nazil honay par farmaya, "Ya Allah hamaray samnay aur khol kar bayan farma", pas Surah Al-Baqarah ki ayat (Feehima Ismun Kabeer) nazil hui. Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur un ke samnay is ki tilawat ki gayi, phir bhi Aap (R.A) ne farmaya, "Aye Allah tu hamain aur wazeh lafzon mein farma!", pas Surah An-Nisa ki ayat (Wa Antum Sukaaraa) nazil hui aur Muazzin jab 'Hayya 'Alas-Salaah' kehta toh saath hi keh deta ke nasha-baaz hargiz hargiz namaz ke qareeb bhi na aayain. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur yeh ayat bhi unhain sunayi gayi lekin phir bhi Aap (R.A) ne yahi farmaya ke, "Aye Allah is baray mein safai se bayan farma". Pas Surah Al-Ma'idah ki ayat utri, Aap (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur yeh ayat sunayi gayi, jab ayat (Fahal Antum Muntahoon) tak suna toh farmanay lagay, "Antahaina, Antahaina", hum ruk gaye, hum ruk gaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne Mimbar-e-Nabwi par khutba detay huay farmaya ke sharab ki hurmat jab nazil hui us waqt sharab paanch cheezon ki banayi jaati thi: angoor, shehad, khajoor, gehoon aur jau. Har woh cheez jo aql par ghalib aa jaye khamr hai, yani sharab ke hukm mein hai aur haram hai. Sahih Bukhari mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se marwi hai ke sharab ki hurmat ki ayat ke nuzool ke mauqay par Madinay Shareef mein paanch qisam ki sharabain thin, un mein angoor ki sharab na thi. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) farmatay hain sharab ke baray mein teen ayatain utrin. Awwal toh ayat (Yas'aloonaka 'Anil-Khamri) wali ayat utri toh kaha gaya ke sharab haram ho gayi, is par ba'az Sahaba ne farmaya, "RasoolAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamain is se nafa uthanay dijiye jaisa ke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya", Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khamosh ho gaye. Phir ayat (Wa Antum Sukaaraa) wali ayat utri aur kaha gaya ke sharab haram ho gayi, lekin Sahaba ne farmaya, "Ya RasoolAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum ba-waqt-e-namaz na piyain ge".

Aap phir chup rahe phir yeh dono aayatein utri aur khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farma diya ke ab sharab haram ho gayi. Muslim waghera mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ek dost tha qabeela Saqeef mein se ya qabeela Daus mein se. Fatah-e-Makkah wale din woh aap se mila aur ek mashk sharab ki aap ko tuhfatan dene laga, aap ne farmaya kya tumhein maloom nahin ke Allah Ta'ala ne ise haram kar diya hai. Ab us shakhs ne apne ghulam se kaha ke ja ise bech daal, aap ne farmaya kya kaha? Us ne jawab diya ke bechne ko keh raha hoon, aap ne farmaya jis Allah ne is ka peena haram kiya hai usi ne is ka bechna bhi haram kiya hai. Us ne usi waqt kaha jao ise le jao aur Batha ke maidan mein baha aao. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke Hazrat Tameem Darmi (R.A) Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tuhfa dene ke liye ek mashk sharab ki laye, aap ise dekh kar hans diye aur farmaya yeh toh tumhare jaane ke baad haram ho gayi hai, kaha khair ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ise wapas le jata hoon aur bech kar qeemat wasool kar loon ga, yeh sun kar aap ne farmaya Yahudiyon par Allah ki la'nat hui ke un par jab gaye bakri ki charbi haram hui toh unhon ne ise pighla kar bechna shuru kiya, Allah Ta'ala ne sharab ko aur us ki qeemat ko haram kar diya hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi yeh riwayat hai ke is mein hai ke har saal Hazrat Darmi (R.A) ek mashk hadiya karte the, is ke aakhir mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka do martaba yeh farmana hai ke sharab bhi haram aur us ki qeemat bhi haram. Ek hadees Musnad-e-Ahmad mein aur hai is mein hai ke Hazrat Kaisan (R.A) sharab ke tajir the, jis saal sharab haram hui us saal yeh Sham ke mulk se bahut si sharab tijarat ke liye laye the, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya, aap ne farmaya ab toh haram ho gayi, poocha phir main ise bech daaloon? Aap ne farmaya yeh bhi haram hai aur us ki qeemat bhi haram hai. Chunancha Hazrat Kaisan (R.A) ne woh saari sharab baha di. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain, main Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A), Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A), Hazrat Sahl bin Baiza (R.A) aur Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) ki ek jamaat ko sharab pila raha tha, daur chal raha tha, sab lazzat-andoz ho rahe the, qareeb tha ke nashe ka para barh jaye, itne mein kisi Sahabi ne aa kar khabar di ke kya tumhein ilm nahin sharab toh haram ho gayi? Unhon ne kaha bas karo jo baqi bachi hai ise lundha do, Allah ki qasam is ke baad ek qatra bhi un mein se kisi ke halq mein nahin gaya. Yeh sharab khajoor ki thi aur aamtan isi ki sharab bana karti thi, yeh riwayat Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai aur riwayat mein hai ke sharab khori ki yeh majlis Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ke makaan par thi, naagah munadi ki aawaz pari, mujh se kaha gaya bahar jao dekho kya munadi ho rahi hai? Main ne ja kar suna munadi nida de raha hai ke sharab tum par haram ki gayi hai, main ne aa kar khabar di toh Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ne farmaya utho jitni sharab hai sab baha do, main ne baha di aur main ne dekha ke Madine ke gali koochon mein sharab beh rahi hai, ba'az as-haab ne kaha un ka kya haal hoga jin ke pait mein sharab thi aur woh qatl kar diye gaye?

Is par us ke baad ki aayat (Laisa 'alal-lazina) al-kh, nazil hui yani un par koi haraj nahin, Ibn-e-Jarir ki riwayat mein is majlis walon ke namon mein Hazrat Abu Dujana aur Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal ka naam bhi hai aur yeh bhi hai ke nida sunte hi hum ne sharab baha di, matke aur peepay tod dale. Kisi ne wuzu kar liya, kisi ne ghusl kar liya aur Hazrat Um-e-Sulaim ke yahan se khushbu mangwa kar lagayi aur masjid pahunche to dekha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh aayat padh rahe thay, ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor is se pehle jo log faut ho gaye hain un ka kya hukm hai? Pas is ke baad aayat utri, kisi ne Hazrat Qatada se poocha ke aap ne yeh hadith khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hai? Farmaya han hum jhoot nahin bolte balkay hum to jante bhi nahin ke jhoot kise kehte hain? Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne sharab aur panse aur barbat ka baja haram kar diya hai, sharab se bacho ghabira naam ki sharab aam hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mujh se woh baat mansoob kare jo main ne na kahi ho woh apni jagah jahannam mein bana le. Main ne aap se suna hai ke sharab, jua, panse aur ghabira sab haram hain aur har nashe wali cheez haram hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai sharab ke bare mein das la'natain hain khud sharab par, is ke peene wale par, is ke pilane wale par, is ke bechne wale par, is ke khareedne wale par, is ke nichodne wale par, is ke banane wale par, is ke uthane wale par aur us par bhi jis ke paas yeh utha kar le jayi jaye aur is ki qeemat khane wale par (Abu Dawood, Ibn-e-Majah). Musnad mein hai Ibn-e-Umar farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) baade ki taraf nikle main aap ke sath tha. Aap ke dayen janib chal raha tha jo Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq aaye main hat gaya aur aap ke dahne Hazrat Siddiq chalne lage thodi der mein Hazrat Umar aa gaye main hat gaya aap Huzoor ke bayen taraf ho gaye jab aap baade mein pahunche to dekha ke wahan par chand mashkein sharab ki rakhi hui hain aap ne mujhe bulaya aur farmaya chhuri lao jab main laya to aap ne hukm diya ke yeh mashkein kaat di jayen phir farmaya sharab par, is ke peene wale par, pilane wale par, bechne wale par, khareedar par, uthane wale par, uthwane wale par, banane wale par, banwane wale par, qeemat lene wale par sab par la'nat hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ne yeh mashkein katwa di phir mujhe aur mere sathiyon ko chhuri de kar farmaya jao jitni mashkein sharab ki jahan pao sab kaat kar baha do, pas hum gaye aur sare bazaar mein ek mashk bhi na chhodi.

Baihaqi ki hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs sharab bechte thay aur bahut khairat kiya karte thay. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se sharab faroshi ka masla poocha gaya toh aap ne farmaya yeh haram hai aur is ki qeemat bhi haram hai, ae Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar tumhari kitab ke baad koi kitab utarne wali hoti aur agar tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad koi Nabi (A.S) aur aane wala hota, jis tarah aglon ki ruswaiyan aur un ki buraiyan tumhari kitab mein utrin tumhari kharabiyan un par nazil hotin lekin tumhare af'aal ka izhar Qayamat ke din par mu'akhar rakha gaya hai aur yeh bahut bhari aur bada hai. Phir Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se yeh sawal kiya gaya toh unhon ne farmaya suno main Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath masjid mein tha. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) goth lagaye hue baithe thay farmane lage jis ke paas jitni sharab ho woh hamare paas laye. Logon ne lani shuru ki, jis ke paas jitni thi hazir ki. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jao ise Baqi ke maidan mein fulan fulan jagah rakho. Jab sab jama ho jaye mujhe khabar do, jab jama ho gayi aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha gaya toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) uthay main aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke dahne janib tha aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujh par tek lagaye chal rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) jab aaye toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe hata diya apne bayen kar diya aur meri jagah Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ne le li, phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) se mulaqat hui toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe aur peeche hata diya aur Janab-e-Farooq (R.A) ko apne bayen le liya aur wahan pahunche logon se farmaya jante ho yeh kya hai? Sab ne kaha han jante hain yeh sharab hai, farmaya suno is par, is ke banane wale par, banwane wale par, peene wale par, pilane wale par, uthane wale par, uthwane wale par, bechne wale par, khareedne wale par, qeemat lene wale par Allah ki phitkar hai. Phir chhuri mangwai aur farmaya ise tez kar lo phir apne hath se mashkein phaarni aur matke todne shuru kiye. Logon ne kaha bhi ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mashkon aur matkon ko rahne dijiye aur kaam aayengi farmaya theek hai lekin main toh ab in sab ko tod kar hi rahunga yeh ghazab-o-ghussa Allah ke liye hai kyunke in tamam cheezon se Rabb naraz hai. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap khud kyun takleef karte hain hum hazir hain farmaya nahin main apne hath se inhe neest-o-nabood karunga. Baihaqi ki hadith mein hai ke sharab ke bare mein char aayatein utri hain. Phir hadith bayan farma kar kaha ke ek Ansari ne dawat ki hum dawat mein jama hue khoob sharabein peen. Nashe mein jhoomte hue apne naam-o-nasab par fakhr karne lage, hum afzal hain. Quraishi ne kaha hum afzal hain. Ek Ansari ne oont ka jabda le kar Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ko mara aur hatha-pai hone lagi phir sharab ki hurmat ki aayat utri. Yeh sharab pee kar badmast ho gaye aur aapas mein laaf-zani hone lagi jab nashe utre toh dekhte hain is ki naak par zakhm hai is ke chehre par zakhm hai is ki darhi nuchi hui hai aur ise chot lagi hui hai, kahne lage mujhe fulan ne mara meri be-hurmati fulan ne ki agar is ka dil meri taraf se saaf hota toh mere sath yeh harkat na karta dilon mein nafrat aur dushmani badhne lagi pas yeh aayat utri.

Is par baaz logon ne kaha jab yeh gandagi hai toh falan falan Sahaba toh ise peete hue hi rihlat kar gaye hain un ka kya haal hoga? In mein se baaz Uhad ke maidan mein shaheed hue hain is ke jawab mein agli aayat utri. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Hazrat Abu Buraidah ke walid kehte hain ke hum chaar shakhs ret ke ek teele par baithe sharab pee rahe the, daur chal raha tha, jaam gardish mein tha, nagahan main khada hua aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua. Salam kiya wahin hurmat-e-sharab ki yeh aayat nazil hui. Main pichle pairon apni usi majlis mein aaya aur apne sathiyon ko yeh aayat parh kar sunayi, baaz woh bhi the, jin ke munh se jaam laga hua tha lekin wallah unhon ne usi waqt ise alag kar diya aur jitna piya tha ise qai kar ke nikal diya aur kehne lage ya Allah hum ruk gaye hum baaz aa gaye. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke jang-e-Uhad ki subah baaz logon ne sharabein pi thin aur maidan mein usi roz Allah ki raah mein shaheed kar diye gaye us waqt tak sharab haram nahin hui thi. Bazzar mein yeh ziyadati bhi hai ke isi par baaz Yahudiyon ne aitraz kiya aur jawab mein aayat (لَيْسَ عَلَي الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيْمَا طَعِمُوْٓا اِذَا مَا اتَّقَوْا وَّاٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ ثُمَّ اتَّقَوْا وَّاٰمَنُوْا ثُمَّ اتَّقَوْا وَّاَحْسَنُوْا ۭ وَاللّٰهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 93) nazil hui. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke ek shakhs Khaibar se sharab la kar Madine mein farokht kiya karta tha, ek din woh la raha tha ek Sahabi raste mein hi use mil gaye aur farmaya sharab toh ab haram ho gayi, woh wapas mur gaya aur ek teele tale use kapde se dhanp kar aa gaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kehne laga kya yeh sach hai ke sharab haram ho gayi? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan sach hai, kaha phir mujhe ijazat dijiye ke jis se li hai use wapas kar doon. Farmaya is ka lautana bhi jaiz nahin, kaha phir ijazat dijiye ke main ise aise shakhs ko tohfa doon jo is ka muawza mujhe de, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh bhi theek nahin, kaha Huzoor is mein yateemon ka maal bhi laga hua hai, farmaya dekho jab hamare paas Bahrain ka maal aayega us se hum tumhare yateemon ki madad karenge, phir Madina mein munadi ho gayi, ek shakhs ne kaha Huzoor sharab ke bartanon se nafa hasil karne ki ijazat dijiye, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jao mashkon ko khol daalo aur sharab baha do, is qadar sharab bahi ke maidan bhar gaye. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke mere haan jo yateem bachay pal rahe hain un ke wirse mein unhein sharab mili hai, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jao ise baha do, arz kiya agar ijazat ho toh is ka sirka bana loon, farmaya nahin. Yeh hadith Muslim, Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein sahih sanad se marvi hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) ne farmaya jaise yeh aayat Quran mein hai Taurat mein bhi hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne haq ko nazil farmaya taake uski wajah se batil ko door kar de aur us se khel tamashe, baje gaje, barbat, duff, tambura, raag ragniyan fana kar de. Sharabi ke liye sharab nuqsan deh hai. Allah Ta'ala ne apni izzat ki qasam khai hai ke jo ise hurmat ke baad piye ga use main Qayamat ke din pyasa rakhunga aur hurmat ke baad jo ise chhore ga main use Jannat ke pakeeza chashme se pilaunga. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai jis shakhs ne nasha ki wajah se ek waqt ki namaz chhori woh aisa hai jaise ke us se roo-e-zameen ki saltanat chhin gayi aur jis shakhs ne chaar baar ki namaz nashe mein chhor di Allah Ta'ala use Teenat-ul-Khayal pilaye ga. Poocha gaya ke yeh kya hai? Farmaya jahannumiyon ka lahoo, peep, paseena, peshab waghera (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Abu Dawood mein hai ke har aql ko dhanpne wali cheez khamr hai aur har nasha wali cheez haram hai aur jo shakhs nashe wali cheez piye ga uski chalees din ki namazein na-qabool hain. Agar woh tauba kare ga to tauba qabool hogi agar us ne chauthi martaba sharab pi to Allah Ta'ala use zaroor Teenat-ul-Khayal pilaye ga, poocha gaya woh kya hai? Farmaya jahannumiyon ka nichod aur unki peep aur jo shakhs ise kisi bacha ko pilaye ga jo halal haram ki tameez na rakhta ho Allah Ta'ala par haq hai ke use bhi jahannumiyon ka peep pilaye. Bukhari, Muslim waghera mein hai duniya mein jo sharab piye ga aur tauba na kare ga woh Jannat ki sharab se mehroom rahe ga. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain har nasha wali cheez khamr hai aur har nasha wali cheez haram hai aur jis shakhs ne sharab ki aadat dali aur be-tauba mar gaya woh Jannat ki sharab se mehroom rahe ga. Nasai waghera mein hai teen shakhson ki taraf Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din nazar-e-rahmat se na dekhe ga, maa baap ka nafarman, sharab ki aadat wala aur Allah ki raah mein de kar ehsan jatlane wala, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke de kar ehsan jatlane wala, maa baap ka nafarman aur sharabi Jannat mein nahin jaye ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein is ke saath hi hai ke zina ki aulad bhi, Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) farmate hain sharab se parhez karo woh tamam buraiyon ki jar hai. Suno agle logon mein ek Wali-ullah tha jo bada ibadat guzar tha aur tarik-e-duniya tha. Basti se alag thalag ek ibadat khane mein shab-o-roz ibadat-e-Ilahi mein mashghool raha karta tha, ek badkar aurat us ke peeche lag gayi, us ne apni londi ko bhej kar use apne haan ek shahadat ke bahane bulwaya, yeh chale gaye londi apne ghar mein unhein le gayi jis darwaze ke andar yeh pahunch jate peeche se londi use band karti jati. Aakhri kamre mein jab gaye to dekha ke ek bahut hi khubsurat aurat baithi hai, us ke paas ek bacha hai aur ek jaam-e-sharab labalab bhara rakha hai.

Us aurat ne us se kaha suniye janab main ne aap ko darhaqiqat kisi gawahi ke liye nahin bulwaya, filwaqay is liye bulwaya hai ke ya to aap mere sath badkari karein ya is bache ko qatl kar dein ya sharab ko pee lein. Darwesh ne soch kar teenon kamon mein halka kaam sharab ka peena jaan kar jaam ko munh se laga liya, sara pee gaya. Kehne laga aur lao aur lao, khoob piya, jab nashe mein madhosh ho gaya to us aurat ke sath zina bhi kar baitha aur us ladke ko bhi qatl kar diya. Pas ae logo! Tum sharab se bacho samajh lo ke sharab aur iman jama nahin hote, ek ka aana dusre ka jaana hai (Baihaqi). Imam Abu Bakr bin Abi Dunya (R.H) ne apni kitab Zamm-ul-Muskir mein bhi ise warid kiya hai aur is mein marfoo hai lekin zyada sahi is ka mauqoof hona hai, wallahu aalam. Is ki shahid Bukhari o Muslim ki marfoo hadith bhi hai jis mein hai ke zani zina ke waqt, chor chori ke waqt, sharabi sharab khori ke waqt momin nahin rehta. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jab sharab haram hui to sahaba ne sawal kiya ke is ki hurmat se pehle jo log inteqal kar chuke hain un ka kya hukm hai? Is par yeh aayat (Laisa 'alal-lazina) al-kh, nazil hui yani un par is mein koi haraj nahin aur jab Bait-ul-Muqaddas ka qibla badla aur Baitullah Sharif qibla hua us waqt bhi sahaba ne pehle qibla ki taraf namazein padhte hue inteqal kar jaane walon ki nisbat daryaft kiya to aayat (Ma kanallahu liyudi'a imanakum) al-kh, nazil hui yani un ki namazein zaya na hongi. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs sharab piye chalis din tak Allah Ta'ala ki narazgi us par rehti hai agar woh isi halat mein mar gaya to kafir mare ga, han agar us ne tauba ki to Allah Ta'ala us ki tauba qabool farmaye ga aur agar us ne phir bhi sharab pi to Allah Ta'ala dozakhiyon ka fazla pilaye ga aur riwayat mein hai ke jab yeh hukm utra ke imandaron par hurmat se pehle pi hui ka koi gunah nahin to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujh se kaha gaya hai ke tu unhi mein se hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai panson ke khel se bacho yeh ajmiyon ka jua hai.

Pansa bazi, jua aur sharab. In ayaton mein Allah Ta'ala baaz cheezon se rokta hai. Sharab ki muman'at farmayi, phir jue ki rok ki. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib R.A se marvi hai ke shatranj bhi jue mein dakhil hai (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Ata, Mujahid aur Taoos se ya in mein se do se marvi hai ke jue ki har cheez maisir mein dakhil hai go bachon ke khel ke tor par ho. Jahiliyat ke zamane mein jue ka bhi aam riwaj tha jise Islam ne gharat kiya. Un ka ek jua yeh bhi tha ke gosht ko bakri ke badle bechte the, panse phenk kar maal ya phal lena bhi jua hai. Hazrat Qasim bin Muhammad farmate hain ke jo cheez zikr-e-Allah aur namaz se ghafil kar de woh jua hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek marfoo ghareeb hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya in panson se bacho jin se log khela karte the, yeh bhi jua hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai panson se khelne wala goya apne hathon ko suar ke khoon aur gosht mein aalooda karne wala hai. Sunan mein hai ke woh Allah aur Rasool ka nafarman hai. Hazrat Abu Musa R.A ka qaul bhi isi tarah marvi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Musnad mein hai panson se khel kar namaz parhne wale ki misal aisi hai jaise koi shakhs qai aur gandagi se aur suar ke khoon se wuzu kar ke namaz ada kare. Hazrat Abdullah R.A farmate hain mere nazdeek shatranj is se bhi buri hai. Hazrat Ali R.A se shatranj ka jue mein se hona pehle bayan ho chuka hai. Imam Malik, Imam Abu Hanifa, Imam Ahmad to khulm khulla ise haram batate hain aur Imam Shafi'i bhi ise makrooh batate hain. Ansaab un pathron ko kehte hain jin par mushrikeen apne janwar charhaya karte the aur unhein wahin zibah karte the. Azlaam un teeron ko kehte hain jin mein woh faal liya karte the. In sab cheezon ki nisbat farmaya ke yeh Allah ki narazgi ke aur shaitani kaam hain. Yeh gunah ke aur burai ke kaam hain tum in shaitani kamon se bacho inhein chor do taake tum nijat pao. Is fiqre mein musalmanon ko in kamon se rokne ki targheeb hai. Phir raghbat aamez dhamki ke sath musalmanon ko in cheezon se roka gaya hai. Hurmat-e-Sharab ki mazeed wazahat: Ab hum yahan par hurmat-e-sharab ki mazeed ahadees warid karte hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmate hain sharab teen martaba haram hui. An-Hazrat ﷺ jab Madine Sharif mein aaye to log juari sharabi the. Huzoor ﷺ se is bare mein sawal hua aur ayat (YAS-ALUNAKA ANIL-KHAMRI WAL-MAISIRI QUL FEEHIMA ISMUN KABEERUN WA MANAFI'U LIN-NASI WA ISMUHUMA AKBARU MIN NAF'IHIMA) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 219) nazil hui. Is par logon ne kaha yeh dono cheezein hum par haram nahin ki gayin balke yeh farmaya gaya hai ke in mein bohat bara gunah hai aur logon ke liye kuch fawaid bhi hain. Chunancha sharab peete rahe.

Ek din ek Sahabi apne sathiyon ko Maghrib ki namaz parhane ke liye kharay huay toh qirat mein ghalti ho gayi, is par ayat (Yaa-Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Laa Taqrabus-Salaata Wa Antum Sukaaraa Hattaa Ta'lamoo Maa Taqooloona Wa Laa Junuban Illaa Aabiree Sabeelin Hattaa Taghtasiloo) (Surah An-Nisa: 43) nazil hui. Yeh ba-nisbat pehli ayat ke zyada sakht thi, ab logon ne namazon ke waqt sharab chhor di lekin aadat barabar jaari rahi, is par is se bhi zyada sakht aur sareeh ayat (Yaa-Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Innamaal Khamru Wal-Maisiru Wal-Ansaabu Wal-Azlaamu Rijsun Min 'Amalish-Shaitaani Fajtaniboohu La'allakum Tuflihoon) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 90) nazil hui. Isay sun kar saaray Sahaba bol uthay, "Antahaina Rabbana", aye Allah hum ab baaz rahay, hum ruk gaye. Phir logon ne un logon ke baray mein daryaft farmaya jo sharab aur juay ki hurmat ke nazil honay se peshtar Allah ki raah mein shaheed kiye gaye thay, is ke jawab mein is ke baad ki ayat (Laisa 'Alallazeena) al-kh, nazil hui aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar un ki zindagi mein yeh hukm utra hota toh woh bhi tumhari tarah isay maan letay. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne tahreem-e-sharab ke nazil honay par farmaya, "Ya Allah hamaray samnay aur khol kar bayan farma", pas Surah Al-Baqarah ki ayat (Feehima Ismun Kabeer) nazil hui. Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur un ke samnay is ki tilawat ki gayi, phir bhi Aap (R.A) ne farmaya, "Aye Allah tu hamain aur wazeh lafzon mein farma!", pas Surah An-Nisa ki ayat (Wa Antum Sukaaraa) nazil hui aur Muazzin jab 'Hayya 'Alas-Salaah' kehta toh saath hi keh deta ke nasha-baaz hargiz hargiz namaz ke qareeb bhi na aayain. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur yeh ayat bhi unhain sunayi gayi lekin phir bhi Aap (R.A) ne yahi farmaya ke, "Aye Allah is baray mein safai se bayan farma". Pas Surah Al-Ma'idah ki ayat utri, Aap (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur yeh ayat sunayi gayi, jab ayat (Fahal Antum Muntahoon) tak suna toh farmanay lagay, "Antahaina, Antahaina", hum ruk gaye, hum ruk gaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne Mimbar-e-Nabwi par khutba detay huay farmaya ke sharab ki hurmat jab nazil hui us waqt sharab paanch cheezon ki banayi jaati thi: angoor, shehad, khajoor, gehoon aur jau. Har woh cheez jo aql par ghalib aa jaye khamr hai, yani sharab ke hukm mein hai aur haram hai. Sahih Bukhari mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se marwi hai ke sharab ki hurmat ki ayat ke nuzool ke mauqay par Madinay Shareef mein paanch qisam ki sharabain thin, un mein angoor ki sharab na thi. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) farmatay hain sharab ke baray mein teen ayatain utrin. Awwal toh ayat (Yas'aloonaka 'Anil-Khamri) wali ayat utri toh kaha gaya ke sharab haram ho gayi, is par ba'az Sahaba ne farmaya, "RasoolAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamain is se nafa uthanay dijiye jaisa ke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya", Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khamosh ho gaye. Phir ayat (Wa Antum Sukaaraa) wali ayat utri aur kaha gaya ke sharab haram ho gayi, lekin Sahaba ne farmaya, "Ya RasoolAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum ba-waqt-e-namaz na piyain ge".

Aap phir chup rahe phir yeh dono aayatein utri aur khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farma diya ke ab sharab haram ho gayi. Muslim waghera mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ek dost tha qabeela Saqeef mein se ya qabeela Daus mein se. Fatah-e-Makkah wale din woh aap se mila aur ek mashk sharab ki aap ko tuhfatan dene laga, aap ne farmaya kya tumhein maloom nahin ke Allah Ta'ala ne ise haram kar diya hai. Ab us shakhs ne apne ghulam se kaha ke ja ise bech daal, aap ne farmaya kya kaha? Us ne jawab diya ke bechne ko keh raha hoon, aap ne farmaya jis Allah ne is ka peena haram kiya hai usi ne is ka bechna bhi haram kiya hai. Us ne usi waqt kaha jao ise le jao aur Batha ke maidan mein baha aao. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke Hazrat Tameem Darmi (R.A) Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tuhfa dene ke liye ek mashk sharab ki laye, aap ise dekh kar hans diye aur farmaya yeh toh tumhare jaane ke baad haram ho gayi hai, kaha khair ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ise wapas le jata hoon aur bech kar qeemat wasool kar loon ga, yeh sun kar aap ne farmaya Yahudiyon par Allah ki la'nat hui ke un par jab gaye bakri ki charbi haram hui toh unhon ne ise pighla kar bechna shuru kiya, Allah Ta'ala ne sharab ko aur us ki qeemat ko haram kar diya hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi yeh riwayat hai ke is mein hai ke har saal Hazrat Darmi (R.A) ek mashk hadiya karte the, is ke aakhir mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka do martaba yeh farmana hai ke sharab bhi haram aur us ki qeemat bhi haram. Ek hadees Musnad-e-Ahmad mein aur hai is mein hai ke Hazrat Kaisan (R.A) sharab ke tajir the, jis saal sharab haram hui us saal yeh Sham ke mulk se bahut si sharab tijarat ke liye laye the, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya, aap ne farmaya ab toh haram ho gayi, poocha phir main ise bech daaloon? Aap ne farmaya yeh bhi haram hai aur us ki qeemat bhi haram hai. Chunancha Hazrat Kaisan (R.A) ne woh saari sharab baha di. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain, main Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A), Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A), Hazrat Sahl bin Baiza (R.A) aur Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) ki ek jamaat ko sharab pila raha tha, daur chal raha tha, sab lazzat-andoz ho rahe the, qareeb tha ke nashe ka para barh jaye, itne mein kisi Sahabi ne aa kar khabar di ke kya tumhein ilm nahin sharab toh haram ho gayi? Unhon ne kaha bas karo jo baqi bachi hai ise lundha do, Allah ki qasam is ke baad ek qatra bhi un mein se kisi ke halq mein nahin gaya. Yeh sharab khajoor ki thi aur aamtan isi ki sharab bana karti thi, yeh riwayat Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai aur riwayat mein hai ke sharab khori ki yeh majlis Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ke makaan par thi, naagah munadi ki aawaz pari, mujh se kaha gaya bahar jao dekho kya munadi ho rahi hai? Main ne ja kar suna munadi nida de raha hai ke sharab tum par haram ki gayi hai, main ne aa kar khabar di toh Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ne farmaya utho jitni sharab hai sab baha do, main ne baha di aur main ne dekha ke Madine ke gali koochon mein sharab beh rahi hai, ba'az as-haab ne kaha un ka kya haal hoga jin ke pait mein sharab thi aur woh qatl kar diye gaye?

Is par us ke baad ki aayat (Laisa 'alal-lazina) al-kh, nazil hui yani un par koi haraj nahin, Ibn-e-Jarir ki riwayat mein is majlis walon ke namon mein Hazrat Abu Dujana aur Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal ka naam bhi hai aur yeh bhi hai ke nida sunte hi hum ne sharab baha di, matke aur peepay tod dale. Kisi ne wuzu kar liya, kisi ne ghusl kar liya aur Hazrat Um-e-Sulaim ke yahan se khushbu mangwa kar lagayi aur masjid pahunche to dekha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh aayat padh rahe thay, ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor is se pehle jo log faut ho gaye hain un ka kya hukm hai? Pas is ke baad aayat utri, kisi ne Hazrat Qatada se poocha ke aap ne yeh hadith khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hai? Farmaya han hum jhoot nahin bolte balkay hum to jante bhi nahin ke jhoot kise kehte hain? Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne sharab aur panse aur barbat ka baja haram kar diya hai, sharab se bacho ghabira naam ki sharab aam hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mujh se woh baat mansoob kare jo main ne na kahi ho woh apni jagah jahannam mein bana le. Main ne aap se suna hai ke sharab, jua, panse aur ghabira sab haram hain aur har nashe wali cheez haram hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai sharab ke bare mein das la'natain hain khud sharab par, is ke peene wale par, is ke pilane wale par, is ke bechne wale par, is ke khareedne wale par, is ke nichodne wale par, is ke banane wale par, is ke uthane wale par aur us par bhi jis ke paas yeh utha kar le jayi jaye aur is ki qeemat khane wale par (Abu Dawood, Ibn-e-Majah). Musnad mein hai Ibn-e-Umar farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) baade ki taraf nikle main aap ke sath tha. Aap ke dayen janib chal raha tha jo Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq aaye main hat gaya aur aap ke dahne Hazrat Siddiq chalne lage thodi der mein Hazrat Umar aa gaye main hat gaya aap Huzoor ke bayen taraf ho gaye jab aap baade mein pahunche to dekha ke wahan par chand mashkein sharab ki rakhi hui hain aap ne mujhe bulaya aur farmaya chhuri lao jab main laya to aap ne hukm diya ke yeh mashkein kaat di jayen phir farmaya sharab par, is ke peene wale par, pilane wale par, bechne wale par, khareedar par, uthane wale par, uthwane wale par, banane wale par, banwane wale par, qeemat lene wale par sab par la'nat hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ne yeh mashkein katwa di phir mujhe aur mere sathiyon ko chhuri de kar farmaya jao jitni mashkein sharab ki jahan pao sab kaat kar baha do, pas hum gaye aur sare bazaar mein ek mashk bhi na chhodi.

Baihaqi ki hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs sharab bechte thay aur bahut khairat kiya karte thay. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se sharab faroshi ka masla poocha gaya toh aap ne farmaya yeh haram hai aur is ki qeemat bhi haram hai, ae Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar tumhari kitab ke baad koi kitab utarne wali hoti aur agar tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad koi Nabi (A.S) aur aane wala hota, jis tarah aglon ki ruswaiyan aur un ki buraiyan tumhari kitab mein utrin tumhari kharabiyan un par nazil hotin lekin tumhare af'aal ka izhar Qayamat ke din par mu'akhar rakha gaya hai aur yeh bahut bhari aur bada hai. Phir Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se yeh sawal kiya gaya toh unhon ne farmaya suno main Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath masjid mein tha. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) goth lagaye hue baithe thay farmane lage jis ke paas jitni sharab ho woh hamare paas laye. Logon ne lani shuru ki, jis ke paas jitni thi hazir ki. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jao ise Baqi ke maidan mein fulan fulan jagah rakho. Jab sab jama ho jaye mujhe khabar do, jab jama ho gayi aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha gaya toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) uthay main aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke dahne janib tha aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujh par tek lagaye chal rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) jab aaye toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe hata diya apne bayen kar diya aur meri jagah Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ne le li, phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) se mulaqat hui toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe aur peeche hata diya aur Janab-e-Farooq (R.A) ko apne bayen le liya aur wahan pahunche logon se farmaya jante ho yeh kya hai? Sab ne kaha han jante hain yeh sharab hai, farmaya suno is par, is ke banane wale par, banwane wale par, peene wale par, pilane wale par, uthane wale par, uthwane wale par, bechne wale par, khareedne wale par, qeemat lene wale par Allah ki phitkar hai. Phir chhuri mangwai aur farmaya ise tez kar lo phir apne hath se mashkein phaarni aur matke todne shuru kiye. Logon ne kaha bhi ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mashkon aur matkon ko rahne dijiye aur kaam aayengi farmaya theek hai lekin main toh ab in sab ko tod kar hi rahunga yeh ghazab-o-ghussa Allah ke liye hai kyunke in tamam cheezon se Rabb naraz hai. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap khud kyun takleef karte hain hum hazir hain farmaya nahin main apne hath se inhe neest-o-nabood karunga. Baihaqi ki hadith mein hai ke sharab ke bare mein char aayatein utri hain. Phir hadith bayan farma kar kaha ke ek Ansari ne dawat ki hum dawat mein jama hue khoob sharabein peen. Nashe mein jhoomte hue apne naam-o-nasab par fakhr karne lage, hum afzal hain. Quraishi ne kaha hum afzal hain. Ek Ansari ne oont ka jabda le kar Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ko mara aur hatha-pai hone lagi phir sharab ki hurmat ki aayat utri. Yeh sharab pee kar badmast ho gaye aur aapas mein laaf-zani hone lagi jab nashe utre toh dekhte hain is ki naak par zakhm hai is ke chehre par zakhm hai is ki darhi nuchi hui hai aur ise chot lagi hui hai, kahne lage mujhe fulan ne mara meri be-hurmati fulan ne ki agar is ka dil meri taraf se saaf hota toh mere sath yeh harkat na karta dilon mein nafrat aur dushmani badhne lagi pas yeh aayat utri.

Is par baaz logon ne kaha jab yeh gandagi hai toh falan falan Sahaba toh ise peete hue hi rihlat kar gaye hain un ka kya haal hoga? In mein se baaz Uhad ke maidan mein shaheed hue hain is ke jawab mein agli aayat utri. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Hazrat Abu Buraidah ke walid kehte hain ke hum chaar shakhs ret ke ek teele par baithe sharab pee rahe the, daur chal raha tha, jaam gardish mein tha, nagahan main khada hua aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua. Salam kiya wahin hurmat-e-sharab ki yeh aayat nazil hui. Main pichle pairon apni usi majlis mein aaya aur apne sathiyon ko yeh aayat parh kar sunayi, baaz woh bhi the, jin ke munh se jaam laga hua tha lekin wallah unhon ne usi waqt ise alag kar diya aur jitna piya tha ise qai kar ke nikal diya aur kehne lage ya Allah hum ruk gaye hum baaz aa gaye. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke jang-e-Uhad ki subah baaz logon ne sharabein pi thin aur maidan mein usi roz Allah ki raah mein shaheed kar diye gaye us waqt tak sharab haram nahin hui thi. Bazzar mein yeh ziyadati bhi hai ke isi par baaz Yahudiyon ne aitraz kiya aur jawab mein aayat (لَيْسَ عَلَي الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيْمَا طَعِمُوْٓا اِذَا مَا اتَّقَوْا وَّاٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ ثُمَّ اتَّقَوْا وَّاٰمَنُوْا ثُمَّ اتَّقَوْا وَّاَحْسَنُوْا ۭ وَاللّٰهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 93) nazil hui. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke ek shakhs Khaibar se sharab la kar Madine mein farokht kiya karta tha, ek din woh la raha tha ek Sahabi raste mein hi use mil gaye aur farmaya sharab toh ab haram ho gayi, woh wapas mur gaya aur ek teele tale use kapde se dhanp kar aa gaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kehne laga kya yeh sach hai ke sharab haram ho gayi? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan sach hai, kaha phir mujhe ijazat dijiye ke jis se li hai use wapas kar doon. Farmaya is ka lautana bhi jaiz nahin, kaha phir ijazat dijiye ke main ise aise shakhs ko tohfa doon jo is ka muawza mujhe de, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh bhi theek nahin, kaha Huzoor is mein yateemon ka maal bhi laga hua hai, farmaya dekho jab hamare paas Bahrain ka maal aayega us se hum tumhare yateemon ki madad karenge, phir Madina mein munadi ho gayi, ek shakhs ne kaha Huzoor sharab ke bartanon se nafa hasil karne ki ijazat dijiye, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jao mashkon ko khol daalo aur sharab baha do, is qadar sharab bahi ke maidan bhar gaye. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke mere haan jo yateem bachay pal rahe hain un ke wirse mein unhein sharab mili hai, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jao ise baha do, arz kiya agar ijazat ho toh is ka sirka bana loon, farmaya nahin. Yeh hadith Muslim, Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein sahih sanad se marvi hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) ne farmaya jaise yeh aayat Quran mein hai Taurat mein bhi hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne haq ko nazil farmaya taake uski wajah se batil ko door kar de aur us se khel tamashe, baje gaje, barbat, duff, tambura, raag ragniyan fana kar de. Sharabi ke liye sharab nuqsan deh hai. Allah Ta'ala ne apni izzat ki qasam khai hai ke jo ise hurmat ke baad piye ga use main Qayamat ke din pyasa rakhunga aur hurmat ke baad jo ise chhore ga main use Jannat ke pakeeza chashme se pilaunga. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai jis shakhs ne nasha ki wajah se ek waqt ki namaz chhori woh aisa hai jaise ke us se roo-e-zameen ki saltanat chhin gayi aur jis shakhs ne chaar baar ki namaz nashe mein chhor di Allah Ta'ala use Teenat-ul-Khayal pilaye ga. Poocha gaya ke yeh kya hai? Farmaya jahannumiyon ka lahoo, peep, paseena, peshab waghera (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Abu Dawood mein hai ke har aql ko dhanpne wali cheez khamr hai aur har nasha wali cheez haram hai aur jo shakhs nashe wali cheez piye ga uski chalees din ki namazein na-qabool hain. Agar woh tauba kare ga to tauba qabool hogi agar us ne chauthi martaba sharab pi to Allah Ta'ala use zaroor Teenat-ul-Khayal pilaye ga, poocha gaya woh kya hai? Farmaya jahannumiyon ka nichod aur unki peep aur jo shakhs ise kisi bacha ko pilaye ga jo halal haram ki tameez na rakhta ho Allah Ta'ala par haq hai ke use bhi jahannumiyon ka peep pilaye. Bukhari, Muslim waghera mein hai duniya mein jo sharab piye ga aur tauba na kare ga woh Jannat ki sharab se mehroom rahe ga. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain har nasha wali cheez khamr hai aur har nasha wali cheez haram hai aur jis shakhs ne sharab ki aadat dali aur be-tauba mar gaya woh Jannat ki sharab se mehroom rahe ga. Nasai waghera mein hai teen shakhson ki taraf Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din nazar-e-rahmat se na dekhe ga, maa baap ka nafarman, sharab ki aadat wala aur Allah ki raah mein de kar ehsan jatlane wala, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke de kar ehsan jatlane wala, maa baap ka nafarman aur sharabi Jannat mein nahin jaye ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein is ke saath hi hai ke zina ki aulad bhi, Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) farmate hain sharab se parhez karo woh tamam buraiyon ki jar hai. Suno agle logon mein ek Wali-ullah tha jo bada ibadat guzar tha aur tarik-e-duniya tha. Basti se alag thalag ek ibadat khane mein shab-o-roz ibadat-e-Ilahi mein mashghool raha karta tha, ek badkar aurat us ke peeche lag gayi, us ne apni londi ko bhej kar use apne haan ek shahadat ke bahane bulwaya, yeh chale gaye londi apne ghar mein unhein le gayi jis darwaze ke andar yeh pahunch jate peeche se londi use band karti jati. Aakhri kamre mein jab gaye to dekha ke ek bahut hi khubsurat aurat baithi hai, us ke paas ek bacha hai aur ek jaam-e-sharab labalab bhara rakha hai.

Us aurat ne us se kaha suniye janab main ne aap ko darhaqiqat kisi gawahi ke liye nahin bulwaya, filwaqay is liye bulwaya hai ke ya to aap mere sath badkari karein ya is bache ko qatl kar dein ya sharab ko pee lein. Darwesh ne soch kar teenon kamon mein halka kaam sharab ka peena jaan kar jaam ko munh se laga liya, sara pee gaya. Kehne laga aur lao aur lao, khoob piya, jab nashe mein madhosh ho gaya to us aurat ke sath zina bhi kar baitha aur us ladke ko bhi qatl kar diya. Pas ae logo! Tum sharab se bacho samajh lo ke sharab aur iman jama nahin hote, ek ka aana dusre ka jaana hai (Baihaqi). Imam Abu Bakr bin Abi Dunya (R.H) ne apni kitab Zamm-ul-Muskir mein bhi ise warid kiya hai aur is mein marfoo hai lekin zyada sahi is ka mauqoof hona hai, wallahu aalam. Is ki shahid Bukhari o Muslim ki marfoo hadith bhi hai jis mein hai ke zani zina ke waqt, chor chori ke waqt, sharabi sharab khori ke waqt momin nahin rehta. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jab sharab haram hui to sahaba ne sawal kiya ke is ki hurmat se pehle jo log inteqal kar chuke hain un ka kya hukm hai? Is par yeh aayat (Laisa 'alal-lazina) al-kh, nazil hui yani un par is mein koi haraj nahin aur jab Bait-ul-Muqaddas ka qibla badla aur Baitullah Sharif qibla hua us waqt bhi sahaba ne pehle qibla ki taraf namazein padhte hue inteqal kar jaane walon ki nisbat daryaft kiya to aayat (Ma kanallahu liyudi'a imanakum) al-kh, nazil hui yani un ki namazein zaya na hongi. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs sharab piye chalis din tak Allah Ta'ala ki narazgi us par rehti hai agar woh isi halat mein mar gaya to kafir mare ga, han agar us ne tauba ki to Allah Ta'ala us ki tauba qabool farmaye ga aur agar us ne phir bhi sharab pi to Allah Ta'ala dozakhiyon ka fazla pilaye ga aur riwayat mein hai ke jab yeh hukm utra ke imandaron par hurmat se pehle pi hui ka koi gunah nahin to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujh se kaha gaya hai ke tu unhi mein se hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai panson ke khel se bacho yeh ajmiyon ka jua hai.

Pansa bazi, jua aur sharab. In ayaton mein Allah Ta'ala baaz cheezon se rokta hai. Sharab ki muman'at farmayi, phir jue ki rok ki. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib R.A se marvi hai ke shatranj bhi jue mein dakhil hai (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Ata, Mujahid aur Taoos se ya in mein se do se marvi hai ke jue ki har cheez maisir mein dakhil hai go bachon ke khel ke tor par ho. Jahiliyat ke zamane mein jue ka bhi aam riwaj tha jise Islam ne gharat kiya. Un ka ek jua yeh bhi tha ke gosht ko bakri ke badle bechte the, panse phenk kar maal ya phal lena bhi jua hai. Hazrat Qasim bin Muhammad farmate hain ke jo cheez zikr-e-Allah aur namaz se ghafil kar de woh jua hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek marfoo ghareeb hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya in panson se bacho jin se log khela karte the, yeh bhi jua hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai panson se khelne wala goya apne hathon ko suar ke khoon aur gosht mein aalooda karne wala hai. Sunan mein hai ke woh Allah aur Rasool ka nafarman hai. Hazrat Abu Musa R.A ka qaul bhi isi tarah marvi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Musnad mein hai panson se khel kar namaz parhne wale ki misal aisi hai jaise koi shakhs qai aur gandagi se aur suar ke khoon se wuzu kar ke namaz ada kare. Hazrat Abdullah R.A farmate hain mere nazdeek shatranj is se bhi buri hai. Hazrat Ali R.A se shatranj ka jue mein se hona pehle bayan ho chuka hai. Imam Malik, Imam Abu Hanifa, Imam Ahmad to khulm khulla ise haram batate hain aur Imam Shafi'i bhi ise makrooh batate hain. Ansaab un pathron ko kehte hain jin par mushrikeen apne janwar charhaya karte the aur unhein wahin zibah karte the. Azlaam un teeron ko kehte hain jin mein woh faal liya karte the. In sab cheezon ki nisbat farmaya ke yeh Allah ki narazgi ke aur shaitani kaam hain. Yeh gunah ke aur burai ke kaam hain tum in shaitani kamon se bacho inhein chor do taake tum nijat pao. Is fiqre mein musalmanon ko in kamon se rokne ki targheeb hai. Phir raghbat aamez dhamki ke sath musalmanon ko in cheezon se roka gaya hai. Hurmat-e-Sharab ki mazeed wazahat: Ab hum yahan par hurmat-e-sharab ki mazeed ahadees warid karte hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmate hain sharab teen martaba haram hui. An-Hazrat ﷺ jab Madine Sharif mein aaye to log juari sharabi the. Huzoor ﷺ se is bare mein sawal hua aur ayat (YAS-ALUNAKA ANIL-KHAMRI WAL-MAISIRI QUL FEEHIMA ISMUN KABEERUN WA MANAFI'U LIN-NASI WA ISMUHUMA AKBARU MIN NAF'IHIMA) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 219) nazil hui. Is par logon ne kaha yeh dono cheezein hum par haram nahin ki gayin balke yeh farmaya gaya hai ke in mein bohat bara gunah hai aur logon ke liye kuch fawaid bhi hain. Chunancha sharab peete rahe.

Ek din ek Sahabi apne sathiyon ko Maghrib ki namaz parhane ke liye kharay huay toh qirat mein ghalti ho gayi, is par ayat (Yaa-Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Laa Taqrabus-Salaata Wa Antum Sukaaraa Hattaa Ta'lamoo Maa Taqooloona Wa Laa Junuban Illaa Aabiree Sabeelin Hattaa Taghtasiloo) (Surah An-Nisa: 43) nazil hui. Yeh ba-nisbat pehli ayat ke zyada sakht thi, ab logon ne namazon ke waqt sharab chhor di lekin aadat barabar jaari rahi, is par is se bhi zyada sakht aur sareeh ayat (Yaa-Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Innamaal Khamru Wal-Maisiru Wal-Ansaabu Wal-Azlaamu Rijsun Min 'Amalish-Shaitaani Fajtaniboohu La'allakum Tuflihoon) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 90) nazil hui. Isay sun kar saaray Sahaba bol uthay, "Antahaina Rabbana", aye Allah hum ab baaz rahay, hum ruk gaye. Phir logon ne un logon ke baray mein daryaft farmaya jo sharab aur juay ki hurmat ke nazil honay se peshtar Allah ki raah mein shaheed kiye gaye thay, is ke jawab mein is ke baad ki ayat (Laisa 'Alallazeena) al-kh, nazil hui aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar un ki zindagi mein yeh hukm utra hota toh woh bhi tumhari tarah isay maan letay. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne tahreem-e-sharab ke nazil honay par farmaya, "Ya Allah hamaray samnay aur khol kar bayan farma", pas Surah Al-Baqarah ki ayat (Feehima Ismun Kabeer) nazil hui. Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur un ke samnay is ki tilawat ki gayi, phir bhi Aap (R.A) ne farmaya, "Aye Allah tu hamain aur wazeh lafzon mein farma!", pas Surah An-Nisa ki ayat (Wa Antum Sukaaraa) nazil hui aur Muazzin jab 'Hayya 'Alas-Salaah' kehta toh saath hi keh deta ke nasha-baaz hargiz hargiz namaz ke qareeb bhi na aayain. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur yeh ayat bhi unhain sunayi gayi lekin phir bhi Aap (R.A) ne yahi farmaya ke, "Aye Allah is baray mein safai se bayan farma". Pas Surah Al-Ma'idah ki ayat utri, Aap (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur yeh ayat sunayi gayi, jab ayat (Fahal Antum Muntahoon) tak suna toh farmanay lagay, "Antahaina, Antahaina", hum ruk gaye, hum ruk gaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne Mimbar-e-Nabwi par khutba detay huay farmaya ke sharab ki hurmat jab nazil hui us waqt sharab paanch cheezon ki banayi jaati thi: angoor, shehad, khajoor, gehoon aur jau. Har woh cheez jo aql par ghalib aa jaye khamr hai, yani sharab ke hukm mein hai aur haram hai. Sahih Bukhari mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se marwi hai ke sharab ki hurmat ki ayat ke nuzool ke mauqay par Madinay Shareef mein paanch qisam ki sharabain thin, un mein angoor ki sharab na thi. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) farmatay hain sharab ke baray mein teen ayatain utrin. Awwal toh ayat (Yas'aloonaka 'Anil-Khamri) wali ayat utri toh kaha gaya ke sharab haram ho gayi, is par ba'az Sahaba ne farmaya, "RasoolAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamain is se nafa uthanay dijiye jaisa ke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya", Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khamosh ho gaye. Phir ayat (Wa Antum Sukaaraa) wali ayat utri aur kaha gaya ke sharab haram ho gayi, lekin Sahaba ne farmaya, "Ya RasoolAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum ba-waqt-e-namaz na piyain ge".

Aap phir chup rahe phir yeh dono aayatein utri aur khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farma diya ke ab sharab haram ho gayi. Muslim waghera mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ek dost tha qabeela Saqeef mein se ya qabeela Daus mein se. Fatah-e-Makkah wale din woh aap se mila aur ek mashk sharab ki aap ko tuhfatan dene laga, aap ne farmaya kya tumhein maloom nahin ke Allah Ta'ala ne ise haram kar diya hai. Ab us shakhs ne apne ghulam se kaha ke ja ise bech daal, aap ne farmaya kya kaha? Us ne jawab diya ke bechne ko keh raha hoon, aap ne farmaya jis Allah ne is ka peena haram kiya hai usi ne is ka bechna bhi haram kiya hai. Us ne usi waqt kaha jao ise le jao aur Batha ke maidan mein baha aao. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke Hazrat Tameem Darmi (R.A) Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tuhfa dene ke liye ek mashk sharab ki laye, aap ise dekh kar hans diye aur farmaya yeh toh tumhare jaane ke baad haram ho gayi hai, kaha khair ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ise wapas le jata hoon aur bech kar qeemat wasool kar loon ga, yeh sun kar aap ne farmaya Yahudiyon par Allah ki la'nat hui ke un par jab gaye bakri ki charbi haram hui toh unhon ne ise pighla kar bechna shuru kiya, Allah Ta'ala ne sharab ko aur us ki qeemat ko haram kar diya hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi yeh riwayat hai ke is mein hai ke har saal Hazrat Darmi (R.A) ek mashk hadiya karte the, is ke aakhir mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka do martaba yeh farmana hai ke sharab bhi haram aur us ki qeemat bhi haram. Ek hadees Musnad-e-Ahmad mein aur hai is mein hai ke Hazrat Kaisan (R.A) sharab ke tajir the, jis saal sharab haram hui us saal yeh Sham ke mulk se bahut si sharab tijarat ke liye laye the, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya, aap ne farmaya ab toh haram ho gayi, poocha phir main ise bech daaloon? Aap ne farmaya yeh bhi haram hai aur us ki qeemat bhi haram hai. Chunancha Hazrat Kaisan (R.A) ne woh saari sharab baha di. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain, main Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A), Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A), Hazrat Sahl bin Baiza (R.A) aur Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) ki ek jamaat ko sharab pila raha tha, daur chal raha tha, sab lazzat-andoz ho rahe the, qareeb tha ke nashe ka para barh jaye, itne mein kisi Sahabi ne aa kar khabar di ke kya tumhein ilm nahin sharab toh haram ho gayi? Unhon ne kaha bas karo jo baqi bachi hai ise lundha do, Allah ki qasam is ke baad ek qatra bhi un mein se kisi ke halq mein nahin gaya. Yeh sharab khajoor ki thi aur aamtan isi ki sharab bana karti thi, yeh riwayat Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai aur riwayat mein hai ke sharab khori ki yeh majlis Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ke makaan par thi, naagah munadi ki aawaz pari, mujh se kaha gaya bahar jao dekho kya munadi ho rahi hai? Main ne ja kar suna munadi nida de raha hai ke sharab tum par haram ki gayi hai, main ne aa kar khabar di toh Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ne farmaya utho jitni sharab hai sab baha do, main ne baha di aur main ne dekha ke Madine ke gali koochon mein sharab beh rahi hai, ba'az as-haab ne kaha un ka kya haal hoga jin ke pait mein sharab thi aur woh qatl kar diye gaye?

Is par us ke baad ki aayat (Laisa 'alal-lazina) al-kh, nazil hui yani un par koi haraj nahin, Ibn-e-Jarir ki riwayat mein is majlis walon ke namon mein Hazrat Abu Dujana aur Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal ka naam bhi hai aur yeh bhi hai ke nida sunte hi hum ne sharab baha di, matke aur peepay tod dale. Kisi ne wuzu kar liya, kisi ne ghusl kar liya aur Hazrat Um-e-Sulaim ke yahan se khushbu mangwa kar lagayi aur masjid pahunche to dekha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh aayat padh rahe thay, ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor is se pehle jo log faut ho gaye hain un ka kya hukm hai? Pas is ke baad aayat utri, kisi ne Hazrat Qatada se poocha ke aap ne yeh hadith khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hai? Farmaya han hum jhoot nahin bolte balkay hum to jante bhi nahin ke jhoot kise kehte hain? Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne sharab aur panse aur barbat ka baja haram kar diya hai, sharab se bacho ghabira naam ki sharab aam hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mujh se woh baat mansoob kare jo main ne na kahi ho woh apni jagah jahannam mein bana le. Main ne aap se suna hai ke sharab, jua, panse aur ghabira sab haram hain aur har nashe wali cheez haram hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai sharab ke bare mein das la'natain hain khud sharab par, is ke peene wale par, is ke pilane wale par, is ke bechne wale par, is ke khareedne wale par, is ke nichodne wale par, is ke banane wale par, is ke uthane wale par aur us par bhi jis ke paas yeh utha kar le jayi jaye aur is ki qeemat khane wale par (Abu Dawood, Ibn-e-Majah). Musnad mein hai Ibn-e-Umar farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) baade ki taraf nikle main aap ke sath tha. Aap ke dayen janib chal raha tha jo Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq aaye main hat gaya aur aap ke dahne Hazrat Siddiq chalne lage thodi der mein Hazrat Umar aa gaye main hat gaya aap Huzoor ke bayen taraf ho gaye jab aap baade mein pahunche to dekha ke wahan par chand mashkein sharab ki rakhi hui hain aap ne mujhe bulaya aur farmaya chhuri lao jab main laya to aap ne hukm diya ke yeh mashkein kaat di jayen phir farmaya sharab par, is ke peene wale par, pilane wale par, bechne wale par, khareedar par, uthane wale par, uthwane wale par, banane wale par, banwane wale par, qeemat lene wale par sab par la'nat hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ne yeh mashkein katwa di phir mujhe aur mere sathiyon ko chhuri de kar farmaya jao jitni mashkein sharab ki jahan pao sab kaat kar baha do, pas hum gaye aur sare bazaar mein ek mashk bhi na chhodi.

Baihaqi ki hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs sharab bechte thay aur bahut khairat kiya karte thay. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se sharab faroshi ka masla poocha gaya toh aap ne farmaya yeh haram hai aur is ki qeemat bhi haram hai, ae Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar tumhari kitab ke baad koi kitab utarne wali hoti aur agar tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad koi Nabi (A.S) aur aane wala hota, jis tarah aglon ki ruswaiyan aur un ki buraiyan tumhari kitab mein utrin tumhari kharabiyan un par nazil hotin lekin tumhare af'aal ka izhar Qayamat ke din par mu'akhar rakha gaya hai aur yeh bahut bhari aur bada hai. Phir Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se yeh sawal kiya gaya toh unhon ne farmaya suno main Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath masjid mein tha. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) goth lagaye hue baithe thay farmane lage jis ke paas jitni sharab ho woh hamare paas laye. Logon ne lani shuru ki, jis ke paas jitni thi hazir ki. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jao ise Baqi ke maidan mein fulan fulan jagah rakho. Jab sab jama ho jaye mujhe khabar do, jab jama ho gayi aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha gaya toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) uthay main aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke dahne janib tha aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujh par tek lagaye chal rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) jab aaye toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe hata diya apne bayen kar diya aur meri jagah Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ne le li, phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) se mulaqat hui toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe aur peeche hata diya aur Janab-e-Farooq (R.A) ko apne bayen le liya aur wahan pahunche logon se farmaya jante ho yeh kya hai? Sab ne kaha han jante hain yeh sharab hai, farmaya suno is par, is ke banane wale par, banwane wale par, peene wale par, pilane wale par, uthane wale par, uthwane wale par, bechne wale par, khareedne wale par, qeemat lene wale par Allah ki phitkar hai. Phir chhuri mangwai aur farmaya ise tez kar lo phir apne hath se mashkein phaarni aur matke todne shuru kiye. Logon ne kaha bhi ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mashkon aur matkon ko rahne dijiye aur kaam aayengi farmaya theek hai lekin main toh ab in sab ko tod kar hi rahunga yeh ghazab-o-ghussa Allah ke liye hai kyunke in tamam cheezon se Rabb naraz hai. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap khud kyun takleef karte hain hum hazir hain farmaya nahin main apne hath se inhe neest-o-nabood karunga. Baihaqi ki hadith mein hai ke sharab ke bare mein char aayatein utri hain. Phir hadith bayan farma kar kaha ke ek Ansari ne dawat ki hum dawat mein jama hue khoob sharabein peen. Nashe mein jhoomte hue apne naam-o-nasab par fakhr karne lage, hum afzal hain. Quraishi ne kaha hum afzal hain. Ek Ansari ne oont ka jabda le kar Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ko mara aur hatha-pai hone lagi phir sharab ki hurmat ki aayat utri. Yeh sharab pee kar badmast ho gaye aur aapas mein laaf-zani hone lagi jab nashe utre toh dekhte hain is ki naak par zakhm hai is ke chehre par zakhm hai is ki darhi nuchi hui hai aur ise chot lagi hui hai, kahne lage mujhe fulan ne mara meri be-hurmati fulan ne ki agar is ka dil meri taraf se saaf hota toh mere sath yeh harkat na karta dilon mein nafrat aur dushmani badhne lagi pas yeh aayat utri.

Is par baaz logon ne kaha jab yeh gandagi hai toh falan falan Sahaba toh ise peete hue hi rihlat kar gaye hain un ka kya haal hoga? In mein se baaz Uhad ke maidan mein shaheed hue hain is ke jawab mein agli aayat utri. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Hazrat Abu Buraidah ke walid kehte hain ke hum chaar shakhs ret ke ek teele par baithe sharab pee rahe the, daur chal raha tha, jaam gardish mein tha, nagahan main khada hua aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua. Salam kiya wahin hurmat-e-sharab ki yeh aayat nazil hui. Main pichle pairon apni usi majlis mein aaya aur apne sathiyon ko yeh aayat parh kar sunayi, baaz woh bhi the, jin ke munh se jaam laga hua tha lekin wallah unhon ne usi waqt ise alag kar diya aur jitna piya tha ise qai kar ke nikal diya aur kehne lage ya Allah hum ruk gaye hum baaz aa gaye. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke jang-e-Uhad ki subah baaz logon ne sharabein pi thin aur maidan mein usi roz Allah ki raah mein shaheed kar diye gaye us waqt tak sharab haram nahin hui thi. Bazzar mein yeh ziyadati bhi hai ke isi par baaz Yahudiyon ne aitraz kiya aur jawab mein aayat (لَيْسَ عَلَي الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيْمَا طَعِمُوْٓا اِذَا مَا اتَّقَوْا وَّاٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ ثُمَّ اتَّقَوْا وَّاٰمَنُوْا ثُمَّ اتَّقَوْا وَّاَحْسَنُوْا ۭ وَاللّٰهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 93) nazil hui. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke ek shakhs Khaibar se sharab la kar Madine mein farokht kiya karta tha, ek din woh la raha tha ek Sahabi raste mein hi use mil gaye aur farmaya sharab toh ab haram ho gayi, woh wapas mur gaya aur ek teele tale use kapde se dhanp kar aa gaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kehne laga kya yeh sach hai ke sharab haram ho gayi? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan sach hai, kaha phir mujhe ijazat dijiye ke jis se li hai use wapas kar doon. Farmaya is ka lautana bhi jaiz nahin, kaha phir ijazat dijiye ke main ise aise shakhs ko tohfa doon jo is ka muawza mujhe de, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh bhi theek nahin, kaha Huzoor is mein yateemon ka maal bhi laga hua hai, farmaya dekho jab hamare paas Bahrain ka maal aayega us se hum tumhare yateemon ki madad karenge, phir Madina mein munadi ho gayi, ek shakhs ne kaha Huzoor sharab ke bartanon se nafa hasil karne ki ijazat dijiye, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jao mashkon ko khol daalo aur sharab baha do, is qadar sharab bahi ke maidan bhar gaye. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke mere haan jo yateem bachay pal rahe hain un ke wirse mein unhein sharab mili hai, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jao ise baha do, arz kiya agar ijazat ho toh is ka sirka bana loon, farmaya nahin. Yeh hadith Muslim, Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein sahih sanad se marvi hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) ne farmaya jaise yeh aayat Quran mein hai Taurat mein bhi hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne haq ko nazil farmaya taake uski wajah se batil ko door kar de aur us se khel tamashe, baje gaje, barbat, duff, tambura, raag ragniyan fana kar de. Sharabi ke liye sharab nuqsan deh hai. Allah Ta'ala ne apni izzat ki qasam khai hai ke jo ise hurmat ke baad piye ga use main Qayamat ke din pyasa rakhunga aur hurmat ke baad jo ise chhore ga main use Jannat ke pakeeza chashme se pilaunga. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai jis shakhs ne nasha ki wajah se ek waqt ki namaz chhori woh aisa hai jaise ke us se roo-e-zameen ki saltanat chhin gayi aur jis shakhs ne chaar baar ki namaz nashe mein chhor di Allah Ta'ala use Teenat-ul-Khayal pilaye ga. Poocha gaya ke yeh kya hai? Farmaya jahannumiyon ka lahoo, peep, paseena, peshab waghera (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Abu Dawood mein hai ke har aql ko dhanpne wali cheez khamr hai aur har nasha wali cheez haram hai aur jo shakhs nashe wali cheez piye ga uski chalees din ki namazein na-qabool hain. Agar woh tauba kare ga to tauba qabool hogi agar us ne chauthi martaba sharab pi to Allah Ta'ala use zaroor Teenat-ul-Khayal pilaye ga, poocha gaya woh kya hai? Farmaya jahannumiyon ka nichod aur unki peep aur jo shakhs ise kisi bacha ko pilaye ga jo halal haram ki tameez na rakhta ho Allah Ta'ala par haq hai ke use bhi jahannumiyon ka peep pilaye. Bukhari, Muslim waghera mein hai duniya mein jo sharab piye ga aur tauba na kare ga woh Jannat ki sharab se mehroom rahe ga. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain har nasha wali cheez khamr hai aur har nasha wali cheez haram hai aur jis shakhs ne sharab ki aadat dali aur be-tauba mar gaya woh Jannat ki sharab se mehroom rahe ga. Nasai waghera mein hai teen shakhson ki taraf Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din nazar-e-rahmat se na dekhe ga, maa baap ka nafarman, sharab ki aadat wala aur Allah ki raah mein de kar ehsan jatlane wala, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke de kar ehsan jatlane wala, maa baap ka nafarman aur sharabi Jannat mein nahin jaye ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein is ke saath hi hai ke zina ki aulad bhi, Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) farmate hain sharab se parhez karo woh tamam buraiyon ki jar hai. Suno agle logon mein ek Wali-ullah tha jo bada ibadat guzar tha aur tarik-e-duniya tha. Basti se alag thalag ek ibadat khane mein shab-o-roz ibadat-e-Ilahi mein mashghool raha karta tha, ek badkar aurat us ke peeche lag gayi, us ne apni londi ko bhej kar use apne haan ek shahadat ke bahane bulwaya, yeh chale gaye londi apne ghar mein unhein le gayi jis darwaze ke andar yeh pahunch jate peeche se londi use band karti jati. Aakhri kamre mein jab gaye to dekha ke ek bahut hi khubsurat aurat baithi hai, us ke paas ek bacha hai aur ek jaam-e-sharab labalab bhara rakha hai.

Us aurat ne us se kaha suniye janab main ne aap ko darhaqiqat kisi gawahi ke liye nahin bulwaya, filwaqay is liye bulwaya hai ke ya to aap mere sath badkari karein ya is bache ko qatl kar dein ya sharab ko pee lein. Darwesh ne soch kar teenon kamon mein halka kaam sharab ka peena jaan kar jaam ko munh se laga liya, sara pee gaya. Kehne laga aur lao aur lao, khoob piya, jab nashe mein madhosh ho gaya to us aurat ke sath zina bhi kar baitha aur us ladke ko bhi qatl kar diya. Pas ae logo! Tum sharab se bacho samajh lo ke sharab aur iman jama nahin hote, ek ka aana dusre ka jaana hai (Baihaqi). Imam Abu Bakr bin Abi Dunya (R.H) ne apni kitab Zamm-ul-Muskir mein bhi ise warid kiya hai aur is mein marfoo hai lekin zyada sahi is ka mauqoof hona hai, wallahu aalam. Is ki shahid Bukhari o Muslim ki marfoo hadith bhi hai jis mein hai ke zani zina ke waqt, chor chori ke waqt, sharabi sharab khori ke waqt momin nahin rehta. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jab sharab haram hui to sahaba ne sawal kiya ke is ki hurmat se pehle jo log inteqal kar chuke hain un ka kya hukm hai? Is par yeh aayat (Laisa 'alal-lazina) al-kh, nazil hui yani un par is mein koi haraj nahin aur jab Bait-ul-Muqaddas ka qibla badla aur Baitullah Sharif qibla hua us waqt bhi sahaba ne pehle qibla ki taraf namazein padhte hue inteqal kar jaane walon ki nisbat daryaft kiya to aayat (Ma kanallahu liyudi'a imanakum) al-kh, nazil hui yani un ki namazein zaya na hongi. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs sharab piye chalis din tak Allah Ta'ala ki narazgi us par rehti hai agar woh isi halat mein mar gaya to kafir mare ga, han agar us ne tauba ki to Allah Ta'ala us ki tauba qabool farmaye ga aur agar us ne phir bhi sharab pi to Allah Ta'ala dozakhiyon ka fazla pilaye ga aur riwayat mein hai ke jab yeh hukm utra ke imandaron par hurmat se pehle pi hui ka koi gunah nahin to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujh se kaha gaya hai ke tu unhi mein se hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai panson ke khel se bacho yeh ajmiyon ka jua hai.

Pansa bazi, jua aur sharab. In ayaton mein Allah Ta'ala baaz cheezon se rokta hai. Sharab ki muman'at farmayi, phir jue ki rok ki. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib R.A se marvi hai ke shatranj bhi jue mein dakhil hai (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Ata, Mujahid aur Taoos se ya in mein se do se marvi hai ke jue ki har cheez maisir mein dakhil hai go bachon ke khel ke tor par ho. Jahiliyat ke zamane mein jue ka bhi aam riwaj tha jise Islam ne gharat kiya. Un ka ek jua yeh bhi tha ke gosht ko bakri ke badle bechte the, panse phenk kar maal ya phal lena bhi jua hai. Hazrat Qasim bin Muhammad farmate hain ke jo cheez zikr-e-Allah aur namaz se ghafil kar de woh jua hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek marfoo ghareeb hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya in panson se bacho jin se log khela karte the, yeh bhi jua hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai panson se khelne wala goya apne hathon ko suar ke khoon aur gosht mein aalooda karne wala hai. Sunan mein hai ke woh Allah aur Rasool ka nafarman hai. Hazrat Abu Musa R.A ka qaul bhi isi tarah marvi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Musnad mein hai panson se khel kar namaz parhne wale ki misal aisi hai jaise koi shakhs qai aur gandagi se aur suar ke khoon se wuzu kar ke namaz ada kare. Hazrat Abdullah R.A farmate hain mere nazdeek shatranj is se bhi buri hai. Hazrat Ali R.A se shatranj ka jue mein se hona pehle bayan ho chuka hai. Imam Malik, Imam Abu Hanifa, Imam Ahmad to khulm khulla ise haram batate hain aur Imam Shafi'i bhi ise makrooh batate hain. Ansaab un pathron ko kehte hain jin par mushrikeen apne janwar charhaya karte the aur unhein wahin zibah karte the. Azlaam un teeron ko kehte hain jin mein woh faal liya karte the. In sab cheezon ki nisbat farmaya ke yeh Allah ki narazgi ke aur shaitani kaam hain. Yeh gunah ke aur burai ke kaam hain tum in shaitani kamon se bacho inhein chor do taake tum nijat pao. Is fiqre mein musalmanon ko in kamon se rokne ki targheeb hai. Phir raghbat aamez dhamki ke sath musalmanon ko in cheezon se roka gaya hai. Hurmat-e-Sharab ki mazeed wazahat: Ab hum yahan par hurmat-e-sharab ki mazeed ahadees warid karte hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmate hain sharab teen martaba haram hui. An-Hazrat ﷺ jab Madine Sharif mein aaye to log juari sharabi the. Huzoor ﷺ se is bare mein sawal hua aur ayat (YAS-ALUNAKA ANIL-KHAMRI WAL-MAISIRI QUL FEEHIMA ISMUN KABEERUN WA MANAFI'U LIN-NASI WA ISMUHUMA AKBARU MIN NAF'IHIMA) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 219) nazil hui. Is par logon ne kaha yeh dono cheezein hum par haram nahin ki gayin balke yeh farmaya gaya hai ke in mein bohat bara gunah hai aur logon ke liye kuch fawaid bhi hain. Chunancha sharab peete rahe.

Ek din ek Sahabi apne sathiyon ko Maghrib ki namaz parhane ke liye kharay huay toh qirat mein ghalti ho gayi, is par ayat (Yaa-Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Laa Taqrabus-Salaata Wa Antum Sukaaraa Hattaa Ta'lamoo Maa Taqooloona Wa Laa Junuban Illaa Aabiree Sabeelin Hattaa Taghtasiloo) (Surah An-Nisa: 43) nazil hui. Yeh ba-nisbat pehli ayat ke zyada sakht thi, ab logon ne namazon ke waqt sharab chhor di lekin aadat barabar jaari rahi, is par is se bhi zyada sakht aur sareeh ayat (Yaa-Ayyuhallazeena Aamanoo Innamaal Khamru Wal-Maisiru Wal-Ansaabu Wal-Azlaamu Rijsun Min 'Amalish-Shaitaani Fajtaniboohu La'allakum Tuflihoon) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 90) nazil hui. Isay sun kar saaray Sahaba bol uthay, "Antahaina Rabbana", aye Allah hum ab baaz rahay, hum ruk gaye. Phir logon ne un logon ke baray mein daryaft farmaya jo sharab aur juay ki hurmat ke nazil honay se peshtar Allah ki raah mein shaheed kiye gaye thay, is ke jawab mein is ke baad ki ayat (Laisa 'Alallazeena) al-kh, nazil hui aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar un ki zindagi mein yeh hukm utra hota toh woh bhi tumhari tarah isay maan letay. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne tahreem-e-sharab ke nazil honay par farmaya, "Ya Allah hamaray samnay aur khol kar bayan farma", pas Surah Al-Baqarah ki ayat (Feehima Ismun Kabeer) nazil hui. Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur un ke samnay is ki tilawat ki gayi, phir bhi Aap (R.A) ne farmaya, "Aye Allah tu hamain aur wazeh lafzon mein farma!", pas Surah An-Nisa ki ayat (Wa Antum Sukaaraa) nazil hui aur Muazzin jab 'Hayya 'Alas-Salaah' kehta toh saath hi keh deta ke nasha-baaz hargiz hargiz namaz ke qareeb bhi na aayain. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur yeh ayat bhi unhain sunayi gayi lekin phir bhi Aap (R.A) ne yahi farmaya ke, "Aye Allah is baray mein safai se bayan farma". Pas Surah Al-Ma'idah ki ayat utri, Aap (R.A) ko bulwaya gaya aur yeh ayat sunayi gayi, jab ayat (Fahal Antum Muntahoon) tak suna toh farmanay lagay, "Antahaina, Antahaina", hum ruk gaye, hum ruk gaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne Mimbar-e-Nabwi par khutba detay huay farmaya ke sharab ki hurmat jab nazil hui us waqt sharab paanch cheezon ki banayi jaati thi: angoor, shehad, khajoor, gehoon aur jau. Har woh cheez jo aql par ghalib aa jaye khamr hai, yani sharab ke hukm mein hai aur haram hai. Sahih Bukhari mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se marwi hai ke sharab ki hurmat ki ayat ke nuzool ke mauqay par Madinay Shareef mein paanch qisam ki sharabain thin, un mein angoor ki sharab na thi. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) farmatay hain sharab ke baray mein teen ayatain utrin. Awwal toh ayat (Yas'aloonaka 'Anil-Khamri) wali ayat utri toh kaha gaya ke sharab haram ho gayi, is par ba'az Sahaba ne farmaya, "RasoolAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamain is se nafa uthanay dijiye jaisa ke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya", Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khamosh ho gaye. Phir ayat (Wa Antum Sukaaraa) wali ayat utri aur kaha gaya ke sharab haram ho gayi, lekin Sahaba ne farmaya, "Ya RasoolAllah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum ba-waqt-e-namaz na piyain ge".

Aap phir chup rahe phir yeh dono aayatein utri aur khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farma diya ke ab sharab haram ho gayi. Muslim waghera mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ek dost tha qabeela Saqeef mein se ya qabeela Daus mein se. Fatah-e-Makkah wale din woh aap se mila aur ek mashk sharab ki aap ko tuhfatan dene laga, aap ne farmaya kya tumhein maloom nahin ke Allah Ta'ala ne ise haram kar diya hai. Ab us shakhs ne apne ghulam se kaha ke ja ise bech daal, aap ne farmaya kya kaha? Us ne jawab diya ke bechne ko keh raha hoon, aap ne farmaya jis Allah ne is ka peena haram kiya hai usi ne is ka bechna bhi haram kiya hai. Us ne usi waqt kaha jao ise le jao aur Batha ke maidan mein baha aao. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke Hazrat Tameem Darmi (R.A) Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tuhfa dene ke liye ek mashk sharab ki laye, aap ise dekh kar hans diye aur farmaya yeh toh tumhare jaane ke baad haram ho gayi hai, kaha khair ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ise wapas le jata hoon aur bech kar qeemat wasool kar loon ga, yeh sun kar aap ne farmaya Yahudiyon par Allah ki la'nat hui ke un par jab gaye bakri ki charbi haram hui toh unhon ne ise pighla kar bechna shuru kiya, Allah Ta'ala ne sharab ko aur us ki qeemat ko haram kar diya hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi yeh riwayat hai ke is mein hai ke har saal Hazrat Darmi (R.A) ek mashk hadiya karte the, is ke aakhir mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka do martaba yeh farmana hai ke sharab bhi haram aur us ki qeemat bhi haram. Ek hadees Musnad-e-Ahmad mein aur hai is mein hai ke Hazrat Kaisan (R.A) sharab ke tajir the, jis saal sharab haram hui us saal yeh Sham ke mulk se bahut si sharab tijarat ke liye laye the, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr kiya, aap ne farmaya ab toh haram ho gayi, poocha phir main ise bech daaloon? Aap ne farmaya yeh bhi haram hai aur us ki qeemat bhi haram hai. Chunancha Hazrat Kaisan (R.A) ne woh saari sharab baha di. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain, main Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A), Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A), Hazrat Sahl bin Baiza (R.A) aur Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) ki ek jamaat ko sharab pila raha tha, daur chal raha tha, sab lazzat-andoz ho rahe the, qareeb tha ke nashe ka para barh jaye, itne mein kisi Sahabi ne aa kar khabar di ke kya tumhein ilm nahin sharab toh haram ho gayi? Unhon ne kaha bas karo jo baqi bachi hai ise lundha do, Allah ki qasam is ke baad ek qatra bhi un mein se kisi ke halq mein nahin gaya. Yeh sharab khajoor ki thi aur aamtan isi ki sharab bana karti thi, yeh riwayat Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai aur riwayat mein hai ke sharab khori ki yeh majlis Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ke makaan par thi, naagah munadi ki aawaz pari, mujh se kaha gaya bahar jao dekho kya munadi ho rahi hai? Main ne ja kar suna munadi nida de raha hai ke sharab tum par haram ki gayi hai, main ne aa kar khabar di toh Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ne farmaya utho jitni sharab hai sab baha do, main ne baha di aur main ne dekha ke Madine ke gali koochon mein sharab beh rahi hai, ba'az as-haab ne kaha un ka kya haal hoga jin ke pait mein sharab thi aur woh qatl kar diye gaye?

Is par us ke baad ki aayat (Laisa 'alal-lazina) al-kh, nazil hui yani un par koi haraj nahin, Ibn-e-Jarir ki riwayat mein is majlis walon ke namon mein Hazrat Abu Dujana aur Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal ka naam bhi hai aur yeh bhi hai ke nida sunte hi hum ne sharab baha di, matke aur peepay tod dale. Kisi ne wuzu kar liya, kisi ne ghusl kar liya aur Hazrat Um-e-Sulaim ke yahan se khushbu mangwa kar lagayi aur masjid pahunche to dekha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh aayat padh rahe thay, ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor is se pehle jo log faut ho gaye hain un ka kya hukm hai? Pas is ke baad aayat utri, kisi ne Hazrat Qatada se poocha ke aap ne yeh hadith khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hai? Farmaya han hum jhoot nahin bolte balkay hum to jante bhi nahin ke jhoot kise kehte hain? Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne sharab aur panse aur barbat ka baja haram kar diya hai, sharab se bacho ghabira naam ki sharab aam hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mujh se woh baat mansoob kare jo main ne na kahi ho woh apni jagah jahannam mein bana le. Main ne aap se suna hai ke sharab, jua, panse aur ghabira sab haram hain aur har nashe wali cheez haram hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai sharab ke bare mein das la'natain hain khud sharab par, is ke peene wale par, is ke pilane wale par, is ke bechne wale par, is ke khareedne wale par, is ke nichodne wale par, is ke banane wale par, is ke uthane wale par aur us par bhi jis ke paas yeh utha kar le jayi jaye aur is ki qeemat khane wale par (Abu Dawood, Ibn-e-Majah). Musnad mein hai Ibn-e-Umar farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) baade ki taraf nikle main aap ke sath tha. Aap ke dayen janib chal raha tha jo Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq aaye main hat gaya aur aap ke dahne Hazrat Siddiq chalne lage thodi der mein Hazrat Umar aa gaye main hat gaya aap Huzoor ke bayen taraf ho gaye jab aap baade mein pahunche to dekha ke wahan par chand mashkein sharab ki rakhi hui hain aap ne mujhe bulaya aur farmaya chhuri lao jab main laya to aap ne hukm diya ke yeh mashkein kaat di jayen phir farmaya sharab par, is ke peene wale par, pilane wale par, bechne wale par, khareedar par, uthane wale par, uthwane wale par, banane wale par, banwane wale par, qeemat lene wale par sab par la'nat hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ne yeh mashkein katwa di phir mujhe aur mere sathiyon ko chhuri de kar farmaya jao jitni mashkein sharab ki jahan pao sab kaat kar baha do, pas hum gaye aur sare bazaar mein ek mashk bhi na chhodi.

Baihaqi ki hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs sharab bechte thay aur bahut khairat kiya karte thay. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se sharab faroshi ka masla poocha gaya toh aap ne farmaya yeh haram hai aur is ki qeemat bhi haram hai, ae Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar tumhari kitab ke baad koi kitab utarne wali hoti aur agar tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad koi Nabi (A.S) aur aane wala hota, jis tarah aglon ki ruswaiyan aur un ki buraiyan tumhari kitab mein utrin tumhari kharabiyan un par nazil hotin lekin tumhare af'aal ka izhar Qayamat ke din par mu'akhar rakha gaya hai aur yeh bahut bhari aur bada hai. Phir Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se yeh sawal kiya gaya toh unhon ne farmaya suno main Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath masjid mein tha. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) goth lagaye hue baithe thay farmane lage jis ke paas jitni sharab ho woh hamare paas laye. Logon ne lani shuru ki, jis ke paas jitni thi hazir ki. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jao ise Baqi ke maidan mein fulan fulan jagah rakho. Jab sab jama ho jaye mujhe khabar do, jab jama ho gayi aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha gaya toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) uthay main aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke dahne janib tha aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujh par tek lagaye chal rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) jab aaye toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe hata diya apne bayen kar diya aur meri jagah Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ne le li, phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) se mulaqat hui toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe aur peeche hata diya aur Janab-e-Farooq (R.A) ko apne bayen le liya aur wahan pahunche logon se farmaya jante ho yeh kya hai? Sab ne kaha han jante hain yeh sharab hai, farmaya suno is par, is ke banane wale par, banwane wale par, peene wale par, pilane wale par, uthane wale par, uthwane wale par, bechne wale par, khareedne wale par, qeemat lene wale par Allah ki phitkar hai. Phir chhuri mangwai aur farmaya ise tez kar lo phir apne hath se mashkein phaarni aur matke todne shuru kiye. Logon ne kaha bhi ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mashkon aur matkon ko rahne dijiye aur kaam aayengi farmaya theek hai lekin main toh ab in sab ko tod kar hi rahunga yeh ghazab-o-ghussa Allah ke liye hai kyunke in tamam cheezon se Rabb naraz hai.
