Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap khud kyun takleef karte hain hum hazir hain farmaya nahin main apne hath se inhe neest-o-nabood karunga. Baihaqi ki hadith mein hai ke sharab ke bare mein char aayatein utri hain. Phir hadith bayan farma kar kaha ke ek Ansari ne dawat ki hum dawat mein jama hue khoob sharabein peen. Nashe mein jhoomte hue apne naam-o-nasab par fakhr karne lage, hum afzal hain. Quraishi ne kaha hum afzal hain. Ek Ansari ne oont ka jabda le kar Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ko mara aur hatha-pai hone lagi phir sharab ki hurmat ki aayat utri. Yeh sharab pee kar badmast ho gaye aur aapas mein laaf-zani hone lagi jab nashe utre toh dekhte hain is ki naak par zakhm hai is ke chehre par zakhm hai is ki darhi nuchi hui hai aur ise chot lagi hui hai, kahne lage mujhe fulan ne mara meri be-hurmati fulan ne ki agar is ka dil meri taraf se saaf hota toh mere sath yeh harkat na karta dilon mein nafrat aur dushmani badhne lagi pas yeh aayat utri.

Is par baaz logon ne kaha jab yeh gandagi hai toh falan falan Sahaba toh ise peete hue hi rihlat kar gaye hain un ka kya haal hoga? In mein se baaz Uhad ke maidan mein shaheed hue hain is ke jawab mein agli aayat utri. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Hazrat Abu Buraidah ke walid kehte hain ke hum chaar shakhs ret ke ek teele par baithe sharab pee rahe the, daur chal raha tha, jaam gardish mein tha, nagahan main khada hua aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua. Salam kiya wahin hurmat-e-sharab ki yeh aayat nazil hui. Main pichle pairon apni usi majlis mein aaya aur apne sathiyon ko yeh aayat parh kar sunayi, baaz woh bhi the, jin ke munh se jaam laga hua tha lekin wallah unhon ne usi waqt ise alag kar diya aur jitna piya tha ise qai kar ke nikal diya aur kehne lage ya Allah hum ruk gaye hum baaz aa gaye. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke jang-e-Uhad ki subah baaz logon ne sharabein pi thin aur maidan mein usi roz Allah ki raah mein shaheed kar diye gaye us waqt tak sharab haram nahin hui thi. Bazzar mein yeh ziyadati bhi hai ke isi par baaz Yahudiyon ne aitraz kiya aur jawab mein aayat (لَيْسَ عَلَي الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيْمَا طَعِمُوْٓا اِذَا مَا اتَّقَوْا وَّاٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ ثُمَّ اتَّقَوْا وَّاٰمَنُوْا ثُمَّ اتَّقَوْا وَّاَحْسَنُوْا ۭ وَاللّٰهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 93) nazil hui. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke ek shakhs Khaibar se sharab la kar Madine mein farokht kiya karta tha, ek din woh la raha tha ek Sahabi raste mein hi use mil gaye aur farmaya sharab toh ab haram ho gayi, woh wapas mur gaya aur ek teele tale use kapde se dhanp kar aa gaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kehne laga kya yeh sach hai ke sharab haram ho gayi? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan sach hai, kaha phir mujhe ijazat dijiye ke jis se li hai use wapas kar doon. Farmaya is ka lautana bhi jaiz nahin, kaha phir ijazat dijiye ke main ise aise shakhs ko tohfa doon jo is ka muawza mujhe de, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh bhi theek nahin, kaha Huzoor is mein yateemon ka maal bhi laga hua hai, farmaya dekho jab hamare paas Bahrain ka maal aayega us se hum tumhare yateemon ki madad karenge, phir Madina mein munadi ho gayi, ek shakhs ne kaha Huzoor sharab ke bartanon se nafa hasil karne ki ijazat dijiye, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jao mashkon ko khol daalo aur sharab baha do, is qadar sharab bahi ke maidan bhar gaye. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke mere haan jo yateem bachay pal rahe hain un ke wirse mein unhein sharab mili hai, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jao ise baha do, arz kiya agar ijazat ho toh is ka sirka bana loon, farmaya nahin. Yeh hadith Muslim, Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein sahih sanad se marvi hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) ne farmaya jaise yeh aayat Quran mein hai Taurat mein bhi hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne haq ko nazil farmaya taake uski wajah se batil ko door kar de aur us se khel tamashe, baje gaje, barbat, duff, tambura, raag ragniyan fana kar de. Sharabi ke liye sharab nuqsan deh hai. Allah Ta'ala ne apni izzat ki qasam khai hai ke jo ise hurmat ke baad piye ga use main Qayamat ke din pyasa rakhunga aur hurmat ke baad jo ise chhore ga main use Jannat ke pakeeza chashme se pilaunga. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai jis shakhs ne nasha ki wajah se ek waqt ki namaz chhori woh aisa hai jaise ke us se roo-e-zameen ki saltanat chhin gayi aur jis shakhs ne chaar baar ki namaz nashe mein chhor di Allah Ta'ala use Teenat-ul-Khayal pilaye ga. Poocha gaya ke yeh kya hai? Farmaya jahannumiyon ka lahoo, peep, paseena, peshab waghera (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Abu Dawood mein hai ke har aql ko dhanpne wali cheez khamr hai aur har nasha wali cheez haram hai aur jo shakhs nashe wali cheez piye ga uski chalees din ki namazein na-qabool hain. Agar woh tauba kare ga to tauba qabool hogi agar us ne chauthi martaba sharab pi to Allah Ta'ala use zaroor Teenat-ul-Khayal pilaye ga, poocha gaya woh kya hai? Farmaya jahannumiyon ka nichod aur unki peep aur jo shakhs ise kisi bacha ko pilaye ga jo halal haram ki tameez na rakhta ho Allah Ta'ala par haq hai ke use bhi jahannumiyon ka peep pilaye. Bukhari, Muslim waghera mein hai duniya mein jo sharab piye ga aur tauba na kare ga woh Jannat ki sharab se mehroom rahe ga. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain har nasha wali cheez khamr hai aur har nasha wali cheez haram hai aur jis shakhs ne sharab ki aadat dali aur be-tauba mar gaya woh Jannat ki sharab se mehroom rahe ga. Nasai waghera mein hai teen shakhson ki taraf Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din nazar-e-rahmat se na dekhe ga, maa baap ka nafarman, sharab ki aadat wala aur Allah ki raah mein de kar ehsan jatlane wala, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke de kar ehsan jatlane wala, maa baap ka nafarman aur sharabi Jannat mein nahin jaye ga. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein is ke saath hi hai ke zina ki aulad bhi, Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) farmate hain sharab se parhez karo woh tamam buraiyon ki jar hai. Suno agle logon mein ek Wali-ullah tha jo bada ibadat guzar tha aur tarik-e-duniya tha. Basti se alag thalag ek ibadat khane mein shab-o-roz ibadat-e-Ilahi mein mashghool raha karta tha, ek badkar aurat us ke peeche lag gayi, us ne apni londi ko bhej kar use apne haan ek shahadat ke bahane bulwaya, yeh chale gaye londi apne ghar mein unhein le gayi jis darwaze ke andar yeh pahunch jate peeche se londi use band karti jati. Aakhri kamre mein jab gaye to dekha ke ek bahut hi khubsurat aurat baithi hai, us ke paas ek bacha hai aur ek jaam-e-sharab labalab bhara rakha hai.

Us aurat ne us se kaha suniye janab main ne aap ko darhaqiqat kisi gawahi ke liye nahin bulwaya, filwaqay is liye bulwaya hai ke ya to aap mere sath badkari karein ya is bache ko qatl kar dein ya sharab ko pee lein. Darwesh ne soch kar teenon kamon mein halka kaam sharab ka peena jaan kar jaam ko munh se laga liya, sara pee gaya. Kehne laga aur lao aur lao, khoob piya, jab nashe mein madhosh ho gaya to us aurat ke sath zina bhi kar baitha aur us ladke ko bhi qatl kar diya. Pas ae logo! Tum sharab se bacho samajh lo ke sharab aur iman jama nahin hote, ek ka aana dusre ka jaana hai (Baihaqi). Imam Abu Bakr bin Abi Dunya (R.H) ne apni kitab Zamm-ul-Muskir mein bhi ise warid kiya hai aur is mein marfoo hai lekin zyada sahi is ka mauqoof hona hai, wallahu aalam. Is ki shahid Bukhari o Muslim ki marfoo hadith bhi hai jis mein hai ke zani zina ke waqt, chor chori ke waqt, sharabi sharab khori ke waqt momin nahin rehta. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jab sharab haram hui to sahaba ne sawal kiya ke is ki hurmat se pehle jo log inteqal kar chuke hain un ka kya hukm hai? Is par yeh aayat (Laisa 'alal-lazina) al-kh, nazil hui yani un par is mein koi haraj nahin aur jab Bait-ul-Muqaddas ka qibla badla aur Baitullah Sharif qibla hua us waqt bhi sahaba ne pehle qibla ki taraf namazein padhte hue inteqal kar jaane walon ki nisbat daryaft kiya to aayat (Ma kanallahu liyudi'a imanakum) al-kh, nazil hui yani un ki namazein zaya na hongi. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs sharab piye chalis din tak Allah Ta'ala ki narazgi us par rehti hai agar woh isi halat mein mar gaya to kafir mare ga, han agar us ne tauba ki to Allah Ta'ala us ki tauba qabool farmaye ga aur agar us ne phir bhi sharab pi to Allah Ta'ala dozakhiyon ka fazla pilaye ga aur riwayat mein hai ke jab yeh hukm utra ke imandaron par hurmat se pehle pi hui ka koi gunah nahin to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujh se kaha gaya hai ke tu unhi mein se hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai panson ke khel se bacho yeh ajmiyon ka jua hai.

Ahram mein shikar ke masail ki tafseelat: Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain chote chote shikar aur kamzor shikar aur un ke bache jinhein insaan apne hath se pakad le aur apne neze ki nok par rakh le, is se Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki aazmaish karega. Ya'ni unhein mana farmaya hai ke tum bawajood is ke bhi un ka shikar halat-e-ahram mein na karo khwah chote hon khwah bade, khwah aasani se shikar ho sakta ho khwah sakhti se. Chunancha Umrah-e-Hudaibiya ke mauqe par yehi hua ke qisam qisam ke shikar is qadar bakasrat aa pade ke Sahaba (R.A) ke khaimon mein ghusne lage, idhar Allah ki taraf se muman'at ho gayi taake poori aazmaish ho jaye, idhar shikar goya handiya mein hai, idhar muman'at hai, hathiyar to kahan yunhi agar chahein to hath se pakad sakte thein aur posheeda taur se shikar qabze mein kar sakte thein. Ye sirf is liye tha ke farmanbardar aur nafarman ka imtehan ho jaye, poshidgi mein bhi Allah ka dar rakhne wale ghairon se mumtaz ho jayen, chunancha farman hai ke jo log Allah Ta'ala se ghaibana darte rehte hain un ke liye badi bhari maghfirat aur bahut bada ajar hai. Ab jo shakhs is hukm ke aane ke baad bhi halat-e-ahram mein shikar khelega shariyat ki mukhalifat karega, phir farmaya imandaro halat-e-ahram mein shikar na khelo. Ye hukm apne ma'ani ki haisiyat se to halal janwaron aur un se jo cheezein hasil hoti hain ke liye hai, lekin jo khushki ke haram janwar hain un ka shikar khelna Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ke nazdeek to jaiz hai aur jamhoor ke nazdeek haram hai, han is aam hukm se sirf woh cheezein makhsoos hain jin ka zikr Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya paanch janwar fasiq hain woh haram mein qatl kar diye jayen aur ghair-e-haram mein bhi, kawa, cheel, bichhoo, chuha aur kante wala kala kutta aur riwayat ke alfaaz yun hain ke in paanch janwaron ke qatl mein ahram wale par bhi koi gunah nahin. Is riwayat ko sun kar Hazrat Ayyub (R.H) apne ustad Hazrat Nafi (R.H) se poochte hain ke saanp ka kya hukm hai? Aap ne farmaya woh is mein shamil hai ye bhi qatl kar diya jaye is mein kisi ko ikhtilaf nahin. Ba'az ulama ne jaise Imam Ahmad (R.H), Imam Malik (R.H) waghera ne kutte ke hukm par darindon ko bhi rakha hai jaise bhediya, sher waghera. Is liye ke ye kutte se bahut zyada zarar wale hain. Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam (R.H) aur Hazrat Sufyan bin Uyaynah (R.H) farmate hain ke har hamla karne wale darinde ka hukm hai, dekhiye Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Utbah bin Abu Lahab ke haq mein jab dua ki to farmaya: "Aye Allah! Is par Shaam mein apna koi kutta muqarrar kar de," pas jab woh Zarqa mein pahuncha wahan use bhediye ne phaad dala. Han agar muharram ne halat-e-ahram mein kawe ko ya lomdi waghera ko maar dala to use badla dena padega. Isi tarah in paanchon qisam ke janwaron ke bache aur hamla karne wale darindon ke bache bhi is hukm se mustasna hain. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain har woh janwar jo khaya nahin jata us ke qatl mein aur us ke bachon ke qatl mein muharram par koi haraj nahin. Wajah ye hai ke un ka gosht khaya nahin jata.

Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) farmate hain kala kutta hamla karne wala aur bheriya toh muhrim qatl kar sakta hai is liye ke bheriya bhi jungli kutta hai. In ke siwa jis janwar ka shikar khele ga fidiya dena pare ga. Haan agar koi sher waghera jungli darinda us par hamla kare aur yeh use maar dale toh is surat mein fidiya nahin. Aap ke shagird Zufar kehte hain yeh hamla karne ki surat mein bhi agar maar dale ga toh fidiya dena pare ga. Baaz ahadith mein ghurab-e-abqa ka lafz aaya hai, yeh woh kawa hai jis ke pet aur peeth par safedi hoti hai. Mutlaq siyah aur bilkul safed kawe ko ghurab-e-abqa nahin kehte lekin jumhoor ka mazhab yeh hai ke har qisam ke kawe ka yahi hukm hai kyunke Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein mutlaq kawe ka zikr hai. Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain kawe ko bhi is haal mein maar sakta hai ke woh us par hamla kare ya use eza de. Mujahid waghera ka qaul hai ke is halat mein bhi maar na dale balkay use pathar waghera phenk kar hata de. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se bhi yeh marwi hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke muhrim kis kis janwar ko qatl kar de? Toh aap ne farmaya saanp, bichhoo aur chuha aur kawe ko kankar mare use maar na dale aur kala kutta aur cheel aur hamla karne wala darinda. (Abu Dawood waghera). Phir farmata hai ke jo shakhs jaan boojh kar halat-e-ihram mein shikar kare us par fidiya hai. Hazrat Ta'oos (R.H) ka farman hai ke khata se qatl karne wale par kuch nahin. Lekin yeh mazhab ghareeb hai aur aayat ke zahiri alfaaz se yahi mushtaq hai. Mujahid bin Jabir (R.H) se marwi hai ke murad woh shakhs hai jo shikar toh qasdan karta hai lekin apni halat-e-ihram ki yaad use nahin rahi. Lekin jo shakhs bawajood ihram ki yaad ke amdan shikar kare woh toh kaffaray ki had se nikal gaya us ka ihram batil ho gaya. Yeh qaul bhi ghareeb hai. Jumhoor ka mazhab yeh hai ke qasdan shikar karne wala aur bhool kar karne wala dono kaffaray mein barabar hain. Imam Zuhri (R.H) farmate hain Quran se toh qasdan shikar khelne wale par kaffara sabit hua aur hadith ne yahi hukm bhoolne wale ka bhi bayan farmaya. Matlab is qaul ka yeh hai ke qasdan shikar khelne wale par kaffara Quran-e-Kareem se sabit hai aur us ka gunahgar hona bhi. Kyunke is ke baad aayat (لِّيَذُوْقَ وَبَالَ اَمْرِهٖ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 95) farmaya hai aur Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke as-haab se khata mein bhi yahi hukm sabit hai aur is liye bhi ke shikar ko qatl karna us ka talaf karna hai aur har talaf karne ka badla zaroori hai khwah woh bil-qasd ho ya anjaan-panay se ho. Haan qasdan karne wala gunahgar bhi hai aur bila-qasd jis se sarzad ho jaye woh qabil-e-malamat nahin. Phir farmaya is ka badla yeh hai ke isi ke misl chopaya janwar rah-e-lillah qurban kare. Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) ki qira'at mein "fajaza'un" hai. In dono qira'aton mein Malik, Shafi'i, Ahmad aur jumhoor ki daleel hai ke jab shikar chopayon ki manind ho toh wahi us ke badlay mein dena hoga.

Imam Abu Hanifa R.H is ke khilaf kehte hain ke khwah shikar ke kisi janwar ki misl ho ya na ho dono suraton mein qeemat deni paregi. Haan is muhrim shikari ko ikhtiyar hai ke khwah is qeemat ko sadaqa kar de khwah is se qurbani ka koi janwar khareed le. Lekin yeh yaad rahe ke Imam Sahab ke is qaul se Sahaba R.A ka faisla hamare liye zyada qabil-e-amal hai. Unhon ne shuturmurg ke shikar ke badle oont muqarrar kiya hai aur jungli gaye ke badle paltu gaye muqarrar farmayi hai aur hiran ke badle bakri. Yeh faisle in buzurg Sahabiyon ki sanadon samet ahkam ki kitabon mein maujood hain. Jahan shikar jaisa aur koi paltu chaupaya na ho is mein Ibn Abbas R.A ka faisla qeemat ka hai jo Makkah Sharif pahunchayi jaye (Baihaqi). Phir farmaya ke is ka faisla do adil musalman kar dein ke kya qeemat hai ya kaunsa janwar badle mein diya jaye. Fuqaha ne is bare mein ikhtilaf kiya ke faisla karne wale do mein ek khud qatil ho sakta hai ya nahin? To Imam Malik waghera ne to inkar kiya hai kyunke isi ka mamla ho aur wahi hukm karne wala ho aur Imam Shafi'i, Imam Ahmad waghera ne ayat ke umoom ko samne rakh kar farmaya hai ke yeh bhi ho sakta hai. Pehle mazhab ki daleel to yeh hai ke khud hakim apne upar apna hi hukm kar ke isi hukm mein apna munsif aap nahin ban sakta. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek a'rabi hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ke paas aaya aur kaha main ne ek shikar ko ehram ki halat mein qatl kar diya hai ab aap farmayiye ke is mein mujh par badla kya hai? Aap ne Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A ki taraf dekh kar un se daryaft farmaya ke aap farmayiye kya hukm hai? Is par a'rabi ne kaha SubhanAllah main aap se daryaft karne aaya hoon aap Khalifa-e-Rasool hain aur aap kisi se daryaft farma rahe hain? Aap ne farmaya is mein tera kya bigra? Yeh to Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke do adil jo faisla kar dein is liye main ne apne sathi se daryaft kiya. Jab hum dono kisi baat par ittefaq kar lenge to tujh se keh denge. Is ki sanad to bahut mazboot hai lekin is mein Maimoon aur Siddiq R.A ke darmiyan inqita hai. Yahan yahi chahiye tha Hazrat Siddiq R.A ne jab dekha ke a'rabi jahil hai aur jahl ki dawa taleem hai to aap ne use narmi aur mohabbat se samjha diya aur jabke aitraz karne wala khud mudda'i-e-ilm ho phir wahan yeh surat nahin rehti. Chunancha Ibn Jarir mein hai Hazrat Qabisa bin Jabir kehte hain hum hajj ke liye chale hamari aadat thi ke subh ki namaz parhte hi hum sawariyon se utar parte aur unhein chalate hue baatein karte hue paidal chal parte. Ek din isi tarah ja rahe the ke ek hiran hamari nigah mein para hum mein se ek shakhs ne use patthar mara jo use puri tarah laga aur woh mar kar gir gaya woh shakhs use murda chor kar apni sawari par sawar ho gaya.

Hamein yeh kaam bada bura maloom hua aur hum ne ise bahut kuch kaha suna. Makkah Sharif pahunch kar main ise Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ke paas le gaya. Us ne sara waqia khud bayan kiya. Us waqt Janab-e-Farooq (R.A) ke pehlu mein ek sahib khade thay jin ka chehra chandi ki tarah jagmaga raha tha, yeh Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf (R.A) thay. Aap ne un ki taraf mutawajja ho kar kuch baatein keen, phir mere sath se farmaya ke tu ne ise jaan boojh kar maar dala ya bhool chook se? Us ne kaha main ne patthar isi par phenka aur qasdan phenka lekin ise maar dalne ki meri niyat na thi. Aap ne farmaya phir to khata aur amd ke darmiyan darmiyan hai. Ja tu ek bakri zibah kar de, us ka gosht sadaqa kar de aur us ki khaal apne kaam mein la. Yeh sun kar hum wahan se chale aaye. Main ne apne sathi se kaha dekh tu ne bada qasoor kiya hai, Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki nishaniyon ki tujhe azmat karni chahiye aur ek baat yeh bhi hai ke khud Ameer-ul-Momineen ko to yeh masla maloom na tha, unhon ne apne sathi se daryaft kiya. Mere khayal se to apni oontni Allah ke naam se qurban kar de, shayad is se tera jurm maaf ho jaye. Afsos ke us waqt mujhe yeh aayat yaad hi na rahi ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne to is hukm par amal kiya hai ke do aadil shakhs baham ittefaq se jo faisla karein. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bhi mera yeh fatwa dena maloom ho gaya, achanak aap kora liye hue aa gaye. Awal to mere sathi par kora utha kar farmaya tu ne ek to jurm mein qatl kiya, dusre hukm ki tameel mein bewaqoofi kar raha hai. Ab meri taraf mutawajja hue, main ne kaha Ameer-ul-Momineen agar aap ne mujhe takleef pahunchai to main aap ko aaj ki takleef hargiz maaf nahin karunga. Aap narm pad gaye aur mujh se farmane lage, ae Qabsiyah mere khayal se to tu jawani ki umar wala, kushaada seene wala aur chalti zaban wala hai. Yaad rakh naujawanon mein agar nau khaslatein achi hon aur ek buri ho to woh ek buri khaslat nau bhali khaslaton ko maat kar deti hai. Sun jawani ki laghzishon se bacha reh. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Jarir bin Abdullah Bajli (R.A) ne ehram ki halat mein ek hiran ka shikar kar liya, phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke paas gaye. Aap ne farmaya jao apne do rishtedaron ko le aao wohi faisla karenge, main ja kar Hazrat Abdur Rahman (R.A) ko aur Hazrat Saad (R.A) ko bula laya. Donon ne faisla kiya ke main ek mota taza bakra fidiya doon. Hazrat Tariq farmate hain ek shakhs ne ek hiran ko teer mara woh mar gaya, Hazrat Umar (R.A) se us ne masla pucha to aap ne khud us ko bhi mashware mein shareek kar liya, donon ne mil kar faisla kiya ke ghar ki paaltu bakri rah-e-Lillah qurban karo. Is mein yeh daleel hai ke khud qatil bhi do hukm karne walon mein ek ban sakta hai, jaise ke Imam Shafi (R.H) aur Imam Ahmad (R.H) ka mazhab hai. Phir aaya har mamla mein ab bhi maujooda logon mein se do hukm faisla karenge ya Sahaba (R.A) ke faisle kaafi hain? Is mein bhi ikhtilaf hai, Imam Malik (R.H) aur Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) farmate hain har faisla us waqt ke maujood do aqalmand logon se karaya jaye go is mein pehle ka koi faisla ho ya na ho.

Phir farmata hai yeh fidiye ki qurbani haram mein pahunche yani wahin zibah ho aur wahin is ka gosht maskeenon mein taqseem ho is par sab ka ittefaq hai phir farmaya kaffara hai maskeenon ka khana khilana ya is ke barabar ke rozay, yani jab muhrim apne qatl kiye hue shikar ke manind koi janwar na paye ya khud shikar aisa hua hi nahin jis ke misl koi janwar paltu ho yahan par lafz 'au' ikhtiyar ke sabit karne ke liye hai yani badle ke janwar mein khana khilane mein aur rozay rakhne mein ikhtiyar hai jaise ke Imam Malik, Imam Abu Hanifa, Imam Abu Yusuf, Imam Muhammad bin Hasan aur Imam Shafi'i ke do qaulon mein se ek qaul aur Imam Ahmad ka mashhoor qaul hai aur ayat ke zahir alfaz bhi yahi hain, dusra qaul yeh hai ke yeh tarteeb-war hain, yani pehle to badla pas Malik, Abu Hanifa, un ke sathi, Hammad aur Ibrahim ka to qaul hai ke khud shikar ki qeemat lagayi jayegi aur Imam Shafi'i farmate hain shikar ke barabar ke janwar ki qeemat lagayi jayegi agar woh maujood ho phir is ka anaj khareeda jayega aur is mein se ek ek mudd ek ek maskeen ko diya jayega Malik aur fuqaha-e-Hijaz ka qaul bhi yahi hai, Imam Abu Hanifa aur un ke sathi kehte hain har maskeen ko do mudd diye jayenge Mujahid ka qaul yahi hai, Imam Ahmad farmate hain gehun hon to ek mudd aur is ke siwa kuch ho to do mudd, pas agar na paye ya ikhtiyar is ayat se sabit ho jaye to har maskeen ke khane ke ewaz ek roza rakh le, baaz kehte hain jitna anaj ho is ke har ek saa ke badle ek roza rakhe jaise ke is shakhs ke liye yeh hukm hai jo khushbu waghera lagaye, Shari' (A.S) ne Hazrat Ka'ab bin Ujra ko hukm diya tha ke woh ek farq ko chhe shakhson ke darmiyan taqseem kar dein ya teen din ke rozay rakhein, farq teen saa ka hota hai ab khana pahunchane ki jagah mein bhi ikhtilaf hai, Imam Shafi'i ka farman hai ke is ki jagah haram hai, Ata ka qaul bhi yahi hai, Mujahid farmate hain jahan shikar kiya hai wahin khilwa de, ya is se bahut zyada ki qareeb ki jagah mein, Imam Abu Hanifa farmate hain khwah haram mein khwah ghair-e-haram mein ikhtiyar hai.

Salaf ki is ayat ke mutaliq aqwal mulahiza hon, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab muhrim shikar khel le us par us ke badle ke chopaye ka faisla kiya jaye ga agar na mile to dekha jaye ga ke woh kis qeemat ka hai, phir us naqdi ke anaj ka andaza kiya jaye ga phir jitna anaj hoga usi ke naap se har nisf sa'a ke badle ek roza rakhna hoga phir jab ta'am paya jaye ga jaza pali gayi aur riwayat mein hai jab muhrim ne hiran ko maar dala to us par ek bakri hai jo Makkah mein zibah ki jaye gi agar na paye to chhe maskeen ka khana hai agar na paye to teen rozay hain agar kisi ne oont ko qatl kiya to us ke zimma ek gaye hai agar na paye to bees maskeenon ka khana dena agar yeh bhi na paye to bees rozay, agar shutur-murgh ya gor-e-khar waghera mara hai to us par ek oontni hai agar na mile to tees maskeenon ka khana dena agar yeh bhi na paye to tees rozay hain. Agar kisi ne oont ko qatl kiya to us ke zimma ek gaye hai agar na paye to bees maskeenon ka khana dena agar yeh bhi na paye to bees rozay, agar shutur-murgh ya gor-e-khar waghera mara hai to us par ek oontni hai agar na mile to tees maskeenon ka khana hai agar na paye to tees din ke rozay, Ibn-e-Jareer ki isi riwayat mein itni ziyadati bhi hai ke ta'am ek ek mudd ho jo un ka pet bhar de, dusre bahut se tabieen ne bhi ta'am ki miqdar batlai hai. Suddi farmate hain yeh sab cheezein tarteeb-war hain aur buzurg farmate hain ke teenon baton mein ikhtiyar hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ka mukhtar qaul bhi yahi hai phir farman hai ke yeh kaffara hum ne is liye wajib kiya hai ke woh apne kartoot ki saza ko pahunch jaye, zamana-e-jahiliyat mein jo kuch kisi ne khata ki hai woh Islam ki achhai ki wajah se maaf hai, ab Islam mein in ahkaam ki maujoodgi mein bhi phir se agar koi shakhs yeh gunah kare to Allah Ta'ala us se inteqam le ga. Go is mein had nahin Imam-e-waqt is par koi saza nahin de sakta yeh gunah Allah aur bande ke darmiyan hai han use fidiya zaroor dena pare ga yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh fidiya hi inteqam hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke jab kabhi muhrim halat-e-ahram mein shikar ko mare ga us par badla wajib hoga khwah kai dafa us se yeh harkat ho jaye aur khwah amdan ho khwah khata ho ek dafa shikar ke baad agar dobara shikar kiya to use keh diya jaye ke Allah tujh se badla le, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se ek riwayat yeh bhi marwi hai ke pehli dafa ke shikar par fidiya ka hukm hoga dobara ke shikar par khud Allah us se inteqam le ga us par faisla fidiya ka na hoga lekin Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ka mukhtar mazhab pehla qaul hi hai, Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain ek shakhs ne muhrim ho kar shikar kiya us par fidiya ka faisla kiya gaya us ne phir shikar kiya to aasman se aag aa gayi aur use jala kar bhasm kar diya yahi ma'ani hain Allah ke farman ayat (Fayantqimullahu minhu) ke.

Allah Ta'ala apni saltanat mein ghalib hai, usay koi maghloob nahin kar sakta, koi usay inteqam se rok nahin sakta. Us ka azaab jis par aajaye, koi nahin jo usay taal de. Makhlooq sab usi ki paida ki hui hai, hukm us ka sab par naafiz hai, izzat aur ghalba usi ke liye hai, woh apne nafarmanon se zabardast inteqam leta hai.

Ahram mein shikar ke masail ki tafseelat: Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain chote chote shikar aur kamzor shikar aur un ke bache jinhein insaan apne hath se pakad le aur apne neze ki nok par rakh le, is se Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki aazmaish karega. Ya'ni unhein mana farmaya hai ke tum bawajood is ke bhi un ka shikar halat-e-ahram mein na karo khwah chote hon khwah bade, khwah aasani se shikar ho sakta ho khwah sakhti se. Chunancha Umrah-e-Hudaibiya ke mauqe par yehi hua ke qisam qisam ke shikar is qadar bakasrat aa pade ke Sahaba (R.A) ke khaimon mein ghusne lage, idhar Allah ki taraf se muman'at ho gayi taake poori aazmaish ho jaye, idhar shikar goya handiya mein hai, idhar muman'at hai, hathiyar to kahan yunhi agar chahein to hath se pakad sakte thein aur posheeda taur se shikar qabze mein kar sakte thein. Ye sirf is liye tha ke farmanbardar aur nafarman ka imtehan ho jaye, poshidgi mein bhi Allah ka dar rakhne wale ghairon se mumtaz ho jayen, chunancha farman hai ke jo log Allah Ta'ala se ghaibana darte rehte hain un ke liye badi bhari maghfirat aur bahut bada ajar hai. Ab jo shakhs is hukm ke aane ke baad bhi halat-e-ahram mein shikar khelega shariyat ki mukhalifat karega, phir farmaya imandaro halat-e-ahram mein shikar na khelo. Ye hukm apne ma'ani ki haisiyat se to halal janwaron aur un se jo cheezein hasil hoti hain ke liye hai, lekin jo khushki ke haram janwar hain un ka shikar khelna Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ke nazdeek to jaiz hai aur jamhoor ke nazdeek haram hai, han is aam hukm se sirf woh cheezein makhsoos hain jin ka zikr Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya paanch janwar fasiq hain woh haram mein qatl kar diye jayen aur ghair-e-haram mein bhi, kawa, cheel, bichhoo, chuha aur kante wala kala kutta aur riwayat ke alfaaz yun hain ke in paanch janwaron ke qatl mein ahram wale par bhi koi gunah nahin. Is riwayat ko sun kar Hazrat Ayyub (R.H) apne ustad Hazrat Nafi (R.H) se poochte hain ke saanp ka kya hukm hai? Aap ne farmaya woh is mein shamil hai ye bhi qatl kar diya jaye is mein kisi ko ikhtilaf nahin. Ba'az ulama ne jaise Imam Ahmad (R.H), Imam Malik (R.H) waghera ne kutte ke hukm par darindon ko bhi rakha hai jaise bhediya, sher waghera. Is liye ke ye kutte se bahut zyada zarar wale hain. Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam (R.H) aur Hazrat Sufyan bin Uyaynah (R.H) farmate hain ke har hamla karne wale darinde ka hukm hai, dekhiye Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Utbah bin Abu Lahab ke haq mein jab dua ki to farmaya: "Aye Allah! Is par Shaam mein apna koi kutta muqarrar kar de," pas jab woh Zarqa mein pahuncha wahan use bhediye ne phaad dala. Han agar muharram ne halat-e-ahram mein kawe ko ya lomdi waghera ko maar dala to use badla dena padega. Isi tarah in paanchon qisam ke janwaron ke bache aur hamla karne wale darindon ke bache bhi is hukm se mustasna hain. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain har woh janwar jo khaya nahin jata us ke qatl mein aur us ke bachon ke qatl mein muharram par koi haraj nahin. Wajah ye hai ke un ka gosht khaya nahin jata.

Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) farmate hain kala kutta hamla karne wala aur bheriya toh muhrim qatl kar sakta hai is liye ke bheriya bhi jungli kutta hai. In ke siwa jis janwar ka shikar khele ga fidiya dena pare ga. Haan agar koi sher waghera jungli darinda us par hamla kare aur yeh use maar dale toh is surat mein fidiya nahin. Aap ke shagird Zufar kehte hain yeh hamla karne ki surat mein bhi agar maar dale ga toh fidiya dena pare ga. Baaz ahadith mein ghurab-e-abqa ka lafz aaya hai, yeh woh kawa hai jis ke pet aur peeth par safedi hoti hai. Mutlaq siyah aur bilkul safed kawe ko ghurab-e-abqa nahin kehte lekin jumhoor ka mazhab yeh hai ke har qisam ke kawe ka yahi hukm hai kyunke Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein mutlaq kawe ka zikr hai. Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain kawe ko bhi is haal mein maar sakta hai ke woh us par hamla kare ya use eza de. Mujahid waghera ka qaul hai ke is halat mein bhi maar na dale balkay use pathar waghera phenk kar hata de. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se bhi yeh marwi hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke muhrim kis kis janwar ko qatl kar de? Toh aap ne farmaya saanp, bichhoo aur chuha aur kawe ko kankar mare use maar na dale aur kala kutta aur cheel aur hamla karne wala darinda. (Abu Dawood waghera). Phir farmata hai ke jo shakhs jaan boojh kar halat-e-ihram mein shikar kare us par fidiya hai. Hazrat Ta'oos (R.H) ka farman hai ke khata se qatl karne wale par kuch nahin. Lekin yeh mazhab ghareeb hai aur aayat ke zahiri alfaaz se yahi mushtaq hai. Mujahid bin Jabir (R.H) se marwi hai ke murad woh shakhs hai jo shikar toh qasdan karta hai lekin apni halat-e-ihram ki yaad use nahin rahi. Lekin jo shakhs bawajood ihram ki yaad ke amdan shikar kare woh toh kaffaray ki had se nikal gaya us ka ihram batil ho gaya. Yeh qaul bhi ghareeb hai. Jumhoor ka mazhab yeh hai ke qasdan shikar karne wala aur bhool kar karne wala dono kaffaray mein barabar hain. Imam Zuhri (R.H) farmate hain Quran se toh qasdan shikar khelne wale par kaffara sabit hua aur hadith ne yahi hukm bhoolne wale ka bhi bayan farmaya. Matlab is qaul ka yeh hai ke qasdan shikar khelne wale par kaffara Quran-e-Kareem se sabit hai aur us ka gunahgar hona bhi. Kyunke is ke baad aayat (لِّيَذُوْقَ وَبَالَ اَمْرِهٖ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 95) farmaya hai aur Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke as-haab se khata mein bhi yahi hukm sabit hai aur is liye bhi ke shikar ko qatl karna us ka talaf karna hai aur har talaf karne ka badla zaroori hai khwah woh bil-qasd ho ya anjaan-panay se ho. Haan qasdan karne wala gunahgar bhi hai aur bila-qasd jis se sarzad ho jaye woh qabil-e-malamat nahin. Phir farmaya is ka badla yeh hai ke isi ke misl chopaya janwar rah-e-lillah qurban kare. Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) ki qira'at mein "fajaza'un" hai. In dono qira'aton mein Malik, Shafi'i, Ahmad aur jumhoor ki daleel hai ke jab shikar chopayon ki manind ho toh wahi us ke badlay mein dena hoga.

Imam Abu Hanifa R.H is ke khilaf kehte hain ke khwah shikar ke kisi janwar ki misl ho ya na ho dono suraton mein qeemat deni paregi. Haan is muhrim shikari ko ikhtiyar hai ke khwah is qeemat ko sadaqa kar de khwah is se qurbani ka koi janwar khareed le. Lekin yeh yaad rahe ke Imam Sahab ke is qaul se Sahaba R.A ka faisla hamare liye zyada qabil-e-amal hai. Unhon ne shuturmurg ke shikar ke badle oont muqarrar kiya hai aur jungli gaye ke badle paltu gaye muqarrar farmayi hai aur hiran ke badle bakri. Yeh faisle in buzurg Sahabiyon ki sanadon samet ahkam ki kitabon mein maujood hain. Jahan shikar jaisa aur koi paltu chaupaya na ho is mein Ibn Abbas R.A ka faisla qeemat ka hai jo Makkah Sharif pahunchayi jaye (Baihaqi). Phir farmaya ke is ka faisla do adil musalman kar dein ke kya qeemat hai ya kaunsa janwar badle mein diya jaye. Fuqaha ne is bare mein ikhtilaf kiya ke faisla karne wale do mein ek khud qatil ho sakta hai ya nahin? To Imam Malik waghera ne to inkar kiya hai kyunke isi ka mamla ho aur wahi hukm karne wala ho aur Imam Shafi'i, Imam Ahmad waghera ne ayat ke umoom ko samne rakh kar farmaya hai ke yeh bhi ho sakta hai. Pehle mazhab ki daleel to yeh hai ke khud hakim apne upar apna hi hukm kar ke isi hukm mein apna munsif aap nahin ban sakta. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek a'rabi hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ke paas aaya aur kaha main ne ek shikar ko ehram ki halat mein qatl kar diya hai ab aap farmayiye ke is mein mujh par badla kya hai? Aap ne Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A ki taraf dekh kar un se daryaft farmaya ke aap farmayiye kya hukm hai? Is par a'rabi ne kaha SubhanAllah main aap se daryaft karne aaya hoon aap Khalifa-e-Rasool hain aur aap kisi se daryaft farma rahe hain? Aap ne farmaya is mein tera kya bigra? Yeh to Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke do adil jo faisla kar dein is liye main ne apne sathi se daryaft kiya. Jab hum dono kisi baat par ittefaq kar lenge to tujh se keh denge. Is ki sanad to bahut mazboot hai lekin is mein Maimoon aur Siddiq R.A ke darmiyan inqita hai. Yahan yahi chahiye tha Hazrat Siddiq R.A ne jab dekha ke a'rabi jahil hai aur jahl ki dawa taleem hai to aap ne use narmi aur mohabbat se samjha diya aur jabke aitraz karne wala khud mudda'i-e-ilm ho phir wahan yeh surat nahin rehti. Chunancha Ibn Jarir mein hai Hazrat Qabisa bin Jabir kehte hain hum hajj ke liye chale hamari aadat thi ke subh ki namaz parhte hi hum sawariyon se utar parte aur unhein chalate hue baatein karte hue paidal chal parte. Ek din isi tarah ja rahe the ke ek hiran hamari nigah mein para hum mein se ek shakhs ne use patthar mara jo use puri tarah laga aur woh mar kar gir gaya woh shakhs use murda chor kar apni sawari par sawar ho gaya.

Hamein yeh kaam bada bura maloom hua aur hum ne ise bahut kuch kaha suna. Makkah Sharif pahunch kar main ise Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ke paas le gaya. Us ne sara waqia khud bayan kiya. Us waqt Janab-e-Farooq (R.A) ke pehlu mein ek sahib khade thay jin ka chehra chandi ki tarah jagmaga raha tha, yeh Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf (R.A) thay. Aap ne un ki taraf mutawajja ho kar kuch baatein keen, phir mere sath se farmaya ke tu ne ise jaan boojh kar maar dala ya bhool chook se? Us ne kaha main ne patthar isi par phenka aur qasdan phenka lekin ise maar dalne ki meri niyat na thi. Aap ne farmaya phir to khata aur amd ke darmiyan darmiyan hai. Ja tu ek bakri zibah kar de, us ka gosht sadaqa kar de aur us ki khaal apne kaam mein la. Yeh sun kar hum wahan se chale aaye. Main ne apne sathi se kaha dekh tu ne bada qasoor kiya hai, Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki nishaniyon ki tujhe azmat karni chahiye aur ek baat yeh bhi hai ke khud Ameer-ul-Momineen ko to yeh masla maloom na tha, unhon ne apne sathi se daryaft kiya. Mere khayal se to apni oontni Allah ke naam se qurban kar de, shayad is se tera jurm maaf ho jaye. Afsos ke us waqt mujhe yeh aayat yaad hi na rahi ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne to is hukm par amal kiya hai ke do aadil shakhs baham ittefaq se jo faisla karein. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bhi mera yeh fatwa dena maloom ho gaya, achanak aap kora liye hue aa gaye. Awal to mere sathi par kora utha kar farmaya tu ne ek to jurm mein qatl kiya, dusre hukm ki tameel mein bewaqoofi kar raha hai. Ab meri taraf mutawajja hue, main ne kaha Ameer-ul-Momineen agar aap ne mujhe takleef pahunchai to main aap ko aaj ki takleef hargiz maaf nahin karunga. Aap narm pad gaye aur mujh se farmane lage, ae Qabsiyah mere khayal se to tu jawani ki umar wala, kushaada seene wala aur chalti zaban wala hai. Yaad rakh naujawanon mein agar nau khaslatein achi hon aur ek buri ho to woh ek buri khaslat nau bhali khaslaton ko maat kar deti hai. Sun jawani ki laghzishon se bacha reh. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Jarir bin Abdullah Bajli (R.A) ne ehram ki halat mein ek hiran ka shikar kar liya, phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke paas gaye. Aap ne farmaya jao apne do rishtedaron ko le aao wohi faisla karenge, main ja kar Hazrat Abdur Rahman (R.A) ko aur Hazrat Saad (R.A) ko bula laya. Donon ne faisla kiya ke main ek mota taza bakra fidiya doon. Hazrat Tariq farmate hain ek shakhs ne ek hiran ko teer mara woh mar gaya, Hazrat Umar (R.A) se us ne masla pucha to aap ne khud us ko bhi mashware mein shareek kar liya, donon ne mil kar faisla kiya ke ghar ki paaltu bakri rah-e-Lillah qurban karo. Is mein yeh daleel hai ke khud qatil bhi do hukm karne walon mein ek ban sakta hai, jaise ke Imam Shafi (R.H) aur Imam Ahmad (R.H) ka mazhab hai. Phir aaya har mamla mein ab bhi maujooda logon mein se do hukm faisla karenge ya Sahaba (R.A) ke faisle kaafi hain? Is mein bhi ikhtilaf hai, Imam Malik (R.H) aur Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) farmate hain har faisla us waqt ke maujood do aqalmand logon se karaya jaye go is mein pehle ka koi faisla ho ya na ho.

Phir farmata hai yeh fidiye ki qurbani haram mein pahunche yani wahin zibah ho aur wahin is ka gosht maskeenon mein taqseem ho is par sab ka ittefaq hai phir farmaya kaffara hai maskeenon ka khana khilana ya is ke barabar ke rozay, yani jab muhrim apne qatl kiye hue shikar ke manind koi janwar na paye ya khud shikar aisa hua hi nahin jis ke misl koi janwar paltu ho yahan par lafz 'au' ikhtiyar ke sabit karne ke liye hai yani badle ke janwar mein khana khilane mein aur rozay rakhne mein ikhtiyar hai jaise ke Imam Malik, Imam Abu Hanifa, Imam Abu Yusuf, Imam Muhammad bin Hasan aur Imam Shafi'i ke do qaulon mein se ek qaul aur Imam Ahmad ka mashhoor qaul hai aur ayat ke zahir alfaz bhi yahi hain, dusra qaul yeh hai ke yeh tarteeb-war hain, yani pehle to badla pas Malik, Abu Hanifa, un ke sathi, Hammad aur Ibrahim ka to qaul hai ke khud shikar ki qeemat lagayi jayegi aur Imam Shafi'i farmate hain shikar ke barabar ke janwar ki qeemat lagayi jayegi agar woh maujood ho phir is ka anaj khareeda jayega aur is mein se ek ek mudd ek ek maskeen ko diya jayega Malik aur fuqaha-e-Hijaz ka qaul bhi yahi hai, Imam Abu Hanifa aur un ke sathi kehte hain har maskeen ko do mudd diye jayenge Mujahid ka qaul yahi hai, Imam Ahmad farmate hain gehun hon to ek mudd aur is ke siwa kuch ho to do mudd, pas agar na paye ya ikhtiyar is ayat se sabit ho jaye to har maskeen ke khane ke ewaz ek roza rakh le, baaz kehte hain jitna anaj ho is ke har ek saa ke badle ek roza rakhe jaise ke is shakhs ke liye yeh hukm hai jo khushbu waghera lagaye, Shari' (A.S) ne Hazrat Ka'ab bin Ujra ko hukm diya tha ke woh ek farq ko chhe shakhson ke darmiyan taqseem kar dein ya teen din ke rozay rakhein, farq teen saa ka hota hai ab khana pahunchane ki jagah mein bhi ikhtilaf hai, Imam Shafi'i ka farman hai ke is ki jagah haram hai, Ata ka qaul bhi yahi hai, Mujahid farmate hain jahan shikar kiya hai wahin khilwa de, ya is se bahut zyada ki qareeb ki jagah mein, Imam Abu Hanifa farmate hain khwah haram mein khwah ghair-e-haram mein ikhtiyar hai.

Salaf ki is ayat ke mutaliq aqwal mulahiza hon, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab muhrim shikar khel le us par us ke badle ke chopaye ka faisla kiya jaye ga agar na mile to dekha jaye ga ke woh kis qeemat ka hai, phir us naqdi ke anaj ka andaza kiya jaye ga phir jitna anaj hoga usi ke naap se har nisf sa'a ke badle ek roza rakhna hoga phir jab ta'am paya jaye ga jaza pali gayi aur riwayat mein hai jab muhrim ne hiran ko maar dala to us par ek bakri hai jo Makkah mein zibah ki jaye gi agar na paye to chhe maskeen ka khana hai agar na paye to teen rozay hain agar kisi ne oont ko qatl kiya to us ke zimma ek gaye hai agar na paye to bees maskeenon ka khana dena agar yeh bhi na paye to bees rozay, agar shutur-murgh ya gor-e-khar waghera mara hai to us par ek oontni hai agar na mile to tees maskeenon ka khana dena agar yeh bhi na paye to tees rozay hain. Agar kisi ne oont ko qatl kiya to us ke zimma ek gaye hai agar na paye to bees maskeenon ka khana dena agar yeh bhi na paye to bees rozay, agar shutur-murgh ya gor-e-khar waghera mara hai to us par ek oontni hai agar na mile to tees maskeenon ka khana hai agar na paye to tees din ke rozay, Ibn-e-Jareer ki isi riwayat mein itni ziyadati bhi hai ke ta'am ek ek mudd ho jo un ka pet bhar de, dusre bahut se tabieen ne bhi ta'am ki miqdar batlai hai. Suddi farmate hain yeh sab cheezein tarteeb-war hain aur buzurg farmate hain ke teenon baton mein ikhtiyar hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ka mukhtar qaul bhi yahi hai phir farman hai ke yeh kaffara hum ne is liye wajib kiya hai ke woh apne kartoot ki saza ko pahunch jaye, zamana-e-jahiliyat mein jo kuch kisi ne khata ki hai woh Islam ki achhai ki wajah se maaf hai, ab Islam mein in ahkaam ki maujoodgi mein bhi phir se agar koi shakhs yeh gunah kare to Allah Ta'ala us se inteqam le ga. Go is mein had nahin Imam-e-waqt is par koi saza nahin de sakta yeh gunah Allah aur bande ke darmiyan hai han use fidiya zaroor dena pare ga yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh fidiya hi inteqam hai. Yeh yaad rahe ke jab kabhi muhrim halat-e-ahram mein shikar ko mare ga us par badla wajib hoga khwah kai dafa us se yeh harkat ho jaye aur khwah amdan ho khwah khata ho ek dafa shikar ke baad agar dobara shikar kiya to use keh diya jaye ke Allah tujh se badla le, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se ek riwayat yeh bhi marwi hai ke pehli dafa ke shikar par fidiya ka hukm hoga dobara ke shikar par khud Allah us se inteqam le ga us par faisla fidiya ka na hoga lekin Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ka mukhtar mazhab pehla qaul hi hai, Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain ek shakhs ne muhrim ho kar shikar kiya us par fidiya ka faisla kiya gaya us ne phir shikar kiya to aasman se aag aa gayi aur use jala kar bhasm kar diya yahi ma'ani hain Allah ke farman ayat (Fayantqimullahu minhu) ke.

Allah Ta'ala apni saltanat mein ghalib hai, usay koi maghloob nahin kar sakta, koi usay inteqam se rok nahin sakta. Us ka azaab jis par aajaye, koi nahin jo usay taal de. Makhlooq sab usi ki paida ki hui hai, hukm us ka sab par naafiz hai, izzat aur ghalba usi ke liye hai, woh apne nafarmanon se zabardast inteqam leta hai.

Ta'am aur shikar mein farq aur halal ki mazeed tashreehat. Daryai shikar se murad taza pakre hue janwar aur ta'am se murad hai un ka jo gosht sukha kar namkeen bator-e-toshe ke sath rakha jata hai, yeh bhi marwi hai ke pani mein se jo zinda pakra jaye woh said yani shikar hai aur jo murda ho kar bahar nikal aaye woh ta'am yani khana hai. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A), Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A), Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (R.A) ajma'een, Hazrat Ikrama (R.H), Hazrat Abu Salama (R.H), Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i (R.H), Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Khalifa-e-Bila Fasl (R.A) se riwayat hai ke pani mein jitne bhi janwar hain woh sab ta'am hain. (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). Aap ne ek khutbay mein is ayat ke agle hissay ki tilawat kar ke farmaya ke jo cheez samundar phenk de woh ta'am hai (Ibn Jarir). Ibn Abbas (R.A) se bhi yahi manqool hai, ek riwayat mein hai ke jo murda janwar pani nikal de. Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) se is ki tafsir mein marwi hai ke jis zinda aabi janwar ko pani kinare par daal de ya pani us se hat jaye ya woh bahar murda mile (Ibn Abi Hatim). Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Abu Huraira (R.A) ne ek martaba Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se sawal kiya ke samundar ne bahut si murda machliyan kinare par phenk di hain to aap kya farmate hain? Hum unhein kha sakte hain ya nahin? Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne jawab diya nahin na khao, jab wapas aaye to Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne Quran-e-Kareem khol kar tilawat ki aur Surah Al-Ma'idah ki is ayat par nazar pari to ek aadmi ko doraya aur kaha jao keh do ke woh usay kha lein yahi bahri ta'am hai. Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) ke nazdeek bhi qaul-e-mukhtar yahi hai ke murad ta'am se woh aabi janwar hain jo pani mein hi mar jayen, farmate hain is bare mein ek riwayat marwi hai go ba'az ne isay mauqoof riwayat kaha hai, chunancha Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ka farman hai, aap ne ayat (اُحِلَّ لَكُمْ صَيْدُ الْبَحْرِ وَطَعَامُهٗ مَتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِلسَّيَّارَةِ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ صَيْدُ الْبَرِّ مَا دُمْتُمْ حُرُمًا ۭ وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ الَّذِيْٓ اِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ) (5-Al-Ma'idah: 96) parh kar farmaya is ka ta'am woh hai jisay woh phenk de aur woh mara hua ho. Ba'az logon ne isay ba-qaul-e-Abu Huraira (R.A) mauqoof riwayat kiya hai, phir farmata hai yeh manfa'at hai tumhare liye aur rah-rau musafiron ke liye, yani jo samundar ke kinare rehte hon aur jo wahan warid hue hon, pas kinare rehne wale to taza shikar khud khelte hain pani jisay dhakkay de kar bahar phenk de aur marjaye usay kha lete hain aur namkeen ho kar door daraz walon ko sookha hua pahunchta hai.

Al-gharz jumhoor ulama-e-kiram ne is ayat se istidlal kiya hai ke pani ka janwar khwah murda hi ho halal hai, is ki daleel alawa is ayat ke Imam Malik ki riwayat karda woh hadith bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne samundar ke kinare par ek chhota sa lashkar bheja jis ka sardar Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A) ko muqarrar kiya, yeh log koi teen sau thay. Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain main bhi un mein se tha, hum abhi raste mein hi thay jo hamare toshay thay khatam ho gaye, amir-e-lashkar ko jab yeh ilm hua to hukum diya ke jo kuch jis kisi ke paas ho mere paas lao, chunancha sab jama kar liya, ab hissa-e-rasdi ke tor par ek muqarrara miqdar har ek ko baant dete thay yahan tak ke aakhir mein hamain har din ek ek khajoor milne lagi, aakhir mein yeh bhi khatam ho gayi. Ab samundar ke kinare pahunch gaye dekhte hain ke kinare par ek badi machhli ek teelay ki tarah padi hui hai, sare lashkar ne athara raaton tak ise khaya, woh itni badi thi ke us ki do pasliyan khadi ki gayin to us ke neeche se ek shutar sawar nikal gaya aur us ka sar us pasli ki haddi tak na pahuncha, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke us ka naam Anbar tha, ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh murda mili thi aur sahaba ne aapas mein kaha tha ke hum Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke bheje hue hain aur is waqt sakht diqqat aur takleef mein hain ise kha lo, hum teen sau aadmi ek mahine tak wahin rahe aur isi ko khate rahe yahan tak ke hum mote tazay aur tayyar ho gaye, us ki aankh ke soorakh mein se hum charbi hathon mein bhar bhar kar nikalte thay, tera shakhs us ki aankh ki gehrai mein baith gaye thay, us ki pasli ki haddi ke darmiyan se sandni sawar guzar jata tha, hum ne us ke gosht aur charbi se matkay bhar liye, jab hum Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke paas wapas pahunche aur aap se us ka zikr kiya to aap ne farmaya yeh Allah ki taraf se rozi thi jo Allah Jalla Majdahu ne tumhain di, kya us ka gosht ab bhi tumhare paas hai? Agar ho to hamain bhi khilao, hamare paas to tha hi hum ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein pesh kiya aur khud aap ne bhi khaya. Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai ke is waqia mein khud Paighambar-e-Allah (ﷺ) bhi maujood thay, is wajah se baaz muhaddiseen kehte hain ke mumkin hai yeh do waqiye hon aur baaz kehte hain waqia to ek hi hai, shuru mein Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ) bhi un ke sath thay baad mein Huzoor (ﷺ) se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ) hum samundar ke safar ko jate hain hamare sath pani bahut kam hota hai agar isi se wuzu karte hain to pyase reh jayain to kya hamain samundar ke pani se wuzu kar lene ki ijazat hai?

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya samundar ka pani pak hai aur is ka murda halal hai, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Ahmad aur Sunan-e-Arba'a walon ne ise riwayat kiya hai. Imam Bukhari, Imam Tirmidhi, Imam Ibn Khuzaima, Imam Ibn Hibban wagaira ne is hadith ko sahih kaha hai. Sahaba ki ek jama'at ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se isi ke misl riwayat kiya hai. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain hum Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath Hajj ya Umre mein thay, ittefaq se tiddiyon ka dal ka dal aa pahuncha, hum ne unhein marna aur pakadna shuru kiya lekin phir khayal aaya ke hum to ehram ki halat mein hain inhein kya karenge? Chunancha hum ne ja kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se masla poocha to aap ne irshad farmaya ke daryai janwaron ke shikar mein koi harj nahin. Is ka ek rawi Abu al-Muhazzam za'eef hai, Wallahu A'alam. Ibn Majah mein hai ke jab tiddiyan nikal aatin aur nuqsan pahunchatin to Rasool-e-Kareem (Alaihis Salam / A.S) Allah Ta'ala se dua karte ke ae Allah in sab ko khwah choti hon khwah badi halak kar, in ke ande tabah kar, in ka silsila kaat de aur hamari ma'ash se in ke munh band kar de, ya Allah hamein roziyan de yaqeenan tu duaon ka sunne wala hai. Hazrat Khalid ne kaha ya Rasool Allah! Aap in ke silsila ke kat jaane ki dua karte hain halankeh woh bhi ek qisam ki makhlooq hai, aap ne farmaya in ki paidaish ki asal machli se hai. Hazrat Ziyad ka qaul hai ke jis ne inhein machli se zahir hote dekha tha khud usi ne mujh se bayan kiya hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke unhon ne haram mein tiddi ke shikar se bhi mana kiya hai. Jin fuqaha-e-kiram ka yeh mazhab hai ke samundar mein jo kuch hai sab halal hai un ka istidlal isi aayat se hai, woh kisi aabi janwar ko haram nahin kehte. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ka woh qaul bayan ho chuka hai ke ta'am se murad pani mein rehne wali har ek cheez hai. Ba'az hazrat ne sirf mendak ko is hukm se alag kar liya hai aur mendak ke siwa pani ke tamam janwaron ko woh mubah kehte hain kyunke Musnad wagaira ki ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mendak ke maarne se mana farmaya hai aur farmaya hai ke is ki aawaz Allah ki tasbeeh hai. Ba'az aur kehte hain samundar ke shikar se machli khai jayegi aur mendak nahin khaya jayega aur baqi ki cheezon mein ikhtilaf hai, kuch to kehte hain ke baqi sab halal hai aur kuch kehte hain baqi sab na khaya jaye. Ek jama'at ka khayal hai ke khushki ke jo janwar halal hain un jaise jo janwar pani ke hon woh bhi halal hain aur khushki ke jo janwar haram hain un ki mushabahat ke jo janwar tari ke hon woh bhi haram. Yeh sab wujooh mazhab-e-Shafi'i mein hain. Hanafi mazhab yeh hai ke samundar mein mar jaye is ka khana halal nahin jaise ke khushki mein az-khud mare hue janwar ka khana halal nahin kyunke Quran ne apni maut aap mare hue janwar ko aayat (Hurrimat 'alaikumul maitatu wad-damu wa lahmul khinziri wa ma uhilla lighairillahi bihi... al-kh) (5:3) mein haram qarar diya hai.

(Al-Ma'idah: 3) mein haram kar diya hai aur yeh aam hai, Ibn Marduyah mein hadith hai ke jo tum shikar kar lo aur woh zinda ho phir mar jaye to usey kha lo aur jise pani aap hi phenk de aur woh mara hua ulta pada hua ho usey na khao, lekin yeh hadith sanad ki roo se munkar hai sahih nahin, Malikiyon, Shafiyon aur Hanbaliyon ki daleel ek to yahi Anbar wali hadith hai jo pehle guzar chuki, dusri daleel woh hadith hai jis mein hai ke samundar ka pani pak aur is ka murda halal kiye gaye hain, do murde machli aur tiddi aur do khoon kaleji aur tilli, yeh hadith Musnad Ahmad, Ibn Majah, Darqutni aur Baihaqi mein bhi hai aur is ke shawahid bhi hain aur yahi riwayat mauqoofan bhi marwi hai, Wallahu A'lam, phir farmata hai ke tum par ehram ki halat mein shikar khelna haram hai, pas agar kisi ehram wale ne shikar kar liya aur agar qasdan kiya hai to usey kaffara bhi dena padega aur gunahgar bhi hoga aur agar khata aur ghalti se shikar kar liya hai to usey kaffara dena padega aur is ka khana is par haram hai khwah woh ehram wale hon ya na hon. Ata, Qasim, Salim, Abu Yusuf, Muhammad bin Hasan waghera bhi yahi kehte hain, phir agar usey kha liya to Ata waghera ka qaul hai ke is par do kaffare lazim hain lekin Imam Malik waghera farmate hain ke khane mein koi kaffara nahin, Jamhoor bhi Imam Sahab ke sath hain, Abu Umar ne is ki taujeeh yeh bayan ki hai ke jis tarah zani ke kayi zina par hadd ek hi hoti hai, Hazrat Abu Hanifa ka qaul hai ke shikar kar ke khane wale ko is ki qeemat bhi deni padegi, Abu Saur kehte hain ke muhrim ne jab koi shikar mara to is par jaza hai, han is shikar ka khana is ke liye halal hai lekin main usey achha nahin samajhta, kyunke farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke khushki ke shikar ko khana tumhare liye halal hai jab tak ke tum aap shikar na karo aur jab tak ke khas tumhare liye shikar na kiya jaye, is hadith ka tafseeli bayan aage aa raha hai, un ka yeh qaul ghareeb hai, han shikari ke siwa aur log bhi usey kha sakte hain ya nahin? Is mein ikhtilaf hai, ba'az to mana karte hain jaise pehle guzar chuka aur ba'az jaiz batate hain, un ki daleel wahi hadith hai jo oopar Abu Saur ke qaul ke bayan mein guzri, Wallahu A'lam, agar kisi aise shakhs ne shikar kiya jo ehram bandhe hue nahin phir us ne kisi ehram wale ko woh janwar hadiye mein diya to ba'az to kehte hain ke yeh mutlaqan halal hai khwah usi ki niyat se shikar kiya ho khwah us ke liye shikar na kiya ho, Hazrat Umar (R.A), Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A), Hazrat Zubair (R.A), Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A), Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Hazrat Ata (R.H), Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) aur Kufiyon ka yahi khayal hai, chunancha Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se yeh mas'ala poocha gaya ke ghair muhrim ke shikar ko muhrim kha sakta hai?

Toh aap ne jawaz ka fatwa diya, jab Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko yeh khabar mili toh aap ne farmaya agar tu is ke khilaf fatwa deta toh main teri saza karta. Kuch log kehte hain ke is surat mein bhi muhrim ko is ka khana durust nahin, un ki daleel is ayat ke ka umoom hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Ibn Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai aur bhi sahaba, tabieen aur aimma-e-deen is taraf gaye hain. Teesri jamaat ne is ki tafseel ki hai, woh kehte hain ke agar kisi ghair-muhrim ne kisi muhrim ke iraday se shikar kiya hai toh us muhrim ko is ka khana jaiz nahin, warna jaiz hai. Un ki daleel Hazrat Sa'ab bin Jathama (R.A) ki hadith hai ke unhon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Abwa ke maidan mein ya Waddan ke maidan mein ek gor-khar (jungli gadha) shikar karda bator-e-hadiye ke diya toh aap ne usay wapas kar diya jis se sahabi ranjeeda hue, asar-e-ranj un ke chehray par dekh kar Rahmatul-lil-Alameen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aur kuch khayal na karo hum ne ba-wajah-e-ahram mein honay ke hi isay wapas kiya hai, yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein majood hai. Toh yeh lautana aap ka isi wajah se tha ke aap ne samajh liya tha ke us ne yeh shikar khas mere liye hi kiya hai aur jab shikar muhrim ke liye hi na ho toh phir usay qabool karne aur khanay mein koi haraj nahin kyunke Hazrat Abu Qatada (R.A) ki hadith mein hai ke unhon ne bhi jabke woh ahram ki halat mein na thay ek gor-khar shikar kiya, sahaba jo ahram mein thay unhon ne is ke khanay mein tawaqquf kiya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh masla poocha toh aap ne farmaya kya tum mein se kisi ne isay ishara kiya tha? Ya isay koi madad di thi? Sab ne inkar kiya toh aap ne farmaya phir kha lo aur khud aap ne bhi khaya, yeh waqea bhi Bukhari-o-Muslim mein majood hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jungli shikar ka khana tumhare liye halal hai is halat mein bhi ke tum ahram mein ho jab tak ke khud tum ne shikar na kiya ho aur jab tak ke khud tumhare liye shikar na kiya gaya ho, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasai mein bhi yeh hadith majood hai, Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ne farmaya hai ke is ke rawi Matlab ka Jabir se sunna sabit nahin. Rabia farmate hain ke Arj mein janab-e-khalifa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) thay, aap ahram ki halat mein thay, jaaron ke din thay, ek chadar se aap munh dhakay hue thay ke aap ke samnay shikar ka gosht pesh kiya gaya toh aap ne apne sathiyon se farmaya tum kha lo, unhon ne kaha aur aap kyun nahin khatay? Farmaya mujh mein tum mein farq hai, yeh shikar mere hi liye kiya gaya hai is liye main nahin khaunga, tumhare liye nahin kiya gaya is liye tum kha sakte ho.

Ta'am aur shikar mein farq aur halal ki mazeed tashreehat. Daryai shikar se murad taza pakre hue janwar aur ta'am se murad hai un ka jo gosht sukha kar namkeen bator-e-toshe ke sath rakha jata hai, yeh bhi marwi hai ke pani mein se jo zinda pakra jaye woh said yani shikar hai aur jo murda ho kar bahar nikal aaye woh ta'am yani khana hai. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A), Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A), Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (R.A) ajma'een, Hazrat Ikrama (R.H), Hazrat Abu Salama (R.H), Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i (R.H), Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Khalifa-e-Bila Fasl (R.A) se riwayat hai ke pani mein jitne bhi janwar hain woh sab ta'am hain. (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). Aap ne ek khutbay mein is ayat ke agle hissay ki tilawat kar ke farmaya ke jo cheez samundar phenk de woh ta'am hai (Ibn Jarir). Ibn Abbas (R.A) se bhi yahi manqool hai, ek riwayat mein hai ke jo murda janwar pani nikal de. Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) se is ki tafsir mein marwi hai ke jis zinda aabi janwar ko pani kinare par daal de ya pani us se hat jaye ya woh bahar murda mile (Ibn Abi Hatim). Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Abu Huraira (R.A) ne ek martaba Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se sawal kiya ke samundar ne bahut si murda machliyan kinare par phenk di hain to aap kya farmate hain? Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ka woh qaul bayan ho chuka hai ke ta'am se murad pani mein rehne wali har ek cheez hai. Ba'az hazrat ne sirf mendak ko is hukm se alag kar liya hai aur mendak ke siwa pani ke tamam janwaron ko woh mubah kehte hain kyunke Musnad wagaira ki ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mendak ke maarne se mana farmaya hai aur farmaya hai ke is ki aawaz Allah ki tasbeeh hai. Ba'az aur kehte hain samundar ke shikar se machli khai jayegi aur mendak nahin khaya jayega aur baqi ki cheezon mein ikhtilaf hai, kuch to kehte hain ke baqi sab halal hai aur kuch kehte hain baqi sab na khaya jaye. Ek jama'at ka khayal hai ke khushki ke jo janwar halal hain un jaise jo janwar pani ke hon woh bhi halal hain aur khushki ke jo janwar haram hain un ki mushabahat ke jo janwar tari ke hon woh bhi haram. Yeh sab wujooh mazhab-e-Shafi'i mein hain. Hanafi mazhab yeh hai ke samundar mein mar jaye is ka khana halal nahin jaise ke khushki mein az-khud mare hue janwar ka khana halal nahin kyunke Quran ne apni maut aap mare hue janwar ko aayat (Hurrimat 'alaikumul maitatu wad-damu wa lahmul khinziri wa ma uhilla lighairillahi bihi... al-kh) (5:3) mein haram qarar diya hai.

(Al-Ma'idah: 3) mein haram kar diya hai aur yeh aam hai, Ibn Marduyah mein hadith hai ke jo tum shikar kar lo aur woh zinda ho phir mar jaye to usey kha lo aur jise pani aap hi phenk de aur woh mara hua ulta pada hua ho usey na khao, lekin yeh hadith sanad ki roo se munkar hai sahih nahin, Malikiyon, Shafiyon aur Hanbaliyon ki daleel ek to yahi Anbar wali hadith hai jo pehle guzar chuki, dusri daleel woh hadith hai jis mein hai ke samundar ka pani pak aur is ka murda halal kiye gaye hain, do murde machli aur tiddi aur do khoon kaleji aur tilli, yeh hadith Musnad Ahmad, Ibn Majah, Darqutni aur Baihaqi mein bhi hai aur is ke shawahid bhi hain aur yahi riwayat mauqoofan bhi marwi hai, Wallahu A'lam, phir farmata hai ke tum par ehram ki halat mein shikar khelna haram hai, pas agar kisi ehram wale ne shikar kar liya aur agar qasdan kiya hai to usey kaffara bhi dena padega aur gunahgar bhi hoga aur agar khata aur ghalti se shikar kar liya hai to usey kaffara dena padega aur is ka khana is par haram hai khwah woh ehram wale hon ya na hon. Ata, Qasim, Salim, Abu Yusuf, Muhammad bin Hasan waghera bhi yahi kehte hain, phir agar usey kha liya to Ata waghera ka qaul hai ke is par do kaffare lazim hain lekin Imam Malik waghera farmate hain ke khane mein koi kaffara nahin, Jamhoor bhi Imam Sahab ke sath hain, Abu Umar ne is ki taujeeh yeh bayan ki hai ke jis tarah zani ke kayi zina par hadd ek hi hoti hai, Hazrat Abu Hanifa ka qaul hai ke shikar kar ke khane wale ko is ki qeemat bhi deni padegi, Abu Saur kehte hain ke muhrim ne jab koi shikar mara to is par jaza hai, han is shikar ka khana is ke liye halal hai lekin main usey achha nahin samajhta, kyunke farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke khushki ke shikar ko khana tumhare liye halal hai jab tak ke tum aap shikar na karo aur jab tak ke khas tumhare liye shikar na kiya jaye, is hadith ka tafseeli bayan aage aa raha hai, un ka yeh qaul ghareeb hai, han shikari ke siwa aur log bhi usey kha sakte hain ya nahin? Is mein ikhtilaf hai, ba'az to mana karte hain jaise pehle guzar chuka aur ba'az jaiz batate hain, un ki daleel wahi hadith hai jo oopar Abu Saur ke qaul ke bayan mein guzri, Wallahu A'lam, agar kisi aise shakhs ne shikar kiya jo ehram bandhe hue nahin phir us ne kisi ehram wale ko woh janwar hadiye mein diya to ba'az to kehte hain ke yeh mutlaqan halal hai khwah usi ki niyat se shikar kiya ho khwah us ke liye shikar na kiya ho, Hazrat Umar (R.A), Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A), Hazrat Zubair (R.A), Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A), Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Hazrat Ata (R.H), Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) aur Kufiyon ka yahi khayal hai, chunancha Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se yeh mas'ala poocha gaya ke ghair muhrim ke shikar ko muhrim kha sakta hai?

Toh aap ne jawaz ka fatwa diya, jab Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko yeh khabar mili toh aap ne farmaya agar tu is ke khilaf fatwa deta toh main teri saza karta. Kuch log kehte hain ke is surat mein bhi muhrim ko is ka khana durust nahin, un ki daleel is ayat ke ka umoom hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Ibn Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai aur bhi sahaba, tabieen aur aimma-e-deen is taraf gaye hain. Teesri jamaat ne is ki tafseel ki hai, woh kehte hain ke agar kisi ghair-muhrim ne kisi muhrim ke iraday se shikar kiya hai toh us muhrim ko is ka khana jaiz nahin, warna jaiz hai. Un ki daleel Hazrat Sa'ab bin Jathama (R.A) ki hadith hai ke unhon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Abwa ke maidan mein ya Waddan ke maidan mein ek gor-khar (jungli gadha) shikar karda bator-e-hadiye ke diya toh aap ne usay wapas kar diya jis se sahabi ranjeeda hue, asar-e-ranj un ke chehray par dekh kar Rahmatul-lil-Alameen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aur kuch khayal na karo hum ne ba-wajah-e-ahram mein honay ke hi isay wapas kiya hai, yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein majood hai. Toh yeh lautana aap ka isi wajah se tha ke aap ne samajh liya tha ke us ne yeh shikar khas mere liye hi kiya hai aur jab shikar muhrim ke liye hi na ho toh phir usay qabool karne aur khanay mein koi haraj nahin kyunke Hazrat Abu Qatada (R.A) ki hadith mein hai ke unhon ne bhi jabke woh ahram ki halat mein na thay ek gor-khar shikar kiya, sahaba jo ahram mein thay unhon ne is ke khanay mein tawaqquf kiya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh masla poocha toh aap ne farmaya kya tum mein se kisi ne isay ishara kiya tha? Ya isay koi madad di thi? Sab ne inkar kiya toh aap ne farmaya phir kha lo aur khud aap ne bhi khaya, yeh waqea bhi Bukhari-o-Muslim mein majood hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jungli shikar ka khana tumhare liye halal hai is halat mein bhi ke tum ahram mein ho jab tak ke khud tum ne shikar na kiya ho aur jab tak ke khud tumhare liye shikar na kiya gaya ho, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasai mein bhi yeh hadith majood hai, Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ne farmaya hai ke is ke rawi Matlab ka Jabir se sunna sabit nahin. Rabia farmate hain ke Arj mein janab-e-khalifa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) thay, aap ahram ki halat mein thay, jaaron ke din thay, ek chadar se aap munh dhakay hue thay ke aap ke samnay shikar ka gosht pesh kiya gaya toh aap ne apne sathiyon se farmaya tum kha lo, unhon ne kaha aur aap kyun nahin khatay? Farmaya mujh mein tum mein farq hai, yeh shikar mere hi liye kiya gaya hai is liye main nahin khaunga, tumhare liye nahin kiya gaya is liye tum kha sakte ho.

Ta'am aur shikar mein farq aur halal ki mazeed tashreehat. Daryai shikar se murad taza pakre hue janwar aur ta'am se murad hai un ka jo gosht sukha kar namkeen bator-e-toshe ke sath rakha jata hai, yeh bhi marwi hai ke pani mein se jo zinda pakra jaye woh said yani shikar hai aur jo murda ho kar bahar nikal aaye woh ta'am yani khana hai. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A), Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A), Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (R.A) ajma'een, Hazrat Ikrama (R.H), Hazrat Abu Salama (R.H), Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i (R.H), Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Khalifa-e-Bila Fasl (R.A) se riwayat hai ke pani mein jitne bhi janwar hain woh sab ta'am hain. (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). Aap ne ek khutbay mein is ayat ke agle hissay ki tilawat kar ke farmaya ke jo cheez samundar phenk de woh ta'am hai (Ibn Jarir). Ibn Abbas (R.A) se bhi yahi manqool hai, ek riwayat mein hai ke jo murda janwar pani nikal de. Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) se is ki tafsir mein marwi hai ke jis zinda aabi janwar ko pani kinare par daal de ya pani us se hat jaye ya woh bahar murda mile (Ibn Abi Hatim). Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Abu Huraira (R.A) ne ek martaba Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se sawal kiya ke samundar ne bahut si murda machliyan kinare par phenk di hain to aap kya farmate hain? Hum unhein kha sakte hain ya nahin? Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne jawab diya nahin na khao, jab wapas aaye to Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne Quran-e-Kareem khol kar tilawat ki aur Surah Al-Ma'idah ki is ayat par nazar pari to ek aadmi ko doraya aur kaha jao keh do ke woh usay kha lein yahi bahri ta'am hai. Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) ke nazdeek bhi qaul-e-mukhtar yahi hai ke murad ta'am se woh aabi janwar hain jo pani mein hi mar jayen, farmate hain is bare mein ek riwayat marwi hai go ba'az ne isay mauqoof riwayat kaha hai, chunancha Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ka farman hai, aap ne ayat (اُحِلَّ لَكُمْ صَيْدُ الْبَحْرِ وَطَعَامُهٗ مَتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِلسَّيَّارَةِ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ صَيْدُ الْبَرِّ مَا دُمْتُمْ حُرُمًا ۭ وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ الَّذِيْٓ اِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ) (5-Al-Ma'idah: 96) parh kar farmaya is ka ta'am woh hai jisay woh phenk de aur woh mara hua ho. Ba'az logon ne isay ba-qaul-e-Abu Huraira (R.A) mauqoof riwayat kiya hai, phir farmata hai yeh manfa'at hai tumhare liye aur rah-rau musafiron ke liye, yani jo samundar ke kinare rehte hon aur jo wahan warid hue hon, pas kinare rehne wale to taza shikar khud khelte hain pani jisay dhakkay de kar bahar phenk de aur marjaye usay kha lete hain aur namkeen ho kar door daraz walon ko sookha hua pahunchta hai.

Al-gharz jumhoor ulama-e-kiram ne is ayat se istidlal kiya hai ke pani ka janwar khwah murda hi ho halal hai, is ki daleel alawa is ayat ke Imam Malik ki riwayat karda woh hadith bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne samundar ke kinare par ek chhota sa lashkar bheja jis ka sardar Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A) ko muqarrar kiya, yeh log koi teen sau thay. Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain main bhi un mein se tha, hum abhi raste mein hi thay jo hamare toshay thay khatam ho gaye, amir-e-lashkar ko jab yeh ilm hua to hukum diya ke jo kuch jis kisi ke paas ho mere paas lao, chunancha sab jama kar liya, ab hissa-e-rasdi ke tor par ek muqarrara miqdar har ek ko baant dete thay yahan tak ke aakhir mein hamain har din ek ek khajoor milne lagi, aakhir mein yeh bhi khatam ho gayi. Ab samundar ke kinare pahunch gaye dekhte hain ke kinare par ek badi machhli ek teelay ki tarah padi hui hai, sare lashkar ne athara raaton tak ise khaya, woh itni badi thi ke us ki do pasliyan khadi ki gayin to us ke neeche se ek shutar sawar nikal gaya aur us ka sar us pasli ki haddi tak na pahuncha, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke us ka naam Anbar tha, ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh murda mili thi aur sahaba ne aapas mein kaha tha ke hum Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke bheje hue hain aur is waqt sakht diqqat aur takleef mein hain ise kha lo, hum teen sau aadmi ek mahine tak wahin rahe aur isi ko khate rahe yahan tak ke hum mote tazay aur tayyar ho gaye, us ki aankh ke soorakh mein se hum charbi hathon mein bhar bhar kar nikalte thay, tera shakhs us ki aankh ki gehrai mein baith gaye thay, us ki pasli ki haddi ke darmiyan se sandni sawar guzar jata tha, hum ne us ke gosht aur charbi se matkay bhar liye, jab hum Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke paas wapas pahunche aur aap se us ka zikr kiya to aap ne farmaya yeh Allah ki taraf se rozi thi jo Allah Jalla Majdahu ne tumhain di, kya us ka gosht ab bhi tumhare paas hai? Agar ho to hamain bhi khilao, hamare paas to tha hi hum ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein pesh kiya aur khud aap ne bhi khaya. Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai ke is waqia mein khud Paighambar-e-Allah (ﷺ) bhi maujood thay, is wajah se baaz muhaddiseen kehte hain ke mumkin hai yeh do waqiye hon aur baaz kehte hain waqia to ek hi hai, shuru mein Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ) bhi un ke sath thay baad mein Huzoor (ﷺ) se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ) hum samundar ke safar ko jate hain hamare sath pani bahut kam hota hai agar isi se wuzu karte hain to pyase reh jayain to kya hamain samundar ke pani se wuzu kar lene ki ijazat hai?

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya samundar ka pani pak hai aur is ka murda halal hai, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Ahmad aur Sunan-e-Arba'a walon ne ise riwayat kiya hai. Imam Bukhari, Imam Tirmidhi, Imam Ibn Khuzaima, Imam Ibn Hibban wagaira ne is hadith ko sahih kaha hai. Sahaba ki ek jama'at ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se isi ke misl riwayat kiya hai. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain hum Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath Hajj ya Umre mein thay, ittefaq se tiddiyon ka dal ka dal aa pahuncha, hum ne unhein marna aur pakadna shuru kiya lekin phir khayal aaya ke hum to ehram ki halat mein hain inhein kya karenge? Chunancha hum ne ja kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se masla poocha to aap ne irshad farmaya ke daryai janwaron ke shikar mein koi harj nahin. Is ka ek rawi Abu al-Muhazzam za'eef hai, Wallahu A'alam. Ibn Majah mein hai ke jab tiddiyan nikal aatin aur nuqsan pahunchatin to Rasool-e-Kareem (Alaihis Salam / A.S) Allah Ta'ala se dua karte ke ae Allah in sab ko khwah choti hon khwah badi halak kar, in ke ande tabah kar, in ka silsila kaat de aur hamari ma'ash se in ke munh band kar de, ya Allah hamein roziyan de yaqeenan tu duaon ka sunne wala hai. Hazrat Khalid ne kaha ya Rasool Allah! Aap in ke silsila ke kat jaane ki dua karte hain halankeh woh bhi ek qisam ki makhlooq hai, aap ne farmaya in ki paidaish ki asal machli se hai.
