Ya isay koi madad di thi? Sab ne inkar kiya toh aap ne farmaya phir kha lo aur khud aap ne bhi khaya, yeh waqea bhi Bukhari-o-Muslim mein majood hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jungli shikar ka khana tumhare liye halal hai is halat mein bhi ke tum ahram mein ho jab tak ke khud tum ne shikar na kiya ho aur jab tak ke khud tumhare liye shikar na kiya gaya ho, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasai mein bhi yeh hadith majood hai, Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ne farmaya hai ke is ke rawi Matlab ka Jabir se sunna sabit nahin. Rabia farmate hain ke Arj mein janab-e-khalifa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) thay, aap ahram ki halat mein thay, jaaron ke din thay, ek chadar se aap munh dhakay hue thay ke aap ke samnay shikar ka gosht pesh kiya gaya toh aap ne apne sathiyon se farmaya tum kha lo, unhon ne kaha aur aap kyun nahin khatay? Farmaya mujh mein tum mein farq hai, yeh shikar mere hi liye kiya gaya hai is liye main nahin khaunga, tumhare liye nahin kiya gaya is liye tum kha sakte ho.

Ta'am aur shikar mein farq aur halal ki mazeed tashreehat. Daryai shikar se murad taza pakre hue janwar aur ta'am se murad hai un ka jo gosht sukha kar namkeen bator-e-toshe ke sath rakha jata hai, yeh bhi marwi hai ke pani mein se jo zinda pakra jaye woh said yani shikar hai aur jo murda ho kar bahar nikal aaye woh ta'am yani khana hai. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A), Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A), Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A), Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (R.A) ajma'een, Hazrat Ikrama (R.H), Hazrat Abu Salama (R.H), Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i (R.H), Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Khalifa-e-Bila Fasl (R.A) se riwayat hai ke pani mein jitne bhi janwar hain woh sab ta'am hain. (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). Aap ne ek khutbay mein is ayat ke agle hissay ki tilawat kar ke farmaya ke jo cheez samundar phenk de woh ta'am hai (Ibn Jarir). Ibn Abbas (R.A) se bhi yahi manqool hai, ek riwayat mein hai ke jo murda janwar pani nikal de. Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) se is ki tafsir mein marwi hai ke jis zinda aabi janwar ko pani kinare par daal de ya pani us se hat jaye ya woh bahar murda mile (Ibn Abi Hatim). Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Abu Huraira (R.A) ne ek martaba Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se sawal kiya ke samundar ne bahut si murda machliyan kinare par phenk di hain to aap kya farmate hain? Hum unhein kha sakte hain ya nahin? Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne jawab diya nahin na khao, jab wapas aaye to Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne Quran-e-Kareem khol kar tilawat ki aur Surah Al-Ma'idah ki is ayat par nazar pari to ek aadmi ko doraya aur kaha jao keh do ke woh usay kha lein yahi bahri ta'am hai. Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) ke nazdeek bhi qaul-e-mukhtar yahi hai ke murad ta'am se woh aabi janwar hain jo pani mein hi mar jayen, farmate hain is bare mein ek riwayat marwi hai go ba'az ne isay mauqoof riwayat kaha hai, chunancha Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ka farman hai, aap ne ayat (اُحِلَّ لَكُمْ صَيْدُ الْبَحْرِ وَطَعَامُهٗ مَتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِلسَّيَّارَةِ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ صَيْدُ الْبَرِّ مَا دُمْتُمْ حُرُمًا ۭ وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ الَّذِيْٓ اِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ) (5-Al-Ma'idah: 96) parh kar farmaya is ka ta'am woh hai jisay woh phenk de aur woh mara hua ho. Ba'az logon ne isay ba-qaul-e-Abu Huraira (R.A) mauqoof riwayat kiya hai, phir farmata hai yeh manfa'at hai tumhare liye aur rah-rau musafiron ke liye, yani jo samundar ke kinare rehte hon aur jo wahan warid hue hon, pas kinare rehne wale to taza shikar khud khelte hain pani jisay dhakkay de kar bahar phenk de aur marjaye usay kha lete hain aur namkeen ho kar door daraz walon ko sookha hua pahunchta hai.

Al-gharz jumhoor ulama-e-kiram ne is ayat se istidlal kiya hai ke pani ka janwar khwah murda hi ho halal hai, is ki daleel alawa is ayat ke Imam Malik ki riwayat karda woh hadith bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne samundar ke kinare par ek chhota sa lashkar bheja jis ka sardar Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A) ko muqarrar kiya, yeh log koi teen sau thay. Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain main bhi un mein se tha, hum abhi raste mein hi thay jo hamare toshay thay khatam ho gaye, amir-e-lashkar ko jab yeh ilm hua to hukum diya ke jo kuch jis kisi ke paas ho mere paas lao, chunancha sab jama kar liya, ab hissa-e-rasdi ke tor par ek muqarrara miqdar har ek ko baant dete thay yahan tak ke aakhir mein hamain har din ek ek khajoor milne lagi, aakhir mein yeh bhi khatam ho gayi. Ab samundar ke kinare pahunch gaye dekhte hain ke kinare par ek badi machhli ek teelay ki tarah padi hui hai, sare lashkar ne athara raaton tak ise khaya, woh itni badi thi ke us ki do pasliyan khadi ki gayin to us ke neeche se ek shutar sawar nikal gaya aur us ka sar us pasli ki haddi tak na pahuncha, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke us ka naam Anbar tha, ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh murda mili thi aur sahaba ne aapas mein kaha tha ke hum Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke bheje hue hain aur is waqt sakht diqqat aur takleef mein hain ise kha lo, hum teen sau aadmi ek mahine tak wahin rahe aur isi ko khate rahe yahan tak ke hum mote tazay aur tayyar ho gaye, us ki aankh ke soorakh mein se hum charbi hathon mein bhar bhar kar nikalte thay, tera shakhs us ki aankh ki gehrai mein baith gaye thay, us ki pasli ki haddi ke darmiyan se sandni sawar guzar jata tha, hum ne us ke gosht aur charbi se matkay bhar liye, jab hum Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke paas wapas pahunche aur aap se us ka zikr kiya to aap ne farmaya yeh Allah ki taraf se rozi thi jo Allah Jalla Majdahu ne tumhain di, kya us ka gosht ab bhi tumhare paas hai? Agar ho to hamain bhi khilao, hamare paas to tha hi hum ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein pesh kiya aur khud aap ne bhi khaya. Muslim ki ek riwayat mein hai ke is waqia mein khud Paighambar-e-Allah (ﷺ) bhi maujood thay, is wajah se baaz muhaddiseen kehte hain ke mumkin hai yeh do waqiye hon aur baaz kehte hain waqia to ek hi hai, shuru mein Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ) bhi un ke sath thay baad mein Huzoor (ﷺ) se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ) hum samundar ke safar ko jate hain hamare sath pani bahut kam hota hai agar isi se wuzu karte hain to pyase reh jayain to kya hamain samundar ke pani se wuzu kar lene ki ijazat hai?

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya samundar ka pani pak hai aur is ka murda halal hai, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Ahmad aur Sunan-e-Arba'a walon ne ise riwayat kiya hai. Imam Bukhari, Imam Tirmidhi, Imam Ibn Khuzaima, Imam Ibn Hibban wagaira ne is hadith ko sahih kaha hai. Sahaba ki ek jama'at ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se isi ke misl riwayat kiya hai. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain hum Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath Hajj ya Umre mein thay, ittefaq se tiddiyon ka dal ka dal aa pahuncha, hum ne unhein marna aur pakadna shuru kiya lekin phir khayal aaya ke hum to ehram ki halat mein hain inhein kya karenge? Chunancha hum ne ja kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se masla poocha to aap ne irshad farmaya ke daryai janwaron ke shikar mein koi harj nahin. Is ka ek rawi Abu al-Muhazzam za'eef hai, Wallahu A'alam. Ibn Majah mein hai ke jab tiddiyan nikal aatin aur nuqsan pahunchatin to Rasool-e-Kareem (Alaihis Salam / A.S) Allah Ta'ala se dua karte ke ae Allah in sab ko khwah choti hon khwah badi halak kar, in ke ande tabah kar, in ka silsila kaat de aur hamari ma'ash se in ke munh band kar de, ya Allah hamein roziyan de yaqeenan tu duaon ka sunne wala hai. Hazrat Khalid ne kaha ya Rasool Allah! Aap in ke silsila ke kat jaane ki dua karte hain halankeh woh bhi ek qisam ki makhlooq hai, aap ne farmaya in ki paidaish ki asal machli se hai. Hazrat Ziyad ka qaul hai ke jis ne inhein machli se zahir hote dekha tha khud usi ne mujh se bayan kiya hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke unhon ne haram mein tiddi ke shikar se bhi mana kiya hai. Jin fuqaha-e-kiram ka yeh mazhab hai ke samundar mein jo kuch hai sab halal hai un ka istidlal isi aayat se hai, woh kisi aabi janwar ko haram nahin kehte. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ka woh qaul bayan ho chuka hai ke ta'am se murad pani mein rehne wali har ek cheez hai. Ba'az hazrat ne sirf mendak ko is hukm se alag kar liya hai aur mendak ke siwa pani ke tamam janwaron ko woh mubah kehte hain kyunke Musnad wagaira ki ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mendak ke maarne se mana farmaya hai aur farmaya hai ke is ki aawaz Allah ki tasbeeh hai. Ba'az aur kehte hain samundar ke shikar se machli khai jayegi aur mendak nahin khaya jayega aur baqi ki cheezon mein ikhtilaf hai, kuch to kehte hain ke baqi sab halal hai aur kuch kehte hain baqi sab na khaya jaye. Ek jama'at ka khayal hai ke khushki ke jo janwar halal hain un jaise jo janwar pani ke hon woh bhi halal hain aur khushki ke jo janwar haram hain un ki mushabahat ke jo janwar tari ke hon woh bhi haram. Yeh sab wujooh mazhab-e-Shafi'i mein hain. Hanafi mazhab yeh hai ke samundar mein mar jaye is ka khana halal nahin jaise ke khushki mein az-khud mare hue janwar ka khana halal nahin kyunke Quran ne apni maut aap mare hue janwar ko aayat (Hurrimat 'alaikumul maitatu wad-damu wa lahmul khinziri wa ma uhilla lighairillahi bihi... al-kh) (5:3) mein haram qarar diya hai.

(Al-Ma'idah: 3) mein haram kar diya hai aur yeh aam hai, Ibn Marduyah mein hadith hai ke jo tum shikar kar lo aur woh zinda ho phir mar jaye to usey kha lo aur jise pani aap hi phenk de aur woh mara hua ulta pada hua ho usey na khao, lekin yeh hadith sanad ki roo se munkar hai sahih nahin, Malikiyon, Shafiyon aur Hanbaliyon ki daleel ek to yahi Anbar wali hadith hai jo pehle guzar chuki, dusri daleel woh hadith hai jis mein hai ke samundar ka pani pak aur is ka murda halal kiye gaye hain, do murde machli aur tiddi aur do khoon kaleji aur tilli, yeh hadith Musnad Ahmad, Ibn Majah, Darqutni aur Baihaqi mein bhi hai aur is ke shawahid bhi hain aur yahi riwayat mauqoofan bhi marwi hai, Wallahu A'lam, phir farmata hai ke tum par ehram ki halat mein shikar khelna haram hai, pas agar kisi ehram wale ne shikar kar liya aur agar qasdan kiya hai to usey kaffara bhi dena padega aur gunahgar bhi hoga aur agar khata aur ghalti se shikar kar liya hai to usey kaffara dena padega aur is ka khana is par haram hai khwah woh ehram wale hon ya na hon. Ata, Qasim, Salim, Abu Yusuf, Muhammad bin Hasan waghera bhi yahi kehte hain, phir agar usey kha liya to Ata waghera ka qaul hai ke is par do kaffare lazim hain lekin Imam Malik waghera farmate hain ke khane mein koi kaffara nahin, Jamhoor bhi Imam Sahab ke sath hain, Abu Umar ne is ki taujeeh yeh bayan ki hai ke jis tarah zani ke kayi zina par hadd ek hi hoti hai, Hazrat Abu Hanifa ka qaul hai ke shikar kar ke khane wale ko is ki qeemat bhi deni padegi, Abu Saur kehte hain ke muhrim ne jab koi shikar mara to is par jaza hai, han is shikar ka khana is ke liye halal hai lekin main usey achha nahin samajhta, kyunke farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke khushki ke shikar ko khana tumhare liye halal hai jab tak ke tum aap shikar na karo aur jab tak ke khas tumhare liye shikar na kiya jaye, is hadith ka tafseeli bayan aage aa raha hai, un ka yeh qaul ghareeb hai, han shikari ke siwa aur log bhi usey kha sakte hain ya nahin? Is mein ikhtilaf hai, ba'az to mana karte hain jaise pehle guzar chuka aur ba'az jaiz batate hain, un ki daleel wahi hadith hai jo oopar Abu Saur ke qaul ke bayan mein guzri, Wallahu A'lam, agar kisi aise shakhs ne shikar kiya jo ehram bandhe hue nahin phir us ne kisi ehram wale ko woh janwar hadiye mein diya to ba'az to kehte hain ke yeh mutlaqan halal hai khwah usi ki niyat se shikar kiya ho khwah us ke liye shikar na kiya ho, Hazrat Umar (R.A), Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A), Hazrat Zubair (R.A), Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A), Hazrat Mujahid (R.H), Hazrat Ata (R.H), Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) aur Kufiyon ka yahi khayal hai, chunancha Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se yeh mas'ala poocha gaya ke ghair muhrim ke shikar ko muhrim kha sakta hai?

Toh aap ne jawaz ka fatwa diya, jab Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko yeh khabar mili toh aap ne farmaya agar tu is ke khilaf fatwa deta toh main teri saza karta. Kuch log kehte hain ke is surat mein bhi muhrim ko is ka khana durust nahin, un ki daleel is ayat ke ka umoom hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Ibn Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai aur bhi sahaba, tabieen aur aimma-e-deen is taraf gaye hain. Teesri jamaat ne is ki tafseel ki hai, woh kehte hain ke agar kisi ghair-muhrim ne kisi muhrim ke iraday se shikar kiya hai toh us muhrim ko is ka khana jaiz nahin, warna jaiz hai. Un ki daleel Hazrat Sa'ab bin Jathama (R.A) ki hadith hai ke unhon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Abwa ke maidan mein ya Waddan ke maidan mein ek gor-khar (jungli gadha) shikar karda bator-e-hadiye ke diya toh aap ne usay wapas kar diya jis se sahabi ranjeeda hue, asar-e-ranj un ke chehray par dekh kar Rahmatul-lil-Alameen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aur kuch khayal na karo hum ne ba-wajah-e-ahram mein honay ke hi isay wapas kiya hai, yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein majood hai. Toh yeh lautana aap ka isi wajah se tha ke aap ne samajh liya tha ke us ne yeh shikar khas mere liye hi kiya hai aur jab shikar muhrim ke liye hi na ho toh phir usay qabool karne aur khanay mein koi haraj nahin kyunke Hazrat Abu Qatada (R.A) ki hadith mein hai ke unhon ne bhi jabke woh ahram ki halat mein na thay ek gor-khar shikar kiya, sahaba jo ahram mein thay unhon ne is ke khanay mein tawaqquf kiya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh masla poocha toh aap ne farmaya kya tum mein se kisi ne isay ishara kiya tha? Ya isay koi madad di thi? Sab ne inkar kiya toh aap ne farmaya phir kha lo aur khud aap ne bhi khaya, yeh waqea bhi Bukhari-o-Muslim mein majood hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jungli shikar ka khana tumhare liye halal hai is halat mein bhi ke tum ahram mein ho jab tak ke khud tum ne shikar na kiya ho aur jab tak ke khud tumhare liye shikar na kiya gaya ho, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasai mein bhi yeh hadith majood hai, Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ne farmaya hai ke is ke rawi Matlab ka Jabir se sunna sabit nahin. Rabia farmate hain ke Arj mein janab-e-khalifa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) thay, aap ahram ki halat mein thay, jaaron ke din thay, ek chadar se aap munh dhakay hue thay ke aap ke samnay shikar ka gosht pesh kiya gaya toh aap ne apne sathiyon se farmaya tum kha lo, unhon ne kaha aur aap kyun nahin khatay? Farmaya mujh mein tum mein farq hai, yeh shikar mere hi liye kiya gaya hai is liye main nahin khaunga, tumhare liye nahin kiya gaya is liye tum kha sakte ho.

Rizq-e-halal kam ho toh barkat, haram zyada bhi ho toh be-barkat aur kasrat-e-sawalat. Maqsad yeh hai ke halal go thoda ho woh behtar hai haram se go bahut sara ho. Jaise warid hai ke jo kam ho aur kifayat kare woh behtar hai us se jo zyada ho aur ghafil kar de. Ibn-e-Hatib ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein arz ki ke Ya Rasool Allah! Dua kijiye ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe maal ata farmaye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Kam maal jis ka shukriya toh ada kare yeh behtar hai us zyada se jis ki toh taqat na rakhe. Ae aqalmand logo! Allah se daro, haram se bacho, halal par iktifa karo, qana'at kiya karo taake deen-o-duniya mein kamyab ho jao. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne momin bando ko adab sikhata hai ke be-faida sawalat mat kiya karo, kured mein na paro, aise na ho ke phir un ka jawab aur un umoor ka izhar tum par shaq guzre. Sahih hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Mujhe koi kisi ki burai ki baat na pahunchaye, main chahta hoon ke tumhari taraf is halat mein aaun ke mere dil mein kisi ki taraf se koi burai na ho. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Anas bin Malik (R.A) se marwi hai ke ek dafa Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hamein khutba sunaya, aisa be-misal ke hum ne kabhi aisa khutba na suna tha. Isi mein farmaya ke agar tum woh jante jo main janta hoon toh tum bahut kam hanste aur bahut zyada rote. Yeh sun kar Ashab-e-Rasool munh dhanp kar rone lage. Isi asna mein ek shakhs aap se pooch baitha ke mera baap kaun hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Fulan. Is par yeh ayat utri. Bukhari Muslim ki aur hadith mein hai ke ek martaba logo ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ba-kasrat sawalat shuru kar diye, chunancha aap mimbar par aa gaye aur farmaya: Aao ab jis kisi ko jo kuch puchna ho puch lo, jo puchoge jawab paoge. Sahaba kanp uthe ke aisa na ho is ke piche koi ahem amr zahir ho, jitne bhi the sab apne apne chehre kapro se dhanp kar rone lage. Ek shakhs the jin se mazaq kiya jata tha aur jinhein log un ke baap ke siwa dusre ki taraf nisbat kar ke bulate the, us ne kaha: Huzoor! Mera baap kaun hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Huzafa. Phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) khade ho gaye aur kehne lage: Ya Rasool Allah! Hum Allah ke Rabb hone par, Islam ke deen hone par aur aap ke Rasool hone par razi ho gaye, hum tamam fitno se Allah ki panah talab karte hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Aaj ki tarah main ne bhalai burai kabhi nahin dekhi, Jannat Dozakh mere samne is diwar ke piche bator naqshe ke pesh kar di gayi thi. Aur riwayat mein hai yeh sawal karne wale Hazrat Abdullah bin Huzafa (R.A) the. Un se un ki walida ne kaha: Tujh se badh kar maa baap ka na-farman main ne nahin dekha. Tujhe kya khabar thi jahiliyat mein kis cheez ka parhez tha.

Farz karo agar main bhi kisi masiyat mein is waqt aalooda ho gayi hoti toh aaj Allah ke Rasool ki zabani meri ruswai hoti aur sab ke samne be-aabru-i hoti, Aap ne farmaya suno maa agar Rasool Allah ki zabani mujhe maloom hota ke falan habshi ghulam ka main beta hoon toh wallah main usi se mil jata, Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek baar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sakht gusse ki halat mein aaye mimbar par charh gaye aap ka chehra mubarak us waqt surkh ho raha tha ek shakhs ne khade ho kar pucha main kahan jaunga? Aap ne farmaya jahannam mein dusre ne pucha mera baap kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya Huzafa, Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne khade ho kar farmaya hum Allah ke Rabb hone par, Islam ke Deen hone par, Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Nabi hone par, Quran ke Imam hone par raazi hain ya Rasool Allah jahiliyat aur shirk mein hum abhi abhi aap ki taraf aaye hain, Allah hi janta hai ke mere aaba-o-ajdad kaun hain? Is se aap ka gussa kam hua aur yeh aayat utri, ek mursal hadith mein hai ke us din Huzoor ne mimbar par baith kar farmaya jo chaho pucho, jo puchoge, bataunga, yeh shakhs jis ne apne baap ka naam pucha tha yeh Quraish ke qabile Banu Sahm mein se tha, is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Janab Umar (R.A) ne Huzoor ke qadam chum kar yeh arz kiya tha aur yeh bhi farmaya tha ke aap hum se darguzar farmaye Allah Ta'ala aap se darguzar farmaye, usi din Huzoor ne yeh qaida muqarrar farmaya tha ke aulad use milegi jis ki biwi ya laundi ho aur zani ko patthar milenge, Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke baaz log az-ru-e-mazaq Huzoor se apne baap ka naam aur apni gum shuda oontniyon ki jagah waghera daryaft karte the jis par yeh aayat utri, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke jab aayat (وَلِلّٰهِ عَلَي النَّاسِ حِجُّ الْبَيْتِ مَنِ اسْـتَـطَاعَ اِلَيْهِ سَبِيْلًا) (3. Aal-e-Imran: 97) nazil hui yani sahib-e-maqdoor logon par Hajj-e-Baitullah farz hai toh logon ne pucha ya Rasool Allah kya har saal hajj farz hai?

Aap khamosh ho rahe, unhon ne phir dobara yahi sawal kiya, aap ne phir sakoot farmaya, unhon ne teesri dafa phir yahi poocha, aap ne farmaya har saal nahin aur agar main haan keh deta toh har saal wajib ho jata aur tum ada na kar sakte, pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari, yeh hadith Tirmidhi aur Ibn Majah mein bhi hai, Imam Tirmidhi farmate hain yeh riwayat is sanad se ghareeb hai aur main ne Imam Bukhari se suna hai ke is ke rawi Abu Al-Khujzi ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se mulaqat nahin ki, Ibn Jareer ki is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke meri haan ke baad agar tum ise chhod dete toh yaqeenan kafir ho jate, ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke poochne wale Muhassan Asadi thay, dusri riwayat mein un ka naam Ukasha bin Muhassan marwi hai, yahi zyada theek hai aur riwayat mein hai ke sail ek Aarabi thay is mein yeh bhi hai ke aap ne farmaya tum se agle log aimma-e-haraj ke aise hi sawalon ki wajah se halak hue, wallah tumhari halat toh yeh hai ke agar main sari zameen tumhare liye halal kar doon aur sirf ek moze ke barabar ki jagah haram kar doon toh tum usi hurmat wali zameen par giro ge, is ki sanad bhi zaeef hai, zahir aayat ke alfaaz ka matlab toh saaf hai yani in baton ka poochna mana hai jin ka zahir hona bura ho, pas awla yeh hai ke aise sawalat tark kar diye jayen aur un se araz kar liya jaye, Musnad-e-Ahmed ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne sahaba se farma diya dekho mujhe kisi ki koi burai na pahunchaye main chahta hoon ke tumhare paas saaf seena le kar aaun, phir farmata hai ke jin cheezon ke sawal se tumhein roka ja raha hai agar tum ne un ki babat pooch guch ki aur tum dekh rahe ho ke wahi nazil ho rahi hai toh tumhare sawalat ka jawab aa jayega aur jis cheez ka zahir hona tumhein bura maloom hota tha woh zahir ho jayegi, is se pehle ke aise sawalat se toh Allah Ta'ala ne darguzar farma liya. Allah hai hi bakhshish wala aur hilm-o-bardbari wala. Matlab yeh hai ke sawalat tark kar do aisa na ho ke tumhare sawal ki wajah se koi aasani sakhti mein badal jaye.

Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai musalmanon mein sab se bada gunahgar woh hai jis ne kisi cheez ki nisbat daryaft kiya jo haram na thi phir us ke sawal ki wajah se woh haram ho gayi, yeh baat aur hai ke Quran-e-Sharif mein koi hukum aaye us mein ijmali ho us ki tafseel daryaft ki jaye, Allah Ta'ala ne jis cheez ka zikr apni pak kitab mein nahin kiya us se khud us ne darguzar farma liya hai, pas tumhein bhi us se khamoshi ikhtiyar karni chahiye jaise ke khud Allah Ta'ala ne ki hai, Sahih Hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab tak main tumhein chhore rakhun tum bhi mujhe chhor rakhu, yaad rakho ke tum se agle logon ki halakat ki wajah sirf kasrat-e-sawal aur ambiya par ikhtilaf hi hui hai aur hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala ne faraiz muqarrar kar diye hain unhein zaya na karo, hadein bandh di hain unhein na toro, jo cheezein haram kar di hain un ki hurmat ko sambhalo, jin cheezon se khamoshi ki hai sirf tum par raham kha kar na ke bhool kar, tum bhi us ki pooch guch na karo, phir farmata hai aise hi masail tum se agle logon ne bhi daryaft kiye unhein bataye gaye phir woh un par iman na laye balkeh un ke ba'is kafir ban gaye, un par woh baatein bayan ki gayin un se unhon ne faida na uthaya kyunke un ke sawal hi sarkashi par thay na ke samajhne aur manne ke liye, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se is ayat ki tafsir mein marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon mein elan kiya phir farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ne tum par hajj farz kar diya hai, Banu Asad qabile ka ek shakhs khara hua aur kaha ya Rasool Allah kya har saal? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sakht ghazabnak huye aur farmaya qasam hai us ki jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai agar main haan keh deta to har saal farz ho jata aur agar aisa hota to us par amal tumhari taqat se bahar tha aur jab amal na karte to kafir ho jate, pas jab tak main na kahun tum bhi na poocho, main khud jab tumhein kisi baat ka hukum dun to use baja lao aur jab main tumhein kisi cheez se rok dun to ruk jao, pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat nazil farmayi aur sahaba ko muman'at kar di ke kahin woh bhi nasraniyon ki tarah asmani dastarkhwan talab na karein jis ke talab karne ke baad aur aane ke baad phir woh kafir ho gaye, pas mana kar diya aur saaf farma diya ke aisi baatein na poocho ke agar Quran mein un ki babat sakht ahkam nazil hon to tumhein bure lagein balkeh tum muntazir raho Quran utar raha hai jo poochna chahte ho sab ka bayan is mein pao ge. Ba-riwayat Mujahid Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se is ayat ki tafsir mein yeh bhi marwi hai ke murad is se woh janwar hain jin ka zikr is ayat ke baad hi hai, Ikrama farmate hain murad mojzat ki talbi hai jaise ke qurayshiyon ne kaha tha ke Arab mein nahrein jari ho jayen aur Safa pahar sone ka ho jaye waghera aur jaise yahud ne kaha tha ke khud un par aasman se kitab utre, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wama mana'ana an nursila bil-ayati illa an kazzaba bihal-awwalun) (17:59).

(Al-Isra: 59) Ya'ni mojzon ke zahir karne se mani' toh kuch bhi nahin magar yeh ke agle logon ne bhi ise jhutlaya. Hum ne Samood ko oontni ka nishan diya tha jis par unhon ne zulm kiya. Hum toh nishanat sirf dhamkane ke liye bhejte hain. Aur ayat mein hai: (Wa aqsamu billahi jahda aymanihim la'in ja'at-hum ayatun layu'minunna biha, qul innamal-ayatu 'indallahi wa ma yush'irukum annaha iza ja'at la yu'minun) (Al-An'am: 109). Hum un ke dilon ko aur aankhon ko ulat denge jaise ke pehli dafa Quran par iman nahin laye the aur hum unhein un ki sarkashi ki halat mein hi pare rehne denge bhatakte phirein. In mein se aksar hain hi be-ilm.

Aur riwayat mein hai yeh sawal karne wale Hazrat Abdullah bin Huzafa (R.A) the. Un se un ki walida ne kaha: Tujh se badh kar maa baap ka na-farman main ne nahin dekha. Tujhe kya khabar thi jahiliyat mein kis cheez ka parhez tha.

Sahaba kanp uthe ke aisa na ho is ke piche koi ahem amr zahir ho, jitne bhi the sab apne apne chehre kapro se dhanp kar rone lage. Ek shakhs the jin se mazaq kiya jata tha aur jinhein log un ke baap ke siwa dusre ki taraf nisbat kar ke bulate the, us ne kaha: Huzoor! Mera baap kaun hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Huzafa. Phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) khade ho gaye aur kehne lage: Ya Rasool Allah! Hum Allah ke Rabb hone par, Islam ke deen hone par aur aap ke Rasool hone par razi ho gaye, hum tamam fitno se Allah ki panah talab karte hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Aaj ki tarah main ne bhalai burai kabhi nahin dekhi, Jannat Dozakh mere samne is diwar ke piche bator naqshe ke pesh kar di gayi thi. Aur riwayat mein hai yeh sawal karne wale Hazrat Abdullah bin Huzafa (R.A) the. Un se un ki walida ne kaha: Tujh se badh kar maa baap ka na-farman main ne nahin dekha. Tujhe kya khabar thi jahiliyat mein kis cheez ka parhez tha.

Farz karo agar main bhi kisi masiyat mein is waqt aalooda ho gayi hoti toh aaj Allah ke Rasool ki zabani meri ruswai hoti aur sab ke samne be-aabru-i hoti, Aap ne farmaya suno maa agar Rasool Allah ki zabani mujhe maloom hota ke falan habshi ghulam ka main beta hoon toh wallah main usi se mil jata, Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek baar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sakht gusse ki halat mein aaye mimbar par charh gaye aap ka chehra mubarak us waqt surkh ho raha tha ek shakhs ne khade ho kar pucha main kahan jaunga? Aap ne farmaya jahannam mein dusre ne pucha mera baap kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya Huzafa, Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne khade ho kar farmaya hum Allah ke Rabb hone par, Islam ke Deen hone par, Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Nabi hone par, Quran ke Imam hone par raazi hain ya Rasool Allah jahiliyat aur shirk mein hum abhi abhi aap ki taraf aaye hain, Allah hi janta hai ke mere aaba-o-ajdad kaun hain? Is se aap ka gussa kam hua aur yeh aayat utri, ek mursal hadith mein hai ke us din Huzoor ne mimbar par baith kar farmaya jo chaho pucho, jo puchoge, bataunga, yeh shakhs jis ne apne baap ka naam pucha tha yeh Quraish ke qabile Banu Sahm mein se tha, is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Janab Umar (R.A) ne Huzoor ke qadam chum kar yeh arz kiya tha aur yeh bhi farmaya tha ke aap hum se darguzar farmaye Allah Ta'ala aap se darguzar farmaye, usi din Huzoor ne yeh qaida muqarrar farmaya tha ke aulad use milegi jis ki biwi ya laundi ho aur zani ko patthar milenge, Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke baaz log az-ru-e-mazaq Huzoor se apne baap ka naam aur apni gum shuda oontniyon ki jagah waghera daryaft karte the jis par yeh aayat utri, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke jab aayat (وَلِلّٰهِ عَلَي النَّاسِ حِجُّ الْبَيْتِ مَنِ اسْـتَـطَاعَ اِلَيْهِ سَبِيْلًا) (3. Aal-e-Imran: 97) nazil hui yani sahib-e-maqdoor logon par Hajj-e-Baitullah farz hai toh logon ne pucha ya Rasool Allah kya har saal hajj farz hai?

Aap khamosh ho rahe, unhon ne phir dobara yahi sawal kiya, aap ne phir sakoot farmaya, unhon ne teesri dafa phir yahi poocha, aap ne farmaya har saal nahin aur agar main haan keh deta toh har saal wajib ho jata aur tum ada na kar sakte, pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari, yeh hadith Tirmidhi aur Ibn Majah mein bhi hai, Imam Tirmidhi farmate hain yeh riwayat is sanad se ghareeb hai aur main ne Imam Bukhari se suna hai ke is ke rawi Abu Al-Khujzi ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) se mulaqat nahin ki, Ibn Jareer ki is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke meri haan ke baad agar tum ise chhod dete toh yaqeenan kafir ho jate, ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke poochne wale Muhassan Asadi thay, dusri riwayat mein un ka naam Ukasha bin Muhassan marwi hai, yahi zyada theek hai aur riwayat mein hai ke sail ek Aarabi thay is mein yeh bhi hai ke aap ne farmaya tum se agle log aimma-e-haraj ke aise hi sawalon ki wajah se halak hue, wallah tumhari halat toh yeh hai ke agar main sari zameen tumhare liye halal kar doon aur sirf ek moze ke barabar ki jagah haram kar doon toh tum usi hurmat wali zameen par giro ge, is ki sanad bhi zaeef hai, zahir aayat ke alfaaz ka matlab toh saaf hai yani in baton ka poochna mana hai jin ka zahir hona bura ho, pas awla yeh hai ke aise sawalat tark kar diye jayen aur un se araz kar liya jaye, Musnad-e-Ahmed ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne sahaba se farma diya dekho mujhe kisi ki koi burai na pahunchaye main chahta hoon ke tumhare paas saaf seena le kar aaun, phir farmata hai ke jin cheezon ke sawal se tumhein roka ja raha hai agar tum ne un ki babat pooch guch ki aur tum dekh rahe ho ke wahi nazil ho rahi hai toh tumhare sawalat ka jawab aa jayega aur jis cheez ka zahir hona tumhein bura maloom hota tha woh zahir ho jayegi, is se pehle ke aise sawalat se toh Allah Ta'ala ne darguzar farma liya. Allah hai hi bakhshish wala aur hilm-o-bardbari wala. Matlab yeh hai ke sawalat tark kar do aisa na ho ke tumhare sawal ki wajah se koi aasani sakhti mein badal jaye.

Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai musalmanon mein sab se bada gunahgar woh hai jis ne kisi cheez ki nisbat daryaft kiya jo haram na thi phir us ke sawal ki wajah se woh haram ho gayi, yeh baat aur hai ke Quran-e-Sharif mein koi hukum aaye us mein ijmali ho us ki tafseel daryaft ki jaye, Allah Ta'ala ne jis cheez ka zikr apni pak kitab mein nahin kiya us se khud us ne darguzar farma liya hai, pas tumhein bhi us se khamoshi ikhtiyar karni chahiye jaise ke khud Allah Ta'ala ne ki hai, Sahih Hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab tak main tumhein chhore rakhun tum bhi mujhe chhor rakhu, yaad rakho ke tum se agle logon ki halakat ki wajah sirf kasrat-e-sawal aur ambiya par ikhtilaf hi hui hai aur hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala ne faraiz muqarrar kar diye hain unhein zaya na karo, hadein bandh di hain unhein na toro, jo cheezein haram kar di hain un ki hurmat ko sambhalo, jin cheezon se khamoshi ki hai sirf tum par raham kha kar na ke bhool kar, tum bhi us ki pooch guch na karo, phir farmata hai aise hi masail tum se agle logon ne bhi daryaft kiye unhein bataye gaye phir woh un par iman na laye balkeh un ke ba'is kafir ban gaye, un par woh baatein bayan ki gayin un se unhon ne faida na uthaya kyunke un ke sawal hi sarkashi par thay na ke samajhne aur manne ke liye, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se is ayat ki tafsir mein marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon mein elan kiya phir farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ne tum par hajj farz kar diya hai, Banu Asad qabile ka ek shakhs khara hua aur kaha ya Rasool Allah kya har saal? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sakht ghazabnak huye aur farmaya qasam hai us ki jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai agar main haan keh deta to har saal farz ho jata aur agar aisa hota to us par amal tumhari taqat se bahar tha aur jab amal na karte to kafir ho jate, pas jab tak main na kahun tum bhi na poocho, main khud jab tumhein kisi baat ka hukum dun to use baja lao aur jab main tumhein kisi cheez se rok dun to ruk jao, pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat nazil farmayi aur sahaba ko muman'at kar di ke kahin woh bhi nasraniyon ki tarah asmani dastarkhwan talab na karein jis ke talab karne ke baad aur aane ke baad phir woh kafir ho gaye, pas mana kar diya aur saaf farma diya ke aisi baatein na poocho ke agar Quran mein un ki babat sakht ahkam nazil hon to tumhein bure lagein balkeh tum muntazir raho Quran utar raha hai jo poochna chahte ho sab ka bayan is mein pao ge. Ba-riwayat Mujahid Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se is ayat ki tafsir mein yeh bhi marwi hai ke murad is se woh janwar hain jin ka zikr is ayat ke baad hi hai, Ikrama farmate hain murad mojzat ki talbi hai jaise ke qurayshiyon ne kaha tha ke Arab mein nahrein jari ho jayen aur Safa pahar sone ka ho jaye waghera aur jaise yahud ne kaha tha ke khud un par aasman se kitab utre, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ayat (Wama mana'ana an nursila bil-ayati illa an kazzaba bihal-awwalun) (17:59).

(Al-Isra: 59) Ya'ni mojzon ke zahir karne se mani' toh kuch bhi nahin magar yeh ke agle logon ne bhi ise jhutlaya. Hum ne Samood ko oontni ka nishan diya tha jis par unhon ne zulm kiya. Hum toh nishanat sirf dhamkane ke liye bhejte hain. Aur ayat mein hai: (Wa aqsamu billahi jahda aymanihim la'in ja'at-hum ayatun layu'minunna biha, qul innamal-ayatu 'indallahi wa ma yush'irukum annaha iza ja'at la yu'minun) (Al-An'am: 109). Bari zor-dar qasmein khate hain ke agar koi mojza aa gaya toh zaroor iman layenge, toh jawab de ke yeh toh Allah Ta'ala ke qabze ki cheez hai. Ho sakta hai ke mojza dekh kar bhi iman na layein. Hum un ke dilon ko aur aankhon ko ulat denge jaise ke pehli dafa Quran par iman nahin laye the aur hum unhein un ki sarkashi ki halat mein hi pare rehne denge bhatakte phirein. Agar hum un par aasman se farishte bhi utarte aur murde bhi un se baatein karne lagte aur tamam cheezein yeh apni aankhon se dekh lete tab bhi toh Allah Ta'ala ki chahat ke baghair unhein iman naseeb na hota. In mein se aksar hain hi be-ilm.

Buton ke naam kate hue janwaron ke naam? Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) se marwi hai ke 'Bahira' us janwar ko kehte hain jis ke batan ka doodh woh log apne buton ke naam kar dete the, ise koi dohta na tha. 'Sa'iba' un janwaron ko kehte the jinhein woh apne mabood-e-batil ke naam par chhod dete the, sawari aur bojh se azad kar dete the. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) rawi hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Main ne Amr bin Amir Khuza'i ko dekha ke woh Jahannam mein apni aanten ghasit raha hai, us ne sab se pehle yeh rasm ijad ki thi." 'Wasila' woh oontni hai jis ke palothe do bache upar tale ke mada hon, un dono ke darmiyan koi nar oont paida na hua ho, ise bhi woh apne buton ke naam waqf kar dete the. 'Haam' us nar oont ka naam tha jis ki nasl se kai bache ho gaye hon, phir ise bhi apne buzurgon ke naam par chhod dete the aur kisi kaam mein na lete the. Ek hadith mein hai ke main ne Jahannam ko dekha, us ka ek hissa dusre ko goya khaye ja raha tha, us mein main ne Amr ko dekha ke apni aanten ghasita phirta hai, isi ne Sa'iba ka riwaj sab se pehle nikala tha. Ek hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Amr ka yeh zikr Hazrat Aktam bin Joon (R.A) se kar ke farmaya: "Woh surat-o-shakal mein bilkul tere jaisa hai." Is par Hazrat Aktam ne farmaya: "Ya Rasool Allah! Kahin yeh mushabahat mujhe nuqsan na pahunchaye?" Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Nahin, be-fikr raho, woh kafir tha tum Musalman ho." Isi ne Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke deen ko sab se pehle badla, isi ne Bahira, Sa'iba aur Haam ki rasm nikali, isi ne but-parasti deen-e-Ibrahimi mein ijad ki. Ek riwayat mein hai yeh Banu Ka'ab mein se hai, Jahannam mein us ke jalne ki badbu se dusre jahannumiyon ko bhi takleef pahunchti hai. Bahira ki rasm ko ijad karne wala Banu Mudlaj ka ek shakhs tha, us ki do oontniyan thin jin ke kaan kaat diye aur doodh haram kar diya, phir kuch arsa ke baad peena shuru kar diya. Main ne use bhi dozakh mein dekha, dono oontniyan use kaat rahi thin aur rond rahi thin. Yaad rahe ke yeh Amr Luhai bin Qum'a ka ladka hai jo Khuza'a ke sardaron mein se ek tha, qabila Jurhum ke baad Baitullah Sharif ki tawaliyat inhi ke paas thi. Yehi shakhs Arab mein but laya aur sufle logon mein un ki ibadat jari ki aur bahut si bid'atein ijad keen, jin mein se chopayon ko alag alag tariqe se buton ke naam karne ki rasm bhi thi. Jis ki taraf ishara ayat (وَجَعَلُوْا لِلّٰهِ مِمَّا ذَرَاَ مِنَ الْحَرْثِ وَالْاَنْعَامِ نَصِيْبًا فَقَالُوْا ھٰذَا لِلّٰهِ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَھٰذَا لِشُرَكَاۗىِٕنَا ۚ فَمَا كَانَ لِشُرَكَاۗىِٕهِمْ فَلَا يَصِلُ اِلَى اللّٰهِ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ لِلّٰهِ فَهُوَ يَصِلُ اِلٰي شُرَكَاۗىِٕهِمْ ۭسَاۗءَ مَا يَحْكُمُوْنَ) (Surah Al-An'am: 136) mein hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke oontni ke jab paanch bache hote to paanchwan agar nar hota to use zibah kar daalte aur us ka gosht sirf mard khate, aurton par haram jante aur agar mada hoti to us ke kaan kaat kar us ka naam Bahira rakhte.

Sa'ibah ki tafsir mein Mujahid se isi ke qareeb qareeb bakriyon mein marwi hai. Muhammad bin Ishaq ka qaul hai ke jis oontni ke pay-dar-pay das oontniyan paida hotin use chhod dete na sawari lete na baal kaat-te na doodh dohte aur isi ka naam Sa'ibah hai. Sirf mehman ke liye to doodh nikal lete warna is ka doodh yunhi ruka rehta, Abu Rooq kehte hain yeh nazr ka janwar hota tha jab kisi ki koi haajat poori ho jati to woh apne but aur buzurg ke naam koi janwar azaad kar deta phir is ki nasl bhi azaad samjhi jati, Suddi kehte hain agar koi shakhs is janwar ki be-hurmati karta to use yeh log saza dete, Ibn-e-Abbas se marwi hai ke Wasilah us janwar ko kehte hain ke maslan ek bakri ka satwan bacha hai ab agar woh nar hai aur hai murda to use mard aurat khate aur agar woh mada hai to use zinda baqi rehne dete aur agar nar mada dono ek sath hue hain to is nar ko bhi zinda rakhte aur kehte ke is ke sath is ki behan hai is ne ise hum par haram kar diya. Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab kehte hain ke jis oontni ke mada paida ho phir dusra bacha bhi mada ho to use Wasilah kehte the, Muhammad bin Ishaq farmate hain jo bakri paanch dafa do do mada bakriyan bache de is ka naam Wasilah tha phir use chhod diya jata tha is ke baad is ka jo bacha hota use zibah kar ke sirf mard kha lete aur agar murda paida hota to mard aurat sab ka hissa samjha jata, Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain Haam us nar oont ko kehte hain jis ki nasl se das bache paida ho jayen yeh bhi marwi hai ke jis ke bache se koi bacha ho jaye use woh azaad kar dete na is par sawari lete na is par bojh ladte, na is ke baal kaam mein lete na kisi kheti ya chare ya hauz se use rokte, aur aqwal bhi hain, Hazrat Malik bin Nafla farmate hain main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua us waqt main phate purane maile kuchailay kapray pehne hue tha aap ne mujhe dekh kar farmaya tere paas kuch maal bhi hai? Main ne kaha haan, farmaya kis qisam ka kaha har qisam ka oont bakriyan ghore ghulam waghera aap ne farmaya phir to Allah ne tujhe bohat kuch de rakha hai sun oont ke jab bacha hota hai to sahih salim kaan wala hi hota hai? Main ne kaha haan aap ne farmaya phir to ustara le kar un ke kaan kaat deta hai aur un ka naam Baheera rakh deta hai? Aur baaz ke kaan cheer kar unhein haram samajhne lagta hai? Main ne kaha ji haan. Farmaya khabardar aisa na karna Allah ne tujhe jitne janwar de rakhe hain sab halal hain. Phir aap ne is ayat ki tilawat ki, Baheera woh hai jis ke kaan kaat diye jate the phir ghar walon mein se koi bhi is se kisi qisam ka faida nahin utha sakta tha haan jab woh mar jata to sab baith kar is ka gosht kha jate, Sa'ibah us janwar ko kehte hain jise apne maboodon ke paas le ja kar un ke naam ka kar dete the.

Waseela us bakri ko kehte thay jis ke yahan saatwein dafa bacha ho, us ke kaan aur seeng kaat kar azaad kar dete. Is riwayat ke mutabiq toh hadees hi mein in janwaron ki tafseel mili juli hai. Ek riwayat mein yeh baqol Hazrat Auf bin Malik (R.A) marwi hai aur yahi zyada theek hai. Phir farman-e-Quran hai ke yeh naam aur cheezein Allah Ta'ala ki muqarrar karda nahin, na us ki shariat mein dakhil hain, na zariya-e-sawab hain. Yeh log Allah Ta'ala ki paak saaf shariat ki taraf dawat diye jate hain toh apne baap dadon ke tariqon ko us ke muqable mein pesh karte hain, halankeh un ke bade mehez nawaqif aur be-rah thay. Un ki tabedari toh woh karega jo un se bhi zyada behka hua aur be-aqal ho.

Sa'ibah ki tafsir mein Mujahid se isi ke qareeb qareeb bakriyon mein marwi hai. Muhammad bin Ishaq ka qaul hai ke jis oontni ke pay-dar-pay das oontniyan paida hotin use chhod dete na sawari lete na baal kaat-te na doodh dohte aur isi ka naam Sa'ibah hai. Sirf mehman ke liye to doodh nikal lete warna is ka doodh yunhi ruka rehta, Abu Rooq kehte hain yeh nazr ka janwar hota tha jab kisi ki koi haajat poori ho jati to woh apne but aur buzurg ke naam koi janwar azaad kar deta phir is ki nasl bhi azaad samjhi jati, Suddi kehte hain agar koi shakhs is janwar ki be-hurmati karta to use yeh log saza dete, Ibn-e-Abbas se marwi hai ke Wasilah us janwar ko kehte hain ke maslan ek bakri ka satwan bacha hai ab agar woh nar hai aur hai murda to use mard aurat khate aur agar woh mada hai to use zinda baqi rehne dete aur agar nar mada dono ek sath hue hain to is nar ko bhi zinda rakhte aur kehte ke is ke sath is ki behan hai is ne ise hum par haram kar diya. Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab kehte hain ke jis oontni ke mada paida ho phir dusra bacha bhi mada ho to use Wasilah kehte the, Muhammad bin Ishaq farmate hain jo bakri paanch dafa do do mada bakriyan bache de is ka naam Wasilah tha phir use chhod diya jata tha is ke baad is ka jo bacha hota use zibah kar ke sirf mard kha lete aur agar murda paida hota to mard aurat sab ka hissa samjha jata, Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain Haam us nar oont ko kehte hain jis ki nasl se das bache paida ho jayen yeh bhi marwi hai ke jis ke bache se koi bacha ho jaye use woh azaad kar dete na is par sawari lete na is par bojh ladte, na is ke baal kaam mein lete na kisi kheti ya chare ya hauz se use rokte, aur aqwal bhi hain, Hazrat Malik bin Nafla farmate hain main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua us waqt main phate purane maile kuchailay kapray pehne hue tha aap ne mujhe dekh kar farmaya tere paas kuch maal bhi hai? Main ne kaha haan, farmaya kis qisam ka kaha har qisam ka oont bakriyan ghore ghulam waghera aap ne farmaya phir to Allah ne tujhe bohat kuch de rakha hai sun oont ke jab bacha hota hai to sahih salim kaan wala hi hota hai? Main ne kaha haan aap ne farmaya phir to ustara le kar un ke kaan kaat deta hai aur un ka naam Baheera rakh deta hai? Aur baaz ke kaan cheer kar unhein haram samajhne lagta hai? Main ne kaha ji haan. Farmaya khabardar aisa na karna Allah ne tujhe jitne janwar de rakhe hain sab halal hain. Phir aap ne is ayat ki tilawat ki, Baheera woh hai jis ke kaan kaat diye jate the phir ghar walon mein se koi bhi is se kisi qisam ka faida nahin utha sakta tha haan jab woh mar jata to sab baith kar is ka gosht kha jate, Sa'ibah us janwar ko kehte hain jise apne maboodon ke paas le ja kar un ke naam ka kar dete the.

Waseela us bakri ko kehte thay jis ke yahan saatwein dafa bacha ho, us ke kaan aur seeng kaat kar azaad kar dete. Is riwayat ke mutabiq toh hadees hi mein in janwaron ki tafseel mili juli hai. Ek riwayat mein yeh baqol Hazrat Auf bin Malik (R.A) marwi hai aur yahi zyada theek hai. Phir farman-e-Quran hai ke yeh naam aur cheezein Allah Ta'ala ki muqarrar karda nahin, na us ki shariat mein dakhil hain, na zariya-e-sawab hain. Yeh log Allah Ta'ala ki paak saaf shariat ki taraf dawat diye jate hain toh apne baap dadon ke tariqon ko us ke muqable mein pesh karte hain, halankeh un ke bade mehez nawaqif aur be-rah thay. Un ki tabedari toh woh karega jo un se bhi zyada behka hua aur be-aqal ho.

Apni islah aap karo. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko hukum deta hai ke woh khud apni islah karein aur apni taqat ke mutabiq nekiyon mein mashghool rahein, jab woh khud theek-thaak ho jayenge to bure logon ka un par koi bojh nahin padega khwah woh rishte-dar aur qareebi hon khwah ajnabi aur door ke hon. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A is aayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke jab koi shakhs Allah Ta'ala ke ahkamat par aamil ho jaye buraiyon se bach jaye to us par gunahgar logon ke gunah ka koi bojh baar nahin. Muqatil se marwi hai ke har aamil ko us ke amal ka badla milta hai buron ko saza achhon ko jaza, is se yeh na samjha jaye ke achhi baat ka hukum aur buri baton se mana bhi na kare, kyunke Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ne apne khutbe mein farmaya logo tum is aayat ko padhte ho aur is ka matlab ghalat lete ho suno! Main ne khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke log jab buri baton ko dekhte hue unhein nahin rokenge to bohat mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala ka koi aam azab aa jaye, Ameer-ul-Momineen ka yeh farman bhi hai ke jhoot se bacho jhoot imaan ki zid hai (Sunan-e-Arba'a). Hazrat Abu Thalaba Khushni R.A se is aayat ki babat sawal hua to aap ne farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is bare mein sawal kiya tha to aap ne farmaya nahin balkay tum bhalai ka hukum aur burai se muman'at karte raho yahan tak ke bakhili ki pairwi aur khwahish-e-nafs ki itteba aur duniya ki pasandidagi aur har shakhs ka apni raye par phoolna aam na ho jaye us waqt tum sirf apni islah mein mashghool ho jao aur aam logon ko chhod do, yaad rakho tumhare peeche sabr ke din aa rahe hain us waqt Deen-e-Islam par jama rehne wala aisa hoga jaise koi angare ko mutthi mein liye hue ho us waqt amal karne wale ko misl pachaas shakhson ke amal ka ajar milega jo bhi achhe aamal karega. Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Sahaba ne poocha ya Rasool Allah misl pachaas shakhson ke un mein se ya hum mein se? Aap ne farmaya nahin balkay tum mein se (Tirmidhi). Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A se bhi jab is aayat ka matlab daryaft kiya gaya to aap ne farmaya yeh woh waqt nahin aaj to tumhari baatein maan li jati hain lekin haan ek zamana aisa bhi aane wala hai ke nek baatein kehne aur bhalai ka hukum karne walon ke sath zulm-o-ziyadati ki jayegi aur us ki baat qabool na ki jayegi us waqt tum sirf apne nafs ki islah mein lag jana, Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ki majlis mein kuch log baithe hue thay do shakhson mein kuch jhagda ho gaya aur woh aamne-saamne khade ho gaye to ek ne kaha main uthta hoon aur unhein neki ka hukum karta hoon aur burai se rokta hoon to dusre ne kaha mujhe kya padi?

Tu apni islah mein laga reh, phir yehi aayat tilawat ki, isay sun kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ne farmaya chup reh, is aayat ke amal ka yeh waqt nahin. Quran mein kayi tarah ki aayatein hain, ba'az toh woh hain jin ke mazameen guzar chuke, ba'az woh hain jin ke waqiyat Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zindagi mein ho gaye, ba'az ke waqiyat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad hue, ba'az Qayamat ke din honge maslan Jannat Dozakh waghera. Suno jab tak tumhare dilon mein phat na jayein, tumhara maqsood ek hi ho, tum mein phoot na padi ho, tum mein ladai dangay shuru na hue hon, tum achi baton ki hidayat karte raho aur buri baton se rokte raho. Haan jab dilon mein judai ho jaye, aap mein ikhtilaf pad jayein, ladaiyan shuru ho jayein, us waqt sirf apne tayein paband-e-shariat rakhna kafi hai aur wohi waqt hai is aayat ke amal ka (Ibn-e-Jareer). Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se kaha gaya ke in dinon toh aap agar apni zaban rok lein toh acha ho, aap ko kya padi koi kuch hi kare, aap na kisi ko rokein na kuch kahein, dekhiye Quran mein bhi toh Allah Ta'ala farmata hai tum apne tayein sambhal lo, gumrahon ki gumrahi ka wabaal tum par nahin jabke tum khud rah-e-rast par ho. Toh Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne kaha yeh hukm mere aur mere sathiyon ke liye nahin, is liye ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai khabardar har maujood shakhs ghair-maujood logon ko pahuncha de. Pas hum maujood thay aur tum ghair-maujood thay. Yeh aayat toh un logon ke haq mein hai jo baad mein aayenge, woh logon ko nek batein kahenge lekin un ki baat qabool na ki jaye gi (Ibn-e-Jareer). Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ki majlis mein ek sahib aaye bade ghuseel aur tez zaban, kehne lage suniye janab chah shakhs hain, sab Quran padhe hue, janne boojhne wale, mujtahid, samajhdar, lekin har ek dusre ko mushrik batlata hai. Us ne kaha main tum se nahin poochta, main toh Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se sawal karta hoon aur phir wohi baat dohra di. Toh Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne farmaya shayad tu yeh chahta hai ke main tujhe yeh keh doon ke ja unhein qatl kar daal, nahin main kehta hoon ja unhein nasihat kar, unhein burai se rok, na maanein toh apni rah lag. Phir aap ne yehi aayat tilawat ki. Khalifa-e-Salis Hazrat Usman (R.A) ke zamane mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Mazin Madine mein aate hain, yahan musalmanon ka ek majma jama tha jis mein se ek shakhs ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki toh aksar logon ne kaha is ke amal ka waqt abhi tak nahin aaya. Hazrat Jubair bin Nufeir (R.H) kehte hain main ek majlis mein tha jis mein bohat se Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) maujood thay, yehi zikr ho raha tha ke achi baton ka hukm karna chahiye aur buri baton se rokna chahiye, main is majlis mein sab se choti umar ka tha lekin jurrat kar ke yeh aayat padh di aur kaha ke phir is ka kya matlab hoga?

Toh sab ne ek zaban ho kar mujhe jawab diya ke is ka sahih matlab tumhein maloom nahin aur jo matlab tum le rahe ho bilkul ghalat hai mujhe bada afsos hua, phir woh apni baton mein mashghool ho gaye jab uthne ka waqt aaya toh mujh se farmaya tum abhi bache ho bemauqa aayat padh dete ho asli matlab tak nahin pahunchte bahut mumkin hai ke tum is aayat ke zamane ko pa lo yeh hukm us waqt hai jab bakhili ka daur daura ho khwahish parasti aam ho har shakhs apni samajh par nazan ho us waqt insaan khud nekiyon aur bhalaiyon mein mashghool rahe gumrahon ki gumrahi use koi nuqsan nahin pahunchaye gi. Hazrat Hasan ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya is par bhi Allah ka shukr hai agle aur pichle mominon ke sath munafiq zaroor rahe jo un ke aamal se bezar hi rahe, Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) farmate hain jab tum ne achi baat ki nasihat kar di aur buri baat se rok diya phir bhi kisi ne buraiyan keen nekiyan chhodin toh tumhein koi nuqsan nahin. Hazrat Huzaifa bhi yahi farmaye hain Hazrat Ka'ab farmate hain is ka waqt woh hai jab masjid-e-Damishq ka kaleesa dha diya jaye aur ta'assub badh jaye.

Mu'tabar gawahi ki sharait. Ba'az logon ne is ayat ke aziz hukm ko mansookh kaha hai lekin aksar hazrat is ke khilaf hain. Isnan khabar hai, is ki taqdeer shahadat-e-isnein hai, muzaf ko hazf kar ke muzaf-ilaih is ke qaim-e-maqam kar diya gaya hai ya dalalat-e-kalam ki bina par fe'l mehzoof kar diya gaya hai yani an yash-hada isnan. Zawa-e-adl sifat hai, minkum se murad musalmanon mein se hona ya wasiyat karne wale ke ahl mein se hona hai, min ghairikum se murad ahl-e-kitab hain, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke minkum se murad qabile mein aur min ghairikum se murad us ke qabile ke siwa. Shartein do hain, ek musafir ke safar mein hone ki surat mein maut ke waqt wasiyat ke liye ghair muslim ki gawahi chal sakti hai, Hazrat Shuraih se yahi marwi hai, Imam Ahmad bhi yahi farmate hain aur teenon imam khilaf hain, Imam Abu Hanifa zimmi kafiron ki gawahi aapas mein ek dusre par jaiz mante hain, Zuhri ka qaul hai ke sunnat jari ho chuki hai ke kafir ki shahadat jaiz nahin na safar mein na hazar mein. Ibn Zaid kehte hain ke yeh ayat us shakhs ke bare mein utri hai jis ki maut ke waqt us ke paas koi musalman na tha, yeh ibtida-e-Islam ka waqt tha jabke zameen kafiron se bhari thi aur wasiyat se wirsa bat-ta tha, wirse ke ahkam nazil nahin hue the, phir wasiyat mansookh ho gayi, wirse ke ahkam utre aur logon ne un par amal-e-dar-amad shuru kar diya, phir yeh bhi ke un donon ghair muslimon ko wasi banaya jaye ga ya gawah? Hazrat Ibn Mas'ood ka qaul hai ke yeh hukm us shakhs ke bare mein hai jo safar mein ho aur wahin ajal aa jaye aur maal us ke paas ho, pas agar do musalman use mil jayen to unhein apna maal sonp de aur do gawah musalman muqarrar kar le, is qaul ke mutabiq to yeh donon wasi hue, dusra qaul yeh hai ke yeh donon gawah honge, ayat ke alfaz ka zahir matlab bhi yahi maloom hota hai, han jis surat mein un ke sath aur gawah na hon to yahi wasi honge aur yahi gawah bhi honge. Imam Ibn Jarir ne ek mushkil is mein yeh bayan ki hai ke shariat ke kisi hukm mein gawah par qasam nahin, lekin hum kehte hain yeh ek hukm hai jo mustaqil taur par bilkul alaihda surat mein hai aur ahkam ka qiyas is par jari nahin hai, yeh ek khas shahadat khas mauqa ki hai is mein aur bhi bahut si aisi baatein hain jo dusre ahkam mein nahin. Pas shak ke qareene ke waqt is ayat ke hukm ke mutabiq un gawahon par qasam lazim aati hai. Namaz ke baad thehra lo se matlab namaz-e-asr ke baad hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke namaz se murad musalmanon ki namaz hai. Teesra qaul yeh hai ke un ke mazhab ki namaz, maqsood yeh hai ke unhein namaz ke baad logon ki maujudgi mein khada kiya jaye aur agar khayanat ka shak ho to un se qasam uthwai jaye, woh kahein ke Allah ki qasam hum apni qasmon ko kisi qeemat bechna nahin chahte.

Duniyawi mafaad ki bina par jhooti qasam nahin khate chahe hamari qasam se kisi hamare qareebi rishtedar ko nuqsan pahunch jaye toh pahunch jaye lekin hum jhooti qasam nahin khayenge aur na hum sachi gawahi chupayenge, is gawahi ki nisbat Allah ki taraf uski izzat-o-azmat ke izhar ke liye hai baaz ne ise qasam ki bina par majroor padha hai lekin mashhoor qira'at pehli hi hai woh sath hi yeh bhi kahein ke agar hum shahadat ko badlein ya ulat pulat karein ya kuch hissa chupa lein toh hum bhi gunahgar, phir agar yeh mashhoor ho ya zahir ho jaye ya ittila mil jaye ke un dono ne marne wale ke maal mein se kuch chura liya ya kisi qism ki khayanat ki. Awliyan ki dusri qira'at awlan bhi hai matlab yeh hai ke jab kisi khabar-e-sahih se pata chale ke un dono ne koi khayanat ki hai toh mayyat ke warison mein se jo mayyat ke zyada nazdeek hon woh do shakhs khade hon aur halifa bayan dein ke hamari shahadat hai ke unhon ne churaya aur yahi zyada haq zyada sahih aur poori sachi baat hai, hum un par jhoot nahin bandhte agar hum aisa karein toh hum zalim, yeh mas'ala aur qasamat ka mas'ala is bare mein bahut milta julta hai, is mein bhi maqtool ke awliya qasamein khate hain, Tameem Dari se manqool hai ke aur log is se bari hain sirf main aur Adi bin Bada is se mutaliq hain, yeh dono nasrani thay Islam se pehle mulk-e-Sham mein bagharz-e-tijarat aate jate thay Ibn-e-Sahm ke maula Badeel bin Abu Maryam bhi maal-e-tijarat le kar Sham ke mulk gaye hue thay un ke sath ek chandi ka jaam tha, jise woh khas badshah ke hath farokht karne ke liye le ja rahe thay. Ittefaqan woh bimar ho gaye un dono ko wasiyat ki aur maal saunp diya ke yeh mere warison ko de dena us ke marne ke baad un dono ne woh jaam toh maal se alag kar diya aur ek hazar dirham mein bech kar aadhon aadh baant liye baqi maal wapas la kar Badeel ke rishtedaron ko de diya, unhon ne poocha ke chandi ka jaam kya hua? Donon ne jawab diya hamein kya khabar? Hamein toh jo diya tha woh hum ne tumhein de diya.

Hazrat Tamim Dari (R.A) farmate hain jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine mein aaye aur Islam ne mujh par asar kiya, main musalman hogaya toh mere dil mein khayal aaya ke yeh insani haq mujh par reh jayega aur Allah Ta'ala ke haan main pakda jaunga toh main Badil ke warisan ke paas aaya aur us se kaha paanch sau dirham jo tu ne le liye hain woh bhi wapas kar. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukum diya ke us se qasam li jaye, is par yeh aayat utri aur Amr bin Aas ne aur un mein se ek aur shakhs ne qasam khai, Adi bin Bada ko paanch sau dirham dene pade (Tirmidhi). Ek riwayat mein hai ke Adi jhooti qasam bhi kha gaya tha aur riwayat mein hai ke us waqt arz-e-Sham ke is hisse mein koi musalman na tha, yeh jaam chandi ka tha aur sone se mandha hua tha aur Makkah mein se jaam kharida gaya tha jahan se mila tha unhon ne bataya tha ke hum ne ise Tamim aur Adi se kharida hai, ab mayyat ke do waris khade hue aur qasam khai, isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke qasam Asr ki namaz ke baad uthai thi. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek musalman ki wafat ka mauqa safar mein aaya, jahan koi musalman use na mila toh us ne apni wasiyat par do Ahl-e-Kitab gawah rakhe, un dono ne Kufay mein aa kar Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari ke samne shahadat di, wasiyat bayan ki aur tarka pesh kiya. Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari ne farmaya An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad yeh waqea pehla hai, pas Asr ki namaz ke baad un se qasam li ke na unhon ne khayanat ki hai, na jhoot bola hai, na badla hai, na chupaya hai, na ulat-palat kiya hai balkeh sach wasiyat aur poora tarka unhon ne pesh kar diya hai, aap ne un ki shahadat ko maan liya. Hazrat Abu Musa ke farman ka matlab yahi hai ke aisa waqea Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein Tamim aur Adi ka hua tha aur ab yeh dusra is qisam ka waqea hai. Hazrat Tamim bin Dari (R.A) ka Islam san 9 Hijri ka hai aur yeh aakhri zamana hai. Suddi farmate hain lazim hai ke maut ke waqt wasiyat kare aur do gawah rakhe, agar safar mein hai aur musalman nahin milte toh khair ghair-muslim hi sahi, unhein wasiyat kare apna maal sonp de, agar mayyat ke warison ko itminan ho jaye toh khair aayi gayi baat hui warna Sultan-e-Islam ke samne woh muqadma pesh kar diya jaye. Upar jo waqea bayan hua us mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Hazrat Abu Musa ne un se Asr ke baad qasam leni chahi toh aap se kaha gaya ke unhein Asr ke baad ki kya parwah?

Un se un ki namaz ke waqt qasam li jaye aur un se kaha jaye ke agar tum ne kuch chupaya ya khayanat ki to hum tumhein tumhari qoum mein ruswa kardenge aur tumhari gawahi kabhi bhi qabool na ki jaye gi aur tumhein sangeen saza di jaye gi, bohat mumkin hai ke is tarah un ki zaban se haq baat maloom ho jaye phir bhi agar shak shuba reh jaye aur kisi aur tareeq se un ki khayanat maloom ho jaye to marhoom ke do musalman waris qasmein khayein ke un kafiron ki shahadat ghalat hai to un ki shahadat ghalat maan li jaye gi aur un se suboot le kar faisla kardiya jaye ga phir bayan hota hai ke is soorat mein faida yeh hai ke shahadat theek theek aa jaye gi ek to Allah ki qasam ka lihaz hoga dusre logon mein ruswa hone ka dar rahe ga, logo! Allah Ta'ala se apne sab kamon mein darte raho us ki baatein sunte raho aur maante chale jao, jo log us ke farman se hat jayein aur us ke ahkaam ke khilaf chalein woh rah-e-rast nahin paate.

Ibn Zaid kehte hain ke yeh ayat us shakhs ke bare mein utri hai jis ki maut ke waqt us ke paas koi musalman na tha, yeh ibtida-e-Islam ka waqt tha jabke zameen kafiron se bhari thi aur wasiyat se wirsa bat-ta tha, wirse ke ahkam nazil nahin hue the, phir wasiyat mansookh ho gayi, wirse ke ahkam utre aur logon ne un par amal-e-dar-amad shuru kar diya, phir yeh bhi ke un donon ghair muslimon ko wasi banaya jaye ga ya gawah? Hazrat Ibn Mas'ood ka qaul hai ke yeh hukm us shakhs ke bare mein hai jo safar mein ho aur wahin ajal aa jaye aur maal us ke paas ho, pas agar do musalman use mil jayen to unhein apna maal sonp de aur do gawah musalman muqarrar kar le, is qaul ke mutabiq to yeh donon wasi hue, dusra qaul yeh hai ke yeh donon gawah honge, ayat ke alfaz ka zahir matlab bhi yahi maloom hota hai, han jis surat mein un ke sath aur gawah na hon to yahi wasi honge aur yahi gawah bhi honge. Imam Ibn Jarir ne ek mushkil is mein yeh bayan ki hai ke shariat ke kisi hukm mein gawah par qasam nahin, lekin hum kehte hain yeh ek hukm hai jo mustaqil taur par bilkul alaihda surat mein hai aur ahkam ka qiyas is par jari nahin hai, yeh ek khas shahadat khas mauqa ki hai is mein aur bhi bahut si aisi baatein hain jo dusre ahkam mein nahin. Pas shak ke qareene ke waqt is ayat ke hukm ke mutabiq un gawahon par qasam lazim aati hai. Namaz ke baad thehra lo se matlab namaz-e-asr ke baad hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke namaz se murad musalmanon ki namaz hai. Teesra qaul yeh hai ke un ke mazhab ki namaz, maqsood yeh hai ke unhein namaz ke baad logon ki maujudgi mein khada kiya jaye aur agar khayanat ka shak ho to un se qasam uthwai jaye, woh kahein ke Allah ki qasam hum apni qasmon ko kisi qeemat bechna nahin chahte.

Duniyawi mafaad ki bina par jhooti qasam nahin khate chahe hamari qasam se kisi hamare qareebi rishtedar ko nuqsan pahunch jaye toh pahunch jaye lekin hum jhooti qasam nahin khayenge aur na hum sachi gawahi chupayenge, is gawahi ki nisbat Allah ki taraf uski izzat-o-azmat ke izhar ke liye hai baaz ne ise qasam ki bina par majroor padha hai lekin mashhoor qira'at pehli hi hai woh sath hi yeh bhi kahein ke agar hum shahadat ko badlein ya ulat pulat karein ya kuch hissa chupa lein toh hum bhi gunahgar, phir agar yeh mashhoor ho ya zahir ho jaye ya ittila mil jaye ke un dono ne marne wale ke maal mein se kuch chura liya ya kisi qism ki khayanat ki. Awliyan ki dusri qira'at awlan bhi hai matlab yeh hai ke jab kisi khabar-e-sahih se pata chale ke un dono ne koi khayanat ki hai toh mayyat ke warison mein se jo mayyat ke zyada nazdeek hon woh do shakhs khade hon aur halifa bayan dein ke hamari shahadat hai ke unhon ne churaya aur yahi zyada haq zyada sahih aur poori sachi baat hai, hum un par jhoot nahin bandhte agar hum aisa karein toh hum zalim, yeh mas'ala aur qasamat ka mas'ala is bare mein bahut milta julta hai, is mein bhi maqtool ke awliya qasamein khate hain, Tameem Dari se manqool hai ke aur log is se bari hain sirf main aur Adi bin Bada is se mutaliq hain, yeh dono nasrani thay Islam se pehle mulk-e-Sham mein bagharz-e-tijarat aate jate thay Ibn-e-Sahm ke maula Badeel bin Abu Maryam bhi maal-e-tijarat le kar Sham ke mulk gaye hue thay un ke sath ek chandi ka jaam tha, jise woh khas badshah ke hath farokht karne ke liye le ja rahe thay. Ittefaqan woh bimar ho gaye un dono ko wasiyat ki aur maal saunp diya ke yeh mere warison ko de dena us ke marne ke baad un dono ne woh jaam toh maal se alag kar diya aur ek hazar dirham mein bech kar aadhon aadh baant liye baqi maal wapas la kar Badeel ke rishtedaron ko de diya, unhon ne poocha ke chandi ka jaam kya hua? Donon ne jawab diya hamein kya khabar? Hamein toh jo diya tha woh hum ne tumhein de diya.

Hazrat Tamim Dari (R.A) farmate hain jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine mein aaye aur Islam ne mujh par asar kiya, main musalman hogaya toh mere dil mein khayal aaya ke yeh insani haq mujh par reh jayega aur Allah Ta'ala ke haan main pakda jaunga toh main Badil ke warisan ke paas aaya aur us se kaha paanch sau dirham jo tu ne le liye hain woh bhi wapas kar. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukum diya ke us se qasam li jaye, is par yeh aayat utri aur Amr bin Aas ne aur un mein se ek aur shakhs ne qasam khai, Adi bin Bada ko paanch sau dirham dene pade (Tirmidhi). Ek riwayat mein hai ke Adi jhooti qasam bhi kha gaya tha aur riwayat mein hai ke us waqt arz-e-Sham ke is hisse mein koi musalman na tha, yeh jaam chandi ka tha aur sone se mandha hua tha aur Makkah mein se jaam kharida gaya tha jahan se mila tha unhon ne bataya tha ke hum ne ise Tamim aur Adi se kharida hai, ab mayyat ke do waris khade hue aur qasam khai, isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke qasam Asr ki namaz ke baad uthai thi. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek musalman ki wafat ka mauqa safar mein aaya, jahan koi musalman use na mila toh us ne apni wasiyat par do Ahl-e-Kitab gawah rakhe, un dono ne Kufay mein aa kar Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari ke samne shahadat di, wasiyat bayan ki aur tarka pesh kiya. Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari ne farmaya An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke baad yeh waqea pehla hai, pas Asr ki namaz ke baad un se qasam li ke na unhon ne khayanat ki hai, na jhoot bola hai, na badla hai, na chupaya hai, na ulat-palat kiya hai balkeh sach wasiyat aur poora tarka unhon ne pesh kar diya hai, aap ne un ki shahadat ko maan liya. Hazrat Abu Musa ke farman ka matlab yahi hai ke aisa waqea Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein Tamim aur Adi ka hua tha aur ab yeh dusra is qisam ka waqea hai. Hazrat Tamim bin Dari (R.A) ka Islam san 9 Hijri ka hai aur yeh aakhri zamana hai. Suddi farmate hain lazim hai ke maut ke waqt wasiyat kare aur do gawah rakhe, agar safar mein hai aur musalman nahin milte toh khair ghair-muslim hi sahi, unhein wasiyat kare apna maal sonp de, agar mayyat ke warison ko itminan ho jaye toh khair aayi gayi baat hui warna Sultan-e-Islam ke samne woh muqadma pesh kar diya jaye. Upar jo waqea bayan hua us mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Hazrat Abu Musa ne un se Asr ke baad qasam leni chahi toh aap se kaha gaya ke unhein Asr ke baad ki kya parwah?

Un se un ki namaz ke waqt qasam li jaye aur un se kaha jaye ke agar tum ne kuch chupaya ya khayanat ki to hum tumhein tumhari qoum mein ruswa kardenge aur tumhari gawahi kabhi bhi qabool na ki jaye gi aur tumhein sangeen saza di jaye gi, bohat mumkin hai ke is tarah un ki zaban se haq baat maloom ho jaye phir bhi agar shak shuba reh jaye aur kisi aur tareeq se un ki khayanat maloom ho jaye to marhoom ke do musalman waris qasmein khayein ke un kafiron ki shahadat ghalat hai to un ki shahadat ghalat maan li jaye gi aur un se suboot le kar faisla kardiya jaye ga phir bayan hota hai ke is soorat mein faida yeh hai ke shahadat theek theek aa jaye gi ek to Allah ki qasam ka lihaz hoga dusre logon mein ruswa hone ka dar rahe ga, logo! Allah Ta'ala se apne sab kamon mein darte raho us ki baatein sunte raho aur maante chale jao, jo log us ke farman se hat jayein aur us ke ahkaam ke khilaf chalein woh rah-e-rast nahin paate.

Isnan khabar hai, is ki taqdeer shahadat-e-isnein hai, muzaf ko hazf kar ke muzaf-ilaih is ke qaim-e-maqam kar diya gaya hai ya dalalat-e-kalam ki bina par fe'l mehzoof kar diya gaya hai yani an yash-hada isnan. Zawa-e-adl sifat hai, minkum se murad musalmanon mein se hona ya wasiyat karne wale ke ahl mein se hona hai, min ghairikum se murad ahl-e-kitab hain, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke minkum se murad qabile mein aur min ghairikum se murad us ke qabile ke siwa. Shartein do hain, ek musafir ke safar mein hone ki surat mein maut ke waqt wasiyat ke liye ghair muslim ki gawahi chal sakti hai, Hazrat Shuraih se yahi marwi hai, Imam Ahmad bhi yahi farmate hain aur teenon imam khilaf hain, Imam Abu Hanifa zimmi kafiron ki gawahi aapas mein ek dusre par jaiz mante hain, Zuhri ka qaul hai ke sunnat jari ho chuki hai ke kafir ki shahadat jaiz nahin na safar mein na hazar mein.
