Roz-e-Qayamat Anbiya se sawal: Is ayat mein bayan farmaya gaya hai ke Rasoolon se Qayamat ke din sawal hoga ke tumhari ummaton ne tumhein mana ya nahin? Jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (Falanas'alannallazina ursila ilaihim walanas'alannal mursalin) (7. Al-A'raf: 6) yani Rasoolon se bhi aur un ki ummaton se bhi yeh zaroor daryaft farmayenge aur jagah irshad hai ayat (Fawarabbika lanas'alannahum ajma'in) (15. Al-Hijr: 92) tere Rab ki qasam hum sab se un ke a'maal ka sawal zaroor zaroor karenge, Rasoolon ka yeh jawab ke hamein mutlaq ilm nahin us din ki haul-o-dehshat ki wajah se hoga, ghabrahat ki wajah se kuch jawab ban na padega, yeh woh waqt hoga ke aql jaati rahegi phir dusri manzil mein har Nabi apni apni ummat par gawahi dega. Ek matlab is ayat ka yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke sawal ki garz yeh hai ke tumhari ummaton ne tumhare baad kya kya a'mal kiye aur kya kya nayi baatein nikal lein? Toh woh un se apni la-ilmi zahir karenge, yeh ma'ni bhi durust ho sakte hain ke hamein koi aisa ilm nahin jo ae Janab-e-Bari tere ilm mein na ho, haqeeqatan yeh qaul bahut hi durust hai ke Allah ke ilm ke muqable mein bande mehez be-ilm hain taqaza-e-adab aur tareeqa-e-guftagu yahi munasib maqam hai, go Anbiya jaante thay ke kis kis ne hamari nabuwwat ko hamare zamane mein tasleem kiya lekin chunke woh zahir ke dekhne wale thay aur Rabb-e-Aalam batin-been hai is liye un ka yahi jawab bilkul durust hai ke hamein haqeeqi ilm mutlaqan nahin tere ilm ki nisbat toh hamara ilm mehez la-ilmi hai haqeeqi Aalim toh sirf ek Tu hi hai.

Janab-e-Masih (Alaihis Salatu Wassalam) par jo ehsanat thay unka aur aapke mojizon ka bayan ho raha hai ke baghair baap ke sirf maa se aap ko paida kiya aur apni kamal-e-qudrat ka nishan aap ko banaya, phir aap ki walida par ehsan kiya ke un ki bara'at isi bachay ke munh se karayi aur jis burayi ki nisbat unki taraf behuda log kar rahe thay Allah ne aaj ke paida shuda bachay ki zaban se un ki pak damni ki shahadat apni qudrat se dilwayi, Jibraeel (A.S) ko apne Nabi ki ta'eed par muqarrar kar diya, bachpan mein aur bari umar mein unhein apni dawat dene wala banaya gaya, gehwaray mein hi bolne ki taqat ata farmayi, apni walida mohtarma ki bara'at zahir kar ke Allah ki ubudiyat ka iqrar kiya aur apni risalat ki taraf logon ko bulaya, murad kalam karne se Allah ki taraf bulana hai warna bari umar mein kalam karna koi khas baat ya ta'ajjub ki cheez nahin. Likhna aur samajhna aap ko sikhaya. Taurat jo Kaleemullah par utri thi aur Injeel jo aap par nazil hui dono ka ilm aap ko sikhaya. Aap mitti se parind ki surat banatay phir us mein dam kar detay to woh Allah ke hukum se chiriya ban kar ur jata, andhon aur korhiyon ke bhala changa karne ki puri tafsir Surah Al-Imran mein guzar chuki hai, murdon ko aap bulatay to woh ba-hukm-e-Ilahi zinda ho kar apni qabron se uth kar aa jatay, Abu Huzail farmatay hain jab Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) kisi murday ke zinda karne ka irada karte to do rakat namaz ada karte pehli mein Surah Tabarak aur dusri mein Surah Alif Lam Meem Tanzeel As-Sajdah parhtay phir Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana parhtay aur uske saat naam aur letay Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyumu, Ya Allah, Ya Rahman, Ya Rahim, Ya Zul-Jalali wal-Ikram, Ya Noor-us-Samawati wal-Ardi thumma bainahuma wa Rabbul Arshil Azeem, yeh asar bara zabardast aur azmat wala hai aur mere is ehsan ko bhi yaad karo ke jab tum dalail-o-barahin le kar apni ummat ke paas aaye aur un mein se jo kafir thay unhon ne isay jadu bataya aur darpay-e-azar huay to unke shar se main ne tumhein bacha liya, unhon ne qatl karna chaha, suli dena chahi, lekin main hamesha tera kafeel-o-hafeez raha is se sabit hota hai ke yeh ehsan aap ke aasman par charha lene ke baad ke hain ya yeh ke yeh khitab aap se baroz-e-Qayamat hoga aur mazi ke sigha se iska bayan us ke pukhta aur yaqeeni hone ke sabab hai. Yeh ghaibi asrar mein se hai jis par Allah Ta'ala ne apne aakhri Nabi ko muttala farma diya, phir apna ek aur ehsan bataya ke main ne tere madadgar aur sathi bana diye, hawariyon ke dil mein ilham aur ilqa kiya. Yahan bhi lafz-e-wahi ka itlaq waisa hi hai jaisa Umm-e-Musa ke baray mein hai aur shehad ki makkhi ke baray mein hai. Unhon ne ilham-e-Rabb par amal kiya, yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai ke main ne teri zabani un tak apni wahi pohanchayi aur unhein qabooliyat ki taufiq di, to unhon ne maan liya aur keh diya ke hum to muslimeen yani tabe-e-farman aur farman-bardar hain.

Janab-e-Masih (Alaihis Salatu Wassalam) par jo ehsanat thay unka aur aapke mojizon ka bayan ho raha hai ke baghair baap ke sirf maa se aap ko paida kiya aur apni kamal-e-qudrat ka nishan aap ko banaya, phir aap ki walida par ehsan kiya ke un ki bara'at isi bachay ke munh se karayi aur jis burayi ki nisbat unki taraf behuda log kar rahe thay Allah ne aaj ke paida shuda bachay ki zaban se un ki pak damni ki shahadat apni qudrat se dilwayi, Jibraeel (A.S) ko apne Nabi ki ta'eed par muqarrar kar diya, bachpan mein aur bari umar mein unhein apni dawat dene wala banaya gaya, gehwaray mein hi bolne ki taqat ata farmayi, apni walida mohtarma ki bara'at zahir kar ke Allah ki ubudiyat ka iqrar kiya aur apni risalat ki taraf logon ko bulaya, murad kalam karne se Allah ki taraf bulana hai warna bari umar mein kalam karna koi khas baat ya ta'ajjub ki cheez nahin. Likhna aur samajhna aap ko sikhaya. Taurat jo Kaleemullah par utri thi aur Injeel jo aap par nazil hui dono ka ilm aap ko sikhaya. Aap mitti se parind ki surat banatay phir us mein dam kar detay to woh Allah ke hukum se chiriya ban kar ur jata, andhon aur korhiyon ke bhala changa karne ki puri tafsir Surah Al-Imran mein guzar chuki hai, murdon ko aap bulatay to woh ba-hukm-e-Ilahi zinda ho kar apni qabron se uth kar aa jatay, Abu Huzail farmatay hain jab Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) kisi murday ke zinda karne ka irada karte to do rakat namaz ada karte pehli mein Surah Tabarak aur dusri mein Surah Alif Lam Meem Tanzeel As-Sajdah parhtay phir Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana parhtay aur uske saat naam aur letay Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyumu, Ya Allah, Ya Rahman, Ya Rahim, Ya Zul-Jalali wal-Ikram, Ya Noor-us-Samawati wal-Ardi thumma bainahuma wa Rabbul Arshil Azeem, yeh asar bara zabardast aur azmat wala hai aur mere is ehsan ko bhi yaad karo ke jab tum dalail-o-barahin le kar apni ummat ke paas aaye aur un mein se jo kafir thay unhon ne isay jadu bataya aur darpay-e-azar huay to unke shar se main ne tumhein bacha liya, unhon ne qatl karna chaha, suli dena chahi, lekin main hamesha tera kafeel-o-hafeez raha is se sabit hota hai ke yeh ehsan aap ke aasman par charha lene ke baad ke hain ya yeh ke yeh khitab aap se baroz-e-Qayamat hoga aur mazi ke sigha se iska bayan us ke pukhta aur yaqeeni hone ke sabab hai. Yeh ghaibi asrar mein se hai jis par Allah Ta'ala ne apne aakhri Nabi ko muttala farma diya, phir apna ek aur ehsan bataya ke main ne tere madadgar aur sathi bana diye, hawariyon ke dil mein ilham aur ilqa kiya. Yahan bhi lafz-e-wahi ka itlaq waisa hi hai jaisa Umm-e-Musa ke baray mein hai aur shehad ki makkhi ke baray mein hai. Unhon ne ilham-e-Rabb par amal kiya, yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai ke main ne teri zabani un tak apni wahi pohanchayi aur unhein qabooliyat ki taufiq di, to unhon ne maan liya aur keh diya ke hum to muslimeen yani tabe-e-farman aur farman-bardar hain.

Bani Israel ki nashukri aur azab-e-Ilahi. Yeh Ma'idah ka waqia hai aur isi ki wajah se is surat ka naam Surah Ma'idah hai. Yeh bhi Janab-e-Masih (A.S) ki nabuwat ki ek zabardast daleel aur aap ka ek aala mojiza hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki dua se aasmani dastarkhwan utara aur aap ki sachai zahir ki. Ba'az aimma ne farmaya hai ke is ka zikr maujooda Injeel mein nahin, Isaiyon ne ise musalmanon se liya hai, wallahu a'lam. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke manne wale aap se tamanna karte hain ke agar ho sake to Allah Ta'ala se ek khwan khane se bhara hua talab kijiye. Ek qira'at mein aayat (هَلْ يَسْتَطِيْعُ رَبُّكَ اَنْ يُّنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا مَاۗىِٕدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاۗءِ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 112) yani kya aap se yeh ho sakta hai? Ke aap Allah Ta'ala se dua karein? Ma'idah kehte hain us dastarkhwan ko jis par khana rakha hua ho. Ba'az logon ka bayan hai ke unhon ne ba-wajah-e-faqr-o-faqa, tangi aur haajat ke yeh sawal kiya tha. Janab-e-Masih (A.S) ne un se farmaya ke Allah par bharosa rakho aur rizq ki talash karo, aise anokhe sawalat na karo, kahin aisa na ho ke yeh fitna ho jaye aur tumhare iman dagmaga jayein.

Unhon ne jawab diya ke ae Allah ke Rasool hum toh khane peene se tang ho rahe hain, mohtaj ho gaye hain. Is se hamare dilon ko itminan ho jayega kyunke hum apni aankhon se apni roziyan aasman se utarti khud dekh lenge. Isi tarah aap par jo iman hai woh bhi barh jayega, aap ki risalat ko yun toh hum maante hi hain lekin yeh dekh kar hamara yaqeen aur barh jayega aur is par khud hum gawah ban jayenge. Allah ki qudrat aur aap ke mojiza ki yeh ek roshan daleel hogi jis ki shahadat hum khud denge aur yeh aap ki nabuwwat ki kaafi daleel hogi. Ab Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki. Eid hone se murad toh eid ka din ya namaz guzarne ka din hona hai ya apne baad walon ke liye yaadgar ka din hona hai ya apni aur apne baad ki naslon ke liye nasihat-o-ibrat hona hai ya aglon pichlon ke liye kaafi-o-wafi hona hai. Hazrat Isa (A.S) farmate hain ya Allah yeh teri qudrat ki ek nishani hogi aur meri sachai ki bhi ke tu ne meri dua qabool farma li. Pas logon tak in baaton ko jo tere naam se hain unhein pahunchaunga, yaqeen kar liya karenge. Ya Allah tu hamein yeh rozi baghair mashaqqat-o-takleef ke mehez apne fazl-o-karam se ata farma, tu toh behtareen raaziq hai. Allah Ta'ala ne dua ki qabooliyat ka wada farma liya aur saath hi yeh bhi farma diya ke is ke utarne ke baad tum mein se jo koi bhi jhutlayega aur kufr karega toh main use woh azab dunga jo tumhare zamane mein kisi aur ko na diya ho. Jaise Aal-e-Firaun ko Qayamat ke din kaha jayega ke tumhein sakht-tar azab mein dakhil ho jao, aur jaise munafiqon ke liye Jahannam ka sab se niche ka tabqa hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Qayamat ke din badtareen azab teen qisam ke logon ko hoga: munafiqon ko, aur Maida-e-Aasmani ke baad inkar karne walon ko, aur Firauniyon ko. Ab in riwayaat ko suniye jo is bare mein salaf se marwi hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne Bani Israel se farmaya ke tum Allah ke liye ek mahine ke rozay rakho phir Rabb se dua karo woh qabool farmayega. Unhon ne tees rozay pooray kar ke kaha ae bhalaion ke batane wale! Hum agar kisi ka kaam ek mah-e-kamil karte toh woh baad-e-faraghat zaroor hamari dawat karta, toh aap bhi Allah se bhare hue khwan ke aasman se utarne ki dua kijiye. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne pehle toh unhein samjhaya lekin un ki nek niyati ke izhaar par Allah Ta'ala se dua ki. Allah Ta'ala ne qabool farmayi, saath hi dhamkaya bhi diya, phir farishton ke hathon aasman se khwan-e-nemat utara, jis par saat machliyan thin, saat rotiyan thin. Jahan yeh thay wahin woh un ke khane ko rakh gaye, sab baith gaye aur shikam-seer ho kar uthay. Ibn Abi Hatim ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke is Maida-e-Aasmani mein gosht-o-roti utra tha, hukum tha ke khayanat na karein, kal ke liye na le jayen lekin unhon ne hukum ki khilaf warzi ki, le bhi gaye aur chura bhi liya, jis ki saza mein woh bandar ban gaye. Hazrat Ammar (R.A) farmate hain is mein Jannat ke meway thay. Aap farmate hain agar woh log khayanat aur zakheera na karte toh woh khwan yun hi rehta lekin sham hone se pehle hi unhon ne choriyan shuru kar din, phir sakht azab kiye gaye. Ae Arab bhaiyo!

Yaad karo tum oonton aur bakriyon ki dumain marorte thay, Allah ne tum par ehsan kiya khud tum hi mein se Rasool ko bheja jin se tum waqif thay jin ke hasb-o-nasab se tum aagah thay, us Rasool (Alaihis Salam) ne tumhein bata diya ke ajmiyon ke mulk tumhare hathon fatah honge lekin khabardar tum sone chandi ke khazanon ke darpay na ho jana lekin wallah din raat wohi hain aur tum woh na rahe, tum ne khazane jama karne shuru kar diye, mujhe toh khauf hai ke kahin tum par bhi Allah ka azab baras na pare, Ishaq bin Abdullah farmate hain jin logon ne Maida-e-Asmani mein se churaya un ka khayal yeh tha ke kahin aisa na ho ke yeh khatam ho jaye aur kal ke liye hamare paas kuch na rahe, Mujahid se marvi hai ke jab woh utarte un par Maida utarta, Atiya farmate hain go woh thi toh machli lekin us mein zaiqa har cheez ka tha, Wahab bin Munabbah farmate hain har din us Maida par aasman se meway utarte thay qisam qisam ki roziyan khate thay, chaar hazar aadmi ek waqt us par baith jate phir Allah ki taraf se ghiza tabdeel ho jati yeh bhi farmate hain ke us par rotiyan jau ki thin, Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain us par siwaye gosht ke tamam cheezein thin. Ikrama farmate hain us par chawal ki roti thi, Hazrat Wahab farmate hain ke un ke is sawal par Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) bahut ranjeeda hue thay aur farmaya tha ke zameen ke rizq par qana'at karo aur aasmani dastarkhwan na mango agar woh utra toh chunke zabardast nishan hoga agar naqadri ki toh buri tarah pakre jaoge.

Samudiyon ki halakat ka ba'is bhi yahi hua ke unhon ne apne Nabi se nishan talab kiya tha lekin hawariyon ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki ek na mani aur israr kiya ke nahin aap zaroor dua kijiye. Ab Janab Isa (A.S) uthay, soof ka jubba utaar diya, siyah baalon ka labada pehan liya aur chadar bhi baalon ki odh li, wuzu kar ke, ghusal kar ke, masjid mein ja kar namaz parh kar qibla ki taraf mutawajja ho kar kharay ho gaye, dono pair milaye, ek pindli dusri pindli se laga li, ungliyan bhi mila lein, apne seenay par apna dahina haath bayen haath par rakha, nigahain zameen mein gaar lein, sar jhuka diya aur nihayat khushoo-o-khuzoo se aajizana taur par girya-o-zari shuru kar di, aansu rukhsaron se beh kar darhi ko tar kar ke zameen par tapakne lage yahan tak ke zameen bhi tar ho gayi. Ab dua ki jis ka bayan is aayat mein hai, Allah Ta'ala ne is dua ko qabool farmaya aur ek surkh rang ka khwan do badalon ke darmiyan aasman se utra, jisay utarte hue sab ne dekha, sab to khushiyan mana rahe thay lekin Roohullah (A.S) kanp rahe thay, rang ud gaya tha aur zaar-o-qatar ro rahe thay ke Allah hi khair kare, zara be-adabi hui to maaray gaye, zaban-e-mubarak se yeh dua nikal rahi thi ke ya Allah isay tu rahmat ka sabab bana, azab ka sabab na bana, ya Allah bahut si ajeeb-o-ghareeb cheezein main ne tujh se talab keen aur tu ne ata farmayin, Bari Ta'ala tu in na'imaton ke shukr ki hamain taufiq ata farma, aye Parwardigar tu apni is na'imat ko hamare liye sabab-e-ghazab na bana, Ilahi tu isay salamti aur aafiyat kar, isay fitna aur azab na kar, yahan tak ke woh khwan zameen tak pahunch gaya aur Hazrat Isa (A.S), hawari aur Isaiyon ke samne rakh diya gaya, is mein se aisi pakeeza khushbu'ein aa rahi thin ke kisi dimagh mein aisi khushbu is se pehle kabhi nahin aayi thi, Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur aap ke as-haab isay dekh kar sajday mein gir pade, Yahudi bhi yeh sab kuch dekh rahe thay aur jal bhun rahe thay. Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur aap ke saathi is dastarkhwan ke gird-o-pesh baith gaye, dekha ke is par ek roomal dhaka hua hai, Masih (A.S) ne farmaya kaun nek bakht jurrat-o-himmat kar ke isay kholta hai? Hawariyon ne kaha aye Kalimatullah (A.S) aap se zyada haqdar is ka kaun hai? Yeh sun kar Hazrat Isa (A.S) kharay hue, naye siray se wuzu kiya, masjid mein ja kar kayi raka'at namaz ada ki, der tak rotay rahe phir dua ki ke ya Allah is ke kholne ki ijazat marhamat ho aur isay barkat-o-rizq bana diya jaye, phir wapas aaye aur Bismillah Khair-ur-Raziqeen keh kar roomal uthaya, to sab ne dekha ke ek bahut bari lambi chauri aur moti bhuni hui machli hai, jis ke oopar chhalka nahin aur jis mein kaantay nahin, ghee is mein se beh raha hai, isi mein har qism ki sabziyan bhi hain, siwaye gandna aur mooli ke, is ke sar ke paas sirka rakha hua hai aur dum ke paas namak hai, sabziyon ke paas paanch rotiyan hain, ek par zaitoon ka tel hai, dusri par khajoorein hain aur ek par paanch anaar hain. Shamoon ne jo hawariyon ke sardar thay kaha ke aye Roohullah (A.S) yeh duniya ka khana hai ya Jannat ka?

Aap ne farmaya abhi tak tumhare sawal khatam nahin hue? Abhi tak kuredna baqi hi hai? Wallah mujhe toh darr lag raha hai ke kahin is par tumhein koi azab na ho, Hazrat Shamoon ne kaha Israel ke Mabood-e-Barhaq ki qasam main kisi sarkashi ki bina par nahin pooch raha, ae sachi maa ke achhe bete! Yaqeen maniye ke meri niyat bad nahin, aap ne farmaya na yeh ta'am-e-dunya hai na ta'am-e-jannat balkeh Allah Ta'ala ne apne khas hukum se ise aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan isi tarah ka paida kar diya hai aur tumhare paas bhej diya hai, ab Allah ka naam le kar khao aur kha kar is ka shukar ada karo shukar guzaron ko woh zyada deta hai aur woh ibtida paida karne wala qadir aur qadr-daan hai, Shamoon ne kaha ae Nabi-e-Allah hum chahte hain ke is nishan-e-qudrat mein hi aur nishan-e-qudrat dekhein. Aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah goya abhi tum ne koi nishan-e-qudrat dekha hi nahin? Achha lo dekho yeh keh kar aap ne us machhli se farmaya ae machhli Allah ke hukum se jaisi tu zinda thi, zinda ho ja, usi waqt Allah ki qudrat se woh zinda ho gayi aur hil jul kar chalne phirne lagi, aankhein chamakne lagein, deede khul gaye aur sher ki tarah munh phaadne lagi aur us ke jism par khapre bhi aa gaye, yeh dekhte hi tamam hazireen darr gaye aur idhar udhar hatne aur dabakne lage, aap ne farmaya dekho toh khud hi nishan talab karte ho khud hi ise dekh kar ghabrate ho wallah mujhe darr lagta hai ke yeh ma'ida-e-aasmani tumhare liye ghazab-e-Allah ka namoona na ban jaye, ae machhli toh ba-hukum-e-Ilahi jaisi thi, waisi hi ho ja, chunancha usi waqt woh waisi hi ho gayi, ab sab ne kaha ke ae Nabi-e-Allah aap ise khana shuru kijiye agar aap ko koi burai na pahunche toh hum bhi kha lenge, aap ne farmaya Ma'azAllah wohi pehle khaye jis ne mangi hai, ab toh sab ke dilon mein dehshat baith gayi ke kahin is ke khane se kisi wabaal mein na par jayein, Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne yeh dekh kar faqiron ko maskeenon ko aur beemaron ko bula liya aur hukum diya ke tum khana shuru kar do yeh tumhare Rab ki di hui rozi hai jo tumhare Nabi ki dua se utri hai, Allah ka shukar kar ke khao tumhein mubarak ho is ki pakar auron par hogi tum Bismillah parh kar khana shuru karo aur Alhamdulillah par khatam karo, pas terah sau aadmiyon ne baith kar pet bhar kar khana khaya lekin woh khana mutlaqan kam nahin hua tha phir sab ne dekha woh dastarkhwan aasman par charh gaya woh kul faqir ghani ho gaye woh tamam beemar tandurust ho gaye aur hamesha tak ameeri aur sehat wale rahe, hawari aur sahabi sab ke sab bare hi nadim hue aur marte dam tak hasrat-o-afsos karte rahe, aap farmate hain is ke baad jab yeh dastarkhwan utarta toh Bani Israel idhar udhar se dore bhage aate kya chota, kya bara, kya ameer, faqir tandurust kya mareez ek bheer lag jati ek dusre par girte parte aate, yeh dekh kar bari muqarrar ho gayi ek din utarta ek din na utarta, chalis din tak yahi kaifiyat rahi ke din charhe utarta aur un ke sone ke waqt charh jata jis ka saya sab dekhte rehte.

Is ke baad farman hua ke ab is mein sirf yateem faqeer aur beemar log hi khayein, maaldaron ne is se bohat bura mana aur lage baatein banane, khud bhi shak mein pad gaye aur logon ke dilon mein bhi tarah tarah ke waswase daalne lage yahan tak Hazrat Isa A.S ke paas aa kar kehne lage ke aap sach sach bataiye ke kya waqai yeh aasman se hi utarta hai? Suniye hum mein se bohat se log is mein mutaraddid hain. Janab-e-Maseeh A.S sakht naraz hue aur farmane lage qasam hai Maseeh ke Rabb ki ab tumhari halakat ka waqt aa gaya, tum ne khud talab kiya, tumhare Nabi ki dua Allah Ta'ala ne qabool farmayi aasmani dastarkhwan tum par utra, tum ne aankhon se ise utarte dekha, Rabb ki rahmat-o-rozi aur barkat tum par nazil hui, badi ibrat-o-nasihat ki nishani tum ne dekh li aah ab tak tumhare dilon ki kamzori na gayi aur tumhari zabanen na rukin, mujhe to dar hai ke agar Rabb ne tum par raham na kiya to anqareeb tum badtareen azabon ke shikar ho jaoge, Allah Ta'ala ne apne bande aur Nabi Hazrat Isa A.S par wahi nazil farmayi ke jis tarah main ne pehle hi farma diya tha ke main in logon ko woh ibratnak sazayein dunga jo kisi ko na di hon. Din ghuroob hua aur yeh be-adab, gustakh, jhutlane wale aur badh badh kar baatein banane wale apne apne bistaron par ja leite nihayat aman-o-aman se hamesha ki tarah apne baal bachon ke sath meethi neend mein the ke pichli raat azab-e-Ilahi aa gaya aur jitne bhi yeh log the sab ke sab suar bana diye gaye jo subah ke waqt pakhano ki paleedi kha rahe the, yeh asar bohat ghareeb hai, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein qissa tukde tukde kar ke manqool hai lekin main ne ise poora bayan kar diya hai taake samajh aa jaye. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Bahar-surat in tamam aasar se saaf zahir hai ke Janab-e-Maseeh A.S ke zamane mein Bani Israel ki talab par aap ki dua se Allah Ta'ala ne aasman se yeh dastarkhwan nazil farmaya. Yehi Quran-e-Azeem ke alfaaz se zahir hai. Baaz ka yeh bhi qaul hai ke yeh Ma'idah utra hi na tha yeh sirf bator-e-misal ke bayan farma diya hai. Chunancha Hazrat Mujahid R.H se manqool hai ke jab azab ki dhamki suni to khamosh ho gaye aur mutalba se dast-bardar ho gaye. Hasan R.H ka qaul bhi yehi hai is qaul ki tayeed is se bhi ho sakti hai ke Nasraniyon ki kutub mein is ka zikr nahin. Itne bade ahem waqiye ka un ki kitabon mein mutlaq na paya jana Hazrat Hasan R.H aur Hazrat Mujahid R.H ke is qaul ko qawi banata hai aur is ki sanad bhi in dono buzurgon tak sehat ke sath pahunchti hai Wallahu A'lam. Lekin jamhoor ka mazhab yehi hai ke Ma'idah nazil hua tha Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H ka mukhtar mazhab bhi yehi hai. Woh farmate hain ke farman-e-Rabbi aayat (Inni munazziluha alaikum faman yakfuru ba'du minkum fa-inni u'azzibuhu azaban la u'azzibuhu ahadan minal alameen) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 115) mein wada hai aur Allah Ta'ala ke wade sache hote hain sahih aur haqeeqi ilm to Allah hi ko hai lekin zyada theek qaul yehi hai jaise ke salaf ke aasar-o-aqwal se zahir hai.

Tareekh mein bhi itna toh hai ke Bani Umayya ke naib Musa bin Naseer ne maghribi shehron ki fath ke mauqa par wahin yeh maida paya tha aur ise Ameer-ul-Momineen Waleed bin Abdul Malik ki khidmat mein jo bani-e-Jame-e-Damishq hain bheja tha lekin abhi qasid raaste hi mein thay ke Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen ka inteqal ho gaya. Aap ke baad aap ke bhai Suleman bin Abdul Malik khalifa huay aur un ki khidmat mein ise pesh kiya gaya yeh har qisam ke jadao aur jawaher se murassa tha jise dekh kar badshah aur darbari sab dang reh gaye yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh maida Hazrat Suleman bin Dawood (A.S) ka tha wallahu aalam, Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Quraishiyon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se kaha Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke woh Safa pahar ko hamare liye sone ka bana de toh hum aap par iman layenge, Aap ne farmaya bilkul sacha wada hai, unhon ne kaha nihayat pukhta aur bilkul sacha. Aap ne dua ki isi waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala aap ko salam kehta hai aur farmata hai ke agar aap chahein toh main Koh-e-Safa ko sone ka bana deta hoon lekin agar phir in logon ne kufr kiya toh main inhein woh azab doonga jo kisi ko na diya ho is par bhi agar aap ka irada ho toh main in ke liye tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza khol doon. Aap ne farmaya ya Allah maaf farma, tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza hi khol de, yeh hadith Ibn-e-Marduyah aur Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi hai.

Bani Israel ki nashukri aur azab-e-Ilahi. Yeh Ma'idah ka waqia hai aur isi ki wajah se is surat ka naam Surah Ma'idah hai. Yeh bhi Janab-e-Masih (A.S) ki nabuwat ki ek zabardast daleel aur aap ka ek aala mojiza hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki dua se aasmani dastarkhwan utara aur aap ki sachai zahir ki. Ba'az aimma ne farmaya hai ke is ka zikr maujooda Injeel mein nahin, Isaiyon ne ise musalmanon se liya hai, wallahu a'lam. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke manne wale aap se tamanna karte hain ke agar ho sake to Allah Ta'ala se ek khwan khane se bhara hua talab kijiye. Ek qira'at mein aayat (هَلْ يَسْتَطِيْعُ رَبُّكَ اَنْ يُّنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا مَاۗىِٕدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاۗءِ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 112) yani kya aap se yeh ho sakta hai? Ke aap Allah Ta'ala se dua karein? Ma'idah kehte hain us dastarkhwan ko jis par khana rakha hua ho. Ba'az logon ka bayan hai ke unhon ne ba-wajah-e-faqr-o-faqa, tangi aur haajat ke yeh sawal kiya tha. Janab-e-Masih (A.S) ne un se farmaya ke Allah par bharosa rakho aur rizq ki talash karo, aise anokhe sawalat na karo, kahin aisa na ho ke yeh fitna ho jaye aur tumhare iman dagmaga jayein.

Unhon ne jawab diya ke ae Allah ke Rasool hum toh khane peene se tang ho rahe hain, mohtaj ho gaye hain. Is se hamare dilon ko itminan ho jayega kyunke hum apni aankhon se apni roziyan aasman se utarti khud dekh lenge. Isi tarah aap par jo iman hai woh bhi barh jayega, aap ki risalat ko yun toh hum maante hi hain lekin yeh dekh kar hamara yaqeen aur barh jayega aur is par khud hum gawah ban jayenge. Allah ki qudrat aur aap ke mojiza ki yeh ek roshan daleel hogi jis ki shahadat hum khud denge aur yeh aap ki nabuwwat ki kaafi daleel hogi. Ab Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki. Eid hone se murad toh eid ka din ya namaz guzarne ka din hona hai ya apne baad walon ke liye yaadgar ka din hona hai ya apni aur apne baad ki naslon ke liye nasihat-o-ibrat hona hai ya aglon pichlon ke liye kaafi-o-wafi hona hai. Hazrat Isa (A.S) farmate hain ya Allah yeh teri qudrat ki ek nishani hogi aur meri sachai ki bhi ke tu ne meri dua qabool farma li. Pas logon tak in baaton ko jo tere naam se hain unhein pahunchaunga, yaqeen kar liya karenge. Ya Allah tu hamein yeh rozi baghair mashaqqat-o-takleef ke mehez apne fazl-o-karam se ata farma, tu toh behtareen raaziq hai. Allah Ta'ala ne dua ki qabooliyat ka wada farma liya aur saath hi yeh bhi farma diya ke is ke utarne ke baad tum mein se jo koi bhi jhutlayega aur kufr karega toh main use woh azab dunga jo tumhare zamane mein kisi aur ko na diya ho. Jaise Aal-e-Firaun ko Qayamat ke din kaha jayega ke tumhein sakht-tar azab mein dakhil ho jao, aur jaise munafiqon ke liye Jahannam ka sab se niche ka tabqa hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Qayamat ke din badtareen azab teen qisam ke logon ko hoga: munafiqon ko, aur Maida-e-Aasmani ke baad inkar karne walon ko, aur Firauniyon ko. Ab in riwayaat ko suniye jo is bare mein salaf se marwi hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne Bani Israel se farmaya ke tum Allah ke liye ek mahine ke rozay rakho phir Rabb se dua karo woh qabool farmayega. Unhon ne tees rozay pooray kar ke kaha ae bhalaion ke batane wale! Hum agar kisi ka kaam ek mah-e-kamil karte toh woh baad-e-faraghat zaroor hamari dawat karta, toh aap bhi Allah se bhare hue khwan ke aasman se utarne ki dua kijiye. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne pehle toh unhein samjhaya lekin un ki nek niyati ke izhaar par Allah Ta'ala se dua ki. Allah Ta'ala ne qabool farmayi, saath hi dhamkaya bhi diya, phir farishton ke hathon aasman se khwan-e-nemat utara, jis par saat machliyan thin, saat rotiyan thin. Jahan yeh thay wahin woh un ke khane ko rakh gaye, sab baith gaye aur shikam-seer ho kar uthay. Ibn Abi Hatim ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke is Maida-e-Aasmani mein gosht-o-roti utra tha, hukum tha ke khayanat na karein, kal ke liye na le jayen lekin unhon ne hukum ki khilaf warzi ki, le bhi gaye aur chura bhi liya, jis ki saza mein woh bandar ban gaye. Hazrat Ammar (R.A) farmate hain is mein Jannat ke meway thay. Aap farmate hain agar woh log khayanat aur zakheera na karte toh woh khwan yun hi rehta lekin sham hone se pehle hi unhon ne choriyan shuru kar din, phir sakht azab kiye gaye. Ae Arab bhaiyo!

Yaad karo tum oonton aur bakriyon ki dumain marorte thay, Allah ne tum par ehsan kiya khud tum hi mein se Rasool ko bheja jin se tum waqif thay jin ke hasb-o-nasab se tum aagah thay, us Rasool (Alaihis Salam) ne tumhein bata diya ke ajmiyon ke mulk tumhare hathon fatah honge lekin khabardar tum sone chandi ke khazanon ke darpay na ho jana lekin wallah din raat wohi hain aur tum woh na rahe, tum ne khazane jama karne shuru kar diye, mujhe toh khauf hai ke kahin tum par bhi Allah ka azab baras na pare, Ishaq bin Abdullah farmate hain jin logon ne Maida-e-Asmani mein se churaya un ka khayal yeh tha ke kahin aisa na ho ke yeh khatam ho jaye aur kal ke liye hamare paas kuch na rahe, Mujahid se marvi hai ke jab woh utarte un par Maida utarta, Atiya farmate hain go woh thi toh machli lekin us mein zaiqa har cheez ka tha, Wahab bin Munabbah farmate hain har din us Maida par aasman se meway utarte thay qisam qisam ki roziyan khate thay, chaar hazar aadmi ek waqt us par baith jate phir Allah ki taraf se ghiza tabdeel ho jati yeh bhi farmate hain ke us par rotiyan jau ki thin, Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain us par siwaye gosht ke tamam cheezein thin. Ikrama farmate hain us par chawal ki roti thi, Hazrat Wahab farmate hain ke un ke is sawal par Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) bahut ranjeeda hue thay aur farmaya tha ke zameen ke rizq par qana'at karo aur aasmani dastarkhwan na mango agar woh utra toh chunke zabardast nishan hoga agar naqadri ki toh buri tarah pakre jaoge.

Samudiyon ki halakat ka ba'is bhi yahi hua ke unhon ne apne Nabi se nishan talab kiya tha lekin hawariyon ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki ek na mani aur israr kiya ke nahin aap zaroor dua kijiye. Ab Janab Isa (A.S) uthay, soof ka jubba utaar diya, siyah baalon ka labada pehan liya aur chadar bhi baalon ki odh li, wuzu kar ke, ghusal kar ke, masjid mein ja kar namaz parh kar qibla ki taraf mutawajja ho kar kharay ho gaye, dono pair milaye, ek pindli dusri pindli se laga li, ungliyan bhi mila lein, apne seenay par apna dahina haath bayen haath par rakha, nigahain zameen mein gaar lein, sar jhuka diya aur nihayat khushoo-o-khuzoo se aajizana taur par girya-o-zari shuru kar di, aansu rukhsaron se beh kar darhi ko tar kar ke zameen par tapakne lage yahan tak ke zameen bhi tar ho gayi. Ab dua ki jis ka bayan is aayat mein hai, Allah Ta'ala ne is dua ko qabool farmaya aur ek surkh rang ka khwan do badalon ke darmiyan aasman se utra, jisay utarte hue sab ne dekha, sab to khushiyan mana rahe thay lekin Roohullah (A.S) kanp rahe thay, rang ud gaya tha aur zaar-o-qatar ro rahe thay ke Allah hi khair kare, zara be-adabi hui to maaray gaye, zaban-e-mubarak se yeh dua nikal rahi thi ke ya Allah isay tu rahmat ka sabab bana, azab ka sabab na bana, ya Allah bahut si ajeeb-o-ghareeb cheezein main ne tujh se talab keen aur tu ne ata farmayin, Bari Ta'ala tu in na'imaton ke shukr ki hamain taufiq ata farma, aye Parwardigar tu apni is na'imat ko hamare liye sabab-e-ghazab na bana, Ilahi tu isay salamti aur aafiyat kar, isay fitna aur azab na kar, yahan tak ke woh khwan zameen tak pahunch gaya aur Hazrat Isa (A.S), hawari aur Isaiyon ke samne rakh diya gaya, is mein se aisi pakeeza khushbu'ein aa rahi thin ke kisi dimagh mein aisi khushbu is se pehle kabhi nahin aayi thi, Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur aap ke as-haab isay dekh kar sajday mein gir pade, Yahudi bhi yeh sab kuch dekh rahe thay aur jal bhun rahe thay. Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur aap ke saathi is dastarkhwan ke gird-o-pesh baith gaye, dekha ke is par ek roomal dhaka hua hai, Masih (A.S) ne farmaya kaun nek bakht jurrat-o-himmat kar ke isay kholta hai? Hawariyon ne kaha aye Kalimatullah (A.S) aap se zyada haqdar is ka kaun hai? Yeh sun kar Hazrat Isa (A.S) kharay hue, naye siray se wuzu kiya, masjid mein ja kar kayi raka'at namaz ada ki, der tak rotay rahe phir dua ki ke ya Allah is ke kholne ki ijazat marhamat ho aur isay barkat-o-rizq bana diya jaye, phir wapas aaye aur Bismillah Khair-ur-Raziqeen keh kar roomal uthaya, to sab ne dekha ke ek bahut bari lambi chauri aur moti bhuni hui machli hai, jis ke oopar chhalka nahin aur jis mein kaantay nahin, ghee is mein se beh raha hai, isi mein har qism ki sabziyan bhi hain, siwaye gandna aur mooli ke, is ke sar ke paas sirka rakha hua hai aur dum ke paas namak hai, sabziyon ke paas paanch rotiyan hain, ek par zaitoon ka tel hai, dusri par khajoorein hain aur ek par paanch anaar hain. Shamoon ne jo hawariyon ke sardar thay kaha ke aye Roohullah (A.S) yeh duniya ka khana hai ya Jannat ka?

Aap ne farmaya abhi tak tumhare sawal khatam nahin hue? Abhi tak kuredna baqi hi hai? Wallah mujhe toh darr lag raha hai ke kahin is par tumhein koi azab na ho, Hazrat Shamoon ne kaha Israel ke Mabood-e-Barhaq ki qasam main kisi sarkashi ki bina par nahin pooch raha, ae sachi maa ke achhe bete! Yaqeen maniye ke meri niyat bad nahin, aap ne farmaya na yeh ta'am-e-dunya hai na ta'am-e-jannat balkeh Allah Ta'ala ne apne khas hukum se ise aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan isi tarah ka paida kar diya hai aur tumhare paas bhej diya hai, ab Allah ka naam le kar khao aur kha kar is ka shukar ada karo shukar guzaron ko woh zyada deta hai aur woh ibtida paida karne wala qadir aur qadr-daan hai, Shamoon ne kaha ae Nabi-e-Allah hum chahte hain ke is nishan-e-qudrat mein hi aur nishan-e-qudrat dekhein. Aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah goya abhi tum ne koi nishan-e-qudrat dekha hi nahin? Achha lo dekho yeh keh kar aap ne us machhli se farmaya ae machhli Allah ke hukum se jaisi tu zinda thi, zinda ho ja, usi waqt Allah ki qudrat se woh zinda ho gayi aur hil jul kar chalne phirne lagi, aankhein chamakne lagein, deede khul gaye aur sher ki tarah munh phaadne lagi aur us ke jism par khapre bhi aa gaye, yeh dekhte hi tamam hazireen darr gaye aur idhar udhar hatne aur dabakne lage, aap ne farmaya dekho toh khud hi nishan talab karte ho khud hi ise dekh kar ghabrate ho wallah mujhe darr lagta hai ke yeh ma'ida-e-aasmani tumhare liye ghazab-e-Allah ka namoona na ban jaye, ae machhli toh ba-hukum-e-Ilahi jaisi thi, waisi hi ho ja, chunancha usi waqt woh waisi hi ho gayi, ab sab ne kaha ke ae Nabi-e-Allah aap ise khana shuru kijiye agar aap ko koi burai na pahunche toh hum bhi kha lenge, aap ne farmaya Ma'azAllah wohi pehle khaye jis ne mangi hai, ab toh sab ke dilon mein dehshat baith gayi ke kahin is ke khane se kisi wabaal mein na par jayein, Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne yeh dekh kar faqiron ko maskeenon ko aur beemaron ko bula liya aur hukum diya ke tum khana shuru kar do yeh tumhare Rab ki di hui rozi hai jo tumhare Nabi ki dua se utri hai, Allah ka shukar kar ke khao tumhein mubarak ho is ki pakar auron par hogi tum Bismillah parh kar khana shuru karo aur Alhamdulillah par khatam karo, pas terah sau aadmiyon ne baith kar pet bhar kar khana khaya lekin woh khana mutlaqan kam nahin hua tha phir sab ne dekha woh dastarkhwan aasman par charh gaya woh kul faqir ghani ho gaye woh tamam beemar tandurust ho gaye aur hamesha tak ameeri aur sehat wale rahe, hawari aur sahabi sab ke sab bare hi nadim hue aur marte dam tak hasrat-o-afsos karte rahe, aap farmate hain is ke baad jab yeh dastarkhwan utarta toh Bani Israel idhar udhar se dore bhage aate kya chota, kya bara, kya ameer, faqir tandurust kya mareez ek bheer lag jati ek dusre par girte parte aate, yeh dekh kar bari muqarrar ho gayi ek din utarta ek din na utarta, chalis din tak yahi kaifiyat rahi ke din charhe utarta aur un ke sone ke waqt charh jata jis ka saya sab dekhte rehte.

Is ke baad farman hua ke ab is mein sirf yateem faqeer aur beemar log hi khayein, maaldaron ne is se bohat bura mana aur lage baatein banane, khud bhi shak mein pad gaye aur logon ke dilon mein bhi tarah tarah ke waswase daalne lage yahan tak Hazrat Isa A.S ke paas aa kar kehne lage ke aap sach sach bataiye ke kya waqai yeh aasman se hi utarta hai? Suniye hum mein se bohat se log is mein mutaraddid hain. Janab-e-Maseeh A.S sakht naraz hue aur farmane lage qasam hai Maseeh ke Rabb ki ab tumhari halakat ka waqt aa gaya, tum ne khud talab kiya, tumhare Nabi ki dua Allah Ta'ala ne qabool farmayi aasmani dastarkhwan tum par utra, tum ne aankhon se ise utarte dekha, Rabb ki rahmat-o-rozi aur barkat tum par nazil hui, badi ibrat-o-nasihat ki nishani tum ne dekh li aah ab tak tumhare dilon ki kamzori na gayi aur tumhari zabanen na rukin, mujhe to dar hai ke agar Rabb ne tum par raham na kiya to anqareeb tum badtareen azabon ke shikar ho jaoge, Allah Ta'ala ne apne bande aur Nabi Hazrat Isa A.S par wahi nazil farmayi ke jis tarah main ne pehle hi farma diya tha ke main in logon ko woh ibratnak sazayein dunga jo kisi ko na di hon. Din ghuroob hua aur yeh be-adab, gustakh, jhutlane wale aur badh badh kar baatein banane wale apne apne bistaron par ja leite nihayat aman-o-aman se hamesha ki tarah apne baal bachon ke sath meethi neend mein the ke pichli raat azab-e-Ilahi aa gaya aur jitne bhi yeh log the sab ke sab suar bana diye gaye jo subah ke waqt pakhano ki paleedi kha rahe the, yeh asar bohat ghareeb hai, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein qissa tukde tukde kar ke manqool hai lekin main ne ise poora bayan kar diya hai taake samajh aa jaye. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Bahar-surat in tamam aasar se saaf zahir hai ke Janab-e-Maseeh A.S ke zamane mein Bani Israel ki talab par aap ki dua se Allah Ta'ala ne aasman se yeh dastarkhwan nazil farmaya. Yehi Quran-e-Azeem ke alfaaz se zahir hai. Baaz ka yeh bhi qaul hai ke yeh Ma'idah utra hi na tha yeh sirf bator-e-misal ke bayan farma diya hai. Chunancha Hazrat Mujahid R.H se manqool hai ke jab azab ki dhamki suni to khamosh ho gaye aur mutalba se dast-bardar ho gaye. Hasan R.H ka qaul bhi yehi hai is qaul ki tayeed is se bhi ho sakti hai ke Nasraniyon ki kutub mein is ka zikr nahin. Itne bade ahem waqiye ka un ki kitabon mein mutlaq na paya jana Hazrat Hasan R.H aur Hazrat Mujahid R.H ke is qaul ko qawi banata hai aur is ki sanad bhi in dono buzurgon tak sehat ke sath pahunchti hai Wallahu A'lam. Lekin jamhoor ka mazhab yehi hai ke Ma'idah nazil hua tha Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H ka mukhtar mazhab bhi yehi hai. Woh farmate hain ke farman-e-Rabbi aayat (Inni munazziluha alaikum faman yakfuru ba'du minkum fa-inni u'azzibuhu azaban la u'azzibuhu ahadan minal alameen) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 115) mein wada hai aur Allah Ta'ala ke wade sache hote hain sahih aur haqeeqi ilm to Allah hi ko hai lekin zyada theek qaul yehi hai jaise ke salaf ke aasar-o-aqwal se zahir hai.

Tareekh mein bhi itna toh hai ke Bani Umayya ke naib Musa bin Naseer ne maghribi shehron ki fath ke mauqa par wahin yeh maida paya tha aur ise Ameer-ul-Momineen Waleed bin Abdul Malik ki khidmat mein jo bani-e-Jame-e-Damishq hain bheja tha lekin abhi qasid raaste hi mein thay ke Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen ka inteqal ho gaya. Aap ke baad aap ke bhai Suleman bin Abdul Malik khalifa huay aur un ki khidmat mein ise pesh kiya gaya yeh har qisam ke jadao aur jawaher se murassa tha jise dekh kar badshah aur darbari sab dang reh gaye yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh maida Hazrat Suleman bin Dawood (A.S) ka tha wallahu aalam, Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Quraishiyon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se kaha Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke woh Safa pahar ko hamare liye sone ka bana de toh hum aap par iman layenge, Aap ne farmaya bilkul sacha wada hai, unhon ne kaha nihayat pukhta aur bilkul sacha. Aap ne dua ki isi waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala aap ko salam kehta hai aur farmata hai ke agar aap chahein toh main Koh-e-Safa ko sone ka bana deta hoon lekin agar phir in logon ne kufr kiya toh main inhein woh azab doonga jo kisi ko na diya ho is par bhi agar aap ka irada ho toh main in ke liye tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza khol doon. Aap ne farmaya ya Allah maaf farma, tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza hi khol de, yeh hadith Ibn-e-Marduyah aur Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi hai.

Aap farmate hain agar woh log khayanat aur zakheera na karte toh woh khwan yun hi rehta lekin sham hone se pehle hi unhon ne choriyan shuru kar din, phir sakht azab kiye gaye. Ae Arab bhaiyo!

Yaad karo tum oonton aur bakriyon ki dumain marorte thay, Allah ne tum par ehsan kiya khud tum hi mein se Rasool ko bheja jin se tum waqif thay jin ke hasb-o-nasab se tum aagah thay, us Rasool (Alaihis Salam) ne tumhein bata diya ke ajmiyon ke mulk tumhare hathon fatah honge lekin khabardar tum sone chandi ke khazanon ke darpay na ho jana lekin wallah din raat wohi hain aur tum woh na rahe, tum ne khazane jama karne shuru kar diye, mujhe toh khauf hai ke kahin tum par bhi Allah ka azab baras na pare, Ishaq bin Abdullah farmate hain jin logon ne Maida-e-Asmani mein se churaya un ka khayal yeh tha ke kahin aisa na ho ke yeh khatam ho jaye aur kal ke liye hamare paas kuch na rahe, Mujahid se marvi hai ke jab woh utarte un par Maida utarta, Atiya farmate hain go woh thi toh machli lekin us mein zaiqa har cheez ka tha, Wahab bin Munabbah farmate hain har din us Maida par aasman se meway utarte thay qisam qisam ki roziyan khate thay, chaar hazar aadmi ek waqt us par baith jate phir Allah ki taraf se ghiza tabdeel ho jati yeh bhi farmate hain ke us par rotiyan jau ki thin, Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain us par siwaye gosht ke tamam cheezein thin. Ikrama farmate hain us par chawal ki roti thi, Hazrat Wahab farmate hain ke un ke is sawal par Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) bahut ranjeeda hue thay aur farmaya tha ke zameen ke rizq par qana'at karo aur aasmani dastarkhwan na mango agar woh utra toh chunke zabardast nishan hoga agar naqadri ki toh buri tarah pakre jaoge.

Samudiyon ki halakat ka ba'is bhi yahi hua ke unhon ne apne Nabi se nishan talab kiya tha lekin hawariyon ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki ek na mani aur israr kiya ke nahin aap zaroor dua kijiye. Ab Janab Isa (A.S) uthay, soof ka jubba utaar diya, siyah baalon ka labada pehan liya aur chadar bhi baalon ki odh li, wuzu kar ke, ghusal kar ke, masjid mein ja kar namaz parh kar qibla ki taraf mutawajja ho kar kharay ho gaye, dono pair milaye, ek pindli dusri pindli se laga li, ungliyan bhi mila lein, apne seenay par apna dahina haath bayen haath par rakha, nigahain zameen mein gaar lein, sar jhuka diya aur nihayat khushoo-o-khuzoo se aajizana taur par girya-o-zari shuru kar di, aansu rukhsaron se beh kar darhi ko tar kar ke zameen par tapakne lage yahan tak ke zameen bhi tar ho gayi. Ab dua ki jis ka bayan is aayat mein hai, Allah Ta'ala ne is dua ko qabool farmaya aur ek surkh rang ka khwan do badalon ke darmiyan aasman se utra, jisay utarte hue sab ne dekha, sab to khushiyan mana rahe thay lekin Roohullah (A.S) kanp rahe thay, rang ud gaya tha aur zaar-o-qatar ro rahe thay ke Allah hi khair kare, zara be-adabi hui to maaray gaye, zaban-e-mubarak se yeh dua nikal rahi thi ke ya Allah isay tu rahmat ka sabab bana, azab ka sabab na bana, ya Allah bahut si ajeeb-o-ghareeb cheezein main ne tujh se talab keen aur tu ne ata farmayin, Bari Ta'ala tu in na'imaton ke shukr ki hamain taufiq ata farma, aye Parwardigar tu apni is na'imat ko hamare liye sabab-e-ghazab na bana, Ilahi tu isay salamti aur aafiyat kar, isay fitna aur azab na kar, yahan tak ke woh khwan zameen tak pahunch gaya aur Hazrat Isa (A.S), hawari aur Isaiyon ke samne rakh diya gaya, is mein se aisi pakeeza khushbu'ein aa rahi thin ke kisi dimagh mein aisi khushbu is se pehle kabhi nahin aayi thi, Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur aap ke as-haab isay dekh kar sajday mein gir pade, Yahudi bhi yeh sab kuch dekh rahe thay aur jal bhun rahe thay. Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur aap ke saathi is dastarkhwan ke gird-o-pesh baith gaye, dekha ke is par ek roomal dhaka hua hai, Masih (A.S) ne farmaya kaun nek bakht jurrat-o-himmat kar ke isay kholta hai? Hawariyon ne kaha aye Kalimatullah (A.S) aap se zyada haqdar is ka kaun hai? Yeh sun kar Hazrat Isa (A.S) kharay hue, naye siray se wuzu kiya, masjid mein ja kar kayi raka'at namaz ada ki, der tak rotay rahe phir dua ki ke ya Allah is ke kholne ki ijazat marhamat ho aur isay barkat-o-rizq bana diya jaye, phir wapas aaye aur Bismillah Khair-ur-Raziqeen keh kar roomal uthaya, to sab ne dekha ke ek bahut bari lambi chauri aur moti bhuni hui machli hai, jis ke oopar chhalka nahin aur jis mein kaantay nahin, ghee is mein se beh raha hai, isi mein har qism ki sabziyan bhi hain, siwaye gandna aur mooli ke, is ke sar ke paas sirka rakha hua hai aur dum ke paas namak hai, sabziyon ke paas paanch rotiyan hain, ek par zaitoon ka tel hai, dusri par khajoorein hain aur ek par paanch anaar hain. Shamoon ne jo hawariyon ke sardar thay kaha ke aye Roohullah (A.S) yeh duniya ka khana hai ya Jannat ka?

Aap ne farmaya abhi tak tumhare sawal khatam nahin hue? Abhi tak kuredna baqi hi hai? Wallah mujhe toh darr lag raha hai ke kahin is par tumhein koi azab na ho, Hazrat Shamoon ne kaha Israel ke Mabood-e-Barhaq ki qasam main kisi sarkashi ki bina par nahin pooch raha, ae sachi maa ke achhe bete! Yaqeen maniye ke meri niyat bad nahin, aap ne farmaya na yeh ta'am-e-dunya hai na ta'am-e-jannat balkeh Allah Ta'ala ne apne khas hukum se ise aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan isi tarah ka paida kar diya hai aur tumhare paas bhej diya hai, ab Allah ka naam le kar khao aur kha kar is ka shukar ada karo shukar guzaron ko woh zyada deta hai aur woh ibtida paida karne wala qadir aur qadr-daan hai, Shamoon ne kaha ae Nabi-e-Allah hum chahte hain ke is nishan-e-qudrat mein hi aur nishan-e-qudrat dekhein. Aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah goya abhi tum ne koi nishan-e-qudrat dekha hi nahin? Achha lo dekho yeh keh kar aap ne us machhli se farmaya ae machhli Allah ke hukum se jaisi tu zinda thi, zinda ho ja, usi waqt Allah ki qudrat se woh zinda ho gayi aur hil jul kar chalne phirne lagi, aankhein chamakne lagein, deede khul gaye aur sher ki tarah munh phaadne lagi aur us ke jism par khapre bhi aa gaye, yeh dekhte hi tamam hazireen darr gaye aur idhar udhar hatne aur dabakne lage, aap ne farmaya dekho toh khud hi nishan talab karte ho khud hi ise dekh kar ghabrate ho wallah mujhe darr lagta hai ke yeh ma'ida-e-aasmani tumhare liye ghazab-e-Allah ka namoona na ban jaye, ae machhli toh ba-hukum-e-Ilahi jaisi thi, waisi hi ho ja, chunancha usi waqt woh waisi hi ho gayi, ab sab ne kaha ke ae Nabi-e-Allah aap ise khana shuru kijiye agar aap ko koi burai na pahunche toh hum bhi kha lenge, aap ne farmaya Ma'azAllah wohi pehle khaye jis ne mangi hai, ab toh sab ke dilon mein dehshat baith gayi ke kahin is ke khane se kisi wabaal mein na par jayein, Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne yeh dekh kar faqiron ko maskeenon ko aur beemaron ko bula liya aur hukum diya ke tum khana shuru kar do yeh tumhare Rab ki di hui rozi hai jo tumhare Nabi ki dua se utri hai, Allah ka shukar kar ke khao tumhein mubarak ho is ki pakar auron par hogi tum Bismillah parh kar khana shuru karo aur Alhamdulillah par khatam karo, pas terah sau aadmiyon ne baith kar pet bhar kar khana khaya lekin woh khana mutlaqan kam nahin hua tha phir sab ne dekha woh dastarkhwan aasman par charh gaya woh kul faqir ghani ho gaye woh tamam beemar tandurust ho gaye aur hamesha tak ameeri aur sehat wale rahe, hawari aur sahabi sab ke sab bare hi nadim hue aur marte dam tak hasrat-o-afsos karte rahe, aap farmate hain is ke baad jab yeh dastarkhwan utarta toh Bani Israel idhar udhar se dore bhage aate kya chota, kya bara, kya ameer, faqir tandurust kya mareez ek bheer lag jati ek dusre par girte parte aate, yeh dekh kar bari muqarrar ho gayi ek din utarta ek din na utarta, chalis din tak yahi kaifiyat rahi ke din charhe utarta aur un ke sone ke waqt charh jata jis ka saya sab dekhte rehte.

Is ke baad farman hua ke ab is mein sirf yateem faqeer aur beemar log hi khayein, maaldaron ne is se bohat bura mana aur lage baatein banane, khud bhi shak mein pad gaye aur logon ke dilon mein bhi tarah tarah ke waswase daalne lage yahan tak Hazrat Isa A.S ke paas aa kar kehne lage ke aap sach sach bataiye ke kya waqai yeh aasman se hi utarta hai? Suniye hum mein se bohat se log is mein mutaraddid hain. Janab-e-Maseeh A.S sakht naraz hue aur farmane lage qasam hai Maseeh ke Rabb ki ab tumhari halakat ka waqt aa gaya, tum ne khud talab kiya, tumhare Nabi ki dua Allah Ta'ala ne qabool farmayi aasmani dastarkhwan tum par utra, tum ne aankhon se ise utarte dekha, Rabb ki rahmat-o-rozi aur barkat tum par nazil hui, badi ibrat-o-nasihat ki nishani tum ne dekh li aah ab tak tumhare dilon ki kamzori na gayi aur tumhari zabanen na rukin, mujhe to dar hai ke agar Rabb ne tum par raham na kiya to anqareeb tum badtareen azabon ke shikar ho jaoge, Allah Ta'ala ne apne bande aur Nabi Hazrat Isa A.S par wahi nazil farmayi ke jis tarah main ne pehle hi farma diya tha ke main in logon ko woh ibratnak sazayein dunga jo kisi ko na di hon. Din ghuroob hua aur yeh be-adab, gustakh, jhutlane wale aur badh badh kar baatein banane wale apne apne bistaron par ja leite nihayat aman-o-aman se hamesha ki tarah apne baal bachon ke sath meethi neend mein the ke pichli raat azab-e-Ilahi aa gaya aur jitne bhi yeh log the sab ke sab suar bana diye gaye jo subah ke waqt pakhano ki paleedi kha rahe the, yeh asar bohat ghareeb hai, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein qissa tukde tukde kar ke manqool hai lekin main ne ise poora bayan kar diya hai taake samajh aa jaye. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Bahar-surat in tamam aasar se saaf zahir hai ke Janab-e-Maseeh A.S ke zamane mein Bani Israel ki talab par aap ki dua se Allah Ta'ala ne aasman se yeh dastarkhwan nazil farmaya. Yehi Quran-e-Azeem ke alfaaz se zahir hai. Baaz ka yeh bhi qaul hai ke yeh Ma'idah utra hi na tha yeh sirf bator-e-misal ke bayan farma diya hai. Chunancha Hazrat Mujahid R.H se manqool hai ke jab azab ki dhamki suni to khamosh ho gaye aur mutalba se dast-bardar ho gaye. Hasan R.H ka qaul bhi yehi hai is qaul ki tayeed is se bhi ho sakti hai ke Nasraniyon ki kutub mein is ka zikr nahin. Itne bade ahem waqiye ka un ki kitabon mein mutlaq na paya jana Hazrat Hasan R.H aur Hazrat Mujahid R.H ke is qaul ko qawi banata hai aur is ki sanad bhi in dono buzurgon tak sehat ke sath pahunchti hai Wallahu A'lam. Lekin jamhoor ka mazhab yehi hai ke Ma'idah nazil hua tha Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H ka mukhtar mazhab bhi yehi hai. Woh farmate hain ke farman-e-Rabbi aayat (Inni munazziluha alaikum faman yakfuru ba'du minkum fa-inni u'azzibuhu azaban la u'azzibuhu ahadan minal alameen) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 115) mein wada hai aur Allah Ta'ala ke wade sache hote hain sahih aur haqeeqi ilm to Allah hi ko hai lekin zyada theek qaul yehi hai jaise ke salaf ke aasar-o-aqwal se zahir hai.

Tareekh mein bhi itna toh hai ke Bani Umayya ke naib Musa bin Naseer ne maghribi shehron ki fath ke mauqa par wahin yeh maida paya tha aur ise Ameer-ul-Momineen Waleed bin Abdul Malik ki khidmat mein jo bani-e-Jame-e-Damishq hain bheja tha lekin abhi qasid raaste hi mein thay ke Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen ka inteqal ho gaya. Aap ke baad aap ke bhai Suleman bin Abdul Malik khalifa huay aur un ki khidmat mein ise pesh kiya gaya yeh har qisam ke jadao aur jawaher se murassa tha jise dekh kar badshah aur darbari sab dang reh gaye yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh maida Hazrat Suleman bin Dawood (A.S) ka tha wallahu aalam, Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Quraishiyon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se kaha Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke woh Safa pahar ko hamare liye sone ka bana de toh hum aap par iman layenge, Aap ne farmaya bilkul sacha wada hai, unhon ne kaha nihayat pukhta aur bilkul sacha. Aap ne dua ki isi waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala aap ko salam kehta hai aur farmata hai ke agar aap chahein toh main Koh-e-Safa ko sone ka bana deta hoon lekin agar phir in logon ne kufr kiya toh main inhein woh azab doonga jo kisi ko na diya ho is par bhi agar aap ka irada ho toh main in ke liye tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza khol doon. Aap ne farmaya ya Allah maaf farma, tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza hi khol de, yeh hadith Ibn-e-Marduyah aur Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi hai.

Bani Israel ki nashukri aur azab-e-Ilahi. Yeh Ma'idah ka waqia hai aur isi ki wajah se is surat ka naam Surah Ma'idah hai. Yeh bhi Janab-e-Masih (A.S) ki nabuwat ki ek zabardast daleel aur aap ka ek aala mojiza hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki dua se aasmani dastarkhwan utara aur aap ki sachai zahir ki. Ba'az aimma ne farmaya hai ke is ka zikr maujooda Injeel mein nahin, Isaiyon ne ise musalmanon se liya hai, wallahu a'lam. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke manne wale aap se tamanna karte hain ke agar ho sake to Allah Ta'ala se ek khwan khane se bhara hua talab kijiye. Ek qira'at mein aayat (هَلْ يَسْتَطِيْعُ رَبُّكَ اَنْ يُّنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا مَاۗىِٕدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاۗءِ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 112) yani kya aap se yeh ho sakta hai? Ke aap Allah Ta'ala se dua karein? Ma'idah kehte hain us dastarkhwan ko jis par khana rakha hua ho. Ba'az logon ka bayan hai ke unhon ne ba-wajah-e-faqr-o-faqa, tangi aur haajat ke yeh sawal kiya tha. Janab-e-Masih (A.S) ne un se farmaya ke Allah par bharosa rakho aur rizq ki talash karo, aise anokhe sawalat na karo, kahin aisa na ho ke yeh fitna ho jaye aur tumhare iman dagmaga jayein.

Unhon ne jawab diya ke ae Allah ke Rasool hum toh khane peene se tang ho rahe hain, mohtaj ho gaye hain. Is se hamare dilon ko itminan ho jayega kyunke hum apni aankhon se apni roziyan aasman se utarti khud dekh lenge. Isi tarah aap par jo iman hai woh bhi barh jayega, aap ki risalat ko yun toh hum maante hi hain lekin yeh dekh kar hamara yaqeen aur barh jayega aur is par khud hum gawah ban jayenge. Allah ki qudrat aur aap ke mojiza ki yeh ek roshan daleel hogi jis ki shahadat hum khud denge aur yeh aap ki nabuwwat ki kaafi daleel hogi. Ab Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki. Eid hone se murad toh eid ka din ya namaz guzarne ka din hona hai ya apne baad walon ke liye yaadgar ka din hona hai ya apni aur apne baad ki naslon ke liye nasihat-o-ibrat hona hai ya aglon pichlon ke liye kaafi-o-wafi hona hai. Hazrat Isa (A.S) farmate hain ya Allah yeh teri qudrat ki ek nishani hogi aur meri sachai ki bhi ke tu ne meri dua qabool farma li. Pas logon tak in baaton ko jo tere naam se hain unhein pahunchaunga, yaqeen kar liya karenge. Ya Allah tu hamein yeh rozi baghair mashaqqat-o-takleef ke mehez apne fazl-o-karam se ata farma, tu toh behtareen raaziq hai. Allah Ta'ala ne dua ki qabooliyat ka wada farma liya aur saath hi yeh bhi farma diya ke is ke utarne ke baad tum mein se jo koi bhi jhutlayega aur kufr karega toh main use woh azab dunga jo tumhare zamane mein kisi aur ko na diya ho. Jaise Aal-e-Firaun ko Qayamat ke din kaha jayega ke tumhein sakht-tar azab mein dakhil ho jao, aur jaise munafiqon ke liye Jahannam ka sab se niche ka tabqa hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Qayamat ke din badtareen azab teen qisam ke logon ko hoga: munafiqon ko, aur Maida-e-Aasmani ke baad inkar karne walon ko, aur Firauniyon ko. Ab in riwayaat ko suniye jo is bare mein salaf se marwi hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne Bani Israel se farmaya ke tum Allah ke liye ek mahine ke rozay rakho phir Rabb se dua karo woh qabool farmayega. Unhon ne tees rozay pooray kar ke kaha ae bhalaion ke batane wale! Hum agar kisi ka kaam ek mah-e-kamil karte toh woh baad-e-faraghat zaroor hamari dawat karta, toh aap bhi Allah se bhare hue khwan ke aasman se utarne ki dua kijiye. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne pehle toh unhein samjhaya lekin un ki nek niyati ke izhaar par Allah Ta'ala se dua ki. Allah Ta'ala ne qabool farmayi, saath hi dhamkaya bhi diya, phir farishton ke hathon aasman se khwan-e-nemat utara, jis par saat machliyan thin, saat rotiyan thin. Jahan yeh thay wahin woh un ke khane ko rakh gaye, sab baith gaye aur shikam-seer ho kar uthay. Ibn Abi Hatim ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke is Maida-e-Aasmani mein gosht-o-roti utra tha, hukum tha ke khayanat na karein, kal ke liye na le jayen lekin unhon ne hukum ki khilaf warzi ki, le bhi gaye aur chura bhi liya, jis ki saza mein woh bandar ban gaye.
