Ab dua ki jis ka bayan is aayat mein hai, Allah Ta'ala ne is dua ko qabool farmaya aur ek surkh rang ka khwan do badalon ke darmiyan aasman se utra, jisay utarte hue sab ne dekha, sab to khushiyan mana rahe thay lekin Roohullah (A.S) kanp rahe thay, rang ud gaya tha aur zaar-o-qatar ro rahe thay ke Allah hi khair kare, zara be-adabi hui to maaray gaye, zaban-e-mubarak se yeh dua nikal rahi thi ke ya Allah isay tu rahmat ka sabab bana, azab ka sabab na bana, ya Allah bahut si ajeeb-o-ghareeb cheezein main ne tujh se talab keen aur tu ne ata farmayin, Bari Ta'ala tu in na'imaton ke shukr ki hamain taufiq ata farma, aye Parwardigar tu apni is na'imat ko hamare liye sabab-e-ghazab na bana, Ilahi tu isay salamti aur aafiyat kar, isay fitna aur azab na kar, yahan tak ke woh khwan zameen tak pahunch gaya aur Hazrat Isa (A.S), hawari aur Isaiyon ke samne rakh diya gaya, is mein se aisi pakeeza khushbu'ein aa rahi thin ke kisi dimagh mein aisi khushbu is se pehle kabhi nahin aayi thi, Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur aap ke as-haab isay dekh kar sajday mein gir pade, Yahudi bhi yeh sab kuch dekh rahe thay aur jal bhun rahe thay. Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur aap ke saathi is dastarkhwan ke gird-o-pesh baith gaye, dekha ke is par ek roomal dhaka hua hai, Masih (A.S) ne farmaya kaun nek bakht jurrat-o-himmat kar ke isay kholta hai? Hawariyon ne kaha aye Kalimatullah (A.S) aap se zyada haqdar is ka kaun hai? Yeh sun kar Hazrat Isa (A.S) kharay hue, naye siray se wuzu kiya, masjid mein ja kar kayi raka'at namaz ada ki, der tak rotay rahe phir dua ki ke ya Allah is ke kholne ki ijazat marhamat ho aur isay barkat-o-rizq bana diya jaye, phir wapas aaye aur Bismillah Khair-ur-Raziqeen keh kar roomal uthaya, to sab ne dekha ke ek bahut bari lambi chauri aur moti bhuni hui machli hai, jis ke oopar chhalka nahin aur jis mein kaantay nahin, ghee is mein se beh raha hai, isi mein har qism ki sabziyan bhi hain, siwaye gandna aur mooli ke, is ke sar ke paas sirka rakha hua hai aur dum ke paas namak hai, sabziyon ke paas paanch rotiyan hain, ek par zaitoon ka tel hai, dusri par khajoorein hain aur ek par paanch anaar hain. Shamoon ne jo hawariyon ke sardar thay kaha ke aye Roohullah (A.S) yeh duniya ka khana hai ya Jannat ka?

Aap ne farmaya abhi tak tumhare sawal khatam nahin hue? Abhi tak kuredna baqi hi hai? Wallah mujhe toh darr lag raha hai ke kahin is par tumhein koi azab na ho, Hazrat Shamoon ne kaha Israel ke Mabood-e-Barhaq ki qasam main kisi sarkashi ki bina par nahin pooch raha, ae sachi maa ke achhe bete! Yaqeen maniye ke meri niyat bad nahin, aap ne farmaya na yeh ta'am-e-dunya hai na ta'am-e-jannat balkeh Allah Ta'ala ne apne khas hukum se ise aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan isi tarah ka paida kar diya hai aur tumhare paas bhej diya hai, ab Allah ka naam le kar khao aur kha kar is ka shukar ada karo shukar guzaron ko woh zyada deta hai aur woh ibtida paida karne wala qadir aur qadr-daan hai, Shamoon ne kaha ae Nabi-e-Allah hum chahte hain ke is nishan-e-qudrat mein hi aur nishan-e-qudrat dekhein. Aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah goya abhi tum ne koi nishan-e-qudrat dekha hi nahin? Achha lo dekho yeh keh kar aap ne us machhli se farmaya ae machhli Allah ke hukum se jaisi tu zinda thi, zinda ho ja, usi waqt Allah ki qudrat se woh zinda ho gayi aur hil jul kar chalne phirne lagi, aankhein chamakne lagein, deede khul gaye aur sher ki tarah munh phaadne lagi aur us ke jism par khapre bhi aa gaye, yeh dekhte hi tamam hazireen darr gaye aur idhar udhar hatne aur dabakne lage, aap ne farmaya dekho toh khud hi nishan talab karte ho khud hi ise dekh kar ghabrate ho wallah mujhe darr lagta hai ke yeh ma'ida-e-aasmani tumhare liye ghazab-e-Allah ka namoona na ban jaye, ae machhli toh ba-hukum-e-Ilahi jaisi thi, waisi hi ho ja, chunancha usi waqt woh waisi hi ho gayi, ab sab ne kaha ke ae Nabi-e-Allah aap ise khana shuru kijiye agar aap ko koi burai na pahunche toh hum bhi kha lenge, aap ne farmaya Ma'azAllah wohi pehle khaye jis ne mangi hai, ab toh sab ke dilon mein dehshat baith gayi ke kahin is ke khane se kisi wabaal mein na par jayein, Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne yeh dekh kar faqiron ko maskeenon ko aur beemaron ko bula liya aur hukum diya ke tum khana shuru kar do yeh tumhare Rab ki di hui rozi hai jo tumhare Nabi ki dua se utri hai, Allah ka shukar kar ke khao tumhein mubarak ho is ki pakar auron par hogi tum Bismillah parh kar khana shuru karo aur Alhamdulillah par khatam karo, pas terah sau aadmiyon ne baith kar pet bhar kar khana khaya lekin woh khana mutlaqan kam nahin hua tha phir sab ne dekha woh dastarkhwan aasman par charh gaya woh kul faqir ghani ho gaye woh tamam beemar tandurust ho gaye aur hamesha tak ameeri aur sehat wale rahe, hawari aur sahabi sab ke sab bare hi nadim hue aur marte dam tak hasrat-o-afsos karte rahe, aap farmate hain is ke baad jab yeh dastarkhwan utarta toh Bani Israel idhar udhar se dore bhage aate kya chota, kya bara, kya ameer, faqir tandurust kya mareez ek bheer lag jati ek dusre par girte parte aate, yeh dekh kar bari muqarrar ho gayi ek din utarta ek din na utarta, chalis din tak yahi kaifiyat rahi ke din charhe utarta aur un ke sone ke waqt charh jata jis ka saya sab dekhte rehte.

Is ke baad farman hua ke ab is mein sirf yateem faqeer aur beemar log hi khayein, maaldaron ne is se bohat bura mana aur lage baatein banane, khud bhi shak mein pad gaye aur logon ke dilon mein bhi tarah tarah ke waswase daalne lage yahan tak Hazrat Isa A.S ke paas aa kar kehne lage ke aap sach sach bataiye ke kya waqai yeh aasman se hi utarta hai? Suniye hum mein se bohat se log is mein mutaraddid hain. Janab-e-Maseeh A.S sakht naraz hue aur farmane lage qasam hai Maseeh ke Rabb ki ab tumhari halakat ka waqt aa gaya, tum ne khud talab kiya, tumhare Nabi ki dua Allah Ta'ala ne qabool farmayi aasmani dastarkhwan tum par utra, tum ne aankhon se ise utarte dekha, Rabb ki rahmat-o-rozi aur barkat tum par nazil hui, badi ibrat-o-nasihat ki nishani tum ne dekh li aah ab tak tumhare dilon ki kamzori na gayi aur tumhari zabanen na rukin, mujhe to dar hai ke agar Rabb ne tum par raham na kiya to anqareeb tum badtareen azabon ke shikar ho jaoge, Allah Ta'ala ne apne bande aur Nabi Hazrat Isa A.S par wahi nazil farmayi ke jis tarah main ne pehle hi farma diya tha ke main in logon ko woh ibratnak sazayein dunga jo kisi ko na di hon. Din ghuroob hua aur yeh be-adab, gustakh, jhutlane wale aur badh badh kar baatein banane wale apne apne bistaron par ja leite nihayat aman-o-aman se hamesha ki tarah apne baal bachon ke sath meethi neend mein the ke pichli raat azab-e-Ilahi aa gaya aur jitne bhi yeh log the sab ke sab suar bana diye gaye jo subah ke waqt pakhano ki paleedi kha rahe the, yeh asar bohat ghareeb hai, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein qissa tukde tukde kar ke manqool hai lekin main ne ise poora bayan kar diya hai taake samajh aa jaye. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Bahar-surat in tamam aasar se saaf zahir hai ke Janab-e-Maseeh A.S ke zamane mein Bani Israel ki talab par aap ki dua se Allah Ta'ala ne aasman se yeh dastarkhwan nazil farmaya. Yehi Quran-e-Azeem ke alfaaz se zahir hai. Baaz ka yeh bhi qaul hai ke yeh Ma'idah utra hi na tha yeh sirf bator-e-misal ke bayan farma diya hai. Chunancha Hazrat Mujahid R.H se manqool hai ke jab azab ki dhamki suni to khamosh ho gaye aur mutalba se dast-bardar ho gaye. Hasan R.H ka qaul bhi yehi hai is qaul ki tayeed is se bhi ho sakti hai ke Nasraniyon ki kutub mein is ka zikr nahin. Itne bade ahem waqiye ka un ki kitabon mein mutlaq na paya jana Hazrat Hasan R.H aur Hazrat Mujahid R.H ke is qaul ko qawi banata hai aur is ki sanad bhi in dono buzurgon tak sehat ke sath pahunchti hai Wallahu A'lam. Lekin jamhoor ka mazhab yehi hai ke Ma'idah nazil hua tha Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H ka mukhtar mazhab bhi yehi hai. Woh farmate hain ke farman-e-Rabbi aayat (Inni munazziluha alaikum faman yakfuru ba'du minkum fa-inni u'azzibuhu azaban la u'azzibuhu ahadan minal alameen) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 115) mein wada hai aur Allah Ta'ala ke wade sache hote hain sahih aur haqeeqi ilm to Allah hi ko hai lekin zyada theek qaul yehi hai jaise ke salaf ke aasar-o-aqwal se zahir hai.

Tareekh mein bhi itna toh hai ke Bani Umayya ke naib Musa bin Naseer ne maghribi shehron ki fath ke mauqa par wahin yeh maida paya tha aur ise Ameer-ul-Momineen Waleed bin Abdul Malik ki khidmat mein jo bani-e-Jame-e-Damishq hain bheja tha lekin abhi qasid raaste hi mein thay ke Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen ka inteqal ho gaya. Aap ke baad aap ke bhai Suleman bin Abdul Malik khalifa huay aur un ki khidmat mein ise pesh kiya gaya yeh har qisam ke jadao aur jawaher se murassa tha jise dekh kar badshah aur darbari sab dang reh gaye yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh maida Hazrat Suleman bin Dawood (A.S) ka tha wallahu aalam, Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Quraishiyon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se kaha Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke woh Safa pahar ko hamare liye sone ka bana de toh hum aap par iman layenge, Aap ne farmaya bilkul sacha wada hai, unhon ne kaha nihayat pukhta aur bilkul sacha. Aap ne dua ki isi waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala aap ko salam kehta hai aur farmata hai ke agar aap chahein toh main Koh-e-Safa ko sone ka bana deta hoon lekin agar phir in logon ne kufr kiya toh main inhein woh azab doonga jo kisi ko na diya ho is par bhi agar aap ka irada ho toh main in ke liye tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza khol doon. Aap ne farmaya ya Allah maaf farma, tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza hi khol de, yeh hadith Ibn-e-Marduyah aur Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi hai.

Roz-e-Qayamat Nasara ki sharmindagi. Jin logon ne Maseeh parasti ya Maryam parasti ki thi, un ki maujoodgi mein Qayamat ke din Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala Hazrat Isa A.S se sawal karega ke kya tum in logon se apni aur apni walida ki pooja paat karne ko keh aaye thay? Is sawal se mardood Nasraniyoon ko daant dapat karna aur un par gusse hona hai taake woh tamam logon ke samne sharminda aur zaleel-o-khwar hoon. Hazrat Qatada R.H waghera ka yahi qaul hai aur is par woh aayat (هٰذَا يَوْمُ يَنْفَعُ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ صِدْقُهُمْ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 119) se istidlal karte hain. Suddi R.H farmate hain yeh khitab aur jawab dena hi kaafi hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H is qaul ko theek bata kar farmate hain ke yeh waqea us waqt ka hai jabke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Isa A.S ko aasman-e-dunya par charha liya tha, is ki daleel ek toh yeh hai ke kalam lafz-e-maazi ke sath hai, dusri daleel aayat (ان تعذبھم) hai lekin yeh dono daleelein theek nahin, pehli daleel ka jawab toh yeh hai ke bohat se umoor jo Qayamat ke din hone wale hain un ka zikr Quran-e-Kareem mein lafz-e-maazi ke sath maujood hai, is se maqsood sirf isi qadar hai ke waqoo aur suboot bakhoobi sabit ho jaye, dusri daleel ka jawab yeh hai ke is se maqsood Janab-e-Maseeh A.S ka yeh hai ke un se apni bara'at zahir kar dein aur un ka mamla Allah ke supurd kar dein, ise shart ke sath mu'allaq rakhne se is ka waqoo lazim nahin jaise ke isi jagah aur aayaton mein hai, zyada zahir wahi tafseer hai jo Hazrat Qatada R.H waghera se marwi hai aur jo oopar guzar chuki hai yani yeh ke yeh guftagu aur yeh sawal jawab Qayamat ke din honge taake sab ke samne Nasraniyoon ki zillat aur un par daant dapat ho chunancha ek marfoo ghareeb-o-aziz hadees mein bhi marwi hai, jise Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir R.H Abu Abdullah Maula Umar bin Abdul Aziz R.H ke halaat mein laye hain ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya Qayamat ke din Ambiya apni apni ummaton samet Allah ke samne bulwaye jayenge phir Hazrat Isa A.S bulwaye jayenge aur Allah Ta'ala apne ehsan unhein jatlayega jin ka woh iqrar karenge farmayega ke ae Isa! jo ehsan main ne tujh par aur teri walida par kiye, unhein yaad kar, phir farmayega tu ne logon se kaha tha ke Allah ko chor kar mujhe aur meri walida ko Ilah samajhna, Aap A.S is ka bilkul inkar karenge, phir Nasraniyoon ko bula kar un se daryaft farmayega toh woh kahenge, haan unhon ne hi hamein is raah par dala tha aur hamein yahi hukm diya tha, isi liye Hazrat Isa A.S ke saare badan ke baal kharay ho jayenge, jinhein le kar farishtay Allah ke samne jhuka denge ba-miqdar ek hazar saal ke yahan tak ke Isaiyoon par hujjat qaim ho jayegi, ab un ke samne saleeb khari ki jayegi aur unhein dhakkay de kar Jahannam mein pohancha diya jayega, Janab-e-Isa A.S ke jawab ko dekhiye ke kis qadar ba-adab aur kamil hai?

Darasal yeh bhi Allah ki ek nemat hai, aap ko isi waqt yeh jawab sikhaya jayega jaise ke ek marfoo hadith mein bhi hai ke aap farmayenge ke Bari Ta'ala mujhe aisi baat kehne ka haq tha na main ne kaha, tujh se na meri koi baat posheeda hai na mera koi irada chupa hua hai, dili raaz tujh par zahir hain, haan tere bhed kisi ne nahin paye tamam dhaki chupi baatein tujh par khuli hui hain ghaibon ka janne wala tu hi hai, jis tableegh par main mamoor aur muqarrar tha main ne toh wahi tableegh ki thi jo kuch mujh se aye janab-e-Bari tu ne irshad farmaya tha wahi bila kam-o-kast main ne un se keh diya tha. Jiska hasil-e-maqsad yeh hai ke sirf ek Allah hi ki ibadat karo, wahi mera Rabb hai aur wahi tum sab ka palanhaar hai, jab main un mein maujood tha un ke aamal dekhta bhalta tha lekin jab tu ne mujhe bula liya phir toh tu hi dekhta bhalta raha aur tu toh har cheez par shahid hai, Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne ek wa'az mein farmaya aye logo tum sab Allah Azza-o-Jal ke samne nange pair, nange badan, be-khatna jama hone wale ho, jaise ke hum ne shuru paidaish ki thi waise hi dobara lautayenge, sab se pehle Khalilullah Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko kapde pehnaye jayenge suno kuch log meri ummat ke aise laye jayenge jinhein bayin janib ghaseet liya jayega toh main kahunga yeh toh mere hain, kaha jayega, aap ko nahin maloom ke aap ke baad unhon ne kya kya gul khilaye thay, toh main wahi kahunga jo Allah ke saleh bande ka qaul hai ke jab tak main un mein raha, un ke aamal par shahid tha, pas farmaya jayega ke aap ke baad yeh toh deen se murtad hi hote rahe. Is ke baad ki ayat ka mazmoon Allah Ta'ala ki chahat aur uski marzi ki taraf kamon ko lautana hai, woh jo kuch chahe karta hai us se koi kisi qisam ka sawal nahin kar sakta aur woh har ek se baaz-purs karta hai, sath hi is maqoolay mein Janab-e-Masih ki bezari hai, un Nasraniyon se jo Allah par aur us ke Rasool par bohtan bandhte thay aur Allah ka shareek thehrate thay aur us ki aulad aur biwi batate thay, Allah Ta'ala un ki in tohmaton se pak hai aur woh buland-o-bartar hai.

Is azeem-ush-shan ayat ki azmat ka izhar is hadith se hota hai, jis mein hai ke poori ek raat Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) isi ek ayat ki tilawat farmate rahe, chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek raat namaz padhi aur subh tak ek hi ayat ki tilawat farmate rahe, isi ko ruku mein aur isi ko sajde mein padhte rahe, woh ayat yahi hai. Subh ko Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne kaha ya Rasool Allah! aaj ki raat toh aap ne isi ek ayat mein guzari, ruku mein bhi is ki tilawat rahi aur sajde mein bhi, aap ne farmaya main ne Allah Ta'ala se apni ummat ki shifa'at ke liye dua ki toh Allah Ta'ala ne is dua ko qabool farma liya, pas meri yeh shifa'at har muwahhid shakhs ke liye hogi, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aur hadith mein hai Hazrat Jurrah bint-e-Dajajah umre ke irade se jaati hain jab Rabzah mein pahunchti hain toh Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se hadith sunti hain ke ek raat Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Isha ki namaz padhayi, farzon ke baad dekha ke sahaba namaz mein mashghool hain toh aap apne khaime ki taraf tashreef le gaye, jab jagah khali ho gayi aur sahaba chale gaye toh aap wapas tashreef laye aur namaz mein khade ho gaye, main bhi aa gaya aur aap ke peeche khada ho gaya toh aap ne apni dayin taraf khada hone ka mujhe ishara kiya, main dayin janib aa gaya, phir Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) aaye aur woh aap ke peeche khade hue toh aap ne apni bayin taraf khade hone ka ishara kiya chunancha woh aa kar bayin janib khade ho gaye, ab hum teenon ne apni apni namaz shuru ki, alag alag tilawat-e-Quran apni namaz mein kar rahe the aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaban-e-mubarak par ek hi ayat thi, baar baar isi ko padh rahe the, jab subh hui toh main ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood se kaha ke zara Huzoor se daryaft toh karo ke raat ko ek hi ayat ke padhne ki kya wajah thi? Unhon ne kaha agar Huzoor khud kuch farmayen toh aur baat hai warna main toh kuch bhi na poochunga, ab main ne khud hi jurrat kar ke aap se daryaft kiya ke Huzoor par mere maa baap fida hon, sara Quran toh aap par utra hai aur aap ke seene mein hai phir aap ne ek hi ayat mein saari raat kaise guzar di? Agar koi aur aisa karta toh hamain toh bahut bura maloom hota, aap ne farmaya apni ummat ke liye dua kar raha tha, main ne poocha phir kya jawab mila? Aap ne farmaya itna achha, aisa pyara, is qadar aasani wala ke agar aam log sun len toh dar hai ke kahin namaz bhi na chhod baithain, main ne kaha mujhe ijazat hai ke main logon mein yeh khush khabri pahuncha doon? Aap ne ijazat di, main abhi kuch hi door gaya hoon ga ke Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne kaha ya Rasool Allah! agar yeh khabar aap ne aam taur par kara di toh dar hai ke kahin log ibadat se be-parwah na ho jayen toh aap ne aawaz di ke laut aaye aur woh ayat (In tu'azzibhum) al-kh, thi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor ne Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ke is qaul ki tilawat ki phir haath utha kar farmaya aye mere Rab meri ummat! aur aap rone lage, Allah Ta'ala ne Jibraeel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ko hukum diya ke ja kar poocho ke kyun ro rahe hain?

Halankeh Allah ko sab kuch maloom hai, Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye daryaft kiya toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya apni ummat ke liye! Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya jao keh do keh hum Aap ko Aap ki ummat ke bare mein khush kar denge aur Aap bilkul ranjeeda na honge, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) farmate hain ek roz Rasool (ﷺ) hamare paas aaye hi nahin yahan tak keh hum ne khayal kiya keh aaj Aap aayenge hi nahin, phir Aap tashreef laye aur aate hi sajde mein gir pade itni der lag gayi keh hamein khauf hua keh kahin Aap ki rooh parwaz na kar gayi ho? Thodi der mein Aap ne sar uthaya aur farmane lage mujh se mere Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal ne meri ummat ke bare mein daryaft farmaya keh main un ke sath kya karoon? Main ne arz kiya keh Bari Ta'ala woh teri makhlooq hai woh sab tere bande aur tere ghulam hain tujhe ikhtiyar hai, phir mujh se dobara mere Allah ne daryaft farmaya main ne phir bhi yahi jawab diya toh mujh se Allah Azz-o-Jal ne farmaya ae Nabi main Aap ko Aap ki ummat ke bare mein kabhi sharminda na karoon ga, suno mujhe mere Rabb ne khushkhabri di hai keh sab se pehle meri ummat mein se mere sath sattar hazar shakhs jannat mein jayenge, har hazar ke sath sattar hazar aur honge, un sab par hisab kitab mutlaqan nahin, phir meri taraf paigham bheja keh mere Habeeb mujh se dua karo main qabool farmaunga mujh se mango main doonga main ne us qasid se kaha keh jo main mangoon mujhe milega? Us ne jawab diya keh han isi liye toh mujhe Allah ne bheja hai, chunancha mere Rabb ne bohat kuch ata farmaya, main yeh sab kuch fakhr ke taur par nahin keh raha, mujhe mere Rabb ne bilkul bakhsh diya, agle pichle sab gunah maaf farma diye halankeh zinda salamat chal phir raha hoon, mujhe mere Rabb ne yeh bhi ata farmaya keh meri tamam ummat qahat-e-sali ki wajah se bhook ke mare halak na hogi aur na sab ke sab maghloob ho jayenge, mujhe mere Rabb ne Hauz-e-Kausar diya hai, woh jannat ki ek nehar hai jo mere hauz mein beh rahi hai, mujhe us ne izzat, madad aur ra'ab diya hai jo ummatiyon ke aage aage mahina bhar ki rah par chalta hai, tamam nabiyon mein sab se pehle main jannat hi mein jaunga, mere aur meri ummat ke liye ghaneemat ka maal halal-e-tayyab kar diya gaya woh sakhtiyan jo pehlon par thin hum par se hata di gayin aur hamare deen mein kisi tarah ki koi tangi nahin rakhi gayi.

Roz-e-Qayamat Nasara ki sharmindagi. Jin logon ne Maseeh parasti ya Maryam parasti ki thi, un ki maujoodgi mein Qayamat ke din Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala Hazrat Isa A.S se sawal karega ke kya tum in logon se apni aur apni walida ki pooja paat karne ko keh aaye thay? Is sawal se mardood Nasraniyoon ko daant dapat karna aur un par gusse hona hai taake woh tamam logon ke samne sharminda aur zaleel-o-khwar hoon. Hazrat Qatada R.H waghera ka yahi qaul hai aur is par woh aayat (هٰذَا يَوْمُ يَنْفَعُ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ صِدْقُهُمْ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 119) se istidlal karte hain. Suddi R.H farmate hain yeh khitab aur jawab dena hi kaafi hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H is qaul ko theek bata kar farmate hain ke yeh waqea us waqt ka hai jabke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Isa A.S ko aasman-e-dunya par charha liya tha, is ki daleel ek toh yeh hai ke kalam lafz-e-maazi ke sath hai, dusri daleel aayat (ان تعذبھم) hai lekin yeh dono daleelein theek nahin, pehli daleel ka jawab toh yeh hai ke bohat se umoor jo Qayamat ke din hone wale hain un ka zikr Quran-e-Kareem mein lafz-e-maazi ke sath maujood hai, is se maqsood sirf isi qadar hai ke waqoo aur suboot bakhoobi sabit ho jaye, dusri daleel ka jawab yeh hai ke is se maqsood Janab-e-Maseeh A.S ka yeh hai ke un se apni bara'at zahir kar dein aur un ka mamla Allah ke supurd kar dein, ise shart ke sath mu'allaq rakhne se is ka waqoo lazim nahin jaise ke isi jagah aur aayaton mein hai, zyada zahir wahi tafseer hai jo Hazrat Qatada R.H waghera se marwi hai aur jo oopar guzar chuki hai yani yeh ke yeh guftagu aur yeh sawal jawab Qayamat ke din honge taake sab ke samne Nasraniyoon ki zillat aur un par daant dapat ho chunancha ek marfoo ghareeb-o-aziz hadees mein bhi marwi hai, jise Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir R.H Abu Abdullah Maula Umar bin Abdul Aziz R.H ke halaat mein laye hain ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya Qayamat ke din Ambiya apni apni ummaton samet Allah ke samne bulwaye jayenge phir Hazrat Isa A.S bulwaye jayenge aur Allah Ta'ala apne ehsan unhein jatlayega jin ka woh iqrar karenge farmayega ke ae Isa! jo ehsan main ne tujh par aur teri walida par kiye, unhein yaad kar, phir farmayega tu ne logon se kaha tha ke Allah ko chor kar mujhe aur meri walida ko Ilah samajhna, Aap A.S is ka bilkul inkar karenge, phir Nasraniyoon ko bula kar un se daryaft farmayega toh woh kahenge, haan unhon ne hi hamein is raah par dala tha aur hamein yahi hukm diya tha, isi liye Hazrat Isa A.S ke saare badan ke baal kharay ho jayenge, jinhein le kar farishtay Allah ke samne jhuka denge ba-miqdar ek hazar saal ke yahan tak ke Isaiyoon par hujjat qaim ho jayegi, ab un ke samne saleeb khari ki jayegi aur unhein dhakkay de kar Jahannam mein pohancha diya jayega, Janab-e-Isa A.S ke jawab ko dekhiye ke kis qadar ba-adab aur kamil hai?

Darasal yeh bhi Allah ki ek nemat hai, aap ko isi waqt yeh jawab sikhaya jayega jaise ke ek marfoo hadith mein bhi hai ke aap farmayenge ke Bari Ta'ala mujhe aisi baat kehne ka haq tha na main ne kaha, tujh se na meri koi baat posheeda hai na mera koi irada chupa hua hai, dili raaz tujh par zahir hain, haan tere bhed kisi ne nahin paye tamam dhaki chupi baatein tujh par khuli hui hain ghaibon ka janne wala tu hi hai, jis tableegh par main mamoor aur muqarrar tha main ne toh wahi tableegh ki thi jo kuch mujh se aye janab-e-Bari tu ne irshad farmaya tha wahi bila kam-o-kast main ne un se keh diya tha. Jiska hasil-e-maqsad yeh hai ke sirf ek Allah hi ki ibadat karo, wahi mera Rabb hai aur wahi tum sab ka palanhaar hai, jab main un mein maujood tha un ke aamal dekhta bhalta tha lekin jab tu ne mujhe bula liya phir toh tu hi dekhta bhalta raha aur tu toh har cheez par shahid hai, Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne ek wa'az mein farmaya aye logo tum sab Allah Azza-o-Jal ke samne nange pair, nange badan, be-khatna jama hone wale ho, jaise ke hum ne shuru paidaish ki thi waise hi dobara lautayenge, sab se pehle Khalilullah Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko kapde pehnaye jayenge suno kuch log meri ummat ke aise laye jayenge jinhein bayin janib ghaseet liya jayega toh main kahunga yeh toh mere hain, kaha jayega, aap ko nahin maloom ke aap ke baad unhon ne kya kya gul khilaye thay, toh main wahi kahunga jo Allah ke saleh bande ka qaul hai ke jab tak main un mein raha, un ke aamal par shahid tha, pas farmaya jayega ke aap ke baad yeh toh deen se murtad hi hote rahe. Is ke baad ki ayat ka mazmoon Allah Ta'ala ki chahat aur uski marzi ki taraf kamon ko lautana hai, woh jo kuch chahe karta hai us se koi kisi qisam ka sawal nahin kar sakta aur woh har ek se baaz-purs karta hai, sath hi is maqoolay mein Janab-e-Masih ki bezari hai, un Nasraniyon se jo Allah par aur us ke Rasool par bohtan bandhte thay aur Allah ka shareek thehrate thay aur us ki aulad aur biwi batate thay, Allah Ta'ala un ki in tohmaton se pak hai aur woh buland-o-bartar hai.

Is azeem-ush-shan ayat ki azmat ka izhar is hadith se hota hai, jis mein hai ke poori ek raat Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) isi ek ayat ki tilawat farmate rahe, chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek raat namaz padhi aur subh tak ek hi ayat ki tilawat farmate rahe, isi ko ruku mein aur isi ko sajde mein padhte rahe, woh ayat yahi hai. Subh ko Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne kaha ya Rasool Allah! aaj ki raat toh aap ne isi ek ayat mein guzari, ruku mein bhi is ki tilawat rahi aur sajde mein bhi, aap ne farmaya main ne Allah Ta'ala se apni ummat ki shifa'at ke liye dua ki toh Allah Ta'ala ne is dua ko qabool farma liya, pas meri yeh shifa'at har muwahhid shakhs ke liye hogi, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aur hadith mein hai Hazrat Jurrah bint-e-Dajajah umre ke irade se jaati hain jab Rabzah mein pahunchti hain toh Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se hadith sunti hain ke ek raat Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Isha ki namaz padhayi, farzon ke baad dekha ke sahaba namaz mein mashghool hain toh aap apne khaime ki taraf tashreef le gaye, jab jagah khali ho gayi aur sahaba chale gaye toh aap wapas tashreef laye aur namaz mein khade ho gaye, main bhi aa gaya aur aap ke peeche khada ho gaya toh aap ne apni dayin taraf khada hone ka mujhe ishara kiya, main dayin janib aa gaya, phir Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) aaye aur woh aap ke peeche khade hue toh aap ne apni bayin taraf khade hone ka ishara kiya chunancha woh aa kar bayin janib khade ho gaye, ab hum teenon ne apni apni namaz shuru ki, alag alag tilawat-e-Quran apni namaz mein kar rahe the aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaban-e-mubarak par ek hi ayat thi, baar baar isi ko padh rahe the, jab subh hui toh main ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood se kaha ke zara Huzoor se daryaft toh karo ke raat ko ek hi ayat ke padhne ki kya wajah thi? Unhon ne kaha agar Huzoor khud kuch farmayen toh aur baat hai warna main toh kuch bhi na poochunga, ab main ne khud hi jurrat kar ke aap se daryaft kiya ke Huzoor par mere maa baap fida hon, sara Quran toh aap par utra hai aur aap ke seene mein hai phir aap ne ek hi ayat mein saari raat kaise guzar di? Agar koi aur aisa karta toh hamain toh bahut bura maloom hota, aap ne farmaya apni ummat ke liye dua kar raha tha, main ne poocha phir kya jawab mila? Aap ne farmaya itna achha, aisa pyara, is qadar aasani wala ke agar aam log sun len toh dar hai ke kahin namaz bhi na chhod baithain, main ne kaha mujhe ijazat hai ke main logon mein yeh khush khabri pahuncha doon? Aap ne ijazat di, main abhi kuch hi door gaya hoon ga ke Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne kaha ya Rasool Allah! agar yeh khabar aap ne aam taur par kara di toh dar hai ke kahin log ibadat se be-parwah na ho jayen toh aap ne aawaz di ke laut aaye aur woh ayat (In tu'azzibhum) al-kh, thi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor ne Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ke is qaul ki tilawat ki phir haath utha kar farmaya aye mere Rab meri ummat! aur aap rone lage, Allah Ta'ala ne Jibraeel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ko hukum diya ke ja kar poocho ke kyun ro rahe hain?

Halankeh Allah ko sab kuch maloom hai, Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye daryaft kiya toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya apni ummat ke liye! Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya jao keh do keh hum Aap ko Aap ki ummat ke bare mein khush kar denge aur Aap bilkul ranjeeda na honge, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) farmate hain ek roz Rasool (ﷺ) hamare paas aaye hi nahin yahan tak keh hum ne khayal kiya keh aaj Aap aayenge hi nahin, phir Aap tashreef laye aur aate hi sajde mein gir pade itni der lag gayi keh hamein khauf hua keh kahin Aap ki rooh parwaz na kar gayi ho? Thodi der mein Aap ne sar uthaya aur farmane lage mujh se mere Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal ne meri ummat ke bare mein daryaft farmaya keh main un ke sath kya karoon? Main ne arz kiya keh Bari Ta'ala woh teri makhlooq hai woh sab tere bande aur tere ghulam hain tujhe ikhtiyar hai, phir mujh se dobara mere Allah ne daryaft farmaya main ne phir bhi yahi jawab diya toh mujh se Allah Azz-o-Jal ne farmaya ae Nabi main Aap ko Aap ki ummat ke bare mein kabhi sharminda na karoon ga, suno mujhe mere Rabb ne khushkhabri di hai keh sab se pehle meri ummat mein se mere sath sattar hazar shakhs jannat mein jayenge, har hazar ke sath sattar hazar aur honge, un sab par hisab kitab mutlaqan nahin, phir meri taraf paigham bheja keh mere Habeeb mujh se dua karo main qabool farmaunga mujh se mango main doonga main ne us qasid se kaha keh jo main mangoon mujhe milega? Us ne jawab diya keh han isi liye toh mujhe Allah ne bheja hai, chunancha mere Rabb ne bohat kuch ata farmaya, main yeh sab kuch fakhr ke taur par nahin keh raha, mujhe mere Rabb ne bilkul bakhsh diya, agle pichle sab gunah maaf farma diye halankeh zinda salamat chal phir raha hoon, mujhe mere Rabb ne yeh bhi ata farmaya keh meri tamam ummat qahat-e-sali ki wajah se bhook ke mare halak na hogi aur na sab ke sab maghloob ho jayenge, mujhe mere Rabb ne Hauz-e-Kausar diya hai, woh jannat ki ek nehar hai jo mere hauz mein beh rahi hai, mujhe us ne izzat, madad aur ra'ab diya hai jo ummatiyon ke aage aage mahina bhar ki rah par chalta hai, tamam nabiyon mein sab se pehle main jannat hi mein jaunga, mere aur meri ummat ke liye ghaneemat ka maal halal-e-tayyab kar diya gaya woh sakhtiyan jo pehlon par thin hum par se hata di gayin aur hamare deen mein kisi tarah ki koi tangi nahin rakhi gayi.

Us ne jawab diya keh han isi liye toh mujhe Allah ne bheja hai, chunancha mere Rabb ne bohat kuch ata farmaya, main yeh sab kuch fakhr ke taur par nahin keh raha, mujhe mere Rabb ne bilkul bakhsh diya, agle pichle sab gunah maaf farma diye halankeh zinda salamat chal phir raha hoon, mujhe mere Rabb ne yeh bhi ata farmaya keh meri tamam ummat qahat-e-sali ki wajah se bhook ke mare halak na hogi aur na sab ke sab maghloob ho jayenge, mujhe mere Rabb ne Hauz-e-Kausar diya hai, woh jannat ki ek nehar hai jo mere hauz mein beh rahi hai, mujhe us ne izzat, madad aur ra'ab diya hai jo ummatiyon ke aage aage mahina bhar ki rah par chalta hai, tamam nabiyon mein sab se pehle main jannat hi mein jaunga, mere aur meri ummat ke liye ghaneemat ka maal halal-e-tayyab kar diya gaya woh sakhtiyan jo pehlon par thin hum par se hata di gayin aur hamare deen mein kisi tarah ki koi tangi nahin rakhi gayi.

Muwahhideen ke liye khush khabriyaan. Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ko un ki baat ka jo jawab Qayamat ke din mile ga us ka bayan ho raha hai ke aaj ke din muwahhidon ko tauheed nafa degi, woh hameshangi wali jannat mein jayenge, woh Allah se khush honge aur Allah un se khush hoga, fi-al-waqai Rabb ki razamandi zabardast cheez hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki hadith mein hai ke phir Allah Ta'ala un par tajalli farmaye ga aur un se kahe ga tum jo chaho mujh se mango main doon ga, woh Allah Ta'ala se us ki khushnudi talab karenge, Allah Ta'ala sab ke samne apni razamandi ka izhar kare ga, phir farmata hai yeh aisi bemisal kamyabi hai jis se barh kar aur koi kamyabi nahin ho sakti, jaise aur jagah hai isi ke liye amal karne walon ko amal ki koshish karni chahiye aur aayat mein hai raghbat karne wale is ki raghbat kar lein, phir farmata hai sab ka khaliq, sab ka malik, sab par qadir, sab ka mutasarrif Allah Ta'ala hi hai, har cheez isi ki malkiyat mein isi ke qabze mein isi ki chahat mein hai, is jaisa koi nahin, na koi is ka wazir-o-musheer hai, na koi nazeer-o-adeel hai na is ki maa hai, na baap, na aulad na biwi. Is ke siwa koi mabood nahin na koi is ke siwa Rabb hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain. Sab se aakhri surat yahi Surah Ma'idah utri hai. (Alhamdulillah Surah Ma'idah ki tafsir khatam hui).
